chapter: Obligation Of Shrouding
arabicText: هتروع ودبت لائلو ،دسجلا رهاط لجو زع هبر ىقليل تيملا نفكي نأ رمأ امنإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع كلذ لثم ىلإ رظنلبا بلقلا وسقي لائلو ،هرظنم حبقو هلاح ضعب لىع سانلا رظني لائلو ،هنفدي وأ هلمحي نمل اميف هظفحي لاف ،هتدومو هركذ ىغليف هميمح هضغبي لائلو ،ءايحلاا سفنلا بيطأ نوكيلو ،داسفلاو ةهاعلل .بحأو هب هرمأو هب هاصوأو فلخ
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: The deceased was commanded to be shrouded so that he meets his Lord, the Mighty and Majestic, with a pure body, and so that his private parts are not exposed to those who carry or bury him, and so that people do not see his condition and unsightly appearance, and so that hearts do not harden by looking at such disability and decay, and so that it is more pleasant for the souls of the living, and so that his loved ones do not come to dislike him and forget his memory and affection, thus failing to preserve what he left behind, what he entrusted them with, what he commanded them with, and what he loved.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: ضورفملا نفكلا امنإ ،لا :لقا ؟يه نفكلا نم ،تيملل ةمامعلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ تلق :لقا ةرارز نع داز امف ،ةسمخ غلبي نأ ىلإ ،ةنس وهف داز امف ،هلك هدسج هيف ىراوي هنم لقأ لا متا بوث وأ ،باوثأ ةثلاث دبع وبأ انثعبو) ،يبنلا ممعو ،ةمامعلبا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا رمأ :لقاو ،ةنس ةمامعلاو ،عدتبمف اطونح يرتشن نبأ نارمفأ ،رانيدب انعم ثعبو ،ءاذحلا ةديبع وبأ تامو ةنيدملبا نحنو ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله .(انلعفف ةمامعو
englishText: From Zurarah who said: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): Is the turban for the deceased considered part of the shroud? He said: No. The obligatory shroud consists of three pieces of cloth, or one complete piece no less than what covers his entire body. Whatever is more than that is Sunnah, up to five pieces. Whatever exceeds that is an innovation. The turban is Sunnah. He said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) ordered the use of turban, and the Prophet was wrapped with a turban. And Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) sent us while we were in Medina when Abu Ubaidah al-Hadha died, and he sent with us a dinar, ordering us to buy perfume and a turban, which we did.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: ،ملسم نب دمحمو ةرارز نع ،زيرح نع ،نامثع نب دامح نع ،هيبأ نع ،ميهاربإ نب ليع نع ينيلكلا هاورو .متا بوث و ،باوثأ ةثلاث ضورفملا نفكلا امنإ :لقا هنأ لاإ هلثم
englishText: Al-Kulayni narrated it from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Hareez, from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim, similar to it except that he said: The obligatory shroud consists of three pieces of cloth and one complete piece.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: ي ف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نفك :لوقي ملاسلاهيلع) رفعج باأ تعمس :لقا يراصنلأا ميرم يبأ نع هيلع) ليع نب نسحلا نإ :لقاو - لقا نأ ىلإ - نييراحص نيضيبأ نيبوثو ،ةربح رمحأ درب :باوثأ ةثلاث رمحأ درب يف فينح نب لهس نفك (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع نإو ،ةربح رمحأ درب يف ديز نب ةماسأ نفك (ملاسلا .ةربح
englishText: From Abu Maryam al-Ansari who said: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was shrouded in three garments: a red striped Yemeni cloth, and two white Suhari (*) cloths- then he said and Al-Hasan bin Ali (peace be upon him) shrouded Usama bin Zayd in a red striped Yemeni cloth, and Ali (peace be upon him) shrouded Sahl bin Hunayf in a red striped Yemeni cloth. Translator: * A cotton fabric from the Al-Yamamah region in the Arabian Peninsula.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: نيبوث :باوثأ ةثلاث يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نفك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع .نادلب امهو ،رافظ نم يربع حيحصلاو .رافظأ وأ ،يربع هنمي بوثو ،نييراحص
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was shrouded in three garments: two Suhari cloths, and one Yemeni Abari cloth, or Zafari. The correct one is Abari from Zafar, and they are two places.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: ،نفكلا كلذ بحأ :لقا ؟اهيف نفكيأ ،موصيو لجرلا اهيف ليصي يتلا بايثلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس .يلإ بحأ صيمقلاو ،هب سبأ لا :لقا ؟باوثأ ةثلاث يف جردي :تلق .اصيمق ينعي
englishText: I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the clothes in which a man prays and fasts, can he be shrouded in them? He said: I prefer that shroud, meaning a shirt. I said: Should he be wrapped in three garments? He said: There is no problem with it, but I prefer the shirt.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: نفك امنإو ،باوثأ ةثلاث :لقا ؟تيملا هب نفكي امع هتلأس :لقا ةعامس نع ،ةعرز نع ،نسحلا نع هدانسإبو ،ةماميلبا نوكت ةيراحصلاو ،ةربح بوثو ،نييراحص نيبوث :باوثأ ةثلاث يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر .باوثأ ةثلاث يف (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ نفكو
englishText: In the chain from Al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah who said: I asked him about what a deceased person should be shrouded in? He said: Three cloths, and indeed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was shrouded in three cloths: two Sahari cloths and one Hibrah cloth. The Sahari cloths are from Yamamah, and Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) was shrouded in three cloths.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: ةقرخلاو ةمامعلاو ،باوثأ ةثلاث لاجرلل ةضيرف نفكلا :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) رفعج يبأ وأ الله دبع يبأ نع .باوثأ ةسمخ هتضيرفف ءاسنلا امأو ،ةنس
englishText: From Abu Abdullah or Abu Ja'far (peace be upon them) who said: The obligatory shroud for men is three cloths, while the turban and rag are sunnah, and for women the obligation is five cloths.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: اهب دشيف ةقرخ ذخؤت :لقا ؟نفكلبا عنصأ فيك :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا نانس نب الله دبع نع ،ئش هنم جرخي لائل كانه ام مضتل عنصت امنإ ،ائيش دعت لا اهنإ ،لا :لقا ؟رازلإفا :تلق ،هيلجرو هتدعقم لىع ريغ صيمق نفكلا مث :لقا ،هيلجر نم عزنيو ،لسغ اذإ صيمقلا قرخي مث ،اهنم لضفأ نطقلا نم عنصي امو .هيلجر لىع اهلضف دريو ،هسأر اهب بصعي ةمامعو ،فوفكم لاو رورزم
englishText: From Abdullah bin Sinan who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): How should I prepare the shroud? He said: Take a cloth and tie it around his posterior and legs. I said: What about the waist wrapper? He said: No, it is not counted as anything, it is only made to hold what is there so nothing comes out, and what is made from cotton is better than it. Then the shirt is torn after washing and removed from his feet. Then the shroud is an unsewn shirt without buttons or hem, and a turban to wrap his head, with its excess returned to his feet (*). Shaykh Hurr Amili: * This is a misspelling, the correct version is: its excess placed on his face, mentioned by the author of Al-Muntaqa, and evidence for this will come.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: عرد :ةسمخ يف ةميظع تناك اذإ ةأرملاو ،باوثأ ةثلاث يف لجرلا نفكي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .نيتفافلو رامخو قطنمو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: A man is shrouded in three cloths, and a woman if she is large in five: a dress, a waistband, a head cover, and two wrapping sheets.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: ناك ،ةربح هل ءادر اهدحأ ،باوثأ ةثلاث يف هنفكأ نأ هتيصو يف يبأ بتك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع نإو ،سانلا كبلغي نأ فاخأ :لاقف ؟اذه بتكت مل :يبلأ تلقف ،صيمقو رخآ بوثو ،ةعمجلا موي هيف لىصي ام دعي امنإ نفكلا نم ةمامعلا دعت سيلو ،ةمامعب (دعب هممعو) لعفت لاف ،ةسمخ وأ ةعبرأ يف هنفك :اولقا .دسجلا هب فلي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: My father wrote in his will that I should shroud him in three cloths, one of them being his Hibra cloak that he used to pray in on Fridays, and another cloth, and a shirt. I said to my father: Why did you write this? He said: I fear that people might overwhelm you, and if they say shroud him in four or five, do not do it. And later he added: And wrap him with a turban, but the turban is not counted as part of the shroud, only what wraps the body is counted.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: دربو ،نييراحص نيبوث :باوثأ ةثلاث يف :لقا ؟نفك مب ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نع الله وبأ لئس .ةربح
englishText: Abu Abdullah was asked about the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), what was he shrouded in? He said: In three cloths: two Suhari cloths and a Hibra cloak.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: ودبي لايكل هيكرو اهب دشي ةقرخلاو ،ةمامعلا ىوس ةثلاث يف نفكي تيملا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .نفكلا نم اتسيلو ،امهنم دب لا ةمامعلاو ةقرخلاو ،ئش هنم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The deceased is shrouded in three pieces besides the turban and the cloth that ties his hips so nothing shows from him. The cloth and turban are necessary but they are not counted from the shroud.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: ةقرخو ،رازإو ،هيلع رزي لا صيمق :باوثأ ةسمخ يف تيملا نفكي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هردص لىع اهلضف ىقليو اهب متعي ةمامعو ،هيف فلي دربو ،هطسو اهب بصعي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The deceased is shrouded in five pieces of cloth: a shirt that is not buttoned, a waist wrap, a cloth to tie around his middle, a garment to wrap him in, and a turban that is wrapped with its excess placed on his chest.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: ءادر اهدحأ :باوثأ ةثلاث يف هنفكأ نأ هتيصو يف بتك يبأ نإ :- ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .ةمامعب كلذ دعب هانبصعو ،سانلا لوق ةفاخم :لقا ؟اذه تبتك ملو :تلق ،صيمقو ،رخآ بوثو ،ةربح هل
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said in a hadith: My father wrote in his will that I should shroud him in three pieces of cloth: one of them being his striped cloak, another cloth, and a shirt. I asked: Why did you write this? He said: For fear of what people would say. And after that we wrapped him with a turban.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: ،امهيف مرحي ناك نييوطش نيبوث يف يبأ تنفك ينإ لوقي هتعمس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا يبأ نع مويلا ناك ول ،ارانيد نيعبربأ هتيرتشا درب يفو ،نيسحلا نب ليعل تناك ةمامع و ،هصمق نم صيمق يفو .رانيد ةئامعبرأ ىواسل
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him), he said: I heard him say: I shrouded my father in two Shatwi (*) garments in which he used to enter ihram, and in one of his shirts, and a turban that belonged to Ali bin Al-Husayn, and in a cloak that I bought for forty dinars, which today would be worth four hundred dinars. Translator: * Derived from the word "shatw" which means to fold or double, referring to a type of garment that is folded or doubled

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: ىلإ يدثلا مضت ةقرخ اهييدث لىع دشن ناأ ريغ لجرلا نفكي امك :لاقف ؟ةأرملا نفكت فيك :هتلأس :لهس نع ،طونحلاو نطقلبا ربدلاو لبقلا ىشحيو ،لاجرلل عنصي امم رثكأ نطقلا اهل عنصيو ،اهرهظ لىع دشنو ،ردصلا .اديدش ادش ةقرخلا اهيلع دشي مث
englishText: From Sahl: I asked him: How is a woman shrouded? He said: Like how a man is shrouded except that we tie a cloth over her breasts to press them against the chest, and we tie it on her back, and more cotton is used for her than for men, and cotton and hanut (camphor) are stuffed in the front and back private parts, then the cloth is tied tightly over her.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: نفك بوث مك يف ،الله دبع باأ يا :هل لقا ريثك نب دابع نأ - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةلق دربلا يف ناكو ،ةربح بوثو ،نييراحص نيبوث :باوثأ ةثلاث يف :لقا ؟(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- that Abbad bin Kathir said to him: O Abu Abdullah, in how many cloths was the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) shrouded? He said: In three cloths: two Sahari cloths and one Hibra cloth, and there was a scarcity of cloaks at that time.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: نفكت مك يف :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا الله دبع يبأ نب نمحرلا دبع نع ،نامثع نب نباأ نع .رامخلا اهدحأ :باوثأ ةسمخ يف نفكت :لقا ؟ةأرملا
englishText: From Aban ibn Uthman, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abu Abdullah who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): In how many cloths should a woman be shrouded? He said: She should be shrouded in five cloths, one of them being the head cover.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: نم نيتيرفظ نيتدرب يف :باوثأ ةثلاث يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نفك :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .نطق بوث وهو فسرك بوثو ،نميلا بايث
englishText: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was shrouded in three cloths: in two Yemeni Zafari cloaks and a cotton garment.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: لا :لقا ؟صيمق ريغب باوثأ ةثلاث يف نفكيأ ،تومي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم لئسو :لقا .يلإ بحأ صيمقلاو ،كلذب سبأ
englishText: He said: And Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) was asked about a man who dies, should he be shrouded in three cloths without a shirt? He said: There is no problem with that, though I prefer including the shirt.

chapter: Number Of Obligatory And Recommended Shroud Pieces, And Some Of Their Rulings
arabicText: :هل تلقف :لقا ،هب يلإ ثعبف ،ينفكل هدعأ هصمق نم صيمقب يلإ ثعبي نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس .هرارزأ عزنا :لقا ؟هب عنصأ فيك
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): I asked him to send me one of his shirts so I could prepare it for my shroud, and he sent it to me. I said to him: What should I do with it? He said: Remove its buttons.

chapter: Recommendation For Camphor In Embalming To Be Thirteen And One-Third Dirhams No More, Or Four Mithqals, Or One Mithqal, Whether For A Man Or Woman
arabicText: ،امهرد نيعبرأ هنزو ناكو ،طونحب (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لىع لزن (ملاسلا هيلع) ليئربج نإ .(ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطافل اءزجو ليعل اءزجو ،هل اءزج :ءازجأ ةثلاث (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر اهمسقف
englishText: Gabriel (peace be upon him) descended upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) with embalming camphor weighing forty dirhams, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) divided it into three parts: a part for himself, a part for Ali, and a part for Fatima (peace be upon her).

chapter: Recommendation For Camphor In Embalming To Be Thirteen And One-Third Dirhams No More, Or Four Mithqals, Or One Mithqal, Whether For A Man Or Woman
arabicText: .لاقثم تيملل روفاكلا نم يزجي ام لقأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The minimum amount of camphor sufficient for the deceased is one mithqal.

chapter: Recommendation For Camphor In Embalming To Be Thirteen And One-Third Dirhams No More, Or Four Mithqals, Or One Mithqal, Whether For A Man Or Woman
arabicText: .ليقاثم ةعبرأ كلذ نم دصقلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The appropriate amount of that is four mithqals.

chapter: Recommendation For Camphor In Embalming To Be Thirteen And One-Third Dirhams No More, Or Four Mithqals, Or One Mithqal, Whether For A Man Or Woman
arabicText: .ليقاثم ةعبرأ روفاكلا نم دصقلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The appropriate amount of camphor is four mithqals.

chapter: Recommendation For Camphor In Embalming To Be Thirteen And One-Third Dirhams No More, Or Four Mithqals, Or One Mithqal, Whether For A Man Or Woman
arabicText: .فصنو لاقثم تيملل روفاكلا نم يزجي ام لقأ :لقا :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The minimum amount of camphor sufficient for the deceased is one and a half mithqal.

chapter: Recommendation For Camphor In Embalming To Be Thirteen And One-Third Dirhams No More, Or Four Mithqals, Or One Mithqal, Whether For A Man Or Woman
arabicText: ةيقولأاو ،ةنجلا نم روفاك ةيقوبأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ىتأ ليئربج نإ :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم اهيلع) ةمطافل اثلثو ،ليعل اثلثو ،هل اثلث :ثلاثأ ةثلاث (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا اهلعجف ،امهرد نوعبرأ .(ملاسلا
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: Gabriel came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) with one ounce of camphor from Paradise, and the ounce is forty dirhams, so the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) divided it into three thirds: a third for himself, a third for Ali, and a third for Fatima (peace be upon her).

chapter: Recommendation For Camphor In Embalming To Be Thirteen And One-Third Dirhams No More, Or Four Mithqals, Or One Mithqal, Whether For A Man Or Woman
arabicText: .ثلثو امهرد رشع ةثلاث طونحلا يف ةنسلا :لقا هعفري نانس نبا نع (للعلا) يفو
englishText: And in (Al-Ilal) from Ibn Sinan who raises it [to an Imam] said: The sunnah regarding embalming is thirteen and one-third dirhams.

chapter: Recommendation For Camphor In Embalming To Be Thirteen And One-Third Dirhams No More, Or Four Mithqals, Or One Mithqal, Whether For A Man Or Woman
arabicText: نيعبرأ هنزو ناكو ،طونحب (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لىع لزن ليئربج نأ اوورو :دمحأ نب دمحم لقا اهيلع) ةمطافل اءزجو ،ليعل اءزجو ،هل اءزج :ءازجأ ةثلاث (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر همسقف ،امهرد .(ملاسلا
englishText: Muhammad bin Ahmad said: They narrated that Gabriel descended upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) with embalming perfume (Hanut), and its weight was forty dirhams. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) divided it into three parts: a part for himself, a part for Ali, and a part for Fatima (peace be upon her).

chapter: Recommendation For Camphor In Embalming To Be Thirteen And One-Third Dirhams No More, Or Four Mithqals, Or One Mithqal, Whether For A Man Or Woman
arabicText: الله لىص) يبنلا ىتأ ليئربج نإ :تلقا (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا نأ يور :لقا (ةمغلا فشك) يف ىسيع نب ليع ناكو ،يل اثلثو ،ليعل اثلثو ،هسفنل اثلث :ثالاثأ همسقف ،ةنجلا نم روفاكب - ةفاولا هترضح امل - (هلآو هيلع .امهرد نيعبرأ
englishText: Ali bin Isa said in (Kashf al-Ghummah): It is narrated that Fatima (peace be upon her) said: Gabriel came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family)- when death approached him- with camphor from Paradise, and he divided it into thirds: a third for himself, a third for Ali, and a third for me, and it was forty dirhams.

chapter: Recommendation For Camphor In Embalming To Be Thirteen And One-Third Dirhams No More, Or Four Mithqals, Or One Mithqal, Whether For A Man Or Woman
arabicText: يف ناك :(ملاسلا هيلع) بلاط يبأ نب ليع لقا :لقا هيبأ نع ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نسحلا يبأ نع ياو ،ليع يا :لاقف ،ليلقب هتفاو لبق (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر يناعدف ،طونحلا يلإ عفدي نأ ةيصولا يل هنم لازعاو ،هامسقا :امكل لوقيو ،ملاسلا امكأرقي وهو ،ليئربج يلإ هعفد ةنجلا نم يطونح اذه ،ةمطفا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) بلاط يبأ نب ليع يقابلا يف رظانلا نكيلو ،(كل هثلث :تلقا) ،امكلو ،اهل يقب ام فصن :لقا ،يقابلا يف لق ،ليع يا :لقاو ،هيلإ امهمضو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر كىبف .هضبقفا كل وه :لقا ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر يا ىرت نمل فصنلاو
englishText: From Abu al-Hasan Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him), from his father who said: Ali bin Abi Talib (peace be upon him) said: It was in the will that the Hanut should be given to me, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) called me shortly before his death and said: "O Ali, and O Fatima, this is my Hanut from Paradise which Gabriel gave to me, and he sends his greetings to both of you, and says to you both: divide it, and set aside from it for me and for you both, (she said: a third of it for you), and let Ali bin Abi Talib (peace be upon him) be the overseer of what remains." Then the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) wept and embraced them both, and said: "O Ali, speak regarding what remains." He said: "Half of what remains is for her, and half for whoever you see fit, O Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)." He said: "It is for you, so take it."

chapter: Recommendation Of Shrouding The Deceased In Garments Used For Prayer And Fasting
arabicText: هيف ليصي ناك بوث هنفك يف نوكي نأ تعطتسا نفإ هنفكت نأ تدرأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .هيف ليصي ناك اميف نفكي نأ ،بحتسي كلذ نفإ ،لعففا فيظن
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: When you want to shroud him, if you can include in his shroud a clean garment that he used to pray in, then do so, for it is recommended that he be shrouded in what he used to pray in. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Al-Saduq narrated it, saying: Abu Ja'far Al-Baqir (peace be upon him) said: When you shroud the deceased, if you can – and he mentioned the hadith.

chapter: Recommendation Of Shrouding The Deceased In Garments Used For Prayer And Fasting
arabicText: نفإ ،فيظن هيف ليصي ناك بوث هنفك يف نوكي نأ بحتسي :لقا هباحصأ ضعب نع ،ةريغملا نب الله دبع نع .هيف ليصي ناك اميف نفكي نأ ،بحتسي كلذ
englishText: From Abdullah bin Al-Mughirah, from some of his companions who said: It is recommended that his shroud include a clean garment that he used to pray in, for it is recommended that he be shrouded in what he used to pray in.

chapter: Recommendation Of Shrouding The Deceased In Garments Used For Prayer And Fasting
arabicText: اهيف ليصي يتلا بايثلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ لأس هنأ ،هيبأ نع ،لهس نب دمحم ثيدح مدقت دقو .اصيمق ينعي ،نفكلا كلذ بحأ :لقا ؟اهيف نفكيأ ،موصيو لجرلا
englishText: The previous hadith of Muhammad bin Sahl, from his father, has already been mentioned, that he asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the clothes in which a man prays and fasts, should he be shrouded in them? He said: I prefer that shroud, meaning a shirt.

chapter: Recommendation Of Shrouding The Deceased In Garments Used For Prayer And Fasting
arabicText: ءادر :باوثأ ةثلاث يف هنفكأ نأ يلإ هتيصو يف يبأ بتك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،يبلحلا ثيدحو .ةعمجلا موي هيف ليصي ناك ،ةربح هل
englishText: And the hadith of Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: My father wrote in his will to me that I should shroud him in three garments: a striped (hibra) cloak of his that he used to pray in on Fridays.

chapter: Recommendation To Shroud The Deceased In A Garment In Which He Used To Enter The State Of Ihram
arabicText: :نيينامي امهيف مرحأ ناذللا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر باوث ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .نفك امهيفو ،رافظأو يربع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The two garments of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) in which he used to enter the state of Ihram were Yemeni: Abari and Azfar, and he was shrouded in them.

chapter: Recommendation To Shroud The Deceased In A Garment In Which He Used To Enter The State Of Ihram
arabicText: ،امهيف مرحي ناك نييوطش نيبوث يف يبأ تنفك ينإ :لوقي هتعمس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا يبأ نع .هصمق نم صيمق يفو
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him), he said: I heard him say: I shrouded my father in two Shatawi garments in which he used to enter the state of Ihram, and in a shirt from his shirts.

chapter: Dislike Of Perfuming The Shroud With Incense, And Using Perfumes Other Than Camphor And Dharira, Like Musk, And Following The Deceased With An Incense Burner
arabicText: .ةرمجمب عبتي نأ هركأو - لقا نأ ىلإ - تيملا طنحت نأ تدرأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When you want to embalm the deceased - until he said - and I dislike that an incense burner follows it.

chapter: Dislike Of Perfuming The Shroud With Incense, And Using Perfumes Other Than Camphor And Dharira, Like Musk, And Following The Deceased With An Incense Burner
arabicText: .نفكلا رمجي لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The shroud should not be perfumed with incense.

chapter: Dislike Of Perfuming The Shroud With Incense, And Using Perfumes Other Than Camphor And Dharira, Like Musk, And Following The Deceased With An Incense Burner
arabicText: .ةرمجمب ةزانج عبتي نأ ىهن (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) forbade following a funeral with an incense burner.

chapter: Dislike Of Perfuming The Shroud With Incense, And Using Perfumes Other Than Camphor And Dharira, Like Musk, And Following The Deceased With An Incense Burner
arabicText: .طونحلا وه روفاكلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Al-kafur (camphor) is the hanut (burial perfume).

chapter: Dislike Of Perfuming The Shroud With Incense, And Using Perfumes Other Than Camphor And Dharira, Like Musk, And Following The Deceased With An Incense Burner
arabicText: تيملا نفإ ،روفاكلا لاإ بيطلبا مكتاوم اوحسمت لاو ،نافكلأا اورمجت لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا .مرحملا ةلزنمب
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Do not perfume the shrouds with incense, and do not anoint your deceased with perfume except camphor, for the deceased is in the state of ihram.

chapter: Dislike Of Perfuming The Shroud With Incense, And Using Perfumes Other Than Camphor And Dharira, Like Musk, And Following The Deceased With An Incense Burner
arabicText: .كسمب طنحي لاو ،رانلا هل لجعت لا ،ءاملا تيملل نخسي لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Water should not be heated for the deceased, do not hasten fire for him, and he should not be embalmed with musk.

chapter: Dislike Of Perfuming The Shroud With Incense, And Using Perfumes Other Than Camphor And Dharira, Like Musk, And Following The Deceased With An Incense Burner
arabicText: امك عنصفا بهذا نكلو ،روفاكلا طونحلا امنإ :ءاذحلا ةديبع يبأ نفك يف يل (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .سانلا عنصي
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said to me regarding the shroud of Abu Ubaidah al-Hadha: The hanut (embalming) is only with camphor, but go and do as people do.

chapter: Dislike Of Perfuming The Shroud With Incense, And Using Perfumes Other Than Camphor And Dharira, Like Musk, And Following The Deceased With An Incense Burner
arabicText: ،رانيدب (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ يلإ لسرفأ ،ةنيدملبا ناأو ءاذحلا ةديبع وبأ تام :لقا ناحرس نب دواد نع تيضم املف :لقا .سانلا عنصي امك عنصا نكلو ،روفاكلا وه طونحلا نأ ملعاو ،اطونح اذهب رتشا :لقاو .اروفاك اذهب رتشا :لقاو ،رانيدب ينعبتا
englishText: From Dawud bin Sarhan who said: Abu Ubayda al-Hadha died while I was in Medina, so Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) sent me a dinar and said: Buy hanut with this, and know that hanut is camphor, but do as people do. He said: When I left he sent after me another dinar and said: Buy camphor with this.

chapter: Dislike Of Perfuming The Shroud With Incense, And Using Perfumes Other Than Camphor And Dharira, Like Musk, And Following The Deceased With An Incense Burner
arabicText: لومحم اذه :لوقأ .معن :لقا ؟روخبلاو كسملا تيملا ىلإ برقي له :(ملاسلا هيلع) ثلاثلا نسحلا وبأ لئس .يتيأو ىضم امل ةيقتلا لىع وأ ،اهوركم ناك نإو ميرحتلا يفن لىع امإ
englishText: Abu Al-Hasan the Third (peace be upon him) was asked: Should musk and incense be brought near to the deceased? He said: Yes. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted either as negating prohibition while still being disliked, or as taqiyyah based on what preceded and what follows.

chapter: Dislike Of Perfuming The Shroud With Incense, And Using Perfumes Other Than Camphor And Dharira, Like Musk, And Following The Deceased With An Incense Burner
arabicText: ىوس كسم لاقثمب طنح هنأ :يورو - لقا نأ ىلإ - باوثأ ةثلاث يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نفكو :لقا ةيقتلا لىع وأ ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلبا صاصتخلاا لىع وأ ،زاوجلا نايب لىع امإ لومحم اذه :لوقأ .روفاكلا .ةياورلا يف
englishText: He said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was shrouded in three garments- and he said- it is narrated that he was perfumed with one mithqal of musk besides the camphor. I (Hurr Amili) say: this is interpreted either as showing permissibility, or as being specific to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), He said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was shrouded in three garments- and he said- it is narrated that he was perfumed with one mithqal of musk besides the camphor. I (Hurr Amili) say: this is interpreted either as showing permissibility, or as being specific to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), or as taqiyyah in the narration.

chapter: Dislike Of Perfuming The Shroud With Incense, And Using Perfumes Other Than Camphor And Dharira, Like Musk, And Following The Deceased With An Incense Burner
arabicText: نع كسملا (١) همكب ضفني (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم نب رفعج تيأر :لقا يرفعجلا دمحم نب ميهاربإ نع .ئش يف طونحلا نم اذه سيل :لوقيو ،نفكلا
englishText: From Ibrahim bin Muhammad al-Ja'fari who said: I saw Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon him) shaking off musk from the shroud with his sleeve, and he said: This is not part of the hanut (burial perfume) in any way.

chapter: Dislike Of Perfuming The Shroud With Incense, And Using Perfumes Other Than Camphor And Dharira, Like Musk, And Following The Deceased With An Incense Burner
arabicText: .ةنخدلا ينعي ،رانلا مكتاوم اوبرقت لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Do not bring fire near your deceased, meaning the smoke.

chapter: Dislike Of Perfuming The Shroud With Incense, And Using Perfumes Other Than Camphor And Dharira, Like Musk, And Following The Deceased With An Incense Burner
arabicText: اذإ هبايث نخدي نأ ملسملا ءرملل يغبنيو ،تيملا نفك ةنخدب سبأ لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ردقي ناك
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: There is no harm in fumigating the shroud of the deceased, and it is appropriate for a Muslim person to fumigate his clothes when he is able.

chapter: Dislike Of Perfuming The Shroud With Incense, And Using Perfumes Other Than Camphor And Dharira, Like Musk, And Following The Deceased With An Incense Burner
arabicText: لىع لعج امبرو ،كسملا هيف دوعلبا تيملا رمجي ناك هنأ ،(ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع ،الله دبع يبأ نع .ةرمجملبا تيملا عبتي نأ هركي ناكو ،هلعجي مل امبرو ،طونحلا شعنلا نفك لىع هلمح نكميو ،كلذ لىع ةنيرق وه ام مدقت دقو ،ةماعلل امهتقفاومل ةيقتلا لىع خيشلا امهلمح :لوقأ .هيف لىصو هتايح يف ناسنلاا هسبل
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, from his father (peace be upon them both), that he used to perfume the deceased with oud containing musk, and sometimes he would put hanut on the bier and sometimes he wouldn't, and he disliked following the deceased with the incense burner. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted both of these as taqiyyah due to their agreement with the Aammah (sunnis), and what preceded serves as evidence for that, and it can be interpreted as referring to clothes worn by a person during their life and prayed in.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Two Green Palm Branches With The Deceased
arabicText: باذعلا هنع ىفاجتي :لاقف ؟ةديرجلا هعم لعجت مل تام اذإ تيملا تيأرأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ تلق ربقلا لخدي ام ردق ،ةدحاو ةعاس يف دحاو موي يف هلك باذعلاو باسحلا امنإ ،ابطر دوعلا ماد ام باسحلاو .الله ءاش نإ ،امهفوفج دعب باسح لاو باذع هبيصي لاف كلذل ناتفعسلا تلعج امنإو ،موقلا عجريو
englishText: I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): What do you think about the deceased when he dies, why (*) is the palm branch placed with him? He said: The punishment and reckoning are lifted from him as long as the branch remains fresh. Indeed all the reckoning and punishment occur in one day, in one hour, during the time it takes to enter the grave and for the people to return. The two palm branches were placed for this purpose, so no punishment or reckoning befalls him after they dry, if Allah wills. Translator: * The word "lam" in the arabic is not being used as a negative particle, but rather it's being used to mean "why" (li-maza). This is a dialectical/colloquial usage.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Two Green Palm Branches With The Deceased
arabicText: :لاقف ؟تيملا عم نوكت يتلا ةديرجلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لأس هنأ ،دياز نب نسحلا نع هدانسإبو .رفاكلاو نمؤملا عفنت
englishText: Through his chain from Al-Hasan bin Ziyad, that he asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the palm branch that is placed with the deceased? He said: It benefits both the believer and the disbeliever.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Two Green Palm Branches With The Deceased
arabicText: نذوفأ كله راصنلأا نم لاجر نإ :لاقف ؟ريضختلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ لأسي يروثلا نايفس تعمس نيرضخملا لقأ امف ،مكبحاص اورضخ :هتبارق نم هيلي نمل لاقف ،هتومب (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر .ةوقرتلا لصأ ىلإ نيديلا لصأ نم عضوت ةرضخ ةديرج :لقا ؟ريضختلا امو :لقا ،ةمايقلا موي
englishText: I heard Sufyan Al-Thawri asking Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about Al-Takhdir? He said: A man from the Ansar died and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was informed of his death. He said to his relatives: Make Takhdir for your companion, for how few will be those with Takhdir on the Day of Resurrection. He asked: And what is Takhdir? He said: A green palm branch placed from the base of the hands to the base of the collarbone.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Two Green Palm Branches With The Deceased
arabicText: .ةبطر تماد ام باذعلا هنع ىفاجتي هنإ :لاقف ؟ةديرجلا ةلع نع (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لئسو
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) was asked about the reason for the palm branch? He said: "The punishment is lifted from him as long as it remains fresh."

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Two Green Palm Branches With The Deceased
arabicText: الله لىص) الله لوسر هدهشف راصنلأا نم تام لاجر نإ :لوقي هعمس هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ئش يأو :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلقف ،ةمايقلا موي نيرضخملا لقأ امف ،هورضخ :لاقف (هلآو هيلع .هبايث عم فلت - هتوقرت دنع ىلإ هديب راشأو - (انه) عضوتف عارذ ردق ةبطر ةديرج ذخؤت :لقا ؟ريضختلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), that he heard him say: A man from the Ansar died and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) attended his funeral and said: Make him green, for how few are those who will be made green on the Day of Resurrection. So I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): What is making green? He said: A fresh palm branch about a forearm's length is taken and placed here- and he pointed with his hand to his collarbone- wrapped with his clothes. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Al-Saduq said: This report came like this, and what must be done is to place two green palm branches for the deceased. This is interpreted as the permissibility of sufficing with one, and similar to it will come often.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Two Green Palm Branches With The Deceased
arabicText: لقاو :لقا ،رسيلأا يف ىرخأو ،نيميلا يف ةدحاو :نتاديرج تيملل عضوت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رفاكلاو نمؤملا عفنت ةديرجلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Two palm branches are placed with the deceased: one on the right side and another on the left side. He said: And he said the palm branch benefits both the believer and the disbeliever.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Two Green Palm Branches With The Deceased
arabicText: ام باذعلا هنع ىفاجتي هنإ :لاقف ؟ةديرجلا تيملا عم عضوت ئش يلأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ ليق .ةبطر تماد
englishText: It was said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Why is the palm branch placed with the deceased? He said: The punishment is lifted from him as long as it remains fresh.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Two Green Palm Branches With The Deceased
arabicText: .ةبطر ةديرج هربق يف هعم لخدي نأ بحتسي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: It is recommended to place a fresh palm branch with him in his grave.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Two Green Palm Branches With The Deceased
arabicText: لساغلا هيتأيف تومي نمؤملا نع هلأسي (ملاسلا هيلع) ثلاثلا نسحلا يبأ ىلإ مساقلا نب دمحأ بتك :بتكف ؟ةديرج هعم ريصي لاو هممعي لاو ةماعلا لسغ هلسغي له ،ةئجرملا نم ةعامج هدنعو هلسغي .هدهج كلذ يف دهجيلو ،هنوري لاو ،اهب فختسيلف ةديرجلا امأو ،اروضح اوناك نإو ،نمؤملا لسغ لسغي
englishText: Ahmad bin Al-Qasim wrote to Abu Al-Hasan the Third (peace be upon him) asking about a believer who dies and the washer comes to wash him while a group of Murji'ah are present, should he wash him with the general washing without wrapping his turban and without placing a palm branch? He wrote back: He should be washed with the believer's washing even if they are present, and as for the palm branch, let it be done discreetly without them seeing it, and let him strive his utmost in that.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Two Green Palm Branches With The Deceased
arabicText: راجشأ نم ئشب هسنؤي نأ ىلاعت الله لأسف ،شحوتسا ضرلأا ىلإ هتنج نم الله هطبهأ امل مدآ نأ يورو :لقا يف اهب سنآ تنك ينإ :هدلول لقا ةفاولا هترضح املف ،هتايح يف اهب سنيأ ناكف ،ةلخنلا هيلإ الله لزنفأ ،ةنجلا ،ينافكأ يف يعم امهوعضو ،نيفصنب هوقشو اديرج اهنم اوذخف تم اذفإ ،يتفاو دعب اهب سنلاا وجرأو ،يتايح هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا هايحفأ ،ةيلهاجلا يف كلذ سردنا مث ،هدعب ءايبنلأا هتلعفو ،كلذ هدلو لعفف .ةعبتم ةنس تراصو ،هلعفو (هلآو
englishText: It is narrated that when Allah brought Adam down from His paradise to earth, he felt lonely. So he asked Allah the Almighty to comfort him with something from the trees of paradise. Allah sent down to him the date palm, and he found comfort in it during his life. When death approached him, he said to his children: I found comfort in it during my life, and I hope to find comfort in it after my death. So when I die, take from it palm fronds and split them in half, and place them with me in my shroud. His children did that, and the prophets after him did the same. Then this practice was forgotten during the period of ignorance, until the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) revived it and did it, and it became an established sunnah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Two Green Palm Branches With The Deceased
arabicText: .ئسملاو نسحملا عفنت ةديرجلا نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع يورو :لقا
englishText: It is narrated from Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) that the palm branch benefits both the righteous and the wrongdoer.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using Palm Branches, Otherwise Lotus Tree Branches, Otherwise Willow Branches, Otherwise Pomegranate Branches, Otherwise Any Fresh Tree Branches
arabicText: ناكم زوجي لهف ،لخن اهيف سيل دلاب يف تومي لجرلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) ثلاثلا نسحلا يبأ ىلإ بتك هنأ تماد ام باذعلا هنع ىفاجتي هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) كئباآ نع يور دق هنفإ ؟لخنلا ريغ رجشلا نم ئش ةديرجلا .بطر رخآ رجش نم زوجي :(ملاسلا هيلع) باجفأ ؟رفاكلاو نمؤملا عفنت اهنأو ،نيتبطر نتاديرجلا
englishText: He wrote to Abu Al-Hasan the Third (peace be upon him): If a man dies in a land where there are no palm trees, is it permissible to use branches from trees other than palm trees in place of the palm branch? For it has been narrated from your forefathers (peace be upon them) that punishment is alleviated from him as long as the two branches remain fresh, and that this benefits both the believer and the disbeliever? He (peace be upon him) responded: It is permissible to use other fresh tree branches.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using Palm Branches, Otherwise Lotus Tree Branches, Otherwise Willow Branches, Otherwise Pomegranate Branches, Otherwise Any Fresh Tree Branches
arabicText: ؟لخنلا نكمي لا عضوم يف اهريغ اهلدب لعجي ،دجي مل اذإ ةديرجلا نع هلأسي هيلإ بتك هنأ ،للاب نب ليع نع .ةياورلا تءاج هبو ،لضفأ ةديرجلاو ،ةديرجلا تزوعأ اذإ زوجي :بتكف
englishText: From Ali ibn Bilal, that he wrote asking him about the palm branch when one cannot f ind it, can something else be used in its place in a location where palm trees are not possible? He wrote: It is permissible when palm branches are not available, though palm branches are superior, and this is what has come in the narration.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using Palm Branches, Otherwise Lotus Tree Branches, Otherwise Willow Branches, Otherwise Pomegranate Branches, Otherwise Any Fresh Tree Branches
arabicText: :لاقف ؟ةديرجلا لىع ردقن مل نإ ،كادف الله انلعج :هل انلق :اولقا ،انباحصأ نم دحاو ريغ نع ،دياز نب لهس نع .فلاخلا دوع :لاقف ؟ردسلا لىع ردقي مل نفإ :ليق ،ردسلا دوع
englishText: From Sahl ibn Ziyad, from several of our companions, they said: We said to him: May Allah make us your ransom, what if we cannot obtain palm branches? He said: Use lote tree branches. It was asked: And if lote branches cannot be obtained? He said: Use willow branches.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using Palm Branches, Otherwise Lotus Tree Branches, Otherwise Willow Branches, Otherwise Pomegranate Branches, Otherwise Any Fresh Tree Branches
arabicText: .نامرلا دوع اهلدب لعجي :ىرخأ ةياور يف ميهاربإ نب ليع ىورو
englishText: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated in another report: Pomegranate branches can be used in their place.

chapter: Non-Permissibility Of Using Dry Palm Branches
arabicText: يف هعم عضوت تيملل زوجي له ،هديب اهعطق اذإ ةسبايلا ةفعسلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس .سبايلا زوجي لا :لاقف ؟هترفح
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a dry palm branch when cut by hand, is it permissible to place it with the deceased in his grave? He said: The dry one is not permissible.

chapter: The Length Of Palm Branches And How To Place Them With The Deceased
arabicText: نذوفأ كله راصنلأا نم لاجر نإ :لاقف ؟ريضختلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ لأسي يروثلا نايفس تعمس نيرضخملا لقأ امف ،مكبحاص اورضخ :هتبارق نم هيلي نمل لاقف ،هتومب (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر .ةوقرتلا لصأ ىلإ نييدثلا لصأ نم عضوت ءارضخ ةديرج :لقا ؟ريضختلا امو :لقا ،ةمايقلا موي
englishText: I heard Sufyan Al-Thawri asking Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about al-takhdir? He said: A man from the Ansar died and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was informed of his death. He said to his relatives who were present: Give your companion takhdir, for how few will be those given takhdir on the Day of Resurrection. He asked: And what is takhdir? He said: A green palm branch placed from the base of the breasts to the base of the collarbone.

chapter: The Length Of Palm Branches And How To Place Them With The Deceased
arabicText: ليي امم تغلب ام ىلإ ةوقرتلا دنع نم ةدحاو عضوت ،ربش ردق ةديرجلا نإ :لقا :لقا ،جارد نب ليمج نع .صيمقلا قوف نم تغلب ام ىلإ ةوقرتلا دنع نم رسيلأا يف ىرخلأاو ،دلجلا
englishText: From Jamil bin Darraj, who said: The palm branch should be a span long, one placed from the collarbone down to wherever it reaches next to the skin, and the other on the left from the collarbone down to wherever it reaches above the shirt.

chapter: The Length Of Palm Branches And How To Place Them With The Deceased
arabicText: نودو صيمقلا قوف :لقا ؟اهقوف نم وأ بايثلا نود نم عضوت ،ةديرجلا نع هتلأس :لقا ليمج نع دانسلاباو .نميلأا بناجلا نم :لاقف ؟بناج يأ نم :هتلأسف ،ةرصاخلا
englishText: Through the same chain from Jamil who said: I asked him about the palm branch, whether it should be placed under or above the clothes? He said: Above the shirt and below the waist. I asked him: From which side? He said: From the right side.

chapter: The Length Of Palm Branches And How To Place Them With The Deceased
arabicText: هديب راشأو - عضوتو عارذ ردق ةبطر ةديرج ذخؤت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ةدابع نب ىيحي نع هتلأسف دعب (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تيقل :لجرلا لقاو :لقا ،هبايث عم فلت - هدي ىلإ هتوقرت دنع نم .ةدابع نب ىيحي هب تثدح دق ،معن :لاقف ؟هنع هديب راشأو - عضوتو عارذ ردق ةبطر ةديرج ذخؤت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ةدابع نب ىيحي نع هتلأسف دعب (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تيقل :لجرلا لقاو :لقا ،هبايث عم فلت - هدي ىلإ هتوقرت دنع نم .ةدابع نب ىيحي هب تثدح دق ،معن :لاقف ؟هنع
englishText: From Yahya bin Ubada, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Take a fresh palm branch the length of a forearm and place it- and he pointed with his hand from his collarbone to his hand- wrap it with his clothes. The man said: I met Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) later and asked him about it? He said: Yes, I had told this to Yahya bin Ubada.

chapter: The Length Of Palm Branches And How To Place Them With The Deceased
arabicText: ينعي - هل لعجتو :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا مهيلع) مهنع ،سنوي نع ،هلاجر نع ،هيبأ نع ،ليع نعو ،قاسلا ليي اميف فصن :هيتبكر نيب ةدحاو هل لعجي ،عارذ ردق ،ابطر لخنلا ديرج نم نيتعطق - تيملا .نميلأا هطبإ تحت ىرخلأا لعجيو ،ذخفلا ليي اميف فصنو
englishText: And from Ali, from his father, from his men, from Yunus, from them (peace be upon them)- in a hadith- he said: And place for him- meaning the deceased- two pieces of fresh palm branches, each a forearm's length, placing one between his knees: half towards the shin and half towards the thigh, and place the other under his right armpit.

chapter: The Length Of Palm Branches And How To Place Them With The Deceased
arabicText: .رسيلأا يف ىرخلأاو ،نميلأا يف ةدحاو :نتاديرج تيملل عضوت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Two palm branches are placed with the deceased: one on the right side and the other on the left. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And what will come indicates that, and in the hadiths here there is a difference that is interpreted as giving a choice (i.e. choose any one hadith).

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Palm Branches However Possible, Even Inside Or On Top Of The Grave
arabicText: لاقف ؟انتيور ام لىع ةديرجلا عضو نكمي لاف هفاخأ نم ينرضح امبر ،كادف تلعج :هل ليق دياز نب لهس نع .نكمأ ام ثيح اهلخدأ
englishText: From Sahl ibn Ziyad who was asked: May I be sacrificed for you, sometimes I am in the presence of someone I fear, and it's not possible to place the palm branch as you have narrated to us? He said: Insert it wherever possible.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Palm Branches However Possible, Even Inside Or On Top Of The Grave
arabicText: .هأزجأ دقف ربقلا يف تعضو نفإ :لقا :هيف دازو ،هلثم ،دمحأ نب دمحم نع هدانسإب خيشلا هاورو
englishText: And the Shaykh narrated it through his chain from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, similarly, and added to it: He said: If it is placed in the grave, then that suffices.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Palm Branches However Possible, Even Inside Or On Top Of The Grave
arabicText: .سبأ لا :لقا ؟ربقلا يف عضوت ةديرجلا نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about placing the palm branch in the grave? He said: There is no problem with it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Palm Branches However Possible, Even Inside Or On Top Of The Grave
arabicText: ةديرجب اعدف ،هبحاص بذعي ربق لىع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر رم :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم ففخي هنإ :لاقف ؟امهتعضو مل :هل ليق هنإو ،هيلجر دنع ىرخلأاو ،هسأر دنع ةدحاو لعجف ،نيفصن اهقشف .نيوارضخ اتناك ام باذعلا هنع
englishText: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) passed by a grave whose occupant was being punished, so he called for a palm branch and split it in half, placing one at his head and the other at his feet. When he was asked why he placed them, he said: The punishment will be lightened from him as long as they remain green.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Palm Branches However Possible, Even Inside Or On Top Of The Grave
arabicText: .سبأ لا :لاقف ؟ربقلا يف عضوت ةديرجلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لئسو :لقا
englishText: He said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) was asked about placing the palm branch in the grave? He said: There is no problem with it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Palm Branches However Possible, Even Inside Or On Top Of The Grave
arabicText: الله لىص) يبنلا دهع لىع ناك روبقلا لىع شرلا نأ ،(ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع ،يرتخبلا يبأ نع .تيملل كلذ بحتسيو ،نامزلا لوأ يف ناسنلاا نفدي نيح روبقلا لىع بطرلا ديرجلا لعجي ناكو ،(هلآو هيلع
englishText: From Abu Al-Bakhtari, from Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon them both), that sprinkling water on graves was practiced during the time of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), and fresh palm branches were placed on graves when people were buried in the early times, and this is recommended for the deceased.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Hussaini Soil With The Deceased In The Embalming, Shroud, And Grave
arabicText: عضوي ربقلا نيط نع هلأسأ (ملاسلا هيلع) هيقفلا ىلإ تبتك :لقا يريمحلا رفعج نب الله دبع نب دمحم نع يف تيملا عم عضوت :- تخسن هنمو عيقوتلا تأرقو - باجفأ ؟لا مأ كلذ زوجي له ،هربق يف تيملا عم .الله ءاش نإ .هطونحب طلخيو ،هربق
englishText: From Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Ja'far Al-Himyari who said: I wrote to the Faqih (*) (peace be upon him) asking him about the soil of the grave, should it be placed with the deceased in his grave, is this permissible or not? He answered- and I read the signed letter from which I copied-: It is to be placed with the deceased in his grave, and mixed with his embalming perfume (hanut). If Allah wills. Translator: * An epithet of the Imam (peace be upon him).

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Hussaini Soil With The Deceased In The Embalming, Shroud, And Grave
arabicText: اهدلاوأ عضوتو ينزت تناك ةأرما نإ :لقا هعفر (بلطملا ىهتنم) يف ةملاعلا رهطملا نب فسوي نب نسحلا اهلبقت ملو اهنع بارتلا فشكنفا تنفد تتام املف ،اهمأ ريغ هب ملعي ملو ،اهلهأ نم فاوخ رانلبا مهقرحتو ،كلذ اهل ىرجف ،هريغ ىلإ ناكملا كلذ نم تلقنف ،ضرلأا نم اهتايح يف هذه عنصت تناك ام :اهملا لاقف ،ةصقلا هل اوكحو (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا ىلإ اهلهأ ءاجف قلخ بذعت تناك اهنلأ ،هذه لبقت لا ضرلأا نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لاقف ،اهرمأ نطابب هتربخفأ ؟يصاعملا .ىلاعت الله اهرتسف اهب كلذ لعفف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا ةبرت نم ائيش اهربق يف اولعجا ،الله باذعب الله
englishText: Al-Hasan bin Yusuf bin Al-Mutahhar Al-Allama in (Muntaha Al-Matlab) raised it saying: A woman used to commit adultery and would place her children and burn them with fire out of fear from her family, and no one knew about it except her mother. When she died and was buried, the soil was uncovered from her and the earth did not accept her. She was moved from that place to another, and the same thing happened to her. Her family came to Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) and told him the story. He said to her mother: What sins did she commit in her life? She informed him of her private matters. Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: The earth will not accept her because she tortured Allah's creation with Allah's punishment. Place something from the soil of Husayn (peace be upon him) in her grave. This was done for her and Allah the Most Her family came to Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) and told him the story. He said to her mother: What sins did she commit in her life? She informed him of her private matters. Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: The earth will not accept her because she tortured Allah's creation with Allah's punishment. Place something from the soil of Husayn (peace be upon him) in her grave. This was done for her and Allah the Most High concealed her.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing Hussaini Soil With The Deceased In The Embalming, Shroud, And Grave
arabicText: بارتلا هدسوو تيملا نفد اذإ مكدحأ لىع ام :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ عمس هنأ ىسيع نب رفعج نع .!؟هسأر تحت اهعضي لاو ،نيطلا نم ةنبل ههجو لباقم عضي نأ خيشلا مهف دقو ،ةرهاظ ةنيرقلاو ،(ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا ربق نيط وهو ،كربتلل دوهعملا نيطلا دارملا :لوقأ .كلذ لىع لدي ام يتيأو ،(ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا ةبرت ثيداحأ ةلمج يف ثيدحلا دروفأ اضيأ كلذ
englishText: From Ja'far bin Isa that he heard Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) saying: What harm would it be for any of you, when burying the deceased and placing him on the earth, to put a clay brick opposite his face, rather than placing it under his head?! I (Hurr Amili) say: The intended meaning is the known soil for blessing, which is the soil from Husayn's grave (peace be upon him), and the context is clear, and the Shaykh understood this as well, so he included the hadith among the collection of hadiths about Husayn's soil (peace be upon him), and what indicates this will come.

chapter: It Is Recommended For The Shroud To Be Made Of Red Striped Yemeni Cloth (Burd Hibra), And The Turban To Be Made Of Cotton, Otherwise Of Fine Fabric (Sabiri)
arabicText: ،انطق هلك هلعجفا ادرب نكي مل نفإ ،ادرب نوكي نفكلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ىسوم نب رامع نع .يارباس ةمامعلا لعجفا نطق ةمامع دجت مل نفإ
englishText: From Ammar bin Musa, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The shroud should be made of Burd cloth, if Burd is not available then make it all from cotton, and if you cannot find a cotton turban then make the turban from Sabiri (*) fabric. Translator: * Sourced from the city of Sabur (Shapur in Persia) which was well-known during that time period for producing high-quality textiles, particularly a type of fine, white fabric that was highly valued for making turbans.

chapter: It Is Recommended For The Shroud To Be Made Of Red Striped Yemeni Cloth (Burd Hibra), And The Turban To Be Made Of Cotton, Otherwise Of Fine Fabric (Sabiri)
arabicText: نأو ،ةربح رمحأ دربب ديز نب ةماسأ نفك (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نب نسحلا نأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ةربح رمحأ دربب فينح نب لهس نفك (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): That Al-Hasan bin Ali (peace be upon him) shrouded Usama bin Zayd in a red striped hibra (from Yemen) cloth, and that Ali (peace be upon him) shrouded Sahl bin Hunaif in a red striped hibra (from Yemen) cloth.

chapter: It Is Recommended For The Shroud To Be Made Of Red Striped Yemeni Cloth (Burd Hibra), And The Turban To Be Made Of Cotton, Otherwise Of Fine Fabric (Sabiri)
arabicText: .ةربح رمحأ درب يف فينح نب لهس نفك ايلع نأ ،دمحم نب رفعج نع
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad: That Ali shrouded Sahl bin Hunaif in a red striped hibra (from Yemen) cloth.

chapter: Method Of Shrouding And Embalming, And Their Various Rulings
arabicText: ،هنم دوجسلا رثاآ هب حسمفا روفاكلا ىلإ دمعفا تيملا طنحت نأ تدرأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع نأ هركأ :لقاو ،ءاوس ةأرملاو (لجرلا طونح) :لقاو ،طونحلا نم هردص لىعو ،هتيحلو هسأرو ،اهلك هلصافمو .ةرمجمب عبتي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When you want to embalm the deceased, take camphor and wipe with it his prostration points, all his joints, his head and beard, and put embalming perfume (hanut) on his chest. And he said: The embalming of a man and woman is the same. And he said: I dislike following it with incense.

chapter: Method Of Shrouding And Embalming, And Their Various Rulings
arabicText: .هكنح :لاقف تيملل ةمامعلا يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding the turban for the deceased, he said: Put it under his chin.

chapter: Method Of Shrouding And Embalming, And Their Various Rulings
arabicText: اهيلع طسبا مث ،اطسب ةربحلا طسبا :لقا ،هنيفكتو تيملا طينحت يف لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) مهنع ،سنوي نع هتهبج لىع هعضف قوحسم روفاك ىلإ دمعا مث ،هيلع صيمقلا مدقم درتو ،هيلع صيمقلا طسبا مث ،رازلإا هيبكنمو هقنع يفو هسأر يفو ،همدق ىلإ هنرق نم هلصافم عيمج لىع روفاكلبا حسماو ،هدوجس عضوم ،هيتحار طسو يفو ،نيلجرلاو نيديلا نم هلصافم نم لصفم لك يفو ،هقفارمو لعجيو ،رورزم لاو فوفكم ريغ صيمقلا نوكيو ،هيلع صيمقلا مدقم دريو ،هصيمق لىع عضويف لمحي مث امم فصنو قاسلا ليي امم فصن ،هيتبكر نيب ةدحاو هل لعجي ،عارذ ردق ابطر لخنلا ديرج نم نيتعطق هل ههجو لىع لاو هعماسمو هرصب يف لاو هيرخنم يف لعجت لاو ،نميلأا هطبإ تحت ىرخلأا لعجيو ،ذخفلا ليي لعجيو ،رورزم لاو فوفكم ريغ صيمقلا نوكيو ،هيلع صيمقلا مدقم دريو ،هصيمق لىع عضويف لمحي مث امم فصنو قاسلا ليي امم فصن ،هيتبكر نيب ةدحاو هل لعجي ،عارذ ردق ابطر لخنلا ديرج نم نيتعطق هل ههجو لىع لاو هعماسمو هرصب يف لاو هيرخنم يف لعجت لاو ،نميلأا هطبإ تحت ىرخلأا لعجيو ،ذخفلا ليي ،اروفاك لاو انطق رسيلأاو ،رسيلأا لىع نميلأا قشلا لصف ىقلي مث ،ريودتلبا هسأر لىع ىنثيف ةمامعلا طسو ذخؤي ،ممعي مث .هردص لىع دمي مث ،نميلأا لىع
englishText: From Yunus, from them (peace be upon them) regarding embalming and shrouding the deceased, he said: Spread the striped garment flat, then spread the waist-wrapper over it, then spread the shirt over it, and fold the front of the shirt over him. Then take powdered camphor and place it on his forehead where he prostrates, and wipe camphor on all his joints from his head to his feet, on his head, neck, shoulders, elbows, and every joint of his hands and feet, and in the middle of his palms. Then carry him and place him on his shirt, and fold the front of the shirt over him, and the shirt should be without cuffs or buttons. Place two pieces of fresh palm branches about an arm's length, one between his knees- half towards the shin and half towards the thigh- and place the other under his right armpit. Do not place cotton or camphor in his nostrils, eyes, ears, or on his face. Then wrap the turban, taking its middle and wrapping it around his head in circles, then place the right end over the left and the left over the right, then extend it over his chest.

chapter: Method Of Shrouding And Embalming, And Their Various Rulings
arabicText: لىع لعجتف أدبت ،هنفكت مث :هيف لوقي اثيدح ركذف ؟تيملا نع لئس هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ةفافللا طسبتف أدبت مث ،داوعأ ةثلاثب هبايث رمجو ،اديدش امض هيذخف مضت ،ةريرذو نطقلا نم ائيش هتدعقم ربش ردق اهضرع ةقرخلا مث ،نيلجرلاو ردصلا ىطغي ىتح لاوط رازلإا مث ،ةريرذلا نم اهيلع رذت مث ،لاوط ،ئش هنم رهظي لا ىتح جرفلاو ةروعلا لايحب صيمقلا لىع ةقرخلا دشت ،صيمقلا مث ،فصنو ،هيفو ،انطق هينيع لىع لعجاو ،روفاكلا نم لقأو ،هيفو هنم هدوجس رثأو ،هعماسم يف روفاكلا لعجاو ربش ردق رسيلأا هبناج لىع ايلدتم ةمامعلا فارط نكيلو ،ةريرذ ههجو لىع قلأو ،هممع مث ،لايلق ائيش هتبنرأو ،لسغ دق تيملا ناك نإو لسغلا هيلعف اتيم سم نم لكو ،هلسغ يذلا لستغيلو ،ههجو لىع اهب ىمري ،يارباس ةمامعلا لعجفا نطق ةمامع دجت مل نفإ ،انطق هلك هلعجفا ادرب نكي مل نإو ،ادرب نوكي نفكلاو صيمقلا قوف ةقرخلبا مث صيمقلبا أدبت نأ نيفكتلا :لقاو .نم فصن ردق اهلبقل نطقلا نم ةأرملا جاتحت :لقاو صيمقلا قوف ةقرخلبا مث صيمقلبا أدبت نأ نيفكتلا :لقاو .نم فصن ردق اهلبقل نطقلا نم ةأرملا جاتحت :لقاو ةعبرأ رازلإا دشي مث ،افصنو اربش اهضرعو ،افصنو عرذأ ةثلاث ةقرخلا لوط لعجيو ،هتروعو هيذخفو هييلأ لىع لعجيو ،روفاكلا نم ائيش بوث لك لىع لعجيو ،ههجو لىع (ةمامعلا لضف حرطيو) ،ةمامعلا مث ةفافللا مث .قرخ ةفافللا يف ناك نإ و :لقاو ،ةريرذ هنفك لىع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), when asked about the deceased, he mentioned in a hadith: Then shroud him, start by placing some cotton and dhareerah (perfume) on his sitting area, press his thighs together firmly, and perfume his clothes with three pieces of incense. Then start by spreading the wrapping lengthwise, then sprinkle dhareerah on it, then the waist-wrapper lengthwise until it covers the chest and legs, then the cloth strip about one and a half spans wide, then the shirt. Tie the strip over the shirt at the private parts so nothing shows. Put camphor in his ears, on his prostration points (*), use little camphor, place cotton on his eyes and in them, and a little on his nose. Then wrap his turban and let its ends hang on his left side about a span's length to be placed over his face. The one who washed him should perform ghusl, and everyone who touches a deceased must perform ghusl even if the deceased was already washed. The shroud should be a burd (striped garment), if not available then make it all cotton, if a cotton turban is not available then use fine cloth. And he said: A woman needs half a mann of cotton for her front area. He said: Shrouding starts with the shirt then the strip above the shirt over his buttocks, thighs, and private parts, making the strip three and a half arms length and one and a half spans wide, then tie the waist-wrapper four times then the wrapping then the turban, and place the excess of the turban over his face. Put some camphor on each cloth and dhareerah on his shroud, and he said: even if there are tears in the wrapping. Translator: * The areas of the body that touch the ground during the act of prostration (sujud) in prayer. These areas include: the forehead, nose, palms, knees and toes.

chapter: Method Of Shrouding And Embalming, And Their Various Rulings
arabicText: لاو ،لاصفم هل اوزمغت لاو ،هورصعت لاو ،هب اوقفرفا مكنم تيملا متلسغ اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا زربأو ،هفلخ نم اهيفرط حرطاو ،هسأر لىع ةينثم اهورشنفا هتمامع اوذخ مث ،روفاكلا نم ائيش هينذأ اوبرقت ،هتهبج :لاقف ؟نفكلفا :تلقف ،هلصافمو ،هدوجس عضومو ،هرخنم يف عضوي :لقا ؟هب عنصأ فيك ،طونحلفا :تلق نفكي مث ،لضفأ نطقلا نم عنصي امو ،كانه ام مضيل اهب هيذخف مضيو ،هلفس اهب دشيف ةقرخ ذخؤي .نفكلا هيف عمجي دربو ةفافلو صيمقب
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: When you wash your deceased, be gentle with him, don't squeeze him, don't press his joints, and don't put camphor near his ears. Then take his turban and spread it folded on his head, place its ends behind him, and expose his forehead. I asked: What about the embalming, how should I do it? He said: Put it in his nostrils, prostration points, and joints. I asked: What about the shroud? He said: Take a cloth and tie his lower part with it, press his thighs together with it to contain what's there, and using cotton is better, then shroud him with a shirt, wrapping, and a burd (striped garment) that contains the shroud.

chapter: Method Of Shrouding And Embalming, And Their Various Rulings
arabicText: تحت عضو ربقلا لخد اذفإ ،احرط هيلع حرطي نكلو ،هب فلي لا دربلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ربقلا لخدأ اذفإ :لقا هنأ لاإ ،هلثم (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،نانس نب الله دبع نع هدانسإبو * .هبنج .هبنج تحتو هدخ تحت عضو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The burd should not be wrapped around him but placed over him as a covering, and when he enters the grave it should be placed under his side. And by his chain from Abdullah bin Sinan, from Abu From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The burd should not be wrapped around him but placed over him as a covering, and when he enters the grave it should be placed under his side. And by his chain from Abdullah bin Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) similar to it, except he said: When he is placed in the grave, it should be placed under his cheek and his side.

chapter: Recommendation Of Perfuming The Deceased And The Shroud With Dhareerah And Camphor
arabicText: .روفاكو ةريرذ نم ائيش بوث لك لىع رذف تيملا تنفك اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When you shroud the deceased, sprinkle on each cloth some dhareerah and camphor.

chapter: Recommendation Of Perfuming The Deceased And The Shroud With Dhareerah And Camphor
arabicText: .نفكلا رهظ لىع ائيشو ،هدجاسمو هعماسم لىع طونحلا نم ائيش لعجيو :دازو ،هلثم ،ةعامس نع
englishText: From Sama'ah, similar to it, and he added: And he should put some of the embalmment perfume (hanut) on his hearing places and prostration places, and some on the back of the shroud. Shaykh Hurr Amili: What has preceded indicates that, and what will come indicates it. The placing of the embalming substance on his ears, its explanation will come.

chapter: Obligation Of Placing Camphor On The Places Of Prostration Of The Deceased, And The Dislike Of Placing It On And In His Ears
arabicText: .هدجاسم يف هلعجا :لاقف ؟تيملل طونحلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the embalming perfume (hanut) for the deceased. He said: Place it on his prostration points.

chapter: Obligation Of Placing Camphor On The Places Of Prostration Of The Deceased, And The Dislike Of Placing It On And In His Ears
arabicText: تلسغ اذإ :لاقف ،لسغأ ينإ :تلق ،نسحتو :لقا ،ىتوملا لسغأ ينإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق ؟عنصأ فيك :تلق ،يبارعلاا ةمع هممعت لاف هتممع اذإو ،روفاكب هعماسم سمت لاو ،هزمغت لاو ،هب قفرفا .هردص لىع اهيفرط حرطاو ،هفلخ ىلإ اهدر مث ،هسأر لىع اهرشناو اهطسو نم ةمامعلا ذخ :لقا
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I wash the dead. He said: And you do well. I said: I wash. He said: When you wash, be gentle with him, don't squeeze him, don't put camphor in his ears, and when you wrap his turban, don't wrap it like a Bedouin's turban. I asked: How should I do it? He said: Take the turban from its middle, spread it on his head, then return it to his back, and place its ends on his chest.

chapter: Obligation Of Placing Camphor On The Places Of Prostration Of The Deceased, And The Dislike Of Placing It On And In His Ears
arabicText: نم دوجسلا رثاآو هعماسمو همف يف عضت :لقا ؟طونحلبا عنصأ فيك :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق .هيتبكرو هيديو ههجو
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): How should I apply the embalming perfume (hanut)? He said: Put it in his mouth, ears, and on the places of prostration on his face, hands, and knees.

chapter: Obligation Of Placing Camphor On The Places Of Prostration Of The Deceased, And The Dislike Of Placing It On And In His Ears
arabicText: .اطونح تيملا عماسم يف لعجت لا :لقا :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Do not put embalming perfume (hanut) in the ears of the deceased.

chapter: Obligation Of Placing Camphor On The Places Of Prostration Of The Deceased, And The Dislike Of Placing It On And In His Ears
arabicText: نطباو ،ةبللا لىعو ،دجاسملا عضوم لىع تيملا نم روفاكلا عضوي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةبللاو ةهبجلاو ،نيتحارلاو نيتبكرلا لىعو ،نيمدقلا نم كارشلا عضومو ،نيمدقلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Camphor is placed on the deceased on the places of prostration, on the throat, the soles of the feet, the place of the laces of the feet, on the knees, the palms, the forehead, and the throat.

chapter: Obligation Of Placing Camphor On The Places Of Prostration Of The Deceased, And The Dislike Of Placing It On And In His Ears
arabicText: رثاآ هب تحسمف روفاكلا ىلإ تدمع تيملا تففج اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) الله دبع يبأو رفعج يبأ نع :لقاو ،هجرفو هردص لىعو ،طونحلا نم هتيحلو هسأرو هعماسمو هيف يف لعجاو ،اهلك هلصافمو ،دوجسلا .ءاوس ةأرملاو لجرلا طونح هلمح نأ ىفخي لاو " لىع " ىنعمب " يف " نأ لىع هعماسم يف روفاكلا عضو نمضت ام خيشلا لمح :لوقأ .ميرحتلا ىفنو ةهاركلا هب داري نأ نكميو ،بيرق ةيقتلا لىع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon them), they said: When you dry the deceased, take the camphor and wipe it on the places of prostration and all his joints, and put embalming perfume (hanut) in his mouth, ears, head, and beard, and on his chest and private parts, and they said: The embalming of men and women is the same. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted what entails putting camphor in the ears to mean "on" rather than "in," and it's clear that interpreting it as taqiyyah is probable, and it could mean dislike rather than prohibition.

chapter: Obligation Of Placing Camphor On The Places Of Prostration Of The Deceased, And The Dislike Of Placing It On And In His Ears
arabicText: نفإ ،ائيش هعماسم وشحت نأ كياإ :- تيملا لسغ هيف ركذي ثيدح رخآ يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا .ائيش هيف لعجت لاف فخت مل نإو ،انطق هيلع ريصت نأ كيلع لاف ئش نيرخنملا نم رهظي نأ تفخ
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said- in the end of a hadith about washing the deceased: Beware of stuffing anything in his ears, but if you fear something might appear from the nostrils, there's no harm in placing cotton on it, and if you don't fear that, don't put anything in it.

chapter: Disliking Placing Perfume (Hanoot) On The Bier
arabicText: .طونحلا شعنلا لىع عضوي نأ ىهن (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) forbade putting embalming perfume (hanut) on the bier (or coffin).

chapter: Disliking Placing Perfume (Hanoot) On The Bier
arabicText: شعنلا لىع لعج امبرو ،كسملا هيف دوعلبا تيملا رمجي ناك هنأ ،هيبأ نع ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هلعجي مل امبرو ،طونحلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), from his father, that he used to perfume the deceased with oud containing musk, and sometimes he would place embalming perfume (hanut) on the bier (or coffin), and sometimes he would not.

chapter: Recommendation Of Having High-Quality Burial Shrouds And Spending Generously On Their Price
arabicText: ادرب يل رتشاو ،اذكو اذك بوث يف ينفك رفعج يا :توملا دنع يناصوأ يبأ نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .مهنافكبأ نوهابتي ىتوملا نفإ ،امهدجأو ،ةمامعو ادحاو
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: My father advised me at the time of his death: O Ja'far, shroud me in such and such cloth, and buy me one cloak and a turban, and make them of good quality, for indeed the deceased take pride in their shrouds.

chapter: Recommendation Of Having High-Quality Burial Shrouds And Spending Generously On Their Price
arabicText: .اهب (نوثعبي مهنفإ) ،نافكلأا يف اوقونت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Be particular about the shrouds, for they will be resurrected in them.

chapter: Recommendation Of Having High-Quality Burial Shrouds And Spending Generously On Their Price
arabicText: .مهتنيز اهنفإ ،مكتاوم نافكأ اوديجأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Make your deceased's shrouds of good quality, for they are their adornment.

chapter: Recommendation Of Having High-Quality Burial Shrouds And Spending Generously On Their Price
arabicText: .اهب نوثعبت مكنفإ نافكلأا يف اوقونت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Be particular about the shrouds for you will be resurrected in them.

chapter: Recommendation Of Having High-Quality Burial Shrouds And Spending Generously On Their Price
arabicText: مرحي ناك ،نييوطش نيبوث يف يبأ تنفك ينإ :لوقي هتعمس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا يبأ نع نيعبربأ هتيرتشا درب يفو ،(ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا نب ليعل تناك ةمامعو ،هصمق نم صيمق يفو ،امهيف .رانيد ةئامعبرأ ىواسل مويلا ناك ولو ،ارانيد
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him), who said: I heard him saying: I shrouded my father in two Shatwi (*) cloths in which he used to enter ihram, and in one of his shirts, and a turban that belonged to Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon From Abu Al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him), who said: I heard him saying: I shrouded my father in two Shatwi (*) cloths in which he used to enter ihram, and in one of his shirts, and a turban that belonged to Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon him), and in a cloak that I bought for forty dinars, and if it were today, it would be worth four hundred dinars. Translator: * From the arabic word "shatw", which means "to fold" or "to double." In the context of clothing, it refers to a specific type of garment that is folded or doubled in a certain way.

chapter: Recommendation Of Having High-Quality Burial Shrouds And Spending Generously On Their Price
arabicText: .مهتنيز اهنفإ مكتاوم نافكأ اوديجأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع نع
englishText: From Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Make your deceased's shrouds of good quality for they are their adornment.

chapter: Recommendation Of Having High-Quality Burial Shrouds And Spending Generously On Their Price
arabicText: ىتوملا نفإ ،هدوجو ادرب يل رتشا ،رفعج يا :يل لقاو هنفكب يبأ يناصوأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .مهنافكبأ نوهابتي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: My father advised me regarding his shroud and said to me: O Ja'far, buy me a cloak and make it of good quality, for indeed the deceased take pride in their shrouds.

chapter: Recommendation Of Having High-Quality Burial Shrouds And Spending Generously On Their Price
arabicText: ةئامسمخو نيفلبأ هل تلمعتسا ةربح يف نفك (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نأ لىع لدي ام يتيأو :لوقأ .هلك نآرقلا اهيلع ،رانيد
englishText: I (Hurr Amili) say: And there will come that which indicates that Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) was shrouded in a striped Yemeni cloth (Hibra) that was made for him for two thousand five hundred dinars, upon which the entire Quran was written.

chapter: Recommendation For The Shroud To Be White
arabicText: ،رهطأو بيطأ هنفإ ،ضايبلا اوسبلا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .مكتاوم هيف اونفكو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Wear white, for it is more pleasant and pure, and shroud your dead in it.

chapter: Recommendation For The Shroud To Be White
arabicText: ضايبلا نم نسحأ ئش مكسابل نم سيل :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .مكتاوم هيف اونفكو ،هوسبلفا :لقا هنأ لاإ ،هلثم ،رباج نع ،ةليمج يبأ نع ،رصن يبأ نب دمحم نب دمحأ نع ،دياز نب لهس نع ،مهنعو .مكتاوم هوسبلفأ .مكتاوم هيف اونفكو هوسبلفا :لقا هنأ لاإ ،هلثم ،دياز نب لهس نع هدانسإب خيشلا هاورو ةربحلا ادع ام نأ لىع وأ ،زاوجلا لىع لمحيف ،ادربو ارمحأ نفكلا عطق ضعب نوك لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ .ضايبلا سبل بابحتسا يف ،ةلاصلا ريغ يف ولو سبلاملا يف دوصقملا لىع لدي ام يتيأو .ضيبأ نوكي دربلاو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: There is nothing better among your clothes than white, so wear it and shroud your dead in it. And from them, from Sahl bin Ziyad, from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr, from Abu Jamila, from Jabir, similar to it, except that he said: So dress your dead in it. And the Shaykh narrated it with his chain from Sahl bin Ziyad, similar to it, except that he said: So wear it and shroud your dead in it. I (Hurr Amili) say: And there has preceded what indicates that some pieces of the shroud can be red and striped, so this is interpreted as permissible, or that what is other than the hibra (striped cloth) and burd (striped garment) should be white. And there will come what indicates the intended meaning regarding clothes, even if not in prayer, in the recommendation of wearing white.

chapter: Recommendation Of Cotton Shrouds And The Dislike Of Linen Shrouds
arabicText: الله لىص) دمحم ةملا نطقلاو ،هب نونفكي ليئارسإ ينبل ناك ناتكلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .(هلآو هيلع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Linen (cloth made from flax plant) was for the Children of Israel to use as shrouds, and cotton is for the nation of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family).

chapter: Recommendation Of Cotton Shrouds And The Dislike Of Linen Shrouds
arabicText: .ناتك يف تيملا نفكي لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Do not shroud the deceased in linen (cloth made from flax plant).

chapter: Dislike Of The Shroud Being Black
arabicText: .داوسلا يف تيملا نفكي لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The deceased should not be shrouded in black.

chapter: Dislike Of The Shroud Being Black
arabicText: .هب نفكي لاو ،دوسلأا بوثلا يف مرحي لا :لقا ؟دوسأ بوث يف لجرلا مرحي :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Can a man enter the state of ihram in a black garment? He said: He should not enter ihram in a black garment, nor should he be shrouded in it.

chapter: Prohibition Of Shrouding The Deceased In The Kiswah Of The Ka'bah
arabicText: هضعب يقبو هتجاح هضعبب ىضقف ائيش ةبعكلا ةوسك نم ىرتشا لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس هب نفكيأ :تلق ،هتكرب بلطيو ،هب عفنتسيو ،دري مل ام بهيو ،دارأ ام عيبي :لقا ؟هعيب حلصي له ،هدي يف .لا :لقا ؟تيملا
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a man who bought something from the Kiswah (covering) of the Ka'bah, and he used some of it for his needs while some remained with him, is it permissible to sell it? He said: He may sell what he wants, give away what he doesn't want, benefit from it, and seek its blessings. I asked: Can the deceased be shrouded in it? He said: No.

chapter: Prohibition Of Shrouding The Deceased In The Kiswah Of The Ka'bah
arabicText: :لقا ؟تيملا هب نفكي له ،ائيش تيبلا ةوسك نم ىرتشا لجر نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .لا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a man who bought something from the Kiswah (covering) of the Ka'bah, can the deceased be shrouded in it? He said: No.

chapter: Prohibition Of Shrouding The Deceased In The Kiswah Of The Ka'bah
arabicText: :لقا ؟تيملا هيف نفكي له ،ائيش تيبلا ةوسك نم ىرتشا لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم نسحلا باأ تلأس .هنم اذهو ،اضحم اريرح نفكلا نوك زاوج مدع لىع لدي ام يتيأو :لوقأ .لا
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) about a man who bought something from the Kiswah (covering) of the Ka'bah, can the deceased be shrouded in it? He said: No. I (Hurr Amili) say: And there will come what indicates the impermissibility of the shroud being pure silk, and this is from it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Shrouding The Deceased In Silk Mixed With Cotton With The Cotton Being In Greater Quantity, And The Impermissibility Of Shrouding In Pure Silk
arabicText: ؟ىتوملا اهيف نفكي نأ حلصي له ،نطقو زق نم يناميلا بصعلا لمع لىع ةرصبلبا لمعت بايث نع هتلأس .سبأ لاف زقلا نم رثكأ نطقلا ناك اذإ :لقا
englishText: I asked him about clothes made in Basra in the style of Yemeni asb from silk and cotton, is it permissible to shroud the dead in them? He said: If the cotton is more than the silk, then there is no problem.

chapter: Permissibility Of Shrouding The Deceased In Silk Mixed With Cotton With The Cotton Being In Greater Quantity, And The Impermissibility Of Shrouding In Pure Silk
arabicText: شبكلا ةيحضلأا معنو ،ةلحلا نفكلا معن :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) ليع نع .نرقلأا .امسيربإ نوكي نأ زوجي لا نفكلا نلا ،هب لمعن انسلو ةماعلل قفاوم اذه :خيشلا لقا ،اضحم لا اجوزمم اريرح ةلحلا نوك لىعو ،ةماعلا نم ةياور نلا ،ةياورلا يف ةيقتلا لىع هلمح نكميف :لوقأ يتيأو ،انه دارملا لىع لدي ام ةبعكلا ةوسك ثيداحأ يف مدقت دقو .ةيقتلل هلقنو ،اخوسنم مكحلا نوك لىعو .امومع ليصملا سابل يف كلذ لىع لدي ام
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: The best shroud is the suit (* hullah), and the best sacrifice is the horned ram. The Shaykh said: This agrees with the Aammah (Sunnis) but we do not act upon it, because the shroud is not permitted to be silk. I (Hurr Amili) say: It is possible to interpret this as taqiyyah in the narration, because it is a narration from the general public, or that the suit was mixed silk not pure silk, or that the ruling was abrogated and transmitted for taqiyyah. What was previously mentioned in the traditions about the covering of the Ka'bah indicates what is meant here, and what will come regarding the prayer garments in general will indicate this as well. Translator: * A traditional Arabian garment that consists of two pieces: an upper piece (rida') and a lower piece (izar). Historically, the hulla was often made from high-quality materials such as silk, fine wool, or a combination of both.

chapter: Ruling Of Impurity When It Comes Into Contact With The Shroud
arabicText: .هنم ضرق نفكلا باصفأ نفكي امدعب ئش تيملا نم جرخ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If anything comes out from the deceased after he has been shrouded and it stains the shroud, the stained part should be cut off.

chapter: Ruling Of Impurity When It Comes Into Contact With The Shroud
arabicText: .لسغلا داعي لاو ،ثدحلا لسغي هنفإ لسغلا دعب ثدحأ مث تيملا لسغ اذإ :لقا هعفر ،هباحصأ ضعب نع
