englishText: From some of his companions, who raised it [to the Prophet], he said: If a deceased person releases impurity after being washed, only the area of impurity should be washed, and the complete washing need not be repeated.

chapter: Ruling Of Impurity When It Comes Into Contact With The Shroud
arabicText: وأ ةمامعلا باصفأ لسغي امدعب ئشلا وأ مدلا تيملا رخنم نم جرخ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هنع ضرق نفكلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: If blood or anything comes out of the deceased's nostril after washing and it touches the turban or the shroud, that part should be cut off.

chapter: Ruling Of Impurity When It Comes Into Contact With The Shroud
arabicText: .نفكلا نم ضرق نفكلا باصفأ نفكي امدعب ئش تيملا نم جرخ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع عمج دقو ،نفكلا ةساجنلا ةباصإب هيف حيرصت لاو ،يناثلا ثيدحلا قفاوي ام ليسغتلا ثيداحأ يف مدقتو :لوقأ .هدعب ام لىع ضرقلاو ،نفدلا لبق ام لىع لسغلا لمحب ثيداحلأا نيب باحصلأا نم ةعامج
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If anything comes out of the deceased after he has been shrouded and it touches the shroud, the affected part of the shroud should be cut away. I (Hurr Amili) say: What agrees with the second hadith has been mentioned previously in the hadiths of washing, but there is no explicit mention in it of impurity touching the shroud. A group of companions have reconciled between the hadiths by I (Hurr Amili) say: What agrees with the second hadith has been mentioned previously in the hadiths of washing, but there is no explicit mention in it of impurity touching the shroud. A group of companions have reconciled between the hadiths by interpreting the washing as being before the burial and the cutting as being after it.

chapter: Ruling Of A Woman Who Dies During Postpartum Bleeding And Her Blood Is Abundant
arabicText: لثم وأ ميدلأا يف ةرسلا ىلإ تلخدأ اهمد رثكو ءاسفن تتام اذإ ةأرملا :لقا هعفر ،بوبحم نب نسحلا نع .نطقلبا ربدلاو لبقلا ىشحيو ،كلذ دعب نفكت مث ،فيظن ميدلأا لبقلا ىشحي مث فظنتو :لقا هنأ لاإ ،هلثم ركذو ،(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .كلذ دعب نفكت مث ،ربدلاو
englishText: From Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, raising it [to the Imam], he said: When a woman dies during postpartum bleeding and her blood is excessive, she should be placed up to her navel in clean leather or something similar to leather, then she should be shrouded after that, and her front and back private parts should be stuffed with cotton. Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said, and he mentioned similar to it, except that he said: She is cleaned, then the front and back private parts are stuffed, then she is shrouded after that.

chapter: Recommendation Of Voluntarily Providing Shroud For A Deceased Believer
arabicText: .ةمايقلا موي يلإ هتوسك نمض نمك ناك انمؤم نفك نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever provides a shroud for a believer is like one who has guaranteed his clothing until the Day of Resurrection.

chapter: Recommendation Of Voluntarily Providing Shroud For A Deceased Believer
arabicText: لقا :لقا - (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ مأ دسأ تنب ةمطفا ةفاو ثيدح يف - سابع نب الله دبع نع ءاسنلا رمو ،امهيف اهنفكف نيذه يبوث ذخو هذه يتمامع ذخ (ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا .اهلسغ نسحيلف
englishText: From Abdullah ibn Abbas- in the hadith about the death of Fatima bint Asad, mother of Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him)- who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said to Ali (peace be upon him): Take this turban of mine and take these two garments of mine and shroud her in them, and instruct the women to perform her washing well.

chapter: Recommendation Of Voluntarily Providing Shroud For A Deceased Believer
arabicText: ةمطفا نفد (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :- ثيدح يف - هدج نع ،هيبأ نع ،الله دبع نب ىسيع نع .اهدحل يف غرمتو ،اهربق يف لزنو ،هصيمق يف اهنفكو دسأ تنب
englishText: From Isa ibn Abdullah, from his father, from his grandfather- in a hadith: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) buried Fatima bint Asad and shrouded her in his shirt, and descended into her grave, and rolled in her burial niche.

chapter: Recommendation Of Voluntarily Providing Shroud For A Deceased Believer
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىلإ تصوأ دسأ تنب ةمطفا نإ :- ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ثيداحأ يف كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ .هيف اهونفك :لقاو ،هصيمق عزن تتام املف ،اهتيصو لبقف (هلآو .ادج ةريثك مهتعيش ىلإ نافكلأا نوثعبي اوناك (ملاسلا مهيلع) ةمئلأا نأ يف ثيداحلأاو ،ةربحلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith: Indeed, Fatima bint Asad made a will to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and he accepted her will. When she died, he removed his shirt and said: Shroud her in it. I (Hurr From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith: Indeed, Fatima bint Asad made a will to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and he accepted her will. When she died, he removed his shirt and said: Shroud her in it. I (Hurr Amili) say: What indicates this has preceded in the hadiths about Hibra, and the hadiths about the Imams (peace be upon them) sending shrouds to their followers are very numerous.

chapter: Recommendation For A Person To Prepare Their Shroud, Keep It With Them At Home, And Repeatedly Look At It
arabicText: .هيلإ رظن املك روجأم وهف هنفك لجرلا دعأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When a man prepares his shroud, he is rewarded every time he looks at it.

chapter: Recommendation For A Person To Prepare Their Shroud, Keep It With Them At Home, And Repeatedly Look At It
arabicText: املك اروجأم ناكو ،نيلفاغلا نم بتكي مل هتيب يف هعم هنفك ناك نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هيلإ رظن
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever has his shroud with him in his house will not be written among the heedless, and he will be rewarded every time he looks at it.

chapter: Recommendation For A Person To Prepare Their Shroud, Keep It With Them At Home, And Repeatedly Look At It
arabicText: ناك هنفك لجرلا دعأ اذإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،قداصلا نع .هيلإ رظن املك اروجأم
englishText: From Al-Sadiq, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: When a man prepares his shroud, he is rewarded every time he looks at it. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The hadiths about the Imams and the elite (khawas) of their Shia preparing their shrouds are numerous.

chapter: Recommendation Of Removing The Shirt Buttons Intended For Shrouding Without Its Sleeves When It's Worn, And The Recommendation Of It Being Unhemmed And Unbuttoned, And The Dislike Of Making Sleeves For Newly Made Shrouds
arabicText: عزنا :لاقف ؟عنصأ فيك :تلقف ،يلإ هب ثعبف ،ينفكل هدعأ صيمقب يل رميأ نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس .هرارزأ
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) to order a shirt for me to prepare for my shroud, so he sent it to me. I asked: What should I do? He said: Remove its buttons.

chapter: Recommendation Of Removing The Shirt Buttons Intended For Shrouding Without Its Sleeves When It's Worn, And The Recommendation Of It Being Unhemmed And Unbuttoned, And The Dislike Of Making Sleeves For Newly Made Shrouds
arabicText: :تلق ،هرارزأ عطقا :لاقف ؟هيف نفكيأ ،صيمقلا هل نوكي لجرلا :تلق :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع لاإ هنم عطقي لاف اسيبل باوث ناك اذإ امفأ ،امك هل لعجي مل ديدج وهو هل عطق اذإ كلذ امنإ ،لا :لقا ؟همكو .رارزلاا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), I said: If a man has a shirt, can he be shrouded in it? He said: Cut off its buttons. I said: And its sleeve? He said: No, that is only when it is cut new, no sleeves are made for it, but if it is a worn garment, nothing is cut from it except the buttons.

chapter: Recommendation Of Removing The Shirt Buttons Intended For Shrouding Without Its Sleeves When It's Worn, And The Recommendation Of It Being Unhemmed And Unbuttoned, And The Dislike Of Making Sleeves For Newly Made Shrouds
arabicText: .رورزم لاو فوفكم ريغ تيملل صيمقلا نوكي نأ يغبني :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: The shirt for the deceased should be unhemmed and unbuttoned.

chapter: Recommendation Of Writing The Name Of The Deceased On The Shroud, And Their Testimony That There Is No God But Allah, And That This Should Be Done With The Clay From Hussain's (Peace Be Upon Him) Grave
arabicText: توملا هرضح املف ،هدنع سلاج (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأو ليعامسإ توم ترضح :لقا سمهك يبأ نع ةيشاح يف بتكف هنفكب اعد هرمأ نم غرف املف ،هتئيهتب رمأ مث ،(ةفحلملا هيلع ىطغو) هضمغو هييحل دش .الله لاإ هلإ لا نأ دهشي ليعامسإ :نفكلا
englishText: From Abu Kahmas who said: I was present at Isma'il's death while Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was sitting with him. When death approached him, he tied his jaw, closed his eyes, (and covered him with a sheet). Then he ordered his preparation. When his matter was completed, he called for his shroud and wrote on the border of the shroud: Isma'il testifies that there is no god but Allah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Writing The Name Of The Deceased On The Shroud, And Their Testimony That There Is No God But Allah, And That This Should Be Done With The Clay From Hussain's (Peace Be Upon Him) Grave
arabicText: لاطفأ ةدجس دجس دقو (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تيأرو ليعامسإ توم ترضح :لقا سمهك يبأ نع ،توملا هرضح دقو هسأر عفر مث ،ىلولأا نم لوطأ ىرخأ ةدجس دجس مث ،هيلإ رظنف هسأر عفر مث ،دوجسلا ،هب ملعأ الله ئش هنم لخد دقو ههجو تيأرو ،مقا مث ،ةفحلملا هيلع ىطغو هتيحل طبرو هضمغف ،هيلع تناك يتلا هبايث ريغ بايث هيلع ،لاحتكم انهدم انيلع جرخ مث ،ةعاس ثكمف ،هلزنم لخدف مقا مث ليعامسإ :نفكلا ةيشاح يف بتكف ،هنفكب اعد غرف اذإ ىتح هرمأ يف ىهنو رمفأ ،هب لخد يذلا ريغ ههجوو .الله لاإ هلإ لا نأ دهشي
englishText: From Abu Kahmas who said: I was present at Isma'il's death and saw Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) prostrate in a lengthy prostration, then he raised his head and looked at him, then he prostrated another prostration longer than the first. Then he raised his head and death had come to him. He closed his eyes, tied his jaw, and covered him with a sheet. Then he stood up, and I saw his face which had been affected by something that Allah knows best. Then he went into his house, stayed for a while, then came out to us oiled and with kohl, wearing different clothes than those he had on before, and his face was different from when he had entered. He gave orders and instructions regarding his matter until when finished, he called for his shroud and wrote on the border of the shroud: Isma'il Then he went into his house, stayed for a while, then came out to us oiled and with kohl, wearing different clothes than those he had on before, and his face was different from when he had entered. He gave orders and instructions regarding his matter until when finished, he called for his shroud and wrote on the border of the shroud: Isma'il testifies that there is no god but Allah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Writing The Name Of The Deceased On The Shroud, And Their Testimony That There Is No God But Allah, And That This Should Be Done With The Clay From Hussain's (Peace Be Upon Him) Grave
arabicText: رازإ لىع بتك هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع انل يور دق :هيلإ بتك هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) نامزلا بحاص نع ؟هريغ مأ ربقلا نيطب كلذ لثم بتكن نأ انل زوجي لهف ،الله لاإ هلإ لا نأ دهشي ليعامسإ :هنبا ليعامسإ .لله دمحلاو ،كلذ زوجي :باجفأ .هيلع لدي ام يتيأو ،تيملا عم ةبرتلا لعج بابحتسا لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ
englishText: From the Master of Time (peace be upon him), that it was written to him: It has been narrated to us from Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) that he wrote on his son Isma'il's cloth: Isma'il testifies that there is no god but Allah, so is it permissible for us to write the same with grave soil or something else? He answered: That is permissible, and praise be to Allah. I (Hurr Amili) say: What preceded indicates the recommendation of placing the soil (turbah) with the deceased, and what follows will indicate the same.

chapter: Recommendation Of Writing What Is Feasible Of The Quran On Al-Hibrah , Or The Entire Quran
arabicText: هيف نفكب نفك (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نأ - ثيدح يف - هيبأ نع ،يفريصلا الله دبع نب نسحلا نع .هلك نآرقلا اهيلع ،رانيد ةئامسمخو نيفلبأ هل تلمعتسا ،ةربح
englishText: From Al-Hasan bin Abdullah Al-Sayrafi, from his father- in a hadith- that Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) was shrouded in a shroud containing Hibrah (a type of yemeni cloth), which was prepared for him for two thousand five hundred dinars, upon which the entire Quran was written.

chapter: Obligation Of The Shroud And That Its Price Is From The Principal/Original Wealth
arabicText: .لاملا عيمج نم نفكلا نمث :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع - الله دبع ينعي - نانس نبا نع
englishText: From Ibn Sinan- meaning Abdullah- from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The price of the shroud is from all the wealth (*). Translator: * The expenses of the shroud should be taken from the total wealth of the deceased before it is divided among the heirs as inheritance.

chapter: Obligation Of Providing Shroud For The Wife By Her Husband, And The Non-obligation Of Shrouding The Martyr, Rather He Is Buried In His Clothes
arabicText: .تتام اذإ اهجوز لىع ةأرملا نفك :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: The shroud of the woman is upon her husband when she dies.

chapter: Obligation Of Providing Shroud For The Wife By Her Husband, And The Non-obligation Of Shrouding The Martyr, Rather He Is Buried In His Clothes
arabicText: .تتام اذإ هتأرما نفك جوزلا لىع :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Upon the husband is the shroud of his wife when she dies.

chapter: Permissibility Of Preparing And Shrouding A Believer From Zakat If He Has Not Left Money, And If He Gets Two Shrouds, He Is Shrouded In One And The Other Is For His Family, And Paying His Debt With It Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: نم لجر يف ىرت ام :هل تلقف (ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم نسحلا باأ تلأس :لقا بتاكلا سنوي نب لضفلا نع ،هنوزهجي ام ردق ةاكزلا نم هلايع طعأ :لاقف ؟ةاكزلا نم هنفك هل يرتشأ ،هب نفكي ام كرتي ملو تومي انباحصأ ،هنوزهجي نيذلا مه نونوكيف نمؤملا ندب ةمرح نإ :لوقي يبأ ناك :لقا ؟ةاكزلا نم ناأ هزهجفأ ،هرمبأ موقي دحأ لاو دلو هل نكي مل نفإ :تلق .هتزانج عيشو ،ةاكزلا نم كلذب بستحاو ،هطنحو هنفكو هزهجو هتروعو هندب راوف ،ايح هتمرحك اتيم ،لا :لقا ؟رخلآبا هنيد ىضقيو دحاوب نفكيأ ،نيد هيلع ناكو ،رخآ نفكب هناوخإ ضعب هيلع رجتا نفإ :تلق مهل رخلآا نوكيو ،هيلع رجتا يذلبا هونفكيلف ،هتفاو دعب هيلإ راص ئش اذه امنإ ،هكرت ثااريم اذه سيل .مهنأش هب نوحلصي
englishText: Al-Fadhl ibn Yunus al-Katib said: I asked Abu al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) saying: What do you think about a man from our companions who dies and has not left anything to be shrouded with, should I buy his shroud from zakat? He said: Give his family from zakat the amount with which they can prepare him, so they will be the ones who prepare him. I said: If he has no child and no one to take care of his affairs, can I prepare him from zakat? He said: My father used to say: The sanctity of a believer's body after death is like its sanctity while alive, so cover his body and private parts, prepare him, shroud him, apply perfume (hanut) to him, and consider this from zakat, and follow his funeral procession. I said: If one of his brothers obtains (through trade) another shroud, and he had a debt, should he be shrouded in one and his debt be paid with the other? He said: No, this is not inheritance he left, this is something that came to him after his death, so let them shroud him with what was traded for him, and the other one should be for them to manage their affairs with it. Translator: In the last part, the questioner mentions a scenario where a deceased person, who had a debt, is given two shrouds- one from zakat and one obtained (through trade) by one of his brothers. The question is whether one shroud should be used for the burial and the other Translator: In the last part, the questioner mentions a scenario where a deceased person, who had a debt, is given two shrouds- one from zakat and one obtained (through trade) by one of his brothers. The question is whether one shroud should be used for the burial and the other sold to pay off his debt. The Imam responds by saying that the second shroud should not be used to pay off the debt, because it is not part of the inheritance left by the deceased, as it came into his possession after his death. Instead, the deceased should be shrouded with the one obtained specifically for him (presumably the one obtained by his brother), and the other shroud (the one from zakat) should be given to his family to use as they see fit for their own needs.

chapter: Recommendation For The Shroud To Be From Pure Wealth
arabicText: :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نسحلا يبلأ لقا كهاش نب يدنس نأ يور :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .انلاومأ روهط نم اننافكأو انئاسن روهمو انترورص جح ،تيب لهأ ناإ :لاقف .كنفكأ ينعدت نأ بحأ
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: It is narrated that Sindi bin Shahik said to Abu Al-Hasan Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him): I would like you to let me provide your shroud. So he said: We, the Ahl al-Bayt (People of the Household), [have] our f irst Hajj, our women's mahrs, and our shrouds from the pure [portions] of our wealth. Translator: The Ahl al-Bayt are careful to fund three important matters- hajj, dowry and shroud from wealth that has been earned lawfully (through pure means).

chapter: Permissibility Of Shrouding By The Washer Before Performing Ghusl Of Touching, And The Recommendation Of It Being After Washing Hands From The Elbows Or Shoulders Thrice
arabicText: ؟لستغي هلسغي يذلفا - لقا نأ ىلإ - تيملا ضمغي يذلا :هل تلق :لقا ،(ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع مث ،قتاعلا نم هيدي لسغي مث هلسغي :لقا ؟لستغي نأ لبق هنافكأ هسبلي مث هلسغيف :تلق ،معن :لاقف .لستغي مث هنافكأ هسبلي
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them), he said: I said to him: The one who closes the eyes of the deceased- until he said- should the one who washes him perform ghusl? He said: Yes. I said: Can he wash him and dress him in his shroud before performing ghusl? He said: He should wash him, then wash his hands from the shoulders, then dress him in his shroud, then perform ghusl.

chapter: Permissibility Of Shrouding By The Washer Before Performing Ghusl Of Touching, And The Recommendation Of It Being After Washing Hands From The Elbows Or Shoulders Thrice
arabicText: لبق هدي هلسغي يذلا لسغي مث - لقا نأ ىلإ تيملا لسغ ةفص ركذو - :(ملاسلا هيلع) حلاصلا دبعلا نع .لستغا هنفك اذإ مث ،تارم ثلاث نيبكنملا ىلإ هنفكي نأ
englishText: From Al-Abd Al-Salih (peace be upon him):- and he mentioned the description of washing the deceased until he said- then the one who washes should wash his hands up to the shoulders thrice before shrouding him, then after shrouding him he should perform ghusl.

chapter: Permissibility Of Shrouding By The Washer Before Performing Ghusl Of Touching, And The Recommendation Of It Being After Washing Hands From The Elbows Or Shoulders Thrice
arabicText: .هنفكت مث ،نيتبكرلا ىلإ كيلجرو ،قفارملا ىلإ كدي لسغت مث :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Then wash your hands up to the elbows, and your feet up to the knees, then shroud him.

chapter: Undesirability Of Bargaining In Purchasing The Shroud
arabicText: هيلع) ليعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ةيصو يف - (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،هيبأ نع ،دمحم نب رفعج نع .ةكم ىلإ ءاركلاو ،ةمسنلاو ،نفكلاو ،ةيحضلأا ءارش يف :ءايشأ ةعبرأ يف سكامت لا ،ليع يا :لقا - (ملاسلا
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them)- in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him)- he said: O Ali, do not bargain (haggle) in four things: in purchasing the sacrificial animal, the shroud, the slave, and the transportation to Makkah.

chapter: Undesirability Of Bargaining In Purchasing The Shroud
arabicText: ،ةمسنلا نمثو ،نفكلاو ،ةيحضلأا يف :ءايشأ ةعبرأ يف سكامت لا :لقا هنإ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ةكم ىلإ ءاركلاو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: Do not bargain (haggle) in four things: in the sacrificial animal, the shroud, the price of a slave, and the transportation to Makkah. Section 2 Salat al Janazah (Funeral Prayer)

chapter: Recommendation Of Informing People, Especially The Brothers Of The Deceased, About The Death, And Gathering For The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: نودهشيف ،هتومب تيملا ناوخإ اونذؤي نأ مكنم تيملا ءايلولأ يغبني :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع رجلاا وه بستكيو ،رافغتسلاا تيملل بتكيو رجلاا مهل بتكيف ،هل نورفغتسيو ،هيلع نولصيو ،هتزانج .رافغتسلاا نم هل بستكا اميفو مهيف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The guardians of the deceased among you should inform the brothers of the deceased about his death, so they can attend his funeral, pray over him, and seek forgiveness for him. Thus, the reward will be written for them, and the seeking of forgiveness will be written for the deceased, and he gains reward through them and through what he gained from their seeking forgiveness.

chapter: Recommendation Of Informing People, Especially The Brothers Of The Deceased, About The Death, And Gathering For The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: لئاس م نع هولأسف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسرىلإ دوهيلا نم رفن ءاج :لقا ،يتيأ دانسإب (سلاجملا) يفو وأ اقفانم نوكي نأ لاإ ،ةنجلا هل الله بجوأ لاإ زئانجلا لىع ليصي نمؤم نم امو - (ملاسلا هيلع) لقا نأ ىلإ .قااع
englishText: And in (Al-Majalis) with a chain of narrators that will come, he said: A group of Jews came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and asked him about matters- until he (peace be upon him) said- and there is no believer who prays over the deceased except that Allah makes Paradise obligatory for him, unless he is a hypocrite or disobedient to parents.

chapter: Recommendation Of Informing People, Especially The Brothers Of The Deceased, About The Death, And Gathering For The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: .معن :لقا ؟سانلا اهب نذؤي ،ةزانجلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about the funeral, should people be informed about it? He said: Yes.

chapter: Recommendation Of Informing People, Especially The Brothers Of The Deceased, About The Death, And Gathering For The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: .سانلا اهب نذؤي ةزانجلا نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, people should be informed about the funeral.

chapter: Manner Of Performing The Funeral Prayer, And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: اذإ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناك :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :تلقا ةملس مأ همأ نع اعدو ةعبارلا ربك مث ،نينمؤملل اعدو ربك مث اعدو ءايبنلأا لىع لىصو ربك مث ،دهشتو ربك تيم لىع لىص ،فرصناو ةسماخلا ربك مث ،تيملل اعدو ربك مث ،نييبنلا لىع لىصو ربك مث ،دهشتو ربك نيقفانملا لىع ةلاصلا نع لجو زع الله هاهن املف .تيملل عدي ملو ،فرصناو ةعبارلا ربك مث ،نينمؤملل
englishText: From his mother Umm Salamah, she said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) prayed over a deceased person, he would say Takbir and recite the Tashahhud, then say Takbir and send blessings upon the Prophets and supplicate, then say Takbir and supplicate for the believers, then say the fourth Takbir and supplicate for the deceased, then say the f ifth Takbir and leave. So when Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, prohibited him from praying over the hypocrites, he would say Allahu Akbar and recite the tashahhud, then say Allahu Akbar and send prayers (salawaat) upon the Prophets, then say Allahu Akbar and make supplication for the believers, then say the fourth Allahu Akbar and depart, without making any supplication for the deceased.

chapter: Manner Of Performing The Funeral Prayer, And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لىع ليصت مث :ربكت :لقا - تيملا لىع ةلاصلا يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع :لوقت مث (هلآو يف دزف انسحم ناك نإ مهللا ،انم هب ملعأ تنأو ،اريخ لاإ هنم ملعأ لا ،كتمأ نبا ،كدبع نبا ،كدبع مهللا الله لىص) دمحم ءاقفر نم هلعجاو ،هربق يف هل حسفاو ،هبنذ هل رفغفا ائيسم ناك نإو ،هنم لبقتو هتانسح ،(هلآو هيلع ،هل رفغفا ائطاخ ناك نإو ،هكزف ايكاز ناك نإ مهللا :لوقتو ةيناثلا ربكت مث ،هدعب انتفت لاو ،هرجأ انمرحت لا مهللا :لوقتو ةثلاثلا ربكت مث ءاقفر نم هلعجاو ،نيرباغلا يف هبقع لىع فلخاو ،نييلع يف كدنع هبتكا مهللا :لوقتو ةعبارلا ربكت مث ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) دمحم .فرصناو ةسماخلا ربك مث
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- regarding the prayer over the deceased- he said: Say Takbir, then send blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), then say: "O Allah, Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, I do not know of him except good, and You know better about him than us. O Allah, if he was a doer "O Allah, Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, I do not know of him except good, and You know better about him than us. O Allah, if he was a doer of good, then increase his good deeds and accept from him, and if he was a wrongdoer, then forgive his sin, and grant him expanse in his grave, and make him among the companions of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family)." Then say the second Takbir and say: "O Allah, if he was pure, then purify him, and if he was mistaken, then forgive him." Then say the third Takbir and say: "O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward, and do not put us to trial after him." Then say the fourth Takbir and say: "O Allah, record him with You in Illiyyun, and be the successor over his descendants among the later ones, and make him among the companions of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family)." Then say the fifth Takbir and leave.

chapter: Manner Of Performing The Funeral Prayer, And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: :لوقت مث ،دهشت مث ،ربكت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،يبلحلا نع دانسلاباو الله ىزج ،هتيب لهأو دمحم لىع لص ،ةايحلاو توملا بر ،نيملاعلا بر لله دمحلا ،نوعجار هيلإ ناإو لله ناإ ،هبر تلااسر نم غلب امبو ،هتمبأ عنص امب ءازجلا ريخ ادمحم انع نع ينغ تنأو ،كتمحر ىلإ جاتحاو ايندلا نم لاخ ،كديب هتيصنا ،كتمأ نبا كدبع نبا كدبع مهللا :لوقت مث نإو ،هنم لبقتو هناسحإ يف دزف انسحم ناك نإ مهللا ،هب ملعأ تنأو ،اريخ لاإ هنم ملعن لا ناإ مهللا ،هباذع ةايحلا يف تباثلا لوقلبا هتبثو ،كيبنب هقحلأ مهللا ،كتمحرب هنع زواجتو همحراو هبنذ هل رفغفا ائيسم ناك ،كوفع كوفع مهللا ،ميقتسملا كطارص هياإو نادهاو ،ىدهلا ليبس هبو انب كلسا مهللا ،ةرخلآا يفو ايندلا .تاريبكت سمخ نم غرفت ىتح تلق ام لثم لوقتو ةيناثلا ربكت مث
englishText: With the chain of narration from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Say Takbir, then recite the Tashahhud, then say: "Indeed we belong to Allah and to Him we shall return. All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds, Lord of death and life. Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family. May Allah reward Muhammad on our behalf with the best reward for what he did with his nation and for conveying the messages of his Lord." Then say: "O Allah, Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, his forelock is in Your Hand. He has left this world and is in need of Your mercy, and You are free of need of punishing him. O Allah, we do not know of him except good, and Then say: "O Allah, Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, his forelock is in Your Hand. He has left this world and is in need of Your mercy, and You are free of need of punishing him. O Allah, we do not know of him except good, and You know better about him. O Allah, if he was a doer of good, then increase his good and accept from him, and if he was a wrongdoer, then forgive his sin, have mercy on him, and overlook his faults by Your mercy. O Allah, join him with Your Prophet, and make him steadfast with the firm word in the life of this world and in the Hereafter. O Allah, guide us and him to the path of guidance, and guide us and him to Your straight path. O Allah, Your pardon, Your pardon." Then say the second Takbir and say the same as you said until you finish five Takbirs.

chapter: Manner Of Performing The Funeral Prayer, And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: ،اهتمأ تنأو سفنلا هذه تقلخ تنأ مهللا :لوقت - زئانجلا لىع ةلاصلا يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .تبحأ نم عم اهرشحاو ،تلوت ام اهلو مهللا ،ءاعفش اهيف نيعفاش كانيتأ ،اهتينلاعو اهرس ملعت
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- regarding the prayer over the funerals say: "O Allah, You created this soul and You gave it death. You know its secret and what it made public. We have come to You interceding for it, so accept our intercession. O Allah, assume what it assumed, and gather it with those it loved."

chapter: Manner Of Performing The Funeral Prayer, And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: :(نهلوأ يف) لوقت ،سمخ لاقف ؟تيملا لىع ريبكتلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا دلاو يبأ نع ،دمحم لآو دمحم لىع لص مهللا ،هل كيرش لا هدحو ،الله لاإ هلإ لا نأ دهشأ ،كتمحر ىلإ جاتحا دقو ،كيلإ هحور تضبق دقو ،كدبع نباو كدبع انمادق جىسملا اذه نإ مهللا :لوقت مث انسحم ناك نإ مهللا ،هتريرسب ملعأ تنأو ،اريخ لاإ هرهاظ نم ملعن لا ناإ مهللا ،هباذع نع نم ينغ تنأو ،هتائيس نع زواجتف ائيسم ناك نإو ،هتانسح فعاضف .ةريبكت لك يف كلذ لعفتو ةيناثلا ربكت مث
englishText: From Abu Walad, he said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the Takbir over the deceased. He said: Five. Say in the first of them: "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad." Then say: "O Allah, this one laid before us is Your servant, son of Your servant, and You have seized his soul to Yourself, and he is in need of Your mercy while You are free of need of punishing him. O Allah, we do not know from his apparent except good, and You know better about his inner reality. O Allah, if he was a doer of good, then multiply his good deeds, and if he was a wrongdoer, then overlook his misdeeds." Then say the second Takbir and do that in every Takbir.

chapter: Manner Of Performing The Funeral Prayer, And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: اذإ لوقي ،تاريبكت سمخ :لاقف ؟تيملا لىع ةلاصلا نع هتلأس :لقا - ثيدح يف - ةعامس نع ،ةعرز نع :ربك دمحم لآو دمحم لىع لص مهللا ،هلوسرو هدبع ادمحم نأ دهشأو ،هل كيرش لا هدحو الله لاإ هلإ لا نأ دهشأ كنإ انبر ،اونمآ نيذلل لاغ انبولق يف لعجت لاو ،ناميلابا ناوقبس نيذلا انناوخلاو انل رفغاو ،ىدهلا ةمئأ لىعو نادهاو ،نارايخأ بولق لىع انبولق نيب فلأو ،تانمؤملاو نينمؤملا نم انتاومأو انئايحلا رفغا مهللا ،ميحر فوؤر ،ميقتسم طارص ىلإ ءاشت نم يدهت كنإ ،كنذإب قحلا نم هيف فلتخا امل ،هب ملعأ تنأ ،كتمأ نباو ،كدبع نبا كدبع اذه مهللا :لقف كرضي لاف ةيناثلا ةريبكتلا كيلع عطق نفإ هل رونو ،همحراو هل رفغاو ،هتانسح يف دزو ،هتائيس نع زواجتف مهللا ،هنع تينغتساو (كتمحر ىلإ) رقتفا ،هدعب انتفت لاو ،هرجأ انمرحت لاو .(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) هيبنب هقحلأو ،هتجح هنقلو ،هربق يف .كنيمي نع تملس تغرف اذإو ،تاريبكت سمخ نم غرفت ىتح اذه لق :هرخآ نم كرتو ،هلثم ،ةعرز نع ،ةمروأ نب دمحم نع ،دياز نب لهس نع ،انباحصأ نم ةدع نع ينيلكلا هاورو .كنيمي نع تملس تغرف اذإو
englishText: From Zur'ah, from Sama'ah- in a hadith- he said: I asked him about the prayer over the deceased. He said: Five Takbirs. Say when you say Takbir: "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad and upon the guiding Imams, and forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and do not put in our hearts any rancor towards those who believe. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful. O Allah, forgive our living and our deceased from the believing men and women, and unite our hearts upon the hearts of our righteous ones, and guide us to that in which there is disagreement of the truth by Your permission. Indeed You guide whom You will to a straight path." If you are cut off from the second Takbir, it does not harm you. Say: "O Allah, this is Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. You know best about him. He became in need of Your mercy and You became free of need of him. O Allah, so overlook his misdeeds, and increase his good deeds, and forgive him and have mercy on him, and illuminate his grave for him, and inspire him with his proof, and join him with his Prophet (peace be upon him and his family). And do not deprive us of his reward, and do not put us to trial after him." Say this until you finish five Takbirs. When you finish, say Salam to your right. Al-Kulayni narrated it from a number of our companions, from Sahl bin Ziyad, from Muhammad bin Awramah, from Zur'ah, similar to it, and he omitted from its end: "When you finish, say Salam to your right."

chapter: Manner Of Performing The Funeral Prayer, And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: لاقف ؟تيملا لىع ريبكتلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا يدسلأا بيلك نع ،ةلاضف نع ،هنعو نع ينغ تنأو ،كتمحر ىلإ جاتحا كدبع مهللا :لوقت :لقا ؟هيلع تيلص اذإ لوقأ فيك :تلق ،اسمخ :هديب .هل رفغفا ائيسم ناك نإو ،هناسحإ يف دزف انسحم ناك نإ مهللا ،هباذع
englishText: From him, from Fadalah, from Kulaib Al-Asadi who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the number of Takbirs over the deceased? He gestured with his hand: five. I said: What should I say when I pray over him? He said: Say: O Allah, Your servant is in need of Your mercy, and You are free from need to punish him. O Allah, if he was of those who did good then increase his good deeds, and if he was of those who did wrong then forgive him.

chapter: Manner Of Performing The Funeral Prayer, And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: ليصت ةيناثلا يفو ،باتكلا مبأ ىلولأا يف أرقت :زئانجلا لىع ةلاصلا يف لقا ملعي اميف (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع .اهب فرصنت ةسماخلاو ،كتيمل ةعبارلا يف وعدتو ،تانمؤملاو نينمؤملل ةثلاثلا يف وعدتو ،هلآو يبنلا لىع
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) regarding what is known, he said concerning the prayer over the deceased: In the first (takbir) you recite the Opening of the Book (Al Fatiha), in the second you send blessings upon the Prophet and his family, in the third you supplicate for the believing men and believing women, in the fourth you supplicate for your deceased, and with the fifth you conclude (the prayer).

chapter: Manner Of Performing The Funeral Prayer, And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لىص :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع ،اعبرأ هيلع ربكف ىرخأ لىع لىصو ،اسمخ هيلع ربكف ةزانج لىع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلل ةيناثلا يف اعدو ،ىلولأا ةريبكتلا يف هدجمو الله دمحف اسمخ هيلع ربك يذلا امفأ ،ةسماخلا يف فرصناو ،تيملل ةعبارلا يف اعدو ،تانمؤملاو نينمؤملل ةثلاثلا يف اعدو ،(هلآو اعدو ،ةيناثلا يف هتيب لهأو هسفنل اعدو ،ىلولأا ةريبكتلا يف هدجمو الله دمحف اعبرأ هيلع ربك يذلا امأو .اقفانم ناك هنلأ هل عدي ملف ةعبارلا يف فرصناو ،ةثلاثلا يف تانمؤملاو نينمؤملل
englishText: From Abul Hasan (peace be upon him) who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) prayed over a funeral and made five takbeers on it, and prayed over another and made four takbeers on it. As for the one he made five takbeers on, he praised and glorified Allah in the first takbir, prayed for the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) in the second, prayed for the believing men and women in the third, prayed for the deceased in the fourth, and concluded in the fifth. And as for the one he made four takbeers on, he praised and glorified Allah in the first takbir, prayed for himself and his household in the second, prayed for the believing And as for the one he made four takbeers on, he praised and glorified Allah in the first takbir, prayed for himself and his household in the second, prayed for the believing men and women in the third, and concluded in the fourth without praying for him because he was a hypocrite.

chapter: Manner Of Performing The Funeral Prayer, And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: دهشأ ةيناثلاو ،ةلاصلا حاتفتسا ىلولأا ةريبكتلا ،زئانجلا لىع ةلاصلا :لقا :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ءانثلاو هتيب لهأ لىعو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لىع ةلاصلا ةثلاثلاو ،الله لوسر ادمحم نأو الله لاإ هلإ لا نأ نيب نم ريرسلا لمحي ىتح حربي لاو ،نيتريبكتلا نيب ام رادقم فقيو ،ملسي ةسماخلاو ،هل ةعبارلاو ،الله لىع .هيدي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The prayer over the deceased consists of: The first takbir is the opening of the prayer; in the second, say "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah"; in the third, send blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and his household and praise Allah; in the fourth, pray for him (the deceased); and in the fifth, give the salutation (salam). One should pause between takbirs for the duration between two takbirs, and should not leave until the bier is carried away from before him.

chapter: Manner Of Performing The Funeral Prayer, And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: :لوقت مث ،ربكت :لاقف ؟تيملا لىع ةلاصلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،اميلست اوملسو هيلع اولص اونمآ نيذلا اهيأ يا ،يبنلا لىع نولصي هتكئلامو الله نإ ،نوعجار هيلإ ناإو لله ناإ ميهاربإ لآو ميهاربإ لىع تكرباو تيلص امك دمحم لآو دمحم لىع كرباو ،دمحم لآو دمحم لىع لص مهللا ،نيملسملا مامإ لىعو دمحم لىع لص مهللا ،نيملسملا ةمئأ لىعو دمحم لىع لص مهللا ،ديجم ديمح كنإ هل رونو ،هربق يف هل حسفاو ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) دمحم هيبنب هقحلأ مهللا ،هب ملعأ تنأو نلاف كدبع مهللا كدنع مهللا ،هيف ناك امم ريخ ىلإ هعجرأو ،هل اريخ كدنع ام لعجاو ،هتجح هنقلو ،هحور دعصو ،هيف ،(كوفع كوفع مهللا) ،كوفع كوفع مهللا ،هدعب انتفت لاو ،هرجأ انمرحت لاف هبستحن لىص) دمحم هيبنب هقحلأ مهللا ،نلاف كدبع مهللا :لوقتو ةيناثلا ربكت مث ،ىلولأا ةريبكتلا يف هلك اذه لوقت ،هل اريخ كدنع ام لعجاو ،هتجح هنقلو ،هحور دعصو ،هيف هل رونو ،هربق يف هل حسفاو ،(هلآو هيلع الله مهللا كوفع مهللا ،هدعب انتفت لاو ،هرجأ انمرحت لاف ،هبستحن كدنع مهللا ،هيف ناك امم ريخ ىلإ هعجرأو ،ةعبارلاو ةثلاثلاو ةيناثلا يف اذه لوقت ،كوفع نيب فلأو ،تانمؤملاو نينمؤملل رفغا مهللا ،دمحم لآ لىعو دمحم لىع لص مهللا :لقف ةسماخلا تربك اذفإ لاغ انبولق يف لعجت لاو ،ناميلابا ناوقبس نيذلا انناوخلاو انل رفغا مهللا ،كلوسر ةلم لىع ينفوتو ،مهبولق .ملستو ،كوفع مهللا كوفع مهللا ،ميحر فوؤر كنإ انبر ،اونمآ نيذلل ميلستلاو ،رييختلا لىع ثيداحلأا هذه لمحتف ،نيعم ءاعد بوجو مدع لىعو كلذ لىع لدي ام يتيأو :لوقأ ةلاص زاوج لىع ةلاد يتيأ امو ثيداحلأا هذهو ،يتيأ امل هريغو خيشلا هركذ ،ةءارقلا اذكو ،ةيقتلا لىع لومحم .ةأرما وأ تيملا ناك لاجر ةزانجلا لىع ءاسنلاو لاجرلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about the prayer over the deceased. He said: Say Takbir, then say: "Indeed we belong to Allah and to Him we shall return. Indeed Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who believe, send blessings upon him and salute him with a worthy salutation. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You sent blessings and blessed Abraham and the family of Abraham. Indeed You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the Imams of the Muslims. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the Imam of the Muslims. O Allah, Your servant so-and-so, and You know best about him. O Allah, join him with his Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and grant him expanse in his grave, and illuminate it for him, and elevate his soul, and "Indeed we belong to Allah and to Him we shall return. Indeed Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who believe, send blessings upon him and salute him with a worthy salutation. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You sent blessings and blessed Abraham and the family of Abraham. Indeed You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the Imams of the Muslims. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the Imam of the Muslims. O Allah, Your servant so-and-so, and You know best about him. O Allah, join him with his Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and grant him expanse in his grave, and illuminate it for him, and elevate his soul, and inspire him with his proof, and make what is with You better for him, and return him to better than what he was in. O Allah, with You we reckon him, so do not deprive us of his reward and do not put us to trial after him. O Allah, Your pardon, Your pardon. O Allah, Your pardon, Your pardon." Say all of this in the first Takbir, then say the second Takbir and say: "O Allah, Your servant so-and-so. O Allah, join him with his Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and grant him expanse in his grave, and illuminate it for him, and elevate his soul, and inspire him with his proof, and make what is with You better for him, and return him to better than what he was in. O Allah, with You we reckon him, so do not deprive us of his reward and do not put us to trial after him. O Allah, Your pardon, O Allah, Your pardon." Say this in the second, third, and fourth. When you say the fifth Takbir, say: "O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad. O Allah, forgive the believing men and women, and unite their hearts, and cause me to die upon the religion of Your Messenger. O Allah, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and do not put in our hearts any rancor towards those who believe. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful. O Allah, Your pardon, O Allah, Your pardon," and say Salam. I (Hurr Amili) say: What indicates that and the lack of obligation of a specific supplication will come, so these hadiths are interpreted as giving a choice. The Salam is interpreted as taqiyyah, and likewise the recitation, as mentioned by the Shaykh and others based on what will come. These hadiths and what will come indicate the permissibility of men and women praying over the funeral, whether the deceased is a man or a woman.

chapter: How To Perform Prayer For The Weak (Mustadh'af) And Those Whose Faith Is Unknown
arabicText: لىع ليصت :هبهذم فرعي لا يذلاو فعضتسملا لىع ةلاصلا :لقا هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع مهقو كليبس اوعبتاو اوبتا نيذلل رفغا مهللا :لاقيو ،تانمؤملاو نينمؤملل ىعديو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا مهللا ،اهتمأ تنأو اهتييحأ تنأ سفنلا هذه نإ مهللا :هبهذم فرعي لا نم لىع ةلاصلا يف لاقيو ،ميحجلا باذع .تبحأ نم عم اهرشحاو ،تلوت ام اهلو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: The prayer for the weak and those whose doctrine is unknown: You send blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and pray for believing men and women, and say: O Allah, forgive those who have repented and followed Your path, and protect them from the punishment of Hell. And for those whose doctrine is unknown, say: O Allah, this soul You have given life to and You have caused its death. O Allah, grant it what it has chosen, and gather it with those it loved.

chapter: How To Perform Prayer For The Weak (Mustadh'af) And Those Whose Faith Is Unknown
arabicText: ةلاصلا :فرعي لا يذلاو فعضتسملا لىع ةلاصلا :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ملسم نب دمحم نع كليبس اوعبتاو اوبتا نيذلل رفغا) انبر :لوقت ،تانمؤملاو نينمؤملل ءاعدلاو ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لىع .نيتيلآا رخآ ىلإ ،(ميحجلا باذع مهقو
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim, from one of them (peace be upon them), he said: The prayer for the weak and those who are unknown: Send blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), and pray for believing men and women, saying: Our Lord, (forgive those who have repented and followed Your path, and protect them from the punishment of Hell), to the end of the two verses.

chapter: How To Perform Prayer For The Weak (Mustadh'af) And Those Whose Faith Is Unknown
arabicText: افقاو ناك نإو ،ءاعدلا يف هل دهتجاو هل عدفا نمؤملا لىع تيلص اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ميحجلا باذع مهقو كليبس اوعبتاو اوبتا نيذلل رفغا مهللا :لقو ،ربكف افعضتسم
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: When you pray for a believer, supplicate for him and strive in supplication. If he was a weak neutral one, say takbir and say: O Allah, forgive those who have repented and followed Your path, and protect them from the punishment of Hell.

chapter: How To Perform Prayer For The Weak (Mustadh'af) And Those Whose Faith Is Unknown
arabicText: مهقو كليبس اوعبتاو اوبتا نيذلل رفغا مهللا :لقف افعضتسم ناك نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،هنع زواجتو همحراو هل رفغفا هلهأو ريخلا بحي ناك نإ مهللا :لقف هلاح ام يردت لا تنك اذإو ،ميحجلا باذع .ةيلاولا هجو لىع لا ةعافشلا هجو لىع هل رفغتسفا ليبسب كنم فعضتسملا ناك نإو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: If he was weak, say: O Allah, forgive those who have repented and followed Your path, and protect them from the punishment of Hell. And if you don't know his condition, say: O Allah, if he loved goodness and its people, then forgive him, have mercy on him, and pardon him. And if the weak one was on Your path, seek forgiveness for him in the way of shafa'ah (intercession), not in the way of wilayah (*). Translator: * Wilayah: Allegiance and obedience to the divine leadership of the Ahl al-Bayt.

chapter: How To Perform Prayer For The Weak (Mustadh'af) And Those Whose Faith Is Unknown
arabicText: .ةعافشلا ةهجو ،ةيلاولا ةهج :نيتهج لىع محرتلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Mercy is of two types: through wilayah (divine guardianship) and through shafa'ah (intercession).

chapter: How To Perform Prayer For The Weak (Mustadh'af) And Those Whose Faith Is Unknown
arabicText: لص مهللا ،الله لوسر ادمحم نأ دهشأو ،الله لاإ هلإ لا نأ دهشأ :لوقت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،هعبت رثكأو ،ههجو ضيبو ،هتعافش لبقتو ،دمحم لآو دمحم لىع لص مهللا ،كلوسرو كدبع دمحم لىع انمؤم ناك نفإ ،ميحجلا باذع مهقو ،كليبس اوعبتاو اوبتا نيذلل رفغا مهللا ،ليع بتو ينمحراو يل رفغا مهللا .اهنم جرخ نمؤمب سيل ناك نإو ،اهيف لخد
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Say: I testify that there is no god but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, Your servant and messenger. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, accept his intercession, brighten his face, and increase his followers. O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, and accept my repentance. O Allah, forgive those who have repented and followed Your path, and protect them from the punishment of Hell. If he was a believer, he is included in it, and if he was not a believer, he is excluded from it.

chapter: How To Perform Prayer For The Weak (Mustadh'af) And Those Whose Faith Is Unknown
arabicText: هنم تنكو اهرضحف هتريج نم موقل ةزانجب اذفإ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ عم تنك :لقا مادقملا يبأ تبثا نع اهرئارسب ملعأ تنأو ،اهييحت تنأو اهتيمت تنأو ،سوفنلا هذه تقلخ كنإ مهللا :لوقي هتعمسف هنم ابيرق نيعفاش كانئج دق ،هب ملعأ تنأو ارش هنم ملعأ لاو كدبع اذهو مهللا ،اهعدوتسمو اهرقتسمو انم اهتينلاعو .هلاوتي ناك نم عم هرشحاو ،هيف انعفشف ابجوتسم ناك نفإ ،هتوم دعب هل هنم تنكو اهرضحف هتريج نم موقل ةزانجب اذفإ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ عم تنك :لقا مادقملا يبأ تبثا نع اهرئارسب ملعأ تنأو ،اهييحت تنأو اهتيمت تنأو ،سوفنلا هذه تقلخ كنإ مهللا :لوقي هتعمسف هنم ابيرق نيعفاش كانئج دق ،هب ملعأ تنأو ارش هنم ملعأ لاو كدبع اذهو مهللا ،اهعدوتسمو اهرقتسمو انم اهتينلاعو .هلاوتي ناك نم عم هرشحاو ،هيف انعفشف ابجوتسم ناك نفإ ،هتوم دعب هل
englishText: From Thabit Abu Al-Miqdam, he said: I was with Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) when there was a funeral of some of his neighbors. He attended it, and I was close to him. I heard him saying: O Allah, You created these souls, and You cause them to die and You give them life, and You know their secrets and what they reveal better than we do, and their permanent and temporary abodes. O Allah, this is Your servant, and I don't know any evil from him, and You know him better. We have come to You as intercessors for him after his death, so if he deserves it, accept our intercession for him, and gather him with those whom he used to follow.

chapter: Manner Of Praying Over The Opponents, And The Dislike Of Running Away From Their Funeral If They Outwardly Profess Islam
arabicText: كل ودع هنأ لاإ هنم ملعن لا ناإ مهللا :لقف الله ودع لىع تيلص اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع يداعيو ،كءادعأ يلاوي ناك هنفإ ،رانلا ىلإ هب لجعو ،ارنا هفوج شحاو ،ارنا هربق شحفا مهللا ،كلوسرلو .هكزت لاو هعفرت لا مهللا :لقف عفر اذفإ ،هربق هيلع قيض مهللا ،كيبن تيب لهأ ضغبيو ،كئايلوأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When you pray over an enemy of Allah, say: "O Allah, we know nothing about him except that he was an enemy to You and Your Messenger. O Allah, fill his grave with fire, fill his body with fire, and hasten him to the Fire, for he used to ally with Your enemies, show enmity to Your friends, and hate the household of Your Prophet. O Allah, constrict his grave upon him." And when he is lifted (from the prayer), say: "O Allah, do not elevate him and do not purify him."

chapter: Manner Of Praying Over The Opponents, And The Dislike Of Running Away From Their Funeral If They Outwardly Profess Islam
arabicText: يشمي (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نب نيسحلا جرخف نيقفانملا نم لجر تام :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هيلع ليصأ نأ قفانملا اذه ةزانج نم رفأ :لاقف ؟بهذت نيأ ىلإ :هل لاقف هل ىلوم هيقلف زخأ مهللا :لاقف هيدي عفرف :لقا ،هلثم لقف لوقأ ينتعمس امف يبنج ىلإ مق (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا هل لاقف يداعيو ،كءادعأ ىلوتي ناك هنفإ ،كباذع رح هقذأ مهللا ،كرنا دشأ هلصأ مهللا ،كدلابو كدابع يف كدبع .كيبن تيب لهأ ضغبيو ،كءايلوأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A man from among the hypocrites died, and Al-Husayn bin Ali (peace be upon him) went out walking when a servant of his met him and asked: "Where are you going?" He replied: "I am fleeing from the funeral of this hypocrite so that I do not pray over him." Husayn (peace be upon him) told him: "Stand beside me and repeat whatever you hear me say." Then he raised his hands and said: "O Allah, disgrace Your servant among Your servants and in Your lands. O Allah, expose him to the most intense of Your fire. O Allah, make him taste the heat of Your punishment, for he used to ally with Your enemies, show enmity to Your allies, and hate the household of Your Prophet."

chapter: Manner Of Praying Over The Opponents, And The Dislike Of Running Away From Their Funeral If They Outwardly Profess Islam
arabicText: دشأ هقذأو ،كرنا هلصأ مهللا ،كدابعو كدلاب يف كدبع زخأ مهللا :لوقت :لقا رصن يبأ نب دمحم نب دمحأ نع .كيبن تيب لهأ ضغبيو ،كءادعأ يلاويو ،كءايلوأ يداعي ناك هنفإ ،كباذع
englishText: Narrated by Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr who said: You say: O Allah, disgrace Your servant in Your lands and among Your servants. O Allah, make him reach Your f ire and make him taste Your severest punishment, for he used to show enmity to Your friends/allies, befriend Your enemies, and hate the Ahl-e-bayt of Your Prophet.

chapter: Manner Of Praying Over The Opponents, And The Dislike Of Running Away From Their Funeral If They Outwardly Profess Islam
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا رضح لولس نب يبأ نب الله دبع تام امل :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع نأ الله كهني ملأ :لاقف ،تكسف !؟هربق لىع موقت نأ الله كهني ملأ ،الله لوسر يا :رمع لاقف ،هتزانج (هلآو هلصأو ،ارنا هربق لأماو ،ارنا هفوج شحا مهللا :تلق ينإ !؟تلق ام كيردي امو ،كليو :هل لاقف !؟هربق لىع موقت .هركي ناك ام (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نم ىدبفأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .ارنا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When Abdullah ibn Ubayy ibn Salul died, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) attended his funeral. Then Umar said: "O Messenger of Allah, hasn't Allah forbidden you from standing at his grave?!" The Prophet remained silent. Umar repeated: "Hasn't Allah forbidden you from standing at his grave?!" He replied to him: "Woe to you! What do you know about what I said? I said: O Allah, fill his inside with fire, fill his grave with fire, and make his destination fire." Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: This revealed from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) what he disliked.

chapter: Manner Of Praying Over The Opponents, And The Dislike Of Running Away From Their Funeral If They Outwardly Profess Islam
arabicText: هيلع طلسو ،ارنا هربقو ارنا هفوج لاما مهللا :لقف قحلل ادحاج ناك نإ :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع هذه لقاو ،يبأ اهيلع لىص ةيمأ ينب نم ءوس ةأرملا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ هلقا كلذو ،براقعلاو تايحلا .انيرق اهل ناطيشلا لعجاو :ةلاقملا
englishText: From one of the two (peace be upon them), he said: If he was a denier of the truth, say: "O Allah, fill his inside with fire, his grave with fire, and unleash upon him snakes and scorpions." That is what Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said for an evil woman from Banu Umayyah over whom my father prayed, and he said these words: "And make Satan her companion."

chapter: Manner Of Praying Over The Opponents, And The Dislike Of Running Away From Their Funeral If They Outwardly Profess Islam
arabicText: يشمي (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نب نيسحلا جرخف تام نيقفانملا نم لاجر نأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع نم رفأ :هلاوم هل لاقف :لقا !؟نلاف يا بهذت نيأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا هل لاقف ،هل ىلوم هيقلف ،هعم ،اهيلع ليصأ نأ قفانملا اذه ةزانج يشمي (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نب نيسحلا جرخف تام نيقفانملا نم لاجر نأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع نم رفأ :هلاوم هل لاقف :لقا !؟نلاف يا بهذت نيأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا هل لاقف ،هل ىلوم هيقلف ،هعم ،اهيلع ليصأ نأ قفانملا اذه ةزانج هيلع ربك نأ املف ،هلثم لقف لوقأ ينعمست امف ينيمي لىع موقت نأ رظنأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا هل لاقف يف كدبع زخأ مهللا ،ةفلتخم ريغ ةفلتؤم ةنعل فلأ كدبع نالاف نعلا مهللا ،ربكأ الله :نيسحلا لقا هيلو لهأ ضغبيو ،كءايلوأ يداعيو ،كءادعأ ىلوتي ناك هنفإ ،كباذع دشأ هقذأو ،كرنا رح هلصأو ،كدلابو كدابع .كيبن تيب
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), that a man from among the hypocrites died, and Al-Husayn bin Ali (peace be upon him) went walking with his funeral. A freed slave of his met him and said to Al-Husayn (peace be upon him): "Where are you going, O so-and-so?!" His freed slave said to him: "I am fleeing from the funeral of this hypocrite to avoid praying over him." Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) said to him: "Stand to my right and repeat whatever you hear me say." When the guardian of the deceased made the takbir, Al-Husayn said: "Allahu Akbar. O Allah, curse Your servant so-and-so with a thousand unified, consistent curses. O Allah, disgrace Your servant among Your servants and in Your lands, make him reach the heat of Your fire, and make him taste Your severest punishment, for he used to ally with Your enemies, show enmity to Your friends, and hate the household of Your Prophet."

chapter: Manner Of Praying Over The Opponents, And The Dislike Of Running Away From Their Funeral If They Outwardly Profess Islam
arabicText: املف اهترضحف ةيمأ ينب نم ةأرما تتام :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،هركذ نمع وأ ،الله دبع يبأ نع :لقا ،لله ةودع تناكو :لقا ،اهكزت لاو اهعفرت لاو اهعض مهللا :لقا لاجرلا يديأ لىع تراصو اهوعفرو اهيلع اولص .انلو :لقا لاإ ملعأ لاو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, or from someone who mentioned it, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A woman from Bani Umayyah died and I attended her funeral. When they prayed over her and lifted her, and she was being carried by the men's hands, he said: "O Allah, lower her and do not elevate her and do not purify her." He said: She was an enemy of Allah. He said: And I believe he also said: And an enemy to us.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: موق لىعو ،اسمخ موق لىع ربكي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .قافنلبا ينعي - مهتا اعبرأ لجر لىع ربك اذفإ ،اعبرأ نيرخآ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to say Takbir five times over some people, and four times over others. If he said Takbir four times over a man, he was suspected meaning of hypocrisy.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: :لقا ؟اسمخ تيملا لىع ريبكتلا لعج مل :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا هعفر ،هيبأ نع ،هنعو .ةريبكت ةلاص لك نم درو :لاقف
englishText: From him, from his father, raising it, he said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Why was the Takbir over the deceased made five? He said: A Takbir is taken from each prayer.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: اسمخ ةلاصلا ضرف ىلاعتو كرابت الله نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةريبكت ةلاص لك نم تيملل لعجو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, obligated five prayers and made for the deceased a Takbir from each prayer.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: يردتف ،تاريبكت سمخ :لقا ،لا :تلق ؟تيملا لىع ةلاصلا مك يردت ،ركببا يا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا .ةريبكت ةلاص لك نم ،تاولص سمخلا نم تاريبكت سمخلا تذخأ :لقا ،لا :تلق ؟سمخلا تذخأ نيأ نم
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: O Ba Bakr, do you know how many Takbirs are in the prayer for the deceased? I said: No. He said: Five Takbirs. Do you know where the five were derived from? I said: No. He said: The five Takbirs were taken from the Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: O Ba Bakr, do you know how many Takbirs are in the prayer for the deceased? I said: No. He said: Five Takbirs. Do you know where the five were derived from? I said: No. He said: The five Takbirs were taken from the f ive daily prayers, one Takbir from each prayer.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: سمخف نمؤملا امأ :لاقف ؟تيملا لىع ةلاصلا نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا يبأ نع .اهيف ملاس لاو ،عبرفأ قفانملا امأو ،تاريبكت
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about the prayer over the deceased. He said: As for the believer, it is five Takbirs, and as for the hypocrite, it is four, and there is no Salam in it.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: .تاريبكت سمخ تيملا لىع ريبكتلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The Takbir over the deceased is five Takbirs.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: .اسمخ هديب :لاقف ؟تيملا لىع ريبكتلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the Takbir over the deceased. He gestured with his hand five [times].

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: .اسمخ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ربك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said Takbir five [times].

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: .اسمخ :لاقف ؟تيملا لىع ريبكتلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the Takbir over the deceased. He said: Five.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: .تاريبكت سمخ تيملا لىع ريبكتلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The Takbir over the deceased is five Takbirs.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: لىص (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تعمس :لقا ةدئاز نب ةمادق نع .اسمخ هيلع ربكف ميهاربإ هنبا لىع
englishText: From Qudamah bin Za'idah, he said: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) prayed over his son Ibrahim and said Takbir over him five [times].

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: ؟زئانجلا لىع ريبكتلا نع هلأسف لجر لخدف اسلاج (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ دنع تنك :لقا ريصب يبأ نع ،تاولص عبرأ :هل لاقف ؟زئانجلا لىع ةلاصلا نع هلأسف رخآ لخد مث ،تاريبكت سمخ :لاقف ،ريبكتلا نع ينتلأس كنإ :لاقف !؟اعبرأ :تلقف اذه كلأسو ،اسمخ :تلقف كتلأس ،كادف تلعج :لولأا لاقف سمخ نهنإ :لاقف هفك طسب مث ،تاولص عبرأ نهنيب تاريبكت سمخ اهنإ :لقا مث ،ةلاصلا نع اذه ينلأسو .تاولص عبرأ نهنيب تاريبكت .ءاعدلا ينعأ ،يوغللا ىنعملا انه ةلاصلبا دارملا :لوقأ
englishText: From Abu Basir, he said: I was sitting with Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) when a man entered and asked him about the Takbir over the funerals. He said: Five Takbirs. Then another entered and asked him about the prayer over the funerals. He said to him: Four prayers. The first one said: May I be sacrificed for you, I asked you and you said: Five, and this one asked you and you said: Four?! He said: You asked me about the Takbir, and this one asked me about the prayer. Then he said: It is five Takbirs with four prayers between them. Then he extended his palm and said: It is five Takbirs with four prayers between them. I (Hurr Amili) say: What is meant by prayer here is the linguistic meaning, meaning supplication (dua).

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: لوسر يا مدقت :ليئربجل الله ةبه لقا ،هيلع ةلاصلا ىلإ غلبف مدآ تام امل :لقا هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع ،مهربأ نم تنأو هدلو راربأ مدقتن انسلف كيبلأ دوجسلبا نارمأ الله نإ :ليئربج لاقف ،الله يبن لىع لصف الله ةنسلا يهو ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) دمحم ةمأ لىع الله اهضرف يتلا تاولصلا ةدع اسمخ هيلع ربكف مدقتف .ةمايقلا موي ىلإ هدلو يف ةيراجلا
englishText: From Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), that he said: When Adam died and reached the (time for) prayer over him, Hibbatullah (*) said to Gabriel: Step forward, O Messenger of Allah, and pray over the Prophet of Allah. Gabriel said: Indeed, Allah commanded us to prostrate to your father, so we do not step forward in front of the From Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), that he said: When Adam died and reached the (time for) prayer over him, Hibbatullah (*) said to Gabriel: Step forward, O Messenger of Allah, and pray over the Prophet of Allah. Gabriel said: Indeed, Allah commanded us to prostrate to your father, so we do not step forward in front of the righteous among his children, and you are among the most righteous of them. So he stepped forward and said Takbir over him five [times], the number of prayers that Allah obligated upon the nation of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and this is the ongoing Sunnah among his children until the Day of Resurrection. Translator: * Prophet Seth (Sheeth in Arabic), the son of Prophet Adam (peace be upon them both).

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: :ضئارف سمخ سانلا لىع ضرف الله نأ تاريبكت سمخ تيملا لىع ربكي اهلجأ نم يتلا ةلعلاو :قودصلا لقا .ةريبكت ةضيرف لك نم تيملل لعجف ،ةيلاولاو جحلاو موصلاو ةاكزلاو ةلاصلا
englishText: Al-Saduq said: The reason for which Takbir is said five times over the deceased is that Allah obligated five obligations upon the people: prayer, Zakat, fasting, Hajj, and Wilayah. So He made for the deceased a Takbir from each obligation.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: تيملل ةضيرف ةلاص لك نم لعجف ،تاولص سمخ سانلا لىع ضرف الله نأ كلذ يف ةلعلا نأ يورو :لقا .ةريبكت
englishText: He said: It is narrated that the reason for that is that Allah obligated five prayers upon the people, so He made a Takbir for the deceased from each obligatory prayer.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: اهنأ اوور :لقا ؟تاريبكت سمخ تيملا لىع ريبكتلا يف ةلعلا ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا لقا (رابخلأا نويع) يفو ،ثيدحلا رهاظ اذه :لاقف ،تاولص سمخ نم تقتشا لعجف ،ةيلاولاو جحلاو موصلاو ةاكزلاو ةلاصلا :ضئارف سمخ دابعلا لىع ضرف الله نفإ ،رخآ هجو يف امفأ نمف ،اعبرأ ربك ةيلاولا لبقي مل نمو ،اسمخ ربك ةيلاولا لبق نمف ،ةدحاو ةريبكت ةضيرف لك نم تيملل .اعبرأ ربكي مكفلاخ نمو ،اسمخ نوربكت كلذ لجأ
englishText: In (Uyun al-Akhbar): Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) said: What is the reason for the Takbir over the deceased being five Takbirs? He said: They narrated that it is derived from the five prayers. He said: This is the apparent meaning of the hadith. As for another aspect, Allah obligated five obligations upon the servants: prayer, Zakat, fasting, Hajj, and Wilayah. So He made for the deceased one Takbir from each obligation. Whoever accepts Wilayah says Takbir five times, and whoever does not accept Wilayah says Takbir four times. For this reason, you say Takbir five times, and those who oppose you say Takbir four times.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: ربكيو ،تاريبكت سمخ تيملا لىع ربكن ةلع يلأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا ريصب يبأ نع جحلاو موصلاو ةاكزلاو ةلاصلا :سمخ ملاسلاا اهيلع ينب يتلا مئاعدلا نلا :لقا ؟تاريبكت عبربأ ناوفلاخم رقأو ،اهلك سمخلبا متررقأ مكنإو ،ةريبكت ةماعد لك نم تيملل الله لعجف ،تيبلا لهأ انل ةيلاولاو .اسمخ نوربكتو ،تاريبكت عبرأ مهتاوم لىع نوربكي كلذ نمف ،ةدحاو اوركنأو عبربأ مكوفلاخم
englishText: From Abu Basir, he said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): For what reason do we say Takbir over the deceased five times, and those who oppose us say Takbir four times? He said: Because the pillars upon which Islam is built are five: prayer, Zakat, fasting, Hajj, and Wilayah for us, the Ahl al-Bayt. So Allah made for the deceased a Takbir from each pillar. You have acknowledged all five, while those who oppose you have acknowledged four and denied one. For that reason, they say Takbir over their deceased four times, and you say Takbir five times.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: الله لىص) الله لوسر ريبكتب قفانملاو نمؤملا فرعي ناك لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اعبرأ قفانملا لىعو ،اسمخ نمؤملا لىع ربكي (هلآو هيلع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: The believer and the hypocrite were known by the Takbir of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). He would say five Takbirs over the believer and four over the hypocrite.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: نإ :لاقف ؟تاريبكت سمخ تيملا لىع ربكي مل :(ملاسلا مهيلع) نيقداصلا ضعب لئس :لقا (عنقملا) يفو .ةريبكت ةلاص لك نم تيملل لعجف تاولص سمخ ضرف لجو زع الله
englishText: In (Al-Muqni'), he said: One of the Truthful Ones (peace be upon them) was asked: Why is Takbir said five times over the deceased? He said: Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, obligated five prayers, so He made for the deceased a Takbir from each prayer.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: سمخ تيملا لىع ةلاصلاو :لقا - نومأملا ىلإ هباتك يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع ،ناذاش نب لضفلا نع .هربق هلخدأ اذإ هب قفريو هيلجر لبق نم لسي تيملاو ،ةنسلا فلاخ دقف صقن نمف ،تاريبكت
englishText: From Al-Fadhl ibn Shadhan, from Al-Ridha (peace be upon him)- in his letter to Al Ma'mun- he said: The prayer for the deceased is five Takbirs, and whoever reduces from this has opposed the Sunnah, and the deceased should be pulled from the direction of his feet and should be handled gently when placing him in his grave.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: هل اوعفشيل تيملا لىع ةلاصلبا اورمأ امنإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع :(للعلا) و (رابخلأا نويع) يفو كلت نم رافغتسلااو ةبلطلاو هيف ةعافشلا ىلإ جوحأ تقاولأا نم تقو يف نكي مل هنلأ ،ةرفغملبا هل اوعديلو نم تذخأ امنإ تاريبكت سمخلا نلا ،اتس وأ اعبرأ ريصت نأ نود تاريبكت سمخ تلعج امنإو ،ةعاسلا .ةليللاو مويلا يف تاولصلا سمخلا
englishText: In (Uyun al-Akhbar) and (Al-Ilal): from Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), he said: They were commanded to pray over the deceased so that they intercede for him and supplicate for forgiveness for him, because there is no time in which he is more in need of intercession, request, and seeking forgiveness than that hour. The five Takbirs were made, rather than becoming four or six, because the five Takbirs are taken from the five prayers in the day and night.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: مث ةكئلاملا هتلسغف (الله هضبق املف) - :لقا نأ ىلإ - كىتشا مدآ نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ربكي نأ هيلإ الله حىوأو ،هفلخ ةكئلاملاو ،هيلع لىصو مدقتف هيلع لىصيو مدقتي نأ الله ةبه رمأو عضو .مكتاومب اوعنصفا اذكه :لقا مث ،هربق يوسيو هلسي نأو اسمخ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Adam fell ill- until he said (when Allah took his soul), the angels washed him, then he was placed and Hibatullah (*) was ordered to go forward and pray over him. He went forward and prayed over him with the angels behind him. Allah revealed to him to say five Takbirs and to enter him [into the grave] him and level his grave. Then he said: This is how you should treat your dead. Translator: * Prophet Seth (Sheeth in Arabic), the son of Prophet Adam (peace be upon them both).

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: تيملا لىع ةلاصلاو :لقا - نيدلا عيارش ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم نب رفعج نع ،شمعلأا نع .ةنسلا فلاخ دقف اهنم صقن نمف ،تاريبكت سمخ
englishText: From Al-A'mash, from Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon him)- in a hadith about the laws of religion- he said: The prayer over the deceased is five Takbirs. Whoever decreases from it has opposed the Sunnah.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: هيلع) ليع نع ،هيوببا نبلا (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا رابخأ باتك نم لاقن (ةمغلا فشك) يف ىسيع نب ليع هيلع) ليع نب دمحم نعو .لايل اهنفدو اسمخ اهيلع ربكو (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا لىع لىص هنأ (ملاسلا .لايل تنفد (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا نأو ،هلثم (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع ،هيوببا نبلا (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا رابخأ باتك نم لاقن (ةمغلا فشك) يف ىسيع نب ليع هيلع) ليع نب دمحم نعو .لايل اهنفدو اسمخ اهيلع ربكو (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا لىع لىص هنأ (ملاسلا .لايل تنفد (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا نأو ،هلثم (ملاسلا
englishText: Ali bin Isa in (Kashf al-Ghumma), quoting from the book Akhbar Fatima by Ibn Babawayh, from Ali (peace be upon him) that he performed the funeral prayer for Fatima (peace be upon her) and made five Takbirs over her and buried her at night. And from Muhammad bin Ali (peace be upon him) similar to it, and that Fatima (peace be upon her) was buried at night. Translator: Hadith 3069 and 3070 exist in a single entry.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: نينمؤملا لىع ليصي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناك :اولقا مهنأ (ملاسلا مهيلع) نيقداصلا نع يور نيبو مهنيب قارف ،اعبرأ ربكيف ،مهيلع ةلاصلا نع ىهنلا درو نم ىوس قافنلا لهأ لىع ليصيو ،اسمخ ربكيو .قافنلا هيلع اوعطق اعبرأ ربكو تيم لىع لىص دق هتأر اذإ ةباحصلا تناكو ناميلاا لهأ
englishText: It is narrated from the Two Truthful Ones [Imam Sadiq and Imam Baqir] (peace be upon them) that they said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would pray over the believers and make five Takbirs, and he would pray over the hypocrites, except those for whom prohibition of prayer was mentioned, making four Takbirs, to distinguish between them and the people of faith. When the companions saw him pray over a deceased and make four Takbirs, they would determine their hypocrisy.

chapter: Obligation Of Five Takbirs In The Funeral Prayer, And The Sufficiency Of Four With Taqiyyah, Or If The Deceased Was An Opponent
arabicText: لاقف هباحصأ ىلإ تفتلا مث ،اسمخ ربكو فينح نب لهس لىع لىص هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نعو .ردب لهأ نم هنإ :مهل
englishText: From Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) that he performed the funeral prayer for Sahl bin Hunaif and made five Takbirs, then he turned to his companions and said to them: He was from the people of Badr.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: ياردب ناكو فينح نب لهس لىع (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ ربك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع اسمخ هيلع ربك ىتح كلذ هب عنصف ،ىرخأ ةسمخ هيلع ربكو هعضو مث ةعاس ىشم مث ،تاريبكت سمخ .ةريبكت نيرشعو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) pronounced five Takbirs over Sahl bin Hunaif, who was a participant at Badr, then walked for a while then placed him down and pronounced another five Takbirs over him, and he did this with him until he had pronounced twenty-five Takbirs over him.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: هيلع) ليع مقا يفوت امل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نإ :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .نوجرخي مث ،هيلع نولصي ةرشع ةرشع سانلا رمأ مث ،هيلع لىصف بابلا لىع (ملاسلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: When the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) passed away, Ali (peace be upon him) stood at the door and prayed over him. Then he commanded the people [to enter] ten by ten to pray over him, then they would exit.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: نيعبس ةزمح لىع لىص (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ةريبكت نيعبس هيلع ربكو ،ةلاص
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) performed seventy prayers over Hamza and made seventy Takbirs over him.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: الله ةبه مدقت هيلع ةلاصلا ىلإ غلبف تام امل مدآ نإ :- ليوط ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع اسمخ عفرف ليئربج رمفأ ،ةريبكت نيثلاث هيلع ربكو ،ةكئلاملا دونجو هفلخ ليئربجو هيبأ لىع لىصف .اعبسو اعست ردب لهأ لىع ربكي ناك دقو ،تاريبكت سمخ انيف مويلا ةنسلاو ،ةريبكت نيرشعو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)- in a long hadith-: When Adam died and it reached the prayer over him, Hibbatullah (*) stepped forward and prayed over his father with Gabriel behind him and the armies of angels. He said thirty Takbirs over him. Gabriel was commanded to reduce it by twenty-five Takbirs. Today, the Sunnah among us is five Takbirs, although he used to say Takbir nine and seven times over the people of Badr. Translator: * Prophet Seth (Sheeth in Arabic), the son of Prophet Adam (peace be upon them both).

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: ربكو ،ةريبكت نيعبس ةزمح لىع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ربك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع املك ،اسمخ اسمخ ربك :لقا ،ةريبكت نيرشعو اسمخ فينح نب لهس لىع مكدنع (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع ىلإ ىهتنا ىتح ،اسمخ هيلع ربكيف هعضيف لهس لىع ةلاصلا كردن مل نينمؤملا ريمأ يا :اولقا سانلا هكردأ .تارم سمخ هربق
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) pronounced seventy Takbirs for Hamza, and Ali (peace be upon him) pronounced twenty-five Takbirs for Sahl bin Hunaif among you. He said: He would pronounce five Takbirs each time, whenever people would come they would say: O Amir al-Mu'minin, we did not get to pray for Sahl, so he would place him down and pronounce five Takbirs over him, until he reached his grave five times.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: :لوقأ .ةلاص نيعبس ةزمح لىع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لىص :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .رم امل ءاعدلا انه ةلاصلبا دارملا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) prayed seventy prayers upon Hamza. Shaykh Hurr Amili: What is meant by prayer here is supplication (dua), as previously mentioned.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: لىع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ربك :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) ليع نع ،هئباآ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع .ةريبكت نيعبس ةزمح باصفأ تاريبكت سمخ ةزمح دعب ءادهشلا لىع ربكو ،تاريبكت سمخ ةزمح
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said five Takbirs over Hamza, and said five Takbirs over the martyrs after Hamza, so Hamza received seventy Takbirs.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ مأ دسأ تنب ةمطفا لىع لىص (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نأ سابع نبا نع مل :رامع هل لاقف ،ةريبكت نيعبرأ اهيلع ربك مث ،ةلاصلا كلت لثم اهلبق دحأ لىع لصي مل ةلاص (ملاسلا نم افص نيعبرأ ىلإ ترظنف ينيمي ىلإ تفتلا ،رامع يا معن :لقا ؟الله لوسر يا ةريبكت نيعبرأ اهيلع تربك .ةريبكت فص لكل تربكف ةكئلاملا
englishText: From Ibn Abbas, that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) prayed over Fatimah bint Asad, the mother of Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him), a prayer that he had not prayed over anyone before her like that prayer.
