Then he said forty Takbirs over her. Ammar said to him: Why did you say forty Takbirs over her, O Messenger of Allah? He said: Yes, O Ammar. I turned to my right and saw forty rows of angels, so I said a Takbir for each row.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: هلسغي لا نأ ىصوأ ناك دقو ،الله لوسر لسغي وهو (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع تيتأ :لقا هنأ يسرافلا ناملس نع :لقا نأ ىلإ - (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع ريغ لىصف هفلخ انففصو مدقتف نيسحلاو نسحلاو ةمطفاو دادقملاو رذ باأ لخدأو ينلخدأ هنفكو هلسغ املف نم دحأ قبي مل ىتح :نوجرخيو نولصيف ،راصنلأا نم ةرشعو ،نيرجاهملا نم ةرشع لخدأ مث .هيلع .هيلع لىص لاإ راصنلأاو نيرجاهملا
englishText: From Salman Al-Farsi, that he said: I came to Ali (peace be upon him) while he was washing the Messenger of Allah, and he had instructed that no one should wash him except Ali (peace be upon him) - until he said: Whenhewashed him and shrouded him, he brought me in along with Abu Dharr, Al Miqdad, Fatimah, Al-Hasan, and Al-Husayn. He stepped forward and we lined up behind him and he prayed over him. Then he brought in ten of the Muhajirun and ten of the Ansar. They would pray and exit, until there did not remain anyone from the Muhajirun and the Ansar except that they prayed over him.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: ؟هيلع ةلاصلا فيك :سانلا لقا - لقا نأ ىلإ الله لوسر زيهجت ثيدح ركذو - (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ةرشع ةرشع هيلع لخدف * ،اتيمو ايح انمامإ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) ليع لاقف مهركذ مهريغصو مهريبك هيلع لىص ىتح ،ءثالاثلا مويو حابصلا ىتح ءثالاثلا ةليلو نينثلاا موي هيلع اولصف .مامإ ريغب ةنيدملا حياوضو مهاثنأو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)- and he mentioned the hadith about preparing the Prophet until he said- People asked: How should we pray over him? Ali (peace be upon him) said: Indeed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) is our Imam in life and death, so they entered upon him in groups of ten and prayed over him on Monday and Monday night until morning and on Tuesday, until all of them prayed over him- their elders and their young, their males and their females, and those from the outskirts of Medina - without any imam (leading it).

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: الله لىص) الله لوسر هب ىصوأ اميف ناك :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع ،رفعج نب ىسوم نسحلا يبأ نع ،(ملاسلا هيلع) ليع ريغ هربق لخدي لاو ،نامي اهدحأ :باوثأ ةثلاثب نفكيو ،هتيب يف نفدي نأ (هلآو هيلع ،فرصناو اسمخ ربكو ،ةريبكت نيعبسو اسمخ اوربكو ،نيسحلاو نسحلاو ةمطفاو تنأ نك ليع يا :لقا مث يتيب لهأ لاجر مث ،اهب كنذؤي ليئربج :لقا ؟اهب يل نذؤي نمو :ليع :لقا .ةلاصلا يف كل نذؤي نأ دعب كلذو .تلعفف :لقا ،كلذ دعب نم سانلا مث ،مهؤاسن مث ،اجاوفأ اجاوفأ لىع نولصي
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Musa bin Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon them both), he said: Among what the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) instructed was that he be buried in his house, shrouded in three garments, one of them Yemeni, and that no one enter his grave except Ali (peace be upon him). Then he said: O Ali, you and Fatima and Al-Hasan and Al-Husain be present, and say Takbir seventy-five times, and say Takbir five times and depart, and that is after you are given permission for the prayer. Ali said: And who will give me permission for it? He said: Gabriel will give you permission for it, then the men of my household will pray in successive groups, then their women, then the people after that. He (Ali) said: So I did that.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: ناكو تاريبكت عبس فينح نب لهس لىع (ملاسلا هيلع) بلاط يبأ نب ليع ربك :لقا هنأ ديز نب نسحلا نع .لاهأ ناكل نيعبس هيلع تربك ول :لقاو ،ياردب
englishText: From Al-Hasan bin Zayd who said: Ali bin Abi Talib (peace be upon him) made seven Takbirs in the funeral prayer of Sahl bin Hunaif who was a participant of Badr, and he said: If I had made seventy Takbirs for him, he would have been worthy of it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: ءاج اهنم غرف املف ةزانج لىع لىص (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع تيضق دق :مهل لاقف ،اهيلع ةلاصلا ديعي نأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر هوملكف اهوكردأ اونوكي مل موق .اهل اوعدا نكلو اهيلع ةلاصلا
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon them both), that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) performed prayer on a funeral. When he finished it, some people who had not caught up with it came and asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) to repeat the prayer on it. He said to them: I have already performed the prayer on it, but you may make supplication for the deceased. Shaykh Hurr Amili: This indicates that repeating the prayer is not obligatory, but not that it is impermissible.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: هيلع لىصو الله ةبه جرخف :لقا - (ملاسلا هيلع) مدآ ةفاو ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا نبا ليع نع .هدلاولأ ةسمخو ،مدلآ نيعبس :ةريبكت نيعبسو اسمخ هيلع ربكو
englishText: From Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon him)- in the hadith of Adam's death (peace be upon him)- he said: Hibbatullah (*) went out and prayed over him and said seventy-five Takbirs over him: seventy for Adam, and five for his children. Translator: * Prophet Seth (Sheeth in Arabic), the son of Prophet Adam (peace be upon them both).

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: !الله ةبه يا مدقت :ليئربج لقا - مدآ ينعي - هوزهج املف :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع اسمخو :(ملاسلا هيلع) مدلآ لاضفت نيعبس ةريبكت نيعبسو اسمخ هيلع ربكف مدقتف ،كيبأ لىع لصف .ةنسلل
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: When they prepared him- meaning Adam- Gabriel said: "Step forward, O Hibbatullah (*)! Pray over your father." So he stepped forward and said seventy-five Takbirs over him, seventy as a favor for Adam (peace be upon him), and five for the Sunnah. Translator: * Prophet Seth (Sheeth in Arabic), the son of Prophet Adam (peace be upon them both).

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نفك :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تعمس :لقا يراصنلأا ميرم يبأ نع موق لخد اذفإ ،تيبلا طسو لعجو بوثب جيس :لقا ؟هيلع لىص فيكو :تلق - :لقا نأ ىلإ - باوثأ ةثلاث .نورخآ لخديو نوجرخي مث هل اوعدو هيلع اولصو هب اوراد يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نفك :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تعمس :لقا يراصنلأا ميرم يبأ نع موق لخد اذفإ ،تيبلا طسو لعجو بوثب جيس :لقا ؟هيلع لىص فيكو :تلق - :لقا نأ ىلإ - باوثأ ةثلاث .نورخآ لخديو نوجرخي مث هل اوعدو هيلع اولصو هب اوراد
englishText: From Abu Maryam Al-Ansari who said: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was shrouded in three garments- then he said- I asked: And how was the prayer performed over him? He said: He was covered with a cloth and placed in the middle of the house, and when people entered they would circle around him, pray over him and supplicate for him, then they would leave and others would enter.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: ربك ،لا :لاقف ؟تقوم ئش هيف له ةزانجلا لىع ريبكتلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس :لقا رباج نع خيشلا لمح :لوقأ .اعبرأو ،اتسو ،اسمخو ،اعبسو ،اعستو ،رشع دحأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر .رم امل افلاخم تيملا نوك لىعو ،ةيقتلا لىع عبرلأا
englishText: From Jabir, he said: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the Takbir over the funeral, is there a specific number for it? He said: No. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said eleven, nine, seven, five, six, and four Takbirs. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Shaykh interpreted the four as taqiyyah, and based on the deceased being an opponent, as previously mentioned.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: اوءاش ام تيملا لهأ ىلإ كلذ :لاقف ؟زئانجلا لىع ريبكتلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج لئس :لقا رفعج نع ،مهيلإ كاذ :لاقف ،اعبرأ نوربكي مهنإ :ليقف ،اوربك ،تاولص سمخ هيلع لىص ىتح اسمخ هيلع ربكف (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع هيلع لىص لاجر نأ مكغلب امأ :لقا مث مهراتخا نيذلا ءابقنلا نم ناكو ،يدحأ يبقع يردب هنإ :لقا مث :لقا .تاريبكت سمخ ةلاص لك يف ربكي .ةلاص ةبقنم لكل هيلع لىصف ،بقانم سمخ هل تناكو ،رشع ينثلاا نم (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر
englishText: Ja'far (peace be upon him) was asked about the Takbir over the funerals. He said: That is up to the family of the deceased, they can say as many Takbirs as they wish. It was said: They say four Takbirs. He (the Imam) said: That is up to them. Then he (the Imam) said: Has it not reached you that a man was prayed over by Ali (peace be upon him) and he said five Takbirs over him until he prayed over him five prayers, saying five Takbirs in each prayer? He was present at Badr and followed up at Uhud, and he was among the representatives whom the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) chose from the twelve, and he had five virtues, so he prayed over him for each virtue a prayer.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: .هيلع لىص دق ناك نإو ،بارتلبا راوي مل ام هيلع لىصي تيملا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Prayer can be offered over the deceased as long as they have not been buried in the earth, even if prayer has already From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Prayer can be offered over the deceased as long as they have not been buried in the earth, even if prayer has already been performed over them.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: اهتكردأ نإ لقا ؟اهيلع ليصأ ربقلا تغلب ىتح اهكردأ مل ةزانجلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهيلع لصف تئش نفإ نفدت نأ لبق
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a funeral that I did not catch up with until it reached the grave- should I pray over it? He said: If you catch up with it before it is buried, then if you wish, pray over it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: لىص (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع نأ قارعلبا ثدحتن ناإ كادف تلعج :دمحم نب رفعجل تلق :لقا رمش نب ورمع نع هيلع) رفعج لاقف :لقا ،ياردب ناك هنإ :لاقف هفلخ ناك نم ىلإ تفتلا مث ،اتس هيلع ربكف فينح نب لهس لىع ،اسمخ هيلع ربكو هعضو مث ،ةعاس هب ىشمو هعفر مث ،اسمخ هيلع لىص نكلو اذك نكي مل هنإ :(ملاسلا .ةريبكت نيرشعو اسمخ هيلع ربك ىتح تارم سمخ كلذ لعفف
englishText: From Amr bin Shimr who said: I said to Ja'far bin Muhammad: May I be sacrificed for you, we narrate in Iraq that Ali (peace be upon him) prayed over Sahl bin Hunayf and said six Takbirs over him, then turned to those behind him and said: He was a participant in Badr. Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: It was not like that, rather he said f ive Takbirs over him, then lifted him and walked with him for a while, then placed him down and said five Takbirs over him, and he did that five times until he had said twenty-five Takbirs over him.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: لىع جرخ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع دانسلاا اذهبو لقا لاإ موق جئي ملف ةزانجلا اوعضوف اونكمي مل ةرفحلا دجوف اهيلع لىصف راجنلا ينب نم ةأرما ةزانج .اهيلع اولص :(ملاسلا هيلع) مهل
englishText: With this chain of narration from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) went out to attend the funeral of a woman from Bani Najjar and prayed over her. He found that the grave was not yet ready, so they placed the bier down. Then, whenever a group of people came, he (peace be upon him) would tell them: "Pray over her."

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: موق ءاج غرف املف ةزانج لىع لىص (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اريخ :اولوقو اهل اوعدا ،نيترم اهيلع لىصي لا ةزانجلا نإ :لاقف ،اهيلع ةلاصلا انتتفا اولاقف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) prayed over a funeral, and when he finished, some people came and said: We missed the prayer over it. He said: A funeral is not prayed over twice, make supplication for it and speak good words.

chapter: Permissibility Of Increasing The Funeral Prayer Beyond Five Takbirs, The Permissibility Of Repeating The Prayer Over The Deceased With Dislike, And The Recommendation Of That In The Prayer Over The People Of Righteousness And Virtue
arabicText: الله لوسر يا :اولاقف سنا هءاج غرف املف ةزانج لىع لىص الله لوسر نأ (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع .هل اوعدا نكلو ،نيترم ةزانج لىع لىصي لا :لاقف ،اهيلع ةلاصلا كردن مل لىع داز ام نفإ بوجولا يفنل نوكي نأ زوجيو :لقا ،ةهاركلا نم برض نيتياورلا نيتاه يف هجولا :خيشلا لقا .هيلإ بودنم بحتسم ةرم نم هيوار نلا ةياورلا يف ةيقتلا لىع لمحلا لمتحيو ،اضيأ خسنلا لمتحيو ،نادنس هل دحاو ربخ اذه :لوقأ .ملعأ اللهو .ةللاد حضوأو رثكأو هنم ىوقأ هضراعمو ،مهبهاذم رهشلأ قفاوم وهو ةماعلا
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon them both) that the Messenger of Allah prayed over a funeral, and when he finished, some people came and said: O Messenger of Allah, we did not catch the prayer over it. He said: A funeral prayer is not performed twice, but supplicate for him. The Shaykh said: The aspect in these two narrations is a form of dislike. He said: It is possible that it negates obligation, for what is more than once is recommended and encouraged. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is a single report with two chains of narration. It may also imply abrogation. It may be interpreted as Taqiyyah in the narration because its narrator is from the general people and it is in accordance with the more famous of their doctrines. What opposes it is stronger than it, more numerous, and clearer in indication. And Allah knows best.

chapter: There Being No  Recitation Or Specific Supplication In The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: قحأو كل ادب امب وعدت ،تقوم ءاعد لاو ةءارق تيملا لىع ةلاصلا يف سيل :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لىع ةلاصلبا أدبي نأو ،نمؤملا هل ىعدي نأ ىتوملا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: There is no [specific] recitation or timed supplication in the prayer over the deceased. You supplicate with whatever comes to you, and the most deserving of the dead to be supplicated for is the believer, and that one should begin with prayer (salawaat) upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).

chapter: There Being No  Recitation Or Specific Supplication In The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: حيبستو ريبكت وه امنإ ،معن :لاقف ؟ءوضو ريغ لىع اهيلع ليصأ ةزانجلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .ليلهتو ديمحتو
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the funeral prayer, can I pray it without ablution? He said: Yes, it is only takbir, tasbih, tahmid, and tahlil. Translator: Takbir is saying "Allahu Akbar". Tasbih is saying "Subhan Allah", Tahmid is saying "Alhamdulillah", Tahlil is saying "La ilaha illa Allah".

chapter: There Being No  Recitation Or Specific Supplication In The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: لاو ةءارق تيملا لىع ةلاصلا يف سيل :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ اعمس امهنأ ةرارزو ملسم نب دمحم نع هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لىع ةلاصلبا أدبت نأ هل ىعدي نأ تاوملأا قحأو ،كل ادب امب وعدت نأ لاإ ،تقوم ءاعد .(هلآو
englishText: Muhammad bin Muslim and Zurarah narrated that they both heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: There is no fixed recitation or specific supplication in the funeral prayer, except that you may supplicate with whatever comes to your mind. And the most deserving among the deceased to be prayed for is that you begin with sending blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).

chapter: There Being No  Recitation Or Specific Supplication In The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: لىص) يبنلا لىع ليصيو باتكلا ةحتافب أرقي تيم لىع لىص اذإ ناك (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع نأ هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع .(هلآو هيلع الله
englishText: Ja'far narrated from his father that Ali (peace be upon him) would recite Al-Fatiha and send blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) when performing the prayer for the deceased.

chapter: There Being No  Recitation Or Specific Supplication In The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: مبأ ىلولأا يف أرقت :لاقف - زئانجلا لىع ةلاصلا يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع ،ديوس نب ليع ثيدح مدقت دقو .باتكلا ،ةءارقلا اهيف ركذت مل ةزانجلا ةلاص ةيفيك يف كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقت دقو ،ةيقتلا لىع خيشلا امهلمح :لوقأ .تونقلا يف كلذ لىع لدي ام يتيأو ،ةفلتخم ةيعدأ اهيف تركذو
englishText: And in the preceding hadith of Ali bin Suwayd, from Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) regarding the prayer for the deceased - he said: You recite Al-Fatiha in the first rak'ah. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted both [last two hadiths] as taqiyyah, and what has preceded indicates this in the manner of funeral prayer where recitation was not mentioned, and different supplications were mentioned in it, and what indicates this will come in [the chapter of] qunut.

chapter: There Is No Ruku Or Sujud In The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: .دوجسو عوكر ةلاصب تسيل اهنإ ،ةعاس لك يف ةزانجلا لىع لىصي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: The funeral prayer can be performed at any hour, as it is not a prayer that includes ruku and sujud.

chapter: There Is No Ruku Or Sujud In The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: ةلاصلا هذهب ديرأ امنإ هنلأ دوجس لاو عوكر تيملا لىع ةلاصلا يف نكي مل امنإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع ريغب تيملا لىع ةلاصلا نازوج امنإو :لقا .مدق ام ىلإ جاتحاو ،فلخ امم لىخت دق يذلا دبعلا اذهل ةعافشلا .دوجس لاو عوكر اهيف سيل هنلأ ،ءوضو
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), he said: There is no ruku or sujud in the prayer for the deceased because this prayer is intended for intercession for this servant who has departed from what he left behind and is in need of what he has sent forth. He said: And we have permitted the funeral prayer without ablution because it has no ruku or sujud.

chapter: There Is No Taslim (Salutation) In The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: ،تاريبكت سمخف نمؤملا امأ :لقا تيملا لىع ةلاصلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا يبأ نع .اهيف ملاس لاو ،عبرفأ قفانملا امأو
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about the prayer over the deceased. He said: As for the believer, it is five Takbirs, and as for the hypocrite, it is four, and there is no Taslim in it.

chapter: There Is No Taslim (Salutation) In The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: .ميلست تيملا لىع ةلاصلا يف سيل :لاقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) الله دبع يبأو رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon them both), they said: There is no Taslim in the prayer over the deceased.

chapter: There Is No Taslim (Salutation) In The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: .ميلست تيملا لىع ةلاصلا يف سيل :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: There is no Taslim in the prayer over the deceased.

chapter: There Is No Taslim (Salutation) In The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: .ليلهتو حيبستو ديمحتو ريبكت وه امنإ :- ةزانجلا ةلاص يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- regarding the funeral prayer-: It is only Takbir, Tahmid, Tasbih, and Tahlil. Translator: See comment on Hadith 3098.

chapter: There Is No Taslim (Salutation) In The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: يف سيلو ،تاريبكت سمخ ةزانجلا لىع ةلاصلاو :لقا - نومأملا ىلإ هباتك يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع ،دوجس لاو عوكر ةزانجلا ةلاصل سيلو ،دوجسلاو عوكرلا (ةلاص) يف ميلستلا نلا ،ميلست زيانجلا ةلاص .منسي لاو تيملا ربق عبريو هركذ مدقتو .اهيف ركذي مل ثيح ميلستلا يفن لىع لدي ام ةزانجلا لىع ةلاصلا ةيفيك ثيداحأ يف مدقتو :لوقأ نع ةيانك هنوك نكميو ،ةيقتلا لىع هريغو خيشلا اهلمحو ،سنوي ثيدحو ،ةعامس ثيدحو ،رامع ثيدح يف دنع ميلستلا بابحتسا نم ةرشعلا يف يتيأ امل ،ةزانجلا ةلاص نع ةجراخ ةنس هنوك لمتحيو .فارصنلاا .ةقرافملا
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him)- in his letter to Al-Ma'mun- he said: The funeral prayer consists of five Takbirs, and there is no Taslim in the funeral prayer, because Taslim is in prayer with ruku and sujud, and the funeral prayer has no ruku or From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him)- in his letter to Al-Ma'mun- he said: The funeral prayer consists of five Takbirs, and there is no Taslim in the funeral prayer, because Taslim is in prayer with ruku and sujud, and the funeral prayer has no ruku or sujud, and the grave of the deceased should be made square and not raised like a hump. I (Hurr Amili) say: What has been mentioned in the hadiths about the manner of the funeral prayer indicates the negation of Taslim, as it is not mentioned in them. Its mention has been made in the hadith of Ammar, the hadith of Sama'ah, and the hadith of Yunus, and the Shaykh and others have interpreted them as taqiyyah. It is possible that it is a metaphor for leaving. It may also be a Sunnah outside of the funeral prayer, as will be mentioned in the tenth chapter regarding the recommendation of saying Taslim when parting.

chapter: Recommendation Of Raising The Hands In Every Takbir Of The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: عفري ،اسمخ ربكف ةزانج لىع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ فلخ تيلص :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةريبكت لك يف هدي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I prayed behind Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) over a funeral, and he said Takbir five times, raising his hand in every Takbir.

chapter: Recommendation Of Raising The Hands In Every Takbir Of The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: ةزانج لىع (ملاسلا امهيلع) دمحم نب رفعج فلخ لىص هنأ ءاديصلا ينب ىلوم دلاخ نب الله دبع نب دمحم نع .ةريبكت لك يف هيدي عفري هآرف
englishText: From Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Khalid, a mawla (client or patron) of Banu Al Sayda', that he prayed behind Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon them both) over a funeral, and he saw him raising his hands in every Takbir.

chapter: Recommendation Of Raising The Hands In Every Takbir Of The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: ةريبكتلا يف تيملا لىع ريبكتلا يف مهيديأ نوعفري سانلا نإ كادف تلعج :تلق (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا تلأس ؟ةريبكت لك يف يدي عفرأ وأ ،نولعفي امك ىلولأا ةريبكتلا لىع رصتقفأ ،كلذ دعب اميف نوعفري لاو ،ىلولأا .ةريبكت لك يف كدي عفرا :لاقف
englishText: I asked Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), I said: May I be sacrificed for you, the people raise their hands in the Takbir over the deceased in the first Takbir, and they do not raise them after that. Should I limit myself to the first Takbir as they do, or should I raise my hands in every Takbir? He said: Raise your hand in every Takbir.

chapter: Recommendation Of Raising The Hands In Every Takbir Of The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ميهاربإ نب ثايغ نع ،ةريغملا نب الله دبع نع ،هيبأ نع ،رفعج يبأ نع .ريبكتلا يف ينعي .ةدحاو ةرم لاإ ةزانجلا يف هدي عفري لا ناك هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), from Ali (peace be upon him), that he would not raise his hand in the funeral prayer except once, meaning in the Takbir. Translator: See comment by Shaykh Hurr Amili on Hadith 3113.

chapter: Recommendation Of Raising The Hands In Every Takbir Of The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: يف هدي عفري :(ملاسلا هيلع) بلاط يبأ نب ليع نينمؤملا ريمأ ناك :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع .فرصني ىتح دوعي لا مث ةزانجلا لىع ريبكتلا لوأ .بوجولا عفرو زاوجلا لىع لمحلا امهيف زوجو ،ةماعلا بهاذمل امهتقفاومل ةيقتلا لىع خيشلا امهلمح :لوقأ
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon them both), he said: Amir al-Mu'minin, Ali bin Abi Talib (peace be upon him), used to raise his hand in the first Takbir over the funeral, then he would not repeat it until he left. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted both of them as taqiyyah due to their agreement with the doctrines of the Aammah (general non-Shia muslims), and he allowed in them the interpretation of permissibility and negating obligation.

chapter: Recommendation For The Imam To Remain In His Position Until The Funeral Is Carried
arabicText: يديأ لىع اهاري ىتح هلاصم نم حربي مل ةزانج لىع لىص اذإ ناك (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع نأ هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع .لاجرلا
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father, that Ali (peace be upon him) when he would pray over a funeral, he would not leave from his prayer position until he saw it being carried on the hands of the men.

chapter: Recommendation For The Imam To Remain In His Position Until The Funeral Is Carried
arabicText: .هيدي نيب نم ريرسلا لمحي ىتح حربي لاو :لقا ،- زئانجلا لىع ةلاصلا يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- regarding the prayer over funerals- he said: And one should not leave until the bier is carried away from in front of him.

chapter: What To Supplicate With In The Funeral Prayer For A Child
arabicText: هلعجا مهللا :لوقي ناك هنأ - لفطلا لىع ةلاصلا يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع ،هئباآ نع ،ليع نب ديز نع .ارجأو اطرفو افلس انلو هيوبلأ
englishText: From Zayd bin Ali, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon him)- regarding the prayer for a child- that he would say: O Allah, make him a predecessor, forerunner and reward for his parents and for us.

chapter: Obligation Of Funeral Prayer For Those Who Have Reached Six Years And Above
arabicText: ،ةلاصلا لقع اذإ :لقا ؟هيلع لىصي ىتم يبصلا لىع ةلاصلا نع لئس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هقاطأ اذإ مايصلاو ،نينس تس نبا ناك اذإ :لاقف ؟هيلع ةلاصلا بجت ىتم :تلق
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he was asked about the funeral prayer for a child, when should it be performed? He said: When they understand prayer. I asked: When does the prayer become obligatory upon them? He said: When they are six years old, and fasting when they can endure it.

chapter: Obligation Of Funeral Prayer For Those Who Have Reached Six Years And Above
arabicText: نبا ناكو ،ةلاصلا لقع اذإ :لاقف ؟هيلع ةلاصلا بجت ىتم :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لئسو :قودصلا لقا .نينس تس
englishText: Al-Saduq said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) was asked: When does prayer become obligatory upon them? He said: When they understand prayer and are six years old.

chapter: Obligation Of Funeral Prayer For Those Who Have Reached Six Years And Above
arabicText: لىصو هعم ىشمو نفكو لسغف هب رمفأ هتومب ربخفأ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ ينب تام :لقا ةرارز نع يشملا ينأ ىتح هعم تفرصناو فرصنا مث ،هنم غرف ىتح هربق لىع مقا مث ،اهيلع ماقف ةرمخ تحرطو هيلع هعم لاو نفديف هب رميأ (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع ناك ،نينس ثلاث نبا ناكو ،اذه لثم لىع لىصي نكي مل هنأ امأ :لاقف اذإ :لاقف ؟ةلاصلا هيلع بجت ىتمف :تلق :لقا ،هلثم عنصن نحنف ائيش اوعنص سانلا نكلو ،هيلع لىصي .نينس تس نبا ناكو ةلاصلا لقع
englishText: From Zurarah who said: A son of Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) died, and when he was informed of his death, he ordered that he be washed and shrouded. He walked with him and prayed over him, and a mat was laid down which he stood upon. Then he stood at his grave until the burial was completed. Then he left and I left with him, walking alongside him. He said: Previously, prayer was not performed over one like this, as he was three years old. Ali (peace be upon him) used to order that such a child be buried without prayer over him, but people have adopted a practice so we do likewise. I asked: When does He said: Previously, prayer was not performed over one like this, as he was three years old. Ali (peace be upon him) used to order that such a child be buried without prayer over him, but people have adopted a practice so we do likewise. I asked: When does prayer over the deceased become obligatory? He replied: When they understand prayer, which is at six years of age.

chapter: Obligation Of Funeral Prayer For Those Who Have Reached Six Years And Above
arabicText: سمخ نبا وهو تام اذإ هيلع لىصيأ يبصلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هيخأ نع .هيلع ليص ةلاصلا لقع اذإ :لاقف ؟نينس
englishText: From his brother Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a child, should funeral prayer be performed over them if they die at five years old? He said: When they understand prayer, prayer is performed over them.

chapter: Recommendation Of Prayer Over A Child Who Died Before Reaching Six Years If Born Alive
arabicText: ملو ،حصي ملو لهتسي مل يذلا دولوملا وهو ،سوفنملا لىع لىصي لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هثروو هيلع لصف لهتسا اذإو ،اهريغ نم لاو ةيدلا نم ثروي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Prayer is not performed over a stillborn, who is a newborn that did not cry or make a sound, and does not inherit blood money or anything else. If the baby cries, then prayer is performed over it and it inherits.

chapter: Recommendation Of Prayer Over A Child Who Died Before Reaching Six Years If Born Alive
arabicText: لىع هيلع لىصي :لقا ؟روهشلاو نينسلا نم غلب اذإ يبصلا لىع لىصي مكل (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس .مامت ريغل طقسي نأ لاإ لاح لك
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) at what age in years and months should prayer be performed over a child? He said: Prayer is performed over them in all cases except if miscarried before full term.

chapter: Recommendation Of Prayer Over A Child Who Died Before Reaching Six Years If Born Alive
arabicText: ،اخراص لهتسفا همأ نطب نم طقس اذإ هيلع لىصيو يبصلا ثروي :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،رفعج نع .هيلع لصي ملو ثروي مل اخراص لهتسي مل اذإو
englishText: From Ja'far, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) who said: A child inherits and prayer is performed over them if they fall from their mother's womb and cry out, and if they do not cry out, they do not inherit and prayer is not performed over them.

chapter: Recommendation Of Prayer Over A Child Who Died Before Reaching Six Years If Born Alive
arabicText: ؟روهشلاو نينسلا نم غلب اذإ يبصلا لىع لىصي مكل :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) يضاملا نسحلا يبأ نع .مامت ريغل طقسي نأ لاإ لاح لك لىع هيلع لىصي :لقا
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Al-Madhi (peace be upon him), I said to him: At what age in years and months should prayer be performed over a child? He said: Prayer is performed over them in all cases except if miscarried before full term.

chapter: Recommendation Of Prayer Over A Child Who Died Before Reaching Six Years If Born Alive
arabicText: امنإ ،لا :لقا ؟هيلع لىصي له ملقلا هيلع رجي مل ام دولوملا نع لئس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ملقلا امهيلع ىرج اذإ ةأرملاو لجرلا لىع ةلاصلا ملقلا امهيلع يرجي ذئنيح هنلأ ،نينس تس غولب لىع لومحم اذه نإ :هريغو (فلتخملا) يف ةملاعلا لقا .رم امل ،نيرمتلبا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he was asked about a newborn over whom the pen has not yet flowed (reached accountability), should prayer be performed over them? He said: No, prayer is only for men and women over whom the pen has flowed. Al-Allama said in (Al-Mukhtalif) and elsewhere: This is interpreted as reaching six years of age, because that is when the pen flows over them for training, as previously mentioned.

chapter: Recommendation Of Prayer Over A Child Who Died Before Reaching Six Years If Born Alive
arabicText: هيلع ربكف ميهاربإ هنبا لىع لىص (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تعمس .اسمخ
englishText: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: Indeed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) prayed over his son Ibrahim and made five takbeers.

chapter: Recommendation Of Prayer Over A Child Who Died Before Reaching Six Years If Born Alive
arabicText: هلو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نبا ميهاربإ تام :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةنجلا يف هعاضر الله متفأ ،ارهش رشع ةينامث
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: Ibrahim, son of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) died at eighteen months, and Allah completed his nursing in Paradise. Shaykh Hurr Amili: What apparently contradicts this will come, and it is interpreted as negating obligation.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Prayer For Funeral Of Those Under Six Years
arabicText: ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ جرخف تام جرد اميطف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ انبا نأ - ثيدح يف - ةرارز نع ،اعبرأ هيلع ربكف هيلع لىصف - :لقا نأ ىلإ - رفصأ زخ فرطمو ،ءارفص زخ ةمامعو ،ءارفص زخ ةبج هيلعو ريمأ ناك امنإ ،لافطلأا لىع لىصي نكي مل هنإ :لقا مث ،يب حىنتف يديب ذخأ مث ،نفدف هب رمأ مث لهأ لجأ نم هيلع تيلص امنإو ،مهيلع ليصي لاو ءارو نم نونفديف مهب رميأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا .مهلافطأ لىع نولصي لا :اولوقي نأ ةيهارك ،ةنيدملا
englishText: From Zurarah- in a hadith- that when a weaned son of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) passed away, Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) came out wearing a yellow silk robe, yellow silk turban, and yellow silk cloak- then said: He prayed over him with four takbirs, then ordered his burial. Then he took my hand and moved aside with me and said: Prayer was not performed over children. Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) used to order their burial from behind without praying over them. I only prayed over him because of the people of Medina, disliking that they would say they don't pray over their children.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Prayer For Funeral Of Those Under Six Years
arabicText: الله لىص) الله لوسر نب ميهاربإ ضبق امل - ثيدح يف - :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم نسحلا باأ تعمس هب جرخ مث ،هنفكو ،هطنحو ميهاربإ لسغف (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع ماقف ،ينبا زهجف مق ليع يا :لقا (هلآو هيلع ،هربق ىلإ هب ىهتنا ىتح (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىضمو .هيلع عزجلا نم هلخد امل ،ميهاربإ لىع ليصي نأ يسن (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :سانلا لاقف نم ينلخد امل ينبا لىع ليصأ نأ تيسن ينأ متمعز ،متلق امب ليئربج ينتاأ ،سانلا اهيأ :لقا مث امئقا بصتنفا لك نم مكتاومل لعجو .تاولص سمخ مكيلع ضرف ريبخلا فيطللا نكلو ،متننظ امك سيل هنإو لاأ ،عزجلا .لىص نم لىع لاإ ليصأ لا نأ ينرمأو ،ةريبكت ةلاص تاريبكتلا ثيداحأ يفو قباسلا بابلا يف مدقت دقو ،خسنلا لمتحيو ،بوجولا يفن ةدارإ لمتحي اذه :لوقأ دعب هيلع لىصو خسن مكحلا لعلف ،ميهاربإ هنبا لىع لىص (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ سمخلا ،ايلقع ازاجم تابثلااو ،ةقيقح يفنلا قدصيف ،وه هيلع لصي ملو هرمبأ هريغ هيلع لىص هلعلو :اولقا ام :مهلوق لىع لب ،هيلع لدي ام يتيأو .نيرمتلا تقو هنلأ ،نينس تس غولب لىع لومحم ،لىص نم لىع لاإ :هلوقو .نينس سمخ ءانبأ مهو ةلاصلبا مهدلاوأ نورميأ اوناك (ملاسلا مهيلع) مهنأ
englishText: I heard Abu al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) say- in a hadith- When Ibrahim son of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) passed away, he said: O Ali, arise and prepare my son. So Ali (peace be upon him) arose and washed Ibrahim, applied perfume, and shrouded him. Then he took him out and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) went until reaching his grave. The people said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forgot to pray over Ibrahim due to his grief. He stood up and said: O people, Gabriel came to The people said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forgot to pray over Ibrahim due to his grief. He stood up and said: O people, Gabriel came to me about what you said. You claimed I forgot to pray over my son due to grief. Know it is not as you thought. Rather, the Subtle, All-Aware prescribed five prayers for you, and made for your deceased one takbir from each prayer, and commanded me to only pray over those who prayed. I (Hurr Amili) say: This could mean negating obligation, or abrogation. It was mentioned in the previous chapter and in hadiths about five takbirs that the Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) prayed over his son Ibrahim. Perhaps the ruling was abrogated and he prayed after what they said. Or perhaps others prayed by his command while he did not, making the negation literal and affirmation metaphorical. His saying "only over those who prayed" refers to reaching six years, as that is the time for practice. Evidence for this will come, even that they (peace be upon them) used to order their children to pray at five years old.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Prayer For Funeral Of Those Under Six Years
arabicText: لىع لىصي لا هنإ :انلوق انيلع نودريو ناوملكي سانلا نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا ماشه نع وأ اينارصن لاجر نأ ول متيأرأ :نولوقيف ،معن :لوقنف ؟لىص نم لىع لاإ لىصي لا :نولوقيف ،لصي مل هنلأ لفطلا مث ةعاسلا ملسأ يذلا اذه نأ ول متيأرأ :مهل اولوق :لاقف ؟هيف باوجلا امف هتعاس نم تام مث ملسأ يادوهي ،دحلا هيلع بجي :نولوقيس مهنفإ ؟هتيرف يف هيلع بجي ناك ام ناسنإ لىع ىرتفا مهنفإ ؟دحلا هيلع بجي ناك له ناسنإ لىع ىرتفا لصي مل يذلا يبصلا اذه نأ ولف :مهل ليق ،اذه اولقا اذفإ لىع لىصي لاو ،دودحلاو ةلاصلا هيلع تبجو نم لىع لىصي نأ بجي امنإ ،متقدص :مهل لاقيف ،لا :نولوقيس .دودحلا لاو ةلاصلا هيلع بجت مل نم .بابحتسلاا وأ توبثلا ىنعمب بوجولاو ،رم امل نينس تس غولب لىع هلمح نكمي اضيأ اذه :لوقأ
englishText: From Hisham who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): People speak to us and reject our saying that we don't pray over children because they haven't prayed, saying "pray only over those who prayed?" We say yes. They say: What about if a Christian or Jew converts to Islam then dies immediately, what is the answer about that? He said: Tell them: What if this person who just converted then slandered someone, what would be required for his slander? They will say: The legal punishment would be required. When they say this, tell them: If this child who hasn't prayed slandered someone, would the legal punishment be required? They will say: No. Tell them: You are correct. Prayer is only required over those for whom prayer and legal punishments When they say this, tell them: If this child who hasn't prayed slandered someone, would the legal punishment be required? They will say: No. Tell them: You are correct. Prayer is only required over those for whom prayer and legal punishments were obligatory, and not over those for whom prayer and legal punishments were not obligatory. I (Hurr Amili) say: This too can be interpreted as reaching six years for what preceded, with obligation meaning establishment or recommendation.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Prayer For Funeral Of Those Under Six Years
arabicText: مث ،نينس ثلاث هل ريغص يبص هل نبا لىع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لىص :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .مهيلع تيلص ام مهدلاوأ نم راغصلا لىع نولصي لا مشاه ينب نإ :نولوقي سانلا نأ لاول :لقا
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin al-Husayn said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) prayed over his young son of three years, then said: If not for people saying Bani Hashim don't pray over their young children, I would not have prayed over them.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Prayer For Funeral Of Those Under Six Years
arabicText: ،ةرارز يا :لقا مث ،هيلع ربكف ،ريغص رفعجل نبا لىع لىص (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تيأر :لقا نيعأ نب ةرارز نع .هيلع تيلص ام راغصلا لىع نولصي لا مشاه ينب نإ :سانلا لوقي نأ لاولو ،هيلع لىصي لا ههبشو اذه نإ
englishText: From Zurarah bin A'yan who said: I saw Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) pray over Ja'far's young son with takbir, then said: O Zurarah, this and similar cases don't require prayer, but if not for people saying Bani Hashim don't pray over the young, I would not have prayed over him.

chapter: Impermissibility Of The Follower Preceding The Imam In Takbir, And If He Precedes Him He Must Repeat It
arabicText: ربكي لا :لقا ؟ماملاا لبق ربكي نأ هل ،ليصي لجرلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هيخأ نع .ريبكتلا داعأ هلبق ربك نفإ ،ماملاا عم لاإ نيب ةزانجلا ةلاص ببا يف هدروأ يريمحلاو ،اهب اصوصخم نكي مل نإو ةزانجلا ةلاص مكح لىع لدي اذه :لوقأ .اهثيداحأ
englishText: From his brother Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a man praying- can he say Takbir before the imam? He said: He should not say Takbir except with the imam, and if he says takbir before him, he must repeat the takbir. I (Hurr Amili) say: This indicates the ruling for funeral prayer even though it is not specific to it, and Al-Himyari included it in the chapter of funeral prayer among its hadiths. Shaykh Hurr Amili: This indicates the ruling of the funeral prayer, even if it is not specific to it, and Al-Humayri mentioned it in the chapter on funeral prayer among its hadiths.

chapter: One Who Misses Some Of The Takbir In The Funeral Prayer Should Make It Up Consecutively, And If The Funeral Is Lifted, He Should Make It Up While Walking With It
arabicText: ضقيلف تيملا لىع ةلاصلا نم نيتريبكتلاو ةريبكتلا لجرلا كردأ اذإ :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اعباتتم يقب ام
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If a person catches one or two takbirs of the funeral prayer, he should make up the remaining takbirs consecutively.

chapter: One Who Misses Some Of The Takbir In The Funeral Prayer Should Make It Up Consecutively, And If The Funeral Is Lifted, He Should Make It Up While Walking With It
arabicText: .يقب ام متي :لقا ،ةريبكت تيملا لىع ةلاصلا نم كردي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who catches one takbir of the prayer for the deceased. He said: He should complete what remains.

chapter: One Who Misses Some Of The Takbir In The Funeral Prayer Should Make It Up Consecutively, And If The Funeral Is Lifted, He Should Make It Up While Walking With It
arabicText: ،ثلاثلا وأ ناتنثلا وأ ةريبكتلا اهنم لجرلا تفا اذإ ،زئانجلا لىع ةلاصلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .هتفا ام ربكي :لقا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the funeral prayer, when a man misses one, two, or three takbirs, he said: He should make up the takbirs that he missed.

chapter: One Who Misses Some Of The Takbir In The Funeral Prayer Should Make It Up Consecutively, And If The Funeral Is Lifted, He Should Make It Up While Walking With It
arabicText: لبقتسا :تلق ،كتفا ام يضقت :لقا ،رثكأ وأ ةريبكت ينتتفا نإ تيأرأ :تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ةزانجلا عبتت تنأو ،لىب :لقا ؟ةلبقلا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: I said: What do you think if I miss one takbir or more? He said: You make up what you missed. I said: Should I face the qibla? He said: Yes, while you are following the funeral.

chapter: One Who Misses Some Of The Takbir In The Funeral Prayer Should Make It Up Consecutively, And If The Funeral Is Lifted, He Should Make It Up While Walking With It
arabicText: نيتريبكت وأ ةريبكت ةزانجلا يف ماملاا عم كردي لجرلا يف لوقي هتعمس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع لىع ربك نفد دقو مهكردأ ناك نفإ ،ربقلا دنع ربك ريبكتلا كردي مل اذفإ ،اهعم يشمي وهو ريبكتلا متي :لاقف .ربقلا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: I heard him speak about a man who joins the Imam during the funeral prayer for one or two takbirs [saying]: He should complete the takbirs while walking with the funeral procession. If he did not catch the takbirs, he should make the takbirs at the grave. And if he reaches them after the burial, he should make takbirs at the grave.

chapter: One Who Misses Some Of The Takbir In The Funeral Prayer Should Make It Up Consecutively, And If The Funeral Is Lifted, He Should Make It Up While Walking With It
arabicText: ريبكت نم قبس ام ىضقي لا :لوقي ناك (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع نأ هيبأ نع ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةزانجلا .رم امل اعباتتم ىضقي امنإو ،ءاعدلبا اهنيب لصفلا نم أدتبي ناك امك يضقي لا يأ :خيشلا لقا بوجولا يفن لىع لمحلا نكميو ،مدقت امك ماملاا داز ول سمخلا لىع دئازلا ريبكتلا لىع لمحلا لمتحيو :لوقأ .طوحأ لولأاو ،هريغ لعفب يئافكلا بجاولا لوصحل
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), from his father, that Ali (peace be upon him) used to say: The missed takbirs of the funeral prayer cannot be compensated for. The Shaykh said: Meaning one does not make up [missed prayers] with separating between them with supplication as they were originally started, rather they are made up consecutively as previously mentioned. I (Hurr Amili) say: It is possible to interpret it as referring to the additional takbir beyond five if the imam adds more as previously mentioned, and it can also be interpreted as negating the obligation since the collective obligation is fulfilled by others' actions, and the first interpretation is more precautionary.

chapter: One Who Misses Some Of The Takbir In The Funeral Prayer Should Make It Up Consecutively, And If The Funeral Is Lifted, He Should Make It Up While Walking With It
arabicText: وأ ةريبكت كردي لجرلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هيخأ نع (هباتك) يف رفعج نب ليع .ففخيو هعفرب هردابيو هريبكت نم يقب ام متي :لقا ؟عنصي فيك ،تيم لىع نيتنث
englishText: Ali ibn Ja'far in (his book) from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: I asked him about a man who joins one or two takbirs in a funeral prayer, what should he do? He replied: He should complete the remaining takbirs and hasten to finish them when they lift the body, and he should do it quickly.

chapter: Permissibility Of Praying Over The Deceased After Burial For One Who Did Not Pray Over Him, With Dislike If The Deceased Had Already Been Prayed Over, And The Limit Of That, And That One Does Not Pray Over The Absent But Rather Supplicates For Him
arabicText: .نفدي ام دعب تيملا لىع لجرلا لىصي نأ سبأ لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: There is no harm in a man praying for the deceased after he is buried.

chapter: Permissibility Of Praying Over The Deceased After Burial For One Who Did Not Pray Over Him, With Dislike If The Deceased Had Already Been Prayed Over, And The Limit Of That, And That One Does Not Pray Over The Absent But Rather Supplicates For Him
arabicText: .نفد دقو هيلع ةلاصلبا سبأ لاف نفدي ىتح تيملا لىع ةلاصلا كتتفا اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: If you miss the prayer for the deceased until he is buried, there is no harm in praying over him after he has been buried.

chapter: Permissibility Of Praying Over The Deceased After Burial For One Who Did Not Pray Over Him, With Dislike If The Deceased Had Already Been Prayed Over, And The Limit Of That, And That One Does Not Pray Over The Absent But Rather Supplicates For Him
arabicText: لىص ةزانجلا لىع ةلاصلا هتتفا اذإ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هربق لىع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) missed the prayer over a funeral, he would pray over the deceased's grave.

chapter: Permissibility Of Praying Over The Deceased After Burial For One Who Did Not Pray Over Him, With Dislike If The Deceased Had Already Been Prayed Over, And The Limit Of That, And That One Does Not Pray Over The Absent But Rather Supplicates For Him
arabicText: ،تام :تلقف ،نيعأ نب الله دبع نع ينلأسف ةكم (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ مدق :لقا ىسيع نب رفعج نع هيلع ليصن نكلو ،لا :لاقف ،معن :تلق ،هيلع ليصن ىتح هربق ىلإ انب قلطنفا :لقا ،معن :تلق ؟تام :لقا .هيلع محرتو ءاعدلا يف دهتجاو وعدي هيدي عفرف ،انهيه
englishText: From Ja'far bin Isa who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) came to Makkah and asked me about Abdullah bin A'yun. I said: He has died. He said: He died? I said: Yes. He said: Let us go to his grave so we can pray for him. I said: Yes. He said: No, but we will pray for him right here. Then he raised his hands in supplication, strived From Ja'far bin Isa who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) came to Makkah and asked me about Abdullah bin A'yun. I said: He has died. He said: He died? I said: Yes. He said: Let us go to his grave so we can pray for him. I said: Yes. He said: No, but we will pray for him right here. Then he raised his hands in supplication, strived earnestly in his prayer, and sought mercy for him.

chapter: Permissibility Of Praying Over The Deceased After Burial For One Who Did Not Pray Over Him, With Dislike If The Deceased Had Already Been Prayed Over, And The Limit Of That, And That One Does Not Pray Over The Absent But Rather Supplicates For Him
arabicText: مل يشاجنلفا :تلق :لقا ءاعدلا وه امنإ نفدي ام دعب تيملا لىع ةلاصلا :لقا ةرارز وأ ملسم نب دمحم نع .هل اعد امنإ ،لا :لاقف ؟(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا هيلع لصي
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim or Zurarah who said: Prayer over the dead after burial is simply supplication. I asked: Then [what about] al-Najashi, did not the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) pray over him? He replied: No, he merely supplicated for him.

chapter: Permissibility Of Praying Over The Deceased After Burial For One Who Did Not Pray Over Him, With Dislike If The Deceased Had Already Been Prayed Over, And The Limit Of That, And That One Does Not Pray Over The Absent But Rather Supplicates For Him
arabicText: دعقي وأ ،ربق لىع لىصي نأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىهن :لقا هيبأ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هيلع ىنبي وأ ،هيلع ةدارلإو ،ةزانجلا ةلاص ىوس اهريغو ةيمويلا ةلاصلبا صاصتخلالو ،ةهاركلا ةدارلإو خسنلل لمتحم اذه :لوقأ .كلذ ريغلو ،هيلع ليص دق تيملا ناك اذإ بوجولا يفن
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), from his father who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) prohibited praying on a grave, sitting on it, or building upon it. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is possibly abrogated, or intended as dislike, or specific to daily prayers and others besides the funeral prayer, or intended to negate obligation if the deceased had already been prayed over, or other than that.

chapter: Permissibility Of Praying Over The Deceased After Burial For One Who Did Not Pray Over Him, With Dislike If The Deceased Had Already Been Prayed Over, And The Limit Of That, And That One Does Not Pray Over The Absent But Rather Supplicates For Him
arabicText: .نوفدم وهو هيلع لىصي لاو :- ثيدح يف - :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), that he said- in a hadith-: And funeral prayer should not be performed over him when he is already buried.

chapter: Permissibility Of Praying Over The Deceased After Burial For One Who Did Not Pray Over Him, With Dislike If The Deceased Had Already Been Prayed Over, And The Limit Of That, And That One Does Not Pray Over The Absent But Rather Supplicates For Him
arabicText: زاج ول ،لا :لقا ؟نفدي ام دعب نوفدملا لىع لىصي :(ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلل تلق :لقا ةريزجلا لهأ نم لجر نع .نيارعلا لىع لاو ،نفدي ام دعب نوفدملا لىع لىصي لا لب :لقا ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسرل زاجل دحلا .مياأ ةثلاث يضم لىع رخآ عضوم يف امهلمحو ،نفدلا دعب ةليلو موي يضم لىع خيشلا امهلمح :لوقأ .مياأ ةثلاث يضم لىع رخآ عضوم يف امهلمحو ،نفدلا دعب ةليلو موي يضم لىع خيشلا امهلمح :لوقأ
englishText: A man from the people of Al-Jazira said: I asked Al-Ridha (peace be upon him): Should funeral prayer be performed for the buried person after burial? He said: No, if it were permissible for anyone, it would have been permissible for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). He said: Rather, funeral prayer should not be performed for the buried person after burial, nor for the naked person. I (Hurr Amili) say: Al-Shaykh interpreted them as after the passing of a day and night after burial, and in another place he interpreted them as after the passing of three days.

chapter: Permissibility Of Praying Over The Deceased After Burial For One Who Did Not Pray Over Him, With Dislike If The Deceased Had Already Been Prayed Over, And The Limit Of That, And That One Does Not Pray Over The Absent But Rather Supplicates For Him
arabicText: .مياأ ةثلاث ىلإ ربقلا لىع لىصي هنأ :(فلاخلا) يف ىور هنأ خيشلا نع اولقنو
englishText: They reported from the Shaykh that he narrated in (Al-Khilaf): Prayer can be offered over the grave up to three days.

chapter: Permissibility Of Praying Over The Deceased After Burial For One Who Did Not Pray Over Him, With Dislike If The Deceased Had Already Been Prayed Over, And The Limit Of That, And That One Does Not Pray Over The Absent But Rather Supplicates For Him
arabicText: هتاأ امل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،يركسعلا ليع نب نسحلا نع - يشاجنلا مسا وهو - همحصأ مكاخأ نإ :لقاو ،هيلع نيزح ءاكب كىب يشاجنلا يعنب (ملاسلا هيلع) ليئربج .ةشبحلبا وهو هتزانج ىأر ىتح عفترم لك هل الله ضفخف ،اعبس ربكو هيلع لىصو ةنابجلا ىلإ جرخ مث ،تام صوصخم وأ ،رم امل ءاعدلا ةلاصلبا دارملا نأ لىع وأ ،ةياورلا يف ةيقتلا لىع لومحم اذه :لوقأ .ملعأ اللهو ،انه ركذ امك هآر هنلأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) لوسرلبا
englishText: From Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Askari, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) that when Jibreel (peace be upon him) came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) with the news of Al-Najashi's death, he wept sorrowfully for him and said: Indeed your brother Ashamah- which is the name of Al-Najashi- has died. Then he went out to the cemetery and prayed over him with seven takbirs, and Allah lowered every elevated thing until he saw his funeral while he (Al-Najashi) was in Abyssinia. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted as taqiyyah in the narration, or that what is intended by prayer is supplication as mentioned before, or specific (limited) to the Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) because he saw him as mentioned here, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Obligation Of Placing The Head Of The Deceased To The Right Of The Imam And His Feet To His Left, And The Obligation Of Repetition If The Prayer Was Performed On Him In A Reversed Position, Even If Out Of Ignorance, Unless He Is Buried
arabicText: بولقم تيملا اذفإ ماملاا ملس املف هيلع ليص نمع لئس هنأ - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع تضم دقف نفد نفإ ،نفدي مل ام ،لمح دق ناك نإو هيلع ةلاصلا داعتو ىوسي :لقا ،هسأر عضوم ىلإ هلاجر .نوفدم وهو هيلع لىصي لاو ،هيلع ةلاصلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- that he was asked about someone who was prayed upon (funeral prayer), then when the Imam gave the salam, it was found that the deceased was placed upside down with his feet where his head should have been. He said: He should be positioned correctly and the prayer should be repeated on him even if he has already been carried, as long as he has not been buried. If he has been buried, then the prayer performed on him stands, and one should not pray on him while he is buried.

chapter: Obligation Of Placing The Head Of The Deceased To The Right Of The Imam And His Feet To His Left, And The Obligation Of Repetition If The Prayer Was Performed On Him In A Reversed Position, Even If Out Of Ignorance, Unless He Is Buried
arabicText: رهط اذفإ ،رسيت امفيك عضوي تيملا نأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع نيطقي نب بوقعي ثيدح يف مدقت دقو .هربق يف عضوي امك عضو
englishText: In a previous hadith from Ya'qub ibn Yaqtin, from Imam Al-Ridha (peace be upon him): The deceased can be placed in any convenient position during washing, but after purification, they should be positioned as they would be placed in their grave. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And there will come what indicates this in the narration of Al-Halabi regarding the arrangement of funerals when they gather.

chapter: Lack Of Dislike For Praying Over The Funeral At Sunrise And Sunset, And Its Permissibility At Any Time As Long As The Time For An Obligatory Prayer Does Not Become Tight, And Likewise For Every Worship That Is Not Time-specific
arabicText: وه امنإ علطت نيحو سمشلا بيغت نيح زئانجلا لىع ةلاصلبا سبأ لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رافغتسا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: There is no harm in performing the funeral prayer when the sun sets and when it rises, for it is only seeking forgiveness.

chapter: Lack Of Dislike For Praying Over The Funeral At Sunrise And Sunset, And Its Permissibility At Any Time As Long As The Time For An Obligatory Prayer Does Not Become Tight, And Likewise For Every Worship That Is Not Time-specific
arabicText: امنإو ،دوجس و عوكر ةلاصب تسيل اهنإ ،ةعاس لك يف ةزانجلا لىع لىصي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ينرق نيب برغت اهنلأ ،دوجسلاو عوكرلاو عوشخلا اهيف يتلا اهبورغ دنعو سمشلا عولط دنع ةلاصلا هركي .ناطيش ينرق نيب علطتو ،ناطيش
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The funeral prayer can be performed at any hour, as it is not a prayer with bowing and prostration. The prayers that are disliked at sunrise and sunset are those that involve humility, bowing, and prostration, because the sun sets between the two horns of Satan and rises between the two horns of Satan.

chapter: Lack Of Dislike For Praying Over The Funeral At Sunrise And Sunset, And Its Permissibility At Any Time As Long As The Time For An Obligatory Prayer Does Not Become Tight, And Likewise For Every Worship That Is Not Time-specific
arabicText: .لا :لاقف ؟زئانجلا لىع ةلاصلا نع تاعاسلا هذه نم ئش كعنمي له (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Does anything prevent you from praying over the deceased during any of these hours (*)? He said: No. Translator: * Refers to sunrise and sunset. See the previous hadith 3154.

chapter: Lack Of Dislike For Praying Over The Funeral At Sunrise And Sunset, And Its Permissibility At Any Time As Long As The Time For An Obligatory Prayer Does Not Become Tight, And Likewise For Every Worship That Is Not Time-specific
arabicText: امنإ ةلاصلا هذه نلأ رجفلا دعبو برغملا لبق تيملا لىع ةلاصلا نازوج امنإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع ،ثدح تقو يف بجت ةلاص يه امنإو تاولصلا رئاسك ةتقوم يه تسيلو ةلعلاو روضحلا تقو يف بجت نكي مل اذإ ناك تقو يأ يف قوقحلا ىدؤت نأ زئاجو ،ىدؤي قح وه امنإو ،رايتخا هيف ناسنلال سيل ثدحلاو .اتقوم قحلا امنإ ةلاصلا هذه نلأ رجفلا دعبو برغملا لبق تيملا لىع ةلاصلا نازوج امنإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع ،ثدح تقو يف بجت ةلاص يه امنإو تاولصلا رئاسك ةتقوم يه تسيلو ةلعلاو روضحلا تقو يف بجت نكي مل اذإ ناك تقو يأ يف قوقحلا ىدؤت نأ زئاجو ،ىدؤي قح وه امنإو ،رايتخا هيف ناسنلال سيل ثدحلاو .اتقوم قحلا
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: We permitted the funeral prayer before Maghrib and after Fajr because this prayer only becomes obligatory at the time of attendance and need. It is not time-bound like other prayers. Rather, it is a prayer that becomes obligatory when an event occurs, and the event is not something that a person can choose. It is merely a right that must be fulfilled, and it is permissible to fulfill rights at any time when the right is not time-bound.

chapter: Lack Of Dislike For Praying Over The Funeral At Sunrise And Sunset, And Its Permissibility At Any Time As Long As The Time For An Obligatory Prayer Does Not Become Tight, And Likewise For Every Worship That Is Not Time-specific
arabicText: .علطت نيحو سمشلا رفصت نيح زئانجلا لىع ةلاصلا هركت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع هيلع لدي ام يتيأو ،زيهجتلا ليجعت ثيداحأ يف كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقت دقو ،ةيقتلا لىع خيشلا هلمح :لوقأ .ةضيرفلا تقو قيض ءانثتسا لىعو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: It is disliked to perform the funeral prayer when the sun turns yellow and when it rises. I (Hurr Amili) say: Al-Shaykh interpreted it as taqiyyah, and what indicates that has been previously mentioned in the hadiths of hastening the preparation of the deceased. And there will come what indicates it and the exception of the tight time for an obligatory prayer.

chapter: Permissibility Of Funeral Prayer Without Purification, And Likewise Takbir, Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, And Supplication, And The Recommendation Of Ablution Or Tayammum For It
arabicText: .مهعم ربكيلف :لقا ،رهط ريغ لىع وهو ةزانجلا هأجفت لجرلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them both) who said: I asked him about a man who encounters a funeral while he is not in a state of purity. He said: Let him say takbir with them.

chapter: Permissibility Of Funeral Prayer Without Purification, And Likewise Takbir, Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, And Supplication, And The Recommendation Of Ablution Or Tayammum For It
arabicText: يزجيأ ،ةلاصلا ينتتفا أضوتأ تبهذ نفإ ،ءوضو لىع تسلو اهب جرخي ةزانجلا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبلأ تلق .يلإ بحأ رهط لىع نوكت :لاقف ؟ءوضو ريغ لىع ناأو اهيلع ليصأ نأ يل
englishText: I said to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him): A funeral procession goes out and I am not in ablution. If I go to perform ablution, I will miss the prayer. Is it sufficient for meto pray over it without ablution? He said: Being in a state of purity is more beloved to me.

chapter: Permissibility Of Funeral Prayer Without Purification, And Likewise Takbir, Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, And Supplication, And The Recommendation Of Ablution Or Tayammum For It
arabicText: حيبستو ريبكت وه امنإ ،معن :لاقف ؟ءوضو ريغ لىع اهيلع ليصأ ةزانجلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .ءوضو ريغ لىع كتيب يف حبستو ربكت امك ،ليلهتو ديمحتو
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the funeral prayer, can I pray it without ablution? He said: Yes, it is only Takbir (Allahu Akbar), Tasbih (Subhan Allah), Tahmid (Al-hamdulillah) and Tahlil (La ilaha illa Allah), just as you say Takbir and Tasbih in your house without ablution.

chapter: Permissibility Of Funeral Prayer Without Purification, And Likewise Takbir, Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, And Supplication, And The Recommendation Of Ablution Or Tayammum For It
arabicText: .بحأ نإ مميتي هنأ :رخآ ربخ يفو :لقا مث
englishText: Then he said: And in another narration: He can perform tayammum if he wishes.

chapter: Permissibility Of Funeral Prayer Without Purification, And Likewise Takbir, Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, And Supplication, And The Recommendation Of Ablution Or Tayammum For It
arabicText: مميتيف نبللا طئاح لىع هيديب برضي :لقا ؟عنصي فيك ،ءوضو ريغ لىع وهو ةزانج هب ترم لجر نع هتلأس .هب
englishText: I asked him about a man who encounters a funeral while he is without ablution, what should he do? He said: He should strike his hands on a mud wall and perform tayammum with it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Funeral Prayer Without Purification, And Likewise Takbir, Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, And Supplication, And The Recommendation Of Ablution Or Tayammum For It
arabicText: ،ةلاصلا هتتفا أضوتي بهذ نفإ ،ءوضو ريغ لىع وهو ةزانجلا هكردت لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لئس .ليصيو مميتي :لقا ،اهيلع
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was asked about a man who encounters a funeral while he is without ablution, and if he goes to perform ablution, he will miss the prayer over it. He said: He should perform tayammum and pray.

chapter: Permissibility Of Funeral Prayer Without Purification, And Likewise Takbir, Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, And Supplication, And The Recommendation Of Ablution Or Tayammum For It
arabicText: امنإو ،دوجس لاو عوكر اهيف سيل هنلأ ءوضو ريغب تيملا لىع ةلاصلا نازوج امنإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع اهيف يتلا ةلاصلا يف ءوضولا بجي امنإو ،تنك لاح يأ لىع هلأستو الله وعدت نأ زوجي دقو ،ةلأسمو اعد يه .دوجسو عوكر
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: We only permitted the funeral prayer without ablution because it has no bowing or prostration in it. It is only supplication and asking, and it is permissible to supplicate to Allah and ask Him in any state you are in. Ablution is only required in prayers that have bowing and prostration.

chapter: Permissibility For Menstruating Women And Those In State Of Janabah To Perform Funeral Prayer, And The Recommendation Of Tayammum For Both, And The Menstruating Woman Standing Separately From The Row
arabicText: .مهعم فصتلاو ،معن :لقا ؟ةزانجلا لىع ليصت ضئاحلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the menstruating woman praying the funeral prayer? He said: Yes, but she should not stand in row with them.

chapter: Permissibility For Menstruating Women And Those In State Of Janabah To Perform Funeral Prayer, And The Recommendation Of Tayammum For Both, And The Menstruating Woman Standing Separately From The Row
arabicText: ،دوجس لاو عوكر اهيف سيل هنلأ ،ةزانجلا لىع ليصت ثماطلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةزانجلا لىع (ليصيو مميتي) بنجلاو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The menstruating woman may pray the funeral prayer because it has no ruku or sujud, and the one in state of janabah (should perform tayammum and pray) the funeral prayer.

chapter: Permissibility For Menstruating Women And Those In State Of Janabah To Perform Funeral Prayer, And The Recommendation Of Tayammum For Both, And The Menstruating Woman Standing Separately From The Row
arabicText: موقت ،مهعم فصت لاو :لقا ،معن :لقا ؟ةزانجلا لىع ضئاحلا ليصت تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةدرفم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), I said: Can a menstruating woman pray the funeral prayer? He said: Yes. He said: But she should not stand in row with them, she should stand alone.

chapter: Permissibility For Menstruating Women And Those In State Of Janabah To Perform Funeral Prayer, And The Recommendation Of Tayammum For Both, And The Menstruating Woman Standing Separately From The Row
arabicText: ،مهعم فقت لاو ،معن :لاقف ؟ةزانجلا لىع ليصت ضئاحلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةزانجلا لىع ليصي بنجلاو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), I asked him about the menstruating woman praying the funeral prayer? He said: Yes, but she should not stand with them, and the one in a state of janabah (sexual impurity) may pray the funeral prayer.

chapter: Permissibility For Menstruating Women And Those In State Of Janabah To Perform Funeral Prayer, And The Recommendation Of Tayammum For Both, And The Menstruating Woman Standing Separately From The Row
arabicText: موقتو ،اهيلع ليصتو مميتت :لاقف ،ةزانجلا ترضح اذإ ثماطلا ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .فصلا نع ةزربا اهدحو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a menstruating woman when she attends a funeral, he said: She should perform tayammum and pray over it, and stand alone separate from the row.

chapter: Prayer Upon The Deceased By Those Most Entitled To It, Or Whom They Authorize, And The Ruling Of The Imam's Presence
arabicText: .بحي نم رميأ وأ ،اهب سانلا ىلوأ ةزانجلا لىع ليصي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The person most entitled prays upon the deceased, or authorizes whom he wishes.

chapter: Prayer Upon The Deceased By Those Most Entitled To It, Or Whom They Authorize, And The Ruling Of The Imam's Presence
arabicText: .بحي نم رميأ وأ ،اهب سانلا ىلوأ ةزانجلا لىع ليصي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The person most entitled prays upon the deceased, or authorizes whom he wishes. Translator: This hadith is identical to 3170 except with a different chain.

chapter: Prayer Upon The Deceased By Those Most Entitled To It, Or Whom They Authorize, And The Ruling Of The Imam's Presence
arabicText: .اهيلع ةلاصلبا سانلا قحأ وهف ةزانجلا ماملاا رضح اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When the Imam is present at the funeral, he is the most entitled person to pray over it.

chapter: Prayer Upon The Deceased By Those Most Entitled To It, Or Whom They Authorize, And The Ruling Of The Imam's Presence
arabicText: نم ناطلس رضح اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع .بصاغ وهف لاإو تيملا يلو همدق نإ اهيلع ةلاصلبا قحأ وهف ةزانج الله ناطلس
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: When an authority from Allah's authorities is present at a funeral, he is most entitled to pray over it if the guardian of the deceased puts him forward, otherwise he is a usurper.

chapter: Husband Has More Right Over His Wife (Her Funeral Prayer) Than All Her Relatives, Including Her Brother, Child, And Father
arabicText: جوزلا تلق ،جوزلا :لقا ؟اهيلع ليصي نأ قحأ نم تومت ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .معن :لقا ؟دلولاو خلأاو بلأا نم قحأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a woman who dies- who has more right to lead her funeral prayer? He said: The husband. I asked: Is the husband more entitled than the father, brother, and son? He said: Yes.

chapter: Husband Has More Right Over His Wife (Her Funeral Prayer) Than All Her Relatives, Including Her Brother, Child, And Father
arabicText: جوزلا :تلق ،اهجوز :لقا ؟اهيلع ةلاصلبا قحأ نم تومت ةأرملا :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهلسغيو ،معن :لقا ؟خلأاو دلولاو بلأا نم قحأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him: When a woman dies, who has more right to lead her funeral prayer? He said: Her husband. I asked: Is the husband more entitled than the father, son, and brother? He said: Yes, and he can also perform her ritual washing (ghusl).

chapter: Husband Has More Right Over His Wife (Her Funeral Prayer) Than All Her Relatives, Including Her Brother, Child, And Father
arabicText: .اهربق يف اهعضي ىتح هتأرمبا قحأ جوزلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The husband has more right over his wife until he places her in her grave.

chapter: Husband Has More Right Over His Wife (Her Funeral Prayer) Than All Her Relatives, Including Her Brother, Child, And Father
arabicText: قحأ اهوخأ :لاقف ؟اهيلع ليصي امهيأ ،اهجوزو اهوخأ اهعمو تومت ةأرملا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهيلع ةلاصلبا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), about a woman who dies while having both her brother and husband present, which of them should perform the funeral prayer for her? He said: Her brother has more right to perform the prayer for her. Translator: Refer to comments in Hadith 3178.

chapter: Husband Has More Right Over His Wife (Her Funeral Prayer) Than All Her Relatives, Including Her Brother, Child, And Father
arabicText: .خلأا :لقا ؟خلأا وأ اهب قحأ جوزلا ،ةأرملا لىع ةلاصلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .ةماعلل امهتقفاومل ةيقتلا لىع نيربخلا لمح هجولا :خيشلا لقا ريغو افلاخم جوزلا نوك لىعو ،ةقلطم ةجوزلا نوك لىعو ،جوزلا رغص لىعو راكنلاا لىع لمحلا لمتحيو :لوقأ .كلذ
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the funeral prayer for a woman, who has more right to lead it - the husband or the brother? He said: The brother. Al-Shaykh said: The appropriate approach is to interpret the two reports (3177 and 3178) as taqiyyah because they agree with the Aammah (general non-Shia muslims). I (Hurr Amili) say: It is also possible to interpret it as denial, the young age of the husband, the wife being divorced, the husband being an opponent, and other than that.

chapter: Permissibility Of Women's Funeral Prayer And That A Woman May Lead Them, Though It Is Disliked For Her To Stand Ahead Of Them, Rather She Should Stand In Their Middle Row
arabicText: ،اهنم ىلوأ دحأ نكي مل اذإ تيملا لىع لاإ ،لا :لقا ؟ءاسنلا مؤت ةأرملا :تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .نربكيو ربكتف نهعم فصلا يف نهطسو موقت
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked: Can a woman lead women in prayer? He said: No, except in funeral prayer when there is no one more worthy than her. She stands in their middle in the row with them, she says takbir and they say takbir.

chapter: Permissibility Of Women's Funeral Prayer And That A Woman May Lead Them, Though It Is Disliked For Her To Stand Ahead Of Them, Rather She Should Stand In Their Middle Row
arabicText: زئانجلا لىع ءاسنلا ليصي فيك :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لئس :لقا لقيصلا دياز نب نسحلا نع هدانسإبو مؤيأ ةبوتكم ةلاص يفف :ليق .ةأرما نهمدقتت لاو دحاو فص يف اعيمج نمقي :لاقف ؟لجر نهعم نكي مل اذإ .معن :لاقف ؟اضعب نهضعب
englishText: Through his chain from Al-Hasan bin Ziyad Al-Sayqal who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was asked: How do women pray the funeral prayer when there is no man with them? He said: They all stand in one row and no woman should stand ahead of them. It was asked: In obligatory prayers, can some of them lead others? He said: Yes.

chapter: Permissibility Of Women's Funeral Prayer And That A Woman May Lead Them, Though It Is Disliked For Her To Stand Ahead Of Them, Rather She Should Stand In Their Middle Row
arabicText: :لقا ؟لجر نهعم نكي مل اذإ ةزانجلا لىع ءاسنلا ليصت فيك لئس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةأرما نهمدقتت لاو اعيمج نففصي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he was asked how women should pray the funeral prayer when there is no man with them? He said: They all form rows and no woman should stand ahead of them.

chapter: Permissibility Of Women's Funeral Prayer And That A Woman May Lead Them, Though It Is Disliked For Her To Stand Ahead Of Them, Rather She Should Stand In Their Middle Row
arabicText: اهلامشو اهنيمي نع ءاسنلا مقاو ،نهطسو ةأرما تمدقت لجرلا رضحي مل اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ةلاصلا نم غرفت ىتح ربكت ،نهطسو يهو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: When no man is present, a woman stands in their middle, and the women stand to her right and left while she is in their middle, saying takbir until she completes the prayer.

chapter: Dislike Of Praying The Funeral Prayer While Wearing Sandals And Its Permissibility While Wearing Leather Socks
arabicText: .فخلبا سبأ لاو ،ءاذحب ةزانج لىع لىصي لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: One should not pray over a funeral while wearing sandals, but there is no problem with leather socks.

chapter: Recommendation For The Imam To Stand At The Middle Of A Man Or His Chest, And At The Chest Or Head Of A Woman
arabicText: يف موقي لاف ةأرما لىع لىص نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هطسو يف مقيلف لجرلا لىع لىص اذإو ،اهردص ليي امم نوكيو ،اهطسو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Whoever prays funeral prayer over a woman should not stand at her middle, and should stand at the position of her chest, and when praying over a man he should stand at his middle.

chapter: Recommendation For The Imam To Stand At The Middle Of A Man Or His Chest, And At The Chest Or Head Of A Woman
arabicText: دنع مقف لجرلا لىع تيلص اذإو ،اهسأر دنع مقف ةأرملا لىع تيلص اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع .هردص
englishText: From Abi Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), he said: When you perform the funeral prayer for a woman, stand at her head, and when you perform the funeral prayer for a man, stand at his chest.

chapter: Recommendation For The Imam To Stand At The Middle Of A Man Or His Chest, And At The Chest Or Head Of A Woman
arabicText: نمو ،ةرسلا لايحب لاجرلا نم موقي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .رييختلا انه عمجلا هجو :لوقأ .ردصلا لبق كلذ نود نم ءاسنلا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would stand level with men's navels, and with women below that near the chest. I (Hurr Amili) say: The reconciliation here is choice.

chapter: That Funeral Prayer Is A Collective Obligation, And That One Or Two People's Prayer For The Deceased Is Sufficient, And It Is Recommended For The Follower To Stand Behind The Imam Not Beside Him
arabicText: ؟اهيلع نايلصي نانثفإ :تلق ،معن :لقا ؟هدحو ةزانج لىع ليصي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .هبنجب موقي لاو رخلآا فلخ رخلآا موقي نكلو ،معن :لقا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man praying the funeral prayer alone? He said: Yes. I said: What about two people praying for the deceased? He said: Yes, but the other person should stand behind the other and not beside him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Choosing To Stand In The Last Row In The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: ريخو مدقملا ةلاصلا يف فوفصلا ريخ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ءاسنلل ةرتس راص :لقا ؟ملو الله لوسر يا :ليق ،رخؤملا زئانجلا يف فوفصلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: The best rows in regular prayer are the front ones, and the best rows in funeral prayers are the back ones. It was said: O Messenger of Allah, why? He said: It becomes a cover for women.

chapter: Recommendation Of Choosing To Stand In The Last Row In The Funeral Prayer
arabicText: الله لىص) يبنلا لاقف زئانجلا لىع ةلاصلا يف لاجرلبا نطلتخي نك ءاسنلا نإ :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم لىع هلضف يقبف ،ريخلأا فصلا ىلإ نرخأتف ،ريخلأا فصلا تيملا لىع ةلاصلا يف عضاوملا لضفأ :(هلآو هيلع .(ملاسلا هيلع) هركذ ام
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: Women used to mix with men in funeral prayers, so the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: The best position in the funeral prayer is the last row. So they moved back to the last row, and its virtue remained as he (peace be upon him) mentioned.

chapter: Permissibility Of Funeral Prayer In The Mosque, Though Disliked
arabicText: .معن :لقا ؟دجسملا يف تيملا لىع لىصي له (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Can funeral prayer be performed in the mosque? He said: Yes.

chapter: Permissibility Of Funeral Prayer In The Mosque, Though Disliked
arabicText: وبأ ءاجف ،اهيلع ليصأ نأ تدرفأ ةزانجب جئ دقو دجسملا يف انك :لقا يولعلا دمحأ نب ىسيع نب ركب يبأ نع يا :لقا مث ،دجسملا نم ينجرخأ ىتح ينعفدي لعجف يردص يف هقفرم عضوف (ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا .دجسملا يف اهيلع لىصي لا زئانجلا نإ ،ركب باأ
englishText: From Abu Bakr bin Isa bin Ahmad al-Alawi who said: We were in the mosque when a funeral was brought and I wanted to pray over it. Then Abu al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him) came and put his elbow on my chest and pushed me until he took me out of the mosque. Then he said: O Abu Bakr, funeral prayers should not be performed in the mosque. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Al-Shaykh interpreted it as dislike based on what was previously mentioned.
