chapter: Permissibility Of Funeral Prayer During Obligatory Prayer Time, And Choice Between Performing Earlier Or Later As Long As Time Is Not Constrained For Either
arabicText: نأ لاإ ،تيملا لىع ةلاصلا لبق اهب أدبفا ةبوتكم ةلاص تقو لخد اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .كلذ وحن وأ ءاسفن وأ ناوطبم تيملا نوكي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When the time for an obligatory prayer enters, start with it before the prayer for the deceased, unless the deceased died from stomach illness or childbirth or similar conditions.

chapter: Permissibility Of Funeral Prayer During Obligatory Prayer Time, And Choice Between Performing Earlier Or Later As Long As Time Is Not Constrained For Either
arabicText: ؟أدبأ امهيأبف ةبوتكم تقو يف ةزانجلا لىع ةلاصلا ترضح اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ تلق :لقا رباج نع عولط ةزانجلا لىع ةلاصلبا رظتنت لاو ،ةضيرفلا تقو توفت نأ فاخت نأ ىلإ هربق ىلإ تيملا لجع :لاقف .اهبورغ لاو سمشلا
englishText: From Jabir who said: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): When a funeral prayer and an obligatory prayer coincide in time, which should I start with? He said: Hasten the deceased to their grave until you fear missing the time of the obligatory prayer, and do not wait for sunrise or sunset to perform the funeral prayer.

chapter: Permissibility Of Funeral Prayer During Obligatory Prayer Time, And Choice Between Performing Earlier Or Later As Long As Time Is Not Constrained For Either
arabicText: ترمحا اذإ زئانجلا ةلاص نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هيخأ نع ،رفعج نب ليع نع لىع لص مث برغملا لصف سمشلا تبجو اذإ :لقاو ،ةلاص تقو يف ةلاص لا :لقا ؟لا وأ حلصتأ سمشلا .زئانجلا
englishText: From Ali bin Ja'far, from his brother Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about the funeral prayer when the sun becomes red, is it permissible or not? He said: There is no prayer during the time of (obligatory) prayer, and he said: When the sun sets, pray the Maghrib prayer then pray for the deceased.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing A Single Prayer For Multiple Funerals Together, And What Is Recommended Regarding Their Arrangement In Placement
arabicText: امم ءاسنلا مامأ لجرلا :لقا ؟مهيلع لىصي فيك ءاسنلاو لاجرلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع .ضعب رثأ لىع مهضعب فصي ماملاا ليي
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them), he said: I asked him about how to pray for men and women? He said: The man is placed in front of the women near the imam, arranging them one after another.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing A Single Prayer For Multiple Funerals Together, And What Is Recommended Regarding Their Arrangement In Placement
arabicText: ؟مهيلع ليصي فيك ،ىتوم ةثلاث وأ نيتيم لىع ليصي لجرلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع سمخ مهيلع ربكي ،ةدحاو ةلاص مهيلع لصيلف كلذ نم رثكأ وأ ةرشع وأ نيتنثا وأ ةثلاث ناك نإ :لقا ،لولأا ةيلأ ىلإ رخلآا لعجي مث ادحاو اتيم عضي اعيمج مهيلع لىص دقو ،دحاو تيم لىع ليصي امك ،تاريبكت يف مقا اذكه مهاوس اذفإ ،اوناك ام مهلك مهنم غرفي ىتح ،جردملا هبش يناثلا ةيلأ ىلإ ثلاثلا سأر لعجي مث .دحاو تيم لىع لىص اذإ لعفي امك لعفي ،تاريبكت سمخ ربكف طسولا نم غرفي ىتح لولأا ةيلأ ىلإ يناثلا سأر لعجيف لاجرلبا أدبي :لقا * ؟ءاسنو لااجر ىتوملا ناك نفإ لئس ىلولأا ةأرملا ةيلأ ىلإ ىرخلأا ةأرملا سأر لعجي مث ،ريخلأا لجرلا ةيلأ ىلإ ةأرملا سأر لعجي مث ،مهلك لاجرلا تيم لىع ليصي امك مهيلع لىصو ربكف لاجرلا طسو طسولا يف مقا اذكه ىوس اذفإ ،مهلك مهنم غرفي ىتح .دحاو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man praying over two or three deceased, how should he pray over them? He said: Whether there are three or two or ten or more than that, he should perform one prayer for them, saying five takbirs for them, just as he prays for a single deceased. He has prayed for all of them by placing one deceased then placing the next one's head at the buttocks of the first, then placing the third one's head at the buttocks of the second like steps, until he finishes with all of them however many there are. When he has arranged them like this, he stands in the middle and says five takbirs, doing as he would do when praying for a single deceased. He was asked: What if the deceased are men and women? He said: He starts with the He was asked: What if the deceased are men and women? He said: He starts with the men, placing the head of the second at the buttocks of the first until he finishes with all the men, then places the woman's head at the buttocks of the last man, then places the next woman's head at the buttocks of the first woman until he finishes with all of them. When he has arranged them like this, he stands in the middle of the men and says takbirs and prays for them as he would pray for a single deceased.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing A Single Prayer For Multiple Funerals Together, And What Is Recommended Regarding Their Arrangement In Placement
arabicText: نايبصلاو ةلبقلا ليي امم ءاسنلا عضي :لقا ءاسنلاو نايبصلاو لاجرلا زئانج يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لاجرلا ليي امم ماملاا موقيو ،كلذ نود امم لاجرلاو مهنود
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding funeral prayers for men, children, and women, he said: Place the women towards the qibla, the children behind them, and the men behind that, and the imam stands by where the men are.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing A Single Prayer For Multiple Funerals Together, And What Is Recommended Regarding Their Arrangement In Placement
arabicText: باتك يف ،لاجرلا مدقي :لاقف ؟تعمتجا اذإ ءاسنلاو لاجرلا زئانج نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .(ملاسلا هيلع) ليع
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about funeral prayers when there are both men and women? He said: The men are placed in front, according to the book of Ali (peace be upon him).

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing A Single Prayer For Multiple Funerals Together, And What Is Recommended Regarding Their Arrangement In Placement
arabicText: لىع لىص اذإو ،لجرلا رخأو ةأرملا مدق لجرلاو ةأرملا لىع لىص اذإ ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ريبكلا رخأو ريغصلا مدق ريبكلاو ريغصلا لىع لىص اذإو ،رحلا رخأو دبعلا مدق ،رحلاو دبعلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When praying over a woman and a man, he would place the woman in front and the man behind, and when praying over a slave and a free person, he would place the slave in front and the free person behind, and when praying over a young person and an elder, he would place the young person in front and the elder behind.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing A Single Prayer For Multiple Funerals Together, And What Is Recommended Regarding Their Arrangement In Placement
arabicText: ينعي ،ةأرملا مدقتو لجرلا رخؤيو ،ةأرملا رخؤتو لجرلا مدقي نأ سبأ لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .تيملا لىع ةلاصلا يف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: There is no problem if a man is placed ahead and a woman behind, or if a man is placed behind and a woman ahead, meaning in the funeral prayer.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing A Single Prayer For Multiple Funerals Together, And What Is Recommended Regarding Their Arrangement In Placement
arabicText: ليي امم ةأرملا يدي نيب لجرلا نوكي :لقا ؟امهيلع لىصي ةأرملاو لجرلا نع هتلأس :لقا يبلحلا الله ديبع نع سأرو ،ماملاا راسي ليي امم اضيأ اهسأر نوكيو ؟هراسي ليي امم لجرلا كيرو دنع ةأرملا سأر نوكيف ةلبقلا .ماملاا نيمي ليي امم لجرلا
englishText: From Ubaydullah al-Halabi who said: I asked him about praying over a man and woman? He said: The man should be placed in front of the woman towards the qibla, with the woman's head at the man's hip on his left side. And her head should also be on the imam's left side, while the man's head should be on the imam's right side.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing A Single Prayer For Multiple Funerals Together, And What Is Recommended Regarding Their Arrangement In Placement
arabicText: عضوتو ،لايلق ةأرملا مادق لجرلا مدقي :لاقف ،تعمتجا اذإ ءاسنلاو لاجرلا زئانج نع هتلأس :لقا ةعامس نع .اعيمج امهيلع ليصيف تيملا سأر دنع ماملاا موقيو ،هيلجر دنع لايلق كلذ نم لفسأ ةأرملا
englishText: From Sama'ah who said: I asked him about funeral prayers when there are both men and women together. He said: The man should be placed slightly ahead of the woman, and the woman should be placed slightly lower near his feet, and the imam stands at the head of the deceased and prays over both of them together.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing A Single Prayer For Multiple Funerals Together, And What Is Recommended Regarding Their Arrangement In Placement
arabicText: امم لاجرلا عضوت :لاقف ؟ءاسنلاو لاجرلا لىع لىصي فيك هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) (الله دبع) رفعج يبأ نع .لاجرلا فلخ ءاسنلاو ،لاجرلا ليي
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (Abdullah) (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him how to pray over men and women? He said: Men are placed on the side of men, and women behind men.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing A Single Prayer For Multiple Funerals Together, And What Is Recommended Regarding Their Arrangement In Placement
arabicText: ،ةأرملا ءارو لجرلا لعجي :لاقف ؟امهيلع لىصي فيك ةأرملاو لجرلا يف :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ماملاا ليي امم لجرلا نوكيو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said regarding how to pray over a man and woman: He said: The man is placed behind the woman, and the man should be on the side of the imam.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing A Single Prayer For Multiple Funerals Together, And What Is Recommended Regarding Their Arrangement In Placement
arabicText: يفو ،رمع نب ديز اهنباو ليع تنب موثلك مأ ةزانج تجرخأ :لقا رسيا نب رامع نع (فلاخلا) يف خيشلا ىورو ليي امم ملاغلا ةزانج اوعضوف ،ةريره وبأو سابع نب الله دبعو رمع نب الله دبعو نيسحلاو نسحلا ةزانجلا .ةنسلا وه اذه :اولقاو ،هءارو ةأرملاو ماملاا .ملاس نب ماشه ثيدحل بابحتسلاا لىع بيترتلا ثيداحأ هريغو خيشلا لمح :لوقأ
englishText: And the Shaykh narrated in (Al-Khilaf) from Ammar bin Yasir who said: The funeral And the Shaykh narrated in (Al-Khilaf) from Ammar bin Yasir who said: The funeral of UmmKulthum bint Ali and her son Zayd bin Umar was brought out, and present at the funeral were Al-Hasan, Al-Husayn, Abdullah bin Umar, Abdullah bin Abbas and Abu Hurayrah. They placed the boy's funeral next to the imam and the woman behind him, and they said: This is the sunnah. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh and others interpreted the arrangement hadiths as recommended based on the hadith of Hisham bin Salim. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Al-Shaykh and others interpreted the hadiths about order as recommendatory based on the hadith of Hisham bin Salim.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing Funeral Prayer In Congregation And Individually
arabicText: موي ينتئاو يتوم متكفا ،عوبسأ ليجأ نم يقب امنإو تيم ناأ ،ليع با يا :ىيحيل لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ميهاربإ باأ نأ .ىدارف يئايلوأو تنأ ليع لصو ،لاوزلا دنع ةعمجلا
englishText: Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) said to Yahya: O Abu Ali, I am dying and only a week remains of my life, so keep my death concealed and come to me on Friday at noon, and perform the funeral prayer over me, you and my supporters (awliya) individually.

chapter: Ruling Of Attending A Funeral In The Midst Of Praying Over Another Funeral
arabicText: تعضوو ،نيتنثا وأ ةريبكت ةزانج لىع اوربك موق نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هيخأ نع اوعفر اوءاش نإو ،ةريخلأا لىع ريبكتلا نم اوغرفي ىتح ىلولأا اوكرت اوءاش نإ :اولقا ؟نوعنصي فيك ىرخأ اهعم .هب سبأ لا كلذ لك ،ةريخلأا لىع يقب ام اومتأو ىلولأا لىع ةلاصلا لامكإ نيبو ،امهيلع اهفانيتساو ىلولأا لىع ةلاصلا عطق نيب رييختلا لىع ةعامج هب لدتسا :لوقأ .ةينثا ةلاصب ةيناثلا دارفإو ىلولأا بوسحم ىلولأا ريبكت نم يقب ام نأ اهرهاظ ذإ ،ىعدملا ةدفاإ نع ةرصقا ةياورلاو :(ىركذلا) يف ديهشلا لقا نم اهعفر نيبو ،ةريخلأا لىع ريبكتلا اولمكي ىتح اهلاحب اهكرت نيب اوريخت ىلولأا ريبكت نم غرف اذفإ ،نيتزانجلل .ىهتنا ،ةريخلأا لىع مامتلااو اهناكم نومتي مهنأ ىنعمب رشعلا تاريبكتلا ينعأ ،نيتزانجلا لىع ريبكتلا عومجم انه ريبكتلبا داري نأ لمتحي :لوقأ هلقا ام لىع لاو هولقا ام لىع لدي لا ذئنيحو ،اهكرتو ىلولأا عفر يف نوريختيو ،ىرخلأل ةلاص نوفنأتسيو ىلولأا .طوحلأا وه اذهو ،ديهشلا
englishText: From his brother Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a group who pronounced takbir once or twice over a funeral, and another funeral was placed alongside it, what should they do? He replied: If they wish, they can leave the f irst one until they complete the takbirs for the second one, and if they wish, they can carry away the first one and complete the remaining takbirs for the second one either way is permissible. I (Hurr Amili) say: A group used it as evidence for the choice between interrupting the prayer over the first and restarting it over both of them, and between completing the prayer over the first and singling out the second with a second prayer. Al-Shahid said in "Al-Dhikra": "The narration falls short of providing the claimed meaning, as its apparent meaning is that what remains of the takbir of the first is counted for both funerals. When they finish the takbir of the first, they have the choice between leaving it as is until they complete the takbir over the last, and between lifting it from its place and completing over the last," end quote. I (Hurr Amili) say: It is possible that what is meant by takbir here is the total takbir over the two funerals, meaning the ten takbirs, in the sense that they complete the I (Hurr Amili) say: It is possible that what is meant by takbir here is the total takbir over the two funerals, meaning the ten takbirs, in the sense that they complete the f irst and start a prayer for the last, and they have the choice of lifting the first or leaving it. In that case, it does not indicate what they said nor what Al-Shahid said, and this is more precautionary.

chapter: How To Perform Prayer For The Crucified
arabicText: هيلع) يدج نأ تملع امأ :لاقف ،بولصملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا تلأس لقا يرفعجلا مشاه يبأ نع كل هنيبأ :لاقف ،انيبم همهفأ لا ينكلو ،كلذ ملعأ :تلق ؟همع لىع لىص (ملاسلا ،رسيلأا هبكنم لىع مقف ةلبقلا ىلإ هافق ناك نإو ،نميلأا هبكنم لىع مقف ةلبقلا ىلإ بولصملا هجو ناك نإ هبكنم ناك نإو نميلأا هبكنم لىع مقف ةلبقلا ىلإ رسيلأا هبكنم ناك نإو ،ةلبق برغملاو قرشملا نيب نفإ ،رسيلأا هبكنم لىع مقف ةلبقلا ىلإ نميلأا هربدتست لاو هلبقتست لاو ،برغملاو قرشملا نيب ام ىلإ كهجو نكيلو ،هبكانم نليازت لاف فارحنم ناك فيكو .اللهو هتمهف الله ءاش نإ تمهف دقو :مشاه وبأ :لقا ،ةتبلا
englishText: From Abu Hashim Al-Ja'fari who said: I asked Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about the crucified person. He said: Don't you know that my grandfather (peace be upon him) prayed for his uncle? I said: I know that, but I don't understand it clearly. So he said: I will explain it to you. If the face of the crucified is towards the qibla, then stand at his right shoulder. If his back is towards the qibla, then stand at his left shoulder, for between the east and west is the qibla. If his left shoulder is towards the qibla, then stand at his right shoulder. If his right shoulder is towards the qibla, then stand at his left shoulder. And however he is positioned, do not move away from his shoulders, and let your face be towards what is between the east and west, and never face him directly or turn your back to him completely. Abu Hashim said: I have understood it, insha'Allah, by Allah I understood it.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Funeral Prayer Before Shrouding, And If No Shroud Is Available, It Is Obligatory To Place The Deceased In The Grave, Cover Their Private Parts, Then Pray Over Them Before Burial
arabicText: لىع نوشمي مهل رفس يف اوناك موق يف لوقت ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا ىسوم نب رامع نع نولصي فيك رازإ لاإ مهيلع سيلو ةارع مهو رحبلا هظفل دق نيارع تيم لجرب مه اذفإ رحبلا لحاس ؟هب هنونفكي بوث لضف مهعم سيلو ،(نيارع وهو) هيلع مث ،هيلع لىصي مث ،(رجحلباو) نبللبا هتروع رتستف هتروع لىع نبللا عضويو ،هدحل يف عضويو هل رفحي :لقا نيارع وهو هيلع لىصي لاو ،نفدي ام دعب تيملا لىع لىصي لا :لاقف ؟نفد اذإ هيلع لىصي لاف :تلق .نفدي .هتروع ىراوت ىتح
englishText: From Ammar bin Musa who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): What do you say about a group who were traveling and walking along the seashore when they found a dead naked man cast out by the sea, and they were barely clothed with only loincloths, how should they pray over him (while he's naked), and they don't have extra cloth to shroud him? He said: Dig a grave for him and place him in his niche, and place bricks over his private parts to cover them with bricks (and stone), then pray over him, then bury him. I asked: So they shouldn't pray over him after burial? He said: One does not pray over the deceased after burial, nor pray over him while naked until his private parts are covered.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Funeral Prayer Before Shrouding, And If No Shroud Is Available, It Is Obligatory To Place The Deceased In The Grave, Cover Their Private Parts, Then Pray Over Them Before Burial
arabicText: لجرب مه اذفإ ،طشلا لىع نوشمي اوجرخف رحب يف مهب رسك موق :(ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا يبلأ تلق فيكف ،لجرلا نوراوي بوث لضف مهيلع سيلو ،اهب نيرزتم ،ليدانم لاإ مهيلع سيل موقلاو نيارع تيم ؟نيارع وهو هيلع نولصي راجحأ وأ نبلب هتروع نوراوي ،هدحل يف هوعضيو هربق اورفحيلف هتروع هب نوراوي بوث لىع اوردقي مل اذإ :لاقف راجحأ وأ نبلب هتروع نوراوي ،هدحل يف هوعضيو هربق اورفحيلف هتروع هب نوراوي بوث لىع اوردقي مل اذإ :لاقف ول ،لا :لقا ؟نفدي ام دعب نوفدم وهو هيلع نولصي لاو :تلق .هربق يف هنوراوي مث ،هيلع نولصي مث ،بارت وأ .نيارعلا لىع لاو نوفدملا لىع لىصي لاف ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسرل زاجل دحلا كلذ زاج
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him): A group whose ship broke at sea and they came out walking on the shore, when they found a dead naked man and the group only had scarves which they wore as loincloths, and they had no extra cloth to cover the man, how should they pray over him while he's naked? He said: If they cannot find cloth to cover his private parts, they should dig his grave and place him in his niche, cover his private parts with bricks or stones or soil, then pray over him, then cover him in his grave. I asked: And they shouldn't pray over him after he's buried? He said: No, if that were permissible for anyone it would have been permissible for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), so one does not pray over someone buried nor over someone naked.

chapter: Obligation Of Praying Over Every Deceased Muslim, Or One Considered As Such, Even If He Was A Drinker Of Wine, An Adulterer, A Thief, A Murderer, A Sinner, A Martyr, An Opponent, Or A Hypocrite
arabicText: :لاقف ؟اوتام اذإ مهيلع لىصي قراسلاو ينازلاو رمخلا براش :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .معن
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I said to him: Should funeral prayer be performed for the one who drinks alcohol, the adulterer, and the thief when they die? He said: Yes.

chapter: Obligation Of Praying Over Every Deceased Muslim, Or One Considered As Such, Even If He Was A Drinker Of Wine, An Adulterer, A Thief, A Murderer, A Sinner, A Martyr, An Opponent, Or A Hypocrite
arabicText: .الله لىع هباسحو ةلبقلا لهأ نم تام نم لىع لص :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع ،الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, from his father (peace be upon them both), who said: Pray (the funeral prayer) over whoever dies from among the people of the qibla, and their reckoning is with Allah.

chapter: Obligation Of Praying Over Every Deceased Muslim, Or One Considered As Such, Even If He Was A Drinker Of Wine, An Adulterer, A Thief, A Murderer, A Sinner, A Martyr, An Opponent, Or A Hypocrite
arabicText: لاتقلا لىعو ،يتمأ نم موجرملا لىع اولص :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع .ةلاص لاب يتمأ نم ادحأ اوعدت لا ،يتمأ نم هسفن ،اضيأ ليسغتلا يفو تاريبكت سمخ لىع ةديازلا يف مدقت انه ام ىلإ فااضم ديهشلا مكح لىع لديو :لوقأ .ههجو ناركذو ةفاانملا هرهاظ ام كانهو
englishText: From his forefathers (peace be upon them), he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Offer the funeral prayer for the one who is stoned to death from my nation, and for the one who commits suicide from my nation. Do not leave anyone from my nation without a funeral prayer. I (Hurr Amili) say: What indicates the ruling on the martyr, in addition to what is here, has preceded regarding more than five takbirs and also in the washing. There is what apparently contradicts it, and we have mentioned its explanation.

chapter: Obligation Of Praying Over Every Deceased Muslim, Or One Considered As Such, Even If He Was A Drinker Of Wine, An Adulterer, A Thief, A Murderer, A Sinner, A Martyr, An Opponent, Or A Hypocrite
arabicText: .هسفن لىع فاوخ كلذ كرت نوكي نأ لاإ هيلع لىصي لا فلغلأا نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع دحج نم لىع وأ ،هيلع ةلاصلا يف ةبغرلا يغبني لا ينعي ،دحاو ولو هيلع لىص اذإ ام لىع هلمح يغبنيو :لوقأ نإ - ةبرشلأاو ةمعطلأا يف يتيأو .ادترم ريصي ثيحب ،هيلع ةجحلا مايقو ،هدنع اهتوبث دعب ناتخلا ةيعرش .ملعأ اللهو هناركذ ام ههجوو رمخلا براش لىع ةلاصلا مدع لىع لدي ام - الله ءاش
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him): The uncircumcised person should not be prayed over [funeral prayer], unless he had left circumcision due to fear for his life. I (Hurr Amili) say: It should be interpreted as when the prayer has been performed over him, even by one person. That is, one should not be eager to pray over him. Or it refers to one who denies the legality of circumcision after it has been established to him and the proof has been established against him, to the extent that he becomes an apostate. In the chapter on foods and drinks- if Allah wills- there will come what indicates not praying over the drinker of wine, and its explanation is what we have mentioned, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Ruling Regarding Finding Some Parts Of A Deceased Person
arabicText: ىقبتف ريطلا وأ عبسلا هلكيأ لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هاخأ لأس هنأ رفعج نب ليع نع .نفديو هيلع لىصيو نفكيو لسغي :لقا ؟هب عنصي فيك محل ريغب هماظع
englishText: From Ali bin Ja'far, that he asked his brother Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a man eaten by a predator or birds, and only his bones remain without flesh, how should he be handled? He said: He should be washed, shrouded, prayed upon, and buried.

chapter: Ruling Regarding Finding Some Parts Of A Deceased Person
arabicText: ،تيم نم اعطق دجو (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع نأ (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع ،قداصلا نع ،رامع نب قاحسإ نع .تنفد مث ،اهيلع لىص مث ،تعمجف
englishText: From Ishaq bin Ammar, from Al-Sadiq, from his father (peace be upon them both) that Ali (peace be upon him) found pieces of a deceased person, so they were gathered, then he prayed upon them, then they were buried.

chapter: Ruling Regarding Finding Some Parts Of A Deceased Person
arabicText: لىع لىصي :لقا ؟هيلع لىصي فيك ةقرفتم هؤاضعأ تدجوو لتق لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لئسو :لقا .هبلق هيف يذلا
englishText: He said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) was asked about a man who was killed and his limbs were found scattered, how should the prayer be performed over him? He said: Pray over the part that contains his heart.

chapter: Ruling Regarding Finding Some Parts Of A Deceased Person
arabicText: يف هاديو هردصو هطسوو) ،ةليبق يف هسأر دجويف لتقي لجرلا يف (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع ،قداصلا نع .هيلع ةلاصلاو ،هاديو هردص هتليبق يف دجو نم لىع هتيد :لقا ،(ةليبق يف هنم يقابلاو ،ةليبق
englishText: From Al-Sadiq, from his father (peace be upon them both) regarding a man who is killed and his head is found in one tribe, (and his middle and chest and hands in another tribe, and the rest of him in another tribe), he said: His blood money is upon those in whose tribe his chest and hands were found, and the prayer should be performed over him.

chapter: Ruling Regarding Finding Some Parts Of A Deceased Person
arabicText: عنصي فيك ،محل ريغب هماظع ىقبتف ريطلا وأ عبسلا هلكيأ لجر نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .هبلق هيف يذلا فصنلا لىع لىص نيفصن تيملا ناك اذفإ ،نفديو هيلع لىصيو نفكيو لسغي :لقا ؟هب
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a man eaten by a predator or birds and only his bones remain without flesh, how should he be handled? He said: He should be washed, shrouded, prayed upon and buried, and if the deceased is in two halves, pray over the half that contains the heart.

chapter: Ruling Regarding Finding Some Parts Of A Deceased Person
arabicText: .كلذ لثم (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هيخأ نع ،رفعج نب ليع نع
englishText: From Ali bin Ja'far, from his brother Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) similar to that.

chapter: Ruling Regarding Finding Some Parts Of A Deceased Person
arabicText: ندبلا ناك اذفإ ادرفنم سأر وأ دي وأ لجر نم لجر وضع لىع لىصي لا :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لجرلاو ديلاو سأرلا نم اصقنا ناك نإو ،هيلع لصف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he said: One should not pray over a single limb of a man, or a hand, or a head separately, but if the body is present then pray over it, even if it is missing the head, hand, and leg.

chapter: Ruling Regarding Finding Some Parts Of A Deceased Person
arabicText: مظع دجو نإو ،هيلع لصي مل مظع لاب محل لاإ دجوي ملف ليتق لتق اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ردصلا ماظع دوجو ههجو :لوقأ .هيلع لصف محل لاب
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: If a slain person is found and only f lesh without bone is found, funeral prayer is not performed for him, but if bone without flesh is found, then funeral prayer is performed for him. I (Hurr Amili) say: The reason is the presence of chest bones.

chapter: Ruling Regarding Finding Some Parts Of A Deceased Person
arabicText: مل نإو ،نفدو هيلع ليص متا وضع هل دجو نفإ لايتق لجرلا دجو اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .نفدو هيلع لصي مل متا وضع هل دجوي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If a slain man is found and a complete limb is found for him, funeral prayer is performed for him and he is buried, and if no complete limb is found for him, no funeral prayer is performed for him and he is buried.

chapter: Ruling Regarding Finding Some Parts Of A Deceased Person
arabicText: .دسجلا نم درفأ اذإ سأرلا لىع لىصي هنأ يورو :ينيلكلا لقا
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: And it is narrated that funeral prayer is performed on the head when it is separated from the body.

chapter: Ruling Regarding Finding Some Parts Of A Deceased Person
arabicText: قودصلا هاورو .بلقلا هيف يذلا فصنلا ليص نيفصنب لجرلا طسو اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هيلع لصي مل سأرلا لاإ هنم دجوي مل ناو :دازو لاسرم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If a man is cut in half, funeral prayer is performed on the half containing the heart. And Al-Saduq narrated it as mursal and added: and if only the head is found from him, funeral prayer is not performed for him.

chapter: Ruling Regarding Finding Some Parts Of A Deceased Person
arabicText: لىع لىصي ءاضعأ عطق اذإ لوتقملا :لقا هعفر انباحصأ ضعب نع ،يطنزبلا رصن يبأ نب دمحم نب دمحلأ نع .بلقلا هيف يذلا وضعلا
englishText: From Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr Al-Bazanti, from some of our companions who raised it (to the Imam) saying: For the slain person whose limbs are cut, funeral prayer is performed on the limb containing the heart.

chapter: Ruling Regarding Finding Some Parts Of A Deceased Person
arabicText: وأ ،ادي وأ ناك لاجر :وضع لك لىع لىصي هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ينغلب :لقا هنأ ةريغملا نبا نعو .هيلع لصي مل لجر وأ دي وأ سأر نع صقن اذفإ - داز امف اءزج - سأرلا ةملاعلا لمحو ،بابحتسلاا لىع باحصلأا ضعب امهلمح ماتلا وضعلا لىع ةلاصلا ثيدحو ،اذه :لوقأ ةيقتلا لىع لمحلاو اذه ،هريغ هيلع لمتشي لا ام لىع لمتشي هنلأ ،ردصلا لىع ماتلا وضعلا (ةركذتلا) يف .ملعأ اللهو ،نكمم
englishText: And from Ibn Al-Mughira who said: I was informed about Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) that funeral prayer is performed on every limb: whether it be a leg, hand, or head- a part or more- but if it is less than a head, hand, or leg, funeral prayer is not performed for it. I (Hurr Amili) say: This, and the hadith about prayer on the complete limb were interpreted by some companions as recommended, and Al-Allama in (Al-Tadhkira) interpreted the complete limb as the chest, because it contains what others do not contain, and interpretation based on taqiyyah is possible, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Permissibility Of Women Going Out For Funeral Prayer When There Is No Corruption
arabicText: :لاقف ؟زيانجلا لىع ءاسنلا ليصتأ لئس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع - ثيدح يف - ةفيلخ نب ديزي نع لىع تلصف اهئاسن يف تجرخ (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا نأو تيفوت (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا تنب بنيز نإ .اهتخأ
englishText: From Yazid bin Khalifa- in a hadith- from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he was asked: Do women pray over the deceased? He said: When Zainab daughter of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) died, Fatima (peace be upon her) went out with her women and prayed over her sister.

chapter: Permissibility Of Women Going Out For Funeral Prayer When There Is No Corruption
arabicText: نإ :لاقف ؟ةزانجلا ىلإ ءاسنلا جرخت :لاقف رضاح ناأو (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ الله دبع نب ىسيع لأس تجرخو - :لقا نأ ىلإ ،هلوطب نامثع ةجوز ةفاو ثيدح ركذ مث - صاعلا يبأ نب ةريغملا همع ىوآ قسافلا .ةزانجلا لىع نيلصف نيرجاهملاو نينمؤملا ءاسنو (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا
englishText: Isa bin Abdullah asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) while I was present, saying: Do women go out to funerals? He said: Indeed the transgressor sheltered his uncle Al Mughira bin Abi Al-As- then he mentioned the lengthy hadith about the death of Uthman's wife, until he said:- and Fatima (peace be upon her) and the women of the believers and emigrants went out and prayed over the deceased.

chapter: Permissibility Of Women Going Out For Funeral Prayer When There Is No Corruption
arabicText: نوكت نأ لاإ ،اهيلع ليصت ةزانجلا ىلإ جرخت ةباشلا ةأرملل يغبني سيل :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .نسلا يف تلخد دق ةأرما .مامحلا بادآ يف ةدسفملا عم عنملا لىعو ،ةزانجلا لىع ءاسنلا ةلاص يف كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقت :لوقأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: It is not appropriate for a young woman to go out to attend a funeral prayer, unless she is an elderly woman. I (Hurr Amili) say: This has been mentioned previously regarding women's funeral prayer, and regarding the prohibition when there is corruption in bath etiquette.

chapter: Permissibility Of Escorting A Funeral Procession In Which Wailing Women Participate, The Recommendation Of Attending The Prayer Over It, And The Impermissibility Of Women Wailing With It
arabicText: تخرصف ،ءاطع اهيف ناكو هعم ناأو شيرق نم لجر ةزانج (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ رضح :لقا ةرارز نع ،عجر دق ءاطع نإ :رفعج يبلأ تلقف ،ءاطع عجرف تكست ملف :لقا ،نعجرنل وأ نتكستل :ءاطع لاقف ،ةخراص ،عجرف تكست ملف ،نعجرنل وأ نتكستل :اهل لاقف ةخراصلا هذه تخرص :تلق ؟ملو :لقا لىع لىص املف ،ملسم قح ضقن مل قحلا هل انكرت قحلا عم لطابلا نم ائيش انيأر اذإ ناأ ولف ،ضما :لاقف .عجري نأ ىبفأ يشملا لىع ىوقت لا كنفإ ،الله كمحر اروجأم عجرا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ اهيلو لقا ةزانجلا
englishText: From Zurarah who said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) attended the funeral of a man from Quraysh and I was with him, and Ata' was present there. A woman began wailing, so Ata' said: Either she stops or we will leave. She did not stop, so Ata left. I said to Abu Ja'far: Ata has left. He said: Why? I said: This woman was wailing, so he told her either to stop or we would leave, and when she didn't stop, he left. He said: Continue on (proceed with the prayer). If we were to abandon truth whenever we see falsehood alongside it, we would never fulfill the right of any Muslim. After he prayed over the funeral, the deceased's guardian said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): Return, may Allah reward you, and have mercy on you, for you are not strong enough to walk. But he refused to return (*). Translator: * The guardian requested the Imam to return home (go back) after the funeral prayer and not continue with walking towards the grave.

chapter: Permissibility Of Escorting A Funeral Procession In Which Wailing Women Participate, The Recommendation Of Attending The Prayer Over It, And The Impermissibility Of Women Wailing With It
arabicText: يفن لىع خيشلا هلمح :لوقأ .ةأرما اهعم ةزانج لىع ةلاص لا :لقا هيبأ نع ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ءازجلاا نود ةيلضفلأا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), from his father, who said: There is no funeral prayer when a woman is present in it. I (Hurr Amili) say: Al-Shaykh interpreted it as negating the preference, not the validity. Section 3 Dafan (Burial) And Related Matters

chapter: Its Obligation
arabicText: ريغتو ،هرظنم حبقو ،هدسج داسف لىع سانلا رهظي لائل تيملا نفدب رمأ امنإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع ،ءادعلأاو ءايلولأا نع اروتسم نوكيلو ،داسفلاو ةفلآا نم هيلع لخدي امبو ،هحيرب ءايحلاا هب ىذأتي لاو ،هحير .قيدص نزحي لاو ،ودع تمشي لاف
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: The dead were commanded to be buried so that people would not see the decay of their body, the unsightliness of their appearance, and the change in their smell, and so the living would not be harmed by their odor and what befalls them of deterioration and decay, and so that they would be concealed from friends and enemies, so that no enemy would rejoice and no friend would grieve.

chapter: Recommendation Of Accompanying The Funeral And Praying For The Deceased
arabicText: لاإ ائيش لقي ملو ،اعافش عبرأ ةمايقلا موي يطعأ ملسم ةزانج عبت نم :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تعمس .كلذ لثم كلو :كلملا لقاو
englishText: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: Whoever follows a Muslim funeral procession will be given four intercessions on the Day of Resurrection, and he does not say anything except that the angel says: And for you the same.

chapter: Recommendation Of Accompanying The Funeral And Praying For The Deceased
arabicText: :لقا ؟ةزانج عيش نمل ام بر يا :لقا نأ هبر ىسوم هب جىنا اميف (١) ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .مهرشحم ىلإ مهروبق نم مهنوعيشي تياار مهعم يتكئلام نم ةكئلام هب لكوأ
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Among what Musa conversed with his Lord was that he said: O Lord, what is there for one who follows a funeral procession? He said: I appoint angels from My angels with them carrying banners, accompanying them from their graves to their place of gathering.

chapter: Recommendation Of Accompanying The Funeral And Praying For The Deceased
arabicText: ءابح (لوأ نإو لاأ) ،ةنجلا كئابح لوأ نإو لاأ :يدون هربق نمؤملا لخد اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ةرفغملا كعبت نم
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: When a believer enters his grave, he is called: Behold, your first gift is Paradise, and behold, the first gift for those who followed you is forgiveness.

chapter: Recommendation Of Accompanying The Funeral And Praying For The Deceased
arabicText: .هتزانج عبت نمل رفغي (نأ هربق يف) نمؤملا هب فحتي ام لوأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The first gift given to a believer in his grave is that those who followed his funeral are forgiven.

chapter: Recommendation Of Accompanying The Funeral And Praying For The Deceased
arabicText: لجر ةزانج يف جرخ لجر :ةنجلا الله لىع ةتسل تنمض :- ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا .ةنجلا هلف تامف ملسم
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said- in a hadith: I guarantee Paradise from Allah for six people: A man who goes out for a Muslim's funeral and dies, for him is Paradise.

chapter: Recommendation Of Accompanying The Funeral And Praying For The Deceased
arabicText: - ثيدح يف - (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نع ،ضيرملا ةدايع يف مدقت دانسإب (لامعلأا باقع) يفو عفريو ،ةئيس فلأ فلأ ةئام هنع احميو ،ةنسح فلأ فلأ ةئام عجري ىتح ةوطخ لكب هلف ةزانج عيش نم :لقا ،عجري ىتح هل نورفغتسي مهلك ،كلم فلأ فلأ ةئام هتزانج يف هعيش اهيلع لىص نفإ ،ةجرد فلأ فلأ ةئام هل لىص تيم لىع لىص نمو .هربق نم ثعبي ىتح هل نورفغتسي مهلك كلم فلأ هب الله لكو اهنفد دهش نفإ بارتلا نم هيلع اثحو هنفدي ىتح هيلع مقاأ نإو ،هبنذ نم مدقت ام هل رفغو كلم فلأ نوعبسو ليئربج هيلع لبج لثم طاريقلاو ،رجلاا نم طاريق هلزنم ىلإ عجري ىتح اهعيش ثيح نم مدق لكب هلو ةزانجلا نم بلقنا .رجلاا نم هنازيم يف نوكي دحأ
englishText: And in (Iqab al-A'mal) with a chain mentioned previously in visiting the sick, from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)- in a hadith- he said: Whoever accompanies a funeral, for each step until he returns, he gets a hundred million good deeds, a hundred million sins are erased from him, and he is raised a hundred million degrees. If he prays over it, a hundred million angels accompany him in his funeral, all seeking forgiveness for him until he returns. If he attends its burial, Allah appoints a thousand angels with him, all seeking forgiveness for him until he is resurrected from his grave. And whoever prays over a deceased, Gabriel and seventy thousand angels pray for him and his past sins are forgiven. If he stays until the burial and throws soil over it, he returns from the funeral with a qirat of reward for each step from where he accompanied it until he returns to his home, and a qirat is like Mount Uhud in his scale of rewards.

chapter: Recommendation Of Accompanying The Funeral And Praying For The Deceased
arabicText: لوأ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع الله دبع يبأ نع .هتزانج عبت نملو هل رفغي نأ نمؤملا ةفحت
englishText: From Abu Abdullah from his forefathers (peace be upon them)- in a hadith- he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: The first gift to the believer is that he and those who followed his funeral are forgiven.

chapter: Recommendation Of Accompanying The Funeral And Praying For The Deceased
arabicText: .زئانجلا عابتا :- اهنم - عبسب مهرمأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ هيبأ نع ،دمحم نب رفعج نع
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his father, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) commanded them with seven things- among them was: following funeral processions.

chapter: Recommendation Of Not Returning From A Funeral Until The Prayer Is Performed, The Burial Is Complete, And Condolences Are Offered To The Family, Even If Permission To Leave Is Given By The Guardian, And That Permission Is Not Needed To Attend The Funeral
arabicText: ،هعابتبا طاريق :طيرارق عبرأ (رجلاا نم) هل الله بتك ةزانج عبت نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا .ةيزعتلل طاريقو ،اهنفد نم غرفي ىتح راظتنلابا طاريقو ،اهيلع ةلاصلل طاريقو
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Whoever follows a funeral procession, Allah writes for him (as reward) four qirats (*): a qirat for following it, a qirat for praying over it, a qirat for waiting until its burial is completed, and a qirat for offering condolences. Translator: * An unit of measure for weight related to the English word "carat". Used metaphorically here to quantify divine reward.

chapter: Recommendation Of Not Returning From A Funeral Until The Prayer Is Performed, The Burial Is Complete, And Condolences Are Offered To The Family, Even If Permission To Leave Is Given By The Guardian, And That Permission Is Not Needed To Attend The Funeral
arabicText: نيعبس هب ىلاعت الله لكو هربق يف نفدي ىتح نمؤم ةزانج عيش نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .فقوملا ىلإ هربق نم جرخ اذإ هل نورفغتسيو هنوعيشي نيعيشملا نم اكلم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever accompanies a believer's funeral until burial in the grave, Allah the Almighty assigns seventy angels from among the escorts to accompany him and seek forgiveness for him when he emerges from his grave to the standing place.

chapter: Recommendation Of Not Returning From A Funeral Until The Prayer Is Performed, The Burial Is Complete, And Condolences Are Offered To The Family, Even If Permission To Leave Is Given By The Guardian, And That Permission Is Not Needed To Attend The Funeral
arabicText: عجر مث اهيلع لىصي ىتح ةزانج عم ىشم نم :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تعمس :لقا ،ريصب يبأ نع .دحأ لبج لثم طاريقلاو ،ناطاريق هل ناك نفدت ىتح اهعم ىشم اذفإ ،(رجلاا نم) طاريق هل ناك
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: Whoever walks with a funeral procession until the prayer is performed and then returns will have one qirat (of reward), and if he walks with it until burial, he will have two qirats, and a qirat is like Mount Uhud.

chapter: Recommendation Of Not Returning From A Funeral Until The Prayer Is Performed, The Burial Is Complete, And Condolences Are Offered To The Family, Even If Permission To Leave Is Given By The Guardian, And That Permission Is Not Needed To Attend The Funeral
arabicText: ىلإ هعم غلب نمو ،رجلاا نم طاريق هل ناك هيلع لىصي ىتح اتيم عيش نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .دحأ لبج لثم طاريقلاو ،رجلاا نم ناطاريق هل ناك نفدي ىتح هربق
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever accompanies a deceased until the prayer is performed will have one qirat of reward, and whoever continues with him to his grave until burial will have two qirats of reward, and the qirat is like Mount Uhud.

chapter: Recommendation Of Not Returning From A Funeral Until The Prayer Is Performed, The Burial Is Complete, And Condolences Are Offered To The Family, Even If Permission To Leave Is Given By The Guardian, And That Permission Is Not Needed To Attend The Funeral
arabicText: هيلو لقا تيملا لىع لىص نأ املف ،هتبارق ضعبل ةزانج يف (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ عم تنك :لقا ةرارز نع ،يشملا نع فعضت كنلأ ،ينعت لاو ،اروجأم رفعج باأ يا عجرا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ وبأ يل لاقف ،اهنع كلأسأ نأ ديرأ ةجاح يلو ،عجرفا عوجرلا يف كل نذأ دق :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ ناأ تلقف سيلف هنذإب امفأ ،اهعبتي يذلا رجوي ةزانجلا عم يشمي ام ردقبف ،رجأو لضف وه امنإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج .عجرن هنذإب لاو ،انئج هنذإب
englishText: From Zurarah who said: I was with Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) at the funeral of one of his relatives. When he finished praying over the deceased, its guardian said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): "Return, O Abu Ja'far, with reward, and don't trouble yourself as you are weak in walking." So I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): "He has given you permission to return, and I have a question I want to ask you." Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said to me: "This is about virtue and reward, and one is rewarded according to how far they walk with the funeral procession. As for his permission, we neither came by his permission nor will we return by it."

chapter: Recommendation Of Not Returning From A Funeral Until The Prayer Is Performed, The Burial Is Complete, And Condolences Are Offered To The Family, Even If Permission To Leave Is Given By The Guardian, And That Permission Is Not Needed To Attend The Funeral
arabicText: نمل سيل :نيريمبأ اسيلو ناريمأ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهكسن يضقت ىتح رفني نأ هل سيلف ةأرما عم جحي لجرو ،هل نذؤي وأ نفدي ىتح عجري نأ ةزانج عبت
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Two leaders who are not really leaders: one who follows a funeral has no right to return until burial or permission is given, and a man who performs Hajj with a woman has no right to depart until she completes her rites.

chapter: Recommendation Of Not Returning From A Funeral Until The Prayer Is Performed, The Burial Is Complete, And Condolences Are Offered To The Family, Even If Permission To Leave Is Given By The Guardian, And That Permission Is Not Needed To Attend The Funeral
arabicText: لىع لىص املف - :لقا نأ ىلإ - هعم ناأو شيرق نم لجر ةزانج (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ رضح :لقا ةرارز نع ،يشملا لىع ىوقت لا كنفإ ،الله كمحر اروجأم عجرا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ اهيلو لقا ةزانجلا هنذإب سيلف ضما :لاقف ،اهنع كلأسأ نأ ديرأ ةجاح يلو ،عوجرلا يف كل نذأ دق :هل تلقف :لقا ،عجري نأ ىبفأ .كلذ لىع رجوي لجرلا ةزانجلا عبتي ام ردقبف هانبلط رجأو لضف وه امنإ ،عجرن هنذإب لاو ،انئج
englishText: From Zurarah who said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) attended the funeral of a From Zurarah who said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) attended the funeral of a Qurayshi man and I was with him- until he said- when he finished praying over the funeral, its guardian said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): "Return with reward, may Allah have mercy on you, for you are not strong enough to walk." He refused to return. I said to him: "He has given you permission to return, and I have a question I want to ask you." He said: "Continue on, for we neither came by his permission nor will we return by it. This is about virtue and reward that we seek, and one is rewarded according to how far they follow the funeral procession."

chapter: Recommendation Of Not Returning From A Funeral Until The Prayer Is Performed, The Burial Is Complete, And Condolences Are Offered To The Family, Even If Permission To Leave Is Given By The Guardian, And That Permission Is Not Needed To Attend The Funeral
arabicText: لىص تيم لىع لىص نم :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نأ - يهانملا ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ناك بارتلا هيلع ىثحيو نفدي ىتح مقا نفإ ،رختأ امو هبنذ نم مدقت ام هل الله رفغو ،كلم فلأ نوعبس هيلع .دحأ لبج لثم طاريقلاو ،رجلاا نم طاريق اهلقن مدق لكب هل
englishText: From his forefathers (peace be upon them)- in the hadith of prohibitions- that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever prays the funeral prayer over a deceased person, seventy thousand angels pray for him, and Allah forgives his past and future sins. And if he stays until the deceased is buried and soil is thrown over him, then for each step he takes, he will get a qirat of reward, and a qirat is like Mount Uhud.

chapter: Recommendation Of Walking Behind The Funeral Procession, Or Along One Of Its Sides
arabicText: .اهيدي نيب يشملا نم لضفأ ةزانجلا فلخ يشملا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Walking behind the funeral procession is better than walking in front of it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Walking Behind The Funeral Procession, Or Along One Of Its Sides
arabicText: كلام الله لوسر يا ليقف ،ةزانج فلخ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ىشم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .مهل عبت نحنو اهمامأ نوشمي (١) مهتيأر ةكئلاملا نإ :لاقف ؟اهفلخ يشمت
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) walked behind a funeral procession, and he was asked, "O Messenger of Allah, why do you walk behind it?" He said: "Indeed, I saw the angels walking in front of it, and we follow them."

chapter: Recommendation Of Walking Behind The Funeral Procession, Or Along One Of Its Sides
arabicText: هاورو .ريرسلا يبنج شميلف نيبتاكلا ماركلا ىشمم يشمي نأ بحأ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .اهيدي نيب يشمي نبأ سبأ لاو :داز هنأ لاإ هدانسبا خيشلا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever wishes to walk the path of the honorable scribes (angels), let him walk beside the bier. And the Shaykh narrated it with his chain of narrators, except that he added: And there is no harm in walking in front of it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Walking Behind The Funeral Procession, Or Along One Of Its Sides
arabicText: اوعبتا :لوقي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا تعمس :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) ليع نع ،هئباآ نع ،هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع .باتكلا لهأ اوفلاخ ،مكعبتت لاو ةزانجلا
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them) who said: I heard the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) saying: Follow the funeral procession and let it not follow you; differ from the People of the Book.

chapter: Permissibility Of Walking In Front Of The Funeral Procession Despite Being Disliked When There Is No Taqiyya, And It Is Emphasized For The Funeral Of An Opponent
arabicText: اهلامش نعو اهنيمي نعو اهيدي نيب :لاقف ،ةزانجلا عم يشملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع .اهفلخو
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them both) who said: I asked him about walking with the funeral procession, he said: In front of it, on its right, on its left, and behind it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Walking In Front Of The Funeral Procession Despite Being Disliked When There Is No Taqiyya, And It Is Emphasized For The Funeral Of An Opponent
arabicText: .اهفلخو ةزانجلا يدي نيب شما :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Walk in front of the funeral procession and behind it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Walking In Front Of The Funeral Procession Despite Being Disliked When There Is No Taqiyya, And It Is Emphasized For The Funeral Of An Opponent
arabicText: نع وأ اهفلخ وأ اهمامأ يشمأ ةزانجلا عم تجرخ اذإ عنصأ فيك لئس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .باذعلا ناولبأ هنولبقتسي باذعلا ةكئلام نفإ ،همامأ شمت لاف افلاخم ناك نإ :لاقف ؟اهلامش نع وأ اهنيمي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: He was asked how should I act when I go out with a funeral procession, should I walk in front of it, behind it, on its right, or on its left? He said: If it is an opponent, do not walk in front of it, for the angels of punishment meet him with various forms of punishment.

chapter: Permissibility Of Walking In Front Of The Funeral Procession Despite Being Disliked When There Is No Taqiyya, And It Is Emphasized For The Funeral Of An Opponent
arabicText: مامأ نفإ ،دحاجلا ةزانج مامأ شمت لاو ،فراعلا ملسملا ةزانج مامأ شما :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رانلا ىلإ هب نوعرسي ةكئلام رفاكلا ةزانج مامأ نإو ةنجلا ىلإ هب نوعرسي ةكئلام ملسملا ةزانج
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Walk in front of the knowledgeable Muslim's funeral procession, but do not walk in front of the denier's funeral procession, for angels rush ahead of the Muslim's funeral procession to Paradise, while angels rush ahead of the disbeliever's funeral procession to Hell. Translator: To walk in front of the funeral of a believer is recommended not obligatory. So one Translator: To walk in front of the funeral of a believer is recommended not obligatory. So one can walk behind it too. See Hadith 3254 and 3255.

chapter: Permissibility Of Walking In Front Of The Funeral Procession Despite Being Disliked When There Is No Taqiyya, And It Is Emphasized For The Funeral Of An Opponent
arabicText: اهفلخ وأ اهمامأ يشمأ ؟ةزانجلا عم تجرخ اذإ عنصأ فيك (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ريصب يبأ نع عاونبأ هنولبقتسي باذعلا ةكئلام نفإ ،همامأ شمت لاف افلاخم ناك نإ :لاقف ؟اهلامش نع وأ اهنيمي نع وأ .باذعلا
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) what should I do when I go out with a funeral procession? Should I walk in front of it, behind it, on its right, or on its left? He said: If it is an opponent, do not walk in front of it, for the angels of punishment meet him with types of punishment.

chapter: Permissibility Of Walking In Front Of The Funeral Procession Despite Being Disliked When There Is No Taqiyya, And It Is Emphasized For The Funeral Of An Opponent
arabicText: .سوجملا لمع نم هنفإ مكعبتت لاو ةزانجلا اوعبتا :يور :لقا (عنقملا) يف نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn in (Al-Muqni') said: It is narrated: Follow the funeral procession and do not let it follow you, for that is from the practices of the Magians. Translator: Except if it is the funeral of a believer. See Hadith 3256, 3257, 3258 and 3260.

chapter: Permissibility Of Walking In Front Of The Funeral Procession Despite Being Disliked When There Is No Taqiyya, And It Is Emphasized For The Funeral Of An Opponent
arabicText: مامأ مدقتي لا رفاكلاو ،هلبقتست ةمحرلا نفإ ،هتزانج مادق يشمي نأ سبأ لاف انمؤم تيملا ناك اذإ :يورو :لقا .هلبقتست ةنعللا نفإ ،هتزانج
englishText: And it is narrated (*): If the deceased is a believer, there is no harm in walking in front of his funeral procession, for mercy meets him, and the disbeliever should not be preceded in front of his funeral procession, for curse meets him. Translator: * Through the same narrator as the previous hadith 3259.

chapter: Permissibility Of Walking In Front Of The Funeral Procession Despite Being Disliked When There Is No Taqiyya, And It Is Emphasized For The Funeral Of An Opponent
arabicText: ذخ ،اهلبقتست لاف كرشم ةزانج تيقل اذإ ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع .اهلامش نعو اهنيمي نع
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: When you encounter the funeral procession of a polytheist, do not face it, take [your path] from its right and its left.

chapter: Recommendation Of Walking With The Funeral Procession, The Dislike Of Riding Except With An Excuse, And Its Permissibility When Returning
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر باحصأ نم راصنلأا نم لجر تام :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع لوسر يا بكرت لاأ :هباحصأ ضعب هل لاقف يشمي هتزانج يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر جرخف (هلآو .نوشمي ةكئلاملاو بكرأ نأ هركلأ ينإ :لاقف ؟الله
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A man from the Ansar, from the companions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) died, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) went out walking in his funeral procession. Some of his companions said to him: "Won't you ride, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "I dislike to ride while the angels are walking."

chapter: Recommendation Of Walking With The Funeral Procession, The Dislike Of Riding Except With An Excuse, And Its Permissibility When Returning
arabicText: ،رذع نم لاإ هتأدب يف ةزانجلا عم لجرلا بكري نأ هرك هنأ (ملاسلا مهيلع) ليع نع ،هيبأ نع ،الله دبع يبأ نع .عجر اذإ بكري :لقاو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Ali (peace be upon them) that he disliked that a person ride alongside a funeral procession at its beginning except with a valid excuse, and he said: He may ride when returning.

chapter: Recommendation Of Walking With The Funeral Procession, The Dislike Of Riding Except With An Excuse, And Its Permissibility When Returning
arabicText: ام :لاقف ناابكر ةزانج فلخ اموق (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىأر :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع !؟لاحلا هذه لىع هوملسأ دقو ناابكر مهبحاص اوعبتي نأ ءلاؤه ىيحتسا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) saw some people riding behind a funeral procession, so he said: Are these people not ashamed to follow their companion while riding when they have surrendered him in this state?!

chapter: Recommendation Of Carrying The Funeral Bier Personally And From All Four Sides
arabicText: .ةريبك نيعبرأ هل الله رفغ اهبناوج عبرأ نم ةزانج لمح نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: Whoever carries a funeral bier from its four sides, Allah forgives him forty major sins.

chapter: Recommendation Of Carrying The Funeral Bier Personally And From All Four Sides
arabicText: وهف لمح نم كلذ دعب ناك امو ،عبرلأا هبناوج نم ريرسلا لمحي نأ ةنسلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .عوطت
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: It is the Sunnah to carry the bier from its four sides, and whatever carrying is done after that is voluntary.

chapter: Recommendation Of Carrying The Funeral Bier Personally And From All Four Sides
arabicText: نيعبرأ هل الله رفغ ةعبرلأا ريرسلا بناوجب ذخأ نم :لوقي هتعمس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةريبك
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I heard him saying: Whoever takes hold of the four sides of the bier, Allah forgives him forty major sins.

chapter: Recommendation Of Carrying The Funeral Bier Personally And From All Four Sides
arabicText: جرخ عبر اذإو ،ةريبك نيرشعو اسمخ هل الله رفغ ريرسلا ةمئاقب ذخأ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .بونذلا نم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Whoever takes hold of one leg of the bier, Allah forgives him twenty-five major sins, and when he carries from all four sides, he emerges free from sins.

chapter: Recommendation Of Carrying The Funeral Bier Personally And From All Four Sides
arabicText: هتوم دنع رشبي نمؤملا نأ ثيدح يف - (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .كربق ىلإ كلمحي نملو كل رفغ دق الله نإ :
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said- in a hadith about the believer being given glad tidings at death-: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said- in a hadith about the believer being given glad tidings at death-: Indeed Allah has forgiven you and those who carry you to your grave.

chapter: Recommendation Of Carrying The Funeral Bier Personally And From All Four Sides
arabicText: ةريبك نيعبرأ هنع الله احم ةعبرلأا ريرسلا بناوجب تيملا هاخأ لمح نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقاو :لقا .عوطت وهف كلذ دعب ناك امو ،ةعبرلأا هبناوج نم ريرسلا لمحي نأ ةنسلاو ،ريابكلا نم
englishText: He said: And Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Whoever carries his deceased brother by the four sides of the bier, Allah erases from him forty major sins from the major sins, and it is the Sunnah to carry the bier from its four sides, and whatever is done after that is voluntary.

chapter: Recommendation Of Carrying The Funeral Bier Personally And From All Four Sides
arabicText: تيملا ريرس ريرسلا بناوج تلمح اذإ :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع ،رامع نب قاحسإ نع هدانسإبو .كمأ كتدلو امك بونذلا نم تجرخ
englishText: And by his chain from Ishaq bin Ammar, from Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) that he said: When you carry the sides of the bier, the deceased's bier, you emerge from sins as the day your mother gave birth to you.

chapter: Recommendation Of Carrying The Funeral Bier Personally And From All Four Sides
arabicText: جرخ عبر اذفإ ،ةريبك نيرشعو اسمخ هل الله رفغ ريرسلا ةمئاقب ذخأ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .بونذلا نم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever takes hold of the leg of a funeral bier, Allah will forgive him twenty-five major sins, and when he helps carry it from all four sides, he will exit from sins.

chapter: Recommended Manner Of Carrying The Bier From All Four Sides
arabicText: هلأ ،لمحي تيملا ريرس نع هلأسي :(ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا يبأ ىلإ بتك هنأ ديعس نب نيسحلا نع نم :بتكف ؟ءاش بناوجلا يأ نم لمحي لجرلا لىع فخ ام وأ ،ةعبرلأا هبناوج نم لمحلا يف هب أدبي بناج .ءاش اهيأ
englishText: From Al-Husain bin Sa'id that he wrote to Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) asking him about carrying the bed of the deceased, is there a specific side to begin with when carrying from its four sides, or can one carry from whichever side is easier? He wrote: From whichever side one wishes.

chapter: Recommended Manner Of Carrying The Bier From All Four Sides
arabicText: مث ،كراسي ليي امم وهو ،نميلأا اهبناج نم ةزانجلا لبقتست نأ ةنسلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .همدقم ىلإ عجرت ىتح هيلع رودتو هرخؤم ىلإ ريصت
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The Sunnah is to face the funeral from its right side, which is on your left, then go to its rear and go around it until you return to its front.

chapter: Recommended Manner Of Carrying The Bier From All Four Sides
arabicText: مث ،ىنميلا ديلبا أدبفا ةيقت عضوم يف تنك اذإ :لقا ؟ةزانجلا عيبرت نع (ملاسلا هيلع) ميهاربإ باأ تلأس ذخأتف ةزانجلا لبقتست ىتح ةتبلا هيلجر فلخ رمت لا تيملا نمايم ىلإ كناكم نم عجرا مث ،ىنميلا لجرلبا امك لعفت اهلبقتست ىتح ةتبلا ةزانجلا فلخ رمت لا كناكم نم عجرا مث ،ىرسيلا هلجر مث ،ىرسيلا هدي لجرلبا مث ،ىنميلا ديلبا أدبت نأ ةنسلا هب ترج يذلا ةزانجلا عيبرت نفإ هيف يقتت نكت مل نفإ ،لاوأ تلعف .اهلوح رودت ىتح ىرسيلا ديلبا مث ،ىرسيلا لجرلبا مث ،ىنميلا
englishText: I asked Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) about the fourfold carrying of the funeral bier? He replied: If you are in a place where taqiyyah is necessary, start with the right hand, then the right foot, then return from your position to the right side of the deceased without ever passing behind his feet until you face the bier to take his left hand, then his left foot, then return from your position without ever passing behind the bier until you face it doing as you did the first time. However, if you do not need to practice taqiyyah, then the traditional fourfold carrying of the bier according to the Sunnah is to begin with the right hand, then the right foot, then the left foot, then the I asked Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) about the fourfold carrying of the funeral bier? He replied: If you are in a place where taqiyyah is necessary, start with the right hand, then the right foot, then return from your position to the right side of the deceased without ever passing behind his feet until you face the bier to take his left hand, then his left foot, then return from your position without ever passing behind the bier until you face it doing as you did the first time. However, if you do not need to practice taqiyyah, then the traditional fourfold carrying of the bier according to the Sunnah is to begin with the right hand, then the right foot, then the left foot, then the left hand until you circle around it.

chapter: Recommended Manner Of Carrying The Bier From All Four Sides
arabicText: ريرسلا بناج لبقتست نأ ةزانجلا لمح يف ةنسلا :لوقي هتعمس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم نسحلا يبأ نع ثلاثلا بناجلا ىلإ هفلخ نم رودتو رخلآا بناجلا ىلإ هيلع رمت مث ،نميلأا كفكب رسيلأا مزلتف نميلأا كقشب .كراسي ليي امم عبارلا بناجلا ىلإ هيلع رمت مث ،ريرسلا نم
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) who said: I heard him saying: The Sunnah in carrying the funeral bier is to face the side of the bier with your right side and hold the left side with your right palm, then move to the other side and go around from behind it to the third side of the bier, then move to the fourth side which is next to your left.

chapter: Recommended Manner Of Carrying The Bier From All Four Sides
arabicText: ىلإ هفلخ نم هيلع رمت مث ،نميلأا بناجلا نم ريرسلا لمح يف أدبت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هيلع حىرلا نارود كلذك مدقملا ىلإ عجرت ىتح هيلع رمت مث .رخلآا بناجلا كناكم نم عجرا مث :لضفلا ثيدح يف لقا هنأ لاإ ميهاربإ نب ليع نع هدانسإب ةثلاثلا ثيداحلأا خيشلا ىورو .هيلجر فلخ رمت لا تيملا نمايم ىلإ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Begin carrying the funeral bier from the right side, then pass behind it to the other side. Then continue passing by it until you return to the front, similar to the rotation of a millstone around it. Al-Shaykh reported the three hadiths with his chain of narration from Ali bin Ibrahim, except that in the hadith of Al-Fadhl he said: Then return from your place to the right sides of the deceased, never passing behind his feet.

chapter: Recommendation Of Supplicating With Traditional Prayers Upon Seeing And Carrying A Funeral Procession
arabicText: مل يذلا لله دمحلا :لقا تلبقأ دق ةزانج ىأر اذإ (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا نب ليع ناك :لقا ةزمح يبأ نع .مرتخملا داوسلا نم ينلعجي
englishText: From Abu Hamza who said: When Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) would see a funeral procession approaching, he would say: Praise be to Allah who did not make me among the masses being taken away by death.

chapter: Recommendation Of Supplicating With Traditional Prayers Upon Seeing And Carrying A Funeral Procession
arabicText: " :لاقف اهآر وأ ةزانج لبقتسا نم :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ززعت يذلا لله دمحلا ،اميلستو نااميا نادز مهللا ،هلوسرو الله قدصو هلوسرو الله نادعو ام اذه ربكأ الله .هتوصل ةمحر كىب لاإ كلم ءامسلا يف قبي مل " توملبا دابعلا رهقو ةردقلبا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever encounters a funeral procession or sees it and says: "Allah is the Greatest, this is what Allah and His Messenger promised us and Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth, O Allah increase us in faith and submission, praise be to Allah who has empowered Himself with ability and overpowered the servants with death"- there would not remain an angel in the heaven except that it would weep out of mercy for his voice.

chapter: Recommendation Of Supplicating With Traditional Prayers Upon Seeing And Carrying A Funeral Procession
arabicText: ينلعجي مل يذلا لله دمحلا :لقا ةزانج ىأر اذإ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ ناك :لقا هعفر يدهنلا نسحلا يبأ نع .مرتخملا داوسلا نم
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Al-Nahdi, raising it, he said: When Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) would see a funeral, he would say: Praise be to Allah who did not make me among the masses taken by death.

chapter: Recommendation Of Supplicating With Traditional Prayers Upon Seeing And Carrying A Funeral Procession
arabicText: مسب :لوقي :لقا ؟اهلمحي يذلا لوقي فيك تلمح اذإ ةزانجلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .تانمؤملاو نينمؤملل رفغأ مهللا ،دمحم لآو دمحم لىع الله لىصو للهباو الله
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I asked him about what one should say when carrying a funeral procession. He said: One should say: "In the name of Allah and by Allah, and may Allah's blessings be upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. O Allah, forgive the believing men and believing women."

chapter: Dislike Of Following The Funeral With Fire And Incense Burner Except If It's At Night Then There's No Problem With Using A Lamp, And The Permissibility Of Burial At Night And Day
arabicText: .ةنخدلا ينعي ،رانلا مكتاوم اوبرقت لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Do not bring fire near your dead, meaning smoke.

chapter: Dislike Of Following The Funeral With Fire And Incense Burner Except If It's At Night Then There's No Problem With Using A Lamp, And The Permissibility Of Burial At Night And Day
arabicText: تيملا عبتي نأ هركي ناك هنأ - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةرمجملبا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) from his father (peace be upon them both) in a hadith - that he disliked following the deceased with an incense burner.

chapter: Dislike Of Following The Funeral With Fire And Incense Burner Except If It's At Night Then There's No Problem With Using A Lamp, And The Permissibility Of Burial At Night And Day
arabicText: .ةرمجمب عبتي نأ هركأو - :لقا نأ ىلإ - تيملا طنحت نأ تدرأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When you want to embalm the deceased - until he said: - and I dislike following it with an incense burner.

chapter: Dislike Of Following The Funeral With Fire And Incense Burner Except If It's At Night Then There's No Problem With Using A Lamp, And The Permissibility Of Burial At Night And Day
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ةنبا نإ :لاقف ؟رانلبا اهعم جرخي ةزانجلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لئس .حيباصم اهعمو لايل تجرخأ (هلآو
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) was asked about taking fire with the funeral? He said: The daughter of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was taken out at night with lamps.

chapter: Dislike Of Following The Funeral With Fire And Incense Burner Except If It's At Night Then There's No Problem With Using A Lamp, And The Permissibility Of Burial At Night And Day
arabicText: اهنلأ :لقا ؟راهنلبا نفدت ملو ليللبا (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا تنفد ةلع يلأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .لاجر اهيلع ليصي لا نأ تصوأ
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): For what reason was Fatima (peace be upon her) buried at night and not during the day? He said: Because she instructed that men should not pray over her.

chapter: Dislike Of Following The Funeral With Fire And Incense Burner Except If It's At Night Then There's No Problem With Using A Lamp, And The Permissibility Of Burial At Night And Day
arabicText: رانب ةزانجلا تعيش) له ،الله كمحري :هل لاقف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لجر ىتأ :لقا الله دبع نب ديازو ؟هب ءاضي امم كلذ ريغ وأ ،ليدنق وأ (ةرمجمبو ،اهعم ىشمت فوج يف مهو اهبحن تضق املف - :لقا نأ ىلإ - اهتفاوو (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا ضرم هيف لايوط اثيدح ركذف رانلبا ةزانجلا عم ىشمو ،لخنلا ديرج يف رانلا لعشأو ،هتعاس نم اهزاهج يف (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع ذخأ ليللا .لايل اهنفدو اهيلع لىص ىتح
englishText: And Ziyad bin Abdullah said: A man came to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) and said to him: May Allah have mercy on you, was (the funeral accompanied by fire walking with it, and with an incense burner) or a lamp, or anything else that gives light? Then he mentioned a long hadith about Fatima's illness (peace be upon her) and her death- until he said:- When she passed away in the middle of the night, Ali (peace be upon him) immediately began preparing her, and lit fire in palm branches, and walked with the funeral with fire until he prayed over her and buried her at night.

chapter: Recommendation Of Personally Digging A Grave
arabicText: .ةمايقلا موي ىلإ اقفاوم اتيب هاوب نمك ناك اربق تيمل رفح نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever digs a grave for a deceased person is like one who has provided him with a suitable dwelling until the Day of Resurrection.

chapter: Recommendation Of Personally Digging A Grave
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نع ضيرملا ةدايع يف مدقت دانسإب (لامعلأا باقع) يف نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم نم هيف اضوح هدروأو ،ةنجلا نم اتيب هأوبو رانلا لىع الله همرح ابستحم اربق ملسمل رفتحا نم :لقا (هلآو .ءاعنصو ةليأ نيب ام هضرع (ءامسلا موجن) ددع قيربالأا
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn in (Iqab Al-A'mal) with a chain of narrators previously mentioned in visiting the sick, from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) who said: Whoever digs a grave for a Muslim seeking reward, Allah will forbid him from the Fire and provide him with a house in Paradise, and will bring him to a fountain containing pitchers equal to (the number of stars in the sky), its width being what is between Ayla and Sana'a (*). Translator: * Ayla is a city located in present-day Israel, at the northern tip of the Gulf of Aqaba, on the Red Sea. Sana'a is the capital city of Yemen, located in the southwestern part of the Arabian Peninsula.

chapter: Recommendation Of Offering Owned Land For Burying The Believer
arabicText: ةفوكلا ىلإ ةريحلا ىلإ قنروخلا نيب ام اضرأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ ىرتشا :لقا ةمقلع نب ةبقع نع :لقا ،هئارش لىع دهشأو ،مهرد فلأ نيعبربأ نيقاهدلا نم ةفوكلا ىلإ ةريحلا ىلإ فجنلا نيب ام :رخآ ربخ يفو الله لىص) الله لوسر تعمس :لاقف ؟اطخ تبني سيلو لاملا اذهب اذه يرتشت نينمؤملا ريمأ يا :هل تلقف ،باسح ريغب ةنجلا نولخدي افلأ نوعبس اهرهظ نم رشحي ،اهرخآ لىع اهلوأ دري نفاوك نفاوك :لوقي (هلآو هيلع .كيلم نم اورشحي نأ تيهتشفا
englishText: From Uqbah bin Alqamah who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) bought land between Al-Khawarnaq to Al-Hirah to Kufa, and in another narration: between Al-Najaf to Al-Hirah to Kufa from the Dehqans (Persian landowners) for forty thousand dirhams, and had witnesses for its purchase. He said: I said to him: Amir al Mu'minin, you buy this for this money while it doesn't even grow grass? He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) say: Kufan Kufan, its beginning returns to its end, seventy thousand shall be gathered (resurrected) from its back who will enter Paradise without reckoning, so I desired that they be gathered (resurrected) from my property.

chapter: Recommendation Of Burial In The Haram And The Ruling On Transferring The Deceased There And To Noble Shrines For Burial, And Visiting With The Deceased
arabicText: ،ربكلأا عزف نم نمأ مرحلا يف نفد نم :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا ةجراخ نب نوراه نع .مهرجفاو سانلا رب نم :لقا ؟هرجفاو سانلا رب نم :هل تلقف
englishText: From Haroon bin Kharijah who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: Whoever is buried in the Haram (Sacred Sanctuary) will be safe from the greatest terror. I said to him: Both the righteous and sinful people? He said: Both the righteous and sinful among them.

chapter: Recommendation Of Burial In The Haram And The Ruling On Transferring The Deceased There And To Noble Shrines For Burial, And Visiting With The Deceased
arabicText: :لقا نأ ىلإ - رصم نم فسوي ماظع جرخأ نأ :نارمع نب ىسوم ىلإ حىوأ الله نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا لمحت كلذلف ،ماشلا ىلإ هلمحف رمقلا علط هجرخأ املف ،رمرم قودنص يف لينلا ئطاش نم هجرختسفا .ماشلا ىلإ مهتاوم باتكلا لهأ
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Allah revealed to Moses son of Imran to remove Joseph's bones from Egypt- until he said- so he retrieved him from the bank of the Nile in a marble casket, and when he took him out the moon rose, then he carried him to Al-Sham, and that is why the People of the Book carry their dead to Al-Sham.

chapter: Recommendation Of Burial In The Haram And The Ruling On Transferring The Deceased There And To Noble Shrines For Burial, And Visiting With The Deceased
arabicText: ام لضف هيف ناك دهاشملا ىلإ لقن نفإ ،دلب ىلإ دلب نم تيملا لقني لا :لقا (حابصملا) يف نسحلا نب دمحم .لضفأ لولأاو ،ةياور دهاشملا ضعب ىلإ هلقن زاوجب تيور دقو ،نفدي مل
englishText: Muhammad bin Al-Hasan said in (Al-Misbah): The deceased should not be transferred from one country to another, but if transferred to the shrines (*) there is virtue in it as long as not buried, and there is a narration permitting transfer to some shrines, though the first option is better. Translator: (*) Tomb sites of the Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them).

chapter: Recommendation Of Burial In The Haram And The Ruling On Transferring The Deceased There And To Noble Shrines For Burial, And Visiting With The Deceased
arabicText: ضعب ىلإ هلقن زاوجب ةياور تدرو دقو ،هعضوم نم هليوحت زوجي لاف عضوم يف نفد اذفإ :(ةياهنلا) يف لقاو .هانمدق ام لصلأاو ،ةركاذم اهانعمس ،(ملاسلا مهيلع) ةمئلأا دهاشم
englishText: And he said in (Al-Nihaya): When buried in a place, it is not permissible to move from its place, though there is a narration permitting transfer to some shrines of the Imams (peace be upon them) that we heard in discussion, but the principle is what we presented first.

chapter: Recommendation Of Burial In The Haram And The Ruling On Transferring The Deceased There And To Noble Shrines For Burial, And Visiting With The Deceased
arabicText: تيملا لقن يف ةصخر لىع لدي ثيدح ءاج دقو :ةيزعلا لئاسملا يف ديفملا لقا :(ىركذلا) يف ديهشلا لقاو .كلذب تيملا ىصوأ نإ (ملاسلا هيلع) لوسرلا لآ دهاشم ضعب ىلإ
englishText: Al-Shaheed said in (Al-Thikra): Al-Mufid said in Al-Masa'il Al-Izziya: There is a hadith indicating permission to transfer the deceased to some shrines of the Prophet's family (peace be upon them) if the deceased had willed it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Burial In The Haram And The Ruling On Transferring The Deceased There And To Noble Shrines For Burial, And Visiting With The Deceased
arabicText: هيلع) ليع نب نسحلا رضح امل :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تعمس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع ينهجو مث ،ينئيهف تم ناأ اذإ :اهظفحفا ةيصوب كيصوأ ينإ خيأ يا :(ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلل لقا ةفاولا (ملاسلا هنأ ملعاو ،عيقبلبا ينفدفا يندر مث ،يمأ ىلإ ينفرصا مث ،ادهع هب ثدحلا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىلإ .اهعينص سانلاو الله ملعي ام ةشئاع نم ينبيصيس
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim who said: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: When death approached Al-Hasan bin Ali (peace be upon him), he said to Al Husayn (peace be upon him): O my brother, I make a will to you so preserve it: When I die prepare me, then take me to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) to renew my covenant with him, then take me to my mother, then return me and bury me in Al-Baqi', and know that I will face from Aisha (*) what Allah and people know of her doing. Translator: * Refers to Imam Hasan's prediction that Aisha, one of the wives of Prophet Muhammad, would do something to afflict him after his death. This statement alludes to the complex political and personal dynamics that existed between Aisha and the Ahl al-Bayt (the family of Prophet Muhammad) after the Prophet's death. Historically, there were tensions and conflicts between Aisha and Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) and his family, particularly in relation to the issue of succession and leadership within the Muslim community. The exact nature of the affliction mentioned in the hadith is not specified, but it suggests that Imam Hasan anticipated some form of opposition, disagreement, or mistreatment from Aisha towards him after his death.

chapter: Recommendation Of Burial In The Haram And The Ruling On Transferring The Deceased There And To Noble Shrines For Burial, And Visiting With The Deceased
arabicText: ماظع لمحأ نأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم ىلإ الله حىوأ :لقا - ليوط ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ماشلبا ةسدقملا ضرلأا ىلإ - اهنم جرخت نأ لبق - رصم نم فسوي
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)- in a long hadith- said: Allah revealed to Moses (peace be upon him): Carry Joseph's bones from Egypt- before you leave it- to the holy land in Al-Sham.

chapter: Recommendation Of Burial In The Haram And The Ruling On Transferring The Deceased There And To Noble Shrines For Burial, And Visiting With The Deceased
arabicText: هيلع) ليع نب نسحلا رضتحا امل :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تعمس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع ىلإ ينهجو مث ،ينئيهف تم ناأ اذفإ :اهظفحفا ةيصوب كيصوأ ينإ خيأ يا :(ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلل لقا (ملاسلا ينفدفا يندر مث ،(ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا يمأ ىلإ ينفرصا مث ،ادهع هب ثدحلا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر .اهعينص نم سانلا ملعي ام ءاريمحلا نم ينبيصيس هنأ ملعاو ،عيقبلبا
englishText: From Muhammad ibn Muslim who said: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: When Al-Hasan ibn Ali (peace be upon him) was on his deathbed, he said to Al-Husayn (peace be upon him): O my brother, I give you a will so preserve it: When I die, prepare me, then direct me to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) to renew my covenant with him, then take me to my mother Fatima (peace be upon her), then return me and bury me in Al-Baqi', and know that I will face from Al-Humaira (* Aisha) what people know of her doings. Translator: * Refer to comment on Hadith 3296.

chapter: Recommendation Of Burial In The Haram And The Ruling On Transferring The Deceased There And To Noble Shrines For Burial, And Visiting With The Deceased
arabicText: ىلإ توبتا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) فسوي هلمح بوقعي تام امل :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .سدقملا تيب يف هنفدف ماشلا ضرأ
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: When Jacob died, Joseph (peace be upon him) carried him in a coffin to the land of Sham and buried him in Bayt al-Maqdis (Jerusalem).

chapter: Recommendation Of Burial In The Haram And The Ruling On Transferring The Deceased There And To Noble Shrines For Burial, And Visiting With The Deceased
arabicText: ينإ خيأ يا :هل لاقف ليع نب نيسحلا ىعدتسا ةفاولا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا ترضح امل :لقا يقراخملا دياز نع ىلإ يريرس لىع ينلمحاو ينفكو ينلسغو ينضمغف يبحن تيضق اذفإ - :لقا نأ ىلإ - يبرب قحلاو كقرافم ينفدفا (دسأ تنب) ةمطفا يتدج ربق ىلإ يندر مث ،ادهع هب ددجلا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر يدج ربق .كانه
englishText: From Ziyad Al-Makhariqi who said: When death approached Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), he called for Al-Husayn ibn Ali and said to him: O my brother, I am parting from you and joining my Lord- until he said:- When I pass away, close my From Ziyad Al-Makhariqi who said: When death approached Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), he called for Al-Husayn ibn Ali and said to him: O my brother, I am parting from you and joining my Lord- until he said:- When I pass away, close my eyes, wash me, shroud me and carry me on my bier to the grave of my grandfather, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) to renew my covenant with him, then return me to the grave of my grandmother Fatima (daughter of Asad) and bury me there.

chapter: Limit Of Digging The Grave And Niche
arabicText: .عرذأ ةثلاث قوف ربقلا قمعي نأ ىهن (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) forbade digging the grave deeper than three cubits.

chapter: Limit Of Digging The Grave And Niche
arabicText: لجرلا ةمقا :مهضعب لقاو ،يدثلا ىلإ مهضعب لقاو ،ةوقرتلا ىلإ ربقلا دح :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع نب ليع رضح املو :لقا ،سولجلا هيف نكمي ام ردقبف دحللا اماو ،ربقلا يف نم سأر لىع بوثلا دمي ىتح .حشرلا اوغلبت ىتح يل اورفحا :لقا ةفاولا (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا
