englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The limit of the grave is up to the collarbone, and some said up to the chest, and some said: A man's height until the cloth can be spread over the head of the one in the grave, and as for the niche, it should be to the extent that allows sitting in it. He said: And when Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) was near death, he said: Dig for me until you reach moisture.

chapter: Permissibility Of Vertical (Shaq) And Lateral (Lahd) Burial Niches, And The Preference For Lateral Niche
arabicText: .يراصنلأا ةحلط وبأ هل دحل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Abu Talha al-Ansari made a lateral niche (lahd) for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).

chapter: Permissibility Of Vertical (Shaq) And Lateral (Lahd) Burial Niches, And The Preference For Lateral Niche
arabicText: يل اورفحفا تم ناأ اذإ :رضحا نيح (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا يبأ نع .اوقدص دقف هل دحل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :مكل ليق نفإ ،اقش يل اوقشو
englishText: From Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said when his death approached: When I die, dig a grave for me and make a vertical niche (shaq), and if it is said to you that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) had a lateral niche (lahd), they have spoken the truth. Translator: Shaq is a a simple trench dug into the ground, and the body is placed directly into the trench, lying on its back facing the qiblah (direction of Mecca). Whereas, lahd is a niche or shelf carved into one side of the grave, and the body is placed on its right side in the niche, facing the qiblah.

chapter: Permissibility Of Vertical (Shaq) And Lateral (Lahd) Burial Niches, And The Preference For Lateral Niche
arabicText: - هتيصو يف بتك يبأ نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا :لقا - ثيدح يف - يبلحلا نع ،بائر نب ليع نع .نادبا ناك هنأ لجأ نم ضرلأا هل انققشو - :لقا نأ ىلإ
englishText: From Ali ibn Ri'ab, from al-Halabi- in a hadith- who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: My father wrote in his will- until he said:- and we made a vertical niche (shaq) in the earth for him because he was corpulent.

chapter: Permissibility Of Vertical (Shaq) And Lateral (Lahd) Burial Niches, And The Preference For Lateral Niche
arabicText: عضوملا اذه يف يل رفحيس :هل لقا هنأ - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع يورهلا تلصلا يبأ نع اولعجي نأ مهرمأتف اودحلي نأ لاإ اوبأ نفإ ،ةحيرض يل قشي نأو ،لفسأ ىلإ يقارم عبس يل اورفحي نأ مهرمأتف .اضيأ (يلاملأا) يف هاورو .ءاشي ام هعسويس الله نفإ ،اربشو نيعارذ دحللا
englishText: From Abu al-Salt al-Harawi from al-Ridha (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- that he said to him: A grave will be dug for me in this place, so instruct them to dig seven From Abu al-Salt al-Harawi from al-Ridha (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- that he said to him: A grave will be dug for me in this place, so instruct them to dig seven steps down, and to make a vertical niche for me. If they refuse except to make a lateral niche, then instruct them to make the lateral niche two cubits and a span, for Allah will expand it as He wishes. This is also narrated in (al-Amali).

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Deceased Below The Grave By Two Or Three Cubits And Moving Them Twice, And Burying Them On The Third Or Second Time
arabicText: .هراو مث ،ةهينه ربقلا نود تيملا عضوي نأ يغبني :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The deceased should be placed below the grave for a short while, then bury him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Deceased Below The Grave By Two Or Three Cubits And Moving Them Twice, And Burying Them On The Third Or Second Time
arabicText: ربقلا نم لفسأ هعض ،هب هحدفت لاف ربقلا ىلإ كيخبأ تيتأ اذإ :لقا ةيطع نب دمحم نع ،نانس نبا نع ،هنعو .هدحل يف هعض مث هتبهأ ذخيأ ىتح ةثلاث وأ نيعارذب
englishText: From him, from Ibn Sinan, from Muhammad bin Atiyyah who said: When you bring your brother to the grave, do not burden him with it. Place him below the grave by two or three cubits until he takes his preparation, then place him in his niche (lahd).

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Deceased Below The Grave By Two Or Three Cubits And Moving Them Twice, And Burying Them On The Third Or Second Time
arabicText: لاف هربق ىلإ تيملبا تئج اذإ :لقا - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ ينعي - الله لىع قدصي قاداص تعمس .هب هحدفت لاو ربقلل بهأتي ىتح هعدو ،عرذأ ةثلاث وأ نيعارذب هربق نود هعض نكلو ،هربقب هحدفت
englishText: I heard a truthful one who speaks truth about Allah- meaning Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- saying: When you bring the deceased to his grave, do not rush him into his grave. Rather, place him two or three cubits away from the grave, and leave him until he prepares himself for the grave, and do not rush him into it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Deceased Below The Grave By Two Or Three Cubits And Moving Them Twice, And Burying Them On The Third Or Second Time
arabicText: ،ليع قاض لاإ تيب يف ناأو هتركذ ام (ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم نسحلا يبأ نع هتعمس ثيدح :لقا سنوي نع .لاؤسلل هتبهأ ذخيأ هنفإ ةعاس هلهمفأ ربقلا ريفش ىلإ تيملبا تيتأ اذإ :لوقي
englishText: From Yunus who said: A hadith I heard from Abu Al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him), whenever I remembered it while in a house, it made me feel confined. He says: When you bring the deceased to the edge of the grave, give him time for an hour, for he is preparing himself for questioning.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Deceased Below The Grave By Two Or Three Cubits And Moving Them Twice, And Burying Them On The Third Or Second Time
arabicText: هنم لفسأ هعض نكلو (ربقلبا كتيم) حدفت لا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا :لقا نلاجع نب دمحم نع .هتبهأ ذخيأ ىتح هعدو ،ةثلاث وأ نيعارذب
englishText: From Muhammad bin Ajlan who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Do not rush (your deceased into the grave), but place him below it by two or three cubits, and leave him until he prepares himself.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Deceased Below The Grave By Two Or Three Cubits And Moving Them Twice, And Burying Them On The Third Or Second Time
arabicText: نم ذوعتو ،ةميظع لااوهأ ربقلل نفإ ،ربقلا هب حدفت لاف ربقلا تيملبا تيتأ اذإ :رخآ ثيدح يفو :قودصلا لقا مث ،هتبهأ ذخأيل هيلع ربصاو ،لايلق همدق مث ةئينه هيلع ربصاو ،ربقلا ريفش برق هعض نكلو ،علطملا لوه .ربقلا ريفش ىلإ همدق
englishText: Al-Saduq said: And in another hadith: When you bring the deceased to the grave, do not thrust him suddenly into the grave, for the grave has great terrors, and seek refuge from the horror of the resurrection. Instead, place him near the edge of the grave and wait a little while, then move him forward slightly and wait so he may prepare himself, then advance him to the edge of the grave.

chapter: Undesirability Of Standing Up When A Funeral Procession Passes By, Unless It Is The Funeral Of A Jew
arabicText: ملو يراصنلأا ماقف ةزانج هب ترمف راصنلأا نم لجر هدنعو (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ دنع تنك :لقا ةرارز نع وبأ هل لاقف ،سلج مث ،اهب اوضم ىتح امئقا يراصنلأا لزي ملو ،هعم تدعقف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ مقي وبأ هل لاقف كلذ لعفي (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نب نيسحلا تيأر :لقا ؟كمقاأ ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج لاقف ،طق تيبلا لهأ انم دحأ اهل مقا لاو (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا هلعف ام اللهو :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج .تيأر ينأ نظأ تنك دق ،الله كحلصأ ينتككش :يراصنلأا
englishText: From Zurarah, he said: I was with Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) and with him was a man from the Ansar. A funeral procession passed by, so the Ansari man stood up while Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) did not stand up. I sat with him, and the Ansari man kept standing until they passed by with it, then he sat down. Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said to him: "What made you stand up?" He said: "I saw Al-Husayn bin Ali (peace be upon him) doing that." Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said to him: "By Allah, Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) did not do it, and none of us Ahl al-Bayt ever stood up for it." The Ansari man said: "You have made me doubt, may Allah set you right. I thought I had seen it."

chapter: Undesirability Of Standing Up When A Funeral Procession Passes By, Unless It Is The Funeral Of A Jew
arabicText: ماقف ةزانج هيلع ترمف اسلاج (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نب نيسحلا ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناكو يدوهي ةزانج ترم ،(ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا لاقف ،ةزانجلا تعلط نيح سانلا .كلذل ماقف يدوهي ةزانج هسأر ولعت نأ هركف اهقيرط لىع (هلآو هيلع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Al-Husayn bin Ali (peace be upon him) was sitting when a funeral procession passed by him. The people stood up when the funeral procession appeared. Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) said: "It was the funeral of a Jew, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was on its way. He disliked that the funeral of a Jew would pass over his head, so he stood up for that reason."

chapter: Undesirability Of Standing Up When A Funeral Procession Passes By, Unless It Is The Funeral Of A Jew
arabicText: ماقف ةزانجب رمف هل باحصأ هعمو اسلاج ناك (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نب نسحلا نأ (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناك دقف ؟الله كفااع تمق لاأ :مهضعب لقا اهب اوضم املف ،نسحلا مقي ملو موقلا ضعب هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر مقا امنإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا لاقف ،اهب اورم اذإ ةزانجلل موقي (هلآو هيلع هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ماقف اقيض ناكملا ناك دقو يدوهي ةزانجب رم هنأ كلذو ،ةدحاو ةرم (هلآو .هسأر ولعت نأ هركو (هلآو
englishText: From his father (peace be upon them both), that Al-Hasan bin Ali (peace be upon him) was sitting with some of his companions when a funeral procession passed by. Some of the people stood up, but Al-Hasan did not stand up. When they had passed by with it, some of them said: "Why did you not stand up, may Allah grant you well being? The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to stand up for the funeral procession when they passed by him." Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said: "The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) only stood up once, and that was when the funeral of a Jew passed by, and the place was narrow. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) stood up and disliked that it would pass over his head."

chapter: Recommendation For One Who Enters The Grave (To Bury The Deceased) To Undo His Buttons And Remove His Sandals, Turban, Cloak, Cap, Taylasan (Outer Garment), And Khuff (Leather Socks) Except In Cases Of Necessity Or Taqiyya
arabicText: ةمامعلا كيلعو ربقلا يف لزنت لا :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا باأ تعمس :لقا نيطقي نب ليع نع .ترج (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ةنس كلذبو ،كرارزأ للحو ،ناسليطلا لاو ءاذحلا لاو ةوسنلقلاو
englishText: From Ali bin Yaqtin who said: I heard Abu Al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him) saying: Do not descend into the grave while wearing a turban, cap, shoes, or taylasan, and undo your buttons, for this was the practice (sunnah) of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).

chapter: Recommendation For One Who Enters The Grave (To Bury The Deceased) To Undo His Buttons And Remove His Sandals, Turban, Cloak, Cap, Taylasan (Outer Garment), And Khuff (Leather Socks) Except In Cases Of Necessity Or Taqiyya
arabicText: ،هلثم ريمع يبأ نبا نع ،ىسيع نب دمحم نع ،الله دبع نب دعس نع ،هيبأ نع (للعلا) يف قودصلا هاورو .مدهيف هيلجرب رثعي نأ ةفاخم :لقا ؟ءاذحلا هركي مل تلق ،اسبا هب ىرأ لا لقا ،فخلفا :تلق ،دازو
englishText: Al-Saduq narrated it in (Al-Ilal) from his father, from Sa'd bin Abdullah, from Muhammad bin Isa, from Ibn Abi Umayr similarly, and added: I asked: What about the khuff? He said: I see no problem with it. I asked: Why are shoes disliked? He said: Fear of stumbling with his feet and causing collapse.

chapter: Recommendation For One Who Enters The Grave (To Bury The Deceased) To Undo His Buttons And Remove His Sandals, Turban, Cloak, Cap, Taylasan (Outer Garment), And Khuff (Leather Socks) Except In Cases Of Necessity Or Taqiyya
arabicText: لاو ءادر لاو ةمامع لاو نيفخ لاو نيلعن يف ربقلا لخدي نأ دحلا يغبني لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةوسنلق
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: It is not appropriate for anyone to enter the grave wearing sandals, khuff, turban, cloak, or cap.

chapter: Recommendation For One Who Enters The Grave (To Bury The Deceased) To Undo His Buttons And Remove His Sandals, Turban, Cloak, Cap, Taylasan (Outer Garment), And Khuff (Leather Socks) Except In Cases Of Necessity Or Taqiyya
arabicText: للحو ،ءاذح لاو ءادر لاو ةوسنلقلا لاو ةمامعلا كيلعو ربقلا لزنت لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةيقتلاو ةرورضلا تقو يف فخلبا سبأ لا :لقا فخلاو تلق :لقا كرارزأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Do not descend into the grave while wearing a turban, cap, cloak, or shoes, and undo your buttons. I asked: What From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Do not descend into the grave while wearing a turban, cap, cloak, or shoes, and undo your buttons. I asked: What about the khuff? He said: There is no problem with the khuff in times of necessity and taqiyyah.

chapter: Recommendation For One Who Enters The Grave (To Bury The Deceased) To Undo His Buttons And Remove His Sandals, Turban, Cloak, Cap, Taylasan (Outer Garment), And Khuff (Leather Socks) Except In Cases Of Necessity Or Taqiyya
arabicText: ؟فخلفا :تلق ،ةمامع لاو ءادر لاو ةوسنلق لاو لعن كيلعو ربقلا لخدت لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةعانش فخلا علخ يف نفإ ،فخلبا سبأ لا :لقا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Do not enter the grave wearing sandals, cap, cloak, or turban. I asked: What about the khuff? He said: There is no problem with the khuff, for removing the khuff causes notoriety.

chapter: Recommendation For One Who Enters The Grave (To Bury The Deceased) To Undo His Buttons And Remove His Sandals, Turban, Cloak, Cap, Taylasan (Outer Garment), And Khuff (Leather Socks) Except In Cases Of Necessity Or Taqiyya
arabicText: ،ميرحتلا يفنو زاوجلا لىع خيشلا هلمح :لوقأ .هرارزأ لحي ملو ربقلا لخد (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تيأر .ةيقتلا لىع لمحلا لمتحيو
englishText: I saw Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) enter the grave without undoing his buttons. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted this as permissibility and negation of prohibition, and it's possible to interpret it as taqiyyah.

chapter: Recommendation To Untie The Knots Of The Shroud, Placing An Earthen Pillow, Placing A Clump Of Earth Behind The Back, Uncovering The Face, And Placing The Cheek On The Ground
arabicText: .ههجو زربيو ،معن :لقا ؟تيملا (١) نفك لحي :(ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحلأ تلق
englishText: I asked one of them (peace be upon them): Should the shroud of the deceased be untied? He said: Yes, and his face should be exposed.

chapter: Recommendation To Untie The Knots Of The Shroud, Placing An Earthen Pillow, Placing A Clump Of Earth Behind The Back, Uncovering The Face, And Placing The Cheek On The Ground
arabicText: .هسأر دنع نم هربق يف تيملا لخدأ اذإ نفكلا قشي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The shroud should be torn from the head side when the deceased is placed in the grave.

chapter: Recommendation To Untie The Knots Of The Shroud, Placing An Earthen Pillow, Placing A Clump Of Earth Behind The Back, Uncovering The Face, And Placing The Cheek On The Ground
arabicText: .اهلحف ربقلا هتلخدأ اذإ :لاقف ؟تيملا نفك دقع نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ريصب يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about tying the shroud of the deceased? He said: When you place him in the grave, untie them.

chapter: Recommendation To Untie The Knots Of The Shroud, Placing An Earthen Pillow, Placing A Clump Of Earth Behind The Back, Uncovering The Face, And Placing The Cheek On The Ground
arabicText: .هدقع لحف هدحل يف هتعضو اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When you place him in his grave, untie its knots.

chapter: Recommendation To Untie The Knots Of The Shroud, Placing An Earthen Pillow, Placing A Clump Of Earth Behind The Back, Uncovering The Face, And Placing The Cheek On The Ground
arabicText: ،يقلتسي لائل ةردم هرهظ فلخ لعجيو ،بارت نم ةداسو هل لعجي :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هل ىعدي مث ههجو نع فشكيو ،اهلك هنفك دقع لحيو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he said: Make for him a pillow from earth, and place behind his back a clump of earth so he doesn't lie flat, and untie all the knots of his shroud, and uncover his face, then supplicate for him.

chapter: Recommendation To Untie The Knots Of The Shroud, Placing An Earthen Pillow, Placing A Clump Of Earth Behind The Back, Uncovering The Face, And Placing The Cheek On The Ground
arabicText: .هربق لخدأ اذإ تيملا سأر دنع نم نفكلا قشي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The shroud should be torn from the head side of the deceased when he is placed in his grave.

chapter: Recommendation Of Reciting Al-Hamd, Al-Mu'awwidhatayn, Al Ikhlas, And Ayat Al-Kursi When Placing The Mayyit In The Grave, And Talqeen Of Shahadatayn And Iqraar Of The Imams By Their Names Up To The Imam Of Their Time
arabicText: نأ ىلإ - ةمامعلا كيلعو ربقلا يف لزنت لا :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تعمس :لقا نيطقي نب ليع نع ،يسركلا ةيآو دحأ الله وه لقو نيتذوعملاو باتكلا ةحتفا أرقيلو ،ميجرلا ناطيشلا نم للهبا ذوعتيلو - لقا .هبحاص ىلإ يهتني ىتح ملعي ام ركذيلو دهشتيلو ،لعفيلف ضرلأبا هقصليو هدخ نع رسحي نأ ردق نإو
englishText: Ali ibn Yaqtin said: I heard Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) saying: Do not descend into the grave wearing a turban- until he said- and seek refuge with Allah from the accursed Satan, and recite Fatihat Al-Kitab, Al-Mu'awwidhatayn, Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad, and Ayat Al-Kursi, and if possible, uncover his cheek and place it on the earth, and testify and mention what he knows until reaching his companion.

chapter: Recommendation Of Reciting Al-Hamd, Al-Mu'awwidhatayn, Al Ikhlas, And Ayat Al-Kursi When Placing The Mayyit In The Grave, And Talqeen Of Shahadatayn And Iqraar Of The Imams By Their Names Up To The Imam Of Their Time
arabicText: نلاف يا :لق مث نميلأا هبكنم لىع كدي برضاو ،يسركلا ةيآ تأرق هدحل يف تيملا تعضو اذإ :لقا ةرارز نع .هنامز مامإ ىتح مسو ،امامإ ليعبو ،ايبن (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) دمحمبو ،انيد ملاسلاباو ،بار للهبا تيضر :لق
englishText: From Zurarah who said: When you place the deceased in their grave, recite Ayat Al Kursi, and strike your hand on their right shoulder then say: O so-and-so, say: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, Islam as religion, Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) as Prophet, and Ali as Imam, and name until the Imam of his time.

chapter: Recommendation Of Reciting Al-Hamd, Al-Mu'awwidhatayn, Al Ikhlas, And Ayat Al-Kursi When Placing The Mayyit In The Grave, And Talqeen Of Shahadatayn And Iqraar Of The Imams By Their Names Up To The Imam Of Their Time
arabicText: الله لىص) الله لوسر ةلم لىعو للهباو الله مسب " :لقف تيملا تللس اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع كبر الله :لقف هنذأ لىع كمف عضف دحللا يف هتعضو اذفإ " كباذع ىلإ لا كتمحر ىلإ مهللا ،(هلآو هيلع .كمامإ ليعو كباتك نآرقلاو كيبن دمحمو كنيد ملاسلااو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When you withdraw the deceased, say: "In the name of Allah, and by Allah, and upon the religion of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), O Allah, to Your mercy not to Your punishment." When you place him in the grave, put your mouth near his ear and say: Allah is your Lord, Islam is your religion, Muhammad is your Prophet, the Quran is your Book, and Ali is your Imam.

chapter: Recommendation Of Reciting Al-Hamd, Al-Mu'awwidhatayn, Al Ikhlas, And Ayat Al-Kursi When Placing The Mayyit In The Grave, And Talqeen Of Shahadatayn And Iqraar Of The Imams By Their Names Up To The Imam Of Their Time
arabicText: ،هسأر دنع هربق يف لزني نم لقعأ نكيلف تيملا نفدت نأ تدرأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ثلاث - مهفا عمسا " :لوقيو هعمس ىلإ همف ينديو ،ضرلأا ىلإ هب يضفي ىتح نميلأا هدخ نع فشكيلو اذه تارم ثلاث هيلع اهدعأو " مهفاو عمسا ،كمامإ نلافو كنيد ملاسلااو كيبن دمحمو كبر الله - تارم .نيقلتلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When you want to bury the deceased, let the most intelligent person descend into his grave at his head, and uncover his right cheek until it touches the earth, and bring his mouth close to his ear and say: "Listen and understand- three times- Allah is your Lord, Muhammad is your Prophet, Islam is your religion, and so-and-so is your Imam, listen and understand" and repeat this instruction three times.

chapter: Recommendation Of Reciting Al-Hamd, Al-Mu'awwidhatayn, Al Ikhlas, And Ayat Al-Kursi When Placing The Mayyit In The Grave, And Talqeen Of Shahadatayn And Iqraar Of The Imams By Their Names Up To The Imam Of Their Time
arabicText: ،هسأر ليي امم سانلا ىلوأ نكيلف هدحل يف هتعضو اذفإ ،اقيفر لاس هلس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع باتكلا ةحتفا أرقيلو ،ناطيشلا نم ذوعتي ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لىع ليصيو ،الله مسا ركذيلو ركذيو دهشتيو ،لعف ضرلأبا هقزليو هدخ نع رسحي نأ ردق نفإ ،يسركلا ةيآو دحأ الله وه لقو نيتذوعملاو .هبحاص ىلإ يهتني ىتح ملعي ام
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Withdraw him gently, and when you place him in his grave, let the closest person be at his head, and mention Allah's name, and send blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), seek refuge from Satan, and recite Fatihat Al-Kitab, Al-Mu'awwidhatayn, Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad, and Ayat Al-Kursi, and if possible, uncover his cheek and place it on the earth, and testify and mention what he knows until reaching his companion.

chapter: Recommendation Of Reciting Al-Hamd, Al-Mu'awwidhatayn, Al Ikhlas, And Ayat Al-Kursi When Placing The Mayyit In The Grave, And Talqeen Of Shahadatayn And Iqraar Of The Imams By Their Names Up To The Imam Of Their Time
arabicText: الله ليبس يفو الله مسب :لقف هدحل يف تيملا تعضو اذإ :لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع يا :لق مث نميلأا هبكنم لىع كديب برضاو ،يسركلا ةيآ أرقاو ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ةلم لىعو مامإ يمستو ،امامإ ليعبو ،لاوسر (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) دمحمبو ،انيد ملاسلاباو ،بار للهبا تيضر :لق نلاف .هنامز
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: When you place the deceased in his grave, say: In the name of Allah, in the path of Allah, and upon the religion of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and recite Ayat Al-Kursi, and strike your hand on his right shoulder then say: O so-and-so, say: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, Islam as religion, Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) as Messenger, and Ali as Imam, and name the Imam of his time.

chapter: Recommendation Of Reciting Al-Hamd, Al-Mu'awwidhatayn, Al Ikhlas, And Ayat Al-Kursi When Placing The Mayyit In The Grave, And Talqeen Of Shahadatayn And Iqraar Of The Imams By Their Names Up To The Imam Of Their Time
arabicText: ىلوأ نوكيو ،ههجو نع رسحتو ،ضرلأبا هدخ قصلأو هدحل يف هعض :لقا - ثيدح يف - ةيطع نب دمحم نع ملعي ام :لقيل مث ،يسركلا ةيآو نيتذوعملاو دحأ الله وه لقو باتكلا ةحتفا أرقيل مث ،هسأر ليي امم هب سانلا .هبحاص ىلإ يهتني ىتح
englishText: From Muhammad ibn Atiyyah- in a hadith- who said: Place him in his grave and place his cheek on the earth, and uncover his face, and let the closest person be at his head, then recite Fatihat Al-Kitab, Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad, Al-Mu'awwidhatayn, and Ayat Al-Kursi, then say what he knows until reaching his companion.

chapter: Recommendation Of Reciting Al-Hamd, Al-Mu'awwidhatayn, Al Ikhlas, And Ayat Al-Kursi When Placing The Mayyit In The Grave, And Talqeen Of Shahadatayn And Iqraar Of The Imams By Their Names Up To The Imam Of Their Time
arabicText: هب سانلا ىلوأ نكيلف هربق ىلإ هتلخدأ اذفإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ عمس هنأ نلاجع نب دمحم نع ةحتفا أرقيلو ،ناطيشلا نم ذوعتيلو ،الله مسا ركذيلو ،ضرلأبا هدخ قصليلو هدخ نع رسحيلو ،هسأر دنع لاإ هلإ لا نأ ةداهش :هنيقلت هعمسيو ملعي ام :لقيل مث ،يسركلا ةيآو نيتذوعملاو دحأ الله وه لقو باتكلا .ادحاو ادحاو ملعي ام هل ركذيو ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ادمحم نأو ،الله
englishText: From Muhammad bin 'Ajlan that he heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) say: When you place him in his grave, let the closest person to him be at his head, and let him uncover his cheek and place his cheek on the ground, and mention the name of Allah, and seek refuge from Satan, and recite Surah Al-Fatiha and Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad [Surah 112] and Al-Mu'awwidhatayn [Surah 113 & 114] and Ayat Al-Kursi [2:255], then let him say what he knows and make him hear the talqeen: the testimony that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and mention to him what he knows one by one.

chapter: Recommendation Of Reciting Al-Hamd, Al-Mu'awwidhatayn, Al Ikhlas, And Ayat Al-Kursi When Placing The Mayyit In The Grave, And Talqeen Of Shahadatayn And Iqraar Of The Imams By Their Names Up To The Imam Of Their Time
arabicText: هيلع) بلاط يبأ نب ليع مأ دسأ تنب ةمطفا عضو امل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نأ سابع نبا نع :يلوقف كبر نم :كلاأسف ريكنو ركنم كتاأ نإ ةمطفا يا :لقا مث ،اهسأر دنع راص ىتح فحز اهربق يف (ملاسلا لوقلبا ةمطفا تبث مهللا :لقا مث ،" ييلوو يمامإ ينباو ،يباتك نآرقلاو ،ينيد ملاسلااو ،ييبن دمحمو يبر الله " .تايثح اهيلع اثحو اهربق نم جرخ مث ،تباثلا
englishText: From Ibn Abbas that when the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) placed Fatima bint Asad, mother of Ali bin Abi Talib (peace be upon him), in her grave, he moved until he was at her head, then said: O Fatima, if Munkar and Nakir come to you and ask you: who is your Lord? Say: "Allah is my Lord, Muhammad is my Prophet, Islam is my religion, the Quran is my book, and my son is my Imam and guardian." Then he said: O Allah, make Fatima firm with the firm word. Then he left her grave and threw handfuls of earth.

chapter: Recommendation Of Supplicating For The Deceased With Narrated Supplications When Placing Him In The Grave And A Summary Of The Rulings Of Burial
arabicText: أرقفا ربقلا يف هتعضو اذفإ هيلجر لبق نم هلسف ربقلا تيملبا تيتأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع :لقو يسركلا ةيآ " هيبنب هقحلأو هربق يف هل حسفا مهللا ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ةلم لىعو الله ليبس يفو الله مسب " ائيسم ناك نإو ،هناسحإ يف دزف انسحم ناك نإ مهللا " دنع نم ةدحاو ةرم هيلع ةلاصلا يف تلق امك :لقو ،تعطتسا ام هل رفغتساو " هنع زواجتو همحراو هل رفغفا دعاصو هيبنج نع ضرلأا فاج مهللا :لقا (ربقلا تيملا لخدأ) اذإ (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا نب ليع ناكو :لقا .نااوضر كنم هقلو هلمع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: When you bring the deceased to the grave, lower him from the direction of his feet. When you place him in the grave, recite Ayat Al-Kursi and say: "In the name of Allah, in the way of Allah, and upon the religion of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). O Allah, expand his grave for him and join him with his Prophet." And say as you said in the prayer upon him once, from "O Allah, if he was a doer of good, then increase his goodness, and if he was a wrongdoer, then forgive him, have mercy on him, and pardon him," and seek forgiveness for him as much as you can. He said: When Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) placed the deceased in the grave, he would say: "O Allah, make the earth hollow from his sides, raise his deeds, and let him meet Your pleasure."

chapter: Recommendation Of Supplicating For The Deceased With Narrated Supplications When Placing Him In The Grave And A Summary Of The Rulings Of Burial
arabicText: :لقف هدحل يف تيملا عضو اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ملسم نب دمحم نع ريخ تنأو ،كب لزن ،كدبع نبا كدبع ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ةلم لىعو ،الله ليبس يفو الله مسب " " هب ملعأ تنأو اريخ لاإ هنم ملعن لا ناإ مهللا ،هيبنب هقحلأو ،هربق يف هل حسفا مهللا هب لوزنم ريخ تنأو ،كب لزن ،كدبع نبا كدبع ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ةلم لىعو ،الله ليبس يفو الله مسب " " هب ملعأ تنأو اريخ لاإ هنم ملعن لا ناإ مهللا ،هيبنب هقحلأو ،هربق يف هل حسفا مهللا هب لوزنم نع هينغت ةمحر كتمحر نم هيلإ نكسأو ،هتشحو سنآو ،هتدحو لص مهللا " :لقف نبللا هيلع تعضو اذفإ " كاوس نم ةمحر لىعأ يف هتجرد عفرا مهللا ،نيملاعلا بر لله دمحلاو ،نوعجار هيلإ ناإو لله ناإ " :لقف هربق نم تجرخ اذإو ." نيملاعلا بر يا (هبستحن كدنعو) نيرباغلا يف هبقع لىع فلخاو نييلع
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim, from one of the two (peace be upon them both), he said: When the deceased is placed in his niche grave (lahd), say: "In the name of Allah, in the way of Allah, and upon the religion of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). Your servant, son of Your servant, has descended to You, and You are the best to be descended to. O Allah, expand his grave for him, join him with his Prophet. O Allah, we do not know of him except good, and You know him best." Whenyou place the bricks upon him, say: "O Allah, unite his loneliness, give solace to his estrangement, and make him dwell in Your mercy, a mercy that will suffice him from the mercy of others besides You." When you leave his grave, say: "Indeed we belong to Allah and to Him we shall return, and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, raise his rank in the highest of the high, and be a guardian to his descendants among the remaining (those who are alive), and with You we reckon him, O Lord of the worlds."

chapter: Recommendation Of Supplicating For The Deceased With Narrated Supplications When Placing Him In The Grave And A Summary Of The Rulings Of Burial
arabicText: :لقا ؟هربق انم تيملا تلخدأ اذإ :لوقأ ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا ةعامس نع ،بويأ يبأ نع :لق ملعن لاو مهللا ،كتمحر ىلإ جاتحا دق ،هب لوزنم ريخ تنأو كب لزن دق ،كدبع نباو نلاف كدبع اذه مهللا " ،هتجح هنقلو ،هيبنج نع ضرلأا فاجف مهللا ،هتينلاعب ءادهشلا نحنو هتريرسب ملعأ تنأو ،اريخ لاإ هنم ،هيف ناك امم ريخ ىلإ هريصو ،هيف لزن تيب ريخ ربقلا اذه لعجاو ،هيلع ىتا موي ريخ مويلا اذه لعجاو ." هدعب انلضت لاو ،هرجأ انمرحت لاو ،هبنذ رفغاو هتشحو سنآو ،هلخدم يف هل عسوو
englishText: From Abu Ayyub, from Suma'ah, he said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), "What should I say when I place our deceased in his grave?" He said: Say, "O Allah, this is Your servant, so-and-so, son of Your servant. He has descended to You, and You are the best to be descended to. He is in need of Your mercy. O Allah, we do not know of him except good, and You know his inner secrets best, and we are witnesses to his apparent deeds. O Allah, make the earth hollow from his sides, make him comprehend his proof, make this day the best day that has come upon him, make this grave the best house he has dwelled in, make him reach what is better than what he was in, expand his entrance, give solace to his estrangement, forgive his sins, do not deprive us of his reward, and do not let us go astray after him."

chapter: Recommendation Of Supplicating For The Deceased With Narrated Supplications When Placing Him In The Grave And A Summary Of The Rulings Of Burial
arabicText: كتمأ نباو كدبع نبا كدبع مهللا " :تلق ربقلا لىع تيملا تعضو اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع " هب لوزنم ريخ تنأو كب لزن ىلإ لا كتمحر ىلإ مهللا ،الله لوسر ةلم لىعو للهباو الله مسب " :تلق هتيلدو نيلجرلا لبق نم هتللس اذفإ ،" ربقلا باذع هياإو انقو تباثلا لوقلبا هتبثو هتجح هنقلو هربق يف هل حسفا مهللا ،كباذع ،نييلع يف نينمؤملا حاورأ ىلإ هحور دعصو ،هيبنج نع ضرلأا فاج مهللا " :لق بارتلا هيلع تيوس اذإو ." نيحلاصلبا هقحلأو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: When you place the deceased upon the grave, say: "O Allah, Your servant, son of Your servant and son of Your maidservant, has descended to You, and You are the best to be descended to." When you lower him from the direction of the feet and let him down, say: "In the name of Allah, by Allah, and upon the religion of the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, to Your mercy, not to Your punishment. O Allah, expand his grave for him, make him comprehend his proof, make him steadfast with the firm word, and protect us and him from the punishment of the grave." When you level the soil upon him, say: "O Allah, make the earth hollow from his sides, raise his soul to the souls of the believers in the highest, and join him with the righteous."

chapter: Recommendation Of Supplicating For The Deceased With Narrated Supplications When Placing Him In The Grave And A Summary Of The Rulings Of Burial
arabicText: ،يقلتسي لائل ةردم هرهظ فلخ لعجيو ،بارت نم ةداسو هل لعجي :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع :لاقيو هل ىعدي مث ،ههجو نع فشكيو اهلك هنفك دقع لحيو ،هتجح هنقلو ،هربق يف هل حسفا مهللا ،هب لوزنم ريخ تنأو كب لزن كتمأ نباو كدبع نباو كدبع مهللا " " ريكنو ركنم رش هقو ،هيبنب هقحلأو اديدش اكيرحت هكرحتو ،رسيلأا هبكنم لىع ىرسيلا كدي عضتو ،نميلأا هبكنم تحت ىنميلا كدي لخدت مث ىمستو " كمامإو كيلو ليعو ،كنيد ملاسلااو ،كيبن دمحمو ،كبر الله ،نلاف نبا نلاف يا " :لوقتو .راربأ ىده ةمئأ كتمئأ مهرخآ ىلإ ادحاو ادحاو (ملاسلا مهيلع) ةمئلأا سنآو ،هتدحو لصو ،هتبرغ محرا مهللا " :لقف نبللا هيلع تعضو اذفإ ،ىرخأ ةرم نيقلتلا هيلع ديعت مث نم عم هرشحاو ،كاوس نم ةمحر نع اهب ينغتسي ةمحر كتمحر نم هيلإ نكسأو ،هتعور نمآو ،هتشحو " هلاوتي ناك تنأو - لقف ربقلا نم تجرخ اذفإ .ربقلا لىع كاديو ةلبقلا لبقتسم تنأو ءاعدلا اذهب هل عدفا هربق ترز ىتمو ،نوعجار هيلإ ناإو لله ناإ :- بارتلا نم كيدي ضفنت الله نادعو ام اذه ،كباتكب اقيدصتو ،كب نااميإ مهللا " :لقو تارم ثلاث كيفك رهظب هيلع بارتلا ثحا مث ،ةنسح ةرذ لكب هل الله بتك تاملكلا هذه لقاو كلذ لعف نم هنفإ " هلوسرو الله قدصو ،هلوسرو ،هسأر دنع ءاملا بصب أدبتو ،ةلبقلا لبقتسم تنأو كمامأ ربقلا لعجتو ءاملا هربق لىع بصف هربق ىوس اذفإ ئش ءاملا نم لضف نفإ ،ءاملا عطقت نأ ريغ نم سأرلا ىلإ عجرت ىتح هبناوج عبرأ نم هربق لىع هب رودتو .هل رفغتساو تيملل عداو ربقلا لىع كدي عض مث ،ربقلا طسو لىع هبصف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: A pillow of dust is made for him, a brick is placed behind his back so that he does not lie flat, all the knots of his shroud are untied, his face is uncovered, then supplications are made for him, and it is said: "O Allah, Your servant, son of Your servant and son of Your maidservant, has descended to You, and You are the best to be descended to. O Allah, expand his grave for him, make him comprehend his proof, join him with his Prophet, and protect him from the evil of Munkar and Nakir." Then you insert your right hand under his right shoulder, place your left hand on his Then you insert your right hand under his right shoulder, place your left hand on his left shoulder, and shake him vigorously, and say: "O so-and-so, son of so-and-so, Allah is your Lord, Muhammad is your Prophet, Islam is your religion, Ali is your guardian and imam," and name the Imams (peace be upon them) one by one until the last of them, "your imams, the imams of guidance, the righteous." Then repeat the teaching (talqin) to him once more. When you place the bricks upon him, say: "O Allah, have mercy on his alienation, unite his loneliness, give solace to his estrangement, give security to his fear, and make him dwell in Your mercy, a mercy that will suffice him from the mercy of others besides You, and gather him with those whom he used to befriend." Whenever you visit his grave, supplicate for him with this supplication while facing the Qiblah and your hands on the grave. When you leave the grave, say- while shaking the dust off your hands-: "Indeed we belong to Allah and to Him we shall return." Then scatter the soil upon him with the back of your palms three times and say: "O Allah, with faith in You, and belief in Your Book, this is what Allah and His Messenger promised us, and Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth." Whoever does that and says these words, Allah will write for him a good deed for every particle. When you level his grave, pour water on his grave while placing the grave in front of you and facing the Qiblah. Begin pouring the water at his head, and go around his grave from its four sides until you return to the head without cutting off the water. If there is any water left, pour it on the middle of the grave. Then place your hand on the grave, supplicate for the deceased, and seek forgiveness for him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Supplicating For The Deceased With Narrated Supplications When Placing Him In The Grave And A Summary Of The Rulings Of Burial
arabicText: للهباو الله مسب " :لقف ربق يف تلزن اذإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا رامع نب قاحسإ نع " (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ةلم لىعو تنأو كب لزن كدبع نبا كدبع بر يا مهللا " :لقو هتدقع لحف هربق يف هتعضو اذفإ ،لاس تيملا لست مث هيبنب هقحلأو ،هنع زواجتف ائيسم ناك نإو ،هناسحإ يف دزف انسحم ناك نإ مهللا ،هب لوزنم ريخ ." كوفع كوفع مهللا ،ميقتسم طارص ىلإ هياإو نادهاو ،هتعيش حلاصو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) دمحم :لقف تلئس اذإ نلاف نبا نلاف يا " :لوقت مث اديدش اكيرحت هكرحتو رسيلأا هدضع لىع ىرسيلا كدي عضت مث ،(ملاسلا مهيلع) ةمئلأا قوست ىتح " يمامإ ليعو ،يباتك نآرقلاو ،ينيد ملاسلااو ،ييبن دمحمو ،يبر الله " :لوقت مث ،معن :لوقيو بيجي هنفإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقا " نلاف يا تمهفأ " :لوقت مث ،لوقلا هيلع ديعت مث " هتمحر نم رقتسم يف كئايلوأ نيبو كنيب الله فرع ،ميقتسم طارص ىلإ الله كادهو ،تباثلا لوقلبا الله كتبث ." كوفع كوفع مهللا ،نااهرب كنم هنقلو ،كيلإ هحورب دعصأو ،هنيبج نع ضرلأا فاج مهللا " :لوقت مث ،هتعور نمآو ،هتشحو سنآو ،هتدحو لص مهللا " :لوقت نيطلاو نبللا عضت تمد امف ،نبللاو نيطلا عضت مث ،" نيملاظلل كتمحر امنفإ ،كاوس نم ةمحر نع اهب هينغت ةمحر كتمحر نم هيلإ نكسأو يف هبقع لىع فلخاو ،نييلع لىعأ يف هتجرد عفرا مهللا ،نوعجار هيلإ ناإو لله ناإ " :لوقتو ربقلا نم جرخت مث ." نيملاعلا بر يا هبستحن كدنعو ،نيرباغلا
englishText: From Ishaq bin 'Ammar, he said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: When you descend into a grave, say: "In the name of Allah, by Allah, and upon the religion of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)." Then lower the deceased gently. When you place him in his grave, untie his knots and say: "O Allah, Lord of Your servant, son of Your servant. He has descended to You, and You are the best to be descended to. O Allah, if he was a doer of good, then increase his goodness, and if he was a wrongdoer, then pardon him, and join him with his Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) and his righteous followers, and guide us and him to a straight path. O Allah, Your pardon, Your pardon." Then place your left hand on his left upper arm and shake him vigorously, then say: "O so-and-so, son of so-and-so, when you are asked, say: Allah is my Lord, Muhammad is my Prophet, Islam is my religion, the Qur'an is my book, and Ali is my imam," until you reach the Imams (peace be upon them). Then repeat the words to him, then say: "Did you understand, O so-and-so?" He (peace be upon him) said: He will answer and say, "Yes." Then say: "May Allah make you steadfast with the firm word, and may Allah guide you to a straight path. May Allah make known between you and your guardians in the abode of His mercy." Then say: "O Allah, make the earth hollow from his forehead, raise his soul to You, and make him comprehend the proof from You. O Allah, Your pardon, Your pardon." Then place the clay and bricks. As long as you are placing the bricks and clay, say: "O Allah, unite his loneliness, give solace to his estrangement, give security to his fear, and make him dwell in Your mercy, a mercy that will suffice him from the mercy of Then place the clay and bricks. As long as you are placing the bricks and clay, say: "O Allah, unite his loneliness, give solace to his estrangement, give security to his fear, and make him dwell in Your mercy, a mercy that will suffice him from the mercy of others besides You, for Your mercy is for the wrongdoers." Then leave the grave and say: "Indeed we belong to Allah and to Him we shall return. O Allah, raise his rank in the highest of the high, and be the successor to his descendants among the remaining, and with You we reckon him, O Lord of the worlds."

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Deceased Into The Grave From The Feet Side Gently With The Head First If It's A Man, And The Woman From The Direction Of The Qiblah
arabicText: .هيلجر لبق نم هلسف ربقلا تيملبا تيتأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When you bring the deceased to the grave, slide him in from the direction of the feet.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Deceased Into The Grave From The Feet Side Gently With The Head First If It's A Man, And The Woman From The Direction Of The Qiblah
arabicText: قزلتو ،نيلجرلا لبق نم هلست :لاقف تيملا نع (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ تلأس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع .هربق عبرت تاجرفم عباصأ عبرأ ردق لاإ ضرلأبا ربقلا
englishText: From Muhammad ibn Muslim who said: I asked one of them (peace be upon them) about the deceased and he said: Slide him in from the direction of the feet, and make the grave level with the ground except for four spread fingers height, and make his grave square-shaped.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Deceased Into The Grave From The Feet Side Gently With The Head First If It's A Man, And The Woman From The Direction Of The Qiblah
arabicText: .لاس تيملا لس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Slide the deceased in gently.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Deceased Into The Grave From The Feet Side Gently With The Head First If It's A Man, And The Woman From The Direction Of The Qiblah
arabicText: لبق نم ربقلا ببا نإو بابا تيب لكل نإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا ىرخأ ةياور يفو :ينيلكلا لقا .نيلجرلا
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: And in another narration, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Every house has a door, and the door of the grave is from the direction of the feet.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Deceased Into The Grave From The Feet Side Gently With The Head First If It's A Man, And The Woman From The Direction Of The Qiblah
arabicText: ،لاس هيلجر لبق نم لسي تيملاو :لقا - نيدلا عيارش ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا امهيلع) دمحم نب رفعج نع .منست لاو عبرت روبقلاو ،دحللا لبق نم ضرعلبا ذخؤت ةأرملاو
englishText: From Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both)- in a hadith about religious From Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both)- in a hadith about religious laws- said: The deceased should be slid in from the direction of the feet, and the woman should be taken sideways from the direction of the niche, and the graves should be made square and not humped.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Deceased Into The Grave From The Feet Side Gently With The Head First If It's A Man, And The Woman From The Direction Of The Qiblah
arabicText: اهعضف ةزانجلا تعضو اذإ ،نيلجرلا ليي امم ربقلا بباو ببا ئش لكل :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .بارتلا هيلع ىوسيو ،هترفح يف عضوي ىتح هل اعديو ،نيلجرلا ليي امم تيملا جرخيو نيلجرلا ليي امم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Everything has a door and the door of the grave is from the direction of the feet. When you place the bier, place it from the direction of the feet (*) and remove the deceased from the direction of the feet, and supplicate for him until he is placed in his pit, and the soil is leveled over him. Translator: * So that the feet enter first.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Deceased Into The Grave From The Feet Side Gently With The Head First If It's A Man, And The Woman From The Direction Of The Qiblah
arabicText: نم ربقلا ببا نإو ،بابا تيب لكل نإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا يمرضحلا ريفن نب ريبج نع .نيلجرلا لبق
englishText: From Jubayr ibn Nufayr Al-Hadrami who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Every house has a door, and the door of the grave is from the direction of the feet.

chapter: Recommendation For Exiting The Grave From The Feet Side For One Who Enters It, And Permissibility Of Entering From Whichever Direction One Wishes
arabicText: .نيلجرلا لبق نم لاإ جرخي لاف ربقلا لخد نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever enters the grave should not exit except from the feet side.

chapter: Recommendation For Exiting The Grave From The Feet Side For One Who Enters It, And Permissibility Of Entering From Whichever Direction One Wishes
arabicText: نم لاإ جرخي لاو ،ءاش ثيح نم ربقلا لجرلا لخدي :لقا :لقا هعفر ،دياز نب لهس نع ،انباحصأ نم ةدع نعو .هيلجر لبق
englishText: From a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, who raised it [to an Imam] saying: A man may enter the grave from whichever direction he wishes, but should not exit except from the feet side.

chapter: Entry Into The Grave Is For The Guardian, And The Permissibility Of Multiple Entrants
arabicText: نإو ،ارتو لخدأ ءاش نإ ،يلولا ىلإ كاذ :لقا ؟هلخدي مك ربقلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لأس هنأ ةرارز نع .اعفش ءاش
englishText: From Zurarah that he asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about how many can enter the grave? He said: That is up to the guardian, if he wishes he can allow an odd number, and if he wishes an even number.

chapter: Entry Into The Grave Is For The Guardian, And The Permissibility Of Multiple Entrants
arabicText: - (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نفك :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تعمس لقا يراصنلأا ميرم يبأ نع لاقف ،سابعلا نب لضفلا هعم لخدأو ،هيدي لىع هعضوف ربقلا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع لخد مث - :لقا نأ ىلإ هيلع) ليع هل لاقف ،انقح اوعطقت نأ الله مكدشنأ :يلوخ نب سوأ :هل لاقي ءلايخلا ينب نم راصنلأا نم لجر .لاس لسو ربقلا لجر دنع :لاقف ؟ريرسلا عضو نيأ هتلأسف :امهعم لخدف لخدأ :(ملاسلا
englishText: From Abu Maryam Al-Ansari who said I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was shrouded- until he said- then Ali (peace be upon him) entered the grave and placed him on his hands, and Al-Fadhl bin Al-Abbas entered with him. Then a man from Al-Ansar from Bani Al-Khayla called Aws bin Khawli said: I implore you by Allah not to cut off our right. So Ali (peace be upon him) said to him: Enter, and he entered with them. So I asked him where was the bier placed? He said: At the foot of the grave and it was gently pulled out.

chapter: Dislike Of Descending Into The Child's Grave Specifically Without It Being Prohibited, And The Permissibility Of Descending Into The Parent's Grave
arabicText: .هدلو ربق يف لزني نأ لجرلل هركي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: It is disliked for a man to descend into his child's grave.

chapter: Dislike Of Descending Into The Child's Grave Specifically Without It Being Prohibited, And The Permissibility Of Descending Into The Parent's Grave
arabicText: .هدلو ربق يف دلاولا لزني لاو ،هدلاو ربق يف لزني لجرلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A man descends into his father's grave, but a father does not descend into his child's grave.

chapter: Dislike Of Descending Into The Child's Grave Specifically Without It Being Prohibited, And The Permissibility Of Descending Into The Parent's Grave
arabicText: لعف اذكه :لقاو ،ليعامسإ هدلو ربق يف لزني مل هنأ - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هدلو ميهاربإب (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- that he did not descend into his son Isma'il's grave, and said: This is what the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) did with his son Ibrahim.

chapter: Dislike Of Descending Into The Child's Grave Specifically Without It Being Prohibited, And The Permissibility Of Descending Into The Parent's Grave
arabicText: هيلع) ليع نع ثيدح يف - :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم نسحلا باأ تعمس :لقا الله دبع نب ليع نع هيلع) لزنف ،ينبا دحلفأ لزنا ،ليع يا :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نبا ميهاربإ ضبق امل - (ملاسلا هدحل يف ميهاربإ دحلفأ (ملاسلا مهل لاقف ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لعفي مل ذإ ،هدلو ربق يف لزني نأ دحلا يغبني لا هنإ :سانلا لاقف تسل ينكلو مكدلاوأ روبق يف اولزنت نأ مارحب مكيلع سيل هنإ سانلا اهيأ يا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر مهل لاقف ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لعفي مل ذإ ،هدلو ربق يف لزني نأ دحلا يغبني لا هنإ :سانلا لاقف تسل ينكلو مكدلاوأ روبق يف اولزنت نأ مارحب مكيلع سيل هنإ سانلا اهيأ يا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر مث ،هرجأ طبحي ام عزجلا نم كلذ دنع هلخديف ناطيشلا هب بعلي نأ هدلو نع نفكلا مكدحأ لح اذإ نمآ .(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) فرصنا
englishText: From Ali bin Abdullah who said: I heard Abu Al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) say- in a hadith from Ali (peace be upon him)- When Ibrahim, the son of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) passed away, he said: O Ali, descend and make a niche for my son. So he (peace be upon him) descended and made a niche for Ibrahim in his grave. The people said: It is not appropriate for anyone to descend into their child's grave, since the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) did not do so. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to them: O people, it is not prohibited for you to descend into your children's graves, but I fear that when one of you unties the shroud of his child, Satan may play with him and cause such grief that would nullify his reward. Then he (peace be upon him and his family) left.

chapter: Dislike Of Descending Into The Child's Grave Specifically Without It Being Prohibited, And The Permissibility Of Descending Into The Parent's Grave
arabicText: .هدلاو ربق يف لزني دلولاو ،هدلو ربق يف لزني لا دلاولا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The parent does not descend into his child's grave, but the child descends into his parent's grave.

chapter: Dislike Of Descending Into The Child's Grave Specifically Without It Being Prohibited, And The Permissibility Of Descending Into The Parent's Grave
arabicText: ،بارتلا يف هنفدي لا :لاقف ؟هنبا نفدي لجرلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا يربنعلا الله دبع نع .سبأ لا معن :لقا ؟هباأ نفدي نبلافا :تلق :لقا
englishText: From Abdullah Al-Anbari who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Should a man bury his son? He said: He should not bury him in the soil. I asked: Should the son bury his father? He said: Yes, there is no problem.

chapter: Dislike Of Descending Into The Child's Grave Specifically Without It Being Prohibited, And The Permissibility Of Descending Into The Parent's Grave
arabicText: مث هربق يف لزنفأ هنبا ليعامسإ تام نيح (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ عم تنك :لقا دشار نب الله دبع نع :لقا مث ،ميهاربإب (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر عنص اذكه :لقا مث ،ةلبقلا ليي امم ضرلأا لىع هسفنب ىمر .هدلو ربق يف لزني لاو ،هدلاو ربق يف لزني لجرلا نإ
englishText: From Abdullah bin Rashid who said: I was with Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) when his son Isma'il died, and he had him descended into his grave, then he threw himself on the ground towards the Qiblah and said: This is how the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) did with Ibrahim. Then he said: Indeed, a man descends into his father's grave, but does not descend into his child's grave.

chapter: Dislike Of Descending Into The Child's Grave Specifically Without It Being Prohibited, And The Permissibility Of Descending Into The Parent's Grave
arabicText: لسرأ ربقلا ىلإ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ ىهتنفا ليعامسإ يفوت امل :لقا دلاخ نب دمحم ىلوم ةرم نع هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر عنص اذكه :لقا مث ربقلا يف لزني ملو ربقلا ةيشاح لىع دعقف هسفن .هدلو ميهاربإب (هلآو
englishText: From Murrah the freed slave of Muhammad bin Khalid who said: When Isma'il From Murrah the freed slave of Muhammad bin Khalid who said: When Isma'il passed away and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) came to the grave, he let himself down and sat on the edge of the grave and did not descend into the grave, then he said: This is how the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) did with his son Ibrahim.

chapter: Recommendation For The Husband To Descend Into The Grave Of His Wife Or One Who Used To See Her In Her Life, And The Descent Of The Guardian Or Whom He Commands In General
arabicText: لىص) الله لوسر نم ةنسلا تضم :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهتايح يف اهاري ناك نم لاإ اهربق لخدي لا ةأرملا نأ (هلآو هيلع الله
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: It was the established sunnah of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) that only those who saw a woman during her life should enter her grave.

chapter: Recommendation For The Husband To Descend Into The Grave Of His Wife Or One Who Used To See Her In Her Life, And The Descent Of The Guardian Or Whom He Commands In General
arabicText: .اهربق يف اهعضي ىتح هتأرمبا قحأ جوزلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The husband has more right over his wife until he places her in her grave.

chapter: Recommendation For The Husband To Descend Into The Grave Of His Wife Or One Who Used To See Her In Her Life, And The Descent Of The Guardian Or Whom He Commands In General
arabicText: يف ةأرملبا سانلا ىلوأ نوكي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نع ،هئباآ نع ،ليع نب ديز ثيدح قبس دقو .اهرخؤم
englishText: The hadith of Zayd bin Ali, from his forefathers, from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) has already been mentioned. He said: The closest person to a woman should be at her rear.

chapter: Recommendation For The Husband To Descend Into The Grave Of His Wife Or One Who Used To See Her In Her Life, And The Descent Of The Guardian Or Whom He Commands In General
arabicText: .هسأر ليي امم سانلا ىلوأ نكيلف هدحل يف هتعضو اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When you place him in his grave, let the closest of people be near his head.

chapter: Permission To Furnish The Grave With Cloth And Teak Wood When Needed, And To Cover It With Teak Wood
arabicText: شرفيف ةيدن ضرلأا نوكتو تيملا نادنع تام امبر هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ ىلإ للاب نب ليع بتك :لقا .زئاج كلذ :بتكف ؟كلذ زوجي لهف ،هيلع قبطي وأ جاسلبا ربقلا
englishText: Ali bin Bilal wrote to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him): Sometimes a person dies among us and the earth is wet, so the grave is lined with teak wood or is covered with it. Is this permissible? He wrote back: That is permissible.

chapter: Permission To Furnish The Grave With Cloth And Teak Wood When Needed, And To Cover It With Teak Wood
arabicText: .ةفيطقلا هربق يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىلوم نارقش ىقلأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Shuqran, the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), placed the velvet cloth in his grave.

chapter: Permission To Furnish The Grave With Cloth And Teak Wood When Needed, And To Cover It With Teak Wood
arabicText: ربقلا شرفي نأ يف قلاطإ (ملاسلا هيلع) ثلاثلا نسحلا يبأ نع يور دقو :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .جاسلبا تيملا لىع قبطيو جاسلبا
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husain said: It has been narrated from Abu Al-Hasan the Third (peace be upon him) permitting the covering of the grave with teak wood and layering teak wood over the deceased.

chapter: Permissibility Of Placing Clay And Bricks On The Grave
arabicText: لوسر ربق لىع (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع لعج :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا بلغت نب نباأ نع .لا :لقا ؟تيملا رضي له ارجآ هيلع لجرلا لعج نإ تيأرأ :تلقف ،انبل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله
englishText: From Aban ibn Taghlib who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: Ali (peace be upon him) placed a brick on the grave of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). So I asked: What do you think if a man places baked bricks on it, would it harm the deceased? He said: No.

chapter: It Is Recommended To Throw Soil With The Palm And Back Of The Hand Three Times And To Recite The Traditional Supplications
arabicText: ىلإ ىهتنا املف ،سانلا ءاش ام لا الله ءاش ام :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تيأر :لقا نامعنلا نب دواد نع .هديب تارم ثلاث بارتلا هيلع اثحف مقا هدحل تيملا لخدأ املف ،سلجف حىنت ربقلا
englishText: From Dawud bin al-Nu'man who said: I saw Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) saying: "Masha Allahu La Masha Annas" (What Allah wills, not what people will). When he reached the grave, he stepped aside and sat. When the deceased was placed in his grave, he stood up and threw soil on him three times with his hand.

chapter: It Is Recommended To Throw Soil With The Palm And Back Of The Hand Three Times And To Recite The Traditional Supplications
arabicText: مث ،هدي يف ةعاس هكسميف تيملا لىع بارتلا حرطي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تيأر :لقا ةنيذأ نب رمع نع ،كثعبب اقيدصتو ،كب نااميإ " :لوقأ تنك رمع يا :لاقف كلذ نع هتلأسف :لقا ،فكأ ةثلاث لىع ديزي لاو هحرطي ترج هبو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لعفي ناك اذكه " اميلستو - هلوق ىلإ ،هلوسرو الله دعو ام اذه .ةنسلا
englishText: From Umar ibn Udhaynah who said: I saw Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) placing soil on a deceased person, holding it in his hand for a moment, then throwing it, and not exceeding three handfuls. He said: So I asked him about that and he said: O Umar, I was saying: In belief in You, and affirming Your resurrection, this is what Allah and His Messenger promised, up to his words- and submission. This is how the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to do, and thus the sunnah was established.

chapter: It Is Recommended To Throw Soil With The Palm And Back Of The Hand Three Times And To Recite The Traditional Supplications
arabicText: هونفد نأ املف انباحصأ نم لجر ةزانج يف (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ عم تنك :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع فاج مهللا " :لقا مث ،ربقلا لىع هفك طسب مث هفكب ثالاث هسأر ليي امم هيلع اثحف هربق ىلإ (ملاسلا هيلع) مقا نم ةمحر نع هب هينغت ام كتمحر نم هربق نكسأو ،نااوضر كنم هقلو ،هحور كيلإ دعصأو ،هيبنج نع ضرلأا .ىضم مث " كاوس
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim who said: I was with Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) at the funeral of one of our companions. When they buried him, he (peace be upon him) From Muhammad bin Muslim who said: I was with Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) at the funeral of one of our companions. When they buried him, he (peace be upon him) stood at his grave and threw three handfuls of soil near his head with his palm, then spread his palm on the grave and said: "O Allah, keep the earth away from his sides, elevate his soul to You, grant him Your pleasure, and fill his grave with Your mercy that will make him needless of the mercy of others." Then he left.

chapter: It Is Recommended To Throw Soil With The Palm And Back Of The Hand Three Times And To Recite The Traditional Supplications
arabicText: ام اذه ،(١) كثعبب اقيدصتو كب نااميإ :لقف تيملا لىع بارتلا توثح اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع :لوقي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر تعمس :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقاو :لقا ،هلوسرو الله دعو .ةنسح ةرذ لكب الله هاطعأ لوقلا اذه :لقاو تيم لىع اثح نم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When you throw soil on the deceased, say: In belief in You and affirming Your resurrection, this is what Allah and His Messenger promised. He said: And Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) say: Whoever throws soil on a deceased and says these words, Allah will grant him a good deed for every particle.

chapter: It Is Recommended To Throw Soil With The Palm And Back Of The Hand Three Times And To Recite The Traditional Supplications
arabicText: لىع بارتلا اثحف ةزانج يف وهو (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تيأر :لقا انباحصأ ضعب نع ،غبصلأا نب دمحم نع .هيفك رهظب ربقلا
englishText: From Muhammad bin al-Asbagh, from some of our companions who said: I saw Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) at a funeral throwing soil on the grave with the backs of his hands.

chapter: Dislike Of Throwing Soil On The Grave Of A Child And Blood Relatives
arabicText: هيلع) الله دبع وبأ رضحف دلو (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ باحصأ ضعبل تام :لقا ةرارز نب ديبع نع هيلع حرطت لا :لقاو هيفكب (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ ذخفأ ،بارتلا هيلع حرطف هوبأ مدقت دحلأ املف ،(ملاسلا دلاولا حرطي نأ ىهن (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نفإ ،بارتلا هيلع حرطي لاف محر اذ هنم ناك نمو ،بارتلا ،بارتلا هتيم لىع محر وذ وأ كلذ نفإ ،مكماحرأ يوذ لىع بارتلا اوحرطت نأ مكاهنأ :لاقف ؟هدحو اذه نع نااهنتأ ،الله لوسر نب يا :انلقف .هبر نم دعب هبلق اسق نمو ،بلقلا يف ةوسقلا ثروي
englishText: From Ubayd ibn Zurarah who said: A child of one of Abu Abdullah's (peace be upon him) companions died, and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was present. When the burial niche was prepared, the father went forward to throw soil on it. Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) took his hands and said: Do not throw soil on him, and whoever is related to him by blood should not throw soil on him. For indeed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade a parent or blood relative from throwing soil on their deceased. We said: O son of the Messenger of Allah, do you forbid us from only this? He said: I forbid you from throwing soil on your blood relatives, for that causes hardness in the heart, and whoever's heart becomes hard becomes distant from his Lord.

chapter: Recommendation Of Making The Grave Square-Shaped And Raising It Four Fingers To A Span
arabicText: .عباصأ عبرأ ضرلأا قوف ربقلا عفريو ،هترفح لخدي نيح تيملل اعدي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Supplicate for the deceased when placed in their grave, and raise the grave above the ground by four fingers.

chapter: Recommendation Of Making The Grave Square-Shaped And Raising It Four Fingers To A Span
arabicText: لس (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تعمس :لقا ةدئاز نب ةمادق نع .هربق عفرو ،لاس هنبا ميهاربإ
englishText: From Qudamah bin Za'idah who said: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) drew out his son Ibrahim, and raised his grave.

chapter: Recommendation Of Making The Grave Square-Shaped And Raising It Four Fingers To A Span
arabicText: اذه يف ينفدا ،ليع يا :(ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ءاملا نم هيلع شرو ،عباصأ عبرأ ضرلأا نم يربق عفراو ،ناكملا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said to Ali (peace be upon him): O Ali, bury me in this place, raise my grave from the ground by four fingers, and sprinkle water on it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Making The Grave Square-Shaped And Raising It Four Fingers To A Span
arabicText: ضرلأا نم هربق عفريو ،ةبطر ةديرج هربق يف هعم لخدي نأ بحتسي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هنع لىخيو ،ءاملا هيلع حضنيو ،ةمومضم عباصأ عبرأ ردق
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: It is recommended to place with him in his grave a fresh palm branch, and raise his grave from the ground by the measure of four joined fingers, sprinkle water on it, and leave him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Making The Grave Square-Shaped And Raising It Four Fingers To A Span
arabicText: عفراو ،ينفكو ينلسغف تم ناأ ذإ :هضرم يف موي تاذ يل لقا يبأ نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ءاملبا هشرو ،عباصأ عبرأ يربق
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed my father said to me one day during his illness: When I die, wash me and shroud me, raise my grave four f ingers, and sprinkle it with water.

chapter: Recommendation Of Making The Grave Square-Shaped And Raising It Four Fingers To A Span
arabicText: عبرأ ضرلأا نم ربقلا عفرأ نأ ينرمأ يبأ نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا :لقا - ثيدح يف - يبلحلا نع .نسح ءاملبا ربقلا شر نأ ركذو ،تاجرفم عباصأ
englishText: From Al-Halabi- in a hadith- who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Indeed my father ordered me to raise the grave from the ground by four separated f ingers, and mentioned that sprinkling the grave with water is good.

chapter: Recommendation Of Making The Grave Square-Shaped And Raising It Four Fingers To A Span
arabicText: ءاملبا شرلا نأ ركذو ،تاجرفم عباصأ عبرأ هربق عافترا لعجأ نأ يبأ ينرمأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ربقلا تيملا تلخدأ اذإ أضوت :لقاو ،نسح
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: My father ordered me to make the height of his grave four separated fingers, and mentioned that sprinkling with water is good, and said: Perform ablution when you place the deceased in the grave.

chapter: Recommendation Of Making The Grave Square-Shaped And Raising It Four Fingers To A Span
arabicText: نأو ،ضرلأا نم اربش عفر (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ربق نأ ،(ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع .روبقلا شرب رمأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon them), that the grave of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was raised a hand span from the ground, and that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) ordered the sprinkling of graves.

chapter: Recommendation Of Making The Grave Square-Shaped And Raising It Four Fingers To A Span
arabicText: يبأ نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ماس لآ ىلوم لىعلأا دبع نع ،نمحرلا دبع نب سنوي نع :لاقف شيرق نم ةعبرأ هل توعدف ،ادوهش يل عدا :لقا ةفاولا هترضح املف كانه ام ينعدوتسا نأ هرمأو ،دمحم نب رفعج ىلإ ليع نب دمحم ىصوأو - لقا نأ ىلإ - هينب بوقعي هب ىصوأ ام اذه :بتكا نأ هرمأو ،دمحم نب رفعج ىلإ ليع نب دمحم ىصوأو - لقا نأ ىلإ - هينب بوقعي هب ىصوأ ام اذه :بتكا نأو ،عباصأ ةعبرأ هعفريو ،هربق عبري نأو ،هتمامعب هممعي نأو ،ةعمجلا هيف ليصي ناك يذلا هدرب يف هنفكي .هنفد دنع هرامطأ هنع لحي
englishText: From Yunus bin Abd al-Rahman, from Abdul A'la the freed slave of Al Sam's family, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: My father entrusted to me what was there, and when death approached him, he said: Call witnesses for me. So I called four from Quraysh for him, and he said: Write: This is what Jacob advised his sons- until he said- and Muhammad bin Ali advised to Ja'far bin Muhammad, and ordered him to shroud him in his cloak in which he used to pray Friday prayers, and to turban him with his turban, and to make his grave square, and raise it four fingers, and to loosen his wraps at his burial.

chapter: Recommendation Of Making The Grave Square-Shaped And Raising It Four Fingers To A Span
arabicText: ربش ردق ضرلأا نم عفر (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوس ربق نإ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع ،هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع .ءاملا ربقلا لىع شري نأ ةنسلاو :ليع لقا ،ءاملا هيلع شرو ،عباصأ عبرأو
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father, from Ali (peace be upon him), that the grave of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was raised from the ground the measure of a hand span and four fingers, and water was sprinkled on it. Ali said: And it is the Sunnah to sprinkle water on the grave.

chapter: Recommendation Of Making The Grave Square-Shaped And Raising It Four Fingers To A Span
arabicText: ةفورعملا ةربقملا ىلإ تلمح اذإ :لقا هنإ - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نسحلا يبأ نع .تاجرفم عباصأ عبرأ نم رثكأ يربق اوعفرت لاو ،اهب ينودحلفأ شيرق رباقمب
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: When I am carried to the cemetery known as the cemetery of Quraysh, make my grave with a side niche there, and do not raise my grave more than four spread fingers.

chapter: Recommendation Of Making The Grave Square-Shaped And Raising It Four Fingers To A Span
arabicText: ؟ربقلا عبري ةلع يلأ :تلق :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله يبأ نع ،هركذ نمع ،ديلولا نب نيسحلا نع :(للعلا) يفو .اعبرم لزن هنلأ ،تيبلا ةلعل :لقا
englishText: And in (Al-'Ilal): From Al-Husayn bin Al-Walid, from whom he mentioned, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said: I said: For what reason is the grave made square (*)? He said: For the reason of the House [Ka'bah], because it descended as square. Translator: * Murabba refers to a square but is also used broadly to refer to any rectangular or quadrilateral shape.

chapter: Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On The Grave Starting From The Head Side In A Circular Motion, Then On Its Middle, And Repeating The Sprinkling For Forty Days, Once Daily
arabicText: ىلإ سأرلا دنع نم أدبتو ةلبقلا لبقتست نأ ربقلا لىع ءاملا شر يف ةنسلا :لقا (لاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةنسلا كلذكف ،ربقلا طسو لىع شري مث ،رخلآا بناجلا نم ربقلا لىع رودت مث ،لجرلا دنع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The sunnah in sprinkling water on the grave is to face the Qiblah and start from the head side to the feet, then circle around the grave from the other side, then sprinkle on the middle of the grave, this is the sunnah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On The Grave Starting From The Head Side In A Circular Motion, Then On Its Middle, And Repeating The Sprinkling For Forty Days, Once Daily
arabicText: .بارتلا يف ىدنلا ماد ام باذعلا هنع ىفاجتي :لقا ربقلا لىع ءاملا شر يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding sprinkling water on the grave, he said: The punishment is kept away from him as long as the moisture remains in the soil.

chapter: Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On The Grave Starting From The Head Side In A Circular Motion, Then On Its Middle, And Repeating The Sprinkling For Forty Days, Once Daily
arabicText: .(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر دهع لىع ربقلا شر ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Sprinkling the grave was practiced during the time of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).

chapter: Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On The Grave Starting From The Head Side In A Circular Motion, Then On Its Middle, And Repeating The Sprinkling For Forty Days, Once Daily
arabicText: زمغتو هسأر دنع كدي عض مث ،هحضنفا ربقلا نم تغرف اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا :لقا ةرارز نع .حضنلا دعب هيلع كفك
englishText: From Zurarah who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: When you finish with the grave, sprinkle it, then place your hand at its head and press your palm on it after sprinkling.

chapter: Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On The Grave Starting From The Head Side In A Circular Motion, Then On Its Middle, And Repeating The Sprinkling For Forty Days, Once Daily
arabicText: .(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا دهع لىع ناك روبقلا لىع شرلا نإ ،(ملاسلا مهيلع) ليع نع ،هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father, from Ali (peace be upon them), that sprinkling on graves was practiced during the time of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).

chapter: Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On The Grave Starting From The Head Side In A Circular Motion, Then On Its Middle, And Repeating The Sprinkling For Forty Days, Once Daily
arabicText: باأ نفا ؟ربقلا اذه بحاص نم :لقاو بوقعي نب سنوي ربق نع هلأس ةربقملا بحاص نإ ،ديلولا نب دمحم نع يف ،اموي نيعبرأ وأ ،ارهش نيعبرأ هربق شرأ نأ ينرمأ هب يناصوأ (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا ىسوم نب ليع نسحلا .ةرم موي لك
englishText: From Muhammad bin Al-Waleed, that the caretaker of the cemetery asked him about the grave of Yunus bin Ya'qub and said: Who is the owner of this grave? For Abu Al Hasan Ali bin Musa Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) entrusted me with it and ordered me to sprinkle his grave for forty months, or forty days, once every day.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Hand On The Grave After Sprinkling Water Near The Head Facing The Qiblah, Spreading The Fingers And Pressing The Palm On It, And Emphasis Of Recommendation For Those Who Did Not Pray Over The Deceased
arabicText: عضف هربق ىوسو بارتلا هيلع يثح اذإو :لقا :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع .ءاملبا حضني ام دعب هيلع كفك زمغاو كعباصأ جرفو ،هسأر دنع هربق لىع كفك
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: When soil is poured and the grave is leveled, place your palm on his grave at his head, spread your fingers and press your palm on it after it is sprinkled with water.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Hand On The Grave After Sprinkling Water Near The Head Facing The Qiblah, Spreading The Fingers And Pressing The Palm On It, And Emphasis Of Recommendation For Those Who Did Not Pray Over The Deceased
arabicText: اورضح اذإ :ائيش نوعنصي انباحصأ نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا يبلأ تلق :لقا رامع نب قاحسإ نع لىع بجاو كلذ :لاقف ؟ةعدب مأ كلذ ةنسفأ ،ربقلا لىع مهيديأ اوحسمي ىتح اوعجري مل تيملا نفدو ةزانجلا .هيلع ةلاصلا رضحي مل نم
englishText: From Ishaq bin Ammar who said: I said to Abu al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him): Our companions do something: when they attend a funeral and the deceased is buried, they don't leave until they wipe their hands on the grave, is this a sunnah or an innovation? He said: This is obligatory for those who did not attend the prayer over him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Hand On The Grave After Sprinkling Water Near The Head Facing The Qiblah, Spreading The Fingers And Pressing The Palm On It, And Emphasis Of Recommendation For Those Who Did Not Pray Over The Deceased
arabicText: نوعضي :نادنع سانلا هعنصي ئش :(ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا يبلأ تلق :لقا قاحسإ نب دمحم نع .لاف ةلاصلا كردأ نم امفأ ،هيلع ةلاصلا كردي مل نمل كلذ امنإ :لقا ؟تيملا نفد اذإ ربقلا لىع مهيديأ ،هيلع لىص نمل هدكتأ مدعو ،هيلع ةلاصلا كردي مل نمل بابحتسلاا دكتأ لىع لومحم هلبق امو اذه :لوقأ .يتيأ امل ،هيلع لىص نمل هدكتأ مدعو ،هيلع ةلاصلا كردي مل نمل بابحتسلاا دكتأ لىع لومحم هلبق امو اذه :لوقأ .يتيأ امل
englishText: From Muhammad bin Ishaq who said: I said to Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (peace be upon him): People among us do something: they place their hands on the grave when the deceased is buried? He said: This is only for those who did not attend the prayer over him, but for those who attended the prayer, it is not. I (Hurr Amili) say: This and what precedes it is interpreted as emphasizing the recommendation for those who did not attend the prayer over him, and not emphasizing it for those who prayed over him, as will come.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Hand On The Grave After Sprinkling Water Near The Head Facing The Qiblah, Spreading The Fingers And Pressing The Palm On It, And Emphasis Of Recommendation For Those Who Did Not Pray Over The Deceased
arabicText: ينب نم تام نمب عنصي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع :نيملسملا نم دحبأ هعنصي لا ائيش ةصاخ مشاه ىرت ىتح ربقلا لىع هفك (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر عضو ءاملبا هربق حضنو يمشاهلا لىع لىص اذإ ناك لوسر فك رثأ هيلع ديدجلا ربقلا ىريف ةنيدملا لهأ نم رفاسملا وأ مدقي بيرغلا ناكف ،نيطلا يف هعباصأ .؟(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) دمحم لآ نم تام نم :لوقيف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to do something specifically for those who died from Bani Hashim that he wouldn't do for any other Muslim: When he prayed over a Hashimite and sprinkled their grave with water, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would place his palm on the grave until his fingers could be seen in the mud. When a stranger or traveler from Medina would come and see the new grave with the hand print of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), they would ask: Who has died from the family of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family)?

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Hand On The Grave After Sprinkling Water Near The Head Facing The Qiblah, Spreading The Fingers And Pressing The Palm On It, And Emphasis Of Recommendation For Those Who Did Not Pray Over The Deceased
arabicText: هعنص :لاقف ؟عنص ملو ؟وه ام ،ربقلا لىع هدي لجرلا عضو نع هتلأس :لقا الله دبع يبأ نب نمحرلا دبع نع ؟نيملسملا روبق لىع يدي عضأ فيك :هتلأسو :لقا .حضنلا دعب هنبا لىع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر .ةلبقلا لباقم وهو اهعفر مث اهيلع اهعضوو ضرلأا يف هديب راشفأ
englishText: From Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Abdullah who said: I asked him about a man placing his hand on the grave, what is it? And why is it done? He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) did it over his son after sprinkling. He said: And I asked him: How should I place my hand on Muslims' graves? He gestured with his hand to the ground and placed it on it then raised it while facing the Qiblah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Standing At The Grave, Supplicating For The Deceased With Transmitted Prayers, Reciting Surat Al-Qadr Seven Times, Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi And Dedicating Their Rewards To The Deceased
arabicText: ،هتدحو لص مهللا :لاقف ةعيشلا نم لجر ربق لىع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ مقا :لقا نلاجع نب الله دبع نع .كاوس نم ةمحر نع اهب ينغتسي ام كتمحر نم هيلإ نكسأو ،هتشحو سنآو
englishText: From Abdullah bin Ajlan who said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) stood at the grave of a man from the Shia and said: "O Allah, connect with his solitude, comfort his loneliness, and bestow upon him from Your mercy that which makes him needless of the mercy of anyone besides You."

chapter: Recommendation Of Standing At The Grave, Supplicating For The Deceased With Transmitted Prayers, Reciting Surat Al-Qadr Seven Times, Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi And Dedicating Their Rewards To The Deceased
arabicText: ةفوكلا لهأ نم لجر ربقب ناررمف ،عيقبلبا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ عم تررم :لقا مادقملا يبأ نب ورمع نع ينغتسي ام كتمحر نم هيلإ نكسأو ،هتدحو لصو ،هتبرغ محرا مهللا :لاقف هيلع فقوف :لقا ،ةعيشلا نم .هلاوتي ناك نمب هقحلأو ،كاوس نم ةمحر نع اهب
englishText: From Amr bin Abi Al-Miqdam who said: I passed by Al-Baqi' with Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), and we passed by the grave of a man from the people of Kufa from the Shia. He said: He stopped at it and said: "O Allah, have mercy on his estrangement, connect with his solitude, and bestow upon him from Your mercy that which makes him needless of the mercy of anyone besides You, and join him with those whom he used to love."

chapter: Recommendation Of Standing At The Grave, Supplicating For The Deceased With Transmitted Prayers, Reciting Surat Al-Qadr Seven Times, Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi And Dedicating Their Rewards To The Deceased
arabicText: مث :دازو ،هتشحو سنآو ،هتدحو لصو :لقا هنأ لاإ ،هلثم ،بوبحم نب نسحلا نع هدانسإب خيشلا هاورو .تارم عبس (ردقلا ةليل يف هانلزنأ ناإ) أرق
englishText: And Al-Shaykh narrated it through his chain from Al-Hasan bin Mahbub, similar to it, except that he said: "connect with his solitude, comfort his loneliness," and added: Then he recited "Indeed, We sent it down during the Night of Decree" (Surah Qadr) seven times.

chapter: Recommendation Of Standing At The Grave, Supplicating For The Deceased With Transmitted Prayers, Reciting Surat Al-Qadr Seven Times, Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi And Dedicating Their Rewards To The Deceased
arabicText: لهلأ هتءارق باوث لعجو يسركلا ةيآ نمؤملا أرق اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقا :لقا (هباتك) يف سارف يبأ نب مارو .ةمايقلا موي ىلإ هل حبسي اكلم فرح لك نم هل ىلاعت الله لعج روبقلا
englishText: Warram ibn Abi Firas reported in his book that he (peace be upon him) said: When a believer recites Ayat al-Kursi [Quran, 2:255-257] and dedicates the reward of its recitation to the people of the graves, Allah the Most High appoints for him an angel for each letter who glorifies Him on his behalf until the Day of Resurrection.

chapter: Recommendation For The Guardian To Instruct The Deceased With The Two Testimonies And Acknowledgment Of The Imams (Peace Be Upon Them) By Their Names After People's Departure
arabicText: نع اوؤردي نأ مكنم تيملا لهأ لىع ام :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا الله دبع نب ىيحي نع ؟عنصن فيك :تلق :لقا !؟ريكنو ركنم ءاقل مهتيم نلاف يا :هتوص لىعبأ يداني مث ،هسأر دنع همف عضيف ،هب سانلا ىلوأ هدنع فلختسيلف تيملا درفأ اذإ :لقا لا هدحو الله لاإ هلإ لا نأ ةداهش نم هيلع انتقرفا يذلا دهعلا لىع تنأ له ،نلاف تنب ةنلاف يا وأ ،نلاف نب هب ءاج ام نأو ،نييصولا ديسو نينمؤملا ريمأ ايلع نأو ،نييبنلا ديس هلوسرو هدبع ادمحم نأو ،هل كيرش ،روبقلا يف نم ثعبي الله نأو ،قح ثعبلاو ،قح توملا نأو ،قح دمحم .هتجح نقل دقف اذه نع انب فرصنا :ريكنل ركنم لوقيف :لقا
englishText: From Yahya bin Abdullah who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: What prevents the family of your deceased from averting their dead from meeting Munkar and Nakir?! I said: How should we do it?
