He said: When the deceased is alone, let the closest person to him stay behind, put his mouth near his head, then call out in his loudest voice: O so-and-so son of so-and-so, or O so-and-so daughter of so-and-so, are you still upon the covenant which you left us upon of testifying that there is no god but Allah alone with no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger and master of prophets, and that Ali is Amir al-Mu'minin and master of successors, and that what Muhammad brought is truth, and that death is truth, and resurrection is truth, and that Allah will resurrect those in the graves. He said: Then Munkar will say to Nakir: Let us leave this one, for he has been instructed of his hujjah (proof).

chapter: Recommendation For The Guardian To Instruct The Deceased With The Two Testimonies And Acknowledgment Of The Imams (Peace Be Upon Them) By Their Names After People's Departure
arabicText: دنع فلختي نأ هربق نع فرصناو هيلع ىوسو هتيم نفد اذإ مكدحأ لىع ام :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع :لوقي مث هربق الله لىص) الله لوسر ادمحم نأو ،الله لاإ هلإ لا نأ ةداهش نم هب كنادهع يذلا دهعلا لىع تنأ ،نلاف نب نلاف يا !؟مهرخآ لىع يتيأ ىتح ،نلافو نلافو ،كمامإ (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ ايلع نأو ،(هلآو هيلع ،هتجح نقل دق هنفإ ،هياإ انتلأسمو هيلإ لوصولا انيفك دق :هبحاصل نيكلملا دحأ لقا كلذ لعف اذإ هنفإ .هيلإ نلاخدي لاو هنع نفارصنيف
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: What prevents any of you, when you have buried your dead and leveled their grave and departed from it, to stay behind at their grave and say: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: What prevents any of you, when you have buried your dead and leveled their grave and departed from it, to stay behind at their grave and say: O so-and-so son of so-and-so, are you upon the covenant we entrusted you with of testifying that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and that Ali Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) is your Imam, and so-and-so and so-and-so, until mentioning the last of them?! When he does that, one of the two angels says to his companion: We have been spared from reaching him and questioning him, for he has been instructed of his proof, so they depart from him and do not enter upon him.

chapter: Recommendation For The Guardian To Instruct The Deceased With The Two Testimonies And Acknowledgment Of The Imams (Peace Be Upon Them) By Their Names After People's Departure
arabicText: ،هنع سانلا فارصنا دعب هب سانلا ىلوأ تيملا ربق دنع فلختي نأ يغبني :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هربق يف ةلأسملا تيملا ىفك كلذ لعف اذفإ ،هتوص عيفرب هنقليو هيفكب بارتلا لىع ضبقيو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The closest person to the deceased should stay behind at his grave after people depart, grab the soil with his palms, and instruct him in a loud voice. When he does that, the deceased will be spared the questioning in his grave.

chapter: Dislike Of Placing On The Grave Other Than Its Own Soil
arabicText: .هنم جرخي مل بارت ربقلا لىع دازي نأ ىهن (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) prohibited adding soil to the grave that did not come from it.

chapter: Dislike Of Placing On The Grave Other Than Its Own Soil
arabicText: .هنيط ريغ نم ربقلا اونيطت لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع دانسلاا اذهبو
englishText: And with this chain of narration from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Do not clay the grave with clay other than its own.

chapter: Dislike Of Placing On The Grave Other Than Its Own Soil
arabicText: وهف ربقلا بارت ريغ نم ربقلا لىع لعج ام لك :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .تيملا لىع لقث
englishText: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Husain said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Everything that is placed on the grave from other than the grave's soil is a burden upon the deceased.

chapter: Permissibility Of Placing Pebbles And Tablets On The Grave And Writing The Name Of The Deceased On It.
arabicText: .ءارمح ءابصح بصحم (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ربق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The grave of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was covered with red pebbles.

chapter: Permissibility Of Placing Pebbles And Tablets On The Grave And Writing The Name Of The Deceased On It.
arabicText: هل تتام ةنيدملا ىلإ ىضمو دادغب نم (ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم نسحلا وبأ عجر امل :لقا بوقعي نب سنوي نع .ربقلا يف هلعجيو اهمسا حول لىع بتكيو اهربق صصجي نأ هيلاوم ضعب رمأو اهنفدف ،ديفب ،ةنبا
englishText: From Yunus ibn Ya'qub who said: When Abu al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) returned from Baghdad and proceeded to Medina, a daughter of his died in Fayd, so he buried her and ordered some of his followers to plaster her grave and write her name on a tablet and place it in the grave.

chapter: Permissibility Of Placing Pebbles And Tablets On The Grave And Writing The Name Of The Deceased On It.
arabicText: هيلع) يدهملا مأ نأ :- ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم يبلأ ةيراج نع ،ينارزيخلا ليع يبأ نع هيلع) دمحم مأ ربق اذه :هيلع بوتكم حول اهربق لىعو (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم يبأ ةايح يف تتام (ملاسلا .(ملاسلا
englishText: From Abu Ali al-Khayzurani, from a maidservant of Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him)- in a hadith: That the mother of al-Mahdi (peace be upon him) died during the lifetime of Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him) and on her grave was a tablet with writing on it: This is the grave of the mother of Muhammad (peace be upon him).

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Woman In The Grave Sideways And Having Her Guardian At Her Feet
arabicText: ناك نإ ربقلا تيملا تلخدأ اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا :لقا ،ثيدحلا عفر ،نوراه نب دمصلا دبع نع .رتسأ هنفإ ،اضرع ذخؤت ةأرملاو ،لاس لسي لاجر
englishText: From Abd al-Samad bin Harun, raising (to) the (level of a) hadith, who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: When you place the deceased in the grave, if it is a man, he should be placed in a straight manner, and the woman should be placed sideways, as it is more concealing.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Woman In The Grave Sideways And Having Her Guardian At Her Feet
arabicText: لاس لجرلا لسي :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) بلاط يبأ نب ليع نينمؤملا ريمأ نع ،هئباآ نع ،ليع نب ديز نع .اهرخؤم يف ةأرملبا سانلا ىلوأ نوكيو ،لاابقتسا ةأرملا لبقتستو
englishText: From Zayd bin Ali, from his forefathers, from Amir al-Mu'minin Ali bin Abi Talib (peace be upon them) who said: The man should be placed straight and the woman should be placed facing sideways, and the closest person to the woman should be at her feet.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Burying A Disbeliever, Even If He Is The Father Of A Muslim, Except A Dhimmi Woman Pregnant From A Muslim. The One With Kumaysh Al-Dhakar Should Be Buried.
arabicText: لا :لقا ؟توميف نيملسملا عم وهو رفسلا يف نوكي ينارصنلا نع لئس هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هباأ ناك نإو ،هربق لىع موقي لاو ،هنفدي لاو ،ةمارك لاو ملسم هلسغي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he was asked about a Christian who is traveling with Muslims and then dies? He said: A Muslim should neither wash his body nor honor him, nor bury him, nor attend his grave, even if he was his father.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Burying A Disbeliever, Even If He Is The Father Of A Muslim, Except A Dhimmi Woman Pregnant From A Muslim. The One With Kumaysh Al-Dhakar Should Be Buried.
arabicText: لمحتف اهعقاويف ةينارصنلاو ةيدوهيلا ةيراجلا هل نوكت لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا تلأس :لقا سنوي نع اهعم نفديأ ،دلولا تامو اهنطب يف دلولاو قلطت يهو تتامف اهتدلاو نادف هيلع ىبأتف ملست نأ ىلإ اهوعدي مث .اهعم نفدي :بتكف ؟ملاسلاا ةرطف لىع نفديو اهنم جرخي وأ ؟ةينارصنلا لىع
englishText: From Yunus who said: I asked Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about a man who has a Jewish or Christian slave girl whom he has intercourse with and she becomes pregnant, then he invites her to accept Islam but she refuses, and when her delivery approaches she dies while in labor with the child still in her womb, and the child also dies- should the child be buried with her according to Christianity? Or should it be removed from her and buried according to the natural disposition of Islam? He wrote: It should be buried with her.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Burying A Disbeliever, Even If He Is The Father Of A Muslim, Except A Dhimmi Woman Pregnant From A Muslim. The One With Kumaysh Al-Dhakar Should Be Buried.
arabicText: ،هريغص يأ ،ركذلا شيمك ةاراومب رمأ ردب موي يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع .سانلا مارك يف لاإ نوكي لا هنإ :لقاو
englishText: From Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him): The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) on the day of Badr ordered the burial of the (ones with) kumaysh al-dhakar (*), meaning the small penis, and said: This condition is only found among noble/ honorable people. Translator: * The term 'kumaysh al-dhakar' is explicitly defined in the hadith itself as meaning "small male organ." The hadith suggests that this physical characteristic was considered a sign of nobility or honor, rather than something shameful.

chapter: If Someone Dies At Sea And Cannot Be Buried On Land, It Is Obligatory To Place Him In A Container, Tie Its Head, Or Weight It, And Release It Into The Water
arabicText: عنصي فيك ،رحبلا يف ةنيفسلا يف وهو تام لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لئس :لقا رحلا نب بويأ نع .ءاملا يف حرطتو اهسأر أكويو ةيباخ يف عضوي :لقا ؟هب
englishText: From Ayoub bin Al-Hurr who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was asked about a man who died while on a ship at sea, what should be done with him? He said: He should be placed in a jar, its head should be tied, and thrown into the water.

chapter: If Someone Dies At Sea And Cannot Be Buried On Land, It Is Obligatory To Place Him In A Container, Tie Its Head, Or Weight It, And Release It Into The Water
arabicText: لسغ رحبلا يف تيملا تام اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ءاملا يف هب ىمريو رجح هيلجر يف قثوي مث ،هيلع لىصي مث ،طنحو نفكو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'mineen (peace be upon him) said: If the deceased dies at sea, he should be washed, shrouded and embalmed, then prayed upon, then a stone should be tied to his feet and he should be thrown into the water.

chapter: If Someone Dies At Sea And Cannot Be Buried On Land, It Is Obligatory To Place Him In A Container, Tie Its Head, Or Weight It, And Release It Into The Water
arabicText: لىصيو نفكيو لسغي :لاقف ،رحبلا يف موقلا عم تومي لجرلا يف لقا هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رحبلا يف هب ىمريو لقثيو ،هيلع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), that he said regarding a man who dies with people at sea, he said: He should be washed, shrouded and prayed upon, then weighted and thrown into the sea.

chapter: If Someone Dies At Sea And Cannot Be Buried On Land, It Is Obligatory To Place Him In A Container, Tie Its Head, Or Weight It, And Release It Into The Water
arabicText: يف طنحيو نفكي :لقا ،طشلا لىع ردقي ملو ةنيفسلا يف لجرلا تام اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ءاملا يف ىقليو بوث
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If a man dies on a ship and cannot reach the shore, he said: He should be shrouded and embalmed in a cloth and thrown into the water.

chapter: Permissibility Of Weighing Down The Dead And Throwing Them In Water When Fearing Enemy Exhumation And Burning, Even If Death Or Killing Occurred Away From Water
arabicText: هيف متعضو يذلا عضوملا ىلإ مكاعد ام :لاقف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ ينلأس :لقا دلاخ نب ناميلس نع ناحبس :لاقف ،رجح ةفذق :تلقف ؟هيف هومتعضو يذلا عضوملا نم تارفلا ىلإ مك - لقا نأ ىلإ - ؟اديز !؟لضفأ ناكو ،تارفلا يف هومتفذقو اديدح هومترقوأ متنك لافأ ،الله
englishText: From Sulayman bin Khalid who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) asked me saying: What led you to the place where you placed Zayd?- until he said- How far is it from the Euphrates to the place where you placed him? I said: A stone's throw. He said: Glory be to Allah, why didn't you weigh him down with iron and throw him in the Euphrates? That would have been better!

chapter: Permissibility Of Weighing Down The Dead And Throwing Them In Water When Fearing Enemy Exhumation And Burning, Even If Death Or Killing Occurred Away From Water
arabicText: اوناك مهنإ :تلق ؟ديز يمعب متعنص فيك :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ يل لقا :لقا دلاخ نب ناميلس نع ليخلا تلاج اوحبصأ املف ،تارفلا ئطاش لىع فرح يف هانفدف هتبشج ناذخأ سانلا فش املف هنوسرحي .هلتقا الله نعلو هيلع الله لىص !؟تارفلا يف هومتيقلأو اديدح هومترقوأ لاأ :لاقف ،هوقرحفأ هودجوف هنوبلطي
englishText: From Sulayman bin Khalid who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said to me: What did you do with my uncle Zayd? I said: They were guarding him, and when people dispersed, we took his body and buried him at an edge by the Euphrates bank. When morning came, the cavalry searched for him, found him, and burned him. He said: Why didn't you weigh him down with iron and throw him in the Euphrates?! May Allah's blessings be upon him and may Allah curse his killer.

chapter: Dislike Of Carrying A Man And Woman On A Single Bier
arabicText: ةزانج لىع نيتيملا لعجي نأ زوجيأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم يبأ ىلإ تبتك :لقا رافصلا نسحلا نب دمحم نع لىصيو دحاو ريرس لىع نلامحي ةأرماو لاجر ناتيملا ناك نإو ؟سانلا ةلقو ةجاحلا عضوم يف ةدحاو .دحاو ريرس لىع ةأرملا عم لجرلا لمحي لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) عقوف ؟امهيلع
englishText: From Muhammad bin Al-Hasan Al-Saffar who said: I wrote to Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him): Is it permissible to place two dead people on a single bier when needed and there are few people? And if the two deceased are a man and a woman, can they be carried on a single bier and the funeral prayer be performed for them? He (peace be upon him) replied: A man should not be carried with a woman on a single bier.

chapter: Prohibition Of Exhuming Graves, Raising Them In A Dome Shape, And The Ruling On Burying Two Dead In One Grave
arabicText: .ملاسلاا نع جرخ دقف لااثم لثم وأ اربق ددج نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا نييطت لاو ربقلا ديدجت زوجي لا :لقا هنأو ،ميجلبا " ددج " هاور هنأ رافصلا نع هريغو خيشلا لقن :لوقأ .روبقلا رئاس مري نأ زئاجف هربق نيطو تيم تام اذإ نكلو ،نيط ام دعبو ميالأا رورم دعب هعيمج هاور " هنأ يقربلا نعو .اربق منس نم هب ينعي ،ةمجعملا ريغ ءاحلبا " ددح " هاور هنأ الله دبع نب دعس نعو نلا ،رخآ ناسنلاا اربق ىرخأ ةعفد ربقلا لعجي نأ هانعم نوكي نأ نكميو ،ءاثلاو ميجلبا " اربق ثدج نم .ربقلا ثدجلا .اربق شبن هانعمو ميجلبا ددج نم وه امنإ :قودصلا لقاو ،قشلا وه دخلاو ،(دودخلأا باحصأ لتق) :ىلاعت هلوق نم نيلادلاو ةمجعملا ءاخلبا " ددخ " هنأ ديفملا نعو ،شبنلا ةهج لىع وأ ،هيف نفديل امإ ربقلا قش لوانت يهنلفا .ملعأ اللهو ،ةياورلا ددعتو عيمجلا ةحص دعبي لاو
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Whoever renews a grave or creates a statue has left Islam. I (Hurr Amili) say: Al-Shaykh and others transmitted from al-Saffar that he narrated it as "jaddada" with jim, and he said: It is not permissible to renew the grave or to plaster all of it after days have passed and after it has been plastered, but if someone dies and their grave is plastered, it is permissible to repair the rest of the graves. From Sa'd ibn Abdullah that he narrated it as "haddada" with unpointed ha, meaning to raise a grave in a dome shape. And from al-Barqi that he "narrated it as man jadatha qabran" with jim and tha, and it's possible its meaning is to make the grave again a grave for another person, because jadath means grave. Al-Saduq said: It is actually "jaddada" with jim and it means to exhume a grave. From al-Mufid that it is "khaddada" with pointed kha and two dals from His saying (May the people of the ditch perish) [Quran, 85:4], and khadd means split, so the prohibition includes splitting the grave either to bury in it, or for the purpose of exhumation. It is not far-fetched that all versions are correct and the narration has multiple variants, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Prohibition Of Exhuming Graves, Raising Them In A Dome Shape, And The Ruling On Burying Two Dead In One Grave
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ينثعب :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هتلتق لاإ ابلك لاو ،هتيوس لاإ اربق لاو ،اهتوحم لاإ ةروص عدت لا :لاقف ةنيدملا ىلإ (هلآو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) sent me to Medina and said: Do not leave any image without erasing it, nor a raised grave without leveling it, nor a dog without killing it.

chapter: Dislike Of Building Over Graves Except For The Prophet's (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) And The Imams' (Peace Be Upon Them) Graves, And Sitting On Them, Plastering Them With Gypsum And Clay
arabicText: له هيلع سولجلاو ربقلا لىع ءانبلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم نسحلا باأ تلأس :لقا رفعج نب ليع نع .هنييطت لاو هصيصجت لاو سولجلا لاو هيلع ءانبلا حلصي لا :لقا ؟حلصي
englishText: Ali ibn Ja'far said: I asked Abu Al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) about building over graves and sitting on them, is it permissible? He said: Neither building over it, nor sitting on it, nor plastering it with gypsum or clay is permissible.

chapter: Dislike Of Building Over Graves Except For The Prophet's (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) And The Imams' (Peace Be Upon Them) Graves, And Sitting On Them, Plastering Them With Gypsum And Clay
arabicText: وأ ،هيلع دعقي وأ ،ربق لىع لىصي نأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىهن :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هيلع ىنبي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) prohibited praying at a grave, or sitting on it, or building over it.

chapter: Dislike Of Building Over Graves Except For The Prophet's (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) And The Imams' (Peace Be Upon Them) Graves, And Sitting On Them, Plastering Them With Gypsum And Clay
arabicText: الله لىص) الله لوسر نفإ ،تويبلا فوقس اوروصت لاو روبقلا لىع اونبت لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .كلذ هرك (هلآو هيلع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Do not build over graves and do not paint house ceilings, for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) disliked that.

chapter: Dislike Of Building Over Graves Except For The Prophet's (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) And The Imams' (Peace Be Upon Them) Graves, And Sitting On Them, Plastering Them With Gypsum And Clay
arabicText: صصجي نأ ىهن هنأ - يهانملا ثيدح يف - (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نع ،هئباآ نع ،قداصلا نع .رباقملا
englishText: From Al-Sadiq, from his forefathers, from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)- in the hadith of prohibitions- that he prohibited plastering graves with gypsum.

chapter: Dislike Of Building Over Graves Except For The Prophet's (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) And The Imams' (Peace Be Upon Them) Graves, And Sitting On Them, Plastering Them With Gypsum And Clay
arabicText: صيصقت نع ىهن هنأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نع هعفر (ديبع نب مساقلا نع) زيزعلا دبع نب ليع نع .صيصجتلا وهو :لقا ،روبقلا
englishText: From Ali ibn Abdul Aziz (from Al-Qasim ibn Ubayd) raising it to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) that he prohibited plastering graves, he said: and it means plastering with gypsum.

chapter: Dislike Of Building Over Graves Except For The Prophet's (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) And The Imams' (Peace Be Upon Them) Graves, And Sitting On Them, Plastering Them With Gypsum And Clay
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ينثعب :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .روصلا رسكو روبقلا مده يف (هلآو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) sent me to demolish graves and break images.

chapter: Dislike Of Building Over Graves Except For The Prophet's (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) And The Imams' (Peace Be Upon Them) Graves, And Sitting On Them, Plastering Them With Gypsum And Clay
arabicText: .هتيوس لاإ اربق لاو ،اهتوحم لاإ ةروص عدت لا :- ثيدح يف - مدقت دقو يفاني لاف ميرحتلا يفن لىع لاد وهو ،ءابصحلا عضو ثيدح يف صيصجتلا زاوج لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ بابحتسا لىع لدي ام يتيأو .هنيط ريغب ربقلا نييطت ةهارك لىع لدي ام مدقت دقو .خيشلا هركذ ،ةهاركلا .(ملاسلا مهيلع) ةمئلأاو يبنلا روبق ةرامع
englishText: And it was previously mentioned- in a hadith-: Do not leave any image except that you erase it, nor any raised grave except that you level it. I (Hurr Amili) say: And there has preceded evidence indicating the permissibility of plastering in the hadith about placing pebbles, which indicates the absence of prohibition and thus does not contradict it being disliked, as mentioned by the Shaykh. And there has preceded evidence indicating the dislike of plastering the grave with other than its own soil. And there will come evidence indicating the recommendation of maintaining the graves of the Prophet and the Imams (peace be upon them).

chapter: Recommendation Of Not Sitting For Those Who Follow The Funeral Until The Deceased Is Placed In Their Grave And That It Is Not Prohibited
arabicText: يف عضو اذفإ ،هدحل يف عضوي ىتح سلجي لا نأ ةزانج عيش نمل يغبني :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .سولجلبا سبا لاف هدحل
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: It is appropriate for whoever follows a funeral not to sit until the deceased is placed in their grave. When they are placed in their grave, then there is no problem with sitting.

chapter: Recommendation Of Not Sitting For Those Who Follow The Funeral Until The Deceased Is Placed In Their Grave And That It Is Not Prohibited
arabicText: املف سلجف حىنت ربقلا ىلإ ىهتنا امل (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ نأ نامعنلا نب دواد ثيدح يف قبس دقو .ةيلضفلأا لىع لولأاو زاوجلا لىع لدي اذه :لوقأ .بارتلا هيلع اثحف مقا هدحل تيملا لخدأ
englishText: And it has preceded in the hadith of Dawud bin al-Nu'man that Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) when he reached the grave, he moved aside and sat. When the deceased was placed in the grave, he stood up and threw soil over it. I (Hurr Amili) say: This indicates permissibility while the first indicates preference.

chapter: Recommendation Of Offering Condolences To Men And Women, Especially To Bereaved Mothers
arabicText: يسك انيزح ىزع نم :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،الله دبع يبأ نع .اهب ربحي ةلح فقوملا يف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever consoles a grieving person will be clothed in the standing place with a garment that will bring him joy.

chapter: Recommendation Of Offering Condolences To Men And Women, Especially To Bereaved Mothers
arabicText: هرجأ لثم هل ناك بااصم ىزع نم :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ائيش باصملا رجأ نم صقتني نأ ريغ نم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever consoles an afflicted person will receive the same reward as them without any decrease in the reward of the afflicted person.

chapter: Recommendation Of Offering Condolences To Men And Women, Especially To Bereaved Mothers
arabicText: لىكثلا ىزع نمل ام بر يا :لقا هبر (ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم هب جىنا اميف ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ليظ لاإ لظ لا موي ليظ يف هلظأ :لقا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Among what Moses (peace be upon him) privately conversed with his Lord was: "O Lord, what is for the one who consoles a bereaved mother?" He said: "I will shade them in My shade on a day when there is no shade except My shade."

chapter: Recommendation Of Offering Condolences To Men And Women, Especially To Bereaved Mothers
arabicText: فقوملا يف يسك انيزح ىزع نم :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهبابحي ةلح
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever consoles a grieving person will be clothed in the standing place with a garment that they will be delighted with.

chapter: Recommendation Of Offering Condolences To Men And Women, Especially To Bereaved Mothers
arabicText: .هلظ لاإ لظ لا موي هشرع لظ يف الله هلظأ لىكثلا ىزع نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا هيبأ نع
englishText: From his father who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Whoever consoles a bereaved mother, Allah will shade them in the shade of His throne on a day when there is no shade except His shade.

chapter: Recommendation Of Offering Condolences To Men And Women, Especially To Bereaved Mothers
arabicText: .ةنجلا ثروت ةيزعتلا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Offering condolences leads to Paradise.

chapter: Recommendation Of Offering Condolences To Men And Women, Especially To Bereaved Mothers
arabicText: .اهب ربحي ةلح فقوملا يف يسك انمؤم ىزع نم :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he said: Whoever consoles a believer will be clothed in the standing place with a garment that will bring them joy.

chapter: Recommendation Of Offering Condolences To Men And Women, Especially To Bereaved Mothers
arabicText: :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،هيبأ نع ،قداصلا دمحم نب رفعج نع .ةنجلا ثروت ةيزعتلا
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad As-Sadiq, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Offering condolences leads to Paradise.

chapter: Recommendation Of Offering Condolences To Men And Women, Especially To Bereaved Mothers
arabicText: .اهب ربحي ةلح فقوملا يف يسك انيزح ىزع نم :لقا دانسلاا اذهبو
englishText: And with the same chain of narrators he said: Whoever consoles a grieving person will be clothed with a garment in the standing place (on the Day of Judgment) that will bring him joy.

chapter: Recommendation Of Offering Condolences Before And After The Burial
arabicText: .هدعبو نفدلا لبق يزعي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم تيأر :لقا مكحلا نب ماشه نع نبا نع ،اعيمج ناذاش نب لضفلا نع ،ليعامسإ نب دمحم نعو ،هيبأ نع ،ميهاربإ نب ليع نع ينيلكلا هاورو .مكحلا نب ماشه نع ،ريمع يبأ
englishText: From Hisham bin Al-Hakam who said: I saw Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) offering condolences before and after the burial. Al-Kulayni narrated it from Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, and from Muhammad bin Isma'il, from Al-Fadhl bin Shadhan altogether, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham bin Al-Hakam.

chapter: Emphasis Of Recommending Condolence After Burial, Hastening Departure From The Grave, And That It Suffices In Condolence For The Bereaved To See You
arabicText: .نفدي امدعب ةبيصملا لهلأ ةيزعتلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Offering condolences to the bereaved family is after the burial.

chapter: Emphasis Of Recommending Condolence After Burial, Hastening Departure From The Grave, And That It Suffices In Condolence For The Bereaved To See You
arabicText: ثدح تيملا يف ثدحي لا نوفرصني مث ربقلا دنع لاإ ةيزعتلا سيل :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .توصلا نوعمسيف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: There is no condolence except at the grave, then they leave so that nothing happens regarding the deceased that makes them hear sounds (*). Translator: (*) The deceased can still hear and be aware of their surroundings for a period after burial. Extended or excessive public mourning and loud expressions of grief that would create a spectacle is discouraged.

chapter: Emphasis Of Recommending Condolence After Burial, Hastening Departure From The Grave, And That It Suffices In Condolence For The Bereaved To See You
arabicText: .دكؤملا بابحتسلاا بوجولبا دارملا :لوقأ .نفدلا دعب ةبجاولا ةيزعتلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The obligatory condolence is after the burial. I (Hurr Amili) say: What is meant by obligation is emphatic recommendation.

chapter: Emphasis Of Recommending Condolence After Burial, Hastening Departure From The Grave, And That It Suffices In Condolence For The Bereaved To See You
arabicText: .ةبيصملا بحاص كاري نأ ةيزعتلا نم كافك :لقاو ،نفدلا دعب ةبجاولا ةيزعتلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: The obligatory condolence visit is after the burial, and he said: It is sufficient for condolence that the bereaved person sees you.

chapter: Etiquette Of Offering Condolences And The Recommendation Of Supplicating For The Bereaved Family To Be Consoled And Compensated
arabicText: نم كل ريخ الله باوثو ،كنم كنبلا ريخ لجو زع الله :لاقف هل نببا لاجر (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ ىزع ،كنبا !؟ةوسأ هب كل امف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر تام دق :هل لاقف هيلإ داع دعب هعزج هغلب املف لوسر ةعافشو ،الله ةمحرو ،الله لاإ هلإ لا نأ ةداهش :لاصخ ثلاث همامأ نإ :لاقف اقهارم ناك هنإ :لاقف .الله ءاش نإ نهنم ةدحاو هتوفت نلف ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) consoled a man for his son and said: Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, is better for your son than you, and the reward of Allah is better for you than your son. When he (the Imam) was informed of his (the man's) grief afterwards, he (the Imam) went back to him and said to him: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) has died, so do you not have an example in him? He (the man) said: He (my son) was an adolescent. He (the Imam) said: Ahead of him are three qualities: testifying that there is no god but Allah, the mercy of Allah, and the intercession of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). He (your son) will not miss any of them, Allah willing.

chapter: Etiquette Of Offering Condolences And The Recommendation Of Supplicating For The Bereaved Family To Be Consoled And Compensated
arabicText: ناك هنأ تركذو ،كنبا ليعب كتبيصم تركذ :لجر ىلإ (ملاسلا هيلع) يناثلا رفعج وبأ بتك :لقا نارهم نبا نع باصملا رجأ هب مظعيل هلهأ دنع ام كىزأ هريغو دلولا نم ذخيأ امنإ لجو زع الله كلذكو ،كيلإ كدلو بحأ نأ وجرأو ،فلخلبا كيلع الله لجعو ،ريدق هنإ ،كبلق لىع هطبرو كازع نسحأو كرجأ الله مظعفأ ،ةبيصملبا .الله ءاش نإ لعف دق الله نوكي
englishText: From Ibn Mihran who said: Abu Ja'far the Second (peace be upon him) wrote to a man: You mentioned your affliction with your son Ali, and you mentioned that he was the most beloved of your children to you. That is how Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, takes from the children and others the purest of what their family has, so that He may greatly reward the one afflicted with the calamity. May Allah magnify your reward, improve your consolation, and strengthen your heart with it. He is From Ibn Mihran who said: Abu Ja'far the Second (peace be upon him) wrote to a man: You mentioned your affliction with your son Ali, and you mentioned that he was the most beloved of your children to you. That is how Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, takes from the children and others the purest of what their family has, so that He may greatly reward the one afflicted with the calamity. May Allah magnify your reward, improve your consolation, and strengthen your heart with it. He is capable. May Allah hasten the compensation for you, and I hope that Allah has done so, Allah willing.

chapter: Etiquette Of Offering Condolences And The Recommendation Of Supplicating For The Bereaved Family To Be Consoled And Compensated
arabicText: الله ربج :لاقف ،ةبيصمب اوبيصأ دق اموق (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ ىتأ :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .فرصنا مث ،مكفاوتم محرو مكازع نسحأو مكنهو .يناعملا هذه لىع ةلمتشم ةريثك مهريغو مهباحصلأ (ملاسلا مهيلع) ةمئلأا ةيزعتو :لوقأ
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) came to a group of people who had been afflicted with a calamity and said: May Allah console your weakness, improve your consolation, and have mercy on your deceased. Then he left. I (Hurr Amili) say: The condolences of the Imams (peace be upon them) to their companions and others are many, including these meanings.

chapter: Recommendation Of Covering The Grave With A Cloth When Placing The Deceased In It If It Is A Woman, And Its Permissibility For A Man
arabicText: ىشغي لاو بوثلبا ةأرملا ربق ىشغي :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم نب رفعج تعمس :لقا بلاك نب رفعج نع .كلذ ركني ملف دهاش (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلاو بوث ذاعم نب دعس ربق لىع دم دقو ،لجرلا ربق
englishText: From Ja'far bin Kilab who said: I heard Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon him) say: The grave of a woman should be covered with a cloth, but the grave of a man should not be covered. A cloth was spread over the grave of Sa'd bin Mu'adh while the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was present, and he did not disapprove of that.

chapter: Obligation Of Abandoning And Making A Well A Grave If A Muslim Dies In A Narrow Well And It Is Not Possible To Extract Him
arabicText: نكمي ملف هيف تامف لجر هيف عقو جرحم رئب يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،هبايس نب ءلاعلا نع جرخأ هجارخإ نكمأ نإو ،اربق لعجيو ،لطعي ،هيف أضوتي لا :لقا ؟رئبلا كلت يف أضوتيأ ،رئبلا نم هجارخإ .ءاوس حي وهو هتمرحك اتيم ملسملا ةمرح :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا ،نفدو لسغو
englishText: From Al-Ala' bin Siyabah, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding a narrow well in which a man fell and died and it was not possible to extract him from the well, can one perform ablution in that well? He said: One should not perform ablution in it. It should be abandoned and made into a grave. If it is possible to extract him, he should be extracted, washed, and buried. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: The sanctity of a Muslim when dead is the same as his sanctity when alive.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using A Bier For Carrying The Deceased, Particularly Emphasized For Women
arabicText: تنب (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا :لقا ؟شعنلا هل لعج نم لوأ نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about who was the f irst person for whom a bier was made? He said: Fatima (peace be upon her), daughter of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).

chapter: Recommendation Of Using A Bier For Carrying The Deceased, Particularly Emphasized For Women
arabicText: تكتشا اهنإ (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا شعن ملاسلاا يف ثدحأ شعن لوأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ؟ينرتسي ائيش يل نيلعجت لاأ ،يمحل بهذف تلحن ينإ :ءامسلأ لقاو اهيف تضبق يتلا اهتاكش ،كل تعنص كبجعأ نفإ ؟كل عنصأ لافأ ائيش نوعنصي مهتيأر ةشبحلا ضربأ تنك ذإ ينإ :ءامسأ تلاقف اذكه :تلاقف باوث هتللج مث ،همئاوق لىع هتددشف دئارجب تعد مث ،ههجول هتبكفأ ريرسب تعدف ،معن :تلقا .رانلا نم الله كرتس ينيرتسا ،هلثم يل يعنصا :تلاقف ،نوعنصي مهتيأر
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The first bier introduced in Islam was the bier of Fatima (peace be upon her). When she complained of the illness from which she passed away, she said to Asma: I have become thin and my flesh has wasted away, won't you make something to cover me? Asma said: When I was in Ethiopia, I saw them make something, shall I make it for you? If you like it, I will make it for you. She said: Yes. So she called for a bed and turned it upside down, then called for palm branches and tied them to its legs, then covered it with cloth and said: This is how I saw them make it. Fatima said: Make one like it for me, may Allah cover you from the Fire.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using A Bier For Carrying The Deceased, Particularly Emphasized For Women
arabicText: تنب ةمطفا شعنلا هل لعج نم لوأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .(اهيلع الله تاولص) دمحم
englishText: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: The first person for whom a bier was made was Fatima daughter of Muhammad (peace be upon her).

chapter: Recommendation Of Using A Bier For Carrying The Deceased, Particularly Emphasized For Women
arabicText: .(ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا :لاقف ،شعنلا هل لعج نم لوأ نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about who was the f irst person for whom a bier was made, and he said: Fatima (peace be upon her).

chapter: Recommendation Of Using A Bier For Carrying The Deceased, Particularly Emphasized For Women
arabicText: تلاقف اديدش اضرم (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا تضرم :لقا سابع نبا نع (ةمغلا فشك) يف ىسيع نب ليع عنصأ نكلو ،يرمعل ،لا :تلاقف ،رهاظ ريرس لىع ينيلمحت لاف ؟تغلب ام ىلإ نيرت لاأ :سيمع تنب ءامسلأ ،ةشبحلبا عنصي تيأر امك اشعن ناك ام لوأ وهو ،اشعن ريرسلا لىع تلعج مث ،قاوسلأا نم تعطقف ةبطر دئارج ىلإ تلسرفأ ،هينيرفأ :تلقا .لايل اهانفدف اهانلمح مث ذئموي لاإ ةمسبتم اهتيأر امو تمسبتف ،شعنلا
englishText: Ali ibn Isa in (Kashf Al-Ghummah) from Ibn Abbas who said: Fatima (peace be upon her) became severely ill and said to Asma bint Umays: Don't you see what has become of me? Do not carry me on an exposed bed. She said: No, by my life, but I will make a bier as I saw made in Ethiopia. She said: Show me. So she sent for fresh palm branches cut from the markets, then made a bier over the bed, and this was the first bier. She smiled, and I had not seen her smile except on that day. Then we carried her and buried her at night.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using A Bier For Carrying The Deceased, Particularly Emphasized For Women
arabicText: حرطي هنإ ،ءاسنلبا عنصي ام تحبقتسا دق ينإ اهل :تلقا (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا نأ سيمع تنب ءامسأ نعو ،ةشبحلا ضربأ هتيأر ائيش كل عنصأ ناأ الله لوسر تنب يا :تلقف ،ىأر نمل اهفصيف بوثلا ةأرملا لىع فرعت لا ،هلمجأو اذه نسحأ ام :ةمطفا تلاقف ،باوث اهيلع تحرط مث اهتسبحف ةبطر ةديرجب توعدف :تلقا .ءامسأو ليع اهلسغ (ملاسلا اهيلع) تتام املف - لقا نأ ىلإ - تنأ ينيلسغفا تم اذفإ ،لجرلا نم ةأرملا هب
englishText: And from Asma bint Umays that Fatima (peace be upon her) said to her: I find what is done with women repulsive, as a cloth is thrown over the woman which describes her to onlookers. So I said: O daughter of the Messenger of Allah, I will make something for you that I saw in Ethiopia. She said: So I called for a fresh palm branch, secured it, then threw a cloth over it. Fatima said: How good and beautiful this is, the woman cannot be distinguished from the man with it. When I die, you wash me- until he said- when she died (peace be upon her), Ali and Asma washed her.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ablution For One Who Places The Deceased In His Grave
arabicText: .ربقلا تيملا تلخدأ اذإ أضوت :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: Perform ablution (wudu) when you place the deceased person into the grave.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ablution For One Who Places The Deceased In His Grave
arabicText: نأ لاإ ،لا :لقا ؟ءوضو هيلع ربقلا تيملا لخدأ نم :هل تلق :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع .ءاش نإ ربقلا بارت نم أضوتي ءوضولا نوكي نأ لمتحيو ،بابحتسلاا يفاني لاف (لىع) ظفل نم مهفي امك بوجولا يفن لىع لدي اذه :لوقأ .ربقلا بارت رثأ نم ديلا لسغ ىنعمب
englishText: From one of them [peace be upon them]- in a hadith- said: I asked him: Must the person who places the deceased in the grave have ritual ablution (wudu)? He replied: No, except if he wishes to perform ablution using the soil of the grave. I (Hurr Amili) say: This indicates the absence of obligation as understood from the word 'must', so it does not negate recommendation. It's possible that ablution here means washing hands from the traces of grave soil.

chapter: Recommendation Of Visiting Graves And Seeking Needs At The Grave Of One's Parents
arabicText: رئازلا هتاأ اذإ نمؤملا نأ ينغلب :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نسحلا يبلأ تلق :لقا ىيحي نب ناوفص نع .شحوتسي لا :لاقف ،شحوتسا هنع فرصنا اذفإ ،هب سنآ
englishText: From Safwan bin Yahya who said: I said to Abu Al-Hasan Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him): I have heard that when a visitor comes to a believer (in the grave), he feels comfort with him, and when he leaves, he (the believer) feels lonely. He said: He does not feel lonely.

chapter: Recommendation Of Visiting Graves And Seeking Needs At The Grave Of One's Parents
arabicText: :تلق ،معن :لقا ؟مهروزت ىتوملا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع هدانسإبو .مكيلإ نوسنأتسيو ،مكب نوحرفيو مكب نوملعيل مهنإ اللهو يإ :لاقف ؟مهانيتأ اذإ انب نوملعيف
englishText: And by his chain from Muhammad bin Muslim who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Do we visit the dead? He said: Yes. I said: Do they know when we come to them? He said: Yes, by Allah, they surely know of you, rejoice with you, and feel comfort with you.

chapter: Recommendation Of Visiting Graves And Seeking Needs At The Grave Of One's Parents
arabicText: اذه :لوقأ .اوشحوتسا مهنع متبغ اذفإ مكب نوسنيأ مهنإ :لقا روبقلا ةرياز يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لولأا يفاني لاف ضعب نود نيرئازلا ضعبب صوصخم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding visiting graves, he said: They feel comfort with you, and when you are absent from them, they feel lonely. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is specific to some visitors and not others, so it does not contradict the first.

chapter: Recommendation Of Visiting Graves And Seeking Needs At The Grave Of One's Parents
arabicText: ام هب اسنأتسم لازي لا معن :لقا ؟هربق روزي نم ملعي نمؤملا :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع .ةشحو هربق نع هفارصنا نم هلخد هربق نم فرصناو مقا اذفإ ،هربق دنع لاز
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), I said to him: Does the believer know who visits his grave? He said: Yes, he continues to feel comfort with them as long as they are at his grave, and when they stand and leave his grave, loneliness enters him from From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), I said to him: Does the believer know who visits his grave? He said: Yes, he continues to feel comfort with them as long as they are at his grave, and when they stand and leave his grave, loneliness enters him from their departure from his grave.

chapter: Recommendation Of Visiting Graves And Seeking Needs At The Grave Of One's Parents
arabicText: نوحرفي مهنفإ مكتاوم اوروز :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .امهل وعدي امب همأ ربق دنعو هيبأ ربق دنع هتجاح مكدحأ بلطيلو ،مكتريازب
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir Al-Mu'mineen (peace be upon him) said: Visit your dead for they rejoice in your visitation, and let each of you seek his need at his father's grave and his mother's grave while supplicating for them.

chapter: Emphasis Of The Recommendation Of Visiting Graves On Monday, Thursday, And Saturday
arabicText: نيعبسو ةسمخ اهيبأ دعب (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا تشاع :لوقي هتعمس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ناك انهيه :لوقتف ،سيمخلاو نينثلاا نيترم ةعمج لك يف ءادهشلا روبق يتتأ ،ةكحاض لاو ةرشاك رت مل اموي .نوكرشملا ناك انهيه (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I heard him saying: Fatima (peace be upon her) lived after her father for seventy-five days, never seen smiling or laughing, visiting the graves of martyrs twice every week on Monday and Thursday, saying: "Here was the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), here were the polytheists."

chapter: Emphasis Of The Recommendation Of Visiting Graves On Monday, Thursday, And Saturday
arabicText: ،تبس ةادغ لك يف ءادهشلا روبق يتتأ تناك (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هل رفغتستو هيلع محرتتو ةزمح ربق يتأتف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed Fatima (peace be upon her) would visit the graves of the martyrs every Saturday morning, coming to Hamza's grave to seek mercy and forgiveness for him.

chapter: Emphasis Of The Recommendation Of Visiting Graves On Monday, Thursday, And Saturday
arabicText: جرخي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناك لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا لامجلا ناوفص نع " ريادلا لهأ يا مكيلع ملاسلا " :لوقيف نييندملا عيقب ىلإ سيمخ ةيشع لك هباحصأ نم سانلا نم لام يف .ثالاث " الله مكمحر " ،ثالاث
englishText: From Safwan Al-Jammal who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would go out with a group of his companions every Thursday evening to Baqi Al-Madineen (cemetery) and say: "Peace be upon you, O people of the abodes" three times, "May Allah have mercy upon you" three times.

chapter: Recommendation Of Greeting The People Of The Graves And Showing Mercy To Them
arabicText: معن :لاقف ؟روبقلا لهأ لىع ميلستلا فيك :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا نانس نب الله دبع نع .نوقحلا مكب - الله ءاش نإ - نحنو طرف انل متنأ نيملسملاو نينمؤملا نم ريادلا لهأ لىع ملاسلا :لوقت
englishText: From Abdullah bin Sinan who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): How does one send peace upon the people of the graves? He said: Yes, you say: "Peace be upon the inhabitants of these dwellings from among the believers and Muslims. You have preceded us, and we - if Allah wills - will join you."

chapter: Recommendation Of Greeting The People Of The Graves And Showing Mercy To Them
arabicText: .نوقحلا مكب - الله ءاش نإ - ناإو ،نينمؤم موق رياد نم مكيلع ملاسلا لوقت :لقا مزاح نب روصنم نع
englishText: From Mansur bin Hazim who said: You say "Peace be upon you, O dwellers of the abodes of the believing people, and we shall - if Allah wills - join you."

chapter: Recommendation Of Greeting The People Of The Graves And Showing Mercy To Them
arabicText: ملاسلا :لوقت :لقا ؟روبقلا لهأ لىع ميلستلا فيك (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ينئادملا حارج نع مكب - الله ءاش نإ - ناإو نيرخأتسملاو انم نيمدقتسملا الله محر ،نيملسملاو نينمؤملا نم ريادلا لهأ لىع .نوقحلا
englishText: From Jarrah al-Madaini who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) how to greet the people of the graves? He said: Say: Peace be upon the inhabitants of these dwellings from among the believers and Muslims. May Allah have mercy on those who preceded us and those who will come after, and we - if Allah wills - will join you.

chapter: Recommendation Of Greeting The People Of The Graves And Showing Mercy To Them
arabicText: نينمؤم موق نم ريادلا لهأ مكيلع ملاسلا :- روبقلا لهأ لىع ملاسلا يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع ناإو لله ناإو ،نيرخأتسملاو مكنم نيمدقتسملا الله محر ،عبت مكل نحنو فلس انل متنأ ،هتاكربو الله ةمحرو .نوعجار هيلإ
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon him)- regarding sending peace upon the people of the graves-: Peace be upon you O people of the dwellings from a believing people, and may Allah's mercy and blessings be upon you. You are our predecessors From Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon him)- regarding sending peace upon the people of the graves-: Peace be upon you O people of the dwellings from a believing people, and may Allah's mercy and blessings be upon you. You are our predecessors and we are your followers. May Allah have mercy on those who preceded among you and those who come later, and indeed we belong to Allah and indeed to Him we will return [Quran, 2:156].

chapter: Recommendation Of Greeting The People Of The Graves And Showing Mercy To Them
arabicText: .ةنجلا لهأ لىع ملاسلا :لقف ةنابجلا تلخد اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: When you enter the cemetery, say: Peace be upon the people of Paradise.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Visitor's Hand On The Grave Facing The Qiblah And Reciting Surat Al-Qadr Seven Times
arabicText: يل لاقف عيزب نب ليعامسإ نب دمحم ربق ىلإ للاب نب ليع عم تيشمف ديفب تنك :لقا دمحأ نب دمحم نع ربقلا لىع هدي عضو مث هيخأ ربق ىتأ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع ربقلا اذه بحاص يل لقا :للاب نب ليع .عزفلا موي وأ ربكلأا عزفلا موي نمأ تارم عبس ردقلا ةليل يف هانلزنأ ناإ :أرقو
englishText: From Muhammadbin Ahmad whosaid: I was in Fayd and walked with Ali bin Bilal to the grave of Muhammad bin Isma'il bin Bazi'. Ali bin Bilal said to me: The occupant of this grave told me from Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever visits the grave of his brother, then places his hand on the grave and recites "Indeed, We sent it down during the Night of Decree" [Surah Qadr] seven times, will be safe on the day of the greatest terror or the day of terror.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Visitor's Hand On The Grave Facing The Qiblah And Reciting Surat Al-Qadr Seven Times
arabicText: هدي عضي ةيحنا يأ نم نمؤملا هيخأ ربق ىتأ نم :لقا هنأ لاإ هلثم بوقعي نب دمحم نع هدانسإب خيشلا هاورو .هانلزنأ ناإ :أرقو
englishText: And the Shaykh narrated it through his chain from Muhammad bin Ya'qub similarly except he said: Whoever visits his believing brother's grave from any direction places his hand and recites "Indeed, We sent it down" [Surah Qadr].

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Visitor's Hand On The Grave Facing The Qiblah And Reciting Surat Al-Qadr Seven Times
arabicText: دمحم ينعي - ربقلا اذه بحاص ينربخأ :لقا نأ ىلإ هوحن ركذو ،ديفب تنك :لقا ىيحي نب دمحأ نب دمحم نع هربق دنع سلجف نمؤملا هيخأ ربق راز نم :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ عمس هنأ - عيزب نب ليعامسإ نب .ربكلأا عزفلا نم نمأ تارم عبس ردقلا ةليل يف هانلزنأ ناإ أرقف ربقلا لىع هدي عضوو ةلبقلا لبقتساو
englishText: From Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya who said: I was in Fayd, and mentioned similar to it until he said: The owner of this grave- meaning Muhammad bin Isma'il bin Bazi'- informed me that he heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: Whoever visits his believing brother's grave and sits at his grave facing the Qiblah and places his hand on the grave and recites "Indeed, We sent it down in the Night of Decree" [Surah Qadr] seven times will be safe from the greatest terror.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Visitor's Hand On The Grave Facing The Qiblah And Reciting Surat Al-Qadr Seven Times
arabicText: تنك :لقا ىيحي نب دمحأ نب دمحم ينربخأ ىيحي نب دمحم لقا :لقا (لاجرلا) باتك يف يشاجنلا هاورو باأ عمس هنأ - ليعامسإ نب دمحم ينعي - ربقلا اذه بحاص ينربخأ :لقا نأ ىلإ هوحن ركذو ،ديفب تارم عبس ردقلا ةليل يف هانلزنأ ناإ أرقو هيلع هدي عضوو نمؤملا هيخأ ربق راز نم :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج .ربكلأا عزفلا نم نمأ
englishText: And Al-Najashi narrated it in his book (Al-Rijal) saying: Muhammad bin Yahya said: Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya informed me saying: I was in Fayd, and mentioned similar to it until he said: The owner of this grave- meaning Muhammad bin Isma'il informed me that he heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: Whoever visits his believing brother's grave and places his hand on it and recites "Indeed, We sent it down in the Night of Decree" [Surah Qadr] seven times will be safe from the greatest terror.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Visitor's Hand On The Grave Facing The Qiblah And Reciting Surat Al-Qadr Seven Times
arabicText: الله رفغ لاإ تارم عبس ردقلا ةليل يف هانلزنأ ناإ هدنع أرقف نمؤم ربق راز دبع نم ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا لقا .ربقلا بحاصلو هل
englishText: Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) said: No servant visits a believer's grave and recites at it "Indeed, We sent it down in the Night of Decree" [Surah Qadr] seven times except that Allah forgives him and the owner of the grave.

chapter: Recommendation Of Placing The Visitor's Hand On The Grave Facing The Qiblah And Reciting Surat Al-Qadr Seven Times
arabicText: ةلبقلا لبقتسم سلجف ربق ىلإ ءاج ذإ رباقملا ضعب يف مشاه نب ميهاربإو ناأ تنك :لقا دمحم نب دمحأ نع ليعامسإ نب دمحم وهو ربقلا اذه بحاص ينثدح :لقا مث ،هانلزنأ ناإ تارم عبس أرقف ربقلا لىع هدي عضو مث .ربقلا بحاصلو هل الله رفغ هانلزنأ ناإ تارم عبس هدنع أرقف نمؤم ربق راز نم هنأ عيزب نب
englishText: From Ahmad bin Muhammad who said: Ibrahim bin Hashim and I were in some graves when he came to a grave and sat facing the Qiblah then placed his hand on the grave and recited "Indeed, We sent it down" [Surah Qadr] seven times, then said: The owner of this grave, who is Muhammad bin Isma'il bin Bazi', told me that whoever visits a believer's grave and recites at it "Indeed, We sent it down" [Surah Qadr] seven times, Allah will forgive him and the owner of the grave.

chapter: Recommendation Of Supplications From Traditions When Visiting Graves And The Impermissibility Of Circumambulating Graves
arabicText: اذإ لوقن ئش يفأ :تلق - :لقا نأ ىلإ - معن :لقا ؟مهروزن ىتوملا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق مهيلإ نكسأو ،نااوضر كنم مهقلو ،مهحاورأ كيلإ دعاصو ،مهبونج نع ضرلأا فاج مهللا :لق :لقا ؟مهانيتأ .ريدق ئش لك لىع كنإ ،مهتشحو هب سنوتو ،مهتدحو هب لصت ام كتمحر نم
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Should we visit the dead? He said: Yes then I said: What should we say when we come to them? He said: Say: "O Allah, keep the earth away from their sides, elevate their souls to You, grant them Your pleasure, and send down to them from Your mercy that which will ease their solitude and comfort their loneliness, indeed You have power over all things."

chapter: Recommendation Of Taking Lessons When Carrying A Funeral, Resuming Work, What Should Be Remembered, And The Recommendation Of Burying Hair, Nails, Teeth, Blood, Placenta, And Blood Clot
arabicText: تنأ كنأك نكف ةزانج تلمح تنأ اذإ حلاص با يا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ يل لقا :لقا حلاص يبأ نلاجع نع سبح موقل بجع :لقا مث :لقا ،فنأتست اذام رظنفا لعفف ايندلا ىلإ عوجرلا كبر تلأس كنأكو ،لومحملا .نوبعلي مهو ليحرلا مهيف يدون مث ،مهرخآ نع مهلوأ
englishText: From Ajlan Abu Salih who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said to me: O Aba Salih, when you carry a funeral, be as if you are the one being carried, and as if you had asked your Lord to return to this world and He granted it, then see what you would do differently. Then he said: How strange are people whose first ones (*) were withheld from their last ones, then they were called to depart while they were playing. Translator: * The living (first ones) are prevented or held back from joining the departed (last ones) because death is like a barrier that confines the living to this world and separates them from the departed ones.

chapter: Recommendation Of Perfecting The Construction Of Graves And Other Works, And That The Bricks Should Be Joined And Gaps Be Filled
arabicText: ىأر (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نب ميهاربإ تام امل :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع قحلأ :لقا مث ،نقتيلف لامع مكدحأ لمع اذإ :لقا مث ،هديب هاوسف لالخ هربق يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا .نوعظم نب نامثع حلاصلا كفلسب
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: When Ibrahim, the son of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) died, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) saw gaps in his grave, so he smoothed them with his hand, then said: "When any of you does a work, let him perfect it." Then he said: "Join your righteous predecessor Uthman bin Madhun."

chapter: Recommendation Of Perfecting The Construction Of Graves And Other Works, And That The Bricks Should Be Joined And Gaps Be Filled
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم نب رفعج قداصلا الله دبع يبأ نع ام هب دسي ،ابطر باارت ينلونا ،ارجح ينلونا :لوقي لعجو ،هيلع نبللا ىوسو ذاعم نب دعس دحل ىتح لزن (هلآو هنأ ملعلا ينإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا هربق ىوسو هيلع بارتلا اثحو غرف نأ املف ،نبللا نيب .همكحأ لامع لمع اذإ ادبع بحي الله نكلو ءلابلا هيلإ لصيو لىبيس
englishText: From Abu Abdullah Al-Sadiq Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) descended until he laid Sa'd bin Mu'adh in the grave and arranged the bricks over him, and he kept saying: "Hand me a stone, hand me wet soil" to fill the gaps between the bricks. When he f inished and poured the soil over him and leveled his grave, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "I know that it will decay and deterioration will reach it, but Allah loves a servant who, when he does a work, perfects it."

chapter: Obligation Of Directing The Deceased In Their Grave Towards The Qiblah By Placing Them On Their Right Side With Their Face Towards It
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناكو ،ةنيدملبا يراصنلأا رورعم نب ءاربلا ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع سدقملا تيب ىلإ نولصي نوملسملاو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناكو ،توملا هرضح هنأو ،ةكمب (هلآو هب ترجف هلام ثلثب ىصوأ هنأو ،ةلبقلا ىلإ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ءاقلت ىلإ ههجو لعجي نأ ءاربلا ىصوفأ .ةنسلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Al-Bara' ibn Ma'rur Al-Ansari was in Medina, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was in Makkah, and when death approached him, while the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and the Muslims were praying towards Bayt al-Maqdis, Al Bara' instructed that his face be turned towards the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) towards the Qiblah, and he bequeathed one-third of his wealth, thus establishing the sunnah.

chapter: Obligation Of Directing The Deceased In Their Grave Towards The Qiblah By Placing Them On Their Right Side With Their Face Towards It
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىلإ ههجو لعجي نأ :لقاو ،ةكم ركذ طقسأ هنأ لاإ هوحن رامع نب ةيواعم نع .ةنسلا هب ترجو باتكلا هب لزنف هلام ثلثب ىصوأ هنأو ةنسلا هب ترجف ةلبقلا ىلإ (هلآو
englishText: From Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar similar to it except that he omitted the mention of Makkah, and said: that his face be turned towards the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) towards the Qiblah, thus establishing the sunnah, and he bequeathed one-third of his wealth, so the Book was revealed about it and the sunnah was established.

chapter: Obligation Of Directing The Deceased In Their Grave Towards The Qiblah By Placing Them On Their Right Side With Their Face Towards It
arabicText: عم هتلوانت ربقلا ىلإ ترص تنأ اذإ :لقا - هسأر عطق اذإ ليتقلا ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةلبقلا هتهجوو ،دحللا هتلخدأو ،دسجلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith about one who is killed when his head is severed- he said: When you reach the grave, take it with the body, place it in the niche, and direct it towards the Qiblah.

chapter: Permissibility Of Stepping On Graves Whether Of A Believer Or A Hypocrite
arabicText: ،روبقلا أطف رباقملا تلخد اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نسحلا وبأ لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .هملأ دجو اقفانم ناك نمو ،كلذ ىلإ حورتسا انمؤم ناك نمف
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husain said: Abu Al-Hasan Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: When you enter the graveyards, step on the graves, for whoever was a believer will find comfort in that, and whoever was a hypocrite will feel its pain.

chapter: Dislike Of Laughing Among Graves, At Funerals, And Peering Into Houses
arabicText: الله نإ :لقا - (ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ةيصو يف - هئباآ نع دمحم نب رفعج نع .رودلا يف علطتلاو روبقلا نيب كحضلا يتملا هرك ىلاعتو كرابت
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad from his forefathers- in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him)- he said: Indeed Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, has made disliked for my nation laughing among graves and peering into houses.

chapter: Dislike Of Laughing Among Graves, At Funerals, And Peering Into Houses
arabicText: نم ءايصولأل نهتهركو لاصخ تس يل هرك ىلاعتو كرابت الله نإ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقاو :لقا ،ابنج دجاسملا نايتإو ،ةقدصلا دعب نملاو ،موصلا يف ثفرلاو ،ةلاصلا يف ثبعلا :يدعب نم مهعابتأو يدلو .روبقلا نيب كحضلاو ،رودلا يف علطتلاو
englishText: He said: And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Indeed Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, has made six traits disliked for me, and I have made them disliked for the successors from my children and their followers after me: f idgeting in prayer, obscene speech while fasting, reminding of sadaqah after giving it, entering mosques while in a state of janabah (sexual impurity), peering into houses, and laughing among graves.

chapter: Dislike Of Laughing Among Graves, At Funerals, And Peering Into Houses
arabicText: مكل هرك الله نإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،هيبأ نع قداصلا نع .رودلا يف علطتلاو ،روبقلا نيب كحضلاو - :لقا نأ ىلإ - اهنع مكاهنو ةلصخ نيرشعو اعبرأ ةملأا اهتيأ
englishText: From Al-Sadiq from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Indeed Allah has made twenty-four traits disliked for you, O nation, and has forbidden you from them- until he said - and laughing among graves, and peering into houses.

chapter: Dislike Of Laughing Among Graves, At Funerals, And Peering Into Houses
arabicText: لاصخ تس يل هرك الله نإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر :لقا لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ةقدصلا دعب نملاو ،موصلا يف ثفرلاو ،ةلاصلا يف ثبعلا :يدعب نم مهعابتأو يدلو نم ءايصولأل نههركو .روبقلا نيب كحضلاو ،رودلا يف علطتلاو ،ابنج دجاسملا نايتإو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Indeed Allah has made six traits disliked for me and made them disliked for the successors from my children and their followers after me: f idgeting in prayer, obscene speech while fasting, reminding of sadaqah after giving it, entering mosques while in a state of janabah (sexual impurity), peering into houses, and laughing among graves.

chapter: Dislike Of Laughing Among Graves, At Funerals, And Peering Into Houses
arabicText: لىع ةمايقلا موي الله هناهأ ةزانج لىع كحض نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقا :لقا - هباتك يف - سارف يبأ نبا هاورو محرت نمو ،دحأ لبج لثم رزولا نم هيلعو عجر ةربقملا يف كحض نمو ،هؤاعد باجتسي لاو ،داهشلاا سوؤر .رانلا نم اجن هيلع
englishText: And Ibn Abi Firas narrated- in his book- he (peace be upon him) said: Whoever laughs at a funeral procession, Allah will humiliate him on the Day of Resurrection before all witnesses, and his supplication will not be answered, and whoever laughs in the cemetery will return with sins equivalent to Mount Uhud, and whoever shows mercy to him will be saved from the Fire.

chapter: Dislike Of Laughing Among Graves, At Funerals, And Peering Into Houses
arabicText: ةمئلأل اهتهركف يل الله اههرك ةتس :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رودلا يف علطتلاو ،روبقلا نيب كحضلا اهنم ،مهعابتلا ةمئلأا اههركتلو يتيرذ نم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Six things Allah made disliked for me, so I made them disliked for the Imams from my progeny, and the Imams should make them disliked for their followers, among them are laughing among graves and peering into houses.

chapter: Recommendation Of Being Gentle With The Deceased And Walking Moderately With The Funeral Procession
arabicText: يشملا يف دصقلبا مكيلع ،ةنيكسلبا مكيلع :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقا :لقا هيبأ نع ،ىسوم يبأ نع .مكتزانجب
englishText: From Abu Musa, from his father who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Upon you is tranquility, upon you is moderation in walking with your funeral procession.

chapter: Dislike Of Building Mosques Near Graves
arabicText: ةرياز امأ :لاقف ،اهيف دجاسملا ءانبو روبقلا ةرياز نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لأس هنأ نارهم نب ةعامس نع .دجاسم اهدنع ىنبت لاو ،اهب سبأ لاف روبقلا
englishText: From Sama'ah ibn Mihran that he asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about visiting graves and building mosques in them, so he said: As for visiting graves, there is no problem with it, but do not build mosques near them.

chapter: Dislike Of Building Mosques Near Graves
arabicText: اوذختا ثيح دوهيلا نعل الله نفإ ،ادجسم لاو ةلبق يربق اوذختت لا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقاو :لقا .دجاسم مهئايبنأ روبق
englishText: He said: And the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Do not take my grave as a qibla (direction of prayer) nor as a mosque, for Allah cursed the Jews when they took the graves of their prophets as mosques.

chapter: Dislike Of Concealing A Person's Death From Their Family And Wife
arabicText: نينمؤملا نم تيم توم اومتكت لا :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا ةبايس نب نمحرلا دبع نع .هثاريم مسقيو هتجوز دتعتل ،هتبيغ يف تام
englishText: From Abdur-Rahman bin Siyabah who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: Do not conceal the death of any believer who dies while away (from his family), so that his wife may observe her waiting period and his inheritance may be distributed.

chapter: Recommendation Of Preparing Food For The Bereaved Family For Three Days And Sending It To Them, And The Dislike Of Eating At Their Place
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر رمأ بلاط يبأ نب رفعج لتق امل :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ميقتو اهءاسنو اهيتتأو ،مياأ ةثلاث سيمع تنب ءامسلأ اماعط ذختت نأ (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا (هلآو .ثالاث اماعط ةبيصملا لهلأ عنصي نأ ةنسلا كلذب ترجف ،(مياأ ةثلاث) اهدنع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When Ja'far bin Abi Talib was martyred, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered Fatima (peace be upon her) to prepare food for Asma bint Umays for three days, and to visit her with other women and stay with her (for three days). Thus, it became a sunnah to prepare food for the bereaved family for three days.

chapter: Recommendation Of Preparing Food For The Bereaved Family For Three Days And Sending It To Them, And The Dislike Of Eating At Their Place
arabicText: .تام موي نم مياأ ةثلاث متأم تيملا لهلأ عنصي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: A meal of condolence should be prepared for the deceased's family for three days from the day of death.

chapter: Recommendation Of Preparing Food For The Bereaved Family For Three Days And Sending It To Them, And The Dislike Of Eating At Their Place
arabicText: .هيف تام مويب مياأ ةثلاث متاملل ماعطلا تيملل عنصي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Food should be prepared for the deceased's mourning for three days including the day of death.

chapter: Recommendation Of Preparing Food For The Bereaved Family For Three Days And Sending It To Them, And The Dislike Of Eating At Their Place
arabicText: .تام موي نم مياأ ةثلاث متأم تيملل عنصي :لقا هنأ لاإ لاسرم قودصلا هاورو
englishText: Al-Saduq narrated it with an incomplete chain, except that he said: A mourning meal should be prepared for the deceased for three days from the day of death.

chapter: Recommendation Of Preparing Food For The Bereaved Family For Three Days And Sending It To Them, And The Dislike Of Eating At Their Place
arabicText: .مياأ ةثلاث هنع ماعطلا اومعطي نأ ةبيصملا بحاص ناريجل يغبني :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The neighbors of the bereaved should feed them for three days.

chapter: Recommendation Of Preparing Food For The Bereaved Family For Three Days And Sending It To Them, And The Dislike Of Eating At Their Place
arabicText: ماعطلبا مهيلإ ثعبلا ةنسلاو ،ةيلهاجلا لهأ لمع نم ةبيصملا لهأ دنع لكلاا :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا .هيعن ءاج امل بلاط يبأ نب رفعج لآ يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا هب رمأ امك
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Eating at the bereaved family's place is from the practices of the pre-Islamic era, and the sunnah is to send food to them as the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) ordered regarding the family of Ja'far bin Abi Talib when news of his death arrived.

chapter: Recommendation Of Preparing Food For The Bereaved Family For Three Days And Sending It To Them, And The Dislike Of Eating At Their Place
arabicText: لىص) الله لوسر لخد بلاط يبأ نب رفعج لتق امل :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا مزارم نع ىلإ ةنسلا ترجف اماعط رفعج لهلأ اولعجا :لاقف - :لقا نأ ىلإ - سيمع تنب ءامسأ لىع (هلآو هيلع الله .مويلا
englishText: From Murazim who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: When Ja'far bin Abi Talib was martyred, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) visited Asma bint Umays- until he said:- and he said: Prepare food for Ja'far's family, and this sunnah continues until today.

chapter: Recommendation Of Preparing Food For The Bereaved Family For Three Days And Sending It To Them, And The Dislike Of Eating At Their Place
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر رمأ بلاط يبأ نب رفعج لتق امل :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .مياأ ةثلاث اماعط اهل عنصتو اهدنع ميقتو اهئاسنو يه سيمع تنب ءامسأ يتتأ نأ (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا (هلآو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When Ja'far bin Abi Talib was killed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered Fatima (peace be upon her) to go to Asma bint Umais with her women and stay with her, and to prepare food for her for three days.

chapter: Recommendation Of Preparing Food For The Bereaved Family For Three Days And Sending It To Them, And The Dislike Of Eating At Their Place
arabicText: :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :لاقف متاملا نع هلأس هنإ - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) هيبأ نع .ةنسلا ترجف اماعط رفعج لهأ ىلإ اوثعبا
englishText: From his father (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- that he was asked about mourning gatherings, so he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Send food to Ja'far's family, and it became a sunnah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Preparing Food For The Bereaved Family For Three Days And Sending It To Them, And The Dislike Of Eating At Their Place
arabicText: داوسلا مشاه ينب ءاسن سبل (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نب نيسحلا لتق امل :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب ورمع نع .متأملل ماعطلا نهل لمعي (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا نب ليع ناكو ،درب لاو رح نم نيكتشي لا نكو حوسملاو
englishText: From Amr bin Ali bin Al-Husayn who said: When Al-Husayn bin Ali (peace be upon him) was killed, the women of Bani Hashim wore black and coarse garments, and they did not complain of heat or cold, and Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) would prepare food for them for the mourning gatherings.

chapter: Recommendation Of A Deceased Person's Will For Funeral Meal Money
arabicText: نلا ،ةنسلا نم كلذ ىري ناكو ،همتأمل مهرد ةئامنامثب (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ ىصوأ :لقا هريغ وأ ةرارز نع .اولغش دقف اماعط رفعج للآ اوذختا :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر
englishText: From Zurarah or others who said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) willed eight hundred dirhams for his funeral meal, and he considered that to be from the Sunnah, because the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Prepare food for the family of Ja'far, for they are preoccupied."

chapter: Permissibility Of Women Going Out For Funerals To Fulfill Rights And For Lamentation, Its Dislike For Other Purposes, And Its Prohibition When There Is Corruption
arabicText: متأملا يف ناجرخت درام نبا ةأرماو يتأرما نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبلأ تلق :لقا ليهاكلا الله دبع نع اذفإ ،هانعنمت ئش يلأف امارح نكي مل نإو ،هكرتن ىتح هنع انهنفا امارح ناك نإ :يتأرما يل لوقتف امهاهنفأ هيلع) يبأ ناك ،ينلأست قوقحلا نع :(ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا وبأ لاقف ،دحأ انئجي مل تيم انل تام .ةنيدملا لهأ قوقح نايضقت ةورف مأو يمأ ثعبي (ملاسلا
englishText: From Abdullah Al-Kahili who said: I said to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him): My wife and Ibn Marid's wife go out to funerals, so I forbid them, but my wife says to me: If it is forbidden then forbid us from it until we leave it, and if it is not forbidden then why do you prevent us from it, for when someone dies among us, no one comes to us. Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said: You ask me about rights? My father (peace be upon him) used to send my mother and Umm Farwah to fulfill the rights of the people of Medina.

chapter: Permissibility Of Women Going Out For Funerals To Fulfill Rights And For Lamentation, Its Dislike For Other Purposes, And Its Prohibition When There Is Corruption
arabicText: .نينس رشع مساوملا يف بدني نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ ىصوأ :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) recommended that he be lamented in the seasons for ten years.

chapter: Permissibility Of Women Going Out For Funerals To Fulfill Rights And For Lamentation, Its Dislike For Other Purposes, And Its Prohibition When There Is Corruption
arabicText: .زئانجلا ءاسنلا عابتا نع ىهن هنأ - يهانملا ثيدح يف - (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نع ،هئباآ نع
englishText: From his forefathers, from the Prophet (peace be upon him)- in the hadith of prohibitions - that he forbade women from following funeral processions.

chapter: Permissibility Of Women Going Out For Funerals To Fulfill Rights And For Lamentation, Its Dislike For Other Purposes, And Its Prohibition When There Is Corruption
arabicText: هيلع) ليعل هتيصو يف - (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نع (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،قداصلا نع .ربق دنع ميقت لاو ،ةزانج عابتا لاو ،ضيرم ةدايع ءاسنلا لىع سيل :لقا - (ملاسلا
englishText: From Al-Sadiq, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him)- in his will to Ali (peace be upon him)- he said: Women From Al-Sadiq, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him)- in his will to Ali (peace be upon him)- he said: Women are not required to visit the sick, nor follow funeral processions, nor stay by a grave.

chapter: Permissibility Of Women Going Out For Funerals To Fulfill Rights And For Lamentation, Its Dislike For Other Purposes, And Its Prohibition When There Is Corruption
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع ةيفنحلا نبا نع (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع ،قداصلا نع ،لا :نلق !؟لمحي نميف نلمحتفأ :لقا ،ةزانجل :نلق ؟انهيه نكدعقأ ام :لاقف ادوعق ةوسن ىأرف جرخ (هلآو ريغ تاروزأم نعجرفا :لقا ،لا :نلق !؟يلدي نميف نيلدتفأ :لقا ،لا :نلق !؟لسغي نميف نلسغتفأ :لقا .تاروجأم نع يهنلا لىع لدي ام مامحلا بادآ يف مدقتو ،ةراجتلا يف هيلع لدي ام يتيأو ،زاوجلا لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ .يهنلا نم انه رم ام اذكو ةدسفملا لوصح لىع لومحم وهو ،تاحاينلا ىلإ جورخلا يف ةأرملل نذلاا
englishText: From Al-Sadiq, from his father (peace be upon them both) from Ibn Al-Hanafiyyah from Ali (peace be upon him) that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) went out and saw women sitting, so he said: What makes you sit here? They said: For a funeral. He said: Do you carry among those who carry?! They said: No. He said: Do you wash among those who wash?! They said: No. He said: Do you lower [into the grave] among those who lower?! They said: No. He said: Then return, bearing sins without rewards. I (Hurr Amili) say: What indicates permissibility has preceded, and what indicates it will come in [the chapter of] trade, and what indicates the prohibition of permitting women to go out for lamentations has preceded in the etiquettes of the bath, and this is interpreted as when corruption occurs, as is the prohibition that passed here.

chapter: Permissibility Of Lamentation And Weeping Over The Dead, And Speaking Kind Words And Making Supplications At That Time
arabicText: دنع نسحلا لوقلبا مكيلاهأ اورم (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ءاعدلبا نكيلعو ،دادعتلا نكرتأ تلاقف ،مشاه تانب اهتدعسأ اهوبأ ضبق امل ةمطفا نفإ ،مكتاوم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Tell your families to speak good words when your dead pass away, for when Fatima's father passed away, the daughters of Hashim helped her mourn, so she said: Leave the enumeration (of qualities) and focus on supplication.

chapter: Permissibility Of Lamentation And Weeping Over The Dead, And Speaking Kind Words And Making Supplications At That Time
arabicText: حانف رخآ دلو هل تام مث ،ةنس اهيلع حانف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ ةنبا تتام :لقا ديزي نب نيسحلا نع :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ ليقف :لقا ،حونلا عطقف اديدش اعزج هيلع عزجف ليعامسإ تام مث ،ةنس هيلع .هل كياوب لا ةزمح نكل :- ةزمح تام امل - لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ لاقف !؟كراد يف حانيأ
englishText: From Al-Husayn bin Yazid who said: A daughter of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) died, and he lamented over her for a year. Then another child of his died, and he lamented over him for a year. Then Isma'il died, and he grieved intensely for him but stopped the lamentation. It was said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): "Is there lamentation in your house?!" He said: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said- when Hamza died-: "But Hamza has no one to weep for him."

chapter: Permissibility Of Lamentation And Weeping Over The Dead, And Speaking Kind Words And Making Supplications At That Time
arabicText: هيكبت ةنبا هقزري نأ هبر لأس (ملاسلا هيلع) نامحرلا ليلخ ميهاربإ نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هتوم دعب
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed Ibrahim, the Friend of the Most Merciful (peace be upon him), asked his Lord to grant him a daughter who would weep for him after his death.

chapter: Permissibility Of Lamentation And Weeping Over The Dead, And Speaking Kind Words And Making Supplications At That Time
arabicText: لىع حونلبا رمأ هنأو ،اهيبأ لىع تحنا (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا نأ (داؤفلا نكسم) يف نيدلا نيز خيشلا ىورو .ةزمح
englishText: Shaykh Zain al-Din narrated in (Muskan al-Fu'ad) that Fatima (peace be upon her) lamented over her father, and that he ordered lamentation over Hamza.

chapter: Dislike Of Wailing At Night, And That The Wailer Should Not Speak Nonsense, And The Non-Prohibition Of Wailing Without Falsehood
arabicText: ةأرملا جاتحت امنإ :لوقي وهو (ملاسلا امهيلع) ليع نب دمحم يمع تعمس :تلقا اهنأ رمع تنب ةجيدخ نع .حونلبا ةكئلاملا يذؤت لاف ليللا اهءاج اذفإ ،ارجه لوقت نأ اهل يغبني لاو ،اهتعمد ليستل حونلا ىلإ متأملا يف
englishText: From Khadijah bint Umar who said: I heard my uncle Muhammad bin Ali (peace be upon them both) saying: A woman only needs to wail at a funeral to make her tears f low, and she should not speak nonsense. When night comes, she should not disturb the angels with wailing.

chapter: Dislike Of Wailing At Night, And That The Wailer Should Not Speak Nonsense, And The Non-Prohibition Of Wailing Without Falsehood
arabicText: لىع حين دق ،هب سبأ لا :لاقف :ةحئانلا رجأ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لئس :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) was asked about the payment for a professional wailer. He said: There is no problem with it, as wailing was done for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).

chapter: Recommendation Of Anticipating Divine Reward For The Death Of Children And Being Patient Over It
arabicText: اوبكر) دق مهلك ،هدعب مهفلخي ادلو نيعبس نم لضفأ لجرلا همدقي دلو :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .الله ليبس يف (اودهاجو ليخلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A child whom a man sends forth (in death) is better than seventy children he leaves behind, even if all of them have "mounted horses and fought" in the way of Allah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Anticipating Divine Reward For The Death Of Children And Being Patient Over It
arabicText: ،هلخد ام ةدشو هدلوب هباصم هيلإ وكشي (ملاسلا هيلع) يناثلا رفعج يبأ ىلإ لجر بتك :لقا نارهم نبا نع .كلذ لىع هرجأيل ،هسفنأ هدلو نمو نمؤملا لام نم راتخي لجو زع الله نأ تملع امأ :هيلإ بتكف
englishText: From Ibn Mihran who said: A man wrote to Abu Ja'far the Second (peace be upon him) complaining about his affliction with [the death of] his child and the severity of what befell him. He wrote back to him: Don't you know that Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, chooses from the believer's wealth and children what is most precious to grant him reward for that?

chapter: Recommendation Of Anticipating Divine Reward For The Death Of Children And Being Patient Over It
arabicText: اهنبا مساقلا تام ثيح ةجيدخ لىع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لخد :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع نأ ةمايقلا موي ناك اذإ نيضرت امأ ةجيدخ يا :لاقف ،تيكبف ةريرد ترد :تلاقف ؟كيكبي ام :اهل لاقف ،كيبت يهو زع الله نإ ،نمؤم لكل كلذو !؟اهلضفأ كلزنيو ةنجلا كلخديو كديب ذخأيف مئقا وهو ةنجلا ببا ىلإ يئيجت .ادبأ اهدعب هبذعي مث هداؤف ةرمث نمؤملا بلسي نأ نم مركأو مكحأ لجو
