englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) entered upon Khadijah when her son Al-Qasim died while she was crying. He said to her: "What makes you cry?" She said: "My milk flowed so I cried." He said: "O Khadijah, wouldn't you be pleased if on the Day of Resurrection you come to the gate of Paradise and he is standing there, then he takes your hand and enters you into Paradise and settles you in its best place?! And this is for every believer. Indeed, Allah the Mighty and Majestic is too Wise and too Generous to take away the fruit of a believer's heart and then punish him afterward forever."

chapter: Recommendation Of Anticipating Divine Reward For The Death Of Children And Being Patient Over It
arabicText: هدلو بحأ ضبق ادبع بحأ اذإ لجو زع الله نإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا ريصب يبأ نع .هيلإ
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: When Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, loves a servant, He takes his most beloved child.

chapter: Recommendation Of Anticipating Divine Reward For The Death Of Children And Being Patient Over It
arabicText: الله لىص) الله لوسر ىهنف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نبا رهاط يفوت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع نأ نيضرت امأ :لاقف ،تيكبف ةريردلا هيلع ترد نكلو ،الله لوسر يا لىب :تلاقف ،ءاكبلا نع ةجيدخ (هلآو هيلع ؟كلذك كلذ نإو :تلقا ؟اهبيطأو نااكم اهرهطأ ،ةنجلا كلخدفأ كديب ذخأ كآر اذفإ ،ةنجلا ببا لىع امئقا هيدجت .هبذعي مث لجو زع الله دمحيو بستحيو ربصيف هداؤف ةرمث ادبع بلسي نأ نم مركأو زعأ لجو زع الله :لقا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: When Tahir, the son of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) died, the Messenger of Allah forbade Khadijah from crying. She said: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah, but my milk f lowed for him so I cried." He said: "Wouldn't you be pleased to find him standing at the gate of Paradise, and when he sees you, he takes your hand and enters you into Paradise, to its purest and best place?" She said: "Is that really so?" He said: "Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, is too Mighty and too Generous to take away the fruit of His servant's heart- who then remains patient, anticipates reward, and praises Allah the Mighty and Majestic - and then punish him."

chapter: Recommendation Of Anticipating Divine Reward For The Death Of Children And Being Patient Over It
arabicText: نذإب رانلا نم هابجح الله دنع امهبستحي نيدلو نيملسملا نم مدق نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .الله
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever from among the Muslims sends forth two children anticipating reward from Allah, they will shield him from the Fire by Allah's permission.

chapter: Recommendation Of Anticipating Divine Reward For The Death Of Children And Being Patient Over It
arabicText: .ربصي مل وأ ربص ةنجلا تام اذإ هدلو نم نمؤملا باوث :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The reward for a believer for [the death of] his child is Paradise, whether he is patient or not.

chapter: Recommendation Of Anticipating Divine Reward For The Death Of Children And Being Patient Over It
arabicText: .لجو زع الله نذإب رانلا نم هوبجح الله دنع مهبستحي ادلاوأ مدق نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: Whoever has children who pass away and he seeks reward for that with Allah, they will shield him from the Fire by Allah's permission, the Mighty and Majestic.

chapter: Recommendation Of Anticipating Divine Reward For The Death Of Children And Being Patient Over It
arabicText: هدعب مهفلخي نيعبس نم هل اريخ ناك ادلو مدق نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .لجو زع الله ليبس يف لتقاو ليخلا بكر دق مهلك
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said, he (peace be upon him) said: Whoever has a child that passes away before him, it is better for him than seventy children who survive him, all of whom ride horses and fight in the way of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.

chapter: Recommendation Of Anticipating Divine Reward For The Death Of Children And Being Patient Over It
arabicText: نوكردي هدعب نوقبي ادلو نيعبس نم لضفأ لجرلا همدقي دحاو دلو :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .(ملاسلا هيلع) مئاقلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: One child who passes away before a man is better than seventy children who remain after him and live to see Al-Qa'im (peace be upon him).

chapter: Recommendation Of Anticipating Divine Reward For The Death Of Children And Being Patient Over It
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر هل لاقف - :لقا نأ ىلإ - نوعظم نب نامثعل نبا يفوت :لقا كلام نب سنأ نع ،كبنج ىلإ كنبا تدجو لاإ اهنم بابا يتتأ لا نأ كرسي امفأ ،باوبأ ةعبس رانللو ،باوبأ ةينامث ةنجلل نإ :(هلآو :لقا ؟نامثعل ام انطرف يف الله لوسر يا انلو :نوملسملا لاقف ،لىب :لاقف ؟كبر ىلإ كل عفشي ،كتزجحب ذخأ .بستحاو مكنم ربص نمل معن
englishText: From Anas bin Malik who said: A son of Uthman bin Madh'un died- until he said then the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to him: Indeed Paradise has eight gates, and Hell has seven gates. Would it not please you that you would not come to any gate except that you find your son beside you, holding onto your waist, interceding for you to your Lord? He said: Yes. Then the Muslims said: O Messenger of Allah, do we have for our deceased children what Uthman has? He said: Yes, for whoever among you is patient and seeks reward.

chapter: Recommendation Of Praising Allah, Saying 'Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilayhi Raji'un', And Asking For Replacement Upon Death Of A Child And Other Calamities
arabicText: ملعأ اللهو - نمؤملا دلو ضبق اذإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع لقا امف :لوقيف :لقا ؟انبر معن :نولوقيف ؟نلاف دلو متضبق :هتكئلامل ىلاعتو كرابت الله لقا - دبعلا لقا امب ،عجرتساو يندمحف ،هنيع ةرقو هبلق ةرمث متذخأ :ىلاعتو كرابت الله لوقيف ،عجرتساو كدمح :اولقا ؟يدبع .دمحلا تيب هومسو ةنجلا يف اتيب هل اونبا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: When the child of a believer dies- and Allah knows best what the servant says- Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, says to His angels: Did you take the child of so-and-so? They say: Yes, our Lord. He says: What did My servant say? They say: He praised You and said "Indeed we belong to Allah and to Him we will return." So Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, says: You took the fruit of his heart and the comfort of his eyes, and he praised Me and said "we belong to Allah and to Him we will return." Build for him a house in Paradise and name it the House of Praise.

chapter: Recommendation Of Praising Allah, Saying 'Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilayhi Raji'un', And Asking For Replacement Upon Death Of A Child And Other Calamities
arabicText: يف هعضوف هسارضأ نم سرض علقنا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ نإ :لقا ءارفلا رفعج يبأ نب ديمحلا دبع نع .لله دمحلا :لقا مث هفك
englishText: From Abdul Hamid bin Abi Ja'far Al-Farra who said: One of Abu Ja'far's (peace be upon him) molars fell out, he placed it in his palm and said: "Praise be to Allah."

chapter: Recommendation Of Praising Allah, Saying 'Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilayhi Raji'un', And Asking For Replacement Upon Death Of A Child And Other Calamities
arabicText: وهو هدلو تومي لجر نم بجعيل الله نإ :لاقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) نسحلا يبأو (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع نع ةرابع زاجم انه بجعتلا :لوقأ .يندمحي وهو هسفن تذخأ يدبع يتكئلام يا :لوقيف الله دمحي .بجعتلا لىع ةكئلاملا لمحي هنأ ىنعملا نوكي نأ نكميو ،ناسحتسلااو ماظعتسلاا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) and Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon them both) who said: Indeed Allah is amazed by a man whose child dies and he praises Allah, so He says: "O My angels, My servant- I took his soul and he praises Me." I (Hurr Amili) say: The amazement here is metaphorical, expressing great approval and From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) and Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon them both) who said: Indeed Allah is amazed by a man whose child dies and he praises Allah, so He says: "O My angels, My servant- I took his soul and he praises Me." I (Hurr Amili) say: The amazement here is metaphorical, expressing great approval and admiration, and it is possible that the meaning is that He causes the angels to be amazed.

chapter: Recommendation Of Praising Allah, Saying 'Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilayhi Raji'un', And Asking For Replacement Upon Death Of A Child And Other Calamities
arabicText: دمحلا :لقا هرسي رما هيلع درو اذإ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لاح لك لىع لله دمحلا :لقا هب متغي رمأ هيلع درو اذإو ،ةمعنلا هذه لىع لله
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: When something pleasing came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), he would say: "Praise be to Allah for this blessing," and when something distressing came to him, he would say: "Praise be to Allah in all conditions."

chapter: Recommendation Of Praising Allah, Saying 'Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilayhi Raji'un', And Asking For Replacement Upon Death Of A Child And Other Calamities
arabicText: لعجي مل يذلا لله دمحلا :ةبيصملا دنع لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ ناك :لقا هعفر طابسأ نب ليع نع يذلا رملاا لىع لله دمحلاو ،تناك امم مظعأ يتبيصم لعجي نأ ءاش ول يذلا لله دمحلاو ،ينيد يف يتبيصم .ناكف نوكي نأ ءاش
englishText: From Ali bin Asbat, raising it, he said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) would say during calamity: "Praise be to Allah who did not make my calamity in my religion, and praise be to Allah who, had He willed, could have made my calamity greater than it was, and praise be to Allah for the matter He willed to be, and so it was."

chapter: Recommendation Of Praising Allah, Saying 'Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilayhi Raji'un', And Asking For Replacement Upon Death Of A Child And Other Calamities
arabicText: - ثالاث - ناكم لضفأبل الله نم نمؤملا نإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا ةرارز نب ديبع نع .كلذ لىع الله دمحي وهو هدسج نم اوضع اوضع هسفن عزني مث ءلابلبا هيلتبيل هنإ
englishText: From Ubayd bin Zurarah who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) say: Indeed the believer is in the best position with Allah- three times- He tests him with trials, then removes his soul limb by limb from his body while he praises Allah for that.

chapter: Recommendation Of Praising Allah, Saying 'Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilayhi Raji'un', And Asking For Replacement Upon Death Of A Child And Other Calamities
arabicText: عنص امب يضر دقف لجو زع الله دمحو عجرتساو ربص نم لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .هرجأ الله طبحأو ميمذ وهو ءاضقلا هيلع ىرج كلذ لعفي مل نمو ،الله لىع هرجأ عقوو الله
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: Whoever is patient, says 'We belong to Allah and to Him we return', and praises Allah the Mighty and Majestic, has indeed been pleased with what Allah has done and his reward falls upon Allah. Whoever does not do that, the decree runs upon him while he is blamed and Allah nullifies his reward.

chapter: Recommendation Of Praising Allah, Saying 'Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilayhi Raji'un', And Asking For Replacement Upon Death Of A Child And Other Calamities
arabicText: الله رون يف ناك هيف نك نم عبرأ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم ناإو لله ناإ :لقا ةبيصم هتباصأ اذإ نمو ،الله لوسر ينأو الله لاإ هلإ لا نأ ةداهش هرمأ ةمصع ناك نم :مظعلأا الله رفغتسا :لقا ةئيطخ باصأ اذإ نمو ،(نيملاعلا بر) لله دمحلا :لقا اريخ باصأ اذإ نمو ،نوعجار هيلإ .هيلإ بوتأو
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Four traits, whoever has them will be in Allah's greatest light: One whose protection in all affairs is the testimony that there is no god but Allah and that I am the Messenger of Allah, one who when afflicted with calamity says: "Indeed we belong to Allah and indeed to Him we will return," one who when obtaining good says: "All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds," and one who when committing a sin says: "I seek Allah's forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance."

chapter: Recommendation Of Praising Allah, Saying 'Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilayhi Raji'un', And Asking For Replacement Upon Death Of A Child And Other Calamities
arabicText: .ةنجلا هل تبجو ةبيصملا دنع عاجرتسلاا مهلأ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع :(لامعلأا باوث) يفو
englishText: And in (Thawab Al-A'mal): From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever is inspired to say the return phrase [* Istirja'] during calamity, Paradise becomes obligatory for him. Translator: * Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilayhi Raji'un

chapter: Recommendation Of Saying "Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilayhi Raji'un" And Making Prescribed Supplications When Remembering Calamities Even After Some Time
arabicText: نيح ربصيو ةبيصملا هركذ دنع عجرتسيف ةبيصمب باصي دبع نم ام :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع بنذ لك هل الله رفغ ةبيصملا هركذ دنع عجرتسفا ةبيصم ركذ املكو هبنذ نم مدقت ام هل الله رفغ لاإ هأجفت .امهنيب اميف هبستكا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: There is no servant who is afflicted with a calamity and says "Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un" when remembering the calamity and shows patience when it first strikes him, except that Allah forgives his past sins, and whenever he remembers a calamity and says "Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un" upon remembering it, Allah forgives all sins he committed between the times.

chapter: Recommendation Of Saying "Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilayhi Raji'un" And Making Prescribed Supplications When Remembering Calamities Even After Some Time
arabicText: دمحلاو نوعجار هيلإ ناإو لله ناإ " :لاقف نيح دعب ولو ةبيصم ركذ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع لوأ دنع ناك ام لثم رجلاا نم هل ناك " اهنم لضفأ ليع فلخاو يتبيصم لىع ينرجأ مهللا ،نيملاعلا بر لله .ةمدص
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever remembers a calamity, even after some time, and says "Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un, walhamdulillahi rabbil 'alamin, Allahumma ajirni 'ala musibati wakhluf 'alayya afdala minha" (Indeed we belong to Allah and indeed to Him we will return, and all praise is due to Allah the Lord of the worlds, O Allah reward me for my calamity and replace it with something better), he will receive the same reward as he would have received at the first moment of shock.

chapter: Recommendation Of Saying "Inna Lillahi Wa Inna Ilayhi Raji'un" And Making Prescribed Supplications When Remembering Calamities Even After Some Time
arabicText: ايندلا يف ةبيصمب باصي نمؤم نم ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم بجوأ يتلا رئابكلا لاإ هبونذ نم ىضم ام هل الله رفغ لاإ ةبيصملا هأجفت نيح ربصيو هتبيصم دنع عجرتسيف رفغ اهدنع لجو زع الله دمحو اهدنع عجرتسفا هرمع نم لبقتسي اميف ةبيصم ركذ املكو رانلا اهيلع الله .بونذلا نم رئابكلا لاإ ريخلأا عاجرتسلاا ىلإ لولأا عاجرتسلاا نيب اميف هبستكا بنذ لك هل الله
englishText: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: There is Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: There is no believer who is afflicted with a worldly calamity and says "Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un" during his calamity and shows patience when it first strikes him, except that Allah forgives his past sins except for the major sins for which Allah has prescribed Hellfire, and whenever he remembers a calamity in his future life and says "Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un" for it and praises Allah the Mighty and Majestic, Allah forgives every sin he committed between the first "Inna lillahi" and the last one, except for the major sins.

chapter: Obligation Of Being Content With Divine Decree
arabicText: ،هل اريخ ناك لاإ اءاضق هل لجو زع الله يضقي لا ملسملا ءرملل تبجع :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هل اريخ ناك اهبراغمو ضرلأا قراشم كلم نإو ،هل اريخ ناك ضيراقملبا ضرق نإ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I am amazed by the Muslim person, for Allah Mighty and Majestic does not decree anything for him except that it is good for him. If he were to be cut with scissors, it would be good for him, and if he were to own the east and west of the earth, it would be good for him.

chapter: Obligation Of Being Content With Divine Decree
arabicText: ،هل اريخ هتلعج لاإ ئش يف هفرصأ لا نمؤملا يدبع :لجو زع الله لقا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .يدنع نيقيدصلا نم دمحم يا هبتكأ يئامعن ركشيلو ،يئلاب لىع ربصيلو ،يئاضقب ضريلف
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Allah Mighty and Majestic says: My believing servant, I do not turn him to anything except I make it good for him, so let him be content with My decree, let him be patient with My trials, and let him be grateful for My blessings. O Muhammad, I shall write him among the truthful ones with Me.

chapter: Obligation Of Being Content With Divine Decree
arabicText: .لجو زع الله ءاضقب مهاضرأ للهبا سانلا ملعأ نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The most knowledgeable of people about Allah are those most content with Allah's decree, Mighty and Majestic.

chapter: Obligation Of Being Content With Divine Decree
arabicText: اميف الله نع يضرو ربص نمو ،الله ةعاط سأر الله نع اضرلاو ربصلا :لقا (ملاسلا اهيلع) نيسحلا نب ليع نع .هل ريخ وه ام لاإ هرك وأ بحأ اميف هل لجو زع الله ضقي مل هرك وأ بحأ اميف هيلع ىضق
englishText: From Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon them) who said: Patience and contentment with Allah are the pinnacle of obedience to Allah, and whoever is patient and content with Allah in what He has decreed for him, whether he likes it or dislikes it, Allah Mighty and Majestic will not decree for him anything he likes or dislikes except what is better for him.

chapter: Obligation Of Being Content With Divine Decree
arabicText: يف همهتي لاو ،هقزر يف هئطبتسي لا نأ الله نع لقع نمل يغبني :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا يبأ نع .هئاضق
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him) who said: It befits one who understands Allah not to consider Him slow in providing sustenance, nor suspect Him in His decree.

chapter: Obligation Of Being Content With Divine Decree
arabicText: دبع يا :هل لاقف رفعج نب الله دبع (ملاسلا امهيلع) ليع نب نسحلا ىقل :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع سجهي مل نماضلا ناأو الله هيلع مكاحلاو ؟هتلزنم رقحيو همسق طخسي وهو انمؤم نمؤملا نوكي فيك ،الله .هل باجتسيف الله وعدي نأ اضرلا لاإ هبلق يف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Al-Hasan bin Ali (peace be upon them) met Abdullah bin Ja'far and said to him: O Abdullah, how can a believer be a believer while he is discontent with his portion and belittles his position? While Allah is the Judge over him, and I guarantee that if contentment settles in his heart, he will not supplicate to Allah except that He responds to him.

chapter: Obligation Of Being Content With Divine Decree
arabicText: اضرلاو لله ميلستلبا :لقا ؟نمؤم هنأ نمؤملا ملع ئش يبأ :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .طخس وأ رورس نم هيلع درو اميف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I asked him: By what does a believer know that he is a believer? He said: By submission to Allah and contentment with whatever comes to him of pleasure or displeasure.

chapter: Obligation Of Being Content With Divine Decree
arabicText: ناك ول :ىضم دق ئشل لوقي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نكي مل :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هريغ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) never said about something that had passed: "If only it were different."

chapter: Obligation Of Being Content With Divine Decree
arabicText: ام ىسوم يا :(ملاسلا هيلع) نارمع نب ىسوم ىلإ الله حىوأ اميف نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ملعأ ناأو ،هل ريخ وه امل هنع يوزأو ،هل ريخ وه امل هيلتبأ امنإ ينإو ،نمؤملا يدبع نم يلإ بحأ اقلخ تقلخ اذإ يدنع نيقيدصلا يف هبتكأ يئاضقب ضريلو ،يئامعن ركشيلو ،يئلاب لىع ربصيلف ،يدبع هيلع حلصي امب .يرمأ عاطأو ياضرب لمع ام ىسوم يا :(ملاسلا هيلع) نارمع نب ىسوم ىلإ الله حىوأ اميف نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ملعأ ناأو ،هل ريخ وه امل هنع يوزأو ،هل ريخ وه امل هيلتبأ امنإ ينإو ،نمؤملا يدبع نم يلإ بحأ اقلخ تقلخ اذإ يدنع نيقيدصلا يف هبتكأ يئاضقب ضريلو ،يئامعن ركشيلو ،يئلاب لىع ربصيلف ،يدبع هيلع حلصي امب .يرمأ عاطأو ياضرب لمع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Among what Allah revealed to Moses son of Imran (peace be upon him): "O Moses, I have not created any creation more beloved to Me than My believing servant. I only test him for what is better for him, and I withhold from him what is better for him. I know best what benefits My servant, so let him be patient with My trials, grateful for My blessings, and content with My decree. I will write him among the truthful ones with Me when he acts according to My pleasure and obeys My command."

chapter: Obligation Of Being Content With Divine Decree
arabicText: ميظع هب فأاكي ءلابلا ميظع نإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .طخسلا هلف ءلابلا طخس نمو ،اضرلا الله دنع هلف يضر نمف ،ءلابلا ميظعب هلاتبا ادبع الله بحأ اذفإ ،ءازجلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Great trials are rewarded with great rewards. When Allah loves a servant, He tests him with great trials. Whoever is content, Allah's contentment is for him, and whoever is discontent with the trial, discontentment is for him.

chapter: Obligation Of Being Content With Divine Decree
arabicText: نمو ،لجو زع الله فرع نم لجو زع الله ىضق امل ملسي نأ الله قلخ قحأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .هرجأ الله طبحأو ءاضقلا هيلع ىضم ءاضقلا طخس نمو ،هرجأ الله مظعأو ءاضقلا هيلع ىتأ ءاضقلبا يضر
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The most deserving of Allah's creation to submit to Allah's decree is the one who knows Allah. Whoever is content with the decree, the decree comes upon him and Allah maximizes his reward. Whoever is discontent with the decree, the decree still comes upon him and Allah nullifies his reward.

chapter: Obligation Of Being Content With Divine Decree
arabicText: ىضري لاو ،هرك وأ دبعلا بحأ اميف الله نع اضرلاو ربصلا الله ةعاط سأر :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هرك وأ بحأ اميف هل اريخ ناك لاإ هرك وأ بحأ اميف الله نع دبع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The foundation of obedience to Allah is patience and contentment with Allah in what the servant likes or dislikes. No servant is content with Allah in what he likes or dislikes except that it is better for him in what he likes or dislikes.

chapter: Obligation Of Being Content With Divine Decree
arabicText: لىعأ ،ءازجأ ةرشع دهزلا :(ملاسلا امهيلع) نيسحلا نب ليع لقا لقا هيبأ نع ،ديربلا نب مشاه نب ليع نع .اضرلا ةجرد ىندأ نيقيلا ةجرد لىعأو ،نيقيلا ةجرد ىندأ عرولا ةجرد لىعأو ،عرولا ةجرد ىندأ دهزلا ةجرد
englishText: From Ali ibn Hashim ibn al-Barid, from his father who said: Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon them both) said: Asceticism has ten parts. The highest degree of asceticism is the lowest degree of piety, and the highest degree of piety is the lowest degree of certainty, and the highest degree of certainty is the lowest degree of contentment.

chapter: Obligation Of Being Content With Divine Decree
arabicText: ليعامسإ (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا ىلإ يعن :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هيبأ نع ،اضرلا هيبأ نع ،ليع نب دمحم نع لكيأ لعجو هئامدن عم دعقف هماعطب اعد مث مسبتف .هؤامدن عمتجا دقو لكيأ نأ ديري وهو هدلاوأ ربكأ وهو ،ارثأ ههجو يف نزحلل نوري لا هنم نوبجعيو مهيديأ نيب عضيو هءامدن ثحيو ،ميالأا رئاس هلكأ نم نسحأ نوكأ لا يلام :لاقف !ىرن امك تنأو نبلاا اذه لثمب تبصأ ،ابجع كنم انيأر دقل الله لوسر نب يا :اولقا غرف املف هفطخي ام اوركني ملف توملا اوفرع اموق نإ ،مكياإو تيم ينأ نيقداصلا قدصأ ربخ ينءاج دقو نورت امك .لجو زع مهقلاخ رملاا اوملسو مهنم توملا
englishText: From Muhammad ibn Ali, from his father Al-Ridha, from his father (peace be upon them) who said: News of Isma'il's death, who was his eldest son, came to Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) while he was about to eat with his companions gathered. He smiled, then called for his food and sat with his companions. He ate better than he did on other days, encouraged his companions, and served them while they were amazed, seeing no trace of grief on his face. When they finished, they said: "O son of the Messenger of Allah, we have seen something amazing from you. You've been struck with the loss of such a son, yet you are as we see!" He said: "Why should I not be as you see when I have received news from the most truthful of the truthful that I and you will die? Indeed, people who understand death do not deny what death takes from them and submit the matter to their Creator, the Mighty and Majestic."

chapter: Obligation Of Being Content With Divine Decree
arabicText: ركذ نمل ىبوط :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نع (ةغلابلا جهن) يف يضرلا نيسحلا نب دمحم .هناحبس الله نع يضرو ،فافكلبا عنقو ،باسحلل لمعو ،داعملا
englishText: Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn Al-Radhi in (Nahj al-Balagha) from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) that he said: Blessed is the one who remembers the return, works for the reckoning, is content with sufficiency, and is pleased with Allah, glory be to Him.

chapter: Obligation Of Being Content With Divine Decree
arabicText: اميف الله عنص امب اضرلا الله ةعاط سأر :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا رامع نب قاحسإ نع .هل ريخ وهو لاإ (هرك اميفو بحأ اميف الله عنص امب يضر) ائيش دبعب الله عنصي ملو هرك اميفو دبعلا بحأ
englishText: From Ishaq ibn Ammar who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: The peak of obedience to Allah is being content with what Allah has decreed, in what the servant likes and in what he dislikes, and Allah has not decreed anything for a servant (who is content with what Allah has decreed in what he likes and what he dislikes) except that it is better for him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: هل ناك هيلع ربصف ءلابب نينمؤملا نم ليتبا نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا :لقا يلامثلا ةزمح يبأ نع .ديهش فلأ رجأ لثم
englishText: From Abu Hamza Al-Thumali who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever among the believers is afflicted with a trial and remains patient upon it, will have the reward equivalent to a thousand martyrs.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: ام :هل لاقف نيزح بئتكم لجرب وه اذفإ دجسملا (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لخد لقا الله دبع يبأ نع الله ىوقتب كيلع :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ هل لاقف ،تلجو نوكأ نأ ىشخأو خيأو يببأ تبصأ :لقا ؟كل ،دسجلا دسف دسجلا سأرلا قرفا اذفإ ،دسجلا نم سأرلا ةلزنمب روملأا يف ربصلاو ،ادغ هيلع مدقت ربصلاو .روملأا تدسف روملأا ربصلا قرفا اذإو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah who said: Amir al-Mu'mineen (peace be upon him) entered the mosque and found a man who was depressed and sad. He asked him: What's wrong with you? The man said: I have been afflicted with [the loss of] my father and brother, and I fear I have become anxious. Amir al-Mu'mineen (peace be upon him) said to him: You must have fear of Allah and patience, you will meet them tomorrow. Patience in affairs is like the head to the body; if the head leaves the body, the body becomes corrupt, and if patience leaves affairs, the affairs become corrupt.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: ربلاو ،هراسي نع ةاكزلاو ،هنيمي نع ةلاصلا تناك هربق نمؤملا لخد اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ةاكزلاو ةلاصلل ربصلا لقا هتلءاسم نايلي ناذللا ناكلملا هيلع لخد اذفإ ،ةيحنا ربصلا حىنتيو ،هيلع لظم .هنود نافأ متزجع نفإ مكبحاص مكنود :ربلاو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When a believer enters his grave, prayer will be on his right, zakat on his left, and righteousness will be shading him, while patience stands aside. When the two angels who are responsible for questioning enter upon him, patience says to prayer, zakat, and righteousness: Take care of your companion, and if you are unable, then I will take care of him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: لىع اوربصا :لقا (اورباصو اوربصا اونمآ نيذلا اهيأ يا) :لجو زع الله لوق يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .بئاصملا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding the words of Allah the Mighty and Majestic: "O you who believe, be patient and endure" [Quran, 3:200], he said: Be patient in the face of calamities.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: .بئاصملا لىع اوربصا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،روفعي يبأ نبا ةياور يفو :لقا
englishText: And in the narration of Ibn Abi Ya'fur, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Be patient upon calamities.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: نإو ،روبص وهو ءلابلا هيتأيف نمؤملا ىلإ ناقبتسي ءلابلاو ربصلا نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .عوزج وهو ءلابلا هيتأيف رفاكلا ىلإ ناقبتسي ءلابلاو عزجلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Patience and affliction race to reach the believer, and affliction reaches him while he is patient; and anxiety and affliction race to reach the disbeliever, and affliction reaches him while he is anxious.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: تكادت نإو ،اهل ربص ةبئنا هتبنا نإ ،هلاوحأ عيمج لىع رح رحلا نإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس ررضي مل ،نيملأا قيدصلا فسوي ناك امك ،ارسع رسيلبا لدبتساو رهقو رسأ نإو ،هرسكت مل بئاصملا هيلع رابجلا لعجف هيلع الله نم نأ هلنا امو ،هتشحوو بجلا ةملظ هررضت ملو رسأو رهقو دبعتسا نأ هتيرح اونطوو اوربصفا ،اريخ بقعي ربصلا كلذكو ،ةمأ هب محر هلسرفأ اكلام (هل) ناك ذإ دعب ادبع هل يتاعلا .اورجؤت ربصلا لىع مكسفنأ
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: The free person remains free in all his conditions. If a calamity befalls him, he remains patient with it. If calamities pile up against him, they do not break him. If he is imprisoned, oppressed, and ease is replaced with hardship- like Yusuf, the truthful and trustworthy- his freedom was not harmed by being enslaved, oppressed, and imprisoned. The darkness and loneliness of the well did not harm him, nor what befell him until Allah favored him and made the tyrannical oppressor his slave after having been his owner. He sent him as a mercy to a nation. Similarly, patience results in good, so be patient and prepare yourselves for patience, you will be rewarded.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: بهذ سأرلا بهذ اذفإ ،دسجلا نم سأرلا ةلزنمب ناميلاا نم ربصلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ناميلاا بهذ ربصلا بهذ اذإ كلذك ،دسجلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Patience is to faith like the head is to the body. When the head is gone, the body is gone, likewise when patience is gone, faith is gone.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: .ناميلاا سأر ربصلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Patience is the head of faith.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: امك نمؤملا رطفتل ءلابلا لبق قلخ ربصلا نأ لاول :لقا ،لجر نع ،هدج نع ،ةليمج يبأ نب دمحم نب ليع نع .افصلا لىع ةضيبلا رطفتت
englishText: From Ali bin Muhammad bin Abi Jamila, from his grandfather, from a man who said: Had patience not been created before affliction, the believer would have cracked like an egg cracks on a smooth stone.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: .هدسج يف ءلاتبلابا لاإ دبع اهغلبي لا ةلزنم ةنجلا يف نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed in Paradise there is a station that a servant cannot reach except through affliction in his body.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: ايضار هريداقم الله ذفني ربصت لا نإو ،طبتغت ربصت نإ :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع .اهراك مأ تنك
englishText: From Abi Al-Hasan (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- who said: If you are patient you will be envied, and if you are not patient Allah will execute His decrees whether you are satisfied or dissatisfied.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: نم سأرلا ةلزنمب ناميلاا نم ربصلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا نب ليع ىلإ هعفر جارسلا الله دبع نع ،هنعو .هل ربص لا نمل ناميإ لاو ،دسجلا
englishText: And from him, from Abdullah Al-Sarraj raising it to Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) who said: Patience is to faith like the head is to the body, and there is no faith for one who has no patience.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: بهذ سأرلا بهذ اذفإ ،دسجلا نم سأرلا ةلزنمب ناميلاا نم ربصلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ناميلاا بهذ ربصلا بهذ اذإ كلذك ،دسجلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Patience is to faith like the head is to the body. When the head is gone, the body is gone, likewise when patience is gone, faith is gone.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: .ءاطعلاا ةورم نم رثكأ انغلاو ففعتلاو ةقافلاو ةجاحلا لاح يف ربصلا ةورم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The virtue of patience during times of need, poverty, abstinence, and wealth is greater than the virtue of giving.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: انبصأ دق ناإ :هل لق :لقاو ،(لضفملا يزعأ نأ) (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ ينرمأ :لقا بوقعي نب سنوي نع .لجو زع الله رملأ انملسف ارمأ لجو زع الله دارأو ارمأ نادرأ ناإ ،ناربص امك ربصفا ناربصف ليعامسإب
englishText: From Yunus ibn Ya'qub who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) ordered me (to console al-Mufaddal) and said: Tell him: We have been afflicted with [the loss of] Isma'il and we were patient, so be patient as we were patient. We wanted something but Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, wanted something else, so we submitted to Allah's command.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: - ثيدح يف - :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع ،هعفر رمش نب ورمع نع امك ةجردلا ىلإ ةجردلا نيب ام ةجرد ةئامثلاث هل الله بتك اهئازع نسحب اهدري ىتح ةبيصملا لىع ربص نم .ضرلأاو ءامسلا نيب
englishText: From Amr ibn Shimr, raising it to Ali (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said- in a hadith: Whoever remains patient during calamity until he overcomes it with good consolation, Allah will write for him three hundred degrees, the distance between each degree is like the distance between the heaven and earth.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: اموق لىتباو ،لاباو مهيلع تراصف اوركشي ملف موق لىع معنأ الله نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةمعن مهيلع تراصف اوربصف بئاصملبا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Allah blessed some people but they were ungrateful, so it became a curse upon them, and He tested others with From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Allah blessed some people but they were ungrateful, so it became a curse upon them, and He tested others with calamities but they were patient, so it became a blessing for them.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: .زجعي رهدلا بئاونل ربصلا دعي لا نم :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) رفعج يبأ وأ الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah or Abu Ja'far (peace be upon them) who said: Whoever does not prepare patience for the vicissitudes of time will be helpless.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: لىص) دمحم عم ةنجلا هلخدأو ،هزع ىلإ ازع الله هداز ةبيصم لىع ربص نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .هتيب لهأو (هلآو هيلع الله
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever is patient during calamity, Allah will increase his honor upon honor, and admit him to Paradise with Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) and his household.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: ءلابب انتعيش نم ليب نم (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع (رابخلأا نويع) يفو .ديهش فلأ رجأ هل الله بتك ربصف
englishText: And in (Uyun al-Akhbar) from Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Whoever among our followers is tested with a trial and remains patient, Allah will write for him the reward of a thousand martyrs.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: .ءايبنلأا قلاخأ نم قلخلا نسحو ملحلاو ربلاو ربصلا نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع (لاصخلا) يفو
englishText: And in (Al-Khisal) from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed patience, righteousness, forbearance, and good character are from the qualities of the Prophets.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: ءاخرلاو ةمعنلا اودعت ىتحو نينمتؤم اونوكت ىتح نينمؤم نونوكت لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ءاخرلا دنع ةيفاعلا نم لضفأ ءلابلا لىع ربصلا نإ كلذو ،ةبيصم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: You will not be believers until you become trustworthy and until you consider blessing and ease as calamity, and that is because patience during hardship is better than wellness during ease.

chapter: Recommendation Of Patience In Affliction
arabicText: ،ةمعنو ،ءاضقو ،ءلاب :ثلاث نيب دبعلا :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا يلامثلا ةزمح يبأ نع ركشلا الله نم ةمعنلل هيلعو ،ةضيرف ميلستلا الله نم ءاضقلل هيلعو ،ةضيرف ربصلا الله نم ءلابلل هيلعف .ةضيرف صوصخم هريغو ريخلأا نم مهفي يذلا بوجولا نإ مث ،هيلع لدي ام يتيأو ،كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ ،لاصأ رثأتلا راهظإ مدعك بحتسم هيلع داز امو ،يبلقلا راكنلاا مدعو ءاضقلبا اضرلاك بتارملا ضعبب .ملعأ اللهو ،انطباو ارهاظ ةبيصملبا رورسلاو حرفلا راعشتساو
englishText: From Abi Hamza Al-Thumali who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: The servant faces three situations: trial, decree, and blessing. For the trial from Allah, patience is obligatory upon him; for the decree from Allah, submission is obligatory upon him; and for the blessing from Allah, gratitude is obligatory upon him. I (Hurr Amili) say: What indicates this has preceded, and what indicates it will come. Then the obligation that is understood from the latter and others is specific to certain levels, such as being content with the decree and absence of denial in the heart. What exceeds this is recommended, such as not showing any effect at all, and feeling joy and pleasure with the calamity both outwardly and inwardly, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: :لاقف ،نمؤملا هب الله صخي امو ءلابلا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ دنع ركذ :لقا جاجحلا نب نمحرلا دبع نع ،لثملأفا لثملأا مث نويبنلا :لاقف ؟ايندلا يف ءلاب سانلا دشأ نم (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لئس فخس نمو ،هؤلاب دتشا هلمع نسحو هناميإ حص نمف ،هلامعأ نسحو هناميأ ردق لىع دعب نمؤملا ليتبيو .هؤلاب لق هلمع فعضو هناميإ
englishText: From Abd al-Rahman bin Al-Hajjaj who said: Tribulation and how Allah specially tests the believer was mentioned before Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), so he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was asked who faces the most severe trials in this world? He said: The Prophets, then the next best, then the next best. The believer is then tested according to his faith and good deeds. Whoever has sound faith and good deeds, his trials increase, and whoever has weak faith and weak deeds, his trials decrease.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: .هدسج يف ءلاتبلابا لاإ دبع اهغلبي لا ةلزنم ةنجلا يف نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed in Paradise there is a station that a servant cannot reach except through tribulation in his body.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: ،ةدش يف اوناك ذنم اولازي مل قحلا لهأ نإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا طبار نب سنوي نع .ةليوط ةيفاعو ةليلق ةدم ىلإ كلذ نإ امأ
englishText: From Yunus bin Ribat who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: Indeed the people of truth have always been in hardship since they existed, however that is for a short period and [leads to] long well-being.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: باهذب امإ نيتلصخ ىدحإب لاإ اهلاني امف الله دنع ةلزنم دبعلل نوكيل هنإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هدسج يف ةيلبب وأ ،هلام
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed a servant may have a station with Allah that he cannot attain except through one of two things: either loss of his wealth or affliction in his body.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: .لثملأفا لثملأا مث ،مهنولي نيذلا مث ،ءايبنلأا ءلاب سانلا دشأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The people who face the most severe trials are the Prophets, then those who follow them, then the next best and the next best.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: .لثاملأفا لثاملأا مث ،ءايصولأا مث ،ءايبنلأا ءلاب سانلا دشأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The people who face the most severe trials are the Prophets, then the successors, then the most exemplary and the next most exemplary.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: هنزحي رمأ هل ضرع لاإ ةليل نوعبرأ هيلع يضمي لا نمؤملا :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا .هب ركذي
englishText: He said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: Not forty nights pass upon a believer except that a matter occurs that grieves him, by which he is reminded.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: مث ،نويبنلا ءلاب سانلا دشأ نإ (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع باتك يف نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع هلمع نسحو هنيد حص نمف ،ةنسحلا هلامعأ ردق لىع نمؤملا لىتبي امنإو ،لثملأفا لثملأا مث ،نويصولا فعضو هنيد فخس نمو رفاكل ةبوقع لاو نمؤمل بااوث ايندلا لعجي مل لجو زع الله نأ كلذو ،هؤلاب دتشا .ضرلأا رارق ىلإ رطملا نم يقتلا نمؤملا ىلإ عرسأ ءلابلا نإو ،هؤلاب لق هلمع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: In the book of Ali (peace be upon him): Indeed the people with the most severe trials are the Prophets, then their successors, then the next best and the next best. The believer is only tested according to his good deeds. Whoever's religion is sound and whose deeds are good, his trials become more severe. This is because Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, did not make this world a reward for a believer nor a punishment for a disbeliever. Whoever's From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: In the book of Ali (peace be upon him): Indeed the people with the most severe trials are the Prophets, then their successors, then the next best and the next best. The believer is only tested according to his good deeds. Whoever's religion is sound and whose deeds are good, his trials become more severe. This is because Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, did not make this world a reward for a believer nor a punishment for a disbeliever. Whoever's religion is weak and whose deeds are weak, his trials become less. Indeed, trials reach a pious believer faster than rain reaches the bottom of the earth.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: ،ةبيغلا نم ةيدهلبا هلهأ لجرلا دهاعتي امك ءلابلبا نمؤملا دهاعتيل الله نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ضيرملا بيبطلا يمحي امك ايندلا هيمحيو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed Allah tends to the believer with trials just as a man tends to his family with gifts when returning from absence, and He protects him from the world just as a doctor protects the patient.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: .مهلاتبا لاإ اموق الله بحأ امو ،ءلابلا ميظع عمل رجلاا ميظع نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed great reward comes with great trials, and Allah does not love a people except that He tests them.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: ناأو ،اتغ ءلابلبا (١) هتغ ادبع بحأ اذإ الله نإ - ريدس هدنعو - :لقا هنإ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .يسمنو هب حبصنل - ريدس يا - مكياإو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he said- while Sudayr was with him: Indeed when Allah loves a servant, He immerses him completely in trials, and we- O Sudayr - encounter it morning and evening.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: .هئلاب يف ديز هناميإ يف ديز املك ،نازيملا ةفك ةلزنمب نمؤملا امنإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The believer is only like the pan of a scale; whenever his faith increases, his trials increase.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: - اماقسم ناكو - عاجولأا نم ىقلأ ام (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ ىلإ توكش :لقا روفعي يبأ نب الله دبع نع .ضيراقملبا ضرق هنأ ينمتل بئاصملا يف رجلاا نم هلام نمؤملا ملعي ول :يل لاقف
englishText: From Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur who said: I complained to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the pains I was experiencing- and he was sickly- so he said to me: If the believer knew what reward he has in calamities, he would wish to be cut with scissors.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: ءامسلا نم لزني ام هدابع صلاخ نم ضرلأا يف ادابع لجو زع لله نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .مهيلإ اهفرص لاإ ةيلب لاو ،مهريغ ىلإ مهنع اهفرص لاإ ضرلأا ىلإ ةفحت
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has servants on earth from His pure servants- no gift descends from the sky to the earth except that He diverts it from them to others, and no trial except that He directs it to them.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: :لقا هاعد اذفإ ،(١) اجث ءلابلبا هجثو ،اتغ ءلابلبا هتغ ادبع بحأ ذإ الله نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .كل ريخ كل ترخدا امف كل ترخدا نئلو ،رداقل كلذ لىع ينإ تلأس ام كل تلجع نئل ،يدبع كيبل
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed when Allah loves a servant, He immerses him completely in trials and pours trials upon him abundantly. When he calls upon Him, He says: "Here I am, My servant. If I hasten what you ask for, I am indeed capable of that, but what I have stored for you is better for you."

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: .هنيد بسح لىع :لقا وأ ،هنيد ردق لىع ايندلا يف نمؤملا لىتبي امنإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, a believer is tested in this world according to his faith, or he said: in proportion to his faith.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: :لاقف :لقا ؟اذه هابشأو صربلاو ماذجلبا نمؤملا لىتبيأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ريكب نبا نع ؟نمؤملا لىع لاإ ءلابلا بتك لهو
englishText: From Ibn Bukayr who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) if a believer can be afflicted with leprosy, vitiligo, and similar ailments? He said: Has affliction been prescribed for anyone other than the believer?

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: بياغلا دهاعتي امك ءلابلبا نمؤملا هدبع دهاعتيل الله نإ :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ضيرملا بيبطلا يمحي امك ايندلا هيمحيل هنإو ،فرطلبا هلهأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- who said: Indeed, Allah tends to His believing servant with trials just as an absent person tends to his family with gifts, and He protects him from worldly matters just as a physician protects his patient.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: ةورف اوخلسف هوذخفأ هموق ىلإ الله هثعب ءايبنلأا نم ايبن نإ - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع عنصي امب ةوسأ يل لاقف ،تئش امب ينرمف كيلإ ينثعب الله نإ :لاقف ،كلم هتافأ ،ههجوو هسأر .(ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلبا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- that a prophet among the prophets was sent by Allah to his people, and they seized him and peeled the skin of his head and face. Then an angel came to him and said: Allah has sent me to you, so command me as you wish. He said: I have a model in what will be done to Al-Husayn (peace be upon him).

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: ههجو ةدلج اورشقف هموق هيلع الله طلس ايبن لاوسر ناك ليعامسإ نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع دقو ،كب عنص ام تيأر دق :لوقيو ملاسلا كئرقي كبر :هل لاقف ،نيملاعلا بر دنع نم لوسر هتافأ هسأر ةورفو .ةوسأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلبا يل نوكي :لاقف ،تئش امب ينرمف كتعاطب ينرمأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Isma'il was a messenger and prophet. Allah gave his people power over him, and they peeled the skin of his face and head. Then a messenger from the Lord of the worlds came to him and said: Your Lord sends you greetings and says: I have seen what they did to you, and He has commanded me to obey you, so command me as you wish. He said: I have a model in Al-Husayn (peace be upon him).

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Tribulation As A Good Deed And Following The Example Of Prophets, Successors, And The Righteous
arabicText: همهتفا هايند هل تفص نم يأ :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نع ،هئباآ نع ،دمحم نب ليع ماملإا نع .هنيد يف
englishText: From Imam Ali bin Muhammad, from his forefathers, from Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon them) who said: Whoever finds his worldly life pure should be suspicious about his religion.

chapter: Prohibition Of Showing Gloating (Shamaatah) Towards A Believer
arabicText: نم :لقاو .كب اهريصيو ،الله همحريف كيخلأ ةتامشلا يدبت لا :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .نتتفي ىتح ايندلا نم جرخي مل هيخبأ تلزن ةبيصمب تمش
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he said: Do not show gloating (*) towards your brother, for Allah will have mercy on him and afflict you with it. And he said: Whoever gloats over a calamity that befalls his brother will not leave this world until he is tried with affliction. Translator: * Expressing satisfaction at another's misfortune often with the intention of rubbing it in or showing superiority.

chapter: Prohibition Of Showing Gloating (Shamaatah) Towards A Believer
arabicText: الله همحريف كيخبأ ةتامشلا رهظت لا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا ةلثاو نع ،لوحكم نع .كيلتبيو
englishText: From Makhool, from Wathila who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Do not show gloating towards your brother, for Allah will have mercy on him and afflict you.

chapter: Recommendation To Remember One's Affliction In Relation To The Prophet's (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) Affliction And Considering One's Own Affliction As Minor In Comparison
arabicText: نفإ ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسرب كباصم ركذفا ةبيصمب تبصأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .طق هلثمب اوباصي مل قلخلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) he said: When you are afflicted with a calamity, remember your affliction in relation to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), for people have never been afflicted with anything like it.

chapter: Recommendation To Remember One's Affliction In Relation To The Prophet's (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) Affliction And Considering One's Own Affliction As Minor In Comparison
arabicText: نم هنفإ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلبا هباصم ركذيلف ةبيصمب بيصأ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .بئاصملا مظعأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) he said: Whoever is afflicted with a calamity should remember his affliction in relation to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) for it is among the greatest of calamities.

chapter: Recommendation To Remember One's Affliction In Relation To The Prophet's (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) Affliction And Considering One's Own Affliction As Minor In Comparison
arabicText: ،نئادملبا وهو نيسحلا ىلإ نسحلا ىعن (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ بيصأ امل :لقا ديلولا نب الله دبع نع بيصأ نم :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ عم ،اهمظعأ ام ةبيصم نم اهل يا :لقا باتكلا أرق املف .(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) قدصو ،اهنم مظعأ ةبيصمب باصي نل هنفإ يب هباصم ركذيلف ةبيصمب مكنم
englishText: From Abdullah bin Al-Waleed who said: When Amir Al-Mu'mineen (peace be upon him) was afflicted, Al-Hasan announced it to Al-Husayn while he was in Al-Mada'in. When he read the letter, he said: What a great calamity this is, even though the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever among you is afflicted with a calamity should remember his affliction in relation to me for he will never be afflicted with a greater calamity than it, and he (peace be upon him and his family) spoke the truth.

chapter: Recommendation To Remember One's Affliction In Relation To The Prophet's (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) Affliction And Considering One's Own Affliction As Minor In Comparison
arabicText: ركذفا كدلو يف وأ كلام يف وأ كسفن يف ةبيصم يف تبصأ نإ :لقا :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .طق هلثمب اوباصي مل قئلاخلا نفإ ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسرب كباصم
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: If you are afflicted with a calamity regarding yourself, your wealth, or your child, remember your affliction in relation to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), for creation has never been afflicted with anything like it.

chapter: Recommendation To Remember One's Affliction In Relation To The Prophet's (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) Affliction And Considering One's Own Affliction As Minor In Comparison
arabicText: يف هتبيصم ركذيلف ةبيصمب بيصأ نم :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع .بئاصملا مظعأ اهنفإ
englishText: From his father (peace be upon them both) he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever is afflicted with a calamity should remember his calamity in relation to me for it is the greatest of calamities.

chapter: Recommendation To Remember One's Affliction In Relation To The Prophet's (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) Affliction And Considering One's Own Affliction As Minor In Comparison
arabicText: اهنفإ يب هتبيصم ركذيلف ةبيصم مكدحأ باصأ اذإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا سابع نبا نع .بئاصملا مظعأ نم
englishText: From Ibn Abbas who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: When any of you is afflicted with a calamity, he should remember his calamity in relation to me for it is among the greatest calamities.

chapter: Recommendation To Remember One's Affliction In Relation To The Prophet's (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) Affliction And Considering One's Own Affliction As Minor In Comparison
arabicText: .هيلع نوهتس اهنفإ يب هتبيصم ركذيلف (ةبيصم هدنع تمظع نم) :لقا هنأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) هنعو
englishText: And from him (peace be upon him and his family) that he said: Whoever considers a calamity great should remember his calamity in relation to me for it will become easier for him.

chapter: Recommendation To Remember One's Affliction In Relation To The Prophet's (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) Affliction And Considering One's Own Affliction As Minor In Comparison
arabicText: يدعب نم ةبيصمب بيصأ يتمأ نم دبع اميأ ،سانلا اهيأ :هتوم ضرم يف :لقا هنأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) هنعو هيلع دشأ يدعب ةبيصمب باصي نل يتمأ نم ادحأ نفإ ،يدعب هبيصت يتلا ةبيصملا نع يب هتبيصمب زعتيلف .يتبيصم نم
englishText: From him (peace be upon him and his progeny) that he said during his illness before death: O people, whichever slave from my nation is afflicted with a calamity after me, then let him find solace in his affliction by [remembering] my calamity over the calamity that befalls him after me, for no one from my nation will be afflicted with a From him (peace be upon him and his progeny) that he said during his illness before death: O people, whichever slave from my nation is afflicted with a calamity after me, then let him find solace in his affliction by [remembering] my calamity over the calamity that befalls him after me, for no one from my nation will be afflicted with a calamity after me that is more severe upon him than my calamity.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Being Impatient During Calamity While Being Displeased With Divine Decree
arabicText: وهو ءلابلا هيتأيف رفاكلا ىلإ ناقبتسي ءلابلاو ربصلا نإ :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .عوزج
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: Patience and affliction race to reach the disbeliever, and affliction reaches him while he is impatient.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Being Impatient During Calamity While Being Displeased With Divine Decree
arabicText: نم اهيلع تبجوتساو ربصلا اهيلع تيطعأ ةبيصم ندعت لا ،قاحسإ يا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهلوزن دنع ربصي مل اذإ اهباوثو اهرجأ اهبحاص مرحي يتلا ةبيصملا امنإ ،باوثلا لجو زع الله
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: O Ishaq, do not consider it a calamity when you are given patience for it and deserve reward from Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, for it. Indeed, the real calamity is that which its bearer is deprived of its reward and recompense when he does not show patience when it befalls.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Being Impatient During Calamity While Being Displeased With Divine Decree
arabicText: هيلع) الله دبع وبأ هل لاقف ،اهب بيصأ ةبيصم هيلإ اكشف لجر ءاجف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ دنع انك .روزأم تنأو كيلع ردق يذلا الله ردق كيلع ضمي ربصت لاإو ،رجؤت ربصت نإ كنإ امأ :(ملاسلا
englishText: We were with Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) when a man came and complained to him about a calamity that had befallen him. Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said to him: If you are patient, you will be rewarded, and if you are not patient, Allah's decree will still be carried out upon you while you bear the burden of sin.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Being Impatient During Calamity While Being Displeased With Divine Decree
arabicText: يا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسرل لقا توملا كلم نأ - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ام اللهوف !؟عزجلا اذه ام :لوقفأ مهراد نم ةيحنا يف موقفأ هلهأ عزجيف مدآ نبا حور ضبقأ ينإ ،دمحم .اورزوتو اومثتأ اوعزجت نإو ،اورجؤت اوربصتو هوبستحت نفإ ،بنذ نم هضبق يف انل ناك امو ،هلجأ لبق هانلجعت
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- that the Angel of Death said to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family): O Muhammad, when I From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- that the Angel of Death said to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family): O Muhammad, when I take the soul of a son of Adam and his family becomes impatient, I stand in a corner of their house and say: What is this impatience for?! By Allah, we did not hasten his death before his appointed time, and we had no sin in taking his soul. If you consider it (as a trial) and be patient, you will be rewarded, but if you become impatient, you will sin and bear the burden.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Being Impatient During Calamity While Being Displeased With Divine Decree
arabicText: نب ثعشلأا ىلإ (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ ءاج :لقا هعفر ،دامح يبأ نب حلاص نع ،دمحم نب ليع نعو تربص نإ كنأ لىع ،تيدأ الله قحف تربص نإو ،تيتأ محرلا قحف تعزج نإ :هل لاقف ،هل خبأ هيزعي سيق .مومذم تنأو ءاضقلا كيلع ىرج تعزج نإو ،دومحم تنأو ءاضقلا كيلع ىرج
englishText: And from Ali bin Muhammad, from Salih bin Abi Hammad, raising it, he said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) came to Al-Ash'ath bin Qays to console him about his brother, and said to him: If you become impatient, you have fulfilled the right of kinship, and if you are patient, you have fulfilled the right of Allah. However, if you are patient, the decree will be carried out upon you while you are praised, and if you are impatient, the decree will be carried out upon you while you are blamed.

chapter: Emphasis On The Abhorrence Of Slapping One's Thigh During Affliction
arabicText: .هرجأ طبح ةبيصم دنع هذخف لىع هدي برض نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع ،ةرارز نع
englishText: From Zurarah, from Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever slaps his hand on his thigh during a calamity, his reward is nullified.

chapter: Emphasis On The Abhorrence Of Slapping One's Thigh During Affliction
arabicText: دنع هذخف لىع هدي ملسملا برض :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هرجلا طابحإ ةبيصملا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: A Muslim slapping his hand on his thigh during a calamity nullifies his reward.

chapter: Emphasis On The Abhorrence Of Slapping One's Thigh During Affliction
arabicText: .هرجلا طابحإ ةبيصملا دنع هذخف لىع هدي لجرلا برض :لقا :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him) who said: A man slapping his hand on his thigh during a calamity nullifies his reward.

chapter: Emphasis On The Abhorrence Of Slapping One's Thigh During Affliction
arabicText: ردق لىع ربصلا :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نع (ةغلابلا جهن) يف يضرلا نيسحلا نب دمحم .هرجأ طبح هتبيصم دنع هذخف لىع هدي برض نمو ،ةبيصملا
englishText: Muhammad bin Al-Husayn Al-Radhi in (Nahj Al-Balagha) from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) that he said: Patience is according to the magnitude of the calamity, and whoever slaps his hand on his thigh during his calamity, his reward is nullified.

chapter: Duration Limit Of Mourning The Dead
arabicText: .اهتدع يضقت ىتح اهجوز لىع ةأرملا لاإ مياأ ةثلاث نم رثكأ دحي نأ دحلأ سيل :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: No one is allowed to mourn (*) more than three days except for a woman [mourning] for her husband until her waiting period is completed. Translator: * The term "yahiddu" refers to the state and practices associated with the prescribed period of mourning during which an individual refrains from adorning themselves, wearing perfume, or engaging in celebratory activities. Shaykh Hurr Amili: There will be mentioned what indicates the mourning of a woman in its place.

chapter: Dislike Of Screaming With Wailing And Howling, Invoking Humiliation, Bereavement And Grief, Slapping The Face And Chest, Pulling Hair, And Establishing (Ritualized) Lamentation
arabicText: ليوعلاو ليولبا خارصلا عزجلا دشأ :لقا ؟عزجلا ام :هل تلق :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،رباج نع .هقيرط ريغ يف ذخأو ،ربصلا كرت دقف ةحاونلا مقاأ نمو ،يصاونلا نم رعشلا زجو ،ردصلاو هجولا مطلو
englishText: From Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him: What is "jaza" (excessive grief/panic)? He said: The most severe form of "jaza" is crying out with wailing and howling, striking the face and chest, cutting the hair from the forelock, and whoever establishes/engages in [ritualized] wailing has abandoned patience (sabr) and taken a path other than the right one. Translator: The term "jaza" refers to excessive grief, panic, or distress that leads to loss of composure and spiritual equilibrium. It's distinguished from natural, healthy grief.

chapter: Dislike Of Screaming With Wailing And Howling, Invoking Humiliation, Bereavement And Grief, Slapping The Face And Chest, Pulling Hair, And Establishing (Ritualized) Lamentation
arabicText: :اهيلإ قبسي مل يتلا ةزجوملا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ظافلأ نم :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .ةيلهاجلا لمع نم ةحاينلا
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: Among the concise expressions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) which he was not preceded in: Wailing over the dead is from the acts of jahiliyyah.

chapter: Dislike Of Screaming With Wailing And Howling, Invoking Humiliation, Bereavement And Grief, Slapping The Face And Chest, Pulling Hair, And Establishing (Ritualized) Lamentation
arabicText: نع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىهن :لقا - يهانملا ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،قداصلا نع .اهيلإ عامتسلااو ةحاينلا نع ىهنو ،ةبيصملا دنع ةنرلا
englishText: From al-Sadiq, from his fathers (peace be upon them)- in the hadith of prohibitions he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade wailing at the time of calamity, and forbade lamentation and listening to it.

chapter: Dislike Of Screaming With Wailing And Howling, Invoking Humiliation, Bereavement And Grief, Slapping The Face And Chest, Pulling Hair, And Establishing (Ritualized) Lamentation
arabicText: امو ،نزح لاو لكث لاو لذب يعدت لا :بلاط يبأ نب رفعج لتق نيح ةمطافل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) لقاو :لقا .تقدص دقف هيف تلق
englishText: He said: And he (peace be upon him and his family) said to Fatimah when Ja'far bin Abi Talib was killed: "Do not invoke humiliation, bereavement, or grief, and whatever you have said about him is true (*)." Translator: * Fatimah had spoken positively about Ja'far and his qualities, and the Prophet confirms the truth of her words.

chapter: Dislike Of Screaming With Wailing And Howling, Invoking Humiliation, Bereavement And Grief, Slapping The Face And Chest, Pulling Hair, And Establishing (Ritualized) Lamentation
arabicText: زع الله لوق يف لوقي (ملاسلا امهيلع) رفعج باأ و نسحلا باأ تعمس :لقا مادقملا يبأ نب ورمع نع ناأ اذإ :(ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطافل لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :لقا (فورعم يف كنيصعي لاو) :لجو اذه :لقا مث :لقا ،ةحئنا ليع نميقت لاو ،ليولبا يدانت لاو ،ارعش ليع خيرت لاو اهجو ليع يشمخت لاف تم .(فورعم يف كنيصعي لاو) :لجو زع الله لقا يذلا فورعملا .ربصلا يف رم امك نامسق هنأ عزجلا ثيداحأ نم مهفيو ،هيلع لدي ام يتيأو ،كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ
englishText: From Amr bin Abi Al-Miqdam who said: I heard Abu Al-Hasan and Abu Ja'far (peace be upon them) speaking regarding the words of Allah Mighty and Majestic: And they will not disobey you in what is right [Quran, 60:12]. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to Fatima (peace be upon her): When I die, do not scratch your face, do not let down your hair, do not cry out in woe, and do not set up a mourner for me. He then said: This is the right thing that Allah Mighty and Majestic spoke of: And they will not disobey you in what is right [Quran, 60:12]. I (Hurr Amili) say: What indicates this has preceded, and what indicates it will come, and it is understood from the hadiths about panic/anxiety that it is of two types as mentioned previously in patience.

chapter: The Dislike Of Wailing Over The Dead And Tearing Clothes Except For Father, Brother And Relatives, And Its Expiation
arabicText: ربصلاو ،هنوفرعي لا سانلا نكلو ،يغبني لاو تيملا لىع حايصلا حلصي لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ريخ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Wailing over the dead is not proper and should not be done, but people do not know this, and patience is better.

chapter: The Dislike Of Wailing Over The Dead And Tearing Clothes Except For Father, Brother And Relatives, And Its Expiation
arabicText: .بايثلا قشت لاو ،تيملا لىع حايصلا يغبني لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Wailing over the dead should not be done, and clothes should not be torn.

chapter: The Dislike Of Wailing Over The Dead And Tearing Clothes Except For Father, Brother And Relatives, And Its Expiation
arabicText: نب ليع نب دمحم يفوت موي اورضح مهنأ ،سطفلأا نسحلا نب نسحلا مهنم مشاه ينب نم ةعامج نع قوقشم ءاج دق ليع نب نسحلا ىلإ رظن ذإ - لقا نأ ىلإ - هنوزعي (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ ببا دمحم .هنيمي نع مقا ىتح بيجلا
englishText: From a group of Bani Hashim, including Al-Hasan bin Al-Hasan Al-Aftas, who were present on the day Muhammad bin Ali bin Muhammad died at Abu Al-Hasan's (peace be upon him) door consoling him- until he said- when he saw Al-Hasan bin Ali coming with torn collar until he stood at his right.

chapter: The Dislike Of Wailing Over The Dead And Tearing Clothes Except For Father, Brother And Relatives, And Its Expiation
arabicText: نب نسحلا يؤر (ملاسلا هيلع) يركسعلا دمحم نب ليع ضبق امل :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .مادقو فلخ نع هصيمق قش دقو رادلا نم جرخ دقو (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: When Ali bin Muhammad Al-Askari (peace be upon him) passed away, Al-Hasan bin Ali (peace be upon him) was seen leaving the house with his shirt torn from front and back.

chapter: The Dislike Of Wailing Over The Dead And Tearing Clothes Except For Father, Brother And Relatives, And Its Expiation
arabicText: هصيمقو (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ ةزانج يف (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم وبأ جرخ :لقا يرفعجلا مشاه يبأ نع وبأ هيلإ بتكف !؟اذه لثم يف هصيمق قش ةمئلأا نم كغلب وأ تيأر نم :نوع نبا هيلإ بتكف ،قوقشم .نوراه لىع ىسوم قش دق !؟اذه ام كيردي امو ،قمحأ يا :(ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم
englishText: From Abu Hashim Al-Ja'fari who said: Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him) came out in Abu Al-Hasan's (peace be upon him) funeral with his shirt torn, so Ibn Awn wrote to him: Who have you seen or heard among the Imams tearing his shirt in such situations?! Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him) wrote back: O fool, what do you know about this?! Moses tore his clothes for Aaron.

chapter: The Dislike Of Wailing Over The Dead And Tearing Clothes Except For Father, Brother And Relatives, And Its Expiation
arabicText: :لقا هنأ لاإ - ثيدحلا ركذو - (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم وبأ جرخ :لقا هريغو نومش نب نسحلا نب دمحم نع .شربلأا نوع وبأ هيلإ بتكف
englishText: From Muhammad bin Al-Hasan bin Shamun and others who said: Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him) came out- and mentioned the hadith- except he said: Abu Awn Al-Abrash wrote to him.

chapter: The Dislike Of Wailing Over The Dead And Tearing Clothes Except For Father, Brother And Relatives, And Its Expiation
arabicText: - ةملس نب حاجن ةبارق - شربلأا نوع وبأ بتك :لقا بيضخلا نب ميهاربإ نع ،دمحم نب قاحسإ نع ،هنعو يا :لاقف !(ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ لىع كقش نم اونهوتسا دق سانلا نا :(ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم يبأ ىلإ .نوراه لىع ىسوم قش دق !؟كاذو كلام ،قمحأ
englishText: And from him, from Ishaq bin Muhammad, from Ibrahim bin Al-Khadib who said: Abu Awn Al-Abrash- a relative of Najah bin Salamah- wrote to Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him): People have found your tearing of clothes for Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) strange! He said: O fool, what is it to you?! Moses tore his clothes for Aaron.

chapter: The Dislike Of Wailing Over The Dead And Tearing Clothes Except For Father, Brother And Relatives, And Its Expiation
arabicText: باأ انيأرف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ يديس جورخ دعب ىأر نم رسب تنك :لقا ثراحلا نب لضفلا نع ،هنعو .هبوث قش دقو ايشام (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم
englishText: From him, from Al-Fadhl ibn Al-Harith who said: I was in Surra man Ra'a after the departure of my master Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), and we saw Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him) walking while his garment was torn.

chapter: The Dislike Of Wailing Over The Dead And Tearing Clothes Except For Father, Brother And Relatives, And Its Expiation
arabicText: نم امدقا ةفوكلا درو امل هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نع (ةغلابلا جهن) يف يضرلا نيسحلا نب دمحم مكبلغتأ :يماشلا ليبحرشل لاقف - لقا نأ ىلإ - نيفص لىتق لىع سانلا ءاكب عمسف نييماشلبا رم نيفص .نينرلا اذه نع نهنوهنت لاأ !؟عمسأ ام لىع مكؤاسن
englishText: Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn Al-Radi in (Nahj Al-Balagha) from Amir Al-Mu'mineen (peace be upon him) that when he arrived in Kufa returning from Siffin, he passed by the people of Sham and heard people weeping over those killed at Siffin- until he said- then he said to Shurahbeel Al-Shami: Are your women overwhelming you with what I hear?! Will you not forbid them from this wailing? Shaykh Hurr Amili: And it has been mentioned previously what indicates that in the hadiths of patience, grief, contentment and other than that, and what indicates it will come, God Almighty willing, in the expiations.

chapter: Permissibility Of Showing Distress Before A Calamity And Having Patience, Acceptance, And Submission After It
arabicText: ،نيزح متهم وه اذفإ ،بابلا لىع هتدجوف ،هل انبا دوعأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تيتأ :لقا ىشعلأا ةبيتق نع رفسأ دقو انيلإ جرخ مث ةعاس ثكمف لخد مث ،هب امل هنإ اللهو :لاقف ؟يبصلا فيك ،كادف تلعج :هل تلقف ؟كادف تلعج ،يبصلا فيك :تلقف ،يبصلا حلص دق نوكي نأ تعمطف :لقا ،نزحلاو ريغتلا بهذو ههجو دقو ةعاسلا كلاح تيأر دقو ،انيزح امتهم حي وهو تنك دقل ،كادف تلعج :تلقف ،هليبسل ىضم دق :لاقف هئاضقب انيضر الله رمأ عقو اذفإ ،ةبيصملا لبق عزجن امنإ تيب لهأ ناإ :لاقف ؟اذه فيكف ،لاحلا كلت ريغ تام .هرملا انملسو
englishText: Qutaibah Al-A'sha narrated: I came to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) to visit his sick son, and found him at the door looking worried and sad. I said to him: May I be sacrificed for you, how is the boy? He said: By Allah, he is in a bad/critical state. Then he went inside for a while and came out to us with a brightened face, the change and sadness gone. I hoped the boy had improved, so I asked: How is the boy, may I be sacrificed for you? He said: He has passed away. I said: May I be sacrificed for you, you were worried and sad when he was alive, and now I see you in a different state after his death, how is this? He said: We, Ahl al-Bayt, show distress before the calamity, but when Allah's command occurs, we accept His decree and submit to His command.

chapter: Permissibility Of Showing Distress Before A Calamity And Having Patience, Acceptance, And Submission After It
arabicText: وبأ ماقف ،رادلا نم ةخراصلا تخرصف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ دنع اسلاج تنك :لقا لماك نب ءلاعلا نع يف ىفاعن نأ بحنل ناإ :لقا مث ،هنم غرف ىتح هثيدح يف داعو ،عجرتسفا سلج مث (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع .انل الله بحي مل ام بحن نأ انل سيلف ءاضقلا عقو اذفإ ،انلاومأو نادلاوأو انسفنأ
englishText: From al-'Ala ibn Kamil who said: I was sitting with Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) when a scream was heard from the house. Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) stood up then sat down saying the verse of return ("Indeed we belong to Allah and to Him weshall return"), and resumed his conversation until he finished it. Then he said: Indeed we love to be granted well-being in ourselves, our children and our wealth. But when divine decree occurs, it is not for us to love what Allah has not loved for us.

chapter: Permissibility Of Showing Distress Before A Calamity And Having Patience, Acceptance, And Submission After It
arabicText: ،اضيرم هل ايبص اوقفاوف (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ اوتأ موق ناك :لقا انباحصأ ضعب نع ،بوقعي نب سنوي نع ،هركن ام هنم ىرن نأ فوختنل ناإ ئش هباصأ نئل اللهو :اولاقف :لقا ،رقي لا لعجو ،امغو امامتها هنم اوأرف اولاقف ،اهيلع ناك يتلا لاحلا ريغ يف هجولا طسبنم مهيلع جرخ دق وه اذفإ ،هيلع حايصلا اوعمس نأ اوثبل امف نأ بحنل ناإ :مهل لاقف ،انمغي ام كنم ىرن نأ عقو ول نإ كنم ىرن امم فاخن انك دقل ،كادف الله انلعج :هل .بحأ اميف انملس الله رمأ ءاج اذفإ ،بحن نميف ىفاعن
englishText: From Yunus ibn Ya'qub, from some of our companions who said: A group of people came to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) and found his young child sick. They saw him worried and grieved, and he was restless. They said: "By Allah, if something happens to him (the child), we fear we might see from him (Abu Ja'far) what we dislike." Shortly after, they heard crying over the child, but then Abu Ja'far came out to them with a cheerful face, different from his previous state. They said to him: "May Allah make us your ransom! We were afraid from what we saw of your state that if something happened, we would see from you what would sadden us." He replied to them: "We love to be granted well-being regarding those we love, but when Allah's decree comes, we submit to what He loves."

chapter: Permissibility Of Showing Distress Before A Calamity And Having Patience, Acceptance, And Submission After It
arabicText: رمأ لزن اذفإ ،ةبيصملا لبق عزجن تيب لهأ ناإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .انل الله بحأ ام هركن نأ انل سيلو ،هرملا انملسو هئاضقب انيضر الله
englishText: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: We, Ahl al-Bayt, show distress before the calamity, but when Allah's command descends, we accept His decree and submit to His command, and we should not dislike what Allah has liked for us.

chapter: Permissibility Of Showing Distress Before A Calamity And Having Patience, Acceptance, And Submission After It
arabicText: هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نب ليعامسإ ترضح امل :لقا يفوكلا الله دبع نب دمحم نع :(نيدلا لامكإ) باتك يفو - ديدج وأ - ليسغ صيمقب اعد هضمغ املف ،اديدش اعزج (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ عزج ةفاولا (ملاسلا ناإ :لاقف !؟كعزج هل انيأر امل اننامز كب عفتنت لا نأ اننظ دقل (هل ليقف) ،ىهنيو رميأ جرخو حرست مث ،هسبلف .ناربص تلزن اذإو ،ةبيصملا لزنت مل ام عزجن تيب لهأ
englishText: In the book "Ikmal Al-Din": Muhammad ibn Abdullah Al-Kufi narrated: When death approached Isma'il ibn Abu Abdullah, Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) showed intense distress. When he closed his eyes, he asked for a washed- or new- shirt, wore it, groomed himself, and went out giving orders and prohibitions. He was told: We thought we would not benefit from you for a while when we saw your distress for him! He said: We, Ahl al-Bayt, show distress until the calamity descends, and when it In the book "Ikmal Al-Din": Muhammad ibn Abdullah Al-Kufi narrated: When death approached Isma'il ibn Abu Abdullah, Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) showed intense distress. When he closed his eyes, he asked for a washed- or new- shirt, wore it, groomed himself, and went out giving orders and prohibitions. He was told: We thought we would not benefit from you for a while when we saw your distress for him! He said: We, Ahl al-Bayt, show distress until the calamity descends, and when it descends, we are patient.

chapter: Permissibility Of Showing Distress Before A Calamity And Having Patience, Acceptance, And Submission After It
arabicText: عزجن نإ :انل لقا ىضق املف - :لقا نأ ىلإ - سلاج (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأو ،رفعجل نبا لقث :لقا ةرارز نع لكفأ ماعطب اعدو ،لحتكاو ،نهدفأ نهدب اعد مث ،ميلستلا لاإ انل سيلف الله رمأ لزن اذفإ ،الله رمأ لزني مل ام ،زخ ةمامعو ،زخ فرطمو ،زخ ةبج سبلو ،لسغف هب رمأ مث ،ليمجلا ربصلا وه اذه :لقا مث ،هعم نمو وه .هيلع لىصف جرخو
englishText: Zurarah narrated: A son of Ja'far became severely ill, while Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) was sitting- until he said: When he passed away, he told us: We show distress until Allah's command descends, but when it descends, we have nothing but submission. Then he asked for oil and applied it, applied kohl, asked for food and ate with those present, then said: This is the beautiful patience. Then he ordered for him to be washed, and wore a silk robe, silk cloak, and silk turban, and went out to pray over him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Consolation And Forgetting Calamities
