arabicText: دعب حيرلا مهيلع ىقلأ :ثلاثب هدابع لىع لوطت ىلاعتو كرابت الله نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع هذه لىع ىقلأو ،لسنلا عطقن لا كلذ لاولو ،ةولسلا مهيلع ىقلأو ،اميمح ميمح نفد ام كلذ لاولو ،حورلا .ةضفلاو بهذلا نوزنكي امك مهكولم اهزنكل كلذ لاولو ،ةبادلا ةبحلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, has bestowed three favors upon His servants: He cast wind after the soul (*), and if not for that, no intimate would bury their intimate; and He cast solace, and if not for that, offspring would cease; and He cast this creature upon the grain, and if not for that, their kings would hoard it as they hoard gold and silver. Translator: * A metaphor with the wind symbolizing an easing of grief and causing a sense of relief and comfort after the soul departs.

chapter: Recommendation Of Consolation And Forgetting Calamities
arabicText: هبلق لىع حسمف هلهأ عجوأ ىلإ اكلم الله ثعب تام اذإ تيملا نإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس .ايندلا رمعت مل كلذ لاولو ،نزحلا ةعول هاسنفأ
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: When someone dies, Allah sends an angel to the most grieved among their family and wipes their heart, making them forget the anguish of grief, and if not for that, the world would not prosper.

chapter: Recommendation Of Consolation And Forgetting Calamities
arabicText: نع مهتزانج نم تيملا لهأ فرصنا اذفإ ،رباقملبا لاكوم اكلم نإ :لقا هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .شيعب دحأ عفتنا ام كلذ لاولف ،متيأر ام اوسنأ :لاقف ،مهرثاآ يف اهب ىمرف بارت نم ةضبق ذخأ مهتيم
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), that he said: There is an angel appointed over the graves, and when the family of the deceased returns from their funeral, he takes a handful of dust and throws it in their tracks, saying: "Forget what you have seen," and if not for that, no one would benefit from life.

chapter: Recommendation Of Consolation And Forgetting Calamities
arabicText: حيرلا مهيلع تيقلأ :ثلاثب يدابع لىع تلوطت ينإ :لوقي لجو زع الله نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع دحأ نهتي مل كلذ لاولو ،ةبيصملا دعب ةولسلا مهيلع تيقلأو ،اميمح ميمح نفد ام كلذ لاولو ،حورلا دعب بهذلا نوزنكي امك مهكولم اهتزنكل كلذ لاولو ،ريعشلاو ةطنحلا لىع اهتطلسو ةبادلا هذه تقلخو ،هشيعب .ةضفلاو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed Allah, the Mighty and Glorious, says: I have bestowed three favors upon My servants: I cast wind after the soul (*), and if not for that, no intimate would bury their intimate; and I cast solace after calamity, and if not for that, no one would enjoy their life; and I created this creature and gave it power over wheat and barley, and if not for that, their kings would hoard it as they hoard gold and silver. Translator: * A metaphor with the wind symbolizing an easing of grief and causing a sense of relief and comfort after the soul departs.

chapter: Permissibility And Recommendation Of Crying Over The Dead And During Calamity, Especially When Grief Intensifies
arabicText: لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر تنب ةيقر تتام امل :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ريصب يبأ نع اهيلع) ةمطفاو :لقا ،هباحصأو نوعظم نب نامثع حلاصلا انفلسب يقحلا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر .ربقلا يف اهعومد ردحتت ربقلا ريفش لىع (ملاسلا
englishText: From Abu Basir, from one of them (peace be upon them) who said: When Ruqayya, daughter of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) died, the Messenger of Allah said: "Join our righteous predecessor Uthman bin Madh'un and his companions." And Fatima (peace be upon her) was at the edge of the grave with her tears falling into it.

chapter: Permissibility And Recommendation Of Crying Over The Dead And During Calamity, Especially When Grief Intensifies
arabicText: يل نبا لىع هتدجو ادجو (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ ىلإ توكش :لقا هيبأ نع ،لقيصلا روصنم نب دمحم نع .كنع نكسي هنفإ ،كعومد نم ضففأ ئش اذه نم كباصأ اذإ :لاقف ؟ليقع لىع تفخ ىتح كله
englishText: From Muhammad bin Mansur al-Sayqal, from his father who said: I complained to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the intense grief I felt over my deceased son until I feared for my sanity. He said: When you experience something like this, let your tears flow, for it will calm you.

chapter: Permissibility And Recommendation Of Crying Over The Dead And During Calamity, Especially When Grief Intensifies
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نبا ميهاربإ تام امل :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع عمدت :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا مث ،عومدلبا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نيع تلمه (هلآو .نونوزحمل ميهاربإ يا كب ناإو ،برلا طخسي ام لوقن لاو ،بلقلا نزحيو ،نيعلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: When Ibrahim, son of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) died, the eyes of the Messenger of Allah flowed with tears, then he said: "The eye weeps, the heart grieves, but we say nothing that displeases the Lord, and we are, O Ibrahim, grieved for you."

chapter: Permissibility And Recommendation Of Crying Over The Dead And During Calamity, Especially When Grief Intensifies
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نبا ميهاربإ تام امل :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم ،نيعلا عمدتو بلقلا نزحي ،نورباصل ناإو ،ميهاربإ يا كيلع نازح :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا (هلآو .برلا طخسي ام :لوقن لاو
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: When Ibrahim, son of the Messenger of Allah died, the Messenger of Allah said: "We grieve for you, O Ibrahim, and we are patient. The heart grieves and the eye weeps, but we say nothing that displeases the Lord."

chapter: Permissibility And Recommendation Of Crying Over The Dead And During Calamity, Especially When Grief Intensifies
arabicText: .هنع نكسي هنفإ هعومد نم ضفيلف ةبيصمب دجو نم هسفن لىع فاخ نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقاو :لقا
englishText: He said: And he (peace be upon him) said: Whoever fears for himself from intense grief due to a calamity should let his tears flow, for it will calm him.

chapter: Permissibility And Recommendation Of Crying Over The Dead And During Calamity, Especially When Grief Intensifies
arabicText: نب ديزو بلاط يبأ نب رفعج ةفاو هتءاج نيح (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقاو :لقا .اعيمج ابهذف يناسنؤيو ينثادحي نااك :لوقيو ،ادج امهيلع هؤاكب رثك هتيب لخد اذإ ناك ةثراح
englishText: He said: And he (peace be upon him) said: When news of the death of Ja'far bin Abi Talib and Zayd bin Haritha reached the Messenger of Allah, whenever he entered his house, he would cry intensely for them, saying: "They used to converse with me and keep me company, and now both are gone."

chapter: Permissibility And Recommendation Of Crying Over The Dead And During Calamity, Especially When Grief Intensifies
arabicText: ،بوقعيو ،مدآ :ةسمخ نوؤاكبلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ ىلإ هعفري ،ينارحبلا لهس نب دمحم نع ،(ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا نب ليعو ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) دمحم تنب ةمطفاو ،فسويو ،هرصب بهذ ىتح فسوي لىع كىبف بوقعي امأو ،ةيدولأا لاثمأ هيدخ يف راص ىتح ةنجلا لىع كىبف مدآ امفأ بوقعي لىع كىبف فسوي امأو ،(نيكلاهلا نم نوكت وأ اضرح نوكت ىتح فسوي ركذت ؤتفت للهتا) :هل ليق ىتحو ،ليللبا تكستو راهنلا كيبت نأ امإو ،راهنلبا تكستو ليللا كيبت نأ امإ :اولاقف نجسلا لهأ هب ىذتأ ىتح .امهنم دحاو لىع مهحلاصف :اهل اولاقف ،ةنيدملا لهأ اهب ىذتأ ىتح (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لىع تكبف (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا امأو ،فرصنت مث اهتجاح يضقت ىتح كيبتف ءادهشلا رباقم رباقملا ىلإ جرخت تناكو ،كئاكب ةرثكب انتيذآ دق عضو ام ،ةنس نيعبرأ وأ ةنس نيرشع (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا لىع كىبف (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا نب ليع امأو امنإ " :لقا ،نيكلاهلا نم نوكت نأ كيلع فاخأ ينإ ،كادف تلعج :هل ىلوم هل لقا ىتح كىب لاإ ماعط هيدي نيب .ةربع كلذل ينتقنخ لاإ ةمطفا ينب عرصم ركذأ مل ينإ " نوملعت لا ام الله نم ملعأو ،الله ىلإ ينزحو يثب وكشأ
englishText: From Muhammad bin Sahl Al-Bahrani, raising it to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The great weepers were five: Adam, Jacob, Joseph, Fatima daughter of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon him). As for Adam, he wept over Paradise until his cheeks became like valleys. As for Jacob, he wept over Joseph until he lost his sight and until it was said to him: "By Allah, you will not cease remembering Joseph until you become fatally ill or become among the As for Adam, he wept over Paradise until his cheeks became like valleys. As for Jacob, he wept over Joseph until he lost his sight and until it was said to him: "By Allah, you will not cease remembering Joseph until you become fatally ill or become among the perished" [12:85]. As for Joseph, he wept over Jacob until the prison inmates were bothered and said: Either weep at night and be quiet during the day, or weep during the day and be quiet at night, so he compromised with them on one of these. As for Fatima (peace be upon her), she wept over the Messenger of Allah until the people of Medina were bothered and said to her: You have disturbed us with your excessive crying. She would go to the martyrs' graves and weep until she fulfilled her need, then leave. As for Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon him), he wept over Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) for twenty or forty years. No food was presented to him except that he would weep, until his servant said to him: May I be sacrificed for you, I fear you will be among the perished. He said: "I only complain of my suffering and grief to Allah, and I know from Allah what you do not know" [12:86]. Whenever I remember the death of the sons of Fatima, I am choked with tears.

chapter: Permissibility And Recommendation Of Crying Over The Dead And During Calamity, Especially When Grief Intensifies
arabicText: لىع هعومد ترج ىتح (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا كىب ميهاربإ تام امل :تلقا ةشئاع نع ،ةكيلم يبأ نبا نع لا نمو ،ةمحر هذه امنإو ،ءاكب اذه سيل :لاقف !؟كيبت تنأو ءاكبلا نع ىهنت ،لله لوسر يا :ليقف ،هتيحل .محري لا محري
englishText: From Ibn Abi Mulaykah, from Aisha who said: When Ibrahim died, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) wept until his tears flowed on his beard. It was said: O Messenger of Allah, you forbid weeping yet you weep? He said: This is not weeping, rather this is mercy, and whoever does not show mercy will not receive mercy.

chapter: Permissibility And Recommendation Of Crying Over The Dead And During Calamity, Especially When Grief Intensifies
arabicText: لىع ءاكبلاو عزجلا ىوس هوركم ءاكبلاو عزجلا لك :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اعم ءاكبلاو نزحلا عامتجا لىع وأ ،نزحلا ةدياز مدع لىع لومحم اذه :لوقأ .(ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: All anxiety and weeping is disliked except anxiety and weeping for Husayn (peace be upon him). I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted as not increasing sadness, or as the combination of sadness and weeping together.

chapter: Permissibility And Recommendation Of Crying Over The Dead And During Calamity, Especially When Grief Intensifies
arabicText: نيدباعلا نيز نأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع (فوفطلا لىتق لىع فوهلملا) باتك يف سواط نب ىسوم نب ليع نيب هعضيف هبارشو هماعطب هملاغ ءاج راطفلاا رضح اذفإ ،هليل امئقا ،هراهن امئاص ،ةنس نيعبرأ هيبأ لىع كىب ،يلاوم يا لك :لوقيف هيدي كلذ رركي لازي لاف ،نااشطع الله لوسر نبا لتق ،اعئاج (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نبا لتق :لوقيف .لجو زع للهبا قحل ىتح كلذك لزي ملف ،هعومدب هبارش جزميو ،هعومدب هماعط لبي ىتح كيبيو
englishText: Ali ibn Musa ibn Tawus in his book (Al-Luhuf ala Qatla Al-Tufuf) from Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), that Zayn Al-Abidin wept for his father for forty years, fasting during the day and standing (in prayer) during the night. When it was time to break the fast, his servant would bring his food and drink and place it before him saying: Eat, O my master. He would say: The son of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was killed hungry, the son of the Messenger of Allah was killed thirsty. He would continue repeating this and weeping until his food would be soaked with his tears, and his drink mixed with his tears. He remained this way until he met Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.

chapter: Permissibility And Recommendation Of Crying Over The Dead And During Calamity, Especially When Grief Intensifies
arabicText: ناأو تفقوف ،ةنشخ ةراجح لىع دجس دق هتدجوف ،هتعبتف ءارحصلا ىلإ اموي جرخ :لقا هيلاوم ضعب نعو هلإ لا ،قارو ادبعت الله لاإ هلإ لا ،اقح اقح الله لاإ هلإ لا :لوقي وهو ةرم فلأ هل تيصحأو ،هءاكبو هقيهش عمسأ ،قادصو نااميإ الله لاإ كنزحل نآ ام ،يديس يا :تلقف ،هينيع عومد نم ءاملبا ارمغ دق ههجوو هتيحل نأو ،هدوجس نم هسأر عفر مث !؟لقي نأ كئاكبلو !؟يضقني نأ ادحاو الله بيغف ،انبا رشع ىنثا هل ناكو ،يبن نبا ايبن ناك ميهاربإ نب قاحسإ نب بوقعي نإ ،كحيو :يل لاقف راد يف حي هنباو ،ءاكبلا نم هرصب بهذو ،مهلاو مغلا نم هرهظ بدودحاو ،نزحلا نم هسأر باشف ،مهنم .!؟يئاكب بهذيو ينزح يضقني فيكف ،نيلوتقم ىعرص يتيب لهأ نم رشع ةعبسو خيأو يبأ تيأر ناإو ،ايندلا
englishText: From one of his followers who said: One day he went out to the desert and I followed him. I found him prostrating on rough stones, so I stood listening to his sobbing and weeping. I counted him saying a thousand times: There is no god but Allah truly truly, there is no god but Allah in worship and slavery, there is no god but Allah in faith and truthfulness. Then he raised his head from prostration, and his beard and face were drenched with water from his eyes' tears. I said: O my master, isn't it time for your grief to end and your weeping to decrease? He said to me: Woe to you! Indeed Ya'qub ibn Ishaq ibn Ibrahim was a prophet son of He said to me: Woe to you! Indeed Ya'qub ibn Ishaq ibn Ibrahim was a prophet son of a prophet, and he had twelve sons. Allah concealed one of them, and his head turned white from grief, his back became hunched from sorrow and worry, and he lost his sight from weeping, while his son was alive in this world. And I saw my father, my brother, and seventeen of my family members slain and killed, so how can my grief end and my weeping go away?!

chapter: Recommendation Of Crying Upon The Death Of A Believer
arabicText: ةكئلاملا هيلع تكب نمؤملا تام اذإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا باأ تعمس :لقا بائر نب ليع نع لا ملاسلاا يف ةملث ملثو ،اهيف هلامعأ دعصي ناك يتلا ءامسلا باوبأو ،اهيلع الله دبعي ناك يتلا ضرلأا عاقبو .اهل ةنيدملا روس نوصحك ملاسلاا نوصح نينمؤملا نلا ،ئش اهدسي
englishText: From Ali bin Ri'ab who said: I heard Abu Al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him) saying: When a believer dies, the angels weep for him, and the spots of earth where he used to worship Allah, and the gates of heaven through which his deeds used to ascend, and a gap appears in Islam that nothing can fill, because the believers are the fortresses of Islam like the fortresses in the city wall.

chapter: Recommendation Of Crying Upon The Death Of A Believer
arabicText: نينمؤملا نإ :لقا هنأ لاإ ،هلثم ركذو ،لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تعمس :لقا ةزمح يبأ نب ليع نع .ءاهقفلا
englishText: From Ali bin Abi Hamza who said: I heard Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) saying, and he mentioned similar to it, except that he said: Indeed the believers are the fuqaha'a (*). Translator: * Plural of "faqih" - a person with good knowledge and understanding of hadith.

chapter: Recommendation Of Crying Upon The Death Of A Believer
arabicText: عمس ةنيدملا ىلإ دحأ ةعقو نم (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر فرصنا امل :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم نكل :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) لاقف ،همع ةزمح راد نم عمسي ملو ،اءاكبو احون ليتق اهلهأ نم لتق راد لك نم هيلع اوحونيف ةزمحب اوؤدبي ىتح هوكبي لاو تيم لىع اوحوني لا نأ ةنيدملا لهأ ىلفآ ،هل كياوب لا ةزمح .كلذ لىع مويلا ىلإ مهف ،هوكبيو
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) returned from the battle of Uhud to Medina, he heard wailing and crying from every house that had lost someone, but he did not hear any from the house of his uncle Hamza. So he (peace be upon him and his family) said: "But Hamza has no one to cry for him." Then the people of Medina vowed not to mourn or cry over any deceased until they first mourn and cry for Hamza, and they continue this practice to this day.

chapter: Permissibility Of Weeping Over A Lost Companion
arabicText: دنع تققرف :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ دنع هلتقمو باطخلا باأ تركذ :لقا يناجرلا ركب نب الله دبع نع باحصأ لتق (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع نأ ركذت كتعمس نكلو ،لا :تلقف ؟مهيلع ىستأأ :لاقف ،تيكبف كلذ :اولاقف !؟مهيلع نوستأأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) ليع لاقف ،مهيلع نوكبي (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع باحصأ حبصفأ ناورهنلا .سبأ لا :لقا ،مهيلع انققر كلذلف ،مهتعقوأ يتلا ةيلبلاو اهيلع انك يتلا ةفللأا ناركذ ناأ ،لا
englishText: From Abdullah ibn Bakr al-Rajani who said: I mentioned Abu al-Khattab and his killing in the presence of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him). He said: I became emotional at that and wept. So he said: "Do you grieve for them?" I said: "No, but I heard you mention that Ali (peace be upon him) killed the people of Nahrawan, and Ali's companions began weeping over them. So Ali (peace be upon him) said: 'Do you grieve for them?!' They said: 'No, we remembered the companionship we had with them and the affliction that befell them, and that is why we became emotional over them.'" He said: "There is no harm in that."

chapter: Recommendation Of Forty Or Fifty Believers Testifying To The Goodness Of A Believer
arabicText: :اولاقف نينمؤملا نم لاجر نوعبرأ هتزانج رضحف نمؤملا تام اذإ :لقا هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ام هل ترفغو مكتاداهش تزجأ دق :ىلاعتو كرابت الله لقا ،انم هب ملعأ تنأو اريخ لاإ هنم ملعن لا ناإ مهللا .نوملعت لا امم تملع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When a believer dies and forty believing men attend his funeral and say: "O Allah, we know nothing of him except good, and You know him better than we do," Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, says: "I have accepted your testimonies and forgiven him for what I know that you do not know."

chapter: Recommendation Of Forty Or Fifty Believers Testifying To The Goodness Of A Believer
arabicText: ينب يف ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع لقا لاإ هملعأ لا :لقا - ثيدح يف - فاكسلإا دعس نع .يئارم هنفإ ،هرمأ نم ئش كبجعي لا :هيلإ الله حىوفأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) دواد هب بجعفأ دباع ليئارسإ اودهشف لاجر نوسمخ مقا لسغ املف ،هرضحي ملو مكبحاص اونفدا :(ملاسلا هيلع) دواد لاقف ،لجرلا تامف نورخآ نوسمخ مقا هونفد املف ،كلذب اودهشف نورخآ نوسمخ مقا هيلع اولص املف ،اريخ لاإ نوملعي ام للهبا ،اضيأ كلذب اودهشف نأ :هيلإ الله حىوفأ ،هرمأ نم هيلع ينتعلطأ يذلل ،بر يا :لاقف ؟نالاف دهشت نأ كعنم ام دواد ىلإ الله حىوفأ ترفغو ،هيلع مهتداهش تزجفأ اريخ لاإ نوملعي ام نابهرلاو رابحلأا نم موق دهش دق هنكلو ،كلذك كلذ ناك .هيف يملع هل
englishText: From Sa'd al-Iskaf- in a hadith- he said: I believe he narrated from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: There was a worshipper among the Children of Israel whom David (peace be upon him) admired. Then Allah revealed to him: "Do not admire anything about him, for he is a show-off." When the man died, David (peace be upon him) said: "Bury your companion," and he did not attend. When the man was washed, fifty men stood and testified by Allah that they knew nothing but good about him. When they prayed over him, another fifty stood and testified likewise. When they buried him, another fifty stood and testified the same. Then Allah revealed to David: "What prevented you from attending for so-and-so?" Then Allah revealed to David: "What prevented you from attending for so-and-so?" He said: "O Lord, because of what You showed me about his matter." So Allah revealed to him: "Even if that was true, but some scholars and monks testified that they knew nothing but good about him, so I accepted their testimony for him and forgave him for what I knew about him."

chapter: Recommendation Of Stroking An Orphan's Head Out Of Mercy For Him, Being Gentle With Him, And Consoling Him When He Cries
arabicText: هاطعأ لاإ هل امحرت ميتي سأر لىع هدي حسمي دبع نم ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .ةمايقلا موي ارون ةرعش لكل لجو زع الله
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: He (peace be upon him) said: There is no servant who strokes his hand over an orphan's head out of mercy for him except that Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will give him light for every hair on the Day of Resurrection.

chapter: Recommendation Of Stroking An Orphan's Head Out Of Mercy For Him, Being Gentle With Him, And Consoling Him When He Cries
arabicText: .ةنسح هدي اهيلع ترم ةرعش لك ددعب هل لجو زع الله بتكي هنأ يورو :لقا
englishText: He said: And it is narrated that Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will write for him a good deed for each hair that his hand passed over.

chapter: Recommendation Of Stroking An Orphan's Head Out Of Mercy For Him, Being Gentle With Him, And Consoling Him When He Cries
arabicText: حسميلو ،هفطلايف اميتي نديلف هبلق ةواسق مكنم ركنأ نم :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقاو :لقا .اقح ميتيلل نفإ ،لجو زع الله نذإب هبلق نيلي ،هسأر
englishText: He said: And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever among you feels hardness in his heart should bring an orphan near, be gentle with him, and stroke his head, his heart will soften by Allah's permission, the Mighty and Majestic, for the orphan has a right.

chapter: Recommendation Of Stroking An Orphan's Head Out Of Mercy For Him, Being Gentle With Him, And Consoling Him When He Cries
arabicText: .هبلق نيلي هسأر حسميو هناوخ لىع هدعقي :لقا هنأ يورو :لقا
englishText: He said: And it is narrated that he said: He should seat him at his table and stroke his head, his heart will soften.

chapter: Recommendation Of Stroking An Orphan's Head Out Of Mercy For Him, Being Gentle With Him, And Consoling Him When He Cries
arabicText: كىبأ يذلا اذه نم :ىلاعتو كرابت الله لوقيف ،شرعلا هل زتها ميتيلا كىب اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقاو :لقا هل تبجو لاإ نمؤم دبع هتكسي لا ،يناكم يف يعافتراو ،يللاجو يتزعوف !؟هرغص يف هيوبأ هتبلس يذلا يدبع .ةنجلا
englishText: He said: And Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: When an orphan cries, the Throne shakes, and Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, says: Who is this who made My servant cry, whom I deprived of his parents in his childhood?! By My Might, My Majesty, and My Elevation in My place, no believing servant consoles him except that Paradise becomes obligatory for him. Section 4 Ghusl Al Mass

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: اذإ :لقا ؟لسغ هيلعأ ،تيملا ضمغي لجرلا :تلق :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ملسم نب دمحم نع ،لستغيلف دربي ام دعب هسم اذإ نكلو ،لاف هترارحب هسم هلسغي :لقا ؟لستغي نأ لبق (هنافكأ هسبلي مث) هلسغيف :تلق ،معن :لقا ؟لستغي هلسغي يذلفا :تلق ،لستغي مث ،هنافكأ هسبلي مث ،قتاعلا نم هيدي لسغي مث نم أضوتي نأ لاإ ،لا :لقا ؟ءوضولا هيلع ،ربقلا هلخدأ نمف :تلق ،لا :لقا ؟لسغ هيلع ،هلمح نمف :تلق .ءاش نإ ،ربقلا بارت
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim, from one of them (peace be upon them) who said: I asked: Does a person who closes the eyes of a deceased need to perform ghusl? He said: If he touches while it's warm, then no, but if he touches after it becomes cold, then he should perform ghusl. I asked: Should the one who washes it perform ghusl? He said: Yes. I asked: Can he wash it (then shroud it) before performing ghusl? He said: He should wash it, then wash his hands from the shoulders, then shroud it, then perform ghusl. I asked: Does one who carries it need to perform ghusl? He said: No. I asked: Does one who places it in the grave need to perform wudu? He said: No, unless he wishes to perform wudu due to the grave's soil.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: لعجف ،ربكلأا ليعامسإ هنبا تام نيح (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ لىع تلخد :لقا رباج نب ليعامسإ نع هيلعف هسم نمو ،تومي ام دعب تيملا سمي نأ يغبني لا سيلأ ،كادف تلعج :تلقف ،تيم وهو هلبقي .درب اذإ كاذ امنإ ،سبأ لاف هترارحب امأ :لاقف !؟لسغلا
englishText: From Isma'il bin Jabir who said: I entered upon Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) when his elder son Isma'il died, and he was kissing him while dead. I said: May I be From Isma'il bin Jabir who said: I entered upon Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) when his elder son Isma'il died, and he was kissing him while dead. I said: May I be sacrificed for you, isn't it inappropriate to touch the deceased after death, and whoever touches must perform ghusl? He said: While it's warm there's no harm, that's only when it becomes cold.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: هدسج تسسم اذإ :لاقف :لقا ؟لسغ هيفأ ،ناسنلاا هسم اذإ تيملا نع هتلأس :لقا ديمح نب مصاع نع .لستغفا دربي نيح
englishText: From Asim bin Humayd who said: I asked him about touching a deceased person, is ghusl required? He said: When you touch the body after it becomes cold, then perform ghusl.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: ،معن :لقا ؟لسغ هيلع ،تيملا لسغي يذلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا رامع نب ةيواعم نع ،اهسم اذإ ريطلاو مئاهبلاو :تلق ،لسغلا هيلعف درب اذفإ ،هيلع لسغ لا :لقا ؟نخس وهو هسم اذفإ :تلق .ناسنلااك اذه سيل ،لا :لقا ؟لسغ هيلع
englishText: From Muawiya bin Ammar who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Must the one who washes the deceased perform ghusl? He said: Yes. I asked: What if he touches it while warm? He said: No ghusl is required, but if it's cold then ghusl is required. I asked: What about touching animals and birds, is ghusl required? He said: No, these aren't like humans.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: نأ لبق هدلج ليي يذلا تيملا بوث هندب وأ هدي باصأ لجر :هيلإ تبتك :لقا رافصلا نسحلا نب دمحم نع نأ لبق تيملا دسج كدي باصأ اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) عقوف ؟هندب وأ هيدي لسغ هيلع بجي له ،لسغي .لسغلا كيلع بجي دقف لسغي
englishText: From Muhammad bin al-Hasan al-Saffar who said: I wrote to him: If a person's hand or body touches the deceased's clothing that's against their skin before washing, must they wash their hands or body? He (peace be upon him) wrote: If your hand touches the deceased's body before it's washed, then ghusl becomes obligatory upon you.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: .ةبانجلا لسغ لستغا هنفكو اتيم لسغ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever washes a deceased and shrouds them should perform ghusl like that of janabah.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: نيح (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لستغا له :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا ىلإ تبتك :لقا ديبع نب نسحلا نع نكلو ،رهطم رهاط (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا :هباجفأ ؟هتوم دنع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لسغ .ةنسلا هب ترجو ،لعف (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ
englishText: From al-Hasan bin Ubayd who said: I wrote to al-Sadiq (peace be upon him): Did Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) perform ghusl when he washed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) at his death? He replied: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was pure and purifying, but Amir al Mu'minin (peace be upon him) did so, and it became the established practice.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: نمو ،بجاو وهو ةبانجلا نم :ةعبس نم لسغلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع ،هئباآ نع ،ليع نب ديز نع .كلذ ريغ ركذو ،كأزجأ ترهطت نإو ،تيملا لسغ .هيلع لمعي لا ،ةماعلل قفاوم وهو ،ةيقتلا لىع لومحم ،كأزجأ ترهطت نإو :هلوق :خيشلا لقا ةيوغللا ةراهطلا داري نأ لمتحيو ،ءوضولا نع ءازجلاا هب داريو ،تلستغا ترهطت ىنعم نوكي نأ لمتحيو :لوقأ ،ةقرخ هدي لىع لساغلا فل اذإ امك ،لسغلا كمزلي مل هسم تبنتجاو تهزنت نإ يأ ،ةهازنلاو ةفاظنلا ىنعمب .يتيأو ىضم ام ضراعي لا تلاامتحلاا هذه عمو
englishText: From Zayd ibn Ali, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon him) who said: Ghusl is required for seven things: from janabah which is obligatory, and from washing the deceased, and if you purify yourself it suffices, and he mentioned others. The Shaykh said: His saying "if you purify yourself it suffices" is interpreted as taqiyyah, and it agrees with the general public, and is not acted upon. I (Hurr Amili) say: It's possible that the meaning of "purified" is "performed ghusl," intending it to suffice instead of wudu, and it's possible that the linguistic meaning of purity is intended, meaning cleanliness and hygiene, meaning if you keep away and avoid touching it, ghusl is not required, like when the washer wraps a cloth around his hand, and with these possibilities it doesn't contradict what came before and what follows.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: دتعيف رخآ لاجر نومدقي :لقا ،تام مث ةعكر مهب لىصف اموق مأ لجر يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هسم نم لستغيو ،مهفلخ تيملا نوحرطيو ،ةعكرلبا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding a man who led people in prayer and prayed one rak'ah with them then died, he said: They should put forward another man who counts that rak'ah, and they should place the deceased behind them, and whoever touches him should perform ghusl.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: نمف :لقا ،معن :لقا ؟تيملا لسغ نم لستغيأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لأس هنأ دلاخ نب ناميلس نع .بايثلا سم امنإ ،لا :لقا ؟ربقلا هلخدأ
englishText: From Sulayman ibn Khalid that he asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Should one perform ghusl after washing the deceased? He said: Yes. He asked: What about one who places him in the grave? He said: No, he only touches the clothes.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: امم ةراهطلا ةلعل لسغلبا تيملا لسغي نم رمأ امنإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع ،ناذاش نب لضفلا نع .هتفآ رثكأ هنم يقب حورلا هنم جرخ اذإ تيملا نلا ،تيملا حضن نم هباصأ
englishText: From Al-Fadhl ibn Shadhan, from Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: The one who washes the deceased was ordered to perform ghusl for the reason of purification from what reached him of the deceased's moisture, because when the soul leaves the deceased, most of his affliction remains.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: ،تيملا حضن نم هباصأ امل ةراهطلا هسم وأ تيملا لسغ نم لاستغا ةلعو :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع .رهطيو هنم رهطتي كلذلف هتفآ رثكأ يقب هنم حورلا جرخ اذإ تيملا نلا
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: The reason for performing ghusl after washing the deceased or touching him is purification from what reached him of the deceased's moisture, because when the soul leaves him, most of his affliction remains, thus he purifies himself from it and becomes pure.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: اتيم مكنم لسغ نمو :لقا - ةئامعبرلأا ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع هدانسإب (لاصخلا) يفو .هنافكأ هسبلي ام دعب لستغيلف
englishText: In (al-Khisal) through his chain from Ali (peace be upon him)- in the hadith of the four hundred- he said: Whoever among you washes a deceased should perform ghusl after shrouding him.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: اذإو ،هيلع لسغ لاف اراح ماد ام هسم نإو ،لستغيلف اتيم لسغ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .بايثلا سمي امنإ ،هيلع لسغ لا :لقا ؟ربقلا هلخدأ نمف :تلق ،لستغيلف هسم مث درب
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever washes a deceased should perform ghusl, and if he touches him while he is still warm there is no ghusl required, but if he has cooled and then touches him he should perform ghusl. I asked: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever washes a deceased should perform ghusl, and if he touches him while he is still warm there is no ghusl required, but if he has cooled and then touches him he should perform ghusl. I asked: What about one who places him in the grave? He said: No ghusl is required for him, he only touches the clothes.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: وهو (١) (هتوم دعب) ناسنإ تيملا لبق نإو ،تيملا لسغ يذلا لستغي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هلبقيو لسغلا دعب هسمي نأ سبأ لاو ،لسغلا هيلعف درب دقو هلبقو هسم اذإ نكلو ،لسغ هيلع سيلف راح
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The one who washed the deceased should perform ghusl, and if someone kisses the deceased (after his death) while he is still warm, no ghusl is required for him, but if he touches and kisses him after he has cooled, ghusl is required for him, and there is no harm in touching and kissing him after washing.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: .بجاو اتيم سم نم لسغو :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ةعامس ثيدح ةبانجلا يف قبس دقو
englishText: Previously mentioned in the chapter of Janabah, a hadith by Sama'ah from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: And performing ghusl after touching a deceased person is obligatory.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: ؟اهنم ضرفلا ام :تلق ،ثلاث ضرفلا اهنم ،انطوم رشع ةعبس يف لسغلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .مارحلاا لسغو ،اتيم سم نم لسغو ،ةبانجلا لسغ :لقا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Ghusl is required in seventeen instances, among which three are obligatory. I asked: Which ones are obligatory? He said: Ghusl of janabah, ghusl after touching a deceased person, and ghusl for ihram. Translator: Refer to Hadith 3808 to 3822 in Vol 3, Section 5, Chapter 1.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Human Corpse After It Becomes Cold And Before Washing It, And The Dislike Of Touching It At That Time
arabicText: ؟لسغلا هيلع ،اتيم سم لجر نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم هيخأ نع (هباتك) يف رفعج نب ليع .هسم اذإ لسغلا هيلعف درب دق ناك نإو ،هيلع لسغ لاف دربي مل تيملا ناك نإ :لقا
englishText: Ali ibn Ja'far in (his book) from his brother Musa (peace be upon him) said: I asked him about a man who touched a deceased person, is ghusl required of him? He said: If the deceased had not yet become cold, then no ghusl is required of him, but if the deceased had become cold, then ghusl is required when touching them.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Part Cut From A Human If It Contains Bone, And No Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Bone After A Year
arabicText: هيف ناك ام لكف ناسنإ هسم اذفإ ،ةتيم يهف ةعطق لجرلا نم عطق اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هيلع لسغ لاف مظع هيف نكي مل نفإ ،لسغلا هسمي نم لىع بجو دقف مظع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When a part is cut from a man it becomes dead, so if a person touches it, then if it contains bone, ghusl becomes obligatory upon whoever touches it, and if it does not contain bone, then there is no ghusl upon him.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Part Cut From A Human If It Contains Bone, And No Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Touching A Bone After A Year
arabicText: .سبأ هب سيلف ةنس زاج اذإ :لقا ؟تيملا مظع سم نمع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع طرشلا موهفمو ،معأ سأبلا توبث لب ،ةنس لبق مظعلا سمب لسغلا بوجو لىع ةللاد هيف سيل :لوقأ .ملعأ اللهو ،لسغلل اهسم بجوملا محللا ءازجأ نم ولخي داكي لا ةنس لبق مظعلا نأ ههجو لعلو ،فيعض
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about one who touches the bone of a dead person? He said: If a year has passed, then there is no harm in it. I (Hurr Amili) say: There is no indication in it of the obligation of ghusl upon touching the bone before a year, rather the existence of harm is more general, and the understood condition is weak, and perhaps the reason is that the bone before a year hardly lacks parts of flesh which touching it obligates ghusl, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Ghusl Upon One Who Touches The Deceased Before Cooling Or After Washing
arabicText: .سبأ اهب سيل ةلبقلاو هلسغ دعبو هتوم دنع تيملا سم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: There is no harm in touching the deceased at the time of death, after washing, and kissing.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Ghusl Upon One Who Touches The Deceased Before Cooling Or After Washing
arabicText: .هلبقيو لسغلا دعب هسمي نبأ سبأ لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: There is no harm in touching and kissing the deceased after washing.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Ghusl Upon One Who Touches The Deceased Before Cooling Or After Washing
arabicText: ناك نإو لسغلا هيلعف اتيم سم نم لكو تيملا لسغ يذلا لستغي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لسغ دق تيملا ملو روفاكلباو هب وأ ،هدحو ردسلبا لسغ اذإ ام لىع لمحلا لمتحيو ،بابحتسلاا لىع خيشلا هلمح :لوقأ نأ لىع وأ ،توملا لسغ لسغي ملو خسولاو تاساجنلا نم هندب لسغ تيملا نأ لىع وأ ،حارقلا ءاملبا لسغي .كلذ ريغ لمتحيو ،طقسي مل لسغ تيملا ناك نإو ،بجاو تيملا لسغ لبق عقاولا سملا لسغ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The one who washes the deceased must perform ghusl, and whoever touches a deceased must perform ghusl, even if the deceased has been washed. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted this as recommended, and it could be interpreted as when washed with sidr alone, or with sidr and camphor but not with pure water, or when the body was cleaned of impurities and dirt but not given the ritual washing of death, or that the ghusl for touching before washing the deceased is obligatory and remains so even after the deceased is washed, and other interpretations are possible.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Ghusl Upon One Who Touches The Deceased Before Cooling Or After Washing
arabicText: ،يريمحلا الله دبع نب دمحم ىلإ (ملاسلا هيلع) نامزلا بحاص نع جرخ امم :لقا (جاجتحلاا) يف يسربطلا تثدحو مهتلاص ضعب مهب لىص موق مامإ نع لئس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) ملاعلا نع انل يور :هيلإ بتك ثيح ؟هسم نم لستغيو ،مهتلاص متيو ،مهضعب مدقتيو ،رخؤي :لاقف ؟هفلخ نم لمعي فيك ،ةثداح هيلع .موقلا عم هتلاص ممت ةلاصلا عطقت ةثداح ثدحت مل اذإو ،ديلا لسغ لاإ هاحن نم لىع سيل :عيقوتلا
englishText: Al-Tabarsi in (al-Ihtijaj) said: Among what came from the Master of Time (peace be upon him) to Muhammad bin Abdullah al-Himyari, when he wrote to him: It is narrated from the Aalim (peace be upon him) that he was asked about an imam who led people in some of their prayer and an incident occurred to him, how should those behind him act? He said: He steps back, one of them steps forward, they complete their prayer, and whoever touched him performs ghusl? The response: Only washing hands is required for those who moved him, and if no incident occurred that invalidates prayer, he completes his prayer with the people.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Ghusl Upon One Who Touches The Deceased Before Cooling Or After Washing
arabicText: دقو هسم نمو ،هدي لسغ هترارحب اتيم سم نم نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) ملاعلا نع يورو :هيلإ بتكو :لقا هنعو هيحني هلعلو ؟وه ام لىع كلذ يف لمعلفا ،هترارحب لاإ نوكي لا لاحلا هذه يف تيملا اذهو ،لسغلا هيلعف درب .هدي لسغ لاإ هيلع نكي مل لاحلا هذه لىع هسم اذإ :عيقوتلا !؟لسغلا هيلع بجي فيكف ،هسمي لاو هبايثب .يتيأو ىضم امل ،ندبلا ةرارح تقوب ناصوصخم نلااؤسلا :لوقأ
englishText: And from him who said: It was written to him: It is narrated from the Aalim (peace be upon him) that whoever touches a deceased while still warm should wash their hands, and whoever touches after cooling must perform ghusl, and this deceased in this condition can only be warm, so what should be done in this case? Perhaps he moves him with his clothes without touching him, so how can ghusl be obligatory?! The response: If he touches him in this condition, he only needs to wash his hands. I (Hurr Amili) say: The two questions are specific to the time when the body is still warm, as mentioned before and will be mentioned later.

chapter: Not Making Ghusl Obligatory For Touching The Deceased's Clothes That Touch Their Skin, Carrying Them, Or Placing Them In The Grave
arabicText: نأ لبق هدلج ليي يذلا تيملا بوث هندبو هيدي باصأ لجر :هيلإ تبتك :لقا رافصلا نسحلا نب دمحم نع كيلع بجي دقف لسغي نأ لبق تيملا دسج كندب باصأ اذإ :عقوف ؟هندب وأ هيدي لسغ بجي له ،لسغي .لسغلا
englishText: From Muhammad bin Al-Hasan Al-Saffar who said: I wrote to him: A man's hands and body touched the deceased's clothes that were touching their skin before washing, is washing his hands or body obligatory? He wrote: If your body touches the deceased's body before it is washed, then ghusl becomes obligatory upon you.

chapter: Not Making Ghusl Obligatory For Touching The Deceased's Clothes That Touch Their Skin, Carrying Them, Or Placing Them In The Grave
arabicText: لستغت لاو ،اتيم تلسغ اذإو ،ةعمجلاو ،رطفلاو ،حىضلأا موي لستغا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هتلمحأ اذإ لاو ،ربقلا هتلخدأ اذإ هسم نم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Perform ghusl on the day of Adha, Fitr, Friday, and when you wash a deceased person, but do not perform ghusl from touching them when you place them in the grave, nor when you carry them.

chapter: Not Making Ghusl Obligatory For Touching The Deceased's Clothes That Touch Their Skin, Carrying Them, Or Placing Them In The Grave
arabicText: .ربقلا لخد اذإ لسغلا نع ىهني (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا ىيحي نب رمعم نع
englishText: From Ma'mar bin Yahya who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) prohibiting ghusl when entering the grave.

chapter: Not Making Ghusl Obligatory For Touching The Deceased's Clothes That Touch Their Skin, Carrying Them, Or Placing Them In The Grave
arabicText: هلخدأ نمف :تلق ،معن :لقا ؟تيملا لسغ نم لستغيأ :هل تلق :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .بايثلا سمي امنإ ،لا :لقا ؟ربقلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), I said to him: Should one perform ghusl after washing a deceased person? He said: Yes. I said: What about one who places them in the grave? He said: No, they only touch the clothes.

chapter: Permissibility Of Kissing The Deceased Before And After Washing
arabicText: .هتوم دعب نوعظم نب نامثع لبق (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) kissed Uthman bin Madhun after his death.

chapter: Permissibility Of Kissing The Deceased Before And After Washing
arabicText: نأ جىسم وهو هب ترمأ ليعامسإ تام امل :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم هتهبج اضيأ تلبقف ،هنع اوفشكا :تلق مث ،يطغف هب ترمأ مث ،هرحنو هنقذو ههجو تلبقف ،ههجو نع فشكي ،ههجو نع اوفشكا :تلقف ،نفك دقو هيلع تلخد مث ،لسغف هب ترمأ مث ،هوطغف مهترمأ مث ،هرحنو هنقذو .نآرقلبا :لاقف ؟هتذوع ئش يبأ :هل ليقف .هوجردأ :تلق مث ،هتذوعو ،هرحنو هنقذو هتهبج تلبقف ليبقتلا زاوج نلأ ،كلذ ىلإ ةجاح لاو ،لسغلا دعب وأ ،دربلا لبق هنأ لىع روكذملا ليبقتلا خيشلا لمح :لوقأ كلذ ىلإ راشأ دقو ،لسغلا بجوي هوركم لاو مرحمب سيل يذلا عامجلا نفإ ،هجوب لسغلا بوجو يفاني لا .(نيدلا لامكإ) باتك يف قودصلا
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: When Isma'il died and he was laid out, I ordered that his face be uncovered, then I kissed his face, chin, and throat. Then I ordered him to be covered. Then I said: Uncover him, and I kissed his forehead, chin, and throat again. Then I ordered them to cover him. Then I ordered him to be washed. Then I entered upon him after he was shrouded and said: Uncover his face, and I kissed his forehead, chin, and throat, and I sought protection for him. Then I said: Wrap him. He was asked: With what did you seek protection for him? He said: With the Quran. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted the mentioned kissing as being before coldness set in, or after washing, but there is no need for that, because the permissibility of kissing does not contradict the obligation of washing in any way, as intimate relations which are neither forbidden nor disliked necessitate washing, and Al-Saduq has pointed to this in the book (Ikmal Al-Din).

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Ghusl When Touching Dead Non-Human Beings And What Life Does Not Make Permissible
arabicText: كلذ امنإ ،لا :لقا ؟لسغلا هيلعأ ،ةتيم سم لجر يف ،(ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ملسم نب دمحم نع .ناسنلاا نم
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim, from one of them (peace be upon them), regarding a man who touches a dead animal, must he perform ghusl? He said: No, that is only for [touching] humans.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Ghusl When Touching Dead Non-Human Beings And What Life Does Not Make Permissible
arabicText: :لاقف ؟اهنم لستغي نأ يغبنيأ ،ةتيملا سمي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا يبلحلا نع .هدحو ناسنلاا نم كلذ امنإ ،لا
englishText: From Al-Halabi who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who touches a dead animal, should he perform ghusl for it? He said: No, that is only for [touching] humans alone.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Ghusl When Touching Dead Non-Human Beings And What Life Does Not Make Permissible
arabicText: باصأ ام لسغي :لاقف ؟تيملا دسج هبوث بيصي لجرلا نع هتلأسو :لقا :دازو ،هلثم ،ريمع يبأ نبا نع .بوثلا
englishText: From Ibn Abi Umayr, similar to it, and he added: He said: And I asked him about a man whose clothes touch a dead body? He said: He should wash what touched the clothes.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Ghusl When Touching Dead Non-Human Beings And What Life Does Not Make Permissible
arabicText: وأ ايح عابسلا نم ائيش وأ بنرلأاو بلعثلا سمي نأ لحي له :هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هدي لسغي نكلو ،هرضي لا :لقا ؟اتيم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him: Is it permissible to touch a fox, rabbit, or any predatory animal whether alive or dead? He said: It doesn't harm him, but he should wash his hands.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Ghusl When Touching Dead Non-Human Beings And What Life Does Not Make Permissible
arabicText: تاوملأا نم ائيش سم نم لىع لسغلا بجي مل امنإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع ،ناذاش نب لضفلا نع ،اربوو ارعشو فاوصو اشير ةسبلم اهلك ءايشلأا هذه نلأ كلذ ريغو عابسلاو مئاهبلاو رويطلاك ناسنلاا ريغ .تيملاو حيلا نم كيذ وه يذلا ئشلا هنم سامي امنإو ،تومي لا كيذ هلك اذهو لدي ام مدقت دقو ،ةصاخ بلغلأا درفلل لايلعت هنوك لمتحيو ،ادج ريثك هلثمو ،يقيقح ريغ ليلعتلا :لوقأ .هيلع لدي ام يتيأو ،دوصقملا لىع
englishText: From Al-Fadhl bin Shadhan, from Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: Ghusl is not obligatory upon one who touches any dead thing other than humans, such as birds, animals, predators and others, because all these things are covered with feathers, wool, hair, and fur, and all of this is pure and does not die, and what is touched from it is something that is pure whether alive or dead. I (Hurr Amili) say: The reasoning is not factual, and there are many similar cases. It's possible that this reasoning applies to the most common case specifically. What was intended has been mentioned before, and evidence for it will come later.

chapter: Ghusl Of Touching The Deceased Is Like The Ghusl Of Janabah
arabicText: .ةبانجلا لسغ لستغا هنفكو اتيم لسغ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever washes a deceased person and shrouds them should perform a ghusl (ritual bath) like the ghusl from janabah (sexual impurity). Section 5 Sunnah Ghusls

chapter: Enumerating Their Types And Categories
arabicText: نيحو ،نيديعلاو ،ةعمجلا مويو ،ةبانجلا نم لسغلا :لوقي هتعمس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع عست ةليل يفو ،ةبعكلا لخدت نيحو ،تيبلا روزت مويو ،ةفرع مويو ،ةنيدملاو ةكم لخدت نيحو ،مرحت .اتيم لسغ نمو ،ناضمر رهش نم نيرشعو ثلاثو نيرشعو ىدحإو ،ةرشع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I heard him say: Ghusl (ritual bath) is for janabah (sexual impurity), Friday, the two Eids, when entering the state of ihram, when entering Makkah and Medina, on the day of Arafah, on the day of visiting the House (Ka'bah), when entering the Ka'bah, on the night of the 19th, 21st and 23rd of Ramadan, and after washing a deceased person.

chapter: Enumerating Their Types And Categories
arabicText: ةليل :لقا ؟ةليل ناضمر رهش يف لستغأ مك :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا دلاخ نب ناميلس نع ،نيرشعو ىدحإ يف :لقا ؟ليع قش نفإ :تلق :لقا ،نيرشعو ثلاثو ،نيرشعو ىدحإ ةليلو ،ةرشع عست .نلاا كبسح :لقا ؟ليع قش نفإ :تلق ،نيرشعو ثلاثو
englishText: From Sulayman bin Khalid who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): How many times should I perform ghusl in the nights of Ramadan? He said: On the night of the 19th, night of the 21st, and 23rd. I said: What if it is difficult for me? He said: Then on the 21st and 23rd. I said: What if that is also difficult for me? He said: Now it suffices you.

chapter: Enumerating Their Types And Categories
arabicText: لاإ ،رضحلاو رفسلا يف بجاو :لاقف ؟ةعمجلا لسغ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ةعامس نع :لقاو ،ءاملا ةلقل ،رفسلا يف ءاسنلل صخر هنأ فسركلبا تشتحا اذإ بجاو ةضاحتسلاا لسغو ،بجاو ترهط اذإ ضئاحلا لسغو ،بجاو ةبانجلا لسغ فسركلبا تشتحا اذإ بجاو ةضاحتسلاا لسغو ،بجاو ترهط اذإ ضئاحلا لسغو ،بجاو ةبانجلا لسغ ،بجاو ءاسفنلا لسغو - لقا نأ ىلإ - فسركلا مدلا زاجف ،بجاو تيملا لسغ نم لسغو ،بجاو تيملا لسغو ،بجاو دولوملا لسغو تيبلا لوخد لسغو ،ةلع نم لاإ بجاو ةريازلا لسغو ،بجاو ةفرع موي لسغو ،بجاو مرحملا لسغو ،لسغب لاإ هلخدت لا نأ بحتسي مرحلا لوخد لسغو ،بجاو ،بجاو ءاقستسلاا لسغو ،بجاو ةلهابملا لسغو نيرشعو ثلاث ةليل لسغو ،ةنس نيرشعو ىدحإ ةليل لسغو ،بحتسم ناضمر رهش نم ةليل لوأ لسغو ،اهكرت بحأ لا ةنس حىضلأا موي لسغو ،رطفلا موي لسغو ،ردقلا ةليل نهادحإ يف جىري هنلأ ،اهكرتت لا ةنس .بحتسي ةراختسلاا لسغو لا نأ بحتسي ،بجاو مرحلا لوخد لسغو :لقا هنأ لاإ ،هوحن ،نارهم نب ةعامس نع هدانسإب قودصلا هاورو .لسغب لاإ هلخدت رابخلاا نأ اوركذو ،ةبجاولا ةتسلا لاسغلأا ريغ يف دكؤملا بابحتسلاا لىع بوجولا هريغو خيشلا لمح :لوقأ .اهبوجو يفن لىع ةلاد
englishText: From Sama'ah who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the ghusl of Friday? He said: It is obligatory while traveling and at home, except that a concession is given to women while traveling due to scarcity of water. And he said: Ghusl for janabah is obligatory, ghusl for a menstruating woman when she becomes pure is obligatory, ghusl for istihadha (irregular bleeding) is obligatory if she stuffs with cotton and the blood flows beyond the cotton- until he said- and ghusl for a woman in nifas (post-partum bleeding) is obligatory, And ghusl for a newborn is obligatory, ghusl for the dead is obligatory, ghusl for one who washed the dead is obligatory, And ghusl for a muhrim (one in ihram) is obligatory, ghusl on the day of Arafah is obligatory, ghusl for Ziyarah (visitation to the graves of Ahl al Bayt) is obligatory except due to an excuse, ghusl for entering the House (Ka'bah) is obligatory, ghusl for entering the Haram is recommended and one should not enter it except with ghusl, And ghusl for Mubahalah (*) is obligatory, ghusl for istisqa (prayer for rain) is obligatory, And ghusl on the first night of Ramadan is recommended, ghusl on the night of the 21st is sunnah, ghusl on the night of 23rd is sunnah which should not be left, because it is hoped that one of them is Laylatul Qadr, ghusl on the day of Eid al-Fitr, and ghusl on the day of Eid al-Adha is sunnah which I do not like to leave, and ghusl for istikharah is recommended. Al-Saduq narrated it with his isnad from Sama'ah bin Mehran, similarly, except that he said: Ghusl for entering the Haram is obligatory, and it is recommended not to enter it except with ghusl. I (Hurr Amili) say: Shaykh (Tusi) and others interpreted the obligation to mean strong recommendation for other than the six obligatory ghusls, and they mentioned that the reports indicate the negation of their obligation. I (Hurr Amili) say: Shaykh (Tusi) and others interpreted the obligation to mean strong recommendation for other than the six obligatory ghusls, and they mentioned that the reports indicate the negation of their obligation. Translator: * Ghusl on the day of Mubahalah- 24th Dhu'l-Hijjah. Mubahalah was a significant historical event that took place in the year 631 CE between Prophet Muhammad and a Christian delegation from Najran (modern-day Yemen). The Christians of Najran disagreed with the Islamic teachings about Jesus, so the Prophet invited them to engage in Mubahalah, which is a form of prayer invoking God's curse upon the lying party in a dispute.

chapter: Enumerating Their Types And Categories
arabicText: ةعبس ةليل :انطوم رشع ةعبس يف لسغلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم ةليل جىري اهيفو نيرشعو ثلاث ةليلو نيرشعو ىدحإ ةليلو ،رشع ةعست ةليلو ،ناضمر رهش نم رشع مويو ،ةيورتلا مويو ،تيبلا لخدت مويو ،ةريازلا مويو ،مرحت مويو ،نيمرحلا تلخد اذإو ،نيديعلا لسغو ،ردقلا صرقلا قرتحا اذإ ،فوسكلا لسغو ،ةعمجلا مويو ،دربي ام دعب هتسسم وأ ،هتنفكو اتيم تلسغ اذإو ،ةفرع .ةضيرف ةبانجلا لسغو ،ةلاصلا يضقتو لستغت نأ كيلعف لصت ملو تظقيتسفا هلك
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin al-Husayn said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Ghusl is (prescribed) in seventeen situations: Night of 17th of Ramadan, night of 19th, night of 21st, night of 23rd in which Laylatul Qadr is hoped for, ghusl of the two Eids, when entering the two Harams, on the day of assuming ihram, on the day of Ziyarah (visitation of the graves of Ahl al Bayt), on the day of entering the House (Ka'bah), on the day of Tarwiyah, on the day of Arafah, when you have washed and shrouded a dead body or touched it after it has become cold, on Friday, ghusl for the eclipse- if the whole disc is blocked and you wake up and have not prayed then you must perform ghusl and make up the prayer, and ghusl for janabah is obligatory.

chapter: Enumerating Their Types And Categories
arabicText: يبأ نب نمحرلا دبع لقاو :لقا مث .تيملا لسغو :دازو ،هلثم ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع (لاصخلا) يفو يف لمعت نأ كيلع امو ،نيرشعو ةعبرأ ةليل يف لستغا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ يل لقا :الله دبع .اعيمج نيتليللا
englishText: In (al-Khisal) from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), similarly, and he added: And ghusl for the dead. Then he said: And Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Abdullah said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said to me: Perform ghusl on the night of 24th, and it is not upon you to perform it on both nights.

chapter: Enumerating Their Types And Categories
arabicText: ،ةنس ةعمجلا موي لسغو :نومأملا ىلإ هبتك هباتك يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع :(رابخلأا نويع) يفو ،ناضمر رهش نم ةليل لوأو ،مارحلاا لسغو ،ةريازلا لسغو ،ةنيدملاو ةكم لوخد لسغو ،نيديعلا لسغو هذه ،ناضمر رهش نم نيرشعو ثلاث ةليلو نيرشعو ىدحإ ةليلو ةرشع عست ةليلو ةرشع عبس ةليلو .هلثم ضيحلا لسغو ،ةضيرف ةبانجلا لسغو ةنس لاسغلأا
englishText: In (Uyun al-Akhbar) from al-Ridha (peace be upon him), in his letter he wrote to al In (Uyun al-Akhbar) from al-Ridha (peace be upon him), in his letter he wrote to al Ma'mun: And ghusl on Friday is sunnah, and ghusl of the two Eids, and ghusl for entering Makkah and Medina, and ghusl for Ziyarah (visitation of the graves of Ahl al Bayt), and ghusl for ihram, and on the first night of Ramadan, and on the nights of 17th, 19th, 21st and 23rd of Ramadan- these ghusls are sunnah. However, ghusl for janabah (sexual impurity) is obligatory, and ghusl for menstruation is likewise obligatory.

chapter: Enumerating Their Types And Categories
arabicText: لسغو ،بنجلا لسغو ،تيملا لسغ :انطوم رشع ةعبرأ يف لسغلا نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ةنيدملا لوخدو ،ةبعكلا لوخدو ،مارحلاا لسغو ،ةفرع مويو ،نيديعلاو ،ةعمجلا لسغو ،تيملا لسغ نم .ناضمر رهش نم نيرشعو ثلاثو ،نيرشعو ىدحإو ،ةرشع عست ةليلو ،ةريازلاو ،مرحلا لوخدو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed ghusl is in fourteen situations: Ghusl for the dead, ghusl for the junub, ghusl for one who washed the dead, ghusl for Friday, the two Eids, the day of Arafah, ghusl for ihram, entering the Ka'bah, entering Medina, entering the Haram, Ziyarah (visitation of the graves of Ahl al Bayt), night of 19th, 21st and 23rd of Ramadan.

chapter: Enumerating Their Types And Categories
arabicText: لاسغلأاو :لقا - نيدلا عئارش ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا امهيلع) دمحم نب رفعج نع ،شمعلأا نع هدانسإبو ،تيملا لسغ نم لسغو ،دربي ام دعب تيملا سم نمو ،تيملا لسغو ،ضيحلاو ،ةبانجلا لسغ :اهنم لسغو ،ةريازلا لسغو ،ةنيدملا لوخد لسغو ،ةكم لوخد لسغو ،نيديعلا لسغو ،ةعمجلا موي لسغو رهش نم ةرشع عست ةليل لسغو ،ناضمر رهش نم ةرشع عبس ةليل لسغو ،ةفرع موي لسغو ،مارحلاا ةبانجلا لسغو ،ةبانجلا لسغف ضرفلا امأو ،هنم نيرشعو ثلاث ةليلو ،نيرشعو ىدحإ ةليل لسغو ،ناضمر .دحاو ضيحلاو
englishText: With his isnad from al-A'mash, from Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon them both)- in a hadith about the laws of religion- he said: Among the ghusls are: Ghusl for janabah (sexual impurity), menstruation, washing the deceased, touching the deceased after it becomes cold, ghusl for one who washes the deceased, ghusl on Friday, ghusl of the two Eids, ghusl for entering Makkah, ghusl for entering Medina, ghusl for Ziyarah (visitation of the graves of Ahl al Bayt), ghusl for entering ihram, ghusl on the day of Arafah, ghusl on the night of 17th of Ramadan, ghusl on the night of 19th of Ramadan, ghusl on the night of 21st and 23rd of it. As for the obligatory one, it is ghusl for janabah (sexual impurity), and ghusl for janabah and menstruation are the same.

chapter: Enumerating Their Types And Categories
arabicText: لستغت لاو ،اتيم تلسغ اذإو ،ةعمجلاو ،رطفلاو ،حىضلأا موي لستغا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هتلمح اذإ لاو ،ربقلا هتلخدأ اذإ هسم نم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Perform ghusl on the day of al Adha, al-Fitr, Friday, when you wash a dead body, and do not perform ghusl for touching it when you put it in the grave or when you carry it.

chapter: Enumerating Their Types And Categories
arabicText: ةفرع مويو ،حىضلأا مويو ،رطفلا مويو ،ةعمجلا مويو ،ةبانجلا نم لسغلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع لسغو ،ةبعكلا لوخدو ،ةنيدملاو ةكم لوخد دنعو ،مرحي نيحو ،اتيم لسغ نمو ،سمشلا لاوز دنع .ناضمر رهش نم يلايللا ثلاثلاو ،ةريازلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Ghusl for janabah, on Friday, on the day of al-Fitr, on the day of al-Adha, on the day of Arafah at the time of the sun's declination (zawal), for one who washed a dead body, when assuming ihram, when entering Makkah and Medina, entering the Ka'bah, ghusl for Ziyarah (visitation of the graves of Ahl al Bayt), and on the three nights of Ramadan.

chapter: Enumerating Their Types And Categories
arabicText: يهو ناضمر رهش نم ةرشع عبس ةليل :انطوم رشع ةعبس يف لسغلا :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع يتلا ةليللا يهو نيرشعو ىدحإ ةليلو ،ةنسلا دفو دفولا بتكي اهيفو ةرشع عست ةليلو ،ناعمجلا ىقتلا ةليل هيلع) ىسوم ضبقو ،(ملاسلا هيلع) ميرم نب ىسيع عفر اهيفو ،(ملاسلا مهيلع) ءايبنلأا ءايصوأ اهيف بيصأ مويو ،مرحت مويو ،نيمرحلا تلخد اذإو ،نيديعلا يمويو ،ردقلا ةليل اهيف جىري نيرشعو ثلاث ةليلو ،(ملاسلا مويو ،دربي ام دعب هتسسم وأ هتنفك وأ اتيم تلسغ اذإو ،ةفرع مويو ،ةيورتلا مويو ،تيبلا لخدت مويو ،ةريازلا .لستغفا هلك صرقلا قرتحا اذإ فوسكلا لسغو ،ةضيرف ةبانجلا لسغو ،ةعمجلا
englishText: From one of the two (peace be upon them both) who said: Ghusl is in seventeen situations: Night of 17th of Ramadan which is the night the two groups met, night of 19th in which the delegations of the year are written down, night of 21st which is the night the successors of the prophets (peace be upon them) were afflicted, Jesus son of Mary (peace be upon him) was raised up in it, and Moses (peace be upon him) passed away, night of 23rd in which Laylatul Qadr is hoped for, the two days of Eid, when entering the two Harams, the day of ihram, the day of Ziyarah (visitation to graves of Ahl al Bayt), the day of entering the House (Ka'bah), the day of Tarwiyah, the day of Arafah, when you have washed a dead body or shrouded it or touched it after it has become cold, on Friday, and ghusl for janabah is obligatory, and ghusl for eclipse if the whole disc is blocked then perform ghusl.

chapter: Enumerating Their Types And Categories
arabicText: لايل ثلاثو ،ةفرع مويو ،نيديعلاو ،ةعمجلا لسغو ،ةبانجلا نم لسغلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع دجسم لوخد (تدرأ اذإو ،مارحلا تيبلا لوخد) تدرأ اذإو ،مرحلا لخدت نيحو ،ناضمر رهش يف .تيملا لسغ نمو ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) لوسرلا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Ghusl for janabah, ghusl on Friday, the two Eids, the day of Arafah, three nights in Ramadan, when entering the Haram, when you want to enter the Sacred House, when you want to enter the mosque of the Messenger (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family), and for one who washed the dead.

chapter: Enumerating Their Types And Categories
arabicText: ؟ناضمر رهش نم لسغلا اهيف بحتسي يتلا يلايللا نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ةرارز نع دفو بتكي ةرشع عست ةليل يف :لقاو نيرشعو ثلاث ةليلو ،نيرشعو ىدحإ ةليلو ،ةرشع عست ةليل :لاقف اهيفو ،ىسوم يصو ضبق اهيفو ،ىسيع عفر اهيف نيرشعو ىدحإ ةليلو ،ميكح رمأ لك قرفي اهيفو ،جاحلا لوسرل لقا هنأ هثيدحو ،ينهجلا ةليل يهو نيرشعو ثلاث ةليلو ،(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ ضبق .نيرشعو ثلاث ةليلب هرمفأ ،اهيف لخدأ ةليلب ينرمف ةنيدملا نع ءنا يلزنم نإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله
englishText: From Zurarah, from one of the two (peace be upon them both), he said: I asked him about the nights in which ghusl is recommended in the month of Ramadan? He said: Night of 19th, night of 21st, and night of 23rd. And he said: On the night of 19th, the delegation of pilgrims is written down, and in it every wise matter is decreed. On the night of 21st, Jesus was raised up, the successor of Moses passed away, and Amir al Mu'minin (peace be upon him) passed away. And the night of 23rd is the night of Al Juhani, and his narration is that he said to the Messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family): Indeed my house is far from Medina, so instruct me of a night I can enter in it. So he instructed him the night of 23rd.

chapter: Enumerating Their Types And Categories
arabicText: يف لستغأ يلايللا يأ يف :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا نيعأ نب ريكب هيبأ نع ،ريكب نب الله دبع نع .نيرشعو ثلاث يقو ،نيرشعو ىدحإ يفو ،ةرشع عست يف :لقا ؟ناضمر رهش
englishText: From Abdullah bin Bukayr, from his father Bukayr bin Ayn who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): In which nights should I perform ghusl in the month of Ramadan? He said: On the 19th, 21st, and 23rd.

chapter: Enumerating Their Types And Categories
arabicText: دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ريكب نب الله دبع نع ،ديلولا نب دمحم نع :(دانسلإا برق) يف رفعج نب الله دبع ،نيرشعو ىدحإو ،ةرشع عست :لقا ؟لستغأ يلايللا يأو ،ناضمر رهش يف لسغلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله .نيرشعو ثلاثو
englishText: Abdullah bin Ja'far in (Qurb al-Isnad): From Muhammad bin al-Walid, from Abdullah bin Bukayr who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about ghusl in the month of Ramadan, and in which nights should I perform ghusl? He said: 19th, 21st, and 23rd. Shaykh Hurr Amili: What indicates the recommendation of most of the ghusls mentioned here, and in the prayer, fasting and Hajj, and the recommendation of other ghusls will come, if Allah the Exalted wills.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl On The Day Of Arafah Wherever One May Be
arabicText: دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ةبايس نب نمحرلا دبع نع (نيظعاولا ةضور) يف يسرافلا لاتفلا دمحأ نب ليع نب دمحم .تنك امنيأ لستغا :لاقف ،راصملأا يف ةفرع موي لسغ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Ahmad al-Fattal al-Farisi in (Rawdat al-Wa'izin) from Abd al Rahman bin Siyabah who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the ghusl on the day of Arafah in the cities, so he said: Perform ghusl wherever you may be.

chapter: Recommendation Of The Mentioned Ghusls For Men And Women
arabicText: ؟ةفرع مويو حىضلأاو رطفلاو ةعمجلا موي لسغ اهيلع ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هلك لسغلا اهيلع ،معن :لقا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a woman, is it upon her (to perform) ghusl on Friday, Eid Al-Fitr, Eid Al-Adha, and the Day of Arafah? He said: Yes, she should perform all these ghusls.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl On The Three Odd Nights Of The Month Of Ramadan
arabicText: عست يف :ناضمر رهش نم لايل ثلاث يف لسغلا :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ملسم نب دمحم نع ،ةرشع عست ةليل يف (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ بيصأو ،نيرشعو ثلاثو ،نيرشعو ىدحإو ،ةرشع .هرخآ ىلإ يزجي وهو ليللا لوأ يف لسغلاو :لقا نيرشعو ىدحإ ةليل يف ضبقو
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim, from one of the two (peace be upon them both) who said: Ghusl is in three nights of the month of Ramadan: on the 19th, 21st, and 23rd. Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) was afflicted on the night of the 19th and passed away on the night of the 21st. He said: And ghusl is at the beginning of the night and it suffices until its end.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl On The Three Odd Nights Of The Month Of Ramadan
arabicText: ةليل :لقا ؟ةليل ناضمر رهش يف لستغأ مك (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا دلاخ نب ناميلس نع .نيرشعو ثلاث ةليلو ،نيرشعو ىدحإ ةليلو ،ةرشع عست دكؤملا بابحتسلاا رصح لىع لومحم روكذملا رصحلاو ،هيلع لدي ام يتيأو ،كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ .رصحلا يف حيرص ريغ هنأ عم ،يتيأو ىضم امل
englishText: From Sulayman bin Khalid who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), how many times should I perform ghusl in the month of Ramadan at night? He said: On the night of the 19th, night of the 21st, and night of the 23rd. I (Hurr Amili) say: What has preceded indicates that, and what will come indicates it. The mentioned limitation is interpreted as limiting the emphasized recommendation based on what has passed and what will come, even though it is not explicit in the limitation.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl On The Night Of The 23rd Of The Month Of Ramadan Twice, At The Beginning Of The Night And At Its End
arabicText: .ليللا رخآ نم ةرمو ،ليللا لوأ نم ةرم :نيترم نيرشعو ثلاث ةليل يف لستغا هتيأر :لقا ديرب نع
englishText: From Burayd who said: I saw him perform ghusl on the night of the 23rd twice: once at the beginning of the night and once at the end of the night.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: يف لاجرلا لىعو ،رضحلا يف ءاسنلاو لاجرلا لىع ةعمجلا موي لسغلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رفسلا يف ءاسنلا لىع سيلو ،رفسلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Ghusl on Friday is upon men and women when at home, and upon men when traveling, but not upon women when traveling.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: .ءاملا ةلقل رفسلا يف ءاسنلل صخر هنأ ىرخأ ةياور يفو :لقا
englishText: He said: And in another narration, he gave a concession to women while traveling due to the scarcity of water.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: وأ ركذ لك لىع بجاو :لاقف ؟ةعمجلا موي لسغلا نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا يبأ نع .رح وأ دبع ،ىثنأ
englishText: From Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about ghusl on Friday? He said: It is obligatory upon every male and female, slave and free person.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: .بيطتيو لستغي ،ةعمجلا موي مكدحأ نيزتيل :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا :لقا مكحلا نب ماشه نع
englishText: From Hisham ibn al-Hakam who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Each one of you should adorn himself on Friday, perform ghusl (ritual bath), and apply perfume.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: لقا نأ ىلإ - بيطلا مشو ،ةنس هنفإ ةعمجلا موي لسغلا عدت لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا :لقا ةرارز نع .ةعمجلا موي بجاو لسغلا :لقاو
englishText: Zurarah narrated that Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Do not abandon the ghusl on Friday for it is a sunnah, and wear (apply) perfume- then he said- and he said: Ghusl is obligatory on Friday.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: ركذ لك لىع بجاو :لاقف ؟ةعمجلا موي لسغ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا تلأس :لقا الله دبع نب دمحم نع .رح وأ دبع نم ىثنأو
englishText: From Muhammad bin Abdullah who said: I asked al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about ghusl on Friday? He said: It is obligatory upon every male and female, slave and free person.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: :لاقف ؟ابجاو ةعمجلا موي لسغ راص فيك :(ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا باأ تلأس :لقا دلاخ نب نيسحلا نع موي لسغب ةلفانلا ءوضو متأو ،ةلفانلا مايصب ةضيرفلا مايص متأو ،ةلفانلا ةلاصب ةضيرفلا ةلاص متأ الله نإ .ناصقن وأ ،نايسن وأ ،ريصقت وأ وهس نم كلذ يف ناك ام ،ةعمجلا بجاوب سيل ةلفانلا ءوضو مامتإ نلا ،دكؤملا بابحتسلاا بوجولبا دارملا نأ لىع ةحضاو ةنيرق اذه يف :لوقأ ةلاصو ةلفانلا موص بوجو مدعب عطقلل ،بجاوب سيل انه نيبجاولا مايصلاو ةلاصلا مامتإو فيك ،مزلا لاو .ةلفانلا
englishText: Al-Husayn bin Khalid narrated: I asked Abu al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him): How did the Friday bath become obligatory? He said: Allah completed the obligatory prayer with supererogatory prayer, and completed obligatory fasting with supererogatory fasting, and completed supererogatory ablution with the Friday ghusl, for whatever occurred in it of oversight, shortcoming, forgetfulness, or deficiency. I (Hurr Amili) say: In this there is clear evidence that what is meant by obligation is emphasized recommendation, because completing supererogatory ablution is neither obligatory nor necessary, especially when completing obligatory prayer and fasting here is not obligatory, as it is definitively established that voluntary fasting and supererogatory prayer are not obligatory.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: .معن :لقا ؟ةعمجلا لسغ نهيلعأ ،ءاسنلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس :لقا نيطقي نب ليع نع
englishText: From Ali bin Yaqtin who said: I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about women, is the ghusl of Friday upon them? He said: Yes.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: ةنس :لقا ؟رطفلاو حىضلأاو ةعمجلا يف لسغلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس :لقا نيطقي نب ليع نع .ةضيرفب سيلو
englishText: From Ali bin Yaqtin who said: I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about ghusl on Friday, al-Adha and al-Fitr? He said: It is sunnah and not obligatory.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: رفسلا يف ةنس :لاقف ؟ةعمجلا موي لسغ نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع .رقلا هسفن لىع رفاسملا فاخي نأ لاإ ،رضحلاو
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about ghusl on Friday? He said: It is sunnah while traveling and at home, except if the traveler fears the cold for himself.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: .كسفن لىع فاخت وأ ،اضيرم نوكت نأ لاإ ةعمجلا موي لستغا :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع
englishText: From one of the two (peace be upon them both) who said: Perform ghusl on Friday unless you are ill or fear for yourself.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: :تلق ،ةنس وه :لاقف ؟وه بجاوأ ،نيديعلا لسغ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ليع نع .ةنس وه :لقا ؟ةعمجلفا
englishText: From Ali who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the ghusl of the two Eids, is it obligatory? He said: It is sunnah. I said: What about Friday? He said: It is sunnah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: .بجاو اهيف لسغلاو :لقا - ةعمجلا ثيدح يف (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) in a hadith about Friday- he said: And ghusl in it is obligatory.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: ىلإ ةعمجلا نم بونذلا نم امهنيب امل ةرافكو روهط ةعمجلا موي لسغ :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقاو :لقا .ةعمجلا
englishText: He said: And al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: The ghusl of Friday is a purification and expiation for the sins between them, from Friday to Friday.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: ،اهلاومأو اهحضاون يف لمعت تناك راصنلأا نإ :ةعمجلا موي لسغ ةلع يف (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقاو :لقا الله لىص) الله لوسر مهرمفأ ،مهداسجأو مهطباآ حاوربأ سانلا ىذأتف ،دجسملا اورضح ةعمجلا موي ناك اذفإ .ةنسلا كلذب ترجف ،لسغلبا (هلآو هيلع
englishText: He said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said regarding the reason for performing ghusl (ritual bath) on Friday: The Ansar used to work with their camels and their properties, and when Friday came, they would attend the mosque. The people were bothered by the odors from their armpits and bodies, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered them to perform ghusl, and thus this practice became established as a Sunnah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: ءوضولا متأو ،ةلفانلا مايصب ةضيرفلا مايص متأو ،ةلفانلا ةلاصب ةضيرفلا ةلاص متأ ىلاعت الله نأ يورو :لقا .ةعمجلا موي لسغب
englishText: He said: It is reported that Allah the Most High completes the obligatory prayer with supererogatory prayer, completes the obligatory fast with supererogatory fast, and completes the ablution with the ghusl of Friday.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: ءاسنلل صخر هنأ لاإ ،رضحلاو رفسلا يف ءاسنلاو لاجرلا لىع بجاو ةعمجلا لسغ :لقا هعفر ىيحي نب دمحأ .ءاملا ةلقل ،رفسلا يف دوجو مدع ةدارإ لامتحاو ،هتلق لا ءاملا مدع دنع لاإ هيف صخر امل لاإو ،اضيأ بابحتسلاا لىع لدي اذه :لوقأ عم ،رضحلاو رفسلا نيب لاو ،ءاسنلاو لاجرلا نيب قرف ىقبي لا هنأ هعفدي برشلل ةرورضلا ردق نع ديزي ام .يتيأو ىضم امك بوجولا يفنب تاحيرصتلا
englishText: Ahmad bin Yahya, raising it (to level of Hadith), he (peace be upon him) said: The ghusl of Friday is obligatory upon men and women while traveling and at home, except that a concession is given to women while traveling due to the scarcity of water. I (Hurr Amili) say: This also indicates recommendation, otherwise the concession would not be given in it except when water is absent, not when it is scarce. The possibility of intending the absence of what exceeds the amount of necessity for drinking is refuted by the fact that there remains no difference between men and women, nor between traveling and being at home, along with the explicit statements negating obligation as has preceded and will come.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: ديعلا لسغ ةلع :هلئاسم باوج هيلإ بتك هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع (رابخلأا نويع) يفو (للعلا) يفو نوكيلو ،هبونذل ةرفغملا بلطو ،ليلجلا ميركلا هلابقتساو ،هبر دبعلا ميظعت نم هيف امل كلذ ريغو ةعمجلاو لىع هل لايضفتو ،مويلا كلذل اميظعت لسغلا هيف لعجف ،الله ركذ لىع هيف نوعمتجي فورعم ديع موي مهل .ةعمجلا ىلإ ةعمجلا نم هل ةراهط نوكيلو ،ةدابعلاو لفاونلا يف ةديازو ،ميالأا رئاس
englishText: In Al-'Ilal and 'Uyun al-Akhbar, from Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), who wrote in response to questions posed to him: The reason for the ghusl on Eid, Friday, and other occasions is for the servant's glorification of his Lord, his reception of the Noble and Majestic One, and his seeking forgiveness for his sins. And so that people may have a known day of Eid in which they gather for the remembrance of Allah. The ghusl was prescribed on that day to honor it, distinguish it from other days, increase supererogatory acts of worship, and serve as a purification from one Friday to the next.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: ةعمجلا لسغ :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع يور :لقا (ةعنقملا) يف ديفملا دمحم نب دمحم .رضحلاو رفسلا يف ةنس رطفلاو
englishText: Muhammad bin Muhammad Al-Mufid narrated in (Al-Muqni'ah), saying: It has been reported from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he said: The ghusl for Friday and Eid Al-Fitr is a recommended practice whether traveling or at home.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: .دبع وأ رح نم ىثنأو ركذ لك لىع ةعمجلا لسغ بجي :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) حلاصلا دبعلا نعو
englishText: And from Al-Abd Al-Salih (peace be upon him) that he said: The Friday ghusl is obligatory upon every male and female, whether free or enslaved.

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: .لستغيلف ةعمجلا ىلإ ءاج نم :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا رمع نبا نع
englishText: Ibn Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever comes to the Friday prayer should perform ghusl (ritual bath).

chapter: Recommendation Of Friday Ghusl While Traveling And At Home, For Females And Males, Slaves And Free People, And The Recommendation Not Being Emphasized For Women While Traveling
arabicText: يبأ ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع ،رصن يبأ نب دمحم نب دمحأ نع :(دانسلإا برق) يف رفعج نب الله دبع .حاورلا دنع (ةعمجلل) لستغي ،رفسلا يف اضيأ ءاسنلل ةعمجلا موي لسغ بابحتسا لىعو هيلع لدي ام يتيأو ،كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ .رفسلا يف نهل بابحتسلاا دكتأ يفن لىع لومحم انه امف
