englishText: Abdullah bin Ja'far in (Qurb al-Isnad): From Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr, from al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: My father used to perform ghusl (for Friday) at the time of going (to the mosque). Abdullah bin Ja'far in (Qurb al-Isnad): From Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr, from al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: My father used to perform ghusl (for Friday) at the time of going (to the mosque). I (Hurr Amili) say: What has preceded indicates that, and what will come indicates it and the recommendation of the ghusl of Friday for women as well while traveling. So what is here is interpreted as negating the emphasis of recommendation for them while traveling.

chapter: Dislike Of Abandoning The Friday Ghusl
arabicText: لسغلاو - لقا نأ ىلإ - ةنس هنفإ ،ةعمجلا موي لسغلا عدت لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا :لقا ةرارز نع .ةعمجلا موي بجاو
englishText: From Zurarah who said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Do not abandon the ghusl on Friday, for it is a sunnah - and then he said - and ghusl is obligatory on Friday.

chapter: Dislike Of Abandoning The Friday Ghusl
arabicText: كراتلا نم زجعأ تنلا اللهو :لوقي لجرلا خبوي نأ دارأ اذإ (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ ناك :لقا غبصلأا نع .ىرخلأا ةعمجلا ىلإ رهط يف لازي لا هنفإ ،ةعمجلا موي لسغلا
englishText: From Al-Asbagh who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) would say when he wanted to rebuke a man: By Allah, you are more incapable than one who abandons ghusl on Friday, for he remains in a state of purity until the next Friday.

chapter: Dislike Of Abandoning The Friday Ghusl
arabicText: ناك نإ :لقا ؟كلذ ريغ وأ ايسنا ةعمجلا لسغ عدي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس :لقا هيبأ نع .دوعي لاو الله رفغتسيلف لعف وه نإو يلإ بحأ لسغلفا ادمعتم ناك نإو ،هتلاص تمت دقف ايسنا
englishText: From his father who said: I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a man who abandons Friday ghusl out of forgetfulness or otherwise? He said: If he forgot, then his prayer is complete, and if he did it intentionally, then performing ghusl is more beloved to me, and if he has done so (abandoned it), he should seek Allah's forgiveness and not repeat it.

chapter: One Who Misses The Friday Ghusl Until After Prayer Should Preferably Perform Ghusl And Repeat The Prayer While Time Remains
arabicText: ؟لىص ىتح ةعمجلا موي لسغلا ىسني لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا يطبااسلا رامع نع .هتلاص تزاج دقف تقولا ىضم نإو ،ةلاصلا ديعيو لستغي نأ هيلعف تقو يف ناك نإ :لقا
englishText: From Ammar al-Sabati who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who forgets the ghusl on Friday until after he has prayed? He said: If there is still time, he should perform ghusl and repeat the prayer, and if the time has passed, his prayer is valid.

chapter: One Who Misses The Friday Ghusl Until After Prayer Should Preferably Perform Ghusl And Repeat The Prayer While Time Remains
arabicText: :لاقف ؟ادمعتم وأ ايسنا ةعمجلا موي لسغ عدي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لأس هنأ ،ريصب يبأ نع .دعي لاو الله رفغتسيلف ادمعتم ناك نإو ،هتلاص تمت دقف ايسنا ناك اذإ
englishText: From Abu Basir, that he asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who omits the Friday ghusl out of forgetfulness or deliberately? He said: If he forgot, his prayer is complete, and if it was deliberate, he should seek Allah's forgiveness and not repeat it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ghusl On Thursday For One Who Fears The Scarcity Of Water On Friday
arabicText: ،دغل مويلا اولستغفا ءام هيف سيل لازنم ادغ نوتتأ مكنإ :هباحصلأ لقا :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةعمجلل سيمخلا موي انلستغفا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said to his companions: Indeed, you will come tomorrow to a place where there is no water, so perform ghusl today for tomorrow. So we performed ghusl on Thursday for Friday.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ghusl On Thursday For One Who Fears The Scarcity Of Water On Friday
arabicText: ،دادغب ديرن نحنو ةيدابلبا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ عم انك :اتلقا رفعج نب ىسوم ةنبا دمحأ مأو همأ نع سيمخلا موي انلستغفا ،(٢) ليلق ادغ اهب ءاملا نفإ ،ةعمجلا موي دغل مويلا لاستغا :سيمخلا موي انل لاقف .ةعمجلا مويل
englishText: From his mother and Ahmad's mother the daughter of Musa bin Ja'far, they both said: We were with Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) in the desert while we were heading to Baghdad. He said to us on Thursday: Perform ghusl today for tomorrow, Friday, because water will be scarce there tomorrow. So we performed ghusl on Thursday for Friday.

chapter: Recommendation For One Who Missed The Ghusl On Friday Before Noon To Make It Up In The Remainder Of The Day Or On Saturday
arabicText: نم دعيلف يسن نمو ،رضحلاو رفسلا يف ةعمجلا موي لسغلا نم دب لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .دغلا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Ghusl on Friday is necessary while traveling and at home, and whoever forgets should repeat it the next day.

chapter: Recommendation For One Who Missed The Ghusl On Friday Before Noon To Make It Up In The Remainder Of The Day Or On Saturday
arabicText: .ليلعلل ةصخر هيف يورو :ينيلكلا لقا
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: And a concession is narrated in it for the ill.

chapter: Recommendation For One Who Missed The Ghusl On Friday Before Noon To Make It Up In The Remainder Of The Day Or On Saturday
arabicText: ،راهنلا رخآ نم هيضقي :لقا ،راهنلا لوأ يف ةعمجلا موي لستغي لا لجرلا يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .تبسلا موي نم هضقيلف دجي مل نفإ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding a man who does not perform ghusl on Friday in the early part of the day, he said: He should make it up in the latter part of the day, and if he cannot find the means to do so, then he should make it up on Saturday.

chapter: Recommendation For One Who Missed The Ghusl On Friday Before Noon To Make It Up In The Remainder Of The Day Or On Saturday
arabicText: نيبو هنيب ام لستغي :لقا ؟ةعمجلا موي لسغلا هتفا لجر نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .تبسلا موي لستغا هتفا نفإ ،ليللا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a man who missed performing ghusl (ritual bath) on Friday? He replied: He should perform ghusl anytime between then and nightfall, and if he misses that, he should perform ghusl on Saturday.

chapter: Recommendation For One Who Missed The Ghusl On Friday Before Noon To Make It Up In The Remainder Of The Day Or On Saturday
arabicText: .لا :لقا ؟ةعمجلا لسغ يضقي له ،لجرلا يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ملعأ اللهو ،ةيقتلا وأ ،تبسلا موي دعب ام لىع وأ ،بابحتسلاا نود بوجولا يفن لىع لومحم اذه :لوقأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding the man, should he make up the ghusl of Friday? He said: No. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted as negating obligation, not recommendation, or as referring to what is after Saturday, or as taqiyyah. And Allah knows best.

chapter: Time For Friday Ghusl Being From Dawn Until Noon, And That Closer To Noon Is Better, And If One Sleeps Afterwards Need Not Repeat
arabicText: .معن :لاقف ؟ةعمجلل رجفلا دعب تلستغا اذإ يزجيأ :هل انلق :لاقا ليضفلاو ةرارز نع
englishText: From Zurarah and Al-Fadil who said: We asked him: Is it sufficient if one performs ghusl after dawn for Friday? He said: Yes.

chapter: Time For Friday Ghusl Being From Dawn Until Noon, And That Closer To Noon Is Better, And If One Sleeps Afterwards Need Not Repeat
arabicText: نأ ىلإ - ناضمر رهش نم لستغأ يلايللا يأ يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا هيبأ نع ،ريكب نبا نع دعب تلستغا اذإ ،ةعمجلا موي لسغ لثم وه :لقا ؟لسغلا دعب منا نفإ :تلق ،ليللا لوأ لسغلاو - لقا .كأزجأ رجفلا
englishText: From Ibn Bukayr, from his father who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) in which nights should I perform ghusl in Ramadan- until he said- and the ghusl is at the beginning of the night. I said: What if one sleeps after the ghusl? He said: It is like the Friday ghusl; if you perform ghusl after dawn it suffices you.

chapter: Time For Friday Ghusl Being From Dawn Until Noon, And That Closer To Noon Is Better, And If One Sleeps Afterwards Need Not Repeat
arabicText: .حاورلا دنع ةعمجلا موي لستغي يبأ ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: My father would perform ghusl on Friday at the time of going [to prayer].

chapter: Time For Friday Ghusl Being From Dawn Until Noon, And That Closer To Noon Is Better, And If One Sleeps Afterwards Need Not Repeat
arabicText: ،ليللا لوأ لسغلاو - لقا نأ ىلإ - ؟ناضمر يف لسغلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لأس هنأ ،ريكب نبا نع !؟كافك رجفلا دعب تلستغا اذإ ،ةعمجلا موي لسغ لثم وه سيلأ :لاقف :لقا ؟لسغلا دعب منا نفإ :تلق
englishText: From Ibn Bukayr, that he asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about ghusl in Ramadan?- until he said- and the ghusl is at the beginning of the night. I said: What if one sleeps after the ghusl? He said: Isn't it like the Friday ghusl, if you perform ghusl after dawn it suffices you?!

chapter: Recommendation Of Reciting The Prescribed Supplication During The Friday Bath
arabicText: :لاقف ةعمجلا موي لستغا نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،دمحم لآو دمحم لىع لص مهللا ،هلوسرو هدبع ادمحم نأو ،هل كيرش لا هدحو الله لاإ هلإ لا نأ دهشأ " " نيرهطتملا نم ينلعجاو ،نيباوتلا نم ينلعجاو .ةعمجلا ىلإ ةعمجلا نم هل ارهط ناك
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever takes a bath on Friday and says: "I bear witness that there is no god except Allah alone with no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and make me among those who repent, and make me among those who purify themselves," then this will be a means of purification for him from one Friday to the next.

chapter: Time For Ghusl In The Month Of Ramadan Being From The Beginning Of The Night Until Its End, And If One Sleeps There Is No Need To Repeat
arabicText: ىلإ - ناضمر رهش نم لايل ثلاث يف لستغت :لقا هنأ ،(ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ملسم نب دمحم نع .هرخآ ىلإ يزجي وهو ليللا لوأ نم لسغلاو - لقا نأ
englishText: From Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of them (peace be upon them both), he said: You perform ghusl on three nights of Ramadan- until he said- and the ghusl is from the beginning of the night and it suffices until its end.

chapter: Time For Ghusl In The Month Of Ramadan Being From The Beginning Of The Night Until Its End, And If One Sleeps There Is No Need To Repeat
arabicText: .رطفيو ليصي مث ،هليبق سمشلا بوجو دنع ناضمر رهش يف لسغلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: The ghusl in the month of Ramadan is at sunset just before it, then one prays and breaks the fast.

chapter: Time For Ghusl In The Month Of Ramadan Being From The Beginning Of The Night Until Its End, And If One Sleeps There Is No Need To Repeat
arabicText: ىتم ،بلطي ام اهيف بلطي يتلا ةليللا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا مساقلا نب صيع نع .هرخآو هلوأ يف موقت :لاقف ؟مايقلا نع هتلأسو .هرخآ نم موقت ثيح تئش نإو ،ليللا لوأ نم :لاقف ؟لسغلا
englishText: From Eis ibn al-Qasim who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the night in which what is sought is sought, when is the ghusl? He said: From the beginning of the night, and if you wish at the time you rise at its end. And I asked him about the standing (in prayer)? He said: You stand at its beginning and its end.

chapter: Recommended Baths During The Month Of Ramadan
arabicText: ىلإ هدانسإب (ناضمر رهش لمع) باتك يف ةرق يبأ نبا ىور :لقا (لابقلاا) باتك يف سواط نب ىسوم نب ليع .هنم فصنلا ةليلو ،ناضمر رهش نم ةليل لوأ يف لسغلا بحتسي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ
englishText: Ali bin Musa bin Tawus in the book (Al-Iqbal) said: Ibn Abi Qurrah narrated in the book (Amal Shahr Ramadan) with his chain to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: It is recommended to take a ghusl on the first night of Ramadan, and the night of its middle.

chapter: Recommended Baths During The Month Of Ramadan
arabicText: .ليللا لوأ لسغلا نأ يور دقو :لقا
englishText: He said: And it has been narrated that the ghusl should be at the beginning of the night.

chapter: Recommended Baths During The Month Of Ramadan
arabicText: .نيرهاطلا ةمئلأا نع كلذ انيورو ،نيءاشعلا نيب يورو
englishText: And it was narrated between the two Ishas (between Salat al-Maghrib and Salat al Isha), and we narrated that from the pure Imams.

chapter: Recommended Baths During The Month Of Ramadan
arabicText: نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع ،يمقلا دمحأ نب رفعج دمحم يبأ فيلتأ هنأ دقتعأ باتك يف تيأرو :لقا رهش ىلإ رهط ءاملا نم افك نيثلاث هسأر لىع بصيو راج رهن يف ناضمر رهش نم ةليل لوأ يف لستغا .لبقا نم ناضمر
englishText: He said: And I saw in a book which I believe is authored by Abu Muhammad Ja'far bin Ahmad Al-Qummi, from Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever performs a ghsul on the first night of Ramadan in flowing water and pours thirty handfuls of water on his head will remain pure until the next Ramadan.

chapter: Recommended Baths During The Month Of Ramadan
arabicText: لوأ لستغيلف ةكحلا هب نوكت لا نأ بحأ نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع هيلإ راشملا باتكلا كلذ نمو :لقا .لبقا نم ناضم رهش ىلإ ةكح هب نوكت لا ،هنم ةليل لوأ لستغا نم هنفإ ناضمر رهش نم ةليل
englishText: He said: And from that same referenced book from Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him): Whoever wishes not to have itching should perform ghusl on the first night of Ramadan, for whoever bathes on its first night will not have itching until the next Ramadan.

chapter: Recommended Baths During The Month Of Ramadan
arabicText: يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع هدانسإب يرهوجلا شايع نب دمحم نب دمحلأ (لاسغلأا) باتك نمو :لقا نم زربو رزيملا دشو رمش ناضمر رهش نم رشعلا لخد اذإ ناك (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نأ - ثيدح .نيءاشعلا نيب هنم ةليل لك لستغي ناكو ،هلك ليللا ىيحأو ،فكتعاو هتيب
englishText: He said: And from the book (al-Aghsal) of Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Ayyash al Jawhari with his chain from Ali (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- that when the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), entered the last ten days of the month of Ramadan, he would roll up his sleeves, tighten his waist wrapper, leave his house, and perform i'tikaf (seclusion in the mosque). He would stay up all night, and would perform ghusl every night between the two Ishas (i.e. between Salat al-Maghrib and Salat al-Isha).

chapter: Recommended Baths During The Month Of Ramadan
arabicText: نع ،ليفونلا نع ،هيبأ نع ،ميهاربإ نب ليع نع ،الله دبع نب دعس ىلإ نادانسإب انيورو :سواط نبا لقا نم موي لوأ لستغا نم :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) ليع نع ،هئباآ نع ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ينوكسلا .ناضمر رهش نم موي لوأ ةنس لك لوأ نإو ،ةنسلا ءاود ناك ةفرغ نيثلاث هسأر لىع بصو راج ءام يف ةنسلا
englishText: Ibn Tawus said: And we narrated with our chain to Sa'd bin Abdullah, from Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them) who said: Whoever performs ghusl on the first day of the year in flowing water and pours thirty scoops on his head, it will be a cure for the year, and indeed the first of every year is the first day of Ramadan.

chapter: Recommended Baths During The Month Of Ramadan
arabicText: نمأ درو ءام نم فكب ههجو برض نم نأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ناميلس نب رفعج باتك نمو :لقا ام اوعدت لاف ،ماسربلا نم ةنسلا كلت نمأ درو ءام نم هسأر لىع عضو نمو ،رقفلاو ةلذملا نم مويلا كلذ .هب مكيصون
englishText: From the book of Ja'far ibn Sulayman, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), that From the book of Ja'far ibn Sulayman, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), that whoever splashes his face with a handful of rose water will be safe from humiliation and poverty that day, and whoever puts rose water on his head will be safe from meningitis that year, so do not abandon what we advise you with.

chapter: Recommended Baths During The Month Of Ramadan
arabicText: ةليل لسغلا بحتسي هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع ةياور يف (ةعنقملا) يف ديفملا خيشلا نع انيورو :لقا .ناضمر رهش نم فصنلا
englishText: And we narrated from Shaykh al-Mufid in (al-Muqni'ah) in a narration from al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), that it is recommended to perform ghusl on the middle night of Ramadan.

chapter: Recommended Baths During The Month Of Ramadan
arabicText: يف لستغي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،هباحصأ ضعب نع .ةليل لك يف رخاولأا رشعلا يف ناضمر رهش
englishText: From some of his companions, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would perform ghusl every night during the last ten days of Ramadan.

chapter: Recommended Baths During The Month Of Ramadan
arabicText: ىدحإ لسغ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ ىلإ هدانسإب ،ديعس نب نيسحلا ىلإ نادانسإب انيور دقو لقا .ةنس ناضمر رهش نم نيرشعو
englishText: He said: And we have narrated through our chain to al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, through his chain to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Performing ghusl on the twenty-first night of Ramadan is sunnah.

chapter: Recommended Baths During The Month Of Ramadan
arabicText: نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،دشار نب ىسيع ىلإ هدانسإب دحاولا دبع نب ليع ىورو :لقا ،نيرشعو ثلاثو ،نيرشعو ىدحإو ،ةرشع عست ةليل يف لستغي يبأ ناك :لاقف ؟ناضمر رهش يف لسغلا .نيرشعو سمخو
englishText: And Ali ibn Abdul Wahid narrated through his chain to Isa ibn Rashid, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), saying: I asked him about ghusl in Ramadan? He said: My father would perform ghusl on the nineteenth, twenty-first, twenty-third, and twenty-fifth nights.

chapter: Recommended Baths During The Month Of Ramadan
arabicText: ،ةرشع عست ةليل لستغا :لاقف ؟ناضمر رهش يف لسغلا نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .نيرشعو عستو ،نيرشعو عبسو ،نيرشعو ثلاثو ،نيرشعو ىدحإو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said: I asked him about ghusl in Ramadan? He said: Perform ghusl on the nineteenth, twenty-first, twenty-third, twenty-seventh, and twenty-ninth nights.

chapter: Recommended Baths During The Month Of Ramadan
arabicText: .رخاولأا رشعلا نم ةليل لك يف لستغي ناك هنأ ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نعو :لقا
englishText: And from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), that he would perform ghusl every night of the last ten days.

chapter: Recommended Baths During The Month Of Ramadan
arabicText: .ةرشع عبس ةليل يف لستغي هنأ :يور دقو :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم
englishText: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn said: And it has been narrated: that one should perform ghusl on the seventeenth night.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl On The Two Eid Nights And Days
arabicText: نم لىع لزنت ةرفغملا نإ :نولوقي سانلا نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا دشار نب نسحلا هدج نع ،ديعلا ةليل كلذو ،هغارف دنع هترجأ ىطعي امنإ راجيراقلا نإ نسح يا :لاقف ؟ردقلا ةليل ناضمر رهش ماص .لستغفا سمشلا تبرغ اذإ :لاقف ؟اهيف لمعن نأ انل يغبني امف ،كادف تلعج :تلق .انخياشم ضعب هلقا ،ريجلأاو لماعلا :هانعم ،برعم يسرفا راجيراقلا :لوقأ
englishText: From his grandfather Al-Hasan bin Rashid who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): People say that forgiveness descends upon those who fasted Ramadan on Laylat al-Qadr? He said: O Hasan, indeed the worker is only given his wages upon completion of his work, and that is on the night of Eid. I said: May I be sacrificed for you, what should we do during it? He said: When the sun sets, perform ghusl. I (Hurr Amili) say: Qarij'ar is a Persianized Arabic word, meaning: the worker and the hired person, as stated by some of our scholars.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl On The Two Eid Nights And Days
arabicText: ةليل اهنأ ملع اذإ ةليل نم بورغلا لبق لستغي هنأ يور :لقا (لابقلاا) باتك يف سواط نب ىسوم نب ليع .ديعلا
englishText: Ali bin Musa bin Tawus in the book (Al-Iqbal) said: It is narrated that one should perform ghusl before sunset on the night when it is known that it is the night of Eid.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl On The Two Eid Nights And Days
arabicText: .ةنس رطفلا موي لسغلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Ghusl on the day of Fitr is sunnah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl On The Two Eid Nights And Days
arabicText: تدصق رهن نكي مل نفإ ،رهن نم لستغت نأ رطفلا موي ديعلا ةلاص :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .كدهجب رتتستو ،طئاح تحن وأ ،للاظلا تحت كلسغ نكيلو ،عشختب ءاملا ءافيتسا كسفنب
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Prayer of Eid on the day of Fitr is that you perform ghusl from a river, if there is no river then aim to fulfill the water requirement with humility, and let your ghusl be under the shade, or beside a wall, and cover yourself to your best ability.

chapter: Recommendation Of Repeating The Prayer After Ghusl For One Who Forgot The Ghusl Of The Two Eids And Remembered During The Time Specifically, And That Not Being Obligatory
arabicText: :لقا ؟رطفلاو حىضلأاو ةعمجلا يف لسغلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس :لقا نيطقي نب ليع نع .ةضيرفب سيلو ،ةنس
englishText: From Ali Ibn Yaqtin who said: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about performing ghusl (ritual bath) for Friday, Eid Al-Adha, and Eid Al-Fitr? He said: It is Sunnah (recommended), not obligatory.

chapter: Recommendation Of Repeating The Prayer After Ghusl For One Who Forgot The Ghusl Of The Two Eids And Remembered During The Time Specifically, And That Not Being Obligatory
arabicText: .اهكرت بحأ لا ةنس حىضلأا موي لسغو رطفلا موي لسغ :لقا ثيدح يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) in a hadith, he said: The ghusl on the day of Fitr and the ghusl on the day of Adha are sunnah (recommended traditions) that I do not like to abandon.

chapter: Recommendation Of Repeating The Prayer After Ghusl For One Who Forgot The Ghusl Of The Two Eids And Remembered During The Time Specifically, And That Not Being Obligatory
arabicText: نإ :لقا ؟لىصي ىتح ديعلا موي لستغي نأ ىسني لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا رامع نع .هتلاص تزاج دقف تقولا ىضم نإو ،ةلاصلا ديعيو لستغي نأ هيلعف تقو يف ناك
englishText: From Ammar who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who forgets to perform ghusl (ritual bath) on the day of Eid until after he has prayed? He replied: If there is still time remaining, he must perform ghusl and repeat the prayer, but if the time has passed, then his prayer is valid.

chapter: Recommendation Of Repeating The Prayer After Ghusl For One Who Forgot The Ghusl Of The Two Eids And Remembered During The Time Specifically, And That Not Being Obligatory
arabicText: .ىنمب لاإ بجاو :لاقف ؟حىضلأا لسغ نع هتلأس :لقا ديلولا نب مساقلا نع
englishText: Al-Qasim ibn Al-Walid said: I asked him about taking a ghusl (ritual bath) for Eid Al Adha? He replied: It is obligatory except in Mina.

chapter: Recommendation Of Repeating The Prayer After Ghusl For One Who Forgot The Ghusl Of The Two Eids And Remembered During The Time Specifically, And That Not Being Obligatory
arabicText: .ةنس نيديعلا لسغ نأ يورو :لقا .كلذ ريغو ةعمجلا لسغ ثيداحأ يف كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقتو .دكؤملا بابحتسلاا ىنعمب انه بوجولا :لوقأ
englishText: It is narrated that performing ghusl (ritual bath) on the two Eids is Sunnah. I (Hurr Amili) say: Obligation here means strong recommendation. And what has preceded indicates that in the hadiths of the Friday ghusl and other than that.

chapter: Time For The Two Eid Baths Being After Dawn
arabicText: نب ىسوم هيخأ نع ،رفعج نب ليع هدج نع ،نسحلا نب الله دبع نع :(دانسلإا برق) يف رفعج نب الله دبع لسغ نم كلذ هيزجي له ؟رجفلا عولط لبق لستغي نأ هيزجي له :هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج .هأزجأ رجفلا عولط دعب لستغا نإو ،هزجي مل رجفلا لبق حىضلأاو رطفلا موي لستغا نإ :لقا ؟نيديعلا
englishText: Abdullah ibn Ja'far in (Qurb al-Isnad): from Abdullah ibn al-Hasan, from his grandfather Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him: Is it sufficient for one to perform ghusl before dawn? Would that suffice for the ghusl of the two Eids? He said: If one performs ghusl on the day of Fitr and Adha before dawn, it is not sufficient, but if one performs ghusl after dawn breaks, it is sufficient.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ghusl For Repentance And Its Prayer
arabicText: افينك لخدأ ينإ ،يمأو تنأ يببأ :لجر هل لاقف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ دنع تنك :لقا دياز نب ةدعسم نع هيلع) لاقف ،نهل ىنم اعامتسا سولجلا تلطأ امبرف دوعلبا نبرضيو نينغتي راوج مهدنعو ناريج يلو ،لعفت لا :(ملاسلا الله تعمس امأ ،تنأ لله :(ملاسلا هيلع) لاقف ،ينذبأ هعمسأ عامس وه امنإ ،نهيتآ ام اللهو :لجرلا لاقف ةيلآا هذهب عمسأ مل ينأكل ،اللهو لىب :لاقف ؟(لاوؤسم هنع ناك كئلوأ لك داؤفلاو رصبلاو عمسلا نإ) :لوقي ،الله رفغتسأ ينإو ،الله ءاش نإ دوعأ لا ينإ مرجلا ،يمجع لاو يبرع نم الله باتك نم .كلذ لىع تم ول كلاح ءوسأ ناك ام ،ميظع رمأ لىع اميقم تنك كنفإ ،كل ادب ام لصو لستغفا مق :هل لاقف .لاهأ لكل نفإ ،هلهلأ هعد حيبقلاو ،حيبق لك لاإ هركي لا هنفإ ،هركي ام لك نم ةبوتلا هلسو ،الله دمحأ
englishText: Masada bin Ziyd narrated: I was with Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) when a man said to him: May my father and mother be sacrificed for you, I enter a bathroom and I have neighbors who have singing girls who play the lute, and sometimes I prolong my stay to listen to them. He (peace be upon him) said: Do not do that. The man said: By Allah, I do not go to them, it is just listening that I hear with my ears. So he (peace be upon him) said: You belong to Allah! Have you not heard Allah saying: "Indeed the hearing and the sight and the heart, each of these will be questioned?" [Quran, 17:36] He replied: Yes, by Allah, it is as if I had never heard this verse from Allah's Book from any Arab or non-Arab. Indeed, I shall not return to it if Allah wills, and I seek Allah's forgiveness. He (peace be upon him) said to him: Rise, perform ghusl and pray whatever you wish, for you were persisting in a grave matter. How terrible would your state have been if you had died in that condition! Praise Allah and ask Him for repentance from everything He dislikes, for He only dislikes what is ugly, and leave what is ugly for its people, for everything has its people.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ghusl For One Who Kills A Gecko, Or Intentionally Looks At A Crucified Person
arabicText: ،سجر وه :لاقف ؟غزولا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ةحلط نب الله دبع نع ،مارك نع ،اشولا نع .لستغفا هتلتق اذفإ ،هلك خسم وهو
englishText: From Al-Washa, from Karram, from Abdullah bin Talha who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the gecko (a type of lizard)? He said: It is filth, and it is completely transformed, so when you kill it, perform Ghusl.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ghusl For One Who Kills A Gecko, Or Intentionally Looks At A Crucified Person
arabicText: ةلعلا نإ :انخياشم ضعب :لقاو :لقا .لسغلا هيلعف اغزو لتق نم نأ يور :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .اهنم لستغيف هبونذ نع جرخي هنأ كلذ يف
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: It is narrated that whoever kills a gecko should perform Ghusl. He said: And some of our scholars said: The reason for that is that he emerges from his sins, so he performs Ghusl from them.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ghusl For One Who Kills A Gecko, Or Intentionally Looks At A Crucified Person
arabicText: .ةبوقع لسغلا هيلع بجو هيلإ رظنف بولصم ىلإ دصق نم نأ يورو :لقا
englishText: He said: And it is narrated that whoever intentionally goes to look at a crucified person must perform Ghusl as a punishment.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl For Fulfilling Needs
arabicText: ،اءاعد تعرتخا ينإ ،كادف تلعج :تلقف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ لىع تلخد :لقا ريصقلا ميحرلا دبع نع امهيدهت نيتعكر لصو ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىلإ عزففا رمأ كب لزن اذإ ،كعارتخا نم ينعد :لقا .نيتعكر ليصتو لستغت :لقا ؟عنصأ فيك :تلق ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىلإ
englishText: From Abdul Rahim Al-Qaseer who said: I entered upon Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) and said: May I be sacrificed for you, I have invented a supplication. He said: Leave me from your invention. When a matter befalls you, then seek refuge with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and pray two rak'ahs which you dedicate to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). I said: How should I do it? He said: Perform ghusl (ritual bath) and pray two rak'ahs.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl For Fulfilling Needs
arabicText: كل تناك اذإ :لاقف ،جئاوحلا ءاضقل ءاعد ينملع :(ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلل تلق :لقا لتاقم نع ،ليود نب ليع نع .كبايث فظنأ سبلاو لستغفا ةمهم الله ىلإ ةجاح
englishText: From Ali bin Duwail, from Muqatil who said: I said to Al-Ridha (peace be upon him): Teach me a supplication for fulfilling needs. He said: When you have an important need from Allah, perform ghusl and wear your cleanest clothes.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl For Istikharah (Seeking Guidance)
arabicText: نيتس لىع هموي يف قدصتي :لقا ،هبر نم بلاطلا هبلطي رملاا يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع ليللا ثلث يف لستغفا ليللا ناك اذفإ ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا عاصب عاص نيكسم لك لىع ،انيكسم .ءاعدلا ركذو ،لوقي ةرم ةئام الله راختسا ةيناثلا ةدجسلا نم هسأر عفر اذفإ - :لقا نأ ىلإ - يقابلا
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding a matter that a seeker asks from his Lord, he said: He gives sadaqah on that day to sixty poor people, each poor person receiving one Sa' according to the Prophet's Sa' (peace be upon him and his family). Then when it is night, he performs ghusl in the last third of the night- until he said- when he raises his head from the second prostration, he seeks Allah's guidance (Istikharah) one hundred times saying, and he mentioned the supplication.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl For Istikharah (Seeking Guidance)
arabicText: .بحتسي ةراختسلاا لسغو :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ةعامس ثيدح قبس دقو
englishText: And previously passed the hadith of Sama'ah from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: And the ghusl for Istikharah is recommended.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ghusl At The Beginning, Middle And End Of Rajab
arabicText: هنأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نع تادابعلا بتك يف نادجو :لقا (لابقلاا) باتك يف سواط نب ىسوم نب ليع .همأ هتدلو مويك هبونذ نم جرخ هرخآو هطسوأو هلوأ يف لستغفا بجر رهش كردأ نم :لقا
englishText: Ali ibn Musa ibn Tawus in the book (Al-Iqbal) said: We found in the books of worship from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) that he said: Whoever reaches the month of Rajab and performs ghusl in its beginning, middle and end, will be cleansed of his sins as the day his mother gave birth to him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ghusl On The Night Of Mid Sha'ban
arabicText: مكبر نم فيفخت كلذ ،هنم فصنلا ةليل اولستغاو نابعش اوموص :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةمحرو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Fast during Shaban and perform ghusl on its middle night, that is an alleviation and mercy from your Lord.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl On The Day Of Nowruz
arabicText: .كبايث فظنأ سبلاو لستغفا زورينلا موي ناك اذإ :لقا ،زورينلا مويلا يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع
englishText: From al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), regarding the day of Nowruz, he said: When it is the day of Nowruz, perform ghusl and wear your cleanest clothes.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl For One Who Deliberately Misses The Eclipse Prayer Or When The Entire Disc Is Eclipsed
arabicText: ضقيلو دغ نم لستغيلف لصي ملو لجرلا ظقيتسفا رمقلا فشكنا اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لسغ ريغب ءاضقلا لاإ هيلع سيلف رمقلا فاسكنبا ملعي ملو ظقيتسي مل نإو ،ةلاصلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: If the moon is eclipsed and a man wakes up but does not pray, he should perform ghusl the next day and make up the prayer. However, if he does not wake up and does not know about the lunar eclipse, he only needs to make up the prayer without performing ghusl.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl For Ihram
arabicText: تيقاوملا هذه نم تقولا ىلإ وأ قارعلا لبق نم قيقعلا ىلإ تيهتنا اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .كيبوث سبلاو لستغاو - لقا نأ ىلإ - كيطبإ فتنفا مارحلاا ديرت تنأو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When you reach al-Aqiq from the direction of Iraq or at the time from these designated places and you want to enter ihram, pluck your armpits- until he said- and perform ghusl and wear your two garments.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl For The Newborn
arabicText: نفإ ،رمغلا نم مكنايبص اولسغا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) ليع نع ،هئباآ نع ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .نابتاكلا هب ىذأتيو ،هدقار يف يبصلا عزفيف رمغلا مشي ناطيشلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), from his fathers, from Ali (peace be upon them) who said: Wash your children from al-ghamr (post-birth discharge), for indeed Satan smells al-ghamr and the child gets frightened in his sleep, and the two recording angels are disturbed by it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl For The Newborn
arabicText: .بجاو دولوملا لسغ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ةعامس ثيدح يف مدقت دق
englishText: It has already preceded in the hadith of Sama'ah from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Ghusl for the newborn is obligatory.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Ghusl On The Day Of Ghadir Half An Hour Before Noon
arabicText: مايص لدعي مخ ريدغ موي مايص :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا يدبعلا نيسحلا نب ليع نع فصن رادقم لوزت نأ لبق نم سمشلا لاوز دنع لستغي نيتعكر هيف لىص نمو - لقا نأ ىلإ - ايندلا رمع .ةرمع فلأ ةئامو ،ةجح فلأ ةئام الله دنع تلدع - لقا نأ ىلإ - ةعاس
englishText: From Ali bin Al-Husayn Al-Abdi who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: Fasting on the day of Ghadir Khum equals fasting the age of the world until he said- and whoever prays two rak'ahs in it, performing ghusl at the time of noon before it by half an hour- until he said- it equals to Allah one hundred thousand Hajj and one hundred thousand Umrah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Ghusl For Visitation
arabicText: .لستغاو تارفلا تفأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا ربق تيتأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When you come to the grave of al Husayn (peace be upon him), go to the Euphrates and perform ghusl.

chapter: Recommendation For A Woman To Perform Ghusl (To Wash Off) Perfume Worn For Other Than Her Husband, Similar To The Ghusl From Janabah
arabicText: قح يف طخاس اهيلع اهجوزو تتبا ةأرما اميأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا :لقا بلاجلا رمع نب دعس نع نم لستغت ىتح ةلاص اهنم لبقت مل اهجوز ريغل تبيطت ةأرما اميأو ،اهنع ىضري ىتح ةلاص اهنم لبقتي مل .اهتبانج نم اهلسغك اهبيط
englishText: From Sa'd bin Umar Al-Jallab who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Any woman who spends the night while her husband is angry with her rightfully, her prayer will not be accepted until he becomes pleased with her, and any woman who wears perfume for other than her husband, her prayer will not be accepted until she performs ghusl to wash off her perfume similar to the ghusl from janabah.

chapter: Overlapping Of Multiple Ghusl And The Sufficiency Of One Ghusl For All, And The Sufficiency Of Any Ghusl In Place Of Wudu
arabicText: ةفرعو ةعمجلاو ةبانجلل كلذ كلسغ كأزجأ رجفلا عولط دعب تلستغا اذإ :لقا ،ةرارز ثيدح يف مدقت دق ةأرملا كلذكو :لقا مث .دحاو لسغ اهنع كأزجأ قوقح كيلع تعمتجا اذفإ ،ةريازلاو حبذلاو قلحلاو رحنلاو .اهديعو اهضيح نم اهلسغو اهتعمجو اهمارحإو اهتبانجل دحاو لسغ اهيزجي
englishText: In the previous hadith of Zurarah, he said: If you perform ghusl after the break of dawn, that single ghusl would suffice you for janabah (sexual impurity), Friday prayer, Arafah, the Day of Sacrifice, head-shaving, animal sacrifice, and ziyarah (visitation of the graves of Ahl al-Bayt). When multiple obligations combine upon you, a single ghusl suffices for all of them. Then he said: Similarly for a woman, one ghusl suffices for her janabah, ihram, Friday prayer, menstruation, and Eid. Section 6 Tayammum (Dry Ablution)

chapter: Obligation Of Searching For Water When Possible - One Bow shot In Rough Terrain And Two Bow-shots In Plain Land
arabicText: نأ فاخ اذفإ ،تقولا يف ماد ام بلطيلف ءاملا رفاسملا دجي مل اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ةرارز نع .لصيلو مميتيلف تقولا هتوفي
englishText: From Zurarah, from one of them (peace be upon them both), who said: When a traveler cannot find water, he should search for it as long as there is time. If he fears the time (for prayer) will elapse, he should perform tayammum and pray.

chapter: Obligation Of Searching For Water When Possible - One Bow shot In Rough Terrain And Two Bow-shots In Plain Land
arabicText: ةنوزحلا تناك نإ رفسلا يف ءاملا بلطي :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا مهيلع) ليع نع ،هيبأ نع ،دمحم نب رفعج نع .كلذ نم رثكأ بلطي لا ،نيتولغف ةلوهس تناك نإو ةولغف
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his father, from Ali (peace be upon them) that he said: Water should be searched for during travel- if it is rough terrain then one bow shot, and if it is plain land then two bow-shots, not searching more than that.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Seeking Water When There Is Fear, Even For Property, And The Permissibility Of Tayammum Even When Water Is Known To Be In A Dangerous Location
arabicText: ،ءام يعم سيلو ةلاصلا رضحتف رفسلا يف نوكأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا يقرلا دواد نع ينفإ ،مميت نكلو ءاملا بلطت لا :لقا ؟لاامشو انيمي تقو يف ناأو ءاملا بلطفأأ ،انم بيرق ءاملا نإ :لاقيو .عبسلا كلكيأو لضتف كباحصأ نع فلختلا كيلع فاخأ
englishText: From Dawud al-Raqqi who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): "I am on a journey and prayer time comes, but I don't have water, and it is said that water is near us. Should I search for water, while I am within the time, to my right and left?" He said: "Do not search for water but perform tayammum, for I fear you might get separated from your companions, then get lost and be eaten by predatory animals."

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Seeking Water When There Is Fear, Even For Property, And The Permissibility Of Tayammum Even When Water Is Known To Be In A Dangerous Location
arabicText: نيمي نع ءاملاو ءام هعم نوكي لا لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ملاس نب بوقعي نع .عبس وأ صل هل ضرعيف هسفنب ررغي نأ هرمآ لا :لقا ؟كلذ وحن وأ نيتولغ هراسيو قيرطلا
englishText: From Yaqub bin Salim who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who has no water with him, while water is about two bow-shots away or so, to the right and left of the path? He said: "I do not order him to endanger himself, as he might encounter a thief or a predatory animal."

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Seeking Water When There Is Fear, Even For Property, And The Permissibility Of Tayammum Even When Water Is Known To Be In A Dangerous Location
arabicText: انيمي ءاملا بلطفأأ :يقرلا دواد هل لاقف - لقا نأ ىلإ - مميتأ :هل تلق :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ضمفا هدجت مل نإو أضوتف قيرطلا لىع هتدجو نإ ،رئب يف لاو لاامش لاو انيمي ءاملا بلطت لا :لاقف ؟لاامشو ام يتيأو ،لولأا بابلا يف مدقت املو ،اقباس هريغو يقرلا دواد هاور امل رطخلاو فوخلا لىع لومحم اذه :لوقأ .كلذ لىع لدي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I said to him: "Should I perform tayammum-" until he said- then Dawud al-Raqqi asked him: "Should I search for water right and left?" He said: "Do not search for water right or left or in a well. If you f ind it on the path then perform wudu, and if you don't find it then proceed." I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted as applying to situations of fear and danger, I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted as applying to situations of fear and danger, based on what Dawud al-Raqqi and others narrated previously, and what was presented in the first chapter, and what will come that indicates this.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum When Unable To Access Water, Such As In Cases Of Wells, Friday Prayer Crowds, And Arafat
arabicText: ؟ولد هعم سيلو ةيكرلبا رمي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لأس هنأ ،يبلحلا ليع نب الله ديبع نع .مميتيلف ضرلأا بر وه ءاملا بر نلا ،ةيكرلا لخدي نأ هيلع سيل :لقا
englishText: From Ubaydullah bin Ali Al-Halabi, that he asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who passes by a well but has no bucket? He said: He is not required to enter the well, because the Lord of water is the Lord of earth, so let him perform tayammum.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum When Unable To Access Water, Such As In Cases Of Wells, Friday Prayer Crowds, And Arafat
arabicText: مميتف هب فرغت ائيش لاو اولد دجت ملف بنج تنأو رئبلا تيتأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .مهءام موقلا لىع دسفت لاو رئبلا يف عقت لاو ،ديعصلا بر وه ءاملا بر نفإ ،ديعصلبا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If you come to a well while in a state of janabah (sexual impurity) and you find neither a bucket nor anything to draw water with, then perform tayammum with clean earth, for the Lord of water is the Lord of earth, and do not fall into the well nor spoil the people's water.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum When Unable To Access Water, Such As In Cases Of Wells, Friday Prayer Crowds, And Arafat
arabicText: موي ماحزلا طسو يف نوكي لجر نع لئس هنأ ،(ملاسلا امهيلع) ليع نع ،هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع ،ينوكسلا نع اذإ ديعيو مهعم ليصيو مميتي :لقا ؟سانلا ةرثك نم دجسملا نم جورخلا عيطتسي لا ةفرع موي وأ ةعمجلا .فرصنا
englishText: From Al-Sakuni, from Ja'far, from his father, from Ali (peace be upon them), that he was asked about a man who is in the middle of a crowd on Friday or the day of Arafat and cannot leave the mosque due to the large number of people? He said: He should perform tayammum and pray with them, and repeat the prayer when he leaves.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum When Unable To Access Water, Such As In Cases Of Wells, Friday Prayer Crowds, And Arafat
arabicText: ؟ولد هعم سيلو ةيكرلبا رمي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ءلاعلا يبأ نب نيسحلا نع .مميتيلف ،ضرلأا بر وه ءاملا بر نإ ،ةيكرلا لزني نأ هيلع سيل :لقا لىع ردقي مل اذإ بكارلا نأ لىعو كلذ لىع لدي ام يتيأو :لوقأ .بوقعي نب دمحم نع هدانسإب خيشلا هاورو .هتباد فرع نم مميتي فوخلل لوزنلا
englishText: From Al-Husayn bin Abi Al-A'la who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) From Al-Husayn bin Abi Al-A'la who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who passes by a well but has no bucket? He said: He is not required to descend into the well, for the Lord of water is the Lord of earth, so let him perform tayammum. And Al-Shaykh narrated it with his chain from Muhammad bin Ya'qub. I (Hurr Amili) say: And there will come what indicates this and that if a rider cannot dismount due to fear, he performs tayammum from his mount's mane.

chapter: Obligation Of Tayammum For One Who Has Impure Water Or Water Of Uncertain Purity
arabicText: ناإ هعم لجر نع لئس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع يطبااسلا رامع ثيدح ءاملا باوبأ يف مدقت دق .مميتيو اعيمج امهقيرهي :لقا ؟امهريغ ءام لىع ردقي سيلو ،وه امهيأ يردي لا رذق امهدحأ يف عقو ،نآ
englishText: Previously mentioned in the chapters of water is the hadith of Ammar al-Sabati from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said: He was asked about a man who has two vessels, and impurity fell into one of them but he does not know which one it is, and he does not have access to any other water? He said: He should pour out both of them and perform tayammum.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum When Unable To Use Water Due To Illness, Cold, Smallpox, Fracture, Wound, Ulcer, And Similar Conditions
arabicText: :لاقف ،تامف هولسغف رودجم وهو ةبانج هتباصأ نالاف نإ :هل ليق :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لاؤسلا يعلا ءافش نإ !؟هوممي لاأ !؟اولأس لاأ ،هولتق
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: He was asked about a man who became ritually impure and had smallpox, so they washed him and he died. He said: They killed him! Why didn't they ask? Why didn't they make him perform tayammum? Indeed, the cure for ignorance is asking.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum When Unable To Use Water Due To Illness, Cold, Smallpox, Fracture, Wound, Ulcer, And Similar Conditions
arabicText: .لستغي لاو مميتي نوطبملاو ريسكلا يف كلذ يورو :لقا
englishText: He said: And it was narrated similarly regarding the one with fractures and stomach ailments that he should perform tayammum and not perform ghusl.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum When Unable To Use Water Due To Illness, Cold, Smallpox, Fracture, Wound, Ulcer, And Similar Conditions
arabicText: لاأ ،هولتق :لاقف ؟تامف هولسغف ةبانج هتباصأ رودجم نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لاؤسلا يعلا ءاود نفإ !؟اولأس
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a person with smallpox who became ritually impure, so they washed him and he died? He said: They killed him! Why didn't they ask? For indeed, the cure for ignorance is asking.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum When Unable To Use Water Due To Illness, Cold, Smallpox, Fracture, Wound, Ulcer, And Similar Conditions
arabicText: .ةبانج هتباصأ اذإ بارتلبا ريسكلاو رودجملا مميتي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع دانسلاا اذهبو
englishText: And with this chain from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The one with smallpox and fractures should perform tayammum with dust when in a state of ritual impurity.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum When Unable To Use Water Due To Illness, Cold, Smallpox, Fracture, Wound, Ulcer, And Similar Conditions
arabicText: لا :لقا ؟بنجي ،ةحارجلاو حرقلا هب نوكي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع .مميتي ،لستغي لا نبأ سبأ
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim who said: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a man who has ulcers and wounds, and becomes ritually impure? He said: There is no harm if he does not perform ghusl; he should perform tayammum.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum When Unable To Use Water Due To Illness, Cold, Smallpox, Fracture, Wound, Ulcer, And Similar Conditions
arabicText: حرج لىع ةبانج هتباصأ لاجر نأ هل ركذ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ناك امنإ ،الله مهلتق هولتق :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لاقف ،تامف زكف لستغفا لسغلبا رمفأ هب ناك .لاؤسلا يعلا ءاود
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was told about a man who became ritually impure while having a wound, so he ordered him to perform ghusl. The man performed ghusl and developed lockjaw and died. So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: They killed him, may Allah deal with them! Indeed, the cure for ignorance was merely asking.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum When Unable To Use Water Due To Illness, Cold, Smallpox, Fracture, Wound, Ulcer, And Similar Conditions
arabicText: ،دربلا نم هسفن لىع فاخي نوكي وأ حورج وأ حورق هبو ةبانجلا هبيصت لجرلا يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع .مميتي ،لستغي لا :لاقف
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), regarding a man who becomes ritually impure while having ulcers or wounds, or fears for himself from the cold, he said: He should not perform ghusl; he should perform tayammum.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum When Unable To Use Water Due To Illness, Cold, Smallpox, Fracture, Wound, Ulcer, And Similar Conditions
arabicText: ،دربلا نم هسفن لىع فاخي وأ حورق وأ حورج هبو ةبانجلا هبيصت لجرلا يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .مميتيو ،لستغي لا :لاقف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding a man who becomes junub (ritually impure) and has wounds or sores, or fears harm from cold upon himself, he said: He should not perform ghusl (ritual bath), and should perform tayammum (dry ablution).

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum When Unable To Use Water Due To Illness, Cold, Smallpox, Fracture, Wound, Ulcer, And Similar Conditions
arabicText: ،ةبانجلا هبيصتف هدسج يف حورقلا هب نوكت لجرلا يف ،(ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ملسم نب دمحم نع .مميتي :لقا
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim, from one of them (peace be upon them both), regarding a man who has sores on his body and becomes junub, he said: He should perform tayammum.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum When Unable To Use Water Due To Illness, Cold, Smallpox, Fracture, Wound, Ulcer, And Similar Conditions
arabicText: اذإ ريسكلاو رودجملا مموي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،هباحصأ ضعب نع ،ريمع يبأ نبا نع .ةبانجلا امهتباصأ
englishText: From Ibn Abi Umayr, from some of his companions, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The one with smallpox and the one with broken bones should be assisted in performing tayammum when they become junub.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum When Unable To Use Water Due To Illness, Cold, Smallpox, Fracture, Wound, Ulcer, And Similar Conditions
arabicText: :لاقف ؟بنجيف تاحارجلاو حورقلا هب نوكي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ لأس هنأ ،ملسم نب دمحم نع .لستغي لاو ،مميتي نبأ سبأ لا
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim, that he asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a man who has sores and wounds and becomes junub? He said: There is no problem in him performing tayammum, and he should not perform ghusl.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum When Unable To Use Water Due To Illness, Cold, Smallpox, Fracture, Wound, Ulcer, And Similar Conditions
arabicText: .نلاسغي لاو نامموي ريسكلاو نوطبملا :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقاو :لقا
englishText: He said: And Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: The one with stomach illness and the one with broken bones should be assisted in performing tayammum and should not perform ghusl.

chapter: Dislike Of Performing Tayammum With Trodden Soil And Soil From The Road
arabicText: ينعي :ليفونلا لقا .أطوم نم ءوضو لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .كلجرب هيلع أطت ام
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: There is no ablution (with dust) from what is stepped upon. Al-Nawfali said: It means what you step on with your foot.

chapter: Dislike Of Performing Tayammum With Trodden Soil And Soil From The Road
arabicText: .قيرطلا رثأ نم بارتب لجرلا مميتي نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ ىهن :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) forbade that a man perform tayammum with dust from the traces of the road.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum With Soil, Stone, And All Parts Of Earth Except Minerals And Similar Materials
arabicText: حون عئارش (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) ادمحم ىطعأ ىلاعتو كرابت الله نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اروهطو ادجسم ضرلأا هل لعجو - لقا نأ ىلإ - ىسيعو ىسومو ميهاربإو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, gave Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) the laws of Noah, Abraham, Moses, and Jesus- until he said- and He made the earth for him a place of prostration and purification.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum With Soil, Stone, And All Parts Of Earth Except Minerals And Similar Materials
arabicText: تلعج :ليبق دحأ اهطعي مل اسمخ تيطعأ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .اروهطو ادجسم ضرلأا يل
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: I have been given five things that were not given to anyone before me: The earth has been made for me a place of prostration and purification.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum With Soil, Stone, And All Parts Of Earth Except Minerals And Similar Materials
arabicText: ،اروهطو ادجسم ضرلأا يل تلعج :عبربأ تلضف :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا ةمامأ يبأ نع بعرلبا ترصنو ،اروهطو ادجسم هل تلعج دقف ضرلأا دجوو ءام دجي ملف ةلاصلا دارأ يتمأ نم لجر اميأو .ةفاك سانلا ىلإ تلسرأو ،مئانغلا يتملا تلحأو ،يدي نيب ريسي رهش ةريسم
englishText: From Abu Umamah who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: I have been favored with four things: The earth has been made for me a place of prostration and purification, and any man from my nation who wants to pray but cannot find water and finds earth, it has been made for him a place of prostration and purification, and I have been supported with awe (striking fear in my enemies) for a distance of a month's journey, and the spoils of war have been made lawful for my nation, and I have been sent to all mankind.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum With Soil, Stone, And All Parts Of Earth Except Minerals And Similar Materials
arabicText: يل تلعج :ليبق دحأ اهطعي مل اسمخ تيطعأ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا سابع نبا نع .ةعافشلا تيطعأو ،ملكلا عماوج تيطعأو ،منغملا يل لحأو ،بعرلبا ترصنو ،اروهطو ادجسم ضرلأا
englishText: From Ibn Abbas who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: I have been given five things that were not given to anyone before me: The earth has been made for me a place of prostration and purification, I have been supported (granted victory) with awe, spoils of war have been made lawful for me, I have been given comprehensive speech, and I have been given intercession.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum With Soil, Stone, And All Parts Of Earth Except Minerals And Similar Materials
arabicText: :لقا (مهيلع تناك يتلا للاغلااو مهرصإ مهنع عضيو) :ىلاعت هلوق يف ،هعفر ،(هريسفت) يف ميهاربإ نب ليع لاإ ةلاصلا مهل لحي ملو ،مميتلا مهل لحي ملو ،ءاملبا ءوضولاو لسغلا ليئارسإ ينب لىع ضرف ناك الله نإ باصأ اذإو ،بنذأ هنأ ملعيف انيتم احرج هسفن حرج بنذأ اذإ لجرلا ناكو ،بيراحملاو سئانكلاو عيبلا يف نع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر كلذ عفرف ،منغملا مهل لحي ملو ،هوعطق لوبلا هندب نم ائيش مهدحأ .هتمأ
englishText: Ali bin Ibrahim in his Tafsir, as a marfu hadith, regarding Allah's words: "And He removes from them their burden and the shackles which were upon them [Quran, 7:157]," he said: Allah had obligated upon the Children of Israel washing and ablution with water, and did not permit them tayammum, and did not permit them to pray except in synagogues, churches and prayer niches. When one of them committed a sin, he would inflict upon himself a deep wound so it would be known that he had sinned, and if urine touched any part of their body they would cut it off, and war booty was not permissible for them. So Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) lifted these from his nation.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum With Soil, Stone, And All Parts Of Earth Except Minerals And Similar Materials
arabicText: ؟ةلاصلل هنم أضوتيأ ،نبللا هعم نوكي لجرلا يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ريصب يبأ ثيدح مدقت دقو .ديعصلاو ءاملا وه امنإ ،لا :لقا
englishText: The hadith of Abu Basir from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) has preceded, regarding a man who has milk with him, can he perform ablution with it for prayer? He said: No, it is only water and earth.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum With Soil, Stone, And All Parts Of Earth Except Minerals And Similar Materials
arabicText: ،هب أضوتي نبأ سبأ لا :لقا ؟هب أضوتي ،قيقدلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ةرارز نب ديبع نع .هب عفتنيو بادآ يف مدقت امب اضيأ هيلع لدتساو ،قباسلا رصحلبا لادتسم نيسحتلا لىع انه ءوضولا خيشلا لمح :لوقأ هب حسمتي هب هتلي مث ،تيزلبا قيقدلا لعجيف ةرونلبا ليطي لجرلا يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع مامحلا .سبأ لا :لقا ،اهحير عطقيل ةرونلا دعب ،ضرلأا هجوب ديعصلا ةغللا ءاملع نم ريثك رسف دقو ،رصحلا يف رهاظ ريغ بارتلا ركذ نمضت امو :لوقأ هرسفو ،ءاهقفلاو نيرسفملا نم ةعامج اذكو ،بارتلبا صتخي لا هنأو ،كلذ لىع عامجلاا مهضعب ىعداو ،اهريغو تادابعلا ةمدقم يف كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقتو ،ضرلأبا مميتلا يف ةريثك صوصن يتيأو ،بارتلبا مهضعب .الله ءاش نإ ،ههجو نيبنو ،هوحنو طاسبلبا مميتلا زاوجو ةفاانملا هرهاظ ام يتيأو
englishText: From Ubayd ibn Zurarah who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about From Ubayd ibn Zurarah who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about f lour, can one perform ablution (yatawadda *) with it? He said: There is no problem in performing ablution (yatwadda) with it and benefiting from it. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted ablution here as beautification, based on the previous restriction, and he also cited as evidence what was mentioned earlier [Hadith 1538 to 1544 in Vol. 2, Section 2, Chapter 38] in the etiquettes of the bath from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding a man who applies depilatory paste and mixes flour with oil, then kneads it to wipe with it after the depilatory paste to remove its smell, he said: There is no problem. I (Hurr Amili) say: What includes the mention of dust is not clearly restrictive, and many linguists have interpreted "al-sa'eed" as the surface of the earth, with some claiming consensus on this, stating that it is not limited to dust. Similarly, a group of exegetes and jurists have held this view, while others interpreted it as dust specifically. Many texts will come regarding tayammum with earth, and evidence for this has preceded in the introduction to acts of worship and elsewhere. There will also come what appears to contradict this, such as the permissibility of tayammum with carpet and similar items, and we will explain its aspect, insha'Allah. Translator: * In classical Arabic, the verb "yatawadda" from root (wa-da-a) is also used for general washing/cleaning. In this hadith, this word likely refers to using flour for cleaning or beautification (skin-treatment) purposes, which was a known practice in traditional Arab and Islamic societies. That this hadith applies to such a use case can also be understood from several contextual clues in the hadith itself. The question is about flour (daqeeq), and it wouldn't make sense to perform wudu with flour. The second part of the hadith mentions "benefiting from it", suggesting a general utilitarian context.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum With Gypsum And Lime, And Its Impermissibility With Ash And Trees
arabicText: :ليقف ،معن :لاقف ؟ةرونلبا :ليقف ،معن :لاقف ؟صجلبا مميتلا نع لئس هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع .رجشلا نم جرخي امنإ ضرلأا نم جرخي سيل هنإ ،لا :لاقف ؟دامرلبا
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him), that he was asked about tayammum with gypsum? He said: Yes. Then he was asked about lime? He said: Yes. Then he was asked about ash? He said: No, it does not come from the earth, rather it comes from trees.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum In Necessity With Dust From Clothes, Saddle Felt, Horse's Mane, And Similar Things, And If Not Found Then With Clay, And The Impermissibility Of Tayammum With Snow
arabicText: لىع ردقي لاو عنصي فيك ،ءوضو لىع نكي مل نإ فقاوملا تيأرأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ تلق :لقا ةرارز نع .ليصيو ،ارابغ اهيف نفإ ،هتباد ةفرعم وأ هجرس وأ هدبل نم مميتي لقا ؟لوزنلا
englishText: From Zurarah who said: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): What do you think about the stopping places if one is not in a state of ablution, what should he do when he cannot dismount? He said: He should perform tayammum from his saddle felt, or his saddle, or his mount's mane, for there is dust in them, and he should pray.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum In Necessity With Dust From Clothes, Saddle Felt, Horse's Mane, And Similar Things, And If Not Found Then With Clay, And The Impermissibility Of Tayammum With Snow
arabicText: نم وأ هرابغ نم مميتيف هجرس دبل رظنيلف جلثلا كباصأ ناك نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع .هنم مميتي نأ سبأ لاف نيطلا لاإ دجي لا لاح يف ناك نإو ،هعم ئش
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: If snow affects you, then look at the felt of your saddle and perform tayammum from its dust or from something you have with you, and if you are in a state where you find nothing but clay, then there is no harm in performing tayammum with it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum In Necessity With Dust From Clothes, Saddle Felt, Horse's Mane, And Similar Things, And If Not Found Then With Clay, And The Impermissibility Of Tayammum With Snow
arabicText: .هب مميتي نأ سبأ لاف نيطلا لاإ دجت لا لاح يف تنك اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: If you are in a state where you find nothing but clay, then there is no harm in performing tayammum with it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum In Necessity With Dust From Clothes, Saddle Felt, Horse's Mane, And Similar Things, And If Not Found Then With Clay, And The Impermissibility Of Tayammum With Snow
arabicText: هدجت عضوم فجأ رظنفا ءام لاو بارت اهيف سيل ةلتبم ضرلأا تناك اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع وأ هرابغ نم مميتيلف هجرس دبل رظنيلف جلث يف ناك نفإ :لقا ،لجو زع الله نم عيسوت كلذ نفإ ،هنم مميتف .هنم مميتي نأ سبأ لاف نيطلا لاإ دجي لا لاح يف ناك نإو ،ربغم ئش
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If the ground is wet with neither From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If the ground is wet with neither soil nor water, then look for the driest place you can find and perform tayammum from it, for that is an allowance from Allah, Mighty and Majestic. He said: If one is in snow, then look at the saddle felt and perform tayammum from its dust or something dusty, and if one is in a state where nothing is found except clay, then there is no harm in performing tayammum with it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum In Necessity With Dust From Clothes, Saddle Felt, Horse's Mane, And Similar Things, And If Not Found Then With Clay, And The Impermissibility Of Tayammum With Snow
arabicText: ؟عنصي ام ،نيط اهيفو ءام اهيف سيل ةمجلأا لخد لجر :تلق :لقا ،(ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ةرارز نع فاخ نإ :لقا ؟ءوضو لىع وه سيلو فوخ نم لوزنلا هنكمي لاو بكار هنفإ :تلق ،ديعصلا هنفإ مميتي :لقا .ليصيو مميتيو ةعذربلا وأ دبللا لىع هديب برضي ،مميتيلف تقولا توف فاخو هريغ وأ عبس نم هسفن لىع
englishText: From Zurarah, from one of them (peace be upon them), who said: I asked: A man enters a thicket where there is no water but there is clay, what should he do? He said: He should perform tayammum for it is clean earth. I asked: What if he is riding and cannot dismount due to fear and he is not in a state of ablution? He said: If he fears for himself from a predator or something else and fears missing the prayer time, then he should perform tayammum by striking his hand on the felt or packsaddle and perform tayammum and pray.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum In Necessity With Dust From Clothes, Saddle Felt, Horse's Mane, And Similar Things, And If Not Found Then With Clay, And The Impermissibility Of Tayammum With Snow
arabicText: ،بارتلا لاو ءاملا بيصي لا لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا تلأس :لقا انباحصأ ضعب نع ،رطم نب ليع نع .روهط ءامو بيط ديعص معن :لقا ؟نيطلبا مميتيأ
englishText: From Ali bin Matar, from some of our companions who said: I asked Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about a man who can find neither water nor soil, can he perform tayammum with clay? He said: Yes, clean earth and purifying water.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum In Necessity With Dust From Clothes, Saddle Felt, Horse's Mane, And Similar Things, And If Not Found Then With Clay, And The Impermissibility Of Tayammum With Snow
arabicText: نيطلا لىع لاإ ردقت لا لاح يف تنك اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع - يدارملا ينعي - ريصب يبأ نع .هب مميتتو هضفنت نأ ردقت (١) دبل وأ فاج بوث كعم نكي مل اذإ رذعلبا ىلوأ الله نفإ ،هب مميتف
englishText: From Abu Basir- meaning Al-Muradi- from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If you are in a state where you can only find clay, then perform tayammum with it, for Allah is most worthy of accepting the excuse when you have neither dry cloth nor felt that you can shake out and perform tayammum with.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum In Necessity With Dust From Clothes, Saddle Felt, Horse's Mane, And Similar Things, And If Not Found Then With Clay, And The Impermissibility Of Tayammum With Snow
arabicText: .روهط ءامو بيط ديعص ،ىرخأ ةياور يفو :لقا
englishText: And in another narration: Clean earth and pure water.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum In Necessity With Dust From Clothes, Saddle Felt, Horse's Mane, And Similar Things, And If Not Found Then With Clay, And The Impermissibility Of Tayammum With Snow
arabicText: :لاقف ؟ادماج اءام وأ جلثلا لاإ دجي ملو رفس يف بنجأ لجر نع تلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هنيد قبوت يتلا ضرلأا هذه ىلإ دوعي نأ ىرأ لاو ،مميتي ةرورضلا ةلزنمب وه .جلثلبا مميتي هنأ يف رهاظب سيلو ،رم امك هوحنو بوث رابغ نم مميتي هنأ لىع لومحم اذه :لوقأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked about a man who becomes junub (ritually impure) while traveling and finds only snow or frozen water? He said: It is considered a necessity and he should perform tayammum, and I do not think he should return to this land that ruins his religion. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted to mean that he performs tayammum with dust from clothing and the like as previously mentioned, and it is not explicitly stating that he performs tayammum with snow.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum In Necessity With Dust From Clothes, Saddle Felt, Horse's Mane, And Similar Things, And If Not Found Then With Clay, And The Impermissibility Of Tayammum With Snow
arabicText: ،هدجت عضوم فجأ رظنفا ءام لاو بارت اهيف سيلو ةلتبم ضرلأا تناك نإ :لقا ،ةريغملا نب الله دبع نع .هب مميتي نأ سبأ لاف نيطلا لاإ دجي لا لاح يف ناك نإو ،ربغم ئش وأ هرابغ نم مميتف
englishText: From Abdullah bin Al-Mughirah who said: If the ground is wet and there is neither soil nor water in it, then look for the driest place you can find and perform tayammum with its dust or something dusty, and if in a situation where one finds only mud, then there is no problem performing tayammum with it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum In Necessity With Dust From Clothes, Saddle Felt, Horse's Mane, And Similar Things, And If Not Found Then With Clay, And The Impermissibility Of Tayammum With Snow
arabicText: مميت رهط ريغ لىع هنأ ركذ مث هشارف ىلإ ىوآ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ثايغ نب صفح نع .الله ركذ ام ةلاص يف ناك ،هبايث رثاد نم
englishText: From Hafs bin Ghiyath, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever retires to his bed then remembers he is not in a state of purity should perform tayammum from the dust of his bedding clothes, and he will be considered in prayer as long as he remembers Allah.

chapter: Obligation Of Purification With Snow When Possible To Melt It, Or Achieving The Name Of Ghusl With Its Moisture
arabicText: ؟جلثلا لاإ دجي لا رفسلا يف بنجي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع .رهنلا ءام وأ جلثلبا لستغي :لقا ةبوطرلا ريثك ناك نإ جلثلبا هدسج كلدي وأ ،نكمأ نإ هئامب لستغيو رانلبا جلثلا بيذي هنأ دارملا :لوقأ باوجلا يف رهنلا ءام ركذف ،جلثلا لاإ دجي لا هنأ ضرف لئاسلا نأ كلذ نايبو ،لسغلا ىمسم لصحي ثيحب .رهنلا ءامب لستغي نأو جلثلا نم باذملا ءاملبا لستغي نأ نيب قرف لا هنأ هدارم نأ لىع لدي
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who becomes junub while traveling and finds only snow? He said: He should perform ghusl with snow or river water. I (Hurr Amili) say: What is meant is that he should melt the snow with fire and perform ghusl with its water if possible, or rub his body with snow if it has sufficient moisture to achieve what is called ghusl. This is explained by the fact that the questioner assumed he only finds snow, so mentioning river water in the answer indicates that there is no difference between performing ghusl with water melted from snow and performing ghusl with river water.

chapter: Obligation Of Purification With Snow When Possible To Melt It, Or Achieving The Name Of Ghusl With Its Moisture
arabicText: ديرنو جلثلاو قمدلا انبيصي :لاقف هدنع ناأو (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لجر لأس :لقا حيرش نب ةيواعم نع .معن :لقا ؟يدلج هب كلدأ ؟أضوتأ فيكف ،ادماج اءام لاإ دجن لاو أضوتن نأ
englishText: From Mu'awiyah bin Shurayh who said: A man asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) while I was with him and said: We encounter dampness and snow and want to perform wudu but find only frozen water, how should I perform wudu? Should I rub it on my skin? He said: Yes.

chapter: Obligation Of Purification With Snow When Possible To Melt It, Or Achieving The Name Of Ghusl With Its Moisture
arabicText: ءام هعم نوكي لا ءوضو ريغ لىع وأ ،بنجلا لجرلا نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هيخأ نع هدسجو هسأر لب اذإ جلثلا :لقا ؟ههجو جلثلبا حسمي مأ مميتيأ ،لضفأ امهيأ ،اديعصو اجلث بيصي وهو .مميتيلف هب لستغي نأ لىع ردقي مل نفإ ،لضفأ
englishText: From his brother Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a From his brother Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a man who is junub, or without wudu, having no water with him but finding snow and earth, which is better, should he perform tayammum or wipe his face with snow? He said: Snow is better if it wets his head and body, but if he cannot perform ghusl with it, then he should perform tayammum.

chapter: Obligation Of Purification With Snow When Possible To Melt It, Or Achieving The Name Of Ghusl With Its Moisture
arabicText: ،ءاملا لىع ردقي لاف ةبانجلا هبصي لجر نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) هيخأ نع ،رفعج نب ليع هدج نع امهيأ :تلق :لقا .مميتلا هيلع لاإو ،هأزجأ هلسغ نإ :لقا ؟مميتي له مأ كلذ هيزجي له ،رطملا هبيصيف ردقي مل نإو ،لضفأ هدسجو هسأر لب نإ جلثلا :لقا ؟هسأرو هدسجو ههجو جلثب حسمي مأ مميتيأ ،لضفأ .مميتي لستغي نأ لىع
englishText: From his grandfather Ali bin Ja'far, from his brother (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a man who becomes junub and cannot find water, then rain falls on him, is that sufficient for him or should he perform tayammum? He said: If it washes him it suffices, otherwise he must perform tayammum. I said: Which is better, to perform tayammum or to wipe his face, body and head with snow? He said: Snow is better if it wets his head and body, but if he cannot perform ghusl, he should perform tayammum.

chapter: How To Perform Tayammum And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: امهادحإ هيفك حسم مث ،ههجو امهب حسمف طاسبلا لىع هيديب برضف ؟مميتلا نع هتلأس :لقا ليهاكلا نع .ىرخلأا رهظ لىع يف دوجوملا رابغلبا مميتلا زاوج ىلإ ةراشإ هنوك لمتحيو ،هب مميتي ام لا مميتلا ةيفيك نايب ضرغلا :لوقأ .ةرورضلا دنع هوحنو طاسبلا
englishText: Al-Kahili said: I asked him about tayammum (dry ablution)? He struck his hands on the carpet and wiped his face with them, then wiped his palms, one over the back of the other. I (Hurr Amili) say: The purpose is to explain how to perform tayammum, not what to perform tayammum with, and it is possible that it is an indication of the permissibility of performing tayammum with the dust found on the rug and the like in case of necessity.

chapter: How To Perform Tayammum And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: ةبانج هتباصأ ارامع نإ :لاقف ؟مميتلا نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،زارخلا بويأ يبأ نع ؟ةبادلا كعمتت امك تكعمت ،رامع يا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر هل لاقف ،ةبادلا كعمتت امك كعمتف .لايلق فكلا قوف حسم مث ههجو حسمف اهعفر مث ،حسملا لىع هدي عضوف ؟مميتلا فيك :هل تلقف
englishText: From Abu Ayyub Al-Khazzaz, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about tayammum (dry ablution)? He said: Ammar was in a state of janabah (sexual impurity), so he rolled in dust like an animal rolls. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to him: O Ammar, did you roll like an animal rolls? So I said to him: "How is tayammum performed?" He placed his hand on the soil, then raised it and wiped his face, then wiped slightly above the palm.

chapter: How To Perform Tayammum And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: مث ،اهضفنف اهعفر مث ضرلأا ىلإ هديب برضف ؟مميتلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس :لقا ةرارز نع ةدحو لىع لدي لاف ،ةدحاو ةرم عقو حسملا نوك دارملا نأ رهاظلا :لوقأ .ةدحاو ةرم هيفكو هنيبج اهب حسم .برضلا
englishText: Zurarah narrates: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about tayammum? He struck Zurarah narrates: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about tayammum? He struck his hand on the ground, then raised it and dusted it off, then wiped his forehead and palms once. Shaykh Hurr Amili: It appears that what is meant is that the wiping occurred once, so this does not indicate that the striking should be done only once. Translator: The focus of the hadith is on the manner of tayammum- that the Imam wiped the face and hands in a single motion after striking the earth. But it doesn't definitively establish that he only struck the earth one time as the minimum requirement for tayammum.

chapter: How To Perform Tayammum And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: ةبانج هتباصأ ارامع نإ :لاقف ؟مميتلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا نامعنلا نب دواد نع امك تكعمت ،رامع يا :هب أزهي وهو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر هل لاقف ،ةبادلا كعمتت امك كعمتف فكلا قوف هيديو ههجو حسمف امهعفر مث ضرلأا لىع هيدي عضوف ؟مميتلا فيكف :هل انلقف !؟ةبادلا كعمتت .لايلق
englishText: Dawud ibn al-Nu'man narrated: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about tayammum (dry ablution)? He said: Ammar became in a state of janabah (sexual impurity) and he rolled in dust like an animal rolls. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to him mockingly: O Ammar, did you roll like an animal rolls?! So we asked him: Then how is tayammum performed? He placed his hands on the ground then raised them and wiped his face and his hands slightly above the wrists.

chapter: How To Perform Tayammum And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: وبأ عضوف - رامع عنص امو مميتلا ركذو - :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تعمس :لقا ةرارز نع .ئشب نيعارذلا حسمي ملو ،هيفكو ههجو حسم مث ضرلأا لىع هيفك (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج
englishText: Zurarah said: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying- and he mentioned the tayammum and what Ammar did- then Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) placed his palms on the ground, then wiped his face and his palms, and did not wipe anything on the forearms.

chapter: How To Perform Tayammum And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: حسم مث ،امهضفنف امهعفر مث ضرلأا لىع هيديب برضف مميتلا فصو هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةدحاو ةرم هيفكو هنيبج لىع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he described tayammum [dry ablution]: He struck his hands on the earth, then raised them and shook them off, then wiped his forehead and his palms once.

chapter: How To Perform Tayammum And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: امهب حسمتو امهضفنت مث ضرلأا كيفكب برضت :لقا مميتلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع .كيديو كهجو
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) regarding tayammum, he said: Strike your palms on the earth, then dust them off, and wipe with them your face and your hands.

chapter: How To Perform Tayammum And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: :هل رفس يف رامعل موي تاذ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا :لقا ةرارز نع كلذك :هل لاقف :لقا ،بارتلا يف - الله لوسر يا - تغرمت :لقا ؟تعنص فيكف ،تبنجأ كنأ انغلب ،رامع يا هعباصبأ هنيبج حسم مث ،ديعصلا لىع امهعضوف ضرلأا ىلإ هيديب ىوهأ مث ،اذك تعنص لافأ ،رامحلا غرمتي .كلذ دعي مل مث ،ىرخلأبا امهادحإ هيفكو
englishText: From Zurarah who said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said one day to Ammar during one of his journeys: "O Ammar, it has reached me that you became in a state of janabah (sexual impurity), so what did you do?" He said: "O Messenger of Allah, I rolled in the dust." He said: "That is how a donkey rolls. Should you not have done this?" Then he lowered his hands to the ground and placed them on the earth, then wiped his forehead with his f ingers and his palms against each other, and did not repeat it.

chapter: How To Perform Tayammum And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: يا :لاقف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر رسيا نب رامع ىتأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع ديعصلا لىع تمقو يبايث تحرط :لقا ؟تعنص فيك :لقا ،ءام يعم نكي ملف ةليللا تبنجأ ينإ ،الله لوسر لىع هديب برضف (ابيط اديعص اومميتف) :لجو زع الله لقا امنإ ،رامحلا عنصي اذكه :لاقف ،هيف تكعمتف حسمف ،ىرخلأا لىع ةدحاو لك هيفك حسم مث ،هنيبجب حسم مث ،ىرخلأا لىع امهادحإ برض مث ضرلأا .ىرسيلا لىع ىنميلاو ،ىنميلا لىع ىرسيلا
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Ammar bin Yasir came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and said: O Messenger of Allah, I became in state of janabah (sexual impurity) at night and I had no water. He said: What did you do? He said: I removed my clothes and rolled in the dust. He said: That is what a donkey does. Indeed Allah Mighty and Majestic said: so perform tayammum with clean earth [Quran, 4:43]. Then he struck the ground with his hand, then struck one hand against the other, then wiped his forehead, then wiped his palms one against the other, wiping the left over the right and the right over the left.

chapter: Obligation Of Two Strikes (on The Earth) In Tayammum, Whether It Is For Wudu Or Ghusl, And The Choice In The Second (strike) Between Combining And Separating
arabicText: .نيديلاو هجولل ،نيترم نيترم :لاقف ؟مميتلا نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،دمحم نع
englishText: From Muhammad, from one of them (peace be upon them), he said: I asked him about tayammum? He replied: Two times, two times - for the face and the hands.

chapter: Obligation Of Two Strikes (on The Earth) In Tayammum, Whether It Is For Wudu Or Ghusl, And The Choice In The Second (strike) Between Combining And Separating
arabicText: امهب حسمتو امهضفنت مث ،نيترم ضرلأا لىع كيفكب برضت :لقا مميتلا يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .كيعارذو كهجو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding tayammum, he said: Strike your palms on the earth twice, then shake them off and wipe your face and forearms with them.

chapter: Obligation Of Two Strikes (on The Earth) In Tayammum, Whether It Is For Wudu Or Ghusl, And The Choice In The Second (strike) Between Combining And Separating
arabicText: .نيفكلل ةبرضو ،هجولل ةبرض مميتلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), he said: Tayammum is one strike for the face and one strike for the palms.

chapter: Obligation Of Two Strikes (on The Earth) In Tayammum, Whether It Is For Wudu Or Ghusl, And The Choice In The Second (strike) Between Combining And Separating
arabicText: لسغلاو ءوضولل دحاو برض وه :لقا ؟مميتلا فيك :هل تلق :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع لسغلا كيلعف ءاملا تبصأ ىتمو ،نيديلل ةرمو ،هجولل ةضفن امهضفنت مث ،نيترم كيديب برضت ،ةبانجلا نم .ابنج نكت مل نإ ءوضولاو ،ابنج تنك نإ فلاتخا هيف سيلو ،لسغلاو ءوضولل دحاو مسقو دحاو عون يأ ،دحاو برض مميتلا دارملا نأ برقلأا :لوقأ لدي لب ،ليصفتلا لىع لدي لاف ،نيتبرض نم هل دبلا نيمميتلا نم دحاو لك نأ نيب مث ،تبارضلا ددع يف فلاتخا هيف سيلو ،لسغلاو ءوضولل دحاو مسقو دحاو عون يأ ،دحاو برض مميتلا دارملا نأ برقلأا :لوقأ لدي لب ،ليصفتلا لىع لدي لاف ،نيتبرض نم هل دبلا نيمميتلا نم دحاو لك نأ نيب مث ،تبارضلا ددع يف .ديعب فلكتو ريدقتب لاإ حيحص ريغ ىنعملفا مهضعب همهف ام لىعو ،لامتحلاا نم لقأ لاو ،هنلاطب لىع
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him: How is Tayammum performed? He said: It is one strike for Wudu and Ghusl from Janabah. You strike with your hands twice, then shake them once for the face, and once for the hands. And whenever you find water, you must perform Ghusl if you were in the state of Janabah, and Wudu if you were not in the state of Janabah. I (Hurr Amili) say: The closest understanding is that what is meant by tayammum is one type, meaning one category and one division for both wudu and ghusl, and there is no difference in the number of strikes. Then it clarifies that each of the two tayammums must have two strikes, so it does not indicate differentiation, rather it indicates its invalidity, or at the very least suggests possibility. And according to what some have understood, the meaning is incorrect except with distant assumptions and forced interpretations.

chapter: Obligation Of Two Strikes (on The Earth) In Tayammum, Whether It Is For Wudu Or Ghusl, And The Choice In The Second (strike) Between Combining And Separating
arabicText: حسم مث ،ضرلأا هيفكب برضف ؟مميتلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع لىع ةدحاوو ،اهرهظ لىع ةدحاو ،عباصلأا فارطأ ىلإ هقفرم اهب حسمف ضرلأا هلامشب برض مث ،ههجو امهب ،هنيميب عنص امك هلامشب عنص مث ،ضرلأا هنيميب برض مث ،اهنطب هيلع ناك ام ىقلأو ،نيقفرملا ىلإ نيديلاو هجولا ءوضولا يفو ،لسغلا هيف ناك ام لىع مميتلا اذه :لقا مث .ديعصلبا مموي لاف نيمدقلاو سأرلا حسم ثيداحلأا هتفلاخمو ،ةماعلا بهذمل هتقفاومل ،ةيقتلا لىع لومحم نيقفرملا ىلإ نيديلاو هجولا حسم :لوقأ .هريغو خيشلا هركذ ،ةيتلآاو ةقباسلا ةريثكلا
