englishText: Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about Tayammum. He struck the earth with his palms, then wiped his face with them. Then he struck the earth with his left hand and wiped his elbow to the fingertips with it, once on the back and once on the palm. Then he struck the earth with his right hand, then did with his left as he did with his right. Then he said: This is the Tayammum for what requires Ghusl, and for Wudu it's the face and hands up to the elbows, excluding what was required for wiping the head and feet, so these are not performed with earth. I (Hurr Amili) say: The wiping of face and hands up to elbows is interpreted as taqiyyah, as it agrees with the general public's school of thought and contradicts numerous previous and subsequent hadiths, as mentioned by Al-Shaykh and others.

chapter: Obligation Of Two Strikes (on The Earth) In Tayammum, Whether It Is For Wudu Or Ghusl, And The Choice In The Second (strike) Between Combining And Separating
arabicText: ؟ءاوس ،ءاسنلل ضيحلا نمو ةبانجلاو ءوضولا نم مميتلا نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .معن :لاقف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said: I asked him about tayammum in place of ablution, and in place of janabah (sexual impurity), and for women in place of menstruation, are they all the same? He said: Yes.

chapter: Obligation Of Two Strikes (on The Earth) In Tayammum, Whether It Is For Wudu Or Ghusl, And The Choice In The Second (strike) Between Combining And Separating
arabicText: .معن :لقا !؟اءام ادجي مل اذإ ءاوس ،بنجلاو ضئاحلا مميت نع هتلأس :لقا - ثيدح يف - ريصب يبأ نع نأ لمتحي هلكو ،خسنلا لمتحي هضعب قباسلا بابلا يف ةدحاولا ةبرضلا لىع راصتقلاا نم مدقت امو :لوقأ لىع برضلا ةنيرقب تبارضلا ددع لا ،ةحوسمملا ءاضعلأا ريرقتو ،ةيمكلا لا ةيفيكلا نايب هب دارملا نوكي ام ديؤي طايتحلااو ،كلذ ريغو لسغلا نع لدب همميت نأ عم رامع ةصق يف ةدحاولا لىع راصتقلااو ،طاسبلا .هانلق
englishText: From Abu Basir- in a hadith- he said: I asked him about tayammum of a menstruating woman and one in a state of janabah (sexual impurity), are they the same when they cannot find water? He replied: Yes. I (Hurr Amili) say: What was previously mentioned about limiting to one strike in the previous chapter, some of it may be abrogated, and all of it could mean that the intention was to explain the method not the quantity, and to establish the parts to be wiped, not the number of strikes, as evidenced by striking on the mat, and limiting to one strike in the story of Ammar despite his tayammum being a substitute for ghusl and other factors, and precaution supports what we have said.

chapter: Obligation Of Two Strikes (on The Earth) In Tayammum, Whether It Is For Wudu Or Ghusl, And The Choice In The Second (strike) Between Combining And Separating
arabicText: ،نتارم ةبانجلا نمو ،ةدحاو ةرم ءوضولا نم مميتلا نأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،انه قباسلا ملسم نب دمحم نع ةنيذأ نبا ثيدح وه لب ،هل دوجو لا ىعدملا ثيدحلا نلا ،بيجع مهو اذهو ةيدتأ نم مهولا لصحف ،بيذهتلا يف هملاك ءانثأ يف نيلامتحلاا دحأ لىع هنومضم ىلإ راشأ خيشلا نكل عجار نمو ،(ىقتنملا) بحاص هققح دقو ،كلذك سيلو ،حيرص رخآ ثيدح هنأ هريغو ةملاعلا نظو ،هانعم .كلذ ققحي خيشلا ملاك
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): The dry ablution (tayammum) in place of regular ablution (wudu) is done once, and in place of major ritual impurity (janabah) it is done twice. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is a strange misconception, because the claimed hadith does not exist. Rather, it is the previously mentioned hadith of Ibn Udhaina from Muhammad bin Muslim, but the Shaykh referred to its content as one of two possibilities during his discussion in Al-Tahdhib. The misconception arose from conveying its meaning, and Allamah and others thought it was another explicit hadith, but it is not so. The author of Al-Muntaqa has verified this, and whoever reviews the Shaykh's words will verify that.

chapter: The Extent Of Wiping The Face And Hands In Tayammum
arabicText: ضعبو سأرلا ضعبب حسملا نإ :تلقو تلمع نيأ نم ينربخت لاأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ لقا هنأ ةرارز نع اوحسماو) :لاقف ملاكلا نيب لصف مث :- (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا نأ ىلإ ثيدحلا ركذو - ؟نيلجرلا اودجت ملف) :- لقا نأ ىلإ - ،ءابلا ناكمل سأرلا ضعبب حسملا نأ (مكسوؤرب) :لقا نيح انفرعف (مكسوؤرب (مكهوجوب اوحسمفا ابيط اديعص اومميتف ءام لصو مث (مكهوجوب) :لقا هنلأ ،احسم لسغلا ضعب تبثأ ءاملا دجي مل نمع ءوضولا عضو نأ املف كلذ نم قلعي هنلأ ،هجولا لىع رجي مل عمجأ كلذ نأ ملع هنلأ ،مميتلا كلذ نم يأ (هنم مكيديأو) اهب .قيضلا :جرحلاو (جرح نم مكيلع لعجيل الله ديري ام) :لقا مث ،اهضعبب قلعي لاو فكلا ضعبب ديعصلا
englishText: From Zurarah who said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): Will you not tell me from where did you derive and say that wiping is done on part of the head and part of the feet?- and he mentioned the hadith until Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said-: Then He differentiated between the words and said And wipe your heads [Quran, 5:6], so we understood when He said your heads that wiping is done on part of the head due to the presence of ba (preposition),- until he said- And if you do not find water, then seek clean earth and wipe your faces [Quran, 4:43] When ablution was lifted from those who could not find water, He established some of the washing as wiping, because He said [And wipe your faces] then connected to it [and your hands from it], meaning from that tayammum, because He knew that all of that would not pass over the face, as some of the dust clings to part of the palm while not clinging to other parts. Then He said [Allah does not wish to place any hardship upon you] [Quran, 5:6], and hardship means difficulty.

chapter: The Extent Of Wiping The Face And Hands In Tayammum
arabicText: اوعطقفا ةقراسلاو قراسلاو) :ةيلآا هذه لاتف ؟مميتلا نع لئس هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،عطقلا عضوم ثيح نم كيفك لىع حسمفا :لقا (قفارملا ىلإ ،مكيديأو مكهوجو اولسغفا) :لقاو (امهيديأ .(ايسن كبر ناك امو) :لقاو ،مميتلا يف مهبهذم لطبيو ،ةقرسلا يف مهبهذم قفاوي امب ةماعلا لىع للادتسلاا لئاسلل ميلعت هيف :لوقأ سيل مميتلاو عطقلا نأ ملع ،ءوضولا ةيآ يف تديقو ،مميتلاو ةقرسلا يتيآ يف يديلأا قلطأ امل :لقا هنأكف .ملعأ اللهو ،نيقفرملا نم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), that he was asked about tayammum? He recited this verse: "And [as for] the male thief and the female thief, cut off their hands" [Quran, 5:38] and said: "wash your faces and your hands up to the elbows" [Quran, 5:6]. He said: So wipe over your palms from where the cutting would From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), that he was asked about tayammum? He recited this verse: "And [as for] the male thief and the female thief, cut off their hands" [Quran, 5:38] and said: "wash your faces and your hands up to the elbows" [Quran, 5:6]. He said: So wipe over your palms from where the cutting would be, and said: "And your Lord is never forgetful" [Quran, 19:64]. I (Hurr Amili) say: In this there is teaching the questioner how to reason with the general public using what agrees with their position regarding theft, while invalidating their position regarding tayammum. It is as if he said: Since hands were mentioned unrestricted in the verses of theft and tayammum, but restricted to the elbows in the verse of ablution, it is known that cutting (in theft) and tayammum are not from the elbows, and Allah knows best.

chapter: The Extent Of Wiping The Face And Hands In Tayammum
arabicText: ىلإ هيعارذو ههجو اهب حسمف ضرلأا لىع هدي عضوف ؟مميتلا فيك هتلأس :لقا ةعامس نع ،نامثع نع .نيقفرملا .ةيقتلا لىع ةقباسلا ملسم نب دمحم ةياورو ةياورلا هذه خيشلا لمح دق :لوقأ
englishText: From Uthman, from Sama'ah who said: I asked him how is tayammum performed? So he placed his hand on the ground and wiped with it his face and his forearms up to the elbows. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh has interpreted this narration and the previous narration of Muhammad ibn Muslim as being under taqiyyah.

chapter: On Not Having To Repeat Prayer Performed With Tayammum Unless One Falls Short In Seeking Water Then It Becomes Obligatory, Or Finds Water Within The Time Then It Becomes Recommended
arabicText: :لقا ؟ءاملا دجي ملو بنجأ اذإ لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لأس هنأ ،يبلحلا ليع نب الله ديبع نع .ةلاصلا ديعي لاو لستغيلف ءاملا دجو اذفإ ،ديعصلبا مميتي
englishText: From Ubaydullah bin Ali Al-Halabi, that he asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who becomes junub and cannot find water? He said: He should perform tayammum with clean earth, and when he finds water he should perform ghusl but need not repeat the prayer.

chapter: On Not Having To Repeat Prayer Performed With Tayammum Unless One Falls Short In Seeking Water Then It Becomes Obligatory, Or Finds Water Within The Time Then It Becomes Recommended
arabicText: فاخيو ةدرابلا ةليللا يف ةبانجلا هبيصت لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لأس هنأ ،نانس نب الله دبع نع .ةلاصلا داعأو لستغا دربلا نم نمأ اذفإ ،ليصيو مميتي :لاقف ؟لستغا نإ فلتلا هسفن لىع
englishText: From Abdullah bin Sinan, that he asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who becomes junub on a cold night and fears death if he performs ghusl? He said: He should perform tayammum and pray, and when he is safe from the cold he should perform ghusl and repeat the prayer.

chapter: On Not Having To Repeat Prayer Performed With Tayammum Unless One Falls Short In Seeking Water Then It Becomes Obligatory, Or Finds Water Within The Time Then It Becomes Recommended
arabicText: نأ فاخ اذفإ ،تقولا يف ماد ام بلطيلف ءاملا رفاسملا دجي مل اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ةرارز نع .لبقتسي امل ضوتيلو ،هيلع ءاضق لاف ءاملا دجو اذفإ ،تقولا رخآ يف لصيلو مميتيلف تقولا هتوفي
englishText: From Zurarah, from one of them (peace be upon them) who said: If a traveler cannot f ind water, he should keep searching while time remains. If he fears the time will elapse, he should perform tayammum and pray at the end of time. If he then finds water, he has no make-up prayer due, but should perform wudu for future prayers.

chapter: On Not Having To Repeat Prayer Performed With Tayammum Unless One Falls Short In Seeking Water Then It Becomes Obligatory, Or Finds Water Within The Time Then It Becomes Recommended
arabicText: نم حسمتيلف ابنج ناكو اروهط لجرلا دجي مل اذإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا يبلحلا نع .لىص يتلا هتلاص هتأزجأ دقو لستغيلف اءام دجو اذفإ ،لصيلو ضرلأا
englishText: From Al-Halabi who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: If a man cannot find pure water and is junub, he should wipe from the earth and pray. When he finds water he should perform ghusl, and his prayer that he prayed is sufficient.

chapter: On Not Having To Repeat Prayer Performed With Tayammum Unless One Falls Short In Seeking Water Then It Becomes Obligatory, Or Finds Water Within The Time Then It Becomes Recommended
arabicText: اءام هعم نأ ركذ مث ،لىصو مميتف هيسنف ءام هعم ناكو رفس يف ناك لجر نع هتلأس :لقا ريصب يبأ نع .ثيدحلا ،ةلاصلا ديعيو أضوتي نأ هيلع :لقا ؟تقولا جرخي نأ لبق نم لىعو ،ءاملا لوصح ءاجر عم تقولا رخآ لبق مميت نم لىعو ،بابحتسلاا لىع لمحلا لمتحي اذه :لوقأ .ملعأ اللهو ،نايسنلا ةنيرقب ءاملا بلطي مل
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: I asked him about a man who was traveling and had water but forgot about it, so he performed tayammum and prayed, then remembered he had water before the time elapsed? He said: He must perform wudu and repeat the prayer, the hadith. I (Hurr Amili) say: This could be interpreted as recommended, or apply to one who performed tayammum before the end of time while hoping to find water, or to one who did not search for water as indicated by the forgetfulness, and Allah knows best.

chapter: On Not Having To Repeat Prayer Performed With Tayammum Unless One Falls Short In Seeking Water Then It Becomes Obligatory, Or Finds Water Within The Time Then It Becomes Recommended
arabicText: ةليل يف ةبانج هتباصأ لجر نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،هاور نمع ،ريشب نب رفعج نع .ةلاصلا داعأو لستغا دربلا نمأ اذفإ ،ليصيو مميتي :لقا ؟لستغا نإ فلتلا هسفن لىع فاخي ةدربا
englishText: From Ja'far bin Bashir, from who narrated it, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a man who became junub on a cold night and fears death if he performs ghusl? He said: He should perform tayammum and pray, and when he is safe from the cold he should perform ghusl and repeat the prayer.

chapter: On Not Having To Repeat Prayer Performed With Tayammum Unless One Falls Short In Seeking Water Then It Becomes Obligatory, Or Finds Water Within The Time Then It Becomes Recommended
arabicText: نم حسميلف ابنج ناكو اروهط لجرلا دجي مل اذإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا نانس نبا نع .لىص يتلا هتلاص هتأزجأ دقو لستغيلف اءام دجو اذفإ ،لصيلو ضرلأا
englishText: From Ibn Sinan who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: If a man cannot find pure water and is junub, he should wipe from the earth and pray. When he finds water he should perform ghusl, and his prayer that he prayed is sufficient.

chapter: On Not Having To Repeat Prayer Performed With Tayammum Unless One Falls Short In Seeking Water Then It Becomes Obligatory, Or Finds Water Within The Time Then It Becomes Recommended
arabicText: هتلاص دعب باصفأ لىصف مميت لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس :لقا نيطقي نب بوقعي نع ،هنعو ىضم نفإ ،داعأو أضوت تقولا يضمي نأ لبق ءاملا دجو اذإ :لقا ؟هتلاص زوجت مأ ةلاصلا ديعيو أضوتيأ ،اءام .هيلع ةداعإ لاف تقولا
englishText: From Ya'qub ibn Yaqtin who said: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a man who performed tayammum and prayed, then found water after his prayer, should he perform ablution and repeat the prayer or is his prayer valid? He said: If he finds water before the time expires, he should perform ablution and repeat, but if the time has expired, there is no repetition required of him.

chapter: On Not Having To Repeat Prayer Performed With Tayammum Unless One Falls Short In Seeking Water Then It Becomes Obligatory, Or Finds Water Within The Time Then It Becomes Recommended
arabicText: تمت :لقا ،تقو يف وهو مميتب لىص دقو ءاملا باصأ نفإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ تلق :لقا ةرارز نع .هيلع ةداعإ لاو هتلاص
englishText: From Zurarah who said: I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): If he finds water after having prayed with tayammum while still within the prayer time? He said: His prayer is complete and no repetition is required of him.

chapter: On Not Having To Repeat Prayer Performed With Tayammum Unless One Falls Short In Seeking Water Then It Becomes Obligatory, Or Finds Water Within The Time Then It Becomes Recommended
arabicText: تنك ينإ ،لاعفا تنكف ناأ امأ :لاقف ،ءاملا باصأ مث لىصف مميت لجر يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .بابحتسلاا لىع ةللادلا حضاو اذه :لوقأ .ديعأو أضوتأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding a man who performed tayammum and prayed then found water, he said: As for me, I would do it; I would perform ablution and repeat. I (Hurr Amili) say: This clearly indicates recommendation.

chapter: On Not Having To Repeat Prayer Performed With Tayammum Unless One Falls Short In Seeking Water Then It Becomes Obligatory, Or Finds Water Within The Time Then It Becomes Recommended
arabicText: ؟تقولا جرخي نأ لبق ءاملا غلب مث لىصو مميت لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ريصب يبأ نع .ةلاصلا ةداعإ هيلع سيل :لاقف
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who performed tayammum and prayed, then found water before the time expired? He said: He is not required to repeat the prayer.

chapter: On Not Having To Repeat Prayer Performed With Tayammum Unless One Falls Short In Seeking Water Then It Becomes Obligatory, Or Finds Water Within The Time Then It Becomes Recommended
arabicText: لوسر يا :لاقف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ىتأ هنأ ،هنع الله يضر رذ يبأ نع ،هئباآ نع ،هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع ،ءامبو ،هب ترتتسفا لمحمب (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا رمفأ لقا !ءام ريغ لىع تعماج ،تكله ،الله .نينس رشع ديعصلا كيفكي ،رذ باأ يا :لقا مث ،يهو ناأ تلستغفا لوسر يا :لاقف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ىتأ هنأ ،هنع الله يضر رذ يبأ نع ،هئباآ نع ،هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع ،ءامبو ،هب ترتتسفا لمحمب (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا رمفأ لقا !ءام ريغ لىع تعماج ،تكله ،الله .نينس رشع ديعصلا كيفكي ،رذ باأ يا :لقا مث ،يهو ناأ تلستغفا
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father, from his forefathers, from Abu Dharr (may Allah be pleased with him), that he came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said: O Messenger of Allah, I am ruined, I had intercourse without water! So the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) ordered a cover to conceal with, and water, so I and she performed ghusl, then he said: O Abu Dharr, clean earth suffices you for ten years.

chapter: On Not Having To Repeat Prayer Performed With Tayammum Unless One Falls Short In Seeking Water Then It Becomes Obligatory, Or Finds Water Within The Time Then It Becomes Recommended
arabicText: لىصو مميت ءاملا دجي لا رفسلا يف لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ةرسيم نب ةيواعم نع نفإ ،هتلاص لىع يضمي :لقا ؟ةلاصلا ديعيو أضوتي مأ هتلاص لىع يضميأ ،تقولا نم ئش هيلعو ءاملا ىتأ مث .بارتلا بر وه ءاملا بر
englishText: From Mu'awiyah ibn Maysarah who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man traveling who cannot find water, performs tayammum and prays, then f inds water while some time remains, should he proceed with his prayer or perform ablution and repeat the prayer? He said: He proceeds with his prayer, for the Lord of water is the Lord of earth.

chapter: On Not Having To Repeat Prayer Performed With Tayammum Unless One Falls Short In Seeking Water Then It Becomes Obligatory, Or Finds Water Within The Time Then It Becomes Recommended
arabicText: هتلاص تضم دق :لقا ،تقو يف وهو ءاملا باصأ مث لىصو مميت لجر يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رهطتيلو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding a man who performed tayammum and prayed then found water while still within the time, he said: His prayer has passed and let him purify himself.

chapter: On Not Having To Repeat Prayer Performed With Tayammum Unless One Falls Short In Seeking Water Then It Becomes Obligatory, Or Finds Water Within The Time Then It Becomes Recommended
arabicText: دجو مث لىصو ديعصلبا مميتف بنجأ لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع .نيروهطلا دحأ لعف دقف ،ديعصلا ءاملا بر نإ ،ديعي لا :لقا ؟ءاملا
englishText: From Muhammad ibn Muslim who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who became junub, performed tayammum with clean earth and prayed, then found water? He said: He does not repeat, for the Lord of clean earth is water, he has performed one of the two purifications.

chapter: On Not Having To Repeat Prayer Performed With Tayammum Unless One Falls Short In Seeking Water Then It Becomes Obligatory, Or Finds Water Within The Time Then It Becomes Recommended
arabicText: لستغي :لقا ؟لىص دقو بنج وهو ءاملا يتيأ لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا صيعلا نع .ةلاصلا ديعي لاو
englishText: From Al-Ais who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who f inds water while he is in a state of janabah (sexual impurity) and has already prayed? From Al-Ais who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who f inds water while he is in a state of janabah (sexual impurity) and has already prayed? He said: He should perform ghusl but does not need to repeat the prayer.

chapter: On Not Having To Repeat Prayer Performed With Tayammum Unless One Falls Short In Seeking Water Then It Becomes Obligatory, Or Finds Water Within The Time Then It Becomes Recommended
arabicText: دعت لا :لاقف ،تقو ليع يقب دقو ءاملا دجأ مث ليصأو مميتأ :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ديعصلا بر وه ءاملا بر نفإ ،ةلاصلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), I said to him: I perform tayammum and pray, then I find water while there is still time remaining [for prayer], so he said: Do not repeat the prayer, for the Lord of water is the same Lord of earth.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum And Prayer For One Who Is Prevented From Leaving For Ablution Due To Crowd, And It Is Recommended To Repeat The Prayer
arabicText: موي وأ ،ةعمجلا موي ماحزلا طسو يف نوكي لجر نع لئس هنأ (ملاسلا مهيلع) ليع نع ،هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع .فرصنا اذإ ديعيو مهعم ليصيو مميتي :لقا ؟سانلا ةرثك نم دجسملا نم جورخلا عيطتسي لا ،ةفرع
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father, from Ali (peace be upon them) that he was asked about a man who is in the middle of a crowd on Friday or on the day of Arafah, unable to leave the mosque due to the large number of people? He said: He should perform tayammum and pray with them, and repeat [the prayer] when he leaves.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum And Prayer For One Who Is Prevented From Leaving For Ablution Due To Crowd, And It Is Recommended To Repeat The Prayer
arabicText: نوكي لجر نع لئس هنأ (ملاسلا مهيلع) ليع نع ،هيبأ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ةعامس نع ؟ماحزلا ةرثك نم جورخلا عيطتسي لاو ءوضو ريغ لىع هنأ ركذ وأ ثدحفأ ةفرع موي وأ ةعمجلا موي ماحزلا طسو .فرصنا وه اذإ ديعيو مهعم ليصيو مميتي :لقا جورخلا نوك لىع لمحلا لمتحيو ،رم امل بابحتسلاا لىع لمحيف بوجولا يف حيرص ريغ اذه :لوقأ .دوصقملا لىع لدي ام مدقت دقو ،ةداعلإا بجتف ،ارذعتم لا ارسعتم
englishText: From Sama'ah, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), from his father, from Ali (peace be upon them) that he was asked about a man who is in the middle of a crowd on Friday or on the day of Arafah and he breaks his ablution or remembers that he is without ablution and cannot leave due to the large crowd? He said: He should perform tayammum and pray with them, and repeat [the prayer] when he leaves. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is not explicit in obligation, so it is interpreted as recommendation based on what has passed, and it might be interpreted as the case where leaving is difficult but not impossible, so repeating becomes obligatory, and what has been mentioned earlier indicates the intended meaning.

chapter: The One Who Intentionally Becomes Junub (Ritually Impure) Then Performs Tayammum And Prays While Fearing Death, It Is Recommended For Him To Repeat
arabicText: فاخيو ةدرابلا ةليللا يف ةبانجلا هبيصت لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لأس هنأ نانس نب الله دبع نع .ةلاصلا داعأو لستغا دربلا نمأ اذفإ ،ليصيو مميتي :لاقف ؟لستغا نإ فلتلا هسفن لىع هب دارملا نأ لىع لدي ام مدقت دقو .باحصلأا ضعب اهيلع هلمح امنإو ،ةبانجلا دمعت يف حيرص ريغ اذه :لوقأ .ملعأ اللهو ،هرذعت مدعو لسغلا رسعت لىع لمحلا لمتحي هنأ عم ،بابحتسلاا هلاثمبأو
englishText: From Abdullah ibn Sinan, that he asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who becomes junub on a cold night and fears death for himself if he performs ghusl (ritual bath)? He said: He should perform tayammum and pray, then when he is safe from the cold, he should perform ghusl and repeat the prayer. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is not explicit regarding intentional impurity, rather some companions interpreted it as such. What has preceded indicates that this and similar narrations indicate recommendation, although it could also be interpreted as referring to difficulty in performing ghusl rather than its impossibility, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Obligation Of Enduring Severe Hardship In Ghusl For One Who Deliberately Enters The State Of Janabah, Unlike One Who Has A Wet Dream, And The Impermissibility Of Tayammum For The One Who Does It Deliberately
arabicText: نإو ،لستغيلف وه بنجأ ناك نإ :لقا ؟ةبانج هتباصأ رودجم نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .مميتيلف ملتحا ناك
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a person with smallpox who enters the state of janabah? He said: If he deliberately entered janabah he must perform ghusl, and if it was from a wet dream then he should perform tayammum.

chapter: Obligation Of Enduring Severe Hardship In Ghusl For One Who Deliberately Enters The State Of Janabah, Unlike One Who Has A Wet Dream, And The Impermissibility Of Tayammum For The One Who Does It Deliberately
arabicText: .مميت ملتحا ناو ،هنم ناك ام لىع لستغي نأ هيلعف بنجأ نإ :لقا هعفر هيبأ نع ،ميهاربإ نب ليع نعو
englishText: From Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, in a raised chain, he said: If one deliberately enters janabah, he must perform ghusl regardless of his condition, and if it was from a wet dream, he performs tayammum.

chapter: Obligation Of Enduring Severe Hardship In Ghusl For One Who Deliberately Enters The State Of Janabah, Unlike One Who Has A Wet Dream, And The Impermissibility Of Tayammum For The One Who Does It Deliberately
arabicText: تنع هبيصي نأ لستغا وه نإ فوختف ةدربا ضرأ يف ناك لجر نع لئس هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هباصأ ام هباصأ نإو لستغي :لقا ؟عنصي فيك ،لسغلا نم - ةدربا حيرلا ةديدش ةليل تناكو ،دربا ناكم يف وهو ةبانج هتباصفأ عجولا ديدش اعجو ناك هنأ ركذو - لقا ينوعضوو ينولمحف ،دب سيل :تلقف !كيلع فاخن ناإ :اولاقف ،ينولسغفا ينولمحا :مهل تلقف ةملغلا توعدف .ينولسغف ءاملا ليع اوبص مث ،تابشخ لىع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he was asked about a man in a cold land who feared that if he performed ghusl he would suffer hardship from it, what should he do? He said: He should perform ghusl regardless of what befalls him. He said- and mentioned that he was severely ill and entered the state of janabah in a cold place, and it was a very cold and windy night- so I called the servants and told them: Carry me and wash me. They said: We fear for you! I said: There is no alternative. So they carried me and placed me on wooden planks, then poured water He said- and mentioned that he was severely ill and entered the state of janabah in a cold place, and it was a very cold and windy night- so I called the servants and told them: Carry me and wash me. They said: We fear for you! I said: There is no alternative. So they carried me and placed me on wooden planks, then poured water on me and washed me.

chapter: Obligation Of Enduring Severe Hardship In Ghusl For One Who Deliberately Enters The State Of Janabah, Unlike One Who Has A Wet Dream, And The Impermissibility Of Tayammum For The One Who Does It Deliberately
arabicText: دجي لاو ةدربا ضرأ يف ةبانجلا هبيصت لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع نم ارهش ضرمف كلذ لعف هنأ لجر هثدح .ناك ام لىع لستغي :لاقف ؟ادماج ءاملا نوكي نأ ىسعو ،ءاملا وهو هيلإ رطضا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ ركذو .لسغلا نم دب لا هنفإ ،ناك ام لىع لستغا :لاقف ،دربلا .لسغلا نم دب لا :لقاو ،لستغفا انخسم هب هوتفأ ضيرم هزنم وهو ماملاا ةبانج ركذ ةنيرقو ،هضعب يف حيرصتلا ةللادب ،دمعتملا لىع قبس ام عيمج اولمح دق :لوقأ .ملعأ اللهو ،نئارقلا نم ركذ ام ريغو ،كلذ يف دراولا صنلل ملاتحلاا نع
englishText: From Muhammad ibn Muslim who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who enters the state of janabah in a cold land and cannot find water, and perhaps the water is frozen? He said: He should perform ghusl regardless of the situation. A man told him that he did that and fell ill for a month from the cold, but he said: Perform ghusl regardless, for ghusl is absolutely necessary. And Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) mentioned that he was compelled to it while ill, so they brought him warm water and he performed ghusl, and said: Ghusl is absolutely necessary. I (Hurr Amili) say: They have interpreted all the preceding to apply to one who deliberately enters janabah, as evidenced by the explicit mention in some narrations, and the context of mentioning the Imam's janabah while he is above having wet dreams according to explicit texts about this, and other contextual evidence, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Ruling On The Gathering Of A Deceased, Someone In Janabah, And Someone Without Wudu, Or Someone In Janabah And A Group Without Wudu, When There Is Insufficient Water For All
arabicText: يف اوناك رفن ةثلاث نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نسحلا باأ لأس هنأ ،نارجن يبأ نب نمحرلا دبع نع يفكي ام ردق ءاملا نم مهعمو ةلاصلا ترضحو ،ءوضو ريغ لىع ثلاثلاو ،تيم يناثلاو ،بنج مهدحأ :رفس ؟نوعنصي فيكو ،ءاملا ذخيأ نم ،مهدحأ ،ةضيرف ةبانجلا نم لسغلا نلا ءوضو ريغ لىع وه يذلا مميتيو ،مميتب تيملا نفديو ،بنجلا لستغي :لقا .زئاج رخلآل مميتلاو ،ةنس تيملا لسغو لىع لمحلا لمتحيو ،هريغو خيشلا لقا ،نآرقلا نم لا ةنسلا نم هبوجو ملع ام انه ةنسلبا دارملا :لوقأ .رم امل ةبجاو تناك نإو ةعبتملا ةقيرطلا
englishText: From Abd al-Rahman bin Abi Najran, who asked Abu Al-Hasan Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) about three people traveling: one in janabah, one deceased, and one without wudu, when prayer time arrived and they had only enough water for one person, who should take the water and what should they do? He said: The one in janabah should perform ghusl, the deceased should be buried with tayammum, and the one without wudu should perform tayammum, because ghusl from janabah is obligatory, washing the deceased is sunnah, and tayammum is permissible for the other. I (Hurr Amili) say: The intended meaning of sunnah here is what is known to be obligatory from sunnah not from the Quran. The Shaykh and others said it could mean the followed way even if obligatory as mentioned before.

chapter: Ruling On The Gathering Of A Deceased, Someone In Janabah, And Someone Without Wudu, Or Someone In Janabah And A Group Without Wudu, When There Is Insufficient Water For All
arabicText: سيلو ةبانج مهضعب باصفأ رفس يف اوناك موق نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ريصب يبأ نع لا مهو لستغيف بنجلا نوطعي وأ ؟لضفأ وه مه نوؤضوتي ،هلسغل بنجلا يفكي ام لاإ ءاملا نم مهعم .بنجلا مميتيو مه نوؤضوتي :لاقف ؟نوؤضوتي
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about people traveling when some became junub and they only had enough water for the junub's ghusl, is it better for them to perform wudu or give it to the junub for ghusl while they remain without wudu? He said: They should perform wudu and the junub should From Abu Basir who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about people traveling when some became junub and they only had enough water for the junub's ghusl, is it better for them to perform wudu or give it to the junub for ghusl while they remain without wudu? He said: They should perform wudu and the junub should perform tayammum.

chapter: Ruling On The Gathering Of A Deceased, Someone In Janabah, And Someone Without Wudu, Or Someone In Janabah And A Group Without Wudu, When There Is Insufficient Water For All
arabicText: يفكي ام امهعمو اعمتجا بنجو تيم نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس :لقا يسيلفتلا نسحلا نع .ضرفلبا ئدب ةضيرفو ةنس تعمتجا اذإ :لقا ؟لستغي امهيأ ،امهدحأ
englishText: From Al-Hasan Al-Taflisi who said: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a deceased and someone in janabah together with only enough water for one, which should perform ghusl? He said: When a sunnah and an obligation combine, begin with the obligation.

chapter: Ruling On The Gathering Of A Deceased, Someone In Janabah, And Someone Without Wudu, Or Someone In Janabah And A Group Without Wudu, When There Is Insufficient Water For All
arabicText: رفسلا يف نونوكي موقلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا باأ تلأس :لقا ،ينمرلأا رضنلا نب نيسحلا نع لستغي :لقا ؟هب أدبي امهيأ ،امهدحأ يفكي ام ردق ليلق ءام مهعمو ،بنج مهعمو ،تيم مهنم توميف .ةنس اذهو ةضيرف اذه نلا ،تيملا كرتيو ،بنجلا
englishText: From Al-Husayn bin Al-Nadr Al-Armani who said: I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about people traveling when one dies among them, and they have someone in janabah, and little water only sufficient for one, which should begin? He said: The one in janabah should perform ghusl and leave the deceased, because this is obligatory and that is sunnah.

chapter: Ruling On The Gathering Of A Deceased, Someone In Janabah, And Someone Without Wudu, Or Someone In Janabah And A Group Without Wudu, When There Is Insufficient Water For All
arabicText: ام ردقب لاإ ءاملا هيف نوكي لا ناكم يف ناقفتي بنجلاو تيملا :هل تلق :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ءاملبا تيملا لستغيو ،بنجلا مميتي :لقا ؟هل ءاملا لعجي نأ ىلوأ امهيأ ،امهدحأ هب يفتكي ،فلاتخلاا كلذ لىع نئارقلا نمو ،بابحتسلااو ةيولولأا ديفت لب ،بوجولا يف ةحيرص ريغ ثيداحلأا هذه :لوقأ .رييختلا لىع لمحيف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), I said to him: A deceased and someone in janabah are in a place with water only sufficient for one, which has more right to the water? He said: The one in janabah should perform tayammum and the deceased should be washed with water. I (Hurr Amili) say: These hadiths are not explicit in obligation, but rather indicate priority and recommendation, and among the evidence for this is the difference in rulings, so it is interpreted as giving choice.

chapter: Invalidation Of Tayammum By Everything That Invalidates Wudhu, And By Having Access To Water Usage, And If Usage Becomes Difficult Then Tayammum Becomes Obligatory, And If The Junub's Tayammum Is Invalidated Even By Minor Ritual Impurity Then Ghusl Becomes Obligatory
arabicText: ،معن :لقا ؟اهلك راهنلاو ليللا ةلاص دحاو ءوضوب لجرلا ليصي :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ تلق :لقا ةرارز نع ،اءام بصي وأ ،ثدحي مل ام ،معن :لقا ؟اهلك راهنلاو ليللا ةلاص دحاو مميتب ليصيف :تلق ،ثدحي مل ام :لقا ؟هيلع كلذ (رسعف ،دارأ املك) هيلع ردقي هنأ نظو ،رخآ ءام لىع ردقي نأ اجرو ،ءاملا باصأ نفإ :تلق .مميتلا ديعي نأ هيلعو ،همميت كلذ ضقني
englishText: From Zurarah who said: I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): Can a man pray with one wudu all prayers of night and day? He said: Yes, as long as he does not nullify it. I said: Can he pray with one tayammum all prayers of night and day? He said: Yes, as long as he does not nullify it or find water. I said: If he finds water and hopes to have access to other water, and thinks he can get it whenever he wants, but it becomes difficult for him? He said: This invalidates his tayammum, and he must perform tayammum again.

chapter: Invalidation Of Tayammum By Everything That Invalidates Wudhu, And By Having Access To Water Usage, And If Usage Becomes Difficult Then Tayammum Becomes Obligatory, And If The Junub's Tayammum Is Invalidated Even By Minor Ritual Impurity Then Ghusl Becomes Obligatory
arabicText: مث ،ديعصلبا مميتف ،ةلاصلا ترضحو ،ءاملا لىع ردقي ملف بنجأ لجر نع ،هلأس نمع ،يرماعلا نيسح نع توف فاخو ،ءاملا ىلإ هتني ملو ىرخلأا ةلاصلا تقو لخدف ،كلذ ءارو رخآ اءام رظتناو ،لستغي ملو ءاملبا رم .لستغي ملو ءاملبا رم نيح ضقتنا لولأا همميت نفإ ،ليصيو مميتي :لقا ،ةلاصلا
englishText: From Husayn Al-Amiri, from one who asked him about a man who became junub and couldn't find water, and prayer time came, so he performed tayammum with earth, then passed by water but didn't perform ghusl, waiting for other water beyond that, then the time for another prayer entered while he hadn't reached water, and feared missing the prayer. He said: He should perform tayammum and pray, for his first tayammum was invalidated when he passed by water and didn't perform ghusl.

chapter: Invalidation Of Tayammum By Everything That Invalidates Wudhu, And By Having Access To Water Usage, And If Usage Becomes Difficult Then Tayammum Becomes Obligatory, And If The Junub's Tayammum Is Invalidated Even By Minor Ritual Impurity Then Ghusl Becomes Obligatory
arabicText: امل أضوتيلو ،هيلع ءاضق لاف ءاملا دجو اذفإ لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ةرارز ثيدح يف مدقت دقو .لبقتسي
englishText: It was previously mentioned in Zurarah's hadith from one of them (peace be upon them) who said: When he finds water, he doesn't need to make up prayers, but should perform wudu for future prayers.

chapter: Invalidation Of Tayammum By Everything That Invalidates Wudhu, And By Having Access To Water Usage, And If Usage Becomes Difficult Then Tayammum Becomes Obligatory, And If The Junub's Tayammum Is Invalidated Even By Minor Ritual Impurity Then Ghusl Becomes Obligatory
arabicText: يبلحلا ثيدح يفو .لستغيلف اءام دجو اذفإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،نانس نبا ثيدح يفو .لستغيلف اءام دجو اذفإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) هنع
englishText: In Ibn Sinan's hadith from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When he f inds water, he should perform ghusl. And in Al-Halabi's hadith from him (peace be upon him): When he finds water, he should perform ghusl.

chapter: Invalidation Of Tayammum By Everything That Invalidates Wudhu, And By Having Access To Water Usage, And If Usage Becomes Difficult Then Tayammum Becomes Obligatory, And If The Junub's Tayammum Is Invalidated Even By Minor Ritual Impurity Then Ghusl Becomes Obligatory
arabicText: نإ ءوضولاو ،ابنج تنك نإ لسغلا كيلعف ءاملا تبصأ ىتمو :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز ثيدح يفو .ابنج نكت مل
englishText: In Zurarah's hadith from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): When you find water, you must perform ghusl if you're junub, and wudu if you're not junub.

chapter: Invalidation Of Tayammum By Everything That Invalidates Wudhu, And By Having Access To Water Usage, And If Usage Becomes Difficult Then Tayammum Becomes Obligatory, And If The Junub's Tayammum Is Invalidated Even By Minor Ritual Impurity Then Ghusl Becomes Obligatory
arabicText: مميتلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،بويأ يبأ نع (هريسفت) يف يشايعلا دوعسم نب دمحم :لقا ؟(ابيط اديعص اومميتف) :لوقي الله سيلأ ،ءام نم ريدغ نم أضوت نمك ءاملا دجي مل نمل ديعصلبا ةلاص مميتلبا ليصيف :هل تلق :لقا ،هتلاص تضم دق :لاقف :لقا ؟تقولا رخآ يف وهو ءاملا باصأ نفإ :تلق .مميتلا ضقتنا هيلع ردقي ناكو ءاملا ىأر اذإ :لقا ؟ىرخأ .هيلع لدي ام يتيأو ،قالاطإو امومع ضقاونلا يف كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ
englishText: Muhammad bin Masood Al-Ayyashi in his Tafsir from Abu Ayyub, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Tayammum with clean earth for one who cannot find water is like one who performs ablution from a pool of water. Does not Allah say And perform tayammum with clean earth [Quran, 4:43]? I asked: What if one finds water at the end of prayer time? He said: His prayer has already been completed. I asked him: Can he pray another prayer with the same tayammum? He said: When he sees water and is able to use it, the tayammum becomes invalid. I (Hurr Amili) say: What indicates this has preceded in the invalidators generally and absolutely, and what indicates it will come.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing Multiple Prayers With One Tayammum As Long As One Does Not Nullify It Or Find Water
arabicText: ،معن :لاقف ؟اهلك راهنلاو ليللا ةلاص دحاو مميتب لجرلا ليصي :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ تلق :لقا ةرارز نع .اءام بصي وأ ،ثدحي مل ام
englishText: From Zurarah who said: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): Can a man pray all night and day prayers with one tayammum? He said: Yes, as long as he does not nullify it or find water.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing Multiple Prayers With One Tayammum As Long As One Does Not Nullify It Or Find Water
arabicText: .ءاملا دجي نأ ىلإ كلذ هيزجي :لقا ،مميت لجر يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man who performed tayammum, he said: That suffices him until he finds water.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing Multiple Prayers With One Tayammum As Long As One Does Not Nullify It Or Find Water
arabicText: مميتيأ ،ءاملا دجي لا لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا نامثع نب دامح نع ،ةلاضف نع ،هنعو .ءاملا ةلزنمب وه ،لا :لاقف ؟ةلاص لكل
englishText: And from him, from Fadala, from Hammad bin Uthman who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who cannot find water, should he perform tayammum for each prayer? He said: No, it is like water (*). Translator: * Just like how one ablution with water suffices for multiple prayers.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing Multiple Prayers With One Tayammum As Long As One Does Not Nullify It Or Find Water
arabicText: لىع لومحم اذه :لوقأ .ءاملا دجوي ىتح ةلاص لكل مميتي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع ،مامه يبأ نع .رم امل ءاملا لامعتسا نم نكمتلا لىع وأ ،ةيقتلا لىع وأ ،مميتلا ضقني ثدح لوصح
englishText: From Abu Hammam, from Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: He should perform tayammum for each prayer until water is found. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted as occurring when there is an event that nullifies tayammum, or based on taqiyyah, or on the ability to use water as previously mentioned.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing Multiple Prayers With One Tayammum As Long As One Does Not Nullify It Or Find Water
arabicText: مميتب راهنلاو ليللا ةلاص ليصت نبأ سبأ لا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،هيبأ نع ،دمحم نب رفعج نع .ءاملا بصت وأ ،ثدحت مل ام دحاو
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) who said: There is no problem in praying night and day prayers with one tayammum as long as you do not nullify it or find water.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing Multiple Prayers With One Tayammum As Long As One Does Not Nullify It Or Find Water
arabicText: .اهتلفناو ةدحاو ةلاص لاإ مميتلبا عتمتي لا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،هيبأ نع ،دمحم نب رفعج نع
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) who said: One cannot benefit from tayammum except for one prayer and its optional prayers.

chapter: Permissibility Of Performing Multiple Prayers With One Tayammum As Long As One Does Not Nullify It Or Find Water
arabicText: .نينس رشع ديعصلا كيفكي ،رذبا يا :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نأ ،(ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،رفعج نع
englishText: From Ja'far, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: O Abu Dharr, clean earth is sufficient for you for ten years.

chapter: The One Who Enters Prayer With Tayammum Then Finds Water Must Leave, Purify And Restart If They Have Not Performed Ruku
arabicText: :لقا ،ةلاصلا يف لخد دقو ءاملا باصأ نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ تلق :لقا - ثيدح يف - ةرارز نع .نيروهطلا دحأ مميتلا نفإ ،هتلاص يف ضميلف عكر دق ناك نفإ ،عكري مل ام أضوتيلف فرصنيلف
englishText: From Zurarah- in a hadith- he said: I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): If one f inds water after having started the prayer? He said: Let him leave and perform wudu if he has not done ruku. If he has done ruku, let him continue his prayer, for tayammum is one of the two purifications.

chapter: The One Who Enters Prayer With Tayammum Then Finds Water Must Leave, Purify And Restart If They Have Not Performed Ruku
arabicText: يف موقيو مميتيف ءاملا دجي لا لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا مصاع نب الله دبع نع يف ضميلف عكر دق ناك نإو ،أضوتيلو فرصنيلف عكري مل ناك نإ :لاقف ،ءاملا اذ وه :لاقف ملاغلا ءاجف ةلاصلا .هتلاص
englishText: From Abdullah bin 'Asim who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who cannot find water so performs tayammum and stands for prayer, then a servant comes saying "here is water." He said: If he has not performed ruku, let him leave and perform wudu, but if he has done ruku, let him continue his prayer.

chapter: The One Who Enters Prayer With Tayammum Then Finds Water Must Leave, Purify And Restart If They Have Not Performed Ruku
arabicText: ردقي ملف ءاملا بلط ناك دقو ةلاصلا يف لخد مث مميت لجر :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع مميتي نأ دحلا يغبني سيل هنأ ملعاو ،ةلاصلا يف يضمي :لقا ،ةلاصلا يف لخدي نيح ءاملبا ىتؤي مث هيلع .تقولا رخآ يف لاإ .هرخآ ةنيرقب تقولا قيض لىع وأ ،قبس امل عكر دق هنوك لىع اذه لمح يغبني :لوقأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), I said to him: A man performs tayammum then enters prayer having searched for water but not found it, then water is brought to him after entering prayer. He said: He continues the prayer. And know that no one should perform tayammum except at the end of the time. I (Hurr Amili) say: This should be interpreted as applying when he has performed ruku based on what preceded, or when time is short as indicated by its end.

chapter: The One Who Enters Prayer With Tayammum Then Finds Water Must Leave, Purify And Restart If They Have Not Performed Ruku
arabicText: ،نيتعكر لىصو مميتف ةلاصلا ترضحو ءاملا بصي مل لجر يف :تلق :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع ،ةرارز نع لاو اهمتيف هتلاص يف يضمي هنكلو ،لا :لقا ؟ليصي مث أضوتيو امهعطقي وأ ،نيتعكرلا ضقنيأ ،ءاملا باصأ مث .مميتب رهط لىع وهو اهلخد (هنأ ناكمل) اهضقني
englishText: From Zurarah, from Muhammad bin Muslim who said: I asked about a man who could not find water when prayer time came, so he performed tayammum and prayed two rak'ahs, then found water- should he invalidate the two rak'ahs or cut them off, perform wudu then pray? He said: No, rather he continues his prayer to completion and does not invalidate it (because) he entered it in a state of purity with tayammum.

chapter: The One Who Enters Prayer With Tayammum Then Finds Water Must Leave, Purify And Restart If They Have Not Performed Ruku
arabicText: ناتبرق هعمو لجر ءاج مث مميت لىع ةعكر لىص لجر نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع ةدحاو لىع ينبي مث أضوتيو ةلاصلا عطقي :لقا ؟ءام نم
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a man who prayed one rak'ah with tayammum then a man came with two water skins? He said: He cuts off the prayer, performs wudu then builds upon the one [rak'ah].

chapter: The One Who Enters Prayer With Tayammum Then Finds Water Must Leave, Purify And Restart If They Have Not Performed Ruku
arabicText: لىص دقو رهن هب رمف ليصي مقا مث مميت لجر (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا لقيصلا نسحلا نع .ديعي لا :لقا ،اهلك هتلاص لىص دق هنإ :تلقف .ةلاصلا لبقتسيلو لستغيلف :لقا ،ةعكر حيرصلا صنلا دوجوو ،اهل هتقفاومل ةيقتلا لىع هلمح نكميو ،بابحتسلاا لىع خيشلا هلمح :لوقأ .كلذ لىع هلمح لمتحيو ،ليصفتلبا
englishText: From Al-Hasan Al-Sayqal who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): A man performs tayammum then stands to pray, then passes by a river after praying one rak'ah? He said: Let him perform ghusl and restart the prayer. I said: But he has completed his whole prayer. He said: He does not repeat it. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted this as recommended, and it can be interpreted as taqiyyah due to its agreement with it, and the existence of explicit text with details, and it is possible to interpret it as such.

chapter: Obligation Of Delaying Tayammum And Prayer Until The End Of Time When Hoping For The Removal Of The Excuse Specifically
arabicText: رخآ ىلإ مميتلا رخفأ مميتلا تدرأو اءام دجت مل اذإ :لوقي هتعمس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ضرلأا كتفت مل ءاملا كتفا نفإ ،تقولا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I heard him saying: If you do not f ind water and want to perform tayammum, then delay the tayammum until the end of time, for if you miss water, you will not miss earth.

chapter: Obligation Of Delaying Tayammum And Prayer Until The End Of Time When Hoping For The Removal Of The Excuse Specifically
arabicText: نأ فاخ اذفإ ،تقولا يف ماد ام بلطيلف ءاملا رفاسملا دجي مل اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ةرارز نع .تقولا رخآ يف لصيلو ،مميتيلف تقولا هتوفي
englishText: From Zurarah, from one of them (peace be upon them), he said: If a traveler does not f ind water, he should seek it as long as there is time. If he fears missing the time, he should perform tayammum and pray at the end of time.

chapter: Obligation Of Delaying Tayammum And Prayer Until The End Of Time When Hoping For The Removal Of The Excuse Specifically
arabicText: ،سبأ لا :لقا ،روهط لىع مهو مميت دقو بنج وهو اموق مأ لجر :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ضرلأا هتوفت نلف ءاملا هتفا نفإ ،تقولا رخآ يف كلذ نكيلف لجرلا مميت اذفإ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a man who led people in prayer while he was in a state of janabah (sexual impurity) and had performed tayammum while they had ritual purity. He said: There is no problem, but when a man performs tayammum, let it be at the end of time, for if he misses water, he will not miss earth.

chapter: Obligation Of Delaying Tayammum And Prayer Until The End Of Time When Hoping For The Removal Of The Excuse Specifically
arabicText: ؟ليصيو مميتي ،اءام دجي ملف بنجأ لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ريكب نب الله دبع نع .ضرلأا هتفت مل ءاملا هتفا نإ هنإ ،تقولا رخآ ىتح ،لا لقا
englishText: From Abdullah bin Bukair, he said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who becomes ritually impure and does not find water, should he perform From Abdullah bin Bukair, he said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who becomes ritually impure and does not find water, should he perform tayammum and pray? He said: No, until the end of time, for if he misses water, he will not miss earth.

chapter: Obligation Of Delaying Tayammum And Prayer Until The End Of Time When Hoping For The Removal Of The Excuse Specifically
arabicText: نأ دحلا يغبني سيل هنأ ملعاو :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،نارمح نب دمحم ثيدح يف مدقت دقو .تقولا رخآ يف لاإ مميتي لىع وأ ،كلذ لىع لومحم ريخلأفا ،رذعلا لاوز ءاجر ضورفملا نأ لىع ثيداحلأا هذه يف ةرهاظ نئارقلا :لوقأ لىع ةداعلإا بوجو مدع لىع ةلادلا ثيداحلأا نم مدقت ام اضيأ كلذ لىع لديو (يغبني) ظفل ةللادب بابحتسلاا .ملعأ اللهو .كلذ ريغو تقولا ءاقب عم رذعلا لاز مث مميتب لىص نم
englishText: And it was previously mentioned in the hadith of Muhammad bin Hamran, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: And know that no one should perform tayammum except at the end of time. I (Hurr Amili) say: The evidence is clear in these hadiths that the assumption is hoping for the removal of the excuse, so the last one is interpreted accordingly, or on recommendation as indicated by the word (should), and this is also evidenced by the previous hadiths indicating that it is not obligatory to repeat the prayer for one who prayed with tayammum and then the excuse was removed while time remained, and other such matters. And Allah knows best.

chapter: The One Performing Tayammum Is Permitted What The One Who Purifies With Water Is Permitted
arabicText: .اروهط ءاملا لعج امك اروهط بارتلا لعج الله نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed Allah made earth a purifier just as He made water a purifier.

chapter: The One Performing Tayammum Is Permitted What The One Who Purifies With Water Is Permitted
arabicText: :لاقف ؟ةلاص لكل مميتيأ ،ءاملا دجي لا لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا نامثع نب دامح نع .ءاملا ةلزنمب وه ،لا
englishText: From Hammad bin Uthman who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who cannot find water, should he perform tayammum for every prayer? He said: No, it is of the same status as water. Translator: Tayammum for every prayer is not required just as one ablution with water suffices for multiple prayers, until it is invalidated.

chapter: The One Performing Tayammum Is Permitted What The One Who Purifies With Water Is Permitted
arabicText: .ءاملا دجي نأ ىلإ كلذ هيزجي :لقا ،مميت لجر يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ةرارز ثيدح يف مدقت دقو
englishText: And it has preceded in the hadith of Zurarah, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man who performed tayammum, he said: That suffices him until he finds water.

chapter: The One Performing Tayammum Is Permitted What The One Who Purifies With Water Is Permitted
arabicText: كيفكي ،رذبا يا :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ينوكسلا ثيدح يفو .نينس رشع ديعصلا
englishText: And in the hadith of Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: O Bazr, clean earth suffices you for ten years.

chapter: The One Performing Tayammum Is Permitted What The One Who Purifies With Water Is Permitted
arabicText: .نيروهطلا دحأ مميتلا نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز ثيدح يفو
englishText: And in the hadith of Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed tayammum is one of the two purifiers.

chapter: The One Performing Tayammum Is Permitted What The One Who Purifies With Water Is Permitted
arabicText: .نيروهطلا دحأ لعف دقف ،ديعصلا بر وه ءاملا بر نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed the Lord of water is the Lord of clean earth, so he has performed one of the two purifiers.

chapter: Obligation Of Tayammum For The Junub Even If He Finds Water Sufficient Only For Wudu, And The Invalidity Of Performing Only Wudu
arabicText: نم هيفكي ام ردق هعمو بنجي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لأس هنأ يبلحلا ليع نب الله ديبع نع .!؟ءوضولا فصن هيلع لعج امنإ هنأ ىرت لاأ ،مميتي لب لا :لقا ؟مميتي وأ ءاملبا أضوتيأ ،ةلاصلا ءوضول ءاملا
englishText: From Ubaydullah bin Ali Al-Halabi that he asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who becomes junub and has with him water only sufficient for the wudu of prayer, should he perform wudu with water or tayammum? He said: Rather, he should perform tayammum. Don't you see that only half of the purification was prescribed for him?!

chapter: Obligation Of Tayammum For The Junub Even If He Finds Water Sufficient Only For Wudu, And The Invalidity Of Performing Only Wudu
arabicText: هتباصأ موق مامإ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لاأس امهنأ جارد نب ليمجو نارمح نب دمحم نع هدانسإبو مميتي نكلو ،لا :لاقف ؟مهب ليصيو مهضعب أضوتيأ ،لسغلل هيفكي ام ءاملا نم هعم سيلو رفسلا يف ةبانج .اروهط ءاملا لعج امك اروهط بارتلا لعج لجو زع الله نفإ ،مهب ليصيو بنجلا
englishText: And by his chain from Muhammad bin Hamran and Jameel bin Darraj that they both asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about an imam of a people who becomes junub during travel and doesn't have enough water for ghusl, should some of them perform wudu and he leads them in prayer? He said: No, but the junub should perform tayammum and lead them in prayer, for Allah the Mighty and Majestic made earth a purifier just as He made water a purifier.

chapter: Obligation Of Tayammum For The Junub Even If He Finds Water Sufficient Only For Wudu, And The Invalidity Of Performing Only Wudu
arabicText: ام ردقب ءاملا نم هعمو بنجي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ءلاعلا يبأ نب نيسحلا نع .روهطلا فصن هيلع لعج هنأ ىرت لاأ ،مميتي :لقا ؟مميتي وأ ءاملبا أضوتيأ ،ةلاصلل هئوضول هيفكي
englishText: From Al-Husayn bin Abi Al-'Ala who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who becomes junub and has water only sufficient for his wudu for prayer, should he perform wudu with water or tayammum? He said: He should perform tayammum. Don't you see that only half of the purification was prescribed for him.

chapter: Obligation Of Tayammum For The Junub Even If He Finds Water Sufficient Only For Wudu, And The Invalidity Of Performing Only Wudu
arabicText: :لقا ،هب أضوتي ام ردق ءام هعمو رفس يف بنجأ لجر يف (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ملسم نب دمحم نع .أضوتي لاو مميتي
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim, from one of them (peace be upon them both) regarding a man who becomes junub during travel and has water only sufficient for wudu, he said: He should perform tayammum and not wudu.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum Despite Having Water That One Needs For Drinking, When It Does Not Exceed The Necessary Amount For Purification, And The Non-obligation Of Spilling Water
arabicText: نإ فاخيو ليلق ءام لاإ هعم سيلو رفسلا يف ةبانج هتباصأ لجر يف :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .يلإ بحأ ديعصلا نفإ ،ديعصلبا مميتيلو ،ةرطق هنم قيرهي لاف اشطع فاخ نإ :لقا ؟شطعي نأ لستغا وه
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he said regarding a man who becomes junub during travel and has only a little water with him and fears thirst if he performs ghusl? He said: If he fears thirst, he should not spill a single drop of it, and should perform tayammum with earth, for earth is more beloved to me.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum Despite Having Water That One Needs For Drinking, When It Does Not Exceed The Necessary Amount For Purification, And The Non-obligation Of Spilling Water
arabicText: هب لستغا وه نفإ ،ليلقلا ءاملا هعم نوكي بنجلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا يبلحلا دمحم نع .ءوضولا دارأ اذإ كلذكو ،مميتي لب :لاقف ؟مميتي وأ هب لستغيأ ،شطعلا فاخ
englishText: From Muhammad al-Halabi who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a junub person who has little water, and if he performs ghusl with it he fears thirst, should he perform ghusl with it or tayammum? He said: Rather, he should perform tayammum, and likewise if he wants to perform wudu.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum Despite Having Water That One Needs For Drinking, When It Does Not Exceed The Necessary Amount For Purification, And The Non-obligation Of Spilling Water
arabicText: ءاملا هعم نوكي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ةعامس نع ،ةعرز نع ،نسحلا نع ،هنعو ءاملا :اروهط امهلعج لجو زع الله نفإ ،ءاملا يقبتسيو ديعصلبا مميتي :لقا ؟هتلق فاخيف رفسلا يف .ديعصلاو
englishText: And from him, from al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who has water while traveling but fears its scarcity? He said: He should perform tayammum with earth and keep the water, for Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has made them both purifiers: water and earth.

chapter: Permissibility Of Tayammum Despite Having Water That One Needs For Drinking, When It Does Not Exceed The Necessary Amount For Purification, And The Non-obligation Of Spilling Water
arabicText: هيفكي ام ردق ءاملا نم هعمو ،بنجي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا روفعي يبأ نبا نع !؟روهطلا فصن هيلع لعج امنإ هنأ ىرت لاأ ،لضفأ مميتي :لقا ؟أضوتي وأ مميتيأ ،هبرشل
englishText: From Ibn Abi Ya'fur who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who becomes junub and has only enough water for drinking, should he perform tayammum or wudu? He said: Tayammum is better, don't you see that only half the purification is required of him?!

chapter: Obligation Of Purchasing Water For Purification Even If The Price Is High, And The Impermissibility Of Tayammum When Able To Purchase
arabicText: ،ءاملا لىع ردقي لا وهو ةلاصلل ءوضولا ىلإ جاتحا لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس :لقا ناوفص نع لب ،لا :لقا ؟مميتي وأ أضوتيو يرتشي ،اهل دجاو وهو مهرد فلبأ وأ مهرد ةئامب هب أضوتي ام ردقب دجوف .ريثك لام كلذب ينرسي امو تأضوتو تيرتشفا كلذ لثم ينباصأ دق ،يرتشي
englishText: From Safwan who said: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a man who needs to perform ablution for prayer and cannot find water, then he finds enough water for ablution for one hundred dirhams or one thousand dirhams and he has the means- should he buy and perform ablution or perform tayammum? He said: No, rather he should buy. I experienced something similar, so I bought and performed ablution, and no amount of wealth would make me happier than that.

chapter: Obligation Of Purchasing Water For Purification Even If The Price Is High, And The Impermissibility Of Tayammum When Able To Purchase
arabicText: هيلع) احلاص ادبع تلأس :لقا ةحلط يبأ نب نيسحلا نع (هريسفت) يف يشايعلا دوعسم نب دمحم :لقا ؟كلذ دح ام ،(ابيط اديعص اومميتف اءام اودجت ملف ءاسنلا متسملا وأ) :لجو زع الله لوق نع (ملاسلا .هتدج ردق لىع كلذ :لقا ؟غلب مكو ،فلبأ وأ ،فلأ ةئامب ءوضو ردق دجو نإ :ءارش ريغب وأ ءارشب اودجت مل نفإ
englishText: Muhammad bin Masood Al-Ayyashi in his Tafsir from Al-Husain bin Abi Talha who said: I asked a righteous servant (peace be upon him) about the saying of Allah the Mighty and Majestic "or you have contacted women and find no water, then seek clean earth" [Quran, 4:43], what is its limit? He said: If you do not find it by purchase or without purchase: if one finds enough water for ablution for a hundred thousand or for a thousand, and how much it costs? He said: That depends on one's means.

chapter: Disliking Of Sexual Intercourse Without Water (For Purification) Except In Necessity And Its Non-Prohibition
arabicText: ،ءاملا دجي لاف رفسلا يف هلهأ عم نوكي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) ميهاربإ باأ تلأس :لقا رامع نب قاحسإ نع .هسفن لىع فاخي وأ ،اقبش نوكي نأ لاإ كلذ لعفي نأ بحأ ام :لاقف ؟هلهأ يتيأ
englishText: From Ishaq bin Ammar who said: I asked Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) about a man who is with his wife while traveling and cannot find water, can he approach his wife? He said: I do not like him to do that unless he is lustful or fears for himself.

chapter: Disliking Of Sexual Intercourse Without Water (For Purification) Except In Necessity And Its Non-Prohibition
arabicText: كلذب بلطي :تلق :دازو .هلثم ،بوبحم نب ليع نب دمحم باتك نم لاقن (رئارسلا) رخآ يف سيردإ نبا هاورو تئا :لاقف ؟اذه نع هلأس رذ باأ نأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نع يور هنفإ :تلقف ،للاح وه :لقا ؟ةذللا .ترجأ للاحلا تيتأ اذإ كلذكف ،ترزأ مارحلا تيتأ اذإ كنإ ،معن :لقا ؟رجؤأو ،الله لوسر يا :لاقف ،رجؤت كلهأ .رجأ للاحلا ىتفأ هسفن لىع فاخ اذإ هنأ ىرت لاأ :لاقف
englishText: Ibn Idris narrated it at the end of (Al-Sara'ir) as quoted from the book of Muhammad bin Ali bin Mahboub, similar to it. And added: I said: Is he seeking pleasure in that? He said: It is permissible. So I said: It has been narrated from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) that Abu Dharr asked him about this? He said: Approach your wife, you will be rewarded. He said: O Messenger of Allah, will I be rewarded? He said: Yes, when you approach the forbidden you are burdened with sin, likewise when you approach the permissible you are rewarded. He said: Don't you see that when he fears for himself and approaches what is permissible, he is rewarded.

chapter: Dislike Of Residing In A Place Without Water, Even If For A Purpose
arabicText: لجأ نم ءام اهيف سيل رهشلأا دلابلبا ميقي لجرلا نع لئس هنأ ،(ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،دمحم نع .لا :لقا ؟لبلإا حلاصو يعارملا
englishText: From Muhammad, from one of them (peace be upon them both), that he was asked about a man staying in a land for months where there is no water, for the sake of pastures and the wellbeing of camels? He said: No.

chapter: Dislike Of Residing In A Place Without Water, Even If For A Purpose
arabicText: لاإ دجي ملو رفس يف بنجأ لجر يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ملسم نب دمحم ثيدح يف مدقت دقو .هنيد قبوت يتلا ضرلأا هذه ىلإ دوعي نأ ىرأ لاو ،مميتي ،ةرورضلا ةلزنمب وه :لاقف ،ادماج اءام وأ جلثلا
englishText: And it was previously mentioned in the hadith of Muhammad bin Muslim from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding a man who became junub while traveling and found only snow or frozen water, so he said: This is a situation of necessity, he should perform tayammum, and I do not think he should return to this land that ruins his religion.

chapter: Dislike Of Residing In A Place Without Water, Even If For A Purpose
arabicText: ىلإ صلخت ملو ادماج اءام لاإ دجت ملو ضرأ يف تبنجأ نإ :يور :لقا (عنقملا) يف نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .كنيد اهيف قبوت يتلا ضرلأا ىلإ دعت لا مث ،حسمتلبا لصف ديعصلا
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said in (Al-Muqni'): It is narrated: If you become junub in a land where you find only frozen water and cannot reach clean earth, then pray with wiping (tamasuh), then do not return to the land that ruins your religion.

chapter: Recommendation Of Shaking The Hands After Striking The Ground
arabicText: امهعفر مث ضرلأا هيديب برضف ؟مميتلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ لأس هنأ ،ةرارز ثيدح مدقت دق .هيفكو هتهبج امهب حسم مث ،امهضفنف
englishText: The previous hadith of Zurarah has been mentioned, that he asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about tayammum? So he struck his hands on the ground, then raised them and shook them, then wiped his forehead and palms with them.

chapter: Recommendation Of Shaking The Hands After Striking The Ground
arabicText: ضرلأا لىع هيديب برضف ،مميتلا فصو هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،مادقملا يبأ نب ورمع ثيدحو .هيفكو هنيبج لىع حسم مث ،امهضفنف امهعفر مث
englishText: And the hadith of Amr ibn Abi al-Miqdam, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), that he described tayammum, so he struck his hands on the ground then raised them and shook them, then wiped his forehead and palms.

chapter: Ruling Of One Who Performs Tayammum And Prays In An Impure Garment, Should He Repeat Or Not? And The Tayammum Of The Impure Person (junub) And The Menstruating Woman To Leave The Two Mosques
arabicText: ءام دجي سيلو هيف ةلاصلا لحت لاو بوث لاإ هيلع سيل لجر نع لئس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةلاصلا داعأو هلسغ اءام باصأ اذفإ ،لىصيو مميتي :لقا ؟عنصي فيك ،هلسغي .الله ءاش نإ ،تاساجنلا يف يتيأ املو ،مدقت امل بابحتسلاا لىع لومحم اذه :لوقأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he was asked about a man who has only one garment which is not permissible to pray in, and he cannot find water to wash it, what should he do? He replied: He should perform tayammum and pray, and when he f inds water, he should wash it and repeat the prayer. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted as recommended based on what has preceded, and what will come regarding impurities, Allah willing.

chapter: Ruling Of One Who Performs Tayammum And Prays In An Impure Garment, Should He Repeat Or Not? And The Tayammum Of The Impure Person (junub) And The Menstruating Woman To Leave The Two Mosques
arabicText: وأ مارحلا دجسملا يف امئنا لجرلا ناك اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا :لقا ةزمح يبأ ثيدح يف مدقت دقو ىتح امميتم لاإ دجسملا يف رمي لاو ،مميتيلف ةبانج هتباصفأ ملتحفا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) لوسرلا دجسم .كلذ لعفت ضيحلا اهباصأ اذإ ضئاحلا كلذكو ،لستغي مث ،هنم جرخي
englishText: It has been narrated in the previous hadith of Abu Hamza who said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: If a man is sleeping in the Sacred Mosque or the Prophet's Mosque (peace be upon him and his family) and has a wet dream becoming in a state of janabah (sexual impurity), he should perform tayammum (dry ablution), and should not pass through the mosque except after performing tayammum until he exits from it, then he should perform ghusl (ritual bath). Similarly, a menstruating woman should do the same when she gets her menstruation. Section 7 Impurities, Containers (or Utensils), and Hides (or Leather)

chapter: Impurity Of Urine And The Obligation To Wash It Twice From Clothes And Body Except For An Infant's
arabicText: .نيترم هلسغا :لقا ؟بوثلا بيصي لوبلا نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them), he said: I asked him about urine that gets on clothes? He said: Wash it twice.

chapter: Impurity Of Urine And The Obligation To Wash It Twice From Clothes And Body Except For An Infant's
arabicText: .نيترم هلسغا :لقا ؟بوثلا بيصي لوبلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا روفعي يبأ نبا نع
englishText: From Ibn Abi Ya'fur who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about urine that gets on clothes? He said: Wash it twice.

chapter: Impurity Of Urine And The Obligation To Wash It Twice From Clothes And Body Except For An Infant's
arabicText: .نيترم ءاملا هيلع بص :لقا ؟دسجلا بيصي لوبلا نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about urine that gets on the body? He said: Pour water on it twice.

chapter: Impurity Of Urine And The Obligation To Wash It Twice From Clothes And Body Except For An Infant's
arabicText: هيلع بص :لقا ؟دسجلا بيصي لوبلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ءلاعلا يبأ نب نيسحلا نع .نيترم هلسغا :لقا ؟لوبلا هبيصي بوثلا نع هتلأسو .ءام وه امنفإ ،نيترم ءاملا
englishText: From Al-Husayn bin Abi Al-A'la who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about urine that gets on the body? He said: Pour water on it twice, for it is just water. And I asked him about clothes that get urine on them? He said: Wash them twice.

chapter: Impurity Of Urine And The Obligation To Wash It Twice From Clothes And Body Except For An Infant's
arabicText: .هريغ وأ ةفشحلا سأر لىع ناك اذإ ءاملا نم هلثمب لسغي نأ ئزجي هنأ :يورو :ينيلكلا لقا
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: And it is narrated: It suffices to wash with an equal amount of water when it is on the tip of the glans or elsewhere.

chapter: Impurity Of Urine And The Obligation To Wash It Twice From Clothes And Body Except For An Infant's
arabicText: .كلدي نأ جاتحيف خسوب سيل ءام هنأ :يورو :لقا
englishText: He said: And it is narrated: It is water, not dirt, so it does not need to be rubbed.

chapter: Impurity Of Urine And The Obligation To Wash It Twice From Clothes And Body Except For An Infant's
arabicText: :لقا يطنزبلا رصن يبأ نب دمحم نب دمحلأ (عماجلا) باتك نم لاقن (رئارسلا) رخآ يف سيردإ نب دمحم هبيصي بوثلا نع هتلأسو .ءام وه امنفإ ،نيترم ءاملا هيلع بص :لقا ؟دسجلا بيصي لوبلا نع هتلأس .نيترم هلسغا :لقا ؟لوبلا
englishText: Muhammad bin Idris at the end of (Al-Sara'ir), quoting from the book (Al-Jami') by Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr Al-Bazanti said: I asked him about urine that gets on the body? He said: Pour water on it twice, for it is just water. And I asked him about clothes that get urine on them? He said: Wash them twice.

chapter: Purification Of Clothing When Washed From Urine In A Wash Basin Twice, And In Running Water Once Is Sufficient
arabicText: نكرملا يف هلسغا :لقا ؟لوبلا هبيصي بوثلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع .ةدحاو ةرمف راج ءام يف هتلسغ نفإ ،نيترم .بايثلا اهيف لسغت يتلا ةناجلإا :نكرملا :يرهوجلا لقا
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about clothing that is affected by urine? He said: Wash it in the wash basin twice, but if you wash it in running water then once is sufficient. Al-Jawhari said: Al-Mirkan is the basin in which clothes are washed.

chapter: Purification Of Clothes From The Urine Of A Nursing Infant By Pouring Water Once
arabicText: ؟بوثلا لىع لوبي يبصلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا - ثيدح يف - ءلاعلا يبأ نب نيسحلا نع .هرصعت مث لايلق ءاملا هيلع بصت :لقا
englishText: From Al-Husayn bin Abi Al-'Alaa- in a hadith- he said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about an infant urinating on clothes? He said: Pour a little water on it then wring it.

chapter: Purification Of Clothes From The Urine Of A Nursing Infant By Pouring Water Once
arabicText: لكأ دق ناك نفإ ،ءاملا هيلع بصت :لقا ؟يبصلا لوب نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا يبلحلا نع .ءاوس عرش (كلذ يف) ةيراجلاو ملاغلاو ،لاسغ ءاملبا هلسغفا
englishText: From Al-Halabi who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about infant urine? He said: Pour water on it, but if the infant has eaten food then wash it properly with water, and in this matter male and female infants are the same.

chapter: Purification Of Clothes From The Urine Of A Nursing Infant By Pouring Water Once
arabicText: لسغا :لقا ؟هناكم دجأ مل نفإ :تلق ،هلسغا :لاقف ؟بوثلا بيصي يبصلا لوب نع هتلأس :لقا ةعامس نع .هلك بوثلا لىع لمحلا لمتحيو :لوقأ .لولأا ثيدحلبا لدتساو ،ءاملا هيلع بص :هب دارأ ،هلسغا :هلوق :خيشلا لقا .ماعطلا لكأ نم لىعو ،بابحتسلاا
englishText: From Sama'ah who said: I asked him about infant urine that gets on clothes? He said: Wash it. I said: What if I cannot find its location? He said: Wash the entire garment. The Shaykh said: His saying "wash it" means pour water on it, as evidenced by the first hadith. I (Hurr Amili) say: It could also mean it is recommended, or applies to those who have eaten food.

chapter: Purification Of Clothes From The Urine Of A Nursing Infant By Pouring Water Once
arabicText: لبق بوثلا هنم لسغي اهلوبو ةيراجلا نبل :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع نأ ،(ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع نبل نلا ،معطي نأ لبق هلوب لاو بوثلا هنم لسغي لا ملاغلا نبلو ،اهمأ ةناثم نم جرخي اهنبل نلا ،معطت نأ .نيبكنملاو نيدضعلا نم جرخي ملاغلا لبق بوثلا هنم لسغي اهلوبو ةيراجلا نبل :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع نأ ،(ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع نبل نلا ،معطي نأ لبق هلوب لاو بوثلا هنم لسغي لا ملاغلا نبلو ،اهمأ ةناثم نم جرخي اهنبل نلا ،معطت نأ .نيبكنملاو نيدضعلا نم جرخي ملاغلا ،رصعي مل نإو هيلع ءاملا بص يفكي هنأ هانعم بوثلا هنم لسغي لا يبصلا لوب نأ نم نمضت ام :خيشلا لقا لىع لومحم ةيراجلا نبل نم بوثلا لسغ نم هنمضت امو :لوقأ .ةمدقتملا هتياور يف يبلحلا هنيب ام لىع رابتعبا نيرملاا عومجم ىلإ (هنم) ريمض دوعو ،واولبا فطعلل ،لوبلا عم هعامتجا لىع وأ ،بابحتسلاا .ايماع هيوار نوكو ةماعلا ضعبل هتقفاومل ،ةيقتلل هلامتحا عم ،ادحاو ائيش امهلعج
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon them), that Ali (peace be upon him) said: The milk and urine of a female infant (*)- the clothes should be washed from it before she eats food, because her milk comes from her mother's bladder, while the clothes need not be washed from the milk and urine of a male infant before he eats food, because the male infant's milk comes from the upper arms and shoulders. The Shaykh said: What it contains about not washing clothes from male infant's urine means that pouring water on it suffices even without wringing, as clarified by Al Halabi in his previous narration. I (Hurr Amili) say: And what it contains about washing clothes from female infant's milk is interpreted as recommended, or when combined with urine due to the conjunction "and" and the pronoun "it" referring to both matters considered as one thing, with the possibility of taqiyyah, as it agrees with some general public and its narrator being from them. Translator: * Due to a phenomenon known as neonatal galactorrhea or "witch's milk", a newborn's (male or female) breasts may enlarge slightly and secrete a small amount of milk. This is a temporary condition and disappears on its own within a few weeks.

chapter: That A Nursemaid Is Not Required To Wash Her Garment From The Child's Urine Except Once A Day If She Has No Other Garment
arabicText: فيك ،اهيلع لوبيف دولوم اهلو صيمق لاإ اهل سيل ةأرما نع لئس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةرم مويلا يف صيمقلا لسغت :لقا ؟عنصت
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: He was asked about a woman who has only one shirt and has a newborn who urinates on her, what should she do? He said: She should wash the shirt once a day.

chapter: How To Wash Bedding And Similar Items Containing Stuffing When Affected By Urine
arabicText: عنصي فيك ،لوبلا امهبيصي شارفلاو ةسفنطلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلل تلق :لقا دومحم يبأ نب ميهاربإ نع .ههجو يف هنم رهظ ام لسغي :لقا ؟وشحلا ريثك نيخث وهو امهب
englishText: From Ibrahim bin Abi Mahmoud who said: I asked Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about a carpet and bedding affected by urine, what should be done with them when they are thick and heavily stuffed? He said: Wash what appears on its surface.

chapter: How To Wash Bedding And Similar Items Containing Stuffing When Affected By Urine
arabicText: بناجلا ىلإ ذفنيف لوبلا هبيصي بوثلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس :لقا ديمحلا دبع نب ميهاربإ نع ئش سم تبصأ نفإ ،رخلآا بناجلا سمو ،هنم باصأ ام لسغا :لقا ؟وشحلا نم هيف امو ورفلا نعو ،رخلآا .ءاملبا هحضنفا لاإو ،هلسغفا هنم
englishText: From Ibrahim bin Abdul Hamid who said: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a garment affected by urine that seeps through to the other side, and about fur and what it contains of stuffing? He said: Wash what was affected of it, and touch the other side; if you find any trace of wetness, wash it, and if not, then sprinkle it with water.

chapter: How To Wash Bedding And Similar Items Containing Stuffing When Affected By Urine
arabicText: فوصلا ريثك نوكي شارفلا نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هيخأ نع ،رفعج نب ليع نع ىتح لوبلا هباصأ يذلا ناكملا يف ءاملا هيلع بصي مث ،رهاظلا لسغي :لقا ؟لسغي فيك ،لوبلا هبيصيف .رخلآا شارفلا بناج نم جرخي
englishText: From Ali bin Ja'far, from his brother Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said: I asked him about bedding containing much wool that is affected by urine, how should it be washed? He said: Wash the exterior, then pour water on the spot affected by urine until it comes out from the other side of the bedding.

chapter: If Impurity Touches A Part Of The Body And Then It Sweats, The Whole Body Does Not Become Impure When There Is No Flowing Of Sweat
arabicText: دقو ءاملا بيصأ لاف لوبأ :هل لاقف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لأس هنأ ،دلاخ خيأ نب ميكح نب مكح نع وأ ،يدسج ضعب وأ ،يهجو حسمفأ يدي قرعت مث ،بارتلباو طئاحلبا هحسمفأ ،لوبلا نم ئش يدي باصأ .هب سبأ لا :لاقف ،يبوث بيصي
englishText: From Hakam bin Hakeem, brother of Khallad, that he asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: I urinate and cannot find water, and some urine has touched my hand, so I wipe it on the wall and with soil, then my hand sweats and I wipe my face, or some part of my body, or it touches my clothes. He said: There is no problem with it.

chapter: If Impurity Touches A Part Of The Body And Then It Sweats, The Whole Body Does Not Become Impure When There Is No Flowing Of Sweat
arabicText: تقرع مث هديب هركذ حسم نمع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا - ثيدح يف - مساقلا نب صيعلا نع .لا :لقا ؟هبوث لسغي ،هبوث باصفأ هدي
englishText: From Al-Ees bin Al-Qasim- in a hadith- he said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about someone who wiped his private part with his hand then his hand sweated and touched his clothes, should he wash his clothes? He said: No.

chapter: If A Spot On The Garment Becomes Impure, That Specific Spot Must Be Washed, And If Its Location Is Uncertain, Every Suspected Spot Must Be Washed, And It Is Recommended To Wash The Entire Garment
arabicText: ،هلسغفا هناكم تفرع نفإ :بوثلا بيصي ينملا يف - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،دمحم نع .هلك هلسغفا كيلع يفخ نإو
englishText: From Muhammad, from one of them (peace be upon them)- in a hadith- regarding semen that touches the garment: If you know its location then wash it, and if it is hidden from you then wash all of it.

chapter: If A Spot On The Garment Becomes Impure, That Specific Spot Must Be Washed, And If Its Location Is Uncertain, Every Suspected Spot Must Be Washed, And It Is Recommended To Wash The Entire Garment
arabicText: دق هنأ تملع دق ينفإ :تلق - لقا نأ ىلإ - ينم نم ئش وأ ،هريغ وأ فاعر مد يبوث باصأ :تلق :لقا ةرارز نع نيقي لىع نوكت ىتح اهباصأ دق هنأ ىرت يتلا ةيحانلا كبوث نم لسغت :لقا ؟هلسغفأ ،وه نيأ ردأ ملو هباصأ .كتراهط نم
englishText: From Zurarah who said: I said: My garment was touched by blood from a nosebleed or something else, or some semen- until he said- I said: I know it touched it but I don't know where it is, should I wash it? He said: Wash the area of your garment that you think it touched until you are certain of its purity.

chapter: If A Spot On The Garment Becomes Impure, That Specific Spot Must Be Washed, And If Its Location Is Uncertain, Every Suspected Spot Must Be Washed, And It Is Recommended To Wash The Entire Garment
arabicText: نفإ :تلق ،هلسغا :لاقف ؟بوثلا بيصي يبصلا لوب نع هتلأس :لقا ةعامس نع ،ىسيع نب نامثع نع ،هنعو .هلك بوثلا لسغا :لقا ؟هناكم دجأ مل
englishText: From him, from Uthman bin Isa, from Sama'ah who said: I asked him about infant's urine touching the garment? He said: Wash it. I said: What if I cannot find its location? He said: Wash the entire garment.

chapter: If A Spot On The Garment Becomes Impure, That Specific Spot Must Be Washed, And If Its Location Is Uncertain, Every Suspected Spot Must Be Washed, And It Is Recommended To Wash The Entire Garment
arabicText: :لقا ؟هناكم نيأ يردي لاف بيصي ينملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا بعصم نب ةسبنع نع .هلسغيلف هناكم ملع نإو ،هلك هلسغي
englishText: From Anbasa bin Mus'ab who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about From Anbasa bin Mus'ab who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about semen that touches but its location is unknown? He said: Wash all of it, and if its location is known then wash it.

chapter: If A Spot On The Garment Becomes Impure, That Specific Spot Must Be Washed, And If Its Location Is Uncertain, Every Suspected Spot Must Be Washed, And It Is Recommended To Wash The Entire Garment
arabicText: هناكم ري ملو - ينملا ينعي - هباصأ دق هنأ نقيتسا نإ :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .نسحأ هنفإ ،هلك بوثلا لسغيلف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: If one is certain it touched it- meaning semen- but cannot see its location then wash the entire garment, for that is better.

chapter: If A Spot On The Garment Becomes Impure, That Specific Spot Must Be Washed, And If Its Location Is Uncertain, Every Suspected Spot Must Be Washed, And It Is Recommended To Wash The Entire Garment
arabicText: لاغبلاو باودلا لاوبأ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا - ثيدح يف - ملسم نب دمحم نع لومحم اذه :لوقأ .هحضنفا تككش نفإ ،هلك بوثلا لسغفا هناكم ملعت مل نفإ ،هلسغا :لاقف ؟ريمحلاو .يتيأ امك ةروكذملا لاوبلأا ةساجن مدعل بابحتسلاا لىع
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim- in a hadith- he said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the urine of animals, mules and donkeys? He said: Wash it, if you don't know its location then wash the entire garment, and if you doubt then sprinkle it. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted as recommended because the mentioned urines are not impure as will be explained.
