chapter: If A Spot On The Garment Becomes Impure, That Specific Spot Must Be Washed, And If Its Location Is Uncertain, Every Suspected Spot Must Be Washed, And It Is Recommended To Wash The Entire Garment
arabicText: نإو ،هلسغفا هناكم تفرع نإ :لقا ؟بوثلا بيصي ينملا نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هلك هلسغفا هناكم كيلع يفخ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about semen that touches the garment? He said: If you know its location then wash it, and if its location is hidden from you then wash all of it.

chapter: If A Spot On The Garment Becomes Impure, That Specific Spot Must Be Washed, And If Its Location Is Uncertain, Every Suspected Spot Must Be Washed, And It Is Recommended To Wash The Entire Garment
arabicText: وأ ناك لايلق ،هناكم كيلع يفخ اذإ هلك بوثلا لسغا :لقا ؟بوثلا بيصي ينملا نع هتلأس :لقا ةعامس نع .اريثك
englishText: From Sama'ah who said: I asked him about semen that gets on clothing? He said: Wash the entire garment if its location is not apparent to you, whether it is a small or large amount.

chapter: If A Spot On The Garment Becomes Impure, That Specific Spot Must Be Washed, And If Its Location Is Uncertain, Every Suspected Spot Must Be Washed, And It Is Recommended To Wash The Entire Garment
arabicText: دق بوثلا هل نوكي لجرلا نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هيخأ نع هباتك يف رفعج نب ليع .هركي :لقا ؟هيف مونلا حلصي له ،هلسغي ملف ةبانجلا هباصأ
englishText: Ali ibn Ja'far in his book from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him), said: I asked him about a man who has a garment that has been affected by janabah (ritual impurity) and he has not washed it, is it permissible to sleep in it? He said: "It is disliked."

chapter: If A Spot On The Garment Becomes Impure, That Specific Spot Must Be Washed, And If Its Location Is Uncertain, Every Suspected Spot Must Be Washed, And It Is Recommended To Wash The Entire Garment
arabicText: نأ لبق ليصي نأ هل حلصي له ؟عنصي فيك ،ةبانج هيف نأ ملعي بوثلا يف قرعي لجرلا نع هتلأسو :لقا نم هدسج باصأ ام لسغيلف بوثلا يف يتلا ةبانجلا كلت نم هدسج باصأ قرع اذإ هنأ ملع اذإ لقا ؟لسغي .هلك دسج لسغيلف هناكم فرعي ملو هدسج باصأ هنأ ملع نإو ،كلذ
englishText: He said: And I asked him about a man who sweats in a garment knowing there is janabah (sexual impurity) in it, what should he do? Is it permissible for him to pray before washing? He said: If he knows that when he sweats, his body is affected by the janabah that is in the garment, then he should wash whatever part of his body was affected by it. And if he knows it affected his body but does not know its location, then he should wash his entire body.

chapter: Impurity Of Urine And Excrement From Humans And All Animals Whose Meat Is Not Permissible To Eat If They Have Flowing Blood
arabicText: .هلسغي ىتح هيف ةلاصلا حصت لاف رونسلا لوب نم ئش بوثلا باصأ نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If cat's urine touches the garment, prayer is not valid in it until it is washed.

chapter: Impurity Of Urine And Excrement From Humans And All Animals Whose Meat Is Not Permissible To Eat If They Have Flowing Blood
arabicText: .همحل لكؤي لا ام لاوبأ نم كبوث لسغا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا :لقا نانس نب الله دبع نع
englishText: From Abdullah bin Sinan who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Wash your garment from the urine of animals whose meat is not permissible to eat.

chapter: Impurity Of Urine And Excrement From Humans And All Animals Whose Meat Is Not Permissible To Eat If They Have Flowing Blood
arabicText: .همحل لكؤي لا ام لك لوب نم كبوث لسغا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Wash your garment from the urine of everything whose meat is not permissible to eat.

chapter: Impurity Of Urine And Excrement From Humans And All Animals Whose Meat Is Not Permissible To Eat If They Have Flowing Blood
arabicText: لا :لاقف هذخفأ ،لابف ،هرجح يف عضوف ليع نب نسحلبا يتأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ ،نسحلا نع .هيلع بصف ءامب اعد مث ،ينبا اومرزت .كلوب تمرزأ دق :هلوب عطق اذإ لجرلل لاقي ،عطقلا :مارزلاا :يعمصلأا لقا
englishText: From Al-Hasan: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was brought Al Hasan bin Ali who was placed in his lap and urinated. He took him and said: Don't interrupt my son's urination, then he asked for water and poured it over it. Al-Asma'i (*) said: Al-Izram means interruption, it is said when a man interrupts his urination: You have interrupted your urination. Translator: * Al-Asma'i was a famous 8th-century Arab scholar of Arabic language and literature. Here, he is providing a linguistic explanation for the term "Al-Izram" used in the hadith. According to him, "Al-Izram" means "cutting off" or "stopping abruptly." He further explains that when a man stops his urine flow abruptly, it is said to him: "You have cut off (azramta) your urine."

chapter: Impurity Of Urine And Excrement From Humans And All Animals Whose Meat Is Not Permissible To Eat If They Have Flowing Blood
arabicText: تءاج اهنأ ،سابعلا ةجوز لضفلا مأ نع (فوفطلا لىتق لىع فوهلملا) باتك يف سواط نب ىسوم نب ليع هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لاقف ،كىبف هتصرقف هبوث لىع لابف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىلإ نيسحلبا .ينبا تعجوأ دقو ،لسغي يبوث اذهف ،لضفلا مأ يا لاهم :(هلآو
englishText: Ali bin Musa bin Tawus in his book (Al-Malhuf ala Qatla Al-Tufuf) from Umm Al Fadhl, wife of Al-Abbas, that she brought Al-Husayn to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and he urinated on his garment, so she pinched him and he cried. The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Take it easy, O Umm Al-Fadhl, this garment can be washed, and you have hurt my son.

chapter: Impurity Of Urine And Excrement From Humans And All Animals Whose Meat Is Not Permissible To Eat If They Have Flowing Blood
arabicText: هنم يقب اذإ :لقا ؟هلكأ زوجي له ،رافلا ورخ هيف بيصي قيقدلا نع لئس هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هلاعأ ذخؤي ،سبأ لاف ئش
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he was asked about flour that mouse droppings fall into it, is it permissible to eat it? He said: If something remains of it, there is no problem, take from its top.

chapter: Impurity Of Urine And Excrement From Humans And All Animals Whose Meat Is Not Permissible To Eat If They Have Flowing Blood
arabicText: .ناسنلاا لاوبأك :لقا ؟سرفلاو رامحلاو بلكلاو رونسلا لوب نع هتلأس :لقا ةعامس نع لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ .يتيأ امل ةيهاركلا وأ ،ةيقتلا لىع لومحم انه سرفلاو رامحلا لوب مكح :خيشلا لقا .ةلئاسلا سفنلا طارتشا لىعو هيلع لدي ام يتيأو ،هريغو ءاجنتسلاا يف كلذ
englishText: From Sama'ah who said: I asked him about the urine of cats, dogs, donkeys and horses? He said: Like human urine. The Shaykh said: The ruling about donkey and horse urine here is based on taqiyyah or dislike, as will be explained later. I (Hurr Amili) say: What indicates this has preceded in the chapter of istinja and others, and what indicates this and the condition of flowing blood will come later.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: .اهلاوبأ لسغاو ،رمحلا ثورب سبأ لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،يبلحلا نع
englishText: From Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: There is no problem with the dung of donkeys, but wash their urine.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: تلبا دقو ليللبا تجرخ امبرف باودلا جلاعأ ينإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا ساحنلا رغلأا يبأ نع .ئش كيلع سيل :لاقف ؟هيف هرثأ ىرفأ حبصفأ يبايث لىع حضنيف هدي وأ هلجرب اهدحأ برضيف تثارو .هب سبأ لا :لاقف ،يبوث لىع حضنيف :لقا هنأ لاإ ،هلثم ،ساحنلا رغلأا يبأ نع هدانسإب قودصلا هاورو
englishText: From Abu Al-Agharr Al-Nahhas who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I treat animals and sometimes I go out at night when they have urinated and defecated, and one of them might strike with its leg or hand and splash on my clothes, and in the morning I see its trace on it? He said: There is nothing upon you. And Al-Saduq narrated it with his chain from Abu Al-Agharr Al-Nahhas, similar to it, except he said: so it splashes on my garment, and he said: There is no problem with it.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: لا :لاقف ؟هيلع أطأ ،بطرلا نيقرسلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ لقا هنأ - ثيدح يف - يبلحلا دمحم نع .هلثم كرضي
englishText: From Muhammad Al-Halabi- in a hadith- that he said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): The wet manure, can I step on it? He said: The like of it will not harm you.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: .همحل لكؤي ئش لوب نم كبوث لسغت لا :لاقا امهنأ ،ةرارز نع
englishText: From Zurarah, that they both said: Do not wash your garment from the urine of anything whose meat is eaten.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: ؟اهموحلو اهلاوبأو منغلاو رقبلاو لبلإا نابلأ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع باودلا لاوبأ نع هتلأسو :لقا .فظنتت نأ لاإ هلسغت لاف كل باوث وأ ئش هنم كباصأ نإ هنم ضوت لا :لاقف .هحضنفا تككش نفإ ،هلك بوثلا لسغفا هناكم ملعت مل نفإ ،هلسغا :لاقف ؟ريمحلاو لاغبلاو
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the milk of camels, cows, sheep and their urine and meat? He said: Do not perform ablution from it if it touches you or your garment, do not wash it except for cleanliness. He said: And I asked him about the urine of beasts, mules and donkeys? He said: Wash it, and if you do not know its location then wash the entire garment, and if you doubt then sprinkle it.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: هلوبو هربو يف ةلاصلفا همحل لكؤي امم ناك نإ :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع .كيذ هنأ تملع اذإ ،زئاج هنم ئش لكو هنابلأو هثورو هرعشو
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: If it is from what its meat is eaten, then prayer is permissible in its fur, urine, hair, dung, milk and everything from it, when you know it is slaughtered properly.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: ؟لالاح اهموحل سيلأ :تلقف ،ههركف ،بوثلا بيصي باودلا لاوبأ يف ،(ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ةرارز نع .لكلال الله هلعج امم سيل نكلو ،لىب :لاقف
englishText: From Zurarah, from one of them (peace be upon them), regarding the urine of beasts that touches the garment, he disliked it, so I said: Isn't their meat permissible? He said: Yes, but it is not from what Allah made for eating.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: لسغفا اهلاوبأ امأ :لقا ؟اهثاورأو باودلا لاوبأ يف لوقت ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا ميرم يبأ نع .كلذ نم ربكأ رثكأ يهف اهثاورأ امأو كباصأ نإ
englishText: From Abu Maryam who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): What do you say about the urine and dung of animals? He said: As for their urine, wash it if it touches you, and as for their dung, it is more abundant than that.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: ،مئاهبلا لاوبأ ضعب هسمي لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا الله دبع يبأ نب نمحرلا دبع نع .هلوبب سبأ لاف همحل لكؤي ام لكو ةاشلا امفأ ،لغبلاو سرفلاو رامحلا لوب لسغي :لقا ؟لا مأ هلسغيأ
englishText: From Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Abdullah who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be From Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Abdullah who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who is touched by some animal urine, should he wash it or not? He said: Wash the urine of donkey, horse, and mule, but as for sheep and everything whose meat is eaten, there is no problem with its urine.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: .هلوبب سبأ لاف همحل لكؤي ام لكو ،ةاشلاو ريعبلا لوب حضنيو :لقا هنأ لاإ ،هلثم ،نباأ نع
englishText: From Aban, similar to it, except that he said: Sprinkle the urine of camel and sheep, and everything whose meat is eaten, there is no problem with its urine.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: .هنم كباصأ ام لسغا :لاقف ؟لاغبلاو ليخلا لاوبأ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا يبلحلا نع
englishText: From Al-Halabi who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the urine of horses and mules? He said: Wash what touches you from it.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: .هنم جرخي امب سبأ لاف همحل لكأ ام لك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Everything whose meat is eaten, there is no problem with what comes out of it.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: ،كبوث لسغا :لقا ؟لاغبلاو ريمحلا لاوبأ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا نيعأ نب لىعلأا دبع نع .كلذ نم رثكأ وه :لقا ؟اهثاورفأ :تلق :لقا
englishText: From Abdul A'la bin A'yan who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the urine of donkeys and mules? He said: Wash your clothes. I said: What about their dung? He said: It is more abundant than that.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: ىتح هلوبب حيرلا تءاجف ،لابف ،رامح انمادقو ةزانج يف انك :لاقا روفعي يبأ نب الله دبعو سينخ نب لىعم نع .سبأ مكيلع سيل :لاقف ،هناربخفأ الله دبع يبأ لىع انلخدف ،انبايثو انهوجو تكص
englishText: From Mu'alla bin Khunays and Abdullah bin Abi Ya'fur who said: We were in a funeral and there was a donkey in front of us, it urinated, and the wind brought its urine until it hit our faces and clothes. We entered upon Abu Abdullah and informed him, and he said: There is no problem upon you.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: اجاتحم ناك نإ :لقا ؟لجرلا هبرشي رقبلا لوب نع لئس :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .منغلاو لبلإا لوب كلذكو ،(هبرشي) هب ىوادتي هيلإ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he was asked about cow urine that a man drinks? He said: If he needs it for medical treatment (he drinks it), and likewise the urine of camels and sheep.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: هرذقت مل نإ :لقا ؟بطر وهو يبوث بيصي ثورلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا بائر نب ليع نع .هيف لصف
englishText: From Ali ibn Ri'ab who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about wet dung that gets on my clothes? He said: If you don't consider it filthy, then pray in it.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: .همحل لكأ ام لوبب سبأ لا :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نأ ،هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father, that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: There is no problem with the urine of animals whose meat is permissible to eat.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: اهلوب بيصيف لوبت ةبادلا نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هيخأ نع ،رفعج نب ليع هدج نع .سبأ لاف فج اذإ :لقا ؟لسغي نأ لبق هيف لىصيأ ،هطئاح وأ دجسملا
englishText: From his grandfather Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about an animal that urinates and its urine touches the mosque or its wall, can one pray there before washing it? He said: If it has dried, then there is no problem.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: نإ :لقا ؟اهثور وأ اهلوب لىع ةبادلا طبرم يف عضوي بوثلا نع هتلأس :لقا ،هيخأ نع ،رفعج نب ليع نع ،هنعو .ةرفص نم هلسغت لاف هعم نوكي يتلا ةرفصلا وأ ثورلا نم ئش هباصأ نإو ،هلسغيلف ئش هب قلع
englishText: And from him, from Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother, he said: I asked him about clothes placed in an animal's stable on its urine or dung? He said: If something sticks to it then wash it, and if it is touched by dung or the yellowness that comes with it, do not wash it from the yellowness.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: هيلع) قداصلا نع ،ىسوم نب رامع باتك نم لاقن (فلتخملا) يف ةملاعلا رهطملا نب فسوي نب نسحلا ىلإ ىوأو) كب راجتسا هنلأ هلكأ هرك نكلو ،همحل لكؤي امم وه ،هب سبأ لا فاطخلا ورخ :لقا (ملاسلا .هرجفأ كب ريجتسي ريط لكو ،(كلزنم
englishText: Al-Hasan ibn Yusuf ibn al-Mutahhar al-Allama in (al-Mukhtalif) quoting from the book of Ammar ibn Musa, from al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: There is no problem with swallow droppings, it is from what its meat can be eaten, but eating it is disliked because it sought your protection (and took shelter in your home), and every bird that seeks your protection, protect it.

chapter: Purity Of Urine And Dung From All Animals Whose Meat Is Permissible To Eat, And The Recommendation To Remove These From Animals Whose Meat Is Disliked Especially Regarding Urine
arabicText: ةبادلا طبرم يف عقي بوثلا نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هيخأ نع هباتك يف رفعج نب ليع .سبأ لاف فااج ناك نإو ،هلسغيلف ئش هب قلع نإ :لقا ؟عنصي فيك ،اهثورو اهلوب لىع
englishText: Ali ibn Ja'far in his book from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him), said: I asked him about clothes that fall in an animal's stable on its urine and dung, what should be done? He said: If something sticks to it then wash it, and if it was dry then there is no problem.

chapter: Ruling On Chicken Droppings, Bat Urine, And All Birds
arabicText: .هئرخو هلوبب سبأ لاف ريطي ئش لك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Everything that flies, there is no problem with its urine and excrement.

chapter: Ruling On Chicken Droppings, Bat Urine, And All Birds
arabicText: مامحلاو جاجدلا ءرخب سبأ لا :لقا هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع ،هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع ،بهو نب بهو نع .بوثلا بيصي
englishText: From Wahb ibn Wahb, from Ja'far, from his father, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said: There is no problem with chicken and pigeon droppings that touch the garment.

chapter: Ruling On Chicken Droppings, Bat Urine, And All Birds
arabicText: ؟هيف ةلاصلا زوجت ،جاجدلا قرذ نع هلأسي لجر هيلإ بتك :لقا سرفا نع ،ىسيع نب دمحم نع ،هنعو .لا :بتكف نم ريثك بهذم هنلأ ،ةيقتلا لىع وأ ،لالاج جاجدلا نوك لىع وأ ،بابحتسلاا لىع لومحم اذه :خيشلا لقا .ةماعلا
englishText: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Faris who said: A man wrote to him asking about chicken droppings, is prayer permitted in it? He wrote back: No. The Shaykh said: This is interpreted as recommended, or when the chicken has eaten f ilth, or based on taqiyyah, because it is the belief of many of the common people.

chapter: Ruling On Chicken Droppings, Bat Urine, And All Birds
arabicText: ؟هدجأ لاف هبلطفأ يبوث بيصي فيشاشخلا لوب نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا يقرلا دواد نع .كبوث لسغا :لقا
englishText: From Dawud al-Raqqi who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about bat urine that touches my garment and I look for it but cannot find it? He said: Wash your garment.

chapter: Ruling On Chicken Droppings, Bat Urine, And All Birds
arabicText: .فيشاشخلا لوبو قبلاو ثيغاربلا مدب سبأ لا :لقا هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع لولأا ثيدحلا نوكيف ،همحل لكؤي لا ام لوب ةساجن لىع لد امب لادتسم ةيقتلا لىع خيشلا هلمح :لوقأ .هلاح لوهجملاو همحل لوكأملبا اصوصخم
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father who said: There is no problem with the blood of fleas and bugs and the urine of bats. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted this as taqiyyah based on evidence indicating the impurity of urine from animals whose meat is not eaten, so the first hadith would be specific to animals whose meat is eaten and those whose status is unknown.

chapter: Purity Of Sweat Of All Animals And Their Bodies And What Comes Out Of Their Nostrils And Mouths Except Dogs And Pigs
arabicText: رامحلاو لبلإاو ةرقبلاو ةاشلاو ةرهلا لضف نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا سابعلا يبأ لضفلا نع بلكلا ىلإ تيهتنا ىتح ،هب سبأ لا :لاقف ؟هنع هتلأس لاإ ائيش كرتأ ملف ؟عابسلاو شحولاو لاغبلاو ليخلاو .سجن سجر :لاقف
englishText: From Al-Fadhl Abu Al-Abbas who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the leftover of cats, sheep, cows, camels, donkeys, horses, mules, wild animals, and predatory animals? I did not leave anything without asking him about it? He said: There is no problem with it, until I reached the dog, then he said: It is filthy and impure.

chapter: Purity Of Sweat Of All Animals And Their Bodies And What Comes Out Of Their Nostrils And Mouths Except Dogs And Pigs
arabicText: .هب سبأ لا :لقا ؟ينبيصي ةبادلا رخنم نم جرخي امع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ينهجلا كلام نع
englishText: From Malik Al-Juhani who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about what comes out of an animal's nostril that gets on me? He said: There is no problem with it.

chapter: Purity Of Sweat Of All Animals And Their Bodies And What Comes Out Of Their Nostrils And Mouths Except Dogs And Pigs
arabicText: .هنم جرخي امب سبأ لاف همحل لكأ ام لك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Everything whose meat is permissible to eat, there is no problem with what comes out of it.

chapter: Purity Of Sweat Of All Animals And Their Bodies And What Comes Out Of Their Nostrils And Mouths Except Dogs And Pigs
arabicText: هباعلو للاح هرؤسف رتجي ئش لك :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .للاح
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Everything that chews cud, its leftover is permissible and its saliva is permissible.

chapter: Purity Of Sweat Of All Animals And Their Bodies And What Comes Out Of Their Nostrils And Mouths Except Dogs And Pigs
arabicText: له ،رونس رهظ سم لجر نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هيخأ نع ،رفعج نب ليع نع .سبأ لا :لقا ؟هدي لسغي نأ لبق ليصي نأ هل حلصي
englishText: From Ali bin Ja'far, from his brother Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said: I asked him about a man who touched the back of a cat, is it proper for him to pray before washing his hand? He said: There is no problem.

chapter: Impurity Of Dogs Even If They Are Saluki (Hunting) Dogs
arabicText: نإو ،هلسغفا ةبوطر بلكلا نم كبوث باصأ نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا :لقا سابعلا يبأ لضفلا نع .اهلتقب رمأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نلا :لقا ؟ةلزنملا هذهب راص مل :تلق ،ءاملا هيلع ببصفا فااج هسم
englishText: From Al-Fadhl Abu Al-Abbas who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: If wetness from a dog touches your garment then wash it, and if it touches it while dry then pour water on it. I asked: Why has it been given this status? He said: Because the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) ordered to kill them.

chapter: Impurity Of Dogs Even If They Are Saluki (Hunting) Dogs
arabicText: سجر :لاقف ؟بلكلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لأس هنأ - ثيدح يف - سابعلا يبأ لضفلا نع دانسلاباو .ءاملبا مث ةرم لوأ بارتلبا هلسغاو ،ءاملا كلذ ببصاو ،هلضفب أضوتي لا ،سجن
englishText: And by the chain from Al-Fadhl Abu Al-Abbas- in a hadith- that he asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the dog? He said: It is filth, impure, do not perform ablution with its leftover water, and pour out that water, and wash it with soil the first time then with water.

chapter: Impurity Of Dogs Even If They Are Saluki (Hunting) Dogs
arabicText: .ءنالاا لسغا :لقا ؟ءنالاا نم برشي بلكلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a dog drinking from a vessel? He said: Wash the vessel.

chapter: Impurity Of Dogs Even If They Are Saluki (Hunting) Dogs
arabicText: :لقا ؟لجرلا دسج نم ائيش بيصي بلكلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع .هباصأ يذلا ناكملا لسغي
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a dog touching something from a man's body? He said: Wash the place it touched.

chapter: Impurity Of Dogs Even If They Are Saluki (Hunting) Dogs
arabicText: .هبصف ءنالاا يف بلكلا غلو اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If a dog laps from a vessel then pour it out.

chapter: Impurity Of Dogs Even If They Are Saluki (Hunting) Dogs
arabicText: ،لا :لقا ؟أضوتي وأ هنم برشي ،بلكلا رؤس نع لئس هنأ - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .سجن هنإ اللهو لا ،سجن هنإ اللهو لا :لقا ؟عبس سيلأ :تلق
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- that he was asked about the leftover water of a dog, can one drink from it or perform ablution? He said: No. I said: Is it not a predator? He said: No by Allah it is impure, no by Allah it is impure.

chapter: Impurity Of Dogs Even If They Are Saluki (Hunting) Dogs
arabicText: اضوح نوكي نأ لاإ بلكلا رؤس برشي لا :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ريصب يبأ نع .هنم ىقتسي اريبك
englishText: From Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: Do not drink the leftover water of a dog unless it is from a large pool that is drawn from.

chapter: Impurity Of Dogs Even If They Are Saluki (Hunting) Dogs
arabicText: ؟(لجرلا دسج نم) ائيش بيصي بلكلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع .هباصأ يذلا ناكملا لسغي :لقا
englishText: From Muhammad ibn Muslim who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a dog touching something (from a man's body)? He said: Wash the spot that it touched.

chapter: Impurity Of Dogs Even If They Are Saluki (Hunting) Dogs
arabicText: لسغفا هتسسم اذإ :لاقف ؟يقولسلا بلكلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع .كدي
englishText: From Muhammad ibn Muslim who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the Saluki (*) dog? He said: If you touch it, wash your hand. Translator: * A famous breed of hunting dog originally from the ancient city of Saluk in Syria, known for their speed, endurance, and agility in chasing prey.

chapter: Impurity Of Dogs Even If They Are Saluki (Hunting) Dogs
arabicText: وه :تلق ،خسم وه :لاقف ؟بلكلا محل نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا يشرقلا لهس يبأ نع .سجن وه :لوقي كلذ لك ،تارم ثلاث هيلع اهديعأ ،سجن وه :لقا ؟مارح
englishText: From Abu Sahl al-Qurashi who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about dog meat? He said: It is metamorphosed. I said: Is it forbidden? He said: It is impure. I repeated it to him three times, each time he said: It is impure.

chapter: Impurity Of Dogs Even If They Are Saluki (Hunting) Dogs
arabicText: بطر وهو بلكلا باصأ نمف ،بلاكلا برق نع اوهزنت :لقا - ةئامعبرلأا ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع .ءاملبا هبوث حضنيلف فااج ناك نإو ،هلسغيلف
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him)- in the hadith of the four hundred- said: Keep away from dogs' proximity. Whoever is touched by a dog while wet should wash it, and if it was dry then sprinkle water on his garment.

chapter: Impurity Of Pigs
arabicText: ملف ريزنخ هبوث بيصي لجرلا نع هتلأس :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هيخأ نع ،رفعج نب ليع نع يف لخد نكي مل نإو ،ضميلف هتلاص يف لخد ناك نإ :لقا ؟هب عنصي فيك ،هتلاص يف وهو ركذف ،هلسغي .هلسغيف رثأ هيف نوكي نأ لاإ ،هبوث نم باصأ ام حضنيلف هتلاص
englishText: From Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a man whose garment is touched by a pig and he did not wash it, then he remembered while he was in prayer, what should he do? He said: If he had already started his prayer, he should continue, and if he had not started his prayer, he should sprinkle water where it touched his garment, unless there is a visible trace, then he should wash it.

chapter: Impurity Of Pigs
arabicText: لىصيأ ،ريزنخلا محلو رمخلا هبيصي بوثلا نع هلأسأ (ملاسلا هيلع) لجرلا ىلإ تبتك :لقا مداخلا ناريخ نع لا :مهضعب لقاو ،اهبرش مرح امنإ الله نفإ هيف لص :مهضعب لاقف ،هيف اوفلتخا دق انباحصأ نفإ ؟لا مأ هيف .سجر هنفإ ،هيف لصت لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) بتكف ؟هيف لصت
englishText: From Khayran Al-Khadim who said: I wrote to the man (peace be upon him) asking him about a garment touched by wine and pork, can one pray in it or not? For our companions have differed about it, some of them said: pray in it for Allah only prohibited drinking it, and some said: do not pray in it? So he (peace be upon him) wrote: Do not pray in it, for it is impure.

chapter: Impurity Of Pigs
arabicText: ،هب سبأ لا :لقا ؟هب زرخي ريزنخلا رعش نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا فاكسلإا ناميلس نع .ليصي نأ دارأ اذإ هدي لسغي نكلو
englishText: From Sulayman Al-Iskaf who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about pig hair used in sewing? He said: There is no problem with it, but he should wash his hand when he wants to pray.

chapter: Impurity Of Pigs
arabicText: :تلق .ريزنخلا محل بلقملاك اهل بلقملا :لقا جنرطشلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع بائر نب ليع نع .هدي لسغي :لقا ؟ريزنخلا محل بلق نم لىع امو
englishText: From Ali ibn Ri'ab from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding chess (shatranj), he said: The one who turns it is like one who turns pork. I said: And what is upon the one who turns pork? He said: He should wash his hand.

chapter: Impurity Of The Disbeliever Whether Dhimmi Or Nasibi
arabicText: يف اولكتأ لا :لاقف ؟سوجملاو ةمذلا لهأ ةينآ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع .رمخلا اهيف نوبرشي يتلا مهتينآ يف لاو ،نوخبطي يذلا مهماعط نم لاو ،مهتينآ
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim who said: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the vessels of the Ahl al-Dhimmah (*) and the Magians? He said: Do not eat from their vessels, nor from their food which they cook, nor from their vessels in which they drink wine. Translator: * Non-Muslim citizens of an Islamic state who have been granted a covenant of protection (dhimmah) by the Muslim government. This covenant ensures their safety, security, freedom to practice their own religion, and exemption from military service in exchange for paying a special tax called jizyah.

chapter: Impurity Of The Disbeliever Whether Dhimmi Or Nasibi
arabicText: لجر مهرضحو نولكيأ نيملسم موق نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ليهاكلا ىيحي نب الله دبع نع يف هنوعنصت ائيش مكيلع مرحأ نأ هركأو ،يسوجملا لكاوأ لاف ناأ امأ :لاقف ؟مهماعط ىلإ هنوعديأ ،يسوجم .مكدلاب
englishText: From Abdullah bin Yahya Al-Kahili who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about Muslim people eating when a Magian man is present with them, should they invite him to their food? He said: As for me, I do not eat with a Magian, and I dislike to forbid you from something you do in your lands.

chapter: Impurity Of The Disbeliever Whether Dhimmi Or Nasibi
arabicText: .أضوتي لاو هدي لسغي :لقا ،ايسوجم لاجر حفاص لجر يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), regarding a man who shook hands with a Magian man, he said: He should wash his hand but does not need to perform ablution.

chapter: Impurity Of The Disbeliever Whether Dhimmi Or Nasibi
arabicText: بارتلبا اهحسما لقا ،ينحفاصيف يمذلا ىقلأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا يسنلاقلا دلاخ نع .اهلسغا :لقا ؟بصانلفا :تلق .طئاحلباو دوجو لىع لومحم هلبق يذلاو ،بابحتسلاا لىع لسغلاو حسملاو ،ةبوطرلا مدع لىع لومحم اذه :لوقأ .هب ةبوطرلا
englishText: From Khalid Al-Qalanisi who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I meet a dhimmi and he shakes hands with me. He said: Wipe it with soil and against From Khalid Al-Qalanisi who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I meet a dhimmi and he shakes hands with me. He said: Wipe it with soil and against the wall. I said: What about a Nasibi? He said: Wash it. I (Hurr Amili) say: This applies when there is no moisture, and the wiping and washing are recommended, and the previous one applies when there is moisture present.

chapter: Impurity Of The Disbeliever Whether Dhimmi Or Nasibi
arabicText: ،بوثلا ءارو نم :لقا ،ينارصنلاو يدوهيلا ملسملا ةحفاصم يف (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ريصب يبأ نع .كدي لسغفا هديب كحفاص نفإ
englishText: From Abu Basir, from one of them (peace be upon them) regarding a Muslim shaking hands with a Jew or Christian, he said: From behind the cloth, but if he shakes your hand directly then wash your hand.

chapter: Impurity Of The Disbeliever Whether Dhimmi Or Nasibi
arabicText: ةعصق يف يسوجملا ةلكاؤم نع هتلأس لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم نسحلا يبأ هيخأ نع ،رفعج نب ليع نع .لا :لقا ؟هحفاصأو ،دحاو شارف لىع هعم دقرأو ،ةدحاو
englishText: From Ali bin Ja'far, from his brother Abu Al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about eating with a Magian from one bowl, and sleeping with him on one bed, and shaking hands with him? He said: No.

chapter: Impurity Of The Disbeliever Whether Dhimmi Or Nasibi
arabicText: .لا :لقا ؟مهماعط نم لكفآ سوجملا طلاخأ ينإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا ةجراخ نب نوراه نع
englishText: From Harun bin Kharijah who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I mix with Magians and eat from their food? He said: No.

chapter: Impurity Of The Disbeliever Whether Dhimmi Or Nasibi
arabicText: .لا لاقف ؟ينارصنلاو يدوهيلا رؤس نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا جرعلأا ديعس نع
englishText: From Sa'id al-A'raj who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the leftover water of a Jew and Christian? He said: No.

chapter: Impurity Of The Disbeliever Whether Dhimmi Or Nasibi
arabicText: يف ملسملا عم لستغي ينارصنلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هاخأ لأس هنأ رفعج نب ليع نع مث هلسغيف ضوحلا لىع هدحو لستغي نأ لاإ ،مامحلا ءام ريغب لستغا ينارصن هنأ ملع اذإ :لقا ،مامحلا .لستغي .هيلإ رطضي نأ لاإ ،لا :لقا ؟ةلاصلل هنم أضوتيأ ءاملا يف هدي لخدي ينارصنلاو يدوهيلا نع هلأسو امل مامحلا يف ةداملا لىع وأ ،ءاملا ةيرك لىع لومحم هرخآو ،ةداملا مدع لىع لومحم ثيدحلا لوأ :لوقأ .مدقت
englishText: From Ali ibn Ja'far that he asked his brother Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) From Ali ibn Ja'far that he asked his brother Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a Christian bathing with a Muslim in the public bath. He said: If he knows that he is a Christian, he should bathe with water other than the bath water, unless he bathes alone in the basin, in which case he should wash it and then bathe. And he asked him about a Jew or Christian dipping his hand in water- can one perform ablution from it for prayer? He said: No, unless one is compelled to do so. I (Hurr Amili) say: The first part of the hadith applies when there is no source water f low, and the latter part applies to stagnant water, or to source water in the bath as previously mentioned.

chapter: Impurity Of The Disbeliever Whether Dhimmi Or Nasibi
arabicText: ماني ينارصنلاو يدوهيلا شارف نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هيخأ نع ،رفعج نب ليع نع هدعقي لاو ،ةدحاو ةعصق يف يسوجملا عم ملسملا لكيأ لا :لقاو ،امهبايث يف لىصي لاو ،سبأ لا :لقا ؟هيلع .هحفاصي لاو هدجسم لاو هشارف لىع نم هارتشا نإ :لقا ؟هيف ةلاصلا حلصت له ،ناك نمل يردي لا سبلل قوسلا نم باوث ىرتشا لجر نع هتلأسو .هلسغي ىتح هيف ليصي لاف ينارصن نم هارتشا نإو ،هيف لصيلف ملسم
englishText: From Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about sleeping on the bed of a Jew or Christian? He said: There is no problem, but do not pray in their clothes, and he said: A Muslim should not eat with a Zoroastrian from one bowl, nor let him sit on his bed or in his mosque, nor shake hands with him. And I asked him about a man who bought clothes from the market to wear, not knowing who they belonged to, is prayer valid in them? He said: If he bought it from a Muslim then pray in it, and if he bought it from a Christian then do not pray in it until washing it.

chapter: Impurity Of The Disbeliever Whether Dhimmi Or Nasibi
arabicText: ةينارصن اهنأ ملعت تنأو كمدخت ةينارصنلا ةيراجلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلل تلق :لقا دومحم يبأ نب ميهاربإ نع .اهيدي لسغت ،سبأ لا :لقا ،ةبانج نم لستغت لاو أضوتت لا
englishText: From Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmoud who said: I said to al-Ridha (peace be upon him): The Christian maid serves you while you know she is Christian, does not perform ablution nor ghusl (ritual bath) from janabah (sexual impurity). He said: There is no problem, she should wash her hands.

chapter: Impurity Of The Disbeliever Whether Dhimmi Or Nasibi
arabicText: .ءاملبا اهولسغفا اهيلإ متررطضا اذإ :لقا ،سوجملا ةينآ يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع ،ةيقتلا لىع لومحم وهو ةفاانملا هرهاظ ام كانه يتيأو الله ءاش نإ ةمعطلأا يف كلذ لىع لدي ام يتيأو :لوقأ ،طايتحلالو نآرقلا صنل ةقفاوملا ةساجنلا ثيداحأ ةرثكل ،انه روكذملا دومحم يبأ نب ميهاربإ ثيدح اذكو يفو لمعتسملاو فاضملا ءاملا يف بصانلاو يسوجملاو ينارصنلاو يدوهيلا ةساجن لىع لدي ام مدقتو .ءوضولا ضقاون
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding the vessels of Zoroastrians, he said: If you are compelled to use them, then wash them with water. I (Hurr Amili) say: More evidence for this will come in the chapter on foods if Allah wills, and there will come what apparently contradicts this which is interpreted as taqiyyah, and likewise the hadith of Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmoud mentioned here, due to numerous hadiths about impurity that conform with the Quranic text and precaution, and previously came what indicates the impurity of the Jew, Christian, Zoroastrian and the Nasibi (hostile to Ahl al-Bayt) in mixed water and used water and in the nullifiers of ablution.

chapter: Dislike Of Sweat From Animals That Eat Filth
arabicText: .هلسغفا اهقرع نم كباصأ نإو ،(ةللاجلا موحللا لكتأ لا) :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: (Do not eat the meat of animals that eat filth), and if their sweat touches you, wash it off.

chapter: Dislike Of Sweat From Animals That Eat Filth
arabicText: .هلسغفا اهقرع نم ئش كباصأ نإو ،ةللاجلا لبلإا نابلأ نم برشت لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةهاركلا امهب دارملا نأ لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Do not drink from the milk of the camel that eats filth (Al-Jallalah), and if any of its sweat touches you, wash it off. I (Hurr Amili) say: It has been previously mentioned that what is meant by this is dislike (karahah).

chapter: Impurity Of Semen
arabicText: نإ ءاملبا هحضني :لاقف ؟بوثلا بيصي يذملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،دمحم نع .هلك هلسغفا كيلع يفخ نإو ،هلسغفا هناكم تفرع نإ :لقا ،بوثلا بيصي ينملا يف :لقاو .ءاش
englishText: From Muhammad, from one of them (peace be upon them both), he said: I asked him about pre-ejaculatory fluid that gets on clothing? He said: He may sprinkle it with water if he wishes. And he said regarding semen that gets on clothing, he said: If you know its location then wash it, and if its location is unclear to you then wash the entire garment.

chapter: Impurity Of Semen
arabicText: وأ لبق ينملا تيأر نإ :لقا مث ،لوبلا نم دشأ هلعجو هددشو ينملا ركذ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع هتيأر مث هيف تيلص مث هبصت ملف كبوث يف ترظن تنأ نإو ،ةلاصلا ةداعإ كيلعف ةلاصلا يف لخدت ام دعب .لوبلا كلذكو ،كيلع ةداعإ لاف دعب
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) he said: He mentioned semen and emphasized its severity making it more severe than urine, then said: If you see semen before or after entering prayer, you must repeat the prayer. If you check your clothing and don't find it then pray, but later see it, you don't need to repeat. The same applies to urine.

chapter: Impurity Of Semen
arabicText: ،هناكم نيأ يردي لاف بوثلا بيصي ينملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا بعصم نب ةسبنع نع .هلسغيلف هناكم ملع نإو ،هلك هلسغي :لقا
englishText: From Anbasa bin Mus'ab who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about semen that gets on clothing and its location is unknown. He said: Wash all of it, and if its location is known then wash it.

chapter: Impurity Of Semen
arabicText: هنأ نظ نفإ هباصأ يذلا لسغيلف (١) ئش هبوث باصفأ لجرلا ملتحا اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع هناكم ري ملو ينم هباصأ دق هنأ نقيتسا نإو ءاملبا هحضنيلف هناكم ري ملو نقيتسي ملو ئش هباصأ .نسحأ هنفإ هلك هبوث لسغيلف هنأ نظ نفإ هباصأ يذلا لسغيلف (١) ئش هبوث باصفأ لجرلا ملتحا اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع هناكم ري ملو ينم هباصأ دق هنأ نقيتسا نإو ءاملبا هحضنيلف هناكم ري ملو نقيتسي ملو ئش هباصأ .نسحأ هنفإ هلك هبوث لسغيلف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If a man has a wet dream and something gets on his clothing, he should wash what was affected. If he thinks something got on it but isn't certain and doesn't see its location, he should sprinkle it with water. If he's certain semen got on it but doesn't see its location, he should wash all his clothing as that is better.

chapter: Impurity Of Semen
arabicText: يفخ اذإ هلك بوثلا لسغا :لقا ؟بوثلا بيصي ينملا نع هتلأس :لقا ةعامس نع ،ىسيع نب نامثع نع .اريثك وأ ناك لايلق هناكم كيلع
englishText: From Uthman bin Isa, from Sama'ah who said: I asked him about semen that gets on clothing? He said: Wash all the clothing if its location is unclear, whether little or much.

chapter: Impurity Of Semen
arabicText: نإو ،هلسغفا هناكم تفرع نإ :لقا ؟بوثلا بيصي ينملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هلك هلسغفا هناكم كيلع يفخ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about semen that gets on clothing? He said: If you know its location wash it, and if its location is unclear to you wash all of it.

chapter: Impurity Of Semen
arabicText: لتبي ىتح ءامسلا ينبيصتف ةبانجلا هيف نوكي بوثلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لأس هنأ ماحشلا ديز نع .كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقتو .ينملا ةساجن يفاني لاف بوثلا رهط رطملا نأ ههجو :لوقأ .هب سبأ لا :لاقف ؟لىع
englishText: From Zayd al-Shahham that he asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a garment that has traces of janabah (sexual impurity) on it, then rain falls on me until it gets wet on me? He said: There is no problem with it. I (Hurr Amili) say: The reason is that the rain purified the garment, so it does not contradict the impurity of semen. And what indicates this has preceded.

chapter: Purity Of Pre-Seminal Fluid (Madhi), Urinary Discharge (Wadi), Saliva, Mucus, Phlegm, And Suspicious Wetness
arabicText: .ءاش نإ ءاملبا هحضني :لاقف ؟بوثلا بيصي يذملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them) who said: I asked him about pre-seminal f luid that gets on clothing? He said: Sprinkle it with water if you wish.

chapter: Purity Of Pre-Seminal Fluid (Madhi), Urinary Discharge (Wadi), Saliva, Mucus, Phlegm, And Suspicious Wetness
arabicText: ،هب سبأ لا :لقا ؟بوثلا بيصي يذملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ءلاعلا يبأ نب نيسحلا نع .ءاملبا هحضني :لقا هيلع ناددر املف
englishText: From Al-Husayn bin Abi Al-'Ala who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about pre-seminal fluid that gets on clothing? He said: There is no problem with it. When we repeated the question to him, he said: Sprinkle it with water.

chapter: Purity Of Pre-Seminal Fluid (Madhi), Urinary Discharge (Wadi), Saliva, Mucus, Phlegm, And Suspicious Wetness
arabicText: تفرع نإ :لقا ؟بوثلا بيصي يذملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ءلاعلا يبأ نب نيسحلا نع .هلك بوثلا لسغفا هناكم كيلع يفخ نإو ،هلسغفا هناكم
englishText: From Al-Husayn bin Abi Al-'Ala who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about pre-seminal fluid that gets on clothing? He said: If you know its location then wash it, and if its location is hidden from you then wash the entire garment.

chapter: Purity Of Pre-Seminal Fluid (Madhi), Urinary Discharge (Wadi), Saliva, Mucus, Phlegm, And Suspicious Wetness
arabicText: :لقا ؟هب قزتليف بوثلا بيصي يذملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ءلاعلا يبأ نب نيسحلا نع لمحلا لمتحيو :لوقأ .مدقت امل بابحتسلاا لىع نلاومحم ناربخلا ناذه :خيشلا لقا * .أضوتي لاو هلسغي .ةيقتلا لىع
englishText: From Al-Husayn bin Abi Al-'Ala who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about pre-seminal fluid that gets on clothing and sticks to it? He said: Wash it and no ablution is needed. The Shaykh said: These two reports are interpreted as recommended based on what preceded. I (Hurr Amili) say: It may also be interpreted as taqiyyah.

chapter: Purity Of Pre-Seminal Fluid (Madhi), Urinary Discharge (Wadi), Saliva, Mucus, Phlegm, And Suspicious Wetness
arabicText: .سبأ هب سيل :لقا ؟بوثلا بيصي يذملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ريصب يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about pre seminal fluid that gets on clothing? He said: There is no problem with it.

chapter: Purity Of Pre-Seminal Fluid (Madhi), Urinary Discharge (Wadi), Saliva, Mucus, Phlegm, And Suspicious Wetness
arabicText: .هب سبأ لا :لقا ؟بوثلا بيصي قازبلا نع لئس (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع نأ هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father that Ali (peace be upon him) was asked about spittle (saliva) that gets on clothing? He said: There is no problem with it.

chapter: Someone Who Orders Another To Wash A Garment Impure With Semen, But They Don't Wash It, Then He Prays In It Before Verifying The Impurity, Must Repeat The Prayer
arabicText: هلسغ يف غلابت لاف ينملا نم يبوث لسغتف ةيراجلا رمآ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا رسيم نع .ئش كيلع نكي مل تنأ تلسغ تنك ول كنأ امأ ،كتلاص دعأ :لقا ،سبيا وه اذفإ هيف ليصفأ
englishText: From Muyassir who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I order the maid to wash my garment from semen, but she doesn't thoroughly wash it, then I pray in it and find it dry. He said: Repeat your prayer. However, if you had washed it yourself, nothing would have been required of you.

chapter: Obligation Of Removing Impurity From Clothes And Body, Whether Little Or Much, For Prayer Except A Small Amount Of Blood
arabicText: وأ ناك لايلق ،هناكم كيلع يفخ اذإ ،هلك بوثلا لسغا :لقا ؟بوثلا بيصي ينملا نع هتلأس :لقا ةعامس نع .اريثك
englishText: From Sama'ah who said: I asked him about semen that gets on the clothes? He said: Wash the entire garment if its location is unclear to you, whether it is little or much.

chapter: Obligation Of Removing Impurity From Clothes And Body, Whether Little Or Much, For Prayer Except A Small Amount Of Blood
arabicText: ةتكن ردق هدسج ضعب بيصيف لوبي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لئس لقا ،دياز نب نسحلا نع .هتلاص ديعيو هلسغي :لقا ؟هلسغي مل هنأ دعب ركذي مث ،ليصيف هلوب نم
englishText: From Al-Hasan bin Ziyad who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was asked about a man who urinates and some of his body gets a spot of urine on it and he prays, then remembers afterwards that he did not wash it? He said: He should wash it and repeat his prayer.

chapter: Obligation Of Removing Impurity From Clothes And Body, Whether Little Or Much, For Prayer Except A Small Amount Of Blood
arabicText: نع هلس :تلق نوميم نب ميهاربإ عم (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ ىلإ ةلأسمب تثعب :لقا ناكسم نبا نع ديعيو اهلسغي :لقا ؟اهلسغي مل هنأ كلذ دعب ركذيو ليصيف هلوب نم ةتكن ردق هذخف بيصيف لوبي لجرلا .هتلاص
englishText: From Ibn Muskan who said: I sent a question to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) with Ibrahim bin Maymun saying: Ask him about a man who urinates and his thigh gets a spot of urine on it, then he prays and remembers afterwards that he did not wash it? He said: He should wash it and repeat his prayer.

chapter: Permissibility Of Prayer With Impurity Of Clothes And Body With Blood Less Than The Size Of A Dirham When Combined, Except What Is Excluded
arabicText: طقن هبوث يف نوكي لجرلا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا - ثيدح يف - روفعي يبأ نب الله دبع نع لاو هلسغي :لقا ؟هتلاص ديعيأ ،لىص ام دعب ركذي مث ،لىصيف هلسغي نأ ىسنيف ملعي مث ،هب ملعي لا مدلا .ةلاصلا ديعيو هلسغيف اعمتجم مهردلا رادقم نوكي نأ لاإ ،هتلاص ديعي
englishText: From Abdullah ibn Abi Yafur- in a hadith- he said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who has blood spots on his clothes without knowing about it, then learns of it but forgets to wash it and prays, then remembers after prayer, should he repeat his prayer? He said: He should wash it but not repeat his prayer, unless it is the size of a dirham when combined, then he should wash it and repeat the prayer.

chapter: Permissibility Of Prayer With Impurity Of Clothes And Body With Blood Less Than The Size Of A Dirham When Combined, Except What Is Excluded
arabicText: نإو ،ةلاصلا ديعي لاف مهردلا ردق نم لقأ ناك نإ بوثلا يف نوكي مدلا يف :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ديعي لاف لىص ىتح هآر نكي مل نإو ،هتلاص دعيلف لىص ىتح هلسغي ملف هآر ناكو مهردلا ردق نم رثكأ ناك .ةلاصلا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) he said: Regarding blood on clothes, if it is less than the size of a dirham, he need not repeat the prayer. If it is more than the size of a dirham and he saw it but did not wash it until he prayed, he should repeat his prayer. If he had not seen it until after he prayed, he need not repeat the prayer.

chapter: Permissibility Of Prayer With Impurity Of Clothes And Body With Blood Less Than The Size Of A Dirham When Combined, Except What Is Excluded
arabicText: .متي :لقا ،امد هبوث يف رصبفأ ليصي لجرلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ناحرس نب دواد نع
englishText: From Dawud ibn Sarhan, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man who prays and sees blood on his clothes, he said: He should continue.

chapter: Permissibility Of Prayer With Impurity Of Clothes And Body With Blood Less Than The Size Of A Dirham When Combined, Except What Is Excluded
arabicText: ليصي نبأ سبأ لا :لاقا امهنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأو (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،انباحصأ ضعب نع نكي مل ام هب سبأ لاف كلذ لبق هبحاص هآر دق ناك نإو ،حضنلا هبش قارفتم مدلا هيفو بوثلا يف لجرلا .مهردلا ردق اعمتجم ليصي نبأ سبأ لا :لاقا امهنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأو (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،انباحصأ ضعب نع نكي مل ام هب سبأ لاف كلذ لبق هبحاص هآر دق ناك نإو ،حضنلا هبش قارفتم مدلا هيفو بوثلا يف لجرلا .مهردلا ردق اعمتجم
englishText: From some of our companions, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that they said: There is no problem if a man prays in clothes that have scattered blood like sprinkles, even if he had seen it before, as long as it is not combined to the size of a dirham.

chapter: Permissibility Of Prayer With Impurity Of Clothes And Body With Blood Less Than The Size Of A Dirham When Combined, Except What Is Excluded
arabicText: ةصمح ردق عمتجا نإ لاقف ،مد هنم جرخف يدلج تككح ينإ :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .مهردلا ةعس غولب لىع لمحلا لمتحيو :لوقأ .بابحتسلاا لىع لومحم اذه :خيشلا لقا .لاف لاإو ،هلسغفا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I told him: I scratched my skin and blood came out. He said: If it accumulates to the size of a chickpea, wash it, otherwise no need. The Shaykh said: This is interpreted as recommended. I (Hurr Amili) say: It might be interpreted as reaching the size of a dirham.

chapter: Permissibility Of Prayer With Impurity Of Clothes And Body With Blood Less Than The Size Of A Dirham When Combined, Except What Is Excluded
arabicText: هريغ بوث كيلعو هتيأر نإ :لقا ،ةلاصلا يف ناأو ليع بوثلا يف نوكي مدلا :هل تلق :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع مهردلا رادقم لىع دزي مل ام كيلع ةداعإ لاو كتلاص يف ضمفا هريغ بوث كيلع نكي مل نإو ،لصو هحرطفا مهردلا رادقم نم رثكأ وهو هتيأر دق تنك اذإو ،هرت مل وأ لبق هتيأر ،ئشب سيلف كلذ نم لقأ ناك امو .هيف تيلص ام دعفأ ةريثك ةلاص هيف تيلصو هلسغ تعيضف سيلو :دازو ثيدحلا ركذو (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ لقا هنأ ملسم نب دمحم نع هدانسإب قودصلا هاورو .لوبلاو ينملا ةلزنمب كلذ
englishText: From Muhammad ibn Muslim who said: I asked him about blood on clothes while I am in prayer. He said: If you see it and you have other clothes, remove it and pray. If you don't have other clothes, continue your prayer and no repetition is required unless it exceeds the size of a dirham. What is less than that is nothing, whether you saw it before or not. If you had seen it and it was more than the size of a dirham but you neglected washing it and prayed many prayers in it, repeat what you prayed in it. Al-Saduq narrated it through his chain from Muhammad ibn Muslim that he said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) and mentioned the hadith and added: This is not like semen and urine.

chapter: Permissibility Of Prayer With Impurity Of Clothes And Body With Blood Less Than The Size Of A Dirham When Combined, Except What Is Excluded
arabicText: نم كلذ هعنمي له بوثلا يف نوكي ثيغاربلا مد نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا يبلحلا نع .هلسغي لاو هحضني فاعرلا نم ههبشب اضيأ سبأ لاف رثك نإو ،لا :لقا ؟هيف ةلاصلا
englishText: From Al-Halabi who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about flea blood on clothes, does it prevent him from praying in it? He said: No, and even if it is much, there is also no problem with similar blood from nosebleed that is sprinkled and not washed.

chapter: Permissibility Of Prayer With Impurity Of Clothes And Body With Blood Less Than The Size Of A Dirham When Combined, Except What Is Excluded
arabicText: وأ اظيلغ ناك نإ :لقا ؟عنصي فيك حيقلا هنم ليسي لمدلا نع هتلأس :لقا هيخأ نع هباتك يف رفعج نب ليع رانيد ردق كبوث باصأ نإو ،ءوضولا كلذ ضقني لاو ،ةيشعو ةودغ نيترم موي لك هلسغفا مد نم طلخ هيف .هلسغت ىتح هيف لصت لاو هلسغفا مدلا نم .بابحتسلاا لىع لومحم ثيدحلا لوأو ابيرقت مهردلا ةعس ردقب رانيدلا ةعس :لوقأ
englishText: Ali bin Ja'far in his book from his brother, said: I asked him about the boil from which pus flows, what should one do? He replied: If it is thick or mixed with blood then wash it twice a day, morning and evening, and this does not invalidate the ablution. And if blood the size of a dinar gets on your clothes, wash it and do not pray in it until you wash it. I (Hurr Amili) say: The size of a dinar is approximately equal to the size of a dirham, and the first part of the hadith indicates recommendation.

chapter: Blood Types Where Small Amounts Are Not Excused
arabicText: هرصبت مد نم ةلاصلا داعت لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ وأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ريصب يبأ نع .ءاوس هري مل وأ هآر نإ بوثلا يف هريثكو هليلق نفإ ،ضيحلا مد ريغ
englishText: From Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), or Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Prayer is not repeated due to blood that you see except menstrual blood, for its small and large amounts on the garment are the same whether one sees it or not.

chapter: Blood Types Where Small Amounts Are Not Excused
arabicText: لاف كمد نم حضنلا هبش كبوث يف ناك اذإ ،كريغ مد نم فظنأ كمد لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هلسغفا اريثك وأ لايلق كريغ مد ناك نإو ،سبأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Your blood is cleaner than the blood of others. If there is something like a spray of your blood on your garment, there is no problem, but if it is someone else's blood, whether little or much, wash it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Prayer With Impurity Of Clothes And Body From Wounds And Ulcers Until They Heal, And The Recommendation Of Washing Clothes Once Daily
arabicText: املف ،امد هبوث يف نإ :يدئقا يل لاقف ،ليصي وهو (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ لىع تلخد :لقا ريصب يبأ نع .أربت ىتح يبوث لسغأ تسلو ليمامد يب نإ :يل لاقف ،امد كبوثب نأ ينربخأ يدئقا نإ :هل تلق فرصنا
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: I entered upon Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) while he was praying. My guide said to me: There is blood on his clothes. When he finished, I told him that my guide informed me there was blood on your clothes. He said to me: I have boils and I will not wash my clothes until they heal.

chapter: Permissibility Of Prayer With Impurity Of Clothes And Body From Wounds And Ulcers Until They Heal, And The Recommendation Of Washing Clothes Once Daily
arabicText: لاو ليصي :لقا ؟همد لسغي لاو هطبري نأ عيطتسي لاو حرجلاو حرقلاو هب لجرلا نع هتلأس لقا ةعامس نع .ةعاس لك هبوث لسغي نأ عيطتسي لا هنفإ ،ةرم لاإ موي لك هبوث لسغي
englishText: From Sama'ah who said: I asked him about a man who has boils and wounds and cannot bandage them or wash their blood? He said: He prays and does not wash his clothes except once daily, for he cannot wash his clothes every hour.

chapter: Permissibility Of Prayer With Impurity Of Clothes And Body From Wounds And Ulcers Until They Heal, And The Recommendation Of Washing Clothes Once Daily
arabicText: .هقاس نم ليسي مدلاو ليصي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تيأر :لقا يفعجلا ليعامسإ نع ،يقربلا نع ،هنعو
englishText: And from him, from al-Barqi, from Isma'il al-Ju'fi who said: I saw Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) praying while blood was flowing from his leg.

chapter: Permissibility Of Prayer With Impurity Of Clothes And Body From Wounds And Ulcers Until They Heal, And The Recommendation Of Washing Clothes Once Daily
arabicText: يمدت لازت لاف حورقلا هب جرخت لجرلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ملسم نب دمحم نع .ليست ءامدلا تناك نإو ليصي :لاقف ؟ليصي فيك
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim, from one of them (peace be upon them) who said: I asked him about a man who has ulcers that continuously bleed, how should he pray? He said: He prays even if blood is flowing.

chapter: Permissibility Of Prayer With Impurity Of Clothes And Body From Wounds And Ulcers Until They Heal, And The Recommendation Of Washing Clothes Once Daily
arabicText: هبايثو هدلجف حورقلاو ليمامدلا هب نوكت لجرلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا يدارملا ثيل نع .هيلع ئش لاو اهلسغي لاو هبايث يف ليصي لاقف ،هدلج ةلزنمب هبايثو ،احيقو امد ةولمم
englishText: From Layth al-Muradi who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): A man has boils and ulcers, and his skin and clothes are full of blood and pus, and his clothes are like his skin. He said: He prays in his clothes and does not wash them and there is nothing upon him.

chapter: Permissibility Of Prayer With Impurity Of Clothes And Body From Wounds And Ulcers Until They Heal, And The Recommendation Of Washing Clothes Once Daily
arabicText: لىع ردقي لا ناكم يف نوكي حرجلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا الله دبع يبأ نب نمحرلا دبع نع .هلسغت لا نأ كرضي لاف هعد :لاقف ،يبوث بيصيف حيقلاو مدلا هنم ليسيف هطبر
englishText: From Abdur Rahman bin Abu Abdullah who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): The wound is in a place that cannot be bandaged and blood and pus flow from it and get on my clothes. He said: Leave it, it does not harm you if you do not wash it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Prayer With Impurity Of Clothes And Body From Wounds And Ulcers Until They Heal, And The Recommendation Of Washing Clothes Once Daily
arabicText: همد نم هبوث باصفأ لئاس حرج لجرلبا ناك اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،نارهم نب ةعامس نع .مدلا عطقنيو أربي ىتح هلسغي لاف
englishText: From Sama'ah bin Mihran, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If a man has a flowing wound and his clothes are stained with its blood, he should not wash them until it heals and the blood stops.

chapter: Permissibility Of Prayer With Impurity Of Clothes And Body From Wounds And Ulcers Until They Heal, And The Recommendation Of Washing Clothes Once Daily
arabicText: هحسمي :لقا ؟ةلاصلا يف وهو رجفنيف لجرلبا نوكي لمدلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةلاصلا عطقي لاو ،ضرلأبا وأ طئاحلبا هدي حسميو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about an abscess that bursts on a man while he is in prayer? He said: He should wipe it and wipe his hand on the wall or on the ground, and not discontinue the prayer.

chapter: Purity Of Blood From Fish, Bed Bugs, Fleas, And Similar Creatures Without Soul, Even If Abundant And Excessive
arabicText: هب سيل :لقا ؟ثيغاربلا مد يف لوقت ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا روفعي يبأ نب الله دبع نع .رثك نإو :لقا ،شحافتيو رثكي هنإ :تلق ،سبأ
englishText: From Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): What do you say about flea blood? He said: There is no problem with it. I said: It becomes abundant and excessive. He said: Even if abundant.

chapter: Purity Of Blood From Fish, Bed Bugs, Fleas, And Similar Creatures Without Soul, Even If Abundant And Excessive
arabicText: ،بوثلا يف نوكي كذي مل ام مدب اسبأ ىري لا ناك (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .كمسلا مد ينعي ،لجرلا هيف ليصيف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed Ali (peace be upon him) saw no problem with the blood of what was not slaughtered being on the garment, and a man praying in it, meaning fish blood.

chapter: Purity Of Blood From Fish, Bed Bugs, Fleas, And Similar Creatures Without Soul, Even If Abundant And Excessive
arabicText: زوجي لهو ؟ثيغاربلا مد ىرجم قبلا مد يرجي له :(ملاسلا هيلع) لجرلا ىلإ تبتك :لقا نيارلا نب دمحم نع هيلع) عقوف ؟هب لمعيف اذه وحن لىع سيقي نأو ؟هيف ليصيف ثيغاربلا لىع قبلا مدب سيقي نأ دحلا .لضفأ هنم رهطلاو ،ةلاصلا زوجي :(ملاسلا
englishText: From Muhammad bin al-Rayyan who said: I wrote to the man (peace be upon him): Does bed bug blood follow the same ruling as flea blood? And is it permissible for someone to make an analogy between bed bug blood and flea blood and pray in it? And to make analogies like this and act upon it? He wrote (peace be upon him): Prayer is permissible, though purifying from it is better.

chapter: Purity Of Blood From Fish, Bed Bugs, Fleas, And Similar Creatures Without Soul, Even If Abundant And Excessive
arabicText: هعنمي له بوثلا يف نوكي ثيغاربلا مد نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا يبلحلا ثيدح مدقت دقو .رثك نإو ،لا :لقا ؟ةلاصلا نم كلذ
englishText: And previously came the hadith of al-Halabi who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about flea blood being on the garment, does it prevent one from prayer? And previously came the hadith of al-Halabi who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about flea blood being on the garment, does it prevent one from prayer? He said: No, even if abundant.

chapter: Purity Of Blood From Fish, Bed Bugs, Fleas, And Similar Creatures Without Soul, Even If Abundant And Excessive
arabicText: .فيشاشخلا لوبو قبلاو ثيغاربلا مدب سبأ لا :لقا هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع ،ثايغ ثيدحو
englishText: And the hadith of Ghiyath, from Ja'far, from his father who said: There is no problem with flea blood, bed bug blood, and bat urine.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing Only The Exterior Of The Body From Impurity, Not The Interior
arabicText: لىع هنم رهظ ام لسغيو جينتسي :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا تعمس :لقا دومحم يبأ نب ميهاربإ نع .ةلمنلأا هيف لخدي لاو جرشلا
englishText: From Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmoud who said: I heard Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) saying: One should clean himself after relieving and wash what appears on the anus without inserting the fingertip.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing Only The Exterior Of The Body From Impurity, Not The Interior
arabicText: ؟عنصي فيك امد ىريف ةلاصلا يف هفنأ سمي لجرلا يف (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ملسم نب دمحم نع .سبأ لاو هب مريلف اسبيا ناك نإ :لقا ؟فرصنيأ
englishText: From Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of them (peace be upon them both) regarding a man who touches his nose during prayer and sees blood, what should he do? Should he leave? He said: If it is dry, let him remove it and there is no problem.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing Only The Exterior Of The Body From Impurity, Not The Interior
arabicText: لسغا :لقا ؟هلسغ يف هب عنصي فيك حرجلا نع هتلأس :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هلوح ام
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: I asked him about how to wash a wound? He said: Wash what is around it.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing Only The Exterior Of The Body From Impurity, Not The Interior
arabicText: :لقا ؟هبحاص هب عنصي فيك حرجلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،نانس نب الله دبع نع .هلوح ام لسغي
englishText: From Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about what should one do with a wound? He said: Wash what is around it.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing Only The Exterior Of The Body From Impurity, Not The Interior
arabicText: لسغي نأ هيلع له ،مدلا هفنأ نم ليسي لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لئس :لقا يطبااسلا رامع نع .هنم رهظ ام لسغي نأ هيلع امنإ :لاقف ؟فنلاا فوج ينعي هنطبا
englishText: From Ammar al-Sabati who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was asked about a man whose nose bleeds, should he wash its interior meaning inside the nose? He said: He only needs to wash what appears of it.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing Only The Exterior Of The Body From Impurity, Not The Interior
arabicText: - ةدعقملا ينعي - اهنم رهظ ام لسغي نأ هيلع امنإ :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهنطبا لسغي نأ هيلع سيلو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: One only needs to wash what appears of it- meaning the anus- and one does not need to wash its interior.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing Only The Exterior Of The Body From Impurity, Not The Interior
arabicText: نأ كيلع امنإ ،ةنس لاو ةضيرف قاشنتسلااو ةضمضملا سيل :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع .رهظ ام لسغت
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Rinsing the mouth and nose is neither obligatory nor recommended practice, you only need to wash what appears.

chapter: Obligation Of Removing The Actual Impurity Not Its Trace, And The Recommendation Of Dyeing Blood Traces With Red Ochre If It Doesn't Go Away
arabicText: ضيحلا مد يبوث باصأ :تلقا - :لقا نأ ىلإ - هيبلأ دلو مأ هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) حلاصلا دبعلا نع .بهذيو طلتخي ىتح قشمب هيغبصا :لاقف ،هرثأ بهذي ملف هتلسغف
englishText: From Al-Abd Al-Salih (peace be upon him), he said: A slave girl of his father asked him- until he said: She said: My garment was stained with menstrual blood, so I washed it but its trace didn't go away. He said: Dye it with red ochre until it mixes and disappears.

chapter: Obligation Of Removing The Actual Impurity Not Its Trace, And The Recommendation Of Dyeing Blood Traces With Red Ochre If It Doesn't Go Away
arabicText: ءاجنتسلال نإ :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع ،ةريغملا نبا نع ،هيبأ نع ،ميهاربإ نب ليع نعو .اهيلإ رظني لا حيرلا :لقا ،حيرلا ىقبيو ةمثام ىقني هنفإ :تلق ،ةمث ام ىقني لا لقا ؟دح
englishText: From Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Al-Mughirah, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him: Is there a limit for cleaning oneself after relieving? He said: Until what is there is cleaned. I said: What if it is cleaned but the smell remains? He said: The smell is not to be considered.

chapter: Obligation Of Removing The Actual Impurity Not Its Trace, And The Recommendation Of Dyeing Blood Traces With Red Ochre If It Doesn't Go Away
arabicText: هتلسغف ضيحلا مد نم اهبوث باصأ ةأرما :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا روصنم يبأ نب ىسيع نع .طلتخي ىتح قشمب هغبصت :اهل لق :لقا ،اهبوث يف مدلا رثأ يقبف
englishText: From Isa bin Abi Mansur who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): A woman's garment was stained with menstrual blood, so she washed it but the blood trace remained in her garment. He said: Tell her to dye it with red ochre until it mixes.

chapter: Obligation Of Removing The Actual Impurity Not Its Trace, And The Recommendation Of Dyeing Blood Traces With Red Ochre If It Doesn't Go Away
arabicText: هتلسغو ضيحلا مد يبوثب نأ ةأرما هتلأس :لقا - ثيدح يف - هعفر يرعشلأا ىيحي نب دمحأ نب دمحم نع .قشمب هيغبصإ :لاقف ؟هرثأ بهذي ملو
englishText: From Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya Al-Ash'ari raising it- in a hadith- he said: A woman asked him that my garment has menstrual blood and I washed it but its trace From Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya Al-Ash'ari raising it- in a hadith- he said: A woman asked him that my garment has menstrual blood and I washed it but its trace didn't go away? He said: Dye it with red ochre.

chapter: Obligation Of Removing The Actual Impurity Not Its Trace, And The Recommendation Of Dyeing Blood Traces With Red Ochre If It Doesn't Go Away
arabicText: اهنم ذختي شرادلا دولج نع هلأس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا يبأ نع - ةرصبلبا نميلا نم حي مسقو .بلاكلا ءرخب غبدت اهنفإ اهيف لصت لا :لقا ،فافخلا .هدعب لا اهلسغ لبق اهيف ةلاصلا نع يهنلا لىع وأ ،يتيأو ىضم امل ةيهاركلا لىع لومحم اذه :لوقأ
englishText: And a living tribe from Yemen in Basra- from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) that he was asked about leather shoes made from darish (certain animal skins), he said: Don't pray in them for they are tanned with dog excrement. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted as being disliked based on what has passed and what will come, or as a prohibition of praying in them before washing, not after.

chapter: Obligation Of Removing The Actual Impurity Not Its Trace, And The Recommendation Of Dyeing Blood Traces With Red Ochre If It Doesn't Go Away
arabicText: أطيف قاقشلا هلجر يفو مامحلا يف أطي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا لئس لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم ئطو يتلا ،هلجربو هب عنصي فيك ،هلسغ دقو رذقلا نم ئطو امم دوسأ رثأ قاقشلا لخديف ةرونلاو لوبلا ئش لا لاقف ؟ائيش ىري لاو هرافظأ نم حيرلا دجيف جينتسيو هرافظبأ هرافظأ للخي مأ لسغلا هيزجيأ ؟امهب .هلسغ دعب قاقشلاو حيرلا نم هيلع
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) was asked about a man who walks in the public bath while having cracks in his feet, and he steps on urine and nurah (depliatory lime), causing black traces from the filth to enter the cracks even though he has washed it. What should he do about it and about his feet with which he stepped? Is washing sufficient for him, or should he clean under his nails with his nails when performing istinja, as he finds an odor from his nails but sees nothing? He replied: After washing, he is not responsible for the odor and the cracks.

chapter: Transfer Of Impurity With Contact And Moisture, Not With Dryness, And The Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On Clothes When They Touch A Dead Animal, Pig, Or Dog Without Moisture
arabicText: حسمف ءام هيف سيل عضوم يف لبا لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس لقا مساقلا نب صيعلا نع .هذخفو هركذ لسغي :لقا ؟هذخفو هركذ قرع دقو رجحب هركذ
englishText: From Al-Ees bin Al-Qasim who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who urinated in a place where there was no water, so he wiped his private part with a stone while his private part and thigh were sweaty? He said: He should wash his private part and thigh.

chapter: Transfer Of Impurity With Contact And Moisture, Not With Dryness, And The Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On Clothes When They Touch A Dead Animal, Pig, Or Dog Without Moisture
arabicText: نإو ،هلسغفا ةبوطر بلكلا نم كبوث باصأ اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا :لقا سابعلا يبأ لضفلا نع .ءاملا هيلع ببصفا فااج هسم
englishText: From Al-Fadhl Abu Al-Abbas who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: If moisture from a dog touches your clothes, wash them, and if it touches them while dry, pour water on them.

chapter: Transfer Of Impurity With Contact And Moisture, Not With Dryness, And The Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On Clothes When They Touch A Dead Animal, Pig, Or Dog Without Moisture
arabicText: .هلسغفا ابطر ناك نإو ،هحضنفا اسبيا ناك نفإ بلك كبوث سم اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If a dog touches your clothes, if it was dry then sprinkle water on it, and if it was wet then wash it.

chapter: Transfer Of Impurity With Contact And Moisture, Not With Dryness, And The Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On Clothes When They Touch A Dead Animal, Pig, Or Dog Without Moisture
arabicText: :لقا ؟بوثلا بيصي بلكلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ليع نع ،مساقلا نع ،هنعو .هلسغفا ابطر ناك نإو ،هحضنا
englishText: And from him, from Al-Qasim, from Ali, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a dog touching clothes? He said: Sprinkle water on it, and if it was wet then wash it.

chapter: Transfer Of Impurity With Contact And Moisture, Not With Dryness, And The Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On Clothes When They Touch A Dead Animal, Pig, Or Dog Without Moisture
arabicText: هل حلصت له ،تيم رامح لىع هبوث عقي لجرلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم هيخأ نع ،رفعج نب ليع .سبأ لاو هيف لصيلو ،هلسغ هيلع سيل :لقا ؟هلسغي نأ لبق هيف ةلاصلا
englishText: Ali bin Ja'far, from his brother Musa (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a man whose clothes fall on a dead donkey, is it permissible for him to pray in them before washing them? He said: He does not need to wash them, he may pray in them and there is no problem.

chapter: Transfer Of Impurity With Contact And Moisture, Not With Dryness, And The Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On Clothes When They Touch A Dead Animal, Pig, Or Dog Without Moisture
arabicText: نأ لبق هيف ةلاصلا حلصت له فاج وهو باوث باصأ ريزنخ نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم نب ليع نع .هيف ليصي مث ءاملبا هحضني معن :لقا ؟هلسغي
englishText: From Ali bin Muhammad (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a pig touching clothes while dry, is it permissible to pray in them before washing them? He said: Yes, sprinkle them with water then pray in them.

chapter: Transfer Of Impurity With Contact And Moisture, Not With Dryness, And The Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On Clothes When They Touch A Dead Animal, Pig, Or Dog Without Moisture
arabicText: ،تيم بلك لىع هبوث عقو لجرلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هيخأ نع ،رفعج نب ليع نع .سبأ لاو هيف ليصيو ءاملبا هحضني :لقا
englishText: From Ali bin Ja'far, from his brother Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a man whose clothes fell on a dead dog, he said: Sprinkle them with water and pray in them, there is no problem.

chapter: Transfer Of Impurity With Contact And Moisture, Not With Dryness, And The Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On Clothes When They Touch A Dead Animal, Pig, Or Dog Without Moisture
arabicText: يشمي لجرلا نع هتلأسو :دازو هلبق يذلاو ثيدحلا ركذو ،رفعج نب ليع هدج نع ،نسحلا نب الله دبع نع ؟هباصأ ام لسغي لاو ليصيف دجسملا لخدي نأ هل حلصي له ،هيلجرو هبوث بيصتف ةسبيا يهو ةرذعلا يف .سبأ لاف اسبيا ناك اذإ :لقا
englishText: From Abdullah bin Al-Hasan, from his grandfather Ali bin Ja'far, mentioning the hadith and what preceded it, and added: I asked him about a man who walks on excrement while it is dry and it touches his clothes and feet, is it permissible for him to enter the mosque and pray without washing what was touched? He said: If it was dry, there is no problem.

chapter: Transfer Of Impurity With Contact And Moisture, Not With Dryness, And The Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On Clothes When They Touch A Dead Animal, Pig, Or Dog Without Moisture
arabicText: مل نإو ،هلسغا :لقا ؟هب عنصي فيك للاتحلاا هبيصي شارفلا نع هتلأس :لقا هيخأ نع ،رفعج نب ليع نع نفإ ،كدسج نم باصأ ام لسغفا دسجلا بطر تنأو هيلع تمن نفإ ،سبيي ىتح هيلع مانت لاف لعفت .سبأ لاف باوث هنيبو كنيب تلعج مل نإو ،هلسغا :لقا ؟هب عنصي فيك للاتحلاا هبيصي شارفلا نع هتلأس :لقا هيخأ نع ،رفعج نب ليع نع نفإ ،كدسج نم باصأ ام لسغفا دسجلا بطر تنأو هيلع تمن نفإ ،سبيي ىتح هيلع مانت لاف لعفت .سبأ لاف باوث هنيبو كنيب تلعج
englishText: From Ali bin Ja'far, from his brother who said: I asked him about bedding affected by wet dreams, what should be done with it? He said: Wash it, and if you don't, then don't sleep on it until it dries, and if you sleep on it while your body is wet, wash whatever touched your body, and if you put a cloth between you and it, there is no problem.

chapter: Transfer Of Impurity With Contact And Moisture, Not With Dryness, And The Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On Clothes When They Touch A Dead Animal, Pig, Or Dog Without Moisture
arabicText: ،ملسملا اهيلع ماني ىراصنلاو دوهيلا بايث نع هتلأس لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم هيخأ نع ،رفعج نب ليع نع .سبأ لا :لقا
englishText: From Ali bin Ja'far, from his brother Musa (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about the clothes of Jews and Christians that a Muslim sleeps on. He said: There is no problem.

chapter: Transfer Of Impurity With Contact And Moisture, Not With Dryness, And The Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On Clothes When They Touch A Dead Animal, Pig, Or Dog Without Moisture
arabicText: ناك اذإ معن :لاقف ؟شرفي نأ حلصي ،هيف لابي وأ ةبانجلا نم هيف لستغي ناكملا نع هتلأس :لقا دانسلاباو .فااج
englishText: With the same chain he said: I asked him about a place where one performs ghusl from janabah or urinates in it, is it proper to lay bedding there? He said: Yes, if it is dry.

chapter: Transfer Of Impurity With Contact And Moisture, Not With Dryness, And The Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On Clothes When They Touch A Dead Animal, Pig, Or Dog Without Moisture
arabicText: هبوث بيصيف ةرذعلا نم هيلع ىفستف حيرلا بهتف ةرذعلا هيف ناكملبا رمي لجرلا نع هتلأس :لقاو :دازو .سبا لاف ،ليصيو هضفني ،معن :لقا ؟هلسغي نأ لبق هيف ليصي هسأرو
englishText: And added: I asked him about a man who passes by a place with excrement, and the wind blows some of it onto his clothes and head, can he pray in it before washing it? He said: Yes, he should shake it off and pray, there is no problem.

chapter: Transfer Of Impurity With Contact And Moisture, Not With Dryness, And The Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On Clothes When They Touch A Dead Animal, Pig, Or Dog Without Moisture
arabicText: سيلو لوبلا ىلإ جاتحفأ قوسلا ىلإ ودغأ ينإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا ميكح نب مكحلا نع .سبأ لا :لقا ؟كلذ دعب يدسج كحأ مث ،ضرلأباو طئاحلبا اهحسمأ مث يديب فشنتاو حسمتأ مث ،ءام يدنع
englishText: From Al-Hakam bin Hakim who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I go to the market early and need to urinate but have no water, so I wipe and dry with my hand then wipe it on the wall and ground, then scratch my body after that? He said: There is no problem.

chapter: Transfer Of Impurity With Contact And Moisture, Not With Dryness, And The Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On Clothes When They Touch A Dead Animal, Pig, Or Dog Without Moisture
arabicText: املف هبوث باصفأ ةسبيا ةرذع لىع ئطو (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ نأ - ثيدح يف - ملسم نب دمحم نع .سبأ لا :لاقف ،لىب :لاقف ؟ةسبيا يه سيلأ :لقا هربخأ
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim- in a hadith- that Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) stepped on dry excrement which touched his clothes, when he was informed about it he said: Isn't it dry? He said: Yes. He said: There is no problem.

chapter: Transfer Of Impurity With Contact And Moisture, Not With Dryness, And The Recommendation Of Sprinkling Water On Clothes When They Touch A Dead Animal, Pig, Or Dog Without Moisture
